The triangular geometry sets the two-face refraction problem; wavelength-dependent index makes the resulting directions differ.

cues.title: 转动同一块棱镜
cues.caption: 改变几何入射条件会改变偏向角，材料色散仍在。
cues.captionEn: Rotating the geometry changes deviation while material dispersion remains.
cues.zh: 继续保持同一组波长和同一种玻璃，只转动棱镜。光线与两个表面的相遇位置改变，内部路径和出射方向也随之变化。角度条也随真实出射方向移动。色散并不是一组固定的彩色斜线，观察到的分开程度同时受材料和几何条件影响。
cues.en: Keep the wavelengths and glass fixed, and rotate the prism. Entry, internal path, exit and outgoing direction all update together. The angle strip follows those actual directions. Dispersion is not a set of fixed coloured slopes: the observed separation depends on both the material relation and the incidence geometry.

cues.title: 单色光不会凭空成白光
cues.caption: 只输入一个波长，棱镜不会创造其他颜色。
cues.captionEn: One input wavelength does not create new colours in the prism.
cues.zh: 最后只留下单色光，再穿过同一块棱镜。仍然有折射，却没有凭空出现的其他颜色。前面展开的光谱，是把原本已经混在输入中的不同波长送向不同方向。本模型是线性透明介质里的传播，不包含会产生新频率的非线性过程。
cues.en: Leave just one wavelength in the input and send it through the same prism. Refraction remains, but no extra colours appear. The earlier spectrum separated wavelengths already present in the incident light. This is propagation through a linear transparent material, without nonlinear processes that could generate new frequencies.

cues.title: 从两条缝出发
cues.caption: 不同观察方向给相邻缝带来不同相位差。
cues.captionEn: Observation direction sets the phase difference between neighbouring slits.
cues.zh: 先用两条相同的狭缝。入射光相干，狭缝被均匀照亮，每条缝都对远处的场作出贡献。观察方向不同，相邻缝多走的路不同，强度便有起伏。横轴是角度正弦，不是平面接收屏的等距离坐标；曲线把中心峰归一为一。
cues.en: Begin with two identical coherent slits under uniform illumination. Each contributes to the far field. Different observation directions give different path differences between neighbours, producing an intensity pattern. The horizontal coordinate is sine of angle, not equal distance on a flat screen. Each curve is normalized to its own central peak.

cues.title: 增加缝，不改间距
cues.caption: 更多相干贡献让主峰变窄，主峰方向不因此改写。
cues.captionEn: More coherent slits narrow the principal peaks without changing their directions.
cues.zh: 保持波长、单缝宽度和中心间距，只增加被照亮的缝数。光栅在同一标尺上变宽，主峰的位置基本不变，却越来越窄。这里比较的是峰的形状，不是固定曝光照片；中心峰被归一化，不能从同样高的曲线推断实际峰值功率没有变化。
cues.en: Keep wavelength, slit width and centre spacing fixed while adding illuminated slits. The grating grows on a common scale. Principal directions stay fixed, but their peaks become narrower. These are normalized shape comparisons, not fixed-exposure photographs: equal plotted peak heights do not imply equal physical central intensity.

cues.title: 对准一个主峰
cues.caption: 相邻缝的路程差为整波长，相量同向相加。
cues.captionEn: Whole-wavelength path differences align the slit contributions.
cues.zh: 跟踪一阶主峰的方向，再把各条缝的场画成相量。相邻缝的光程差等于一个波长，增加的相位是完整一周，所以这些相量同向排成一条线。青色线段是合成结果。这个方向上的增强由所有缝共同形成，并不是光栅只允许几根独立光线通过。
cues.en: Select the first principal maximum and draw the contributions as phasors. Neighbouring paths differ by one wavelength, adding a complete cycle of phase. The vectors line up and add; the teal segment shows their resultant. Reinforcement is the collective far-field sum, not a filter that allows only a few independent rays through.

cues.title: 稍微偏开方向
cues.caption: 相量逐步转向，首尾闭合时合成场为零。
cues.captionEn: Phasors turn relative to one another; closure cancels the resultant field.
cues.zh: 只把观察方向偏开一点，各缝之间多出的相位就不再是整周。相量开始转向，最后首尾闭合，合成场接近零。对于更多条缝，只需更小的角度变化就能到达相邻的零点。这给出了主峰变窄的原因，而不只是让曲线看起来更尖。
cues.en: Move the observation direction slightly. The added phase between neighbouring slits is no longer a full cycle, so successive phasors turn. When the chain closes, the resultant field vanishes. With more slits, a smaller angular change reaches the adjacent zero. This explains narrowing rather than merely drawing a sharper curve.

cues.title: 同一光栅分开波长
cues.caption: 相同级次下，较长波长出现在更大的偏转角。
cues.captionEn: For the same order, a longer wavelength appears at a larger angle.
cues.zh: 固定同一光栅，比较蓝、绿、红三种波长。各自的一阶主峰出现在不同方向，较长波长通常离零级更远。中心零级仍然重合。这与普通玻璃棱镜的可见光顺序不同：这里选择方向的原因是相邻缝之间的周期性光程差，不是材料折射率随波长变化。
cues.en: Keep the grating and compare blue, green and red wavelengths. Their first principal maxima occur at different angles, with longer wavelengths farther from zero order. Zero order remains common. Unlike the visible ordering of an ordinary glass prism, this separation comes from periodic path differences between slits rather than material dispersion.

cues.title: 间距限制级次
cues.caption: 缩小缝距会把主峰推开，也使某些级次不再能传播。
cues.captionEn: Smaller spacing moves orders outward and can remove propagating orders.
cues.zh: 现在只减小缝中心间距。满足增强条件的方向向外移动，但角度正弦不能超过一。某些较高级次越过这个边界后，就不再对应真实的传播方向。显示的最大传播级次来自这个范围条件，并不是把所有整数都画成一定存在的亮线。
cues.en: Reduce only the centre spacing. Reinforcing directions move outward, but the sine of a real angle cannot exceed one. Some higher orders cross that boundary and cease to be propagating directions. The displayed maximum propagating order respects this limit; integers alone do not guarantee visible bright lines.

cues.title: 有级次，未必有亮线
cues.titleEn: An allowed order can still be dark
cues.caption: 单缝衍射包络为零时，主峰级次也会消失。
cues.captionEn: A single-slit envelope zero can suppress a principal order.
cues.zh: 最后恢复间距，把每条缝的宽度改成间距的一半。二阶方向仍满足相邻缝同相，但单条缝内部不同位置的贡献恰好抵消。虚线是单缝包络，二阶因此缺失。判断真实光栅图样，必须同时检查多缝干涉与每条缝自己的衍射，不能只记一个级次公式。
cues.en: Restore the spacing and make each slit half as wide as that spacing. The second order still aligns the slit-centre contributions, but contributions across each finite slit cancel there. The dashed single-slit envelope reaches zero and that order is missing. A real grating pattern requires both multi-slit interference and the diffraction of each slit.

cues.title: 轴线对齐时
cues.caption: 夹角为零，输入与输出同速。
cues.captionEn: Zero bend gives equal input and output speed.
cues.zh: 先让两根轴对齐。铜色输入轴匀速转动，青色输出轴以相同的速度跟随。注意中间的十字轴，它有两对互相垂直的轴颈，分别装在两个叉头里。转动通过真实的轴承连接传递，不是两根互不相连的轴同时播放动画。
cues.en: Start with the shafts aligned. The copper input turns uniformly, and the teal output follows at the same speed. Look at the central cross: its two perpendicular pairs of journals sit in the two yokes. Rotation passes through these bearing connections. The mechanism is slowed down so you can follow them.

cues.title: 弯折轴线，保持连接
cues.titleEn: Bend the axes, keep the connection
cues.caption: 十字轴允许两根传动轴带着夹角转动。
cues.captionEn: The cross connects shafts with intersecting axes.
cues.zh: 停在同一个输入转角，逐渐增加轴线夹角。叉头仍然连在十字轴两端，每对轴颈仍然垂直于自己的传动轴。正是这些空间约束，使输出转角和输入转角不再一一相等。下面的曲线开始偏离速度比为一的水平线。
cues.en: Hold the same input phase while increasing the bend. Both yokes remain attached to the cross, and each bearing-pin pair stays perpendicular to its own shaft. These spatial constraints make equal increments of input angle produce unequal increments of output angle. The speed-ratio curve starts to depart from one.

cues.title: 一圈里面，快慢两次
cues.titleEn: Two speed cycles in one turn
cues.caption: 30°夹角：输入120 rpm，输出约104–139 rpm。
cues.captionEn: At 30°: input 120 rpm, output about 104–139 rpm.
cues.zh: 保持三十度夹角，输入转速设为每分钟一百二十转。动画放慢，但读数按照这个真实转速计算。看输出标记和曲线上的移动点：一圈之内，输出加快和减慢各出现两次。这里的波动来自几何，完全不需要摩擦才能发生。
cues.en: Keep a thirty-degree bend and a constant input of one hundred and twenty revolutions per minute. The animation is slow, but speed readings use that reference. Follow the output marker and moving curve point. The output passes through two fast and two slow phases per revolution, purely because of geometry.

cues.title: 夹角改变波动大小
cues.caption: 在相同输入相位，增大夹角会扩大整圈速度波动。
cues.captionEn: Greater bend gives larger speed variation.
cues.zh: 再停在固定的输入相位，只改变夹角。整条曲线的峰谷逐渐拉开，输出不均匀的程度随之增加。把夹角调回零，曲线重新变平。这解释了为什么选用传动结构时，不能只确认它能接上两根轴，还要考虑工作夹角。
cues.en: Freeze the input phase again and change only the bend. Peaks and troughs spread farther apart across the entire curve. Returning to zero bend flattens it. Connecting two shafts is therefore only part of the design problem: their working angle also determines how unevenly a single joint transmits angular speed.

cues.title: 总圈数相同，瞬时速度不同
cues.caption: 输入每完成一圈，输出也完成一圈。
cues.captionEn: Each full input turn gives one full output turn.
cues.zh: 跟着累计圈数看两圈完整转动。中途，输入和输出可能略有领先或落后；每当输入完成一整圈，输出也完成一整圈。平均传动比等于一，并没有消除圈内的速度起伏。总行程和瞬时速度，是两个需要分别检查的量。
cues.en: Watch two complete turns with the accumulated turn counts. During each revolution the output can lead or lag slightly. At every complete input revolution, the output has completed one too. An average ratio of one does not remove the variation within each turn. Total rotation and instantaneous speed are different measurements.

cues.title: 第二节反向补偿
cues.caption: 夹角相等、相位正确：末端匀速，中间轴仍变速。
cues.captionEn: Equal bends, phased yokes: the final speed is steady.
cues.zh: 现在加入第二个万向节，两节都是三十度，中间轴两端叉头正确同相。中间轴的虚线仍有快慢变化，但末端输出的实线变成水平。第二节正好反向补偿第一节的变化。等速发生在最终输出，不能误以为中间每个部件都已经匀速。
cues.en: Add a second joint with the same thirty-degree bend and correctly phased intermediate yokes. The dashed intermediate-speed trace still varies, but the solid final-output trace becomes flat. The second joint exactly compensates for the first. Constant velocity at the final output does not mean every intermediate part turns uniformly.

cues.title: 少一个条件，波动就回来
cues.titleEn: Break one condition, restore the ripple
cues.caption: 第二节改为15°，抵消不再完整。
cues.captionEn: Changing the second bend to 15° leaves residual variation.
cues.zh: 保持叉头相位，只把第二节夹角改为十五度。末端输出的速度波动重新出现。两个万向节并不会自动组成等速传动；本例需要相等的夹角和正确的中间叉头相位。真实设计还要检查干涉、载荷和振动，这里的运动学模型只回答角度如何传递。
cues.en: Keep the yoke phasing but reduce the second bend to fifteen degrees. Final-output speed variation returns. Two universal joints do not automatically form a constant-velocity transmission. This arrangement requires equal bends and correct intermediate phasing. Real designs must also check interference, loads and vibration; this model answers the kinematic question.

cues.title: 根最大，不等于全体有序
cues.titleEn: Maximum root, not a sorted array
cues.caption: 父项不小于孩子；数组里的 7、8 仍可逆序。
cues.captionEn: Parents dominate children; array neighbors 7 and 8 can remain inverted.
cues.zh: 这棵树只守一条局部规则：父项不小于孩子。沿父链推回去，根上的九就是全局最大值。但数组中的七排在八前面，说明整列并没有排序。
cues.en: This tree keeps one local rule: parents are no smaller than their children. Following parent chains makes nine at the root the global maximum. Yet seven precedes eight in the array, so the whole row is not sorted.

cues.title: 先维持形状
cues.caption: 10 先接到下一个叶位，完整树没有空洞。
cues.captionEn: 10 first occupies the next leaf position, preserving completeness.
cues.zh: 新来的十并不直接挤到根上。先把它接到下一个叶位，让树的层序形状保持完整。树和下方数组使用同一份数据，这个新位置正是索引七。
cues.en: The new ten does not jump straight to the root. It first occupies the next leaf position, keeping the tree complete. The tree and array share one state; this new position is index seven.

cues.title: 沿父链上浮
cues.caption: 同一个 10 经过索引 7、3、1、0；其余分支不动。
cues.captionEn: The same 10 visits indices 7, 3, 1 and 0; other branches stay.
cues.zh: 十比自己的父项大，就与父项交换，再比较新的父项。追踪同一个金色节点，它只沿七、三、一、零这条索引路径上浮。其他分支原本已符合堆序，不需要重新排序。
cues.en: Ten exceeds its parent, so they swap, then it checks its new parent. Follow the same amber item through indices seven, three, one and zero. Other branches already satisfy heap order and do not need sorting.

cues.title: 弹出，再填根
cues.caption: 弹出 10，用最后的 3 填根，先保住完整形状。
cues.captionEn: Remove 10; the last 3 fills the root, preserving the complete shape.
cues.zh: 现在取走最高优先级的十。若直接删掉根，树会留下空洞。把最后一个三搬到根上，既移除了末尾叶位，又保住完整形状；接下来才修复被打破的堆序。
cues.en: Now remove the highest-priority ten. Simply deleting the root would leave a hole. Moving the last three to the root removes the final leaf and preserves completeness. Heap order is repaired next.

cues.title: 必须选较大孩子
cues.caption: 先选 9 而非 8，再让 3 沿同一条路径下沉。
cues.captionEn: Choose 9 over 8, then sink 3 along that path.
cues.zh: 三下面有九和八。必须让较大的九上来；如果选八，父项八下面仍有九，规则还会失败。三继续比较下一层的两个孩子，只沿一条路径下沉，直到不再需要交换。
cues.en: Three has children nine and eight. The larger nine must rise. Choosing eight would leave a larger nine below it, so the rule would still fail. Three compares the next pair of children and sinks along just one path until no exchange is needed.

cues.title: 逐次取出，不必全排
cues.titleEn: Repeated removal without a fully sorted heap
cues.caption: 每次只取根，输出优先级非增，最后队列为空。
cues.captionEn: Each removal takes the root; output is nonincreasing, until empty.
cues.zh: 重复取根并修复，离开队列的优先级依次下降。中间的数组始终只保证父子关系。相同优先级在本例额外按到达次序比较；这是明确加入的规则，不是堆天然具有的稳定性。
cues.en: Repeated root removal and repair produce nonincreasing priorities. Intermediate arrays still guarantee only parent–child order. This example adds arrival order to break priority ties. That is an explicit extra rule, not stability inherent in every heap.

cues.title: 输入不停，输出停一停
cues.caption: 输入连续转动，槽轮分步前进。
cues.captionEn: Continuous rotation produces discrete output steps.
cues.zh: 看金色销钉绕输入轴转一圈。它并没有中途停下，但绿色槽轮只在一小段时间里转动，其余时间保持不动。这种连续输入、间歇输出的关系，适合需要先移动到位、再留出操作时间的机构。先跟住销钉，看它什么时候真正碰到槽壁。
cues.en: Follow the gold pin through one input revolution. The pin keeps moving, but the green wheel turns during only part of the cycle and then stays still. This sequence suits a mechanism that must advance to a position and leave time for an operation. Watch when the pin actually reaches a slot.

cues.title: 销钉沿切线进入
cues.caption: 进入槽口时，输出速度从零开始。
cues.captionEn: Output starts from zero speed as the pin enters.
cues.zh: 在槽口附近放慢。销钉进入径向槽，开始通过槽壁推动从动轮。此时销钉的运动方向与槽的方向一致，输出转速从零开始。继续转动后，销钉到从动轴心的连线改变方向，槽轮就必须跟着转。入口位置由轴间距、曲柄半径和槽数共同决定。
cues.en: Slow down near the slot entrance. The pin enters the radial slot and starts pushing its walls. At entry, the pin travels along the slot direction and output speed begins at zero. As the line from output centre to pin changes direction, the wheel must turn with it. Entry geometry depends on spacing, crank radius and slot count.

cues.title: 一个槽，一次九十度
cues.caption: 四槽轮每次前进90°，中途速度更快。
cues.captionEn: A four-slot wheel advances 90°, speeding up within the move.
cues.zh: 跟完整个啮合区间。四槽轮从这一停歇位置转到下一个位置，恰好前进九十度。注意转速读数：入口和出口都回到零，中间更快。输入轴完成这一步也只转过九十度，所以平均每圈只走一步，却不意味着这一步走得很慢或匀速。
cues.en: Follow the complete engagement interval. The four-slot wheel advances ninety degrees to its next dwell position. Speed returns to zero at entry and exit and is higher between them. The input also uses only ninety degrees for this move. One step per input revolution does not mean the step itself is slow or uniform.

cues.title: 退出后，圆弧接手
cues.caption: 销钉离开后，配合圆弧保持输出位置。
cues.captionEn: Matching circular faces hold position after pin exit.
cues.zh: 销钉已经退出，为什么槽轮没有自由晃动？看标出的圆弧接触处。驱动盘上的锁止圆盘，与槽间的凹圆弧相配，保持这一位置。开始下一次分度时，锁止盘的让位缺口才转到槽轮附近，让它有空间转动。推动和锁止是两种不同的接触。
cues.en: The pin has left, so why does the wheel not turn freely? Look at the marked circular contact. The driving locking disc fits the concave face between slots and holds the output position. Its relief cut returns for the next index, giving the wheel room to move. Driving contact and dwell locking perform different jobs.

cues.title: 四槽与六槽比较
cues.caption: 槽数改变步长，也改变分度和停歇比例。
cues.captionEn: Slot count changes both step angle and timing fractions.
cues.zh: 先看四槽版本，再换成六槽，同时调整匹配的曲柄半径。每步从九十度变成六十度。下面的时间条也变了：分度从四分之一圈变为三分之一圈，停歇相应缩短。槽数不是单独的外观变化，它和进入角、曲柄半径、运动时序相互关联。
cues.en: Compare four slots with six while also changing the matching crank radius. Each step shrinks from ninety to sixty degrees. The timing band changes too: indexing grows from one quarter to one third of the input cycle, leaving a shorter dwell fraction. Slot count, entry angle, crank radius and timing are connected geometric choices.

cues.title: 提高转速，比例不变
cues.caption: 相同几何：时间缩短，输出峰值速度上升。
cues.captionEn: With fixed geometry, times shrink and peak output speed rises.
cues.zh: 最后保持四槽几何，提高参考输入转速。分度和停歇在一圈里所占的比例没有变化，但完成每圈的时间变短，输出的峰值转速变高。动画仍是慢放。真实机器还会遇到惯性和冲击负载；这个几何模型说明运动关系，不能代替零件的强度和转速设计。
cues.en: Keep the four-slot geometry and raise reference input speed. Index and dwell retain the same fractions of each turn, but each turn takes less time and peak output speed rises. The animation remains slowed. Real hardware also experiences inertia and impact loads; these kinematics do not establish a component strength or speed rating.

cues.title: 先分成八组
cues.caption: 根指向自己；每个成员开始各自成组。
cues.captionEn: Each root points to itself; every member starts in its own set.
cues.zh: 开始时八个成员各自是一组。根的父指针指向自己。判断两者是否同组，要沿各自的父指针找到根，而不是比较它们在图上的远近。
cues.en: Initially each of the eight members forms its own set. A root points to itself. To test whether two members share a set, follow their parent pointers to their roots, rather than compare their positions in the drawing.

cues.title: 合并的是根
cues.caption: 把小集合的根接到大集合，分量减一。
cues.captionEn: Attach the smaller root to the larger set; the count falls by one.
cues.zh: 把零和一合并，先找到它们的根，再连接根。相同大小时，这里按较小编号决定代表。两个成员现在都通向零，分量数由八变成七。
cues.en: To unite zero and one, first find their roots, then link roots. For equal sizes this example chooses the smaller label as representative. Both members now reach zero, and the component count falls from eight to seven.

cues.title: 按大小保持浅树
cues.titleEn: Use size to keep trees shallow
cues.caption: 合并较小的根，逐渐形成两个四成员集合。
cues.captionEn: Smaller roots attach as two four-member sets emerge.
cues.zh: 继续合并。每次只看两个根所记录的集合大小，让小集合接到大集合。已经在同组的成员不必逐个改标签。最后留下两棵各含四个成员的树。
cues.en: Continue joining sets. Each union compares the sizes stored at the two roots and attaches the smaller set. Existing members do not all need relabeling. Eventually two trees remain, each containing four members.

cues.title: 一组，不等于一层
cues.titleEn: One set can still have depth
cues.caption: 两根合并后，7 仍沿 7 → 6 → 4 → 0 查找。
cues.captionEn: After joining roots, 7 still follows 7 → 6 → 4 → 0.
cues.zh: 把两棵树的根合并，八个成员已经同组。但同组不代表每个成员都直接指向根。七仍经过六和四，才找到零；这些父指针是内部索引，不是原网络的道路。
cues.en: Joining the two roots puts all eight members in one set. That does not mean every member points directly to the root. Seven still passes through six and four to reach zero. These pointers are internal indices, not roads in an original network.

cues.title: 查找后压缩路径
cues.caption: 沿链找到 0，再把经过的非根成员直接指向 0。
cues.captionEn: Reach root 0, then redirect visited non-root members straight to it.
cues.zh: 查找先完整走过七、六、四、零，确认根是零。随后把经过的非根成员改指向零。七的下次查找只需跨一条链接。别的成员关系没有改变，只有将来访问这条路径的成本变了。
cues.en: A lookup first follows seven, six, four and zero to establish the root. It then redirects visited non-root members straight to zero. The next lookup from seven crosses one link. Membership stays the same; future access along this path becomes cheaper.

cues.title: 重复合并是空操作
cues.titleEn: A redundant union changes no sets
cues.caption: 1 与 7 已同根，分量数仍为 1。
cues.captionEn: 1 and 7 already share a root, so the count remains 1.
cues.zh: 再合并一和七，两者已经找到同一个根，分量数仍是一。并查集回答的是是否同组。它不提供最短路线，也不能仅靠删除一个父指针就正确撤销原网络的一条边。
cues.en: Unite one and seven again. Both already reach the same root, so the component count remains one. Union–find answers same-set membership. It neither finds shortest routes nor correctly deletes an original edge by merely removing a parent pointer.

cues.title: 先数未完成前提
cues.caption: A、B、C 入度为零，最初都可执行。
cues.captionEn: A, B and C have zero indegree and are initially ready.
cues.zh: 箭头表示前提必须先完成。每项下方的计数，表示还有多少前提没有解除。开始时，A、B、C 的计数都是零，可以从它们中的任意一项开始。
cues.en: An arrow means its prerequisite must finish first. The count below each task records unfinished prerequisites. Initially A, B and C all have zero, so any of them can be chosen first.

cues.title: 一个前提还不够
cues.caption: 完成 A 后，D 仍有来自 B 的一个前提。
cues.captionEn: After A, D still has its prerequisite from B.
cues.zh: 先输出 A，并移除 A 发出的依赖边。D 的计数由二降到一，仍不能执行。完成一个前提，并不等于完成所有前提；D 还在等 B。
cues.en: Output A and remove its outgoing dependency. D’s count falls from two to one, so it is not ready. Completing one prerequisite does not clear them all: D is still waiting for B.

cues.title: 就绪来自计数归零
cues.caption: 完成 B 后 D 就绪，E 却仍需等待 C。
cues.captionEn: B releases D, while E still waits for C.
cues.zh: 输出 B 后，两条发出的边一起解除。D 的最后一个前提消失，进入就绪区。E 的计数也减少，但还剩 C，因此不能跟着 D 一起就绪。
cues.en: Outputting B clears both outgoing dependencies. D loses its final prerequisite and enters the ready tray. E’s count also decreases, but C remains, so E is not ready yet.

cues.title: 正确顺序可以不唯一
cues.caption: C 完成后 D、E 都就绪，谁先都可满足依赖。
cues.captionEn: After C, both D and E are ready; either can come first.
cues.zh: 完成 C，D 和 E 同时出现在就绪区。先选哪一个都不会违反箭头方向。拓扑排序未必给出唯一答案；自由探索可以反过来挑选字母，检查每条边仍然向后。
cues.en: After C finishes, both D and E appear in the ready tray. Either choice respects the arrows. A topological order need not be unique. Exploration can reverse the letter preference while keeping every edge directed forward in the order.

cues.title: 所有前提解除才放行
cues.titleEn: Release only when every count clears
cues.caption: F 等 D、E 都输出后才就绪，完整顺序覆盖所有项。
cues.captionEn: F becomes ready after both D and E; the complete order includes every task.
cues.zh: 继续输出 D 和 E，它们分别解除 F 的一个前提。只有两项都完成，F 的计数才变成零。六项全部输出，才得到这个图的完整拓扑顺序；这里只约束先后，没有计算最佳工期。
cues.en: D and E each clear one of F’s prerequisites. Only after both finish does F reach zero. Outputting all six tasks gives a complete topological order. It constrains precedence; it does not calculate an optimal completion time.

cues.title: 环与下游阻塞
cues.titleEn: A cycle and its blocked descendants
cues.caption: 加入 E → B：环是 B ↔ E，D、F 只是被阻塞。
cues.captionEn: Add E → B: B ↔ E is the cycle; D and F are blocked downstream.
cues.zh: 现在加一条 E 指向 B 的前提。A、C 仍能完成，随后就绪区为空。B 等 E，E 又等 B，形成真正的环。D、F 也无法执行，但不在环上。剩余节点中有环，不代表每个剩余节点都是环的成员。
cues.en: Add E as a prerequisite of B. A and C can still finish, then the ready tray becomes empty. B waits for E and E waits for B: that is the actual cycle. D and F are also blocked, but are not on it. A cyclic remainder does not make every remaining vertex a cycle member.

cues.title: 已付出，加剩余下界
cues.titleEn: Cost paid plus a remaining lower bound
cues.caption: 普通格成本 1；曼哈顿值忽略墙，因此只是下界。
cues.captionEn: Plain cells cost 1; Manhattan distance ignores walls and is only a lower bound.
cues.zh: 从 S 到 G，只看横纵间距是八步。但墙可能迫使绕路，赭色格还更昂贵。曼哈顿值忽略这些代价，给出不高估的下界；它不是提前知道的真实答案。
cues.en: From S to G, horizontal and vertical separation totals eight steps. Walls can force detours and the ochre cell is more expensive. Manhattan distance ignores those costs, giving a lower bound, not advance knowledge of the actual answer.

cues.title: 选的是 g 加 h
cues.caption: 前沿按 f = g + h 比较，不只看谁离目标近。
cues.captionEn: The frontier compares f = g + h, not distance to the goal alone.
cues.zh: A 星给前沿中的每一项加两笔账。g 是已经付出的路线成本，h 是剩余估计，合起来叫 f。接下来选择最小的 f，而不是只挑几何上最接近目标的格子。
cues.en: A-star adds two quantities for every frontier item. g is the route cost already paid; h estimates what remains. Their sum is f. The next choice minimizes f, rather than simply choosing the cell nearest the goal.

cues.title: 障碍让真实成本增长
cues.caption: 遇墙要绕行；g 随真实进入的格子累加。
cues.captionEn: Walls force detours; g sums the actual entered cells.
cues.zh: 搜索碰到墙，就不能沿直线穿过去。路线绕行时，g 按实际进入的格子累加。前沿仍保留别的候选，比较它们的总估计，不把一次朝向目标的决定锁成唯一道路。
cues.en: The search cannot pass through a wall. As a route detours, g accumulates actual cell-entry costs. Other candidates remain on the frontier and compete by total estimate; one move toward the goal does not lock in a single route.

cues.title: 终点被选中才停止
cues.titleEn: Stop when the goal is selected
cues.caption: 合法下界下，终点从前沿取出，成本为 12。
cues.captionEn: With the valid lower bound, selecting the goal returns cost 12.
cues.zh: 合法下界引导这次搜索得到成本十二的路线。停止的时机是终点作为前沿最优项被取出。第一次看见目标还不能直接宣布最优，因为其他尚未完成的路线仍可能更便宜。
cues.en: The valid lower bound guides this search to a route costing twelve. It stops when the goal is selected as the best frontier item. First discovering the goal is not sufficient: an unfinished alternative might still be cheaper.

cues.title: 去掉估计也能求解
cues.titleEn: Remove the estimate, keep the optimum
cues.caption: h = 0 仍得到成本 12，本例需要取出更多项。
cues.captionEn: h = 0 still returns cost 12, with more selections on this map.
cues.zh: 把 h 改为零，只按 g 排前沿，就回到这张非负权地图上的 Dijkstra。两种方法都得到十二；合法估计在这里减少了取出次数。差异依赖地图和平局规则，并非每次都严格减少。
cues.en: Set h to zero and order only by g: this is Dijkstra on the nonnegative map. Both methods return twelve. Here the valid estimate reduces selections, but the difference depends on the map and tie rule; it is not always a strict reduction.

cues.title: 高估会改变答案
cues.caption: 六倍曼哈顿估计先取到成本 15，超过最优的 12。
cues.captionEn: Sixfold Manhattan selects a cost-15 goal before the cost-12 optimum.
cues.zh: 现在把曼哈顿估计放大六倍。搜索更急于靠近目标，走过成本为六的赭色格，先取出总成本十五的终点。十二的路线仍存在。更强烈的方向感，不能替代不高估这个最优性前提。
cues.en: Multiply Manhattan distance by six. The search favors approaching the goal more strongly, crosses the cost-six ochre cell and selects a goal costing fifteen. A route costing twelve still exists. A stronger directional preference does not replace the no-overestimation condition for optimality.

cues.title: 没有路线也是结果
cues.titleEn: No route is a valid result
cues.caption: 封闭整列墙后，前沿耗尽，终点不可达。
cues.captionEn: Seal the column: the frontier empties and the goal is unreachable.
cues.zh: 最后封闭整列墙。搜索可以检查起点这一侧，却没有办法到达 G。当前沿耗尽，正确结果是不可达，不是把最后访问过的父链伪装成一条成功路线。
cues.en: Finally seal the entire column. Search can inspect the start side but cannot reach G. Once the frontier is exhausted, the correct result is unreachable, not a successful route made from the last visited parent chain.

cues.title: 先有一幅实像
cues.caption: 同一远方物点的平行光，在物镜后交于同一点。
cues.captionEn: Parallel rays from one distant point meet behind the objective.
cues.zh: 先只看物镜。每一种颜色代表远处的一个物点，同色的三条光线互相平行，却从物镜不同高度进入。它们在物镜焦平面会合成一个点。不同方向来的物点落在不同位置，于是形成中间实像。这里的颜色只是帮助认出同一束光，不是在演示色散。
cues.en: Start with the objective. Each colour identifies a point far away. Its three parallel rays enter at different heights and meet at one point in the focal plane. Another direction forms another point. Together they make an intermediate real image. Colours help us follow the fields; they do not represent different wavelengths.

cues.title: 目镜接着做什么
cues.caption: 中间实像位于目镜前焦面，出射光重新平行。
cues.captionEn: The intermediate image lies in the eyepiece focal plane.
cues.zh: 沿着实像继续向右看。把目镜放在它后面一个目镜焦距的位置，同一个像点发出的光经过目镜后重新平行。放松调焦的眼睛可以接收它，好像物体仍在远方。望远镜放大的是进入眼睛的角度，负号说明图像上下颠倒；并不是把物镜焦面上的实像再投到出瞳处。
cues.en: Follow the rays beyond that image. Place the eyepiece one eyepiece focal length farther on. Rays from each image point leave parallel again, suitable for a relaxed eye. The telescope enlarges the viewing angle. The negative sign means inversion. The intermediate image and the exit pupil have different roles and different locations.

cues.title: 短目镜的代价
cues.caption: 目镜焦距变短，角放大率增加，出瞳同时变小。
cues.captionEn: A shorter eyepiece raises magnification and shrinks the exit pupil.
cues.zh: 现在逐渐缩短目镜焦距，同时移动目镜保持清晰。相同的中间像，被转换成更大的出射角，角放大率的绝对值随之增加。但物镜收集的光没有因此变多。看下面的出瞳直径，它正在缩小：把视角放大和把光束变窄，是同一个光路的两面。
cues.en: Shorten the eyepiece focal length and refocus by moving it. The same intermediate image now produces a larger output angle. The objective has not collected any extra light. Meanwhile the exit pupil becomes smaller. Greater angular magnification and a narrower emerging beam follow from the same pair of lenses.

cues.title: 出瞳不是星像
cues.titleEn: The pupil is not the star image
cues.caption: 出瞳是物镜孔径的像；多个视场的光束在这里对齐。
cues.captionEn: The exit pupil images the objective aperture, not a star.
cues.zh: 把观察切到光束截面。三种颜色仍然对应三个视场。在出瞳平面，它们的圆形光束中心重合，浅色轮廓是直径四毫米的眼瞳。物镜直径四十毫米、放大十倍，出瞳就是四毫米。这个小圆是物镜孔径经过目镜所成的像，不是被放大的天体图像。
cues.en: Switch to a cross-section of the beams. The colours still identify three fields. At the exit-pupil plane their circular footprints share a centre. The pale outline is a four-millimetre eye pupil. A forty-millimetre objective at ten-times magnification gives a four-millimetre exit pupil. This circle images the aperture, not the astronomical object.

cues.title: 眼睛前后移动
cues.titleEn: Move the eye along the axis
cues.caption: 离开出瞳平面，离轴视场先受到遮挡。
cues.captionEn: Away from the exit pupil, off-axis fields become clipped.
cues.zh: 保持眼睛横向居中，只把它移近目镜。中间视场仍然通过，另外两个视场的光束中心却逐渐分开。眼瞳不能同时接住完整的三束光，下面的比例显示各束进入眼睛的面积。这就是为什么只把眼睛对准目镜中心还不够，前后位置也影响能看全多少视场。
cues.en: Keep the eye centred but move it toward the eyepiece. The central field still passes, while the two off-axis beam centres separate. The eye can no longer catch all three circular beams completely. The percentages show their captured areas. Centring the eye is only part of the task; its distance from the eyepiece also matters.

cues.title: 横向偏离
cues.caption: 光路没有消失，眼瞳与光束的重叠面积变小了。
cues.captionEn: The beam remains, but less of it overlaps the eye pupil.
cues.zh: 回到出瞳平面，再把眼瞳横向移开。三束光仍在原来的位置，只有眼睛接收到的部分逐渐减少。在这组四毫米直径的条件下，偏移四毫米后，两个圆只剩相切，入眼面积变成零。自由探索可以同时改变口径、目镜焦距和眼睛位置，比较放大率与可接收光束的关系。
cues.en: Return to the exit-pupil plane and shift the eye sideways. The beams stay where they were, but their overlap with the eye decreases. With both diameters set to four millimetres, a four-millimetre offset leaves only tangency and zero captured area. Explore aperture, eyepiece focal length and eye position to compare the consequences.

cues.title: 一面镜只翻一项
cues.caption: 镜面反转垂直于它的方向分量，另外两项保留。
cues.captionEn: A mirror reverses its normal component and keeps the other two.
cues.zh: 从一面镜开始。金色光线从三角入口进入，碰到第一面后转向；箭头和光点标出传播顺序。镜面只把垂直于自己的方向分量反过来，沿镜面的两个分量不变。一般斜射时，这样的返回方向不会指向来处。这里其余两面暂时敞开，让一次反射的结果单独显现。
cues.en: Begin with one mirror. The gold ray enters through the triangular opening and changes direction at the first face. Arrows and a moving point show the travel order. A reflection reverses only the component normal to that mirror, leaving two tangential components unchanged. For general incidence, one bounce does not send the ray back toward its source.

cues.title: 两面仍少一项
cues.caption: 在三维中，两次垂直反射仍保留第三个分量。
cues.captionEn: Two perpendicular reflections still preserve the third component.
cues.zh: 补上第二面互相垂直的镜子。同一条入射光现在先后翻转两个方向分量，第三项仍然保持原号。所以二维纸面里常见的直角返回，在一般三维入射中还不够。看实际离开的光线，它与入射反向仍有夹角；反射次数增加，不等于已经回归。
cues.en: Add a second perpendicular mirror and keep the same incoming ray. Two direction components reverse, but the third retains its sign. A right-angle pair that returns a ray in a two-dimensional drawing is not sufficient for general three-dimensional incidence. The outgoing ray still has a measurable angular error from the reverse of the incoming direction.

cues.title: 第三面完成反向
cues.caption: 真正经历三面反射后，三个分量全部反号。
cues.captionEn: After three actual reflections, all three components reverse.
cues.zh: 现在第三面也成为反射镜。沿着编号追踪，光线每次碰到一个不同的面，最后一个未翻转的分量也反过来。三个分量都变成原来的相反数，出射方向就与入射方向反向平行。浅蓝光线回到光源所在的一侧，误差读数降为零。
cues.en: Now make the third face reflective. Follow the numbered encounters. At each new face, one more direction component reverses. After the third, all three are the negatives of their original values, so the outgoing direction is antiparallel to the incoming one. The pale-blue ray heads back toward the source side with zero ideal angular error.

cues.title: 不必每次瞄正
cues.caption: 入射方向变化，只要仍遇到三面，返回关系保留。
cues.captionEn: The return persists while the changed ray still reaches all three faces.
cues.zh: 在入口附近缓缓改变入射方向，镜面保持不动。反射点跟着移动，光在内部走过的折线路径也改变，但只要它仍然遇到三个互相垂直的面，三个分量最终都会反号。这种对方向变化的容忍，使回归反射器适合不容易始终精确对准的测量与标记。
cues.en: Vary the incoming direction while keeping the mirrors fixed. The encounter points move and the folded path changes. As long as the ray still reaches all three perpendicular faces, every component is reversed by the end. This tolerance of changing aim is useful when a reflector cannot remain perfectly aligned with a distant source.

cues.title: 平行不等于原路
cues.titleEn: Parallel is not the same line
cues.caption: 返回方向相反，两条直线仍可有横向间隔。
cues.captionEn: Opposite directions can belong to laterally separated lines.
cues.zh: 保持入射方向不变，只移动入口位置。返回仍然反向平行，但入口和出口通常不重合，两条延长直线之间出现横向间隔。下面的间隔按真实三维几何计算，不是屏幕上看到的距离。回归反射意味着光回到来处的方向，不能一概理解成每条光线都重走自己的原路。
cues.en: Keep the direction fixed and move the entry point. The return remains antiparallel, but the entry and exit usually differ. Their extended lines have a lateral separation, calculated in three dimensions rather than measured on the projected screen. Retroreflection means returning toward the source direction; it does not require every individual ray to retrace exactly the same line.

cues.title: 有限大小的边界
cues.caption: 这条边缘光只遇到两面，已经从入口离开。
cues.captionEn: This edge ray leaves through the entrance after only two encounters.
cues.zh: 最后把入射点移到三角入口的边缘附近。这条光线没有等到第三面，就已重新穿过入口离开。因此实际反射次数只有两次，反向误差不再为零。三面镜能保证的是三次正交反射后的方向关系；有限大小、入口位置和入射方向，决定这三次反射是否真的发生。
cues.en: Move the entry near an edge of the triangular opening. This ray crosses the entrance again before reaching the third face. Only two reflections actually occur, and its return error is no longer zero. The three-mirror rule describes the result of three orthogonal reflections. Finite size, entry position and incidence determine whether those reflections happen at all.

cues.title: 容量与守恒
cues.caption: 边有容量上限，中间节点必须流入等于流出。
cues.captionEn: Edges have capacity bounds; intermediate vertices conserve flow.
cues.zh: 每条边标出当前流量和容量上限。S 提供，T 接收，中间的 A 和 B 不能凭空制造或存下流量。这里要增加的是源到汇的净分配，不是寻找一条最短路线。
cues.en: Every edge shows assigned flow and its capacity limit. S supplies, T receives, and A and B cannot create or store flow. The objective is greater net source-to-sink allocation, not a shortest route.

cues.title: 先选一条有效绕路
cues.caption: 先沿 S → A → B → T 发送 1，瓶颈是中间边。
cues.captionEn: Send 1 on S → A → B → T; the middle edge is the bottleneck.
cues.zh: 先刻意选择一条有效绕路，经过 A 再经过 B。中间边容量只有一，所以整条路径最多增加一。所有中间节点仍守恒，但这次分配未必适合后续需求。
cues.en: Deliberately choose a valid detour through A and then B. The middle edge has capacity one, limiting the entire augmentation to one. Intermediate vertices conserve flow, but this initial allocation may need revising later.

cues.title: 正向看似走不通
cues.caption: 直接路线把总量增到 3，B → T 已满。
cues.captionEn: Direct routes raise the total to 3, saturating B → T.
cues.zh: 再沿直接路线增加分配，总流量来到三。B 到 T 已满，原方向看似没有完整路可走。但 S 到 B 还有一单位空间，A 到 T 也有一单位空间；问题在于先前那次跨接。
cues.en: Direct routes increase the total to three. B to T is full, and original forward directions appear to offer no complete route. Yet S to B and A to T each have one unit free. The earlier cross-allocation is the obstacle.

cues.title: 反向残余允许改账
cues.titleEn: Reverse residual capacity revises an allocation
cues.caption: A → B 已有 1，因此 B → A 允许撤回 1。
cues.captionEn: A → B carries 1, so B → A may cancel 1.
cues.zh: A 到 B 已经分配一，所以残余网络允许从 B 回到 A，撤回这一单位。它不是新管道。现在 S、B、A、T 构成一条残余路径，最小可调整量仍是一。
cues.en: A to B already carries one, so the residual network allows a move from B back to A that cancels that unit. This is not a new pipe. S, B, A and T now form a residual path whose bottleneck permits one unit of adjustment.

cues.title: 撤回局部，增加整体
cues.caption: A → B 从 1 变 0，总流量从 3 变 4。
cues.captionEn: A → B falls from 1 to 0 while total flow rises from 3 to 4.
cues.zh: 沿这条残余路径调整。S 到 B 加一，A 到 T 加一，A 到 B 减一。A 和 B 的流入流出仍相等，源与汇的净流量却一起从三升到四。撤回旧选择，让新的整体分配成为可能。
cues.en: Adjust along that residual path. Add one on S to B and A to T, and subtract one on A to B. Both interior vertices still conserve flow, while net source and sink flow rise from three to four. Revising an old choice enables a better overall allocation.

cues.title: 用上界证明完成
cues.titleEn: Certify completion with an upper bound
cues.caption: 割容量 2 + 2 = 4，已实现的流量正好达到它。
cues.captionEn: The cut capacity is 2 + 2 = 4, exactly matching achieved flow.
cues.zh: 最后，残余网络已无法从 S 到达 T。把仍可到达的节点留在源侧，跨向另一侧的容量总和是四。任何可行流都不能超过这个割上界；现在已经达到四，因此这次最大流有了明确的证据。
cues.en: Finally T is unreachable from S in the residual network. Keep still-reachable vertices on the source side: the capacities crossing to the other side total four. No feasible flow can exceed this cut bound. Achieving four therefore certifies maximum flow.

cues.title: 正向走过一颗颗齿
cues.caption: 斜面抬起棘爪，弹簧让它落回。
cues.captionEn: The ramp lifts the pawl; the spring returns it.
cues.zh: 看这只带不对称齿的轮子正向转动。金色棘爪只沿固定导向上下移动，弹簧把它压向齿面。每经过一个齿，它先被抬起，然后落回。外部驱动使轮子向前，棘爪负责约束方向，不会凭空给轮子增加动力。
cues.en: Watch the asymmetric wheel turn forward. The gold pawl slides in a fixed guide, with a spring pressing it toward the teeth. Each tooth lifts it before it drops back. An external drive supplies forward motion. The pawl constrains direction; it does not add energy to the wheel.

cues.title: 近看斜面与回位
cues.titleEn: Look closely at the ramp and return
cues.caption: 有限宽度的棘爪沿真实齿面升降。
cues.captionEn: The finite pawl follows the actual tooth face.
cues.zh: 近看棘爪的底面。齿的斜面逐渐进入它下面，把它向上推，弹簧随之压缩。齿尖通过后，弹簧让棘爪回到较低位置。这个模型把回位理想化为准静态过程，重点看斜面如何让开正向运动，以及导向怎样限制棘爪的位置。
cues.en: Look closely beneath the pawl. The ramp advances under its flat end, raising it and compressing the spring. After the tip clears, the spring returns it to a lower position. This quasistatic example idealizes that return. Follow how the ramp permits forward motion while the guide constrains the pawl.

cues.title: 先退一点，才碰到止挡
cues.caption: 前进49.5°后，12齿轮可回退19.5°。
cues.captionEn: After 49.5° of advance, a twelve-tooth wheel can roll back 19.5°.
cues.zh: 轮子已经前进四十九点五度，现在尝试回退。注意，它确实先退了一小段，才碰到最近的止挡。十二颗齿每隔三十度重复一次，这里实际退了十九点五度。单向约束并不代表任意位置都没有空回，要看上一颗齿的工作面在哪里。
cues.en: The wheel has advanced forty-nine and a half degrees. Now request a reversal. It really does roll back a little before meeting the previous stop. Twelve teeth repeat every thirty degrees, so this case allows nineteen and a half degrees of rollback. One-way holding does not mean zero lost motion at every position.

cues.title: 陡面把反向作用传到导向
cues.titleEn: The steep face transfers load to the guide
cues.caption: 虚线目标继续回退，实际轮子已被挡住。
cues.captionEn: The dashed target continues backward; the wheel stays held.
cues.zh: 继续把回退目标移得更远。虚线在走，实际轮子却停住。近看陡齿面与棘爪侧面的接触，反向作用被传给固定导向。这里没有靠更大的摩擦把轮子粘住，而是两块实体不能互相穿过。这个简化构型的止挡力沿横向，不会把棘爪直接向上推出。
cues.en: Move the rollback target farther. The dashed target moves, but the wheel stays held. In the close view, the steep tooth face meets the pawl side and transfers the reaction to the fixed guide. The stop comes from geometric contact. In this ideal arrangement the reaction acts sideways instead of pushing the pawl upward.

cues.title: 抬起棘爪，约束解除
cues.titleEn: Lift the pawl to release the constraint
cues.caption: 离开全部齿尖后，同一轮子可以反转。
cues.captionEn: Clear the tooth tips and the same wheel can reverse.
cues.zh: 先把棘爪沿导向提起，直到它完全高于齿尖，再继续回退。原来被挡住的轮子现在可以反转了。轮子和齿形都没有改变，改变的是接触条件。也因此，保持啮合的弹簧和实际解锁机构，都是棘轮装置里需要认真设计的部件。
cues.en: Lift the pawl along its guide until it clears every tooth tip, then continue the rollback. The same wheel can now reverse. Neither the wheel nor its tooth shape changed; the contact constraint changed. Biasing springs and real release mechanisms are therefore functional parts of a ratchet assembly.

cues.title: 更多齿，较小的空回区间
cues.titleEn: More teeth, a smaller lost-motion interval
cues.caption: 相同前进22°：12齿与24齿停在不同位置。
cues.captionEn: After the same 22° advance, twelve and twenty-four teeth stop differently.
cues.zh: 最后用相同的二十二度前进量，比较十二齿与二十四齿。回退时，两者遇到的最近止挡不同。更多齿把每个空回区间分得更细，但并不让所有位置都变成零间隙。真实选型还要兼顾齿的尺寸和承载能力，不能只按齿数判断好坏。
cues.en: Compare twelve and twenty-four teeth after the same twenty-two-degree advance. During rollback they meet different previous stops. More teeth divide the lost-motion intervals more finely, but do not remove clearance at every position. Real selection must also consider tooth dimensions and load capacity, rather than judging by tooth count alone.

cues.title: 公共状态与私有草稿
cues.caption: 初始余票 1、订单 0，两者合计等于容量。
cues.captionEn: Initially stock 1 plus orders 0 equals capacity.
cues.zh: 这里只有一张余票。一次预订必须把余票减一，并增加一张订单。先区分已经提交的公共状态和每笔事务尚未公布的草稿，才能看清别人究竟能读到什么。
cues.en: There is one ticket. A reservation must reduce stock and create an order. Separate the committed public state from each transaction’s unpublished draft to understand what other readers can actually observe.

cues.title: 准备修改不立即公布
cues.caption: T1 拟写 0，但公共状态仍是余票 1、订单 0。
cues.captionEn: T1 stages 0 while public stock stays 1 and orders stay 0.
cues.zh: T1 读到一，在本地准备把余票写成零，并创建自己的订单。公共状态暂时不变。提交时两项变化必须一起生效，不能只让别人看到余票减少，却看不到订单。
cues.en: T1 reads one and privately prepares stock zero plus its own order. Public state stays unchanged. Commit must publish both changes together, rather than expose reduced stock without the order.

cues.title: 回滚丢弃整笔草稿
cues.caption: 未提交的拟写被丢弃，公共状态保持 1、0。
cues.captionEn: Discard uncommitted writes; public state remains 1 and 0.
cues.zh: 现在不提交，而是回滚。T1 的拟写被丢弃，余票仍是一，成功订单仍是零。回滚保护的是这笔尚未提交的修改，并不需要让别人的已提交工作一起倒退。
cues.en: Now roll back instead of committing. T1’s proposed write is discarded, leaving one ticket and zero orders. Rollback removes this uncommitted work; it does not undo other transactions’ committed work.

cues.title: 两笔原子，也可能冲突
cues.titleEn: Two atomic commits can still conflict
cues.caption: 两者先读 1，再各写 0，最后出现两张订单。
cues.captionEn: Both read 1, then each writes 0, producing two orders.
cues.zh: 让 T1 和 T2 都先读到一，再各自在本地算出零。第一笔提交后余票零、订单一。第二笔仍把旧读数算出的零写回，又新增订单。两笔各自都是完整提交，整体却把一张票预订了两次。
cues.en: Let T1 and T2 both read one and privately compute zero. The first commit gives stock zero and one order. The second writes its stale zero and adds another order. Both commits are individually whole, yet the single ticket has been reserved twice.

cues.title: 提交前检验旧读数
cues.caption: T1 改变版本，T2 的旧版本整笔中止，订单不公布。
cues.captionEn: T1 changes the version; T2’s stale transaction aborts without an order.
cues.zh: 加入版本校验。第一笔提交会改变库存版本。第二笔提交时，发现自己读取的版本已经过期，于是整笔中止，拟写和订单都不发布。这里演示单库存的乐观检查，不冒充某个数据库的内部隔离实现。
cues.en: Add version validation. The first commit changes the stock version. At commit, the second sees that its read version is stale and aborts the whole update: neither its write nor its order is published. This is a single-stock optimistic check, not a particular database’s isolation implementation.

cues.title: 重试必须重新读取
cues.caption: 第二位重试读到 0，拒绝预订，库存约束保持。
cues.captionEn: The retry reads 0 and refuses the reservation, preserving the invariant.
cues.zh: 第二位从新状态重试，读到余票已经为零，不能再创建订单。原子性、并发隔离和失败重试是不同环节。校验失败没有替用户自动成功；重试必须重新读取，并重新判断业务条件。
cues.en: The second requester retries from fresh state, reads stock zero and cannot create an order. Atomicity, concurrent isolation and retry handling are separate parts. Validation failure does not fulfill a request automatically: retry must reread and recheck the application condition.

cues.title: 分走了哪些光
cues.caption: 每个波长：直达与被散射的部分，加起来等于入射。
cues.captionEn: At each wavelength: direct + redirected = input.
cues.zh: 把一束含有多种波长的光穿过稀薄的散射介质。浅色轮廓是入射光谱，橙色区域是继续直达的部分，蓝色区域是离开直达光束的部分。同一波长上下两块相加，总是回到入射轮廓。短波长一侧被分走得更多，因此直达光与散射光获得不同的光谱。
cues.en: Send broad-spectrum light through a dilute scattering medium. The pale outline is the input spectrum. The warm area continues directly; the blue area has left the direct beam. At every wavelength the two areas add back to the input. More short-wavelength light is redirected, so direct and scattered light acquire different spectra.

cues.title: 四次方的选择
cues.caption: 450nm的散射截面，约为650nm的4.35倍。
cues.captionEn: Cross-section ratio: σ450 / σ650 ≈ 4.35.
cues.zh: 先去掉入射光谱不均匀的影响，给蓝光和红光相同的输入能量。瑞利极限下，散射截面与波长的四次方成反比。四百五十纳米与六百五十纳米相比，散射截面约大四点三五倍。这里比较的是同等照明下的散射倾向，不能直接当作眼睛看到的亮度比。
cues.en: Remove differences in illumination and give blue and red equal incident energy. In the Rayleigh limit, scattering cross-section varies inversely with the fourth power of wavelength. At 450 nanometres it is about 4.35 times the value at 650 nanometres. This compares scattering tendency under equal illumination, rather than perceived brightness or the total light captured by an eye.

cues.title: 光分散到哪里
cues.caption: 非偏振光在90度仍散射，前后方向更强。
cues.captionEn: At 90°, scattering density is half its forward value.
cues.zh: 离开直达光束的能量，不会全都到同一个观察者那里。现在转动观察方向，曲线半径表示这个方向的相对散射密度。对于非偏振入射光，前方和后方相同，九十度方向仍有散射，只是密度为前方的一半。所有方向的份额合起来，才分完被散射的能量。
cues.en: Redirected energy is shared among directions, rather than all reaching one observer. Rotate the observation direction. The curve radius represents relative angular density. With unpolarized input, forward and backward directions are equal. Scattering at ninety degrees remains nonzero, at half the forward density. Integrating over all directions accounts for the redirected energy.

cues.title: 更长的直达路径
cues.caption: 路径增长，短波长更早从直达光中减少。
cues.captionEn: Longer paths remove more blue from the direct beam.
cues.zh: 回到光谱，并增加穿过介质的相对路径长度。蓝色区域变大，直达光中短波长下降得更快，下面的直达色调逐渐偏暖。这帮助理解日落时更长路径带来的选择性衰减。不过，这里没有计算散射后再次穿过大气的过程，不能用这一小段介质完整预测某次日落或天空的颜色。
cues.en: Return to the spectrum and lengthen the path. More energy leaves the direct beam, and its short wavelengths decrease faster. The independently normalized direct swatch becomes warmer. This illustrates selective attenuation along a longer sunset path. Subsequent scattering and atmospheric paths are omitted, so the model does not predict a complete sunset or sky.

cues.title: 为什么不能只选最短
cues.titleEn: Why the shortest wavelength is not the whole answer
cues.caption: 看见的颜色取决于入射光谱、散射和视觉匹配。
cues.captionEn: Colour combines the spectrum and visual sensitivity.
cues.zh: 紫光的散射截面比蓝光还大，为什么不能因此宣布天空应该最紫？因为颜色来自整段光谱，不是只选截面最大的波长。现在的三条曲线是标准颜色匹配函数的近似，紫端的匹配贡献与蓝色区域不同，入射光在各波长的能量也不同。下方色块把这些因素合在一起，而不把散射截面直接涂成颜色。
cues.en: Violet has a larger scattering cross-section than blue, but that alone does not determine the sky’s colour. Colour combines a whole spectrum. These curves approximate standard colour-matching functions, with a different contribution at the violet end. Incident energy also varies with wavelength. The swatch combines spectrum and visual matching instead of assigning colour from cross-section alone.

cues.title: 红光不会变蓝光
cues.titleEn: Red light does not turn blue
cues.caption: 瑞利散射改变方向，不把650nm变成另一种波长。
cues.captionEn: Red light is redirected without turning blue.
cues.zh: 最后只输入六百五十纳米的红光。入射轮廓变成一条窄线，直达和散射的能量都仍在这个波长，两个色块也保持红色。瑞利散射是弹性过程，它优先分走已有的短波长光，却不会把红光制造成蓝光。自由探索可以分别改变路径和观察角，比较光谱选择与方向分配。
cues.en: Finally, supply only 650-nanometre red light. Input becomes one narrow spectral line. Both direct and redirected energy remain at that wavelength, and both swatches remain red. Rayleigh scattering is elastic: it preferentially redirects short wavelengths already present, but does not manufacture blue light from red. Explore path length and observation angle separately.

cues.title: 厚度不是处处有用
cues.caption: 光在均匀材料中直行，转向发生在界面。
cues.captionEn: Light travels straight inside the material and bends at its surfaces.
cues.zh: 先看一片连续曲面的透镜。平行光从平面一侧进入，在材料里保持直行；离开弯曲表面时，才改变方向并会合到焦点。不同高度的表面斜率不同，让不同位置的光获得所需的转向。中央较厚的材料增加了体积，但直行这一段本身没有继续把光弯向焦点。
cues.en: Begin with a continuous lens surface. Parallel light enters the flat side and travels straight through the uniform material. It changes direction at the curved exit surface and converges. Different surface slopes provide different deflections. The thick central material adds volume, but that straight internal segment does not keep bending the ray toward the focus.

cues.title: 分给各个环带
cues.caption: 各环表面单独设计，仍把轴向平行光折向共同焦点。
cues.captionEn: Each annular surface redirects axial rays toward the same focus.
cues.zh: 把一整片曲面分到同心环带上，每一环都只留下薄薄一段。这里重新计算每段曲面，让从这个实际出射位置离开的光，仍到达同一个设计焦点。外侧环带倾斜较大，内侧较缓。看所有出射线，它们的交点来自各环表面的折射，而透镜整体已经薄了许多。
cues.en: Distribute the surface among concentric annuli, retaining a thin section in each. Each curved facet is designed for its actual exit position so its ray still reaches the common focus. Outer zones are steeper, inner zones gentler. The emerging rays meet because of refraction at those surfaces, while the overall lens is much thinner.

cues.title: 放大一段真实曲面
cues.caption: 局部法线改变，出射方向随斯涅尔定律确定。
cues.captionEn: The local normal and Snell’s law determine the emerging direction.
cues.zh: 现在放大其中一段，纵横使用相同的尺度。橙色光线在材料内沿轴前进，虚线是碰撞点的表面法线。光从较高折射率的材料进入空气，偏离法线。入射角和折射角的正弦比例由两侧折射率决定。微小的环带之所以能聚光，就在于这些真实界面的方向。
cues.en: Enlarge one facet with equal horizontal and vertical scales. The orange ray travels axially inside the material; the dashed line is the local surface normal. Entering lower-index air bends the ray away from that normal. Snell’s law relates the two angles through the indices. The focusing action comes from these small, correctly oriented interfaces.

cues.title: 少了多少材料
cues.caption: 保持口径与设计焦点，比较实际旋转体积。
cues.captionEn: Compare rotational volume at the same aperture and design focus.
cues.zh: 回到完整剖面。虚线给出连续曲面的轮廓，实线是分环后的表面。口径和设计焦点保持相同，把每一小段剖面绕光轴旋转，积分得到下面的体积。分环结构使用明显更少的材料。这里比较的是几何体积；没有把它直接当成制造成本、透过率或最终成像质量。
cues.en: Return to the complete section. The dashed outline shows the continuous lens and the solid outline the annular design, with the same aperture and focus. Rotating each radial strip about the axis and integrating gives the volumes below. The annular lens uses less material. Volume alone does not specify manufacturing cost, transmission or image quality.

cues.title: 相同折射率的反例
cues.caption: 保留所有环带，减小折射率差，聚光逐渐消失。
cues.captionEn: Keep the grooves but remove index contrast, and focusing disappears.
cues.zh: 让透镜周围的折射率慢慢接近材料。所有环带都还在，表面法线也没有改变，但出射转向逐渐减弱。两侧折射率相等时，光线穿过界面继续平行前进，不再会合在设计焦点。聚光需要曲面方向与折射率差共同作用，只有环纹的形状还不够。
cues.en: Raise the surrounding index toward that of the lens. Every annulus and every normal stays in place, but the deflection weakens. With equal indices on both sides, the rays continue parallel through the interface and no longer meet at the design focus. Both surface orientation and index contrast are needed for focusing.

cues.title: 同焦点不等于同相位
cues.titleEn: One focus does not mean one phase
cues.caption: 各环光程不同；几何光线不足以保证高质量成像。
cues.captionEn: Zone optical paths differ; geometric rays alone cannot guarantee image quality.
cues.zh: 恢复空气后，几何光线又在共同焦点交会。不过，各环走过的光程并不相同。下面把每环相对中央的光程，换算成五百五十纳米光的相位余数；这些高度并不一致。真实成像还要考虑环边衍射、波的叠加、色散与制造误差。因此更薄、更会聚，不能直接推出更清晰。
cues.en: Restore air and the geometric rays meet again. Their optical paths through different annuli are not equal, however. The bars show each zone’s relative phase modulo a 550-nanometre wavelength; the phases differ. Actual imaging also depends on edge diffraction, wave interference, dispersion and manufacturing errors. Thinness and geometric convergence alone do not establish sharpness.

cues.title: 内存新，数据页旧
cues.caption: 内存改为 11，持久页暂时仍是 7。
cues.captionEn: Memory changes to 11 while the durable page remains 7.
cues.zh: 内存里的七已经改成十一，持久数据页还停在七。这不一定是错误。预写日志先记录怎样恢复变化，让数据页可以稍后更新；关键是分清缓存和真正持久的记录。
cues.en: Memory has changed from seven to eleven, while the durable data page still holds seven. That is not necessarily wrong. Write-ahead logging records recovery information so the page can follow later. The key distinction is buffering versus durable storage.

cues.title: 写入缓存不算持久
cues.caption: 修改与 COMMIT 都在缓存时，还不能确认成功。
cues.captionEn: An update and COMMIT in memory cannot yet acknowledge success.
cues.zh: 日志按 LSN 顺序排好，先是修改，再是提交标记。但它们目前都只在缓存里。提交标记存在于内存，并不代表掉电后还在，因此还不能按持久提交的规则确认成功。
cues.en: The log orders records by LSN: first the update, then a commit marker. Both are still buffered. A marker in memory may disappear in a crash, so this does not yet justify a durable success acknowledgement.

cues.title: 日志先持久，再确认
cues.titleEn: Make the log durable, then acknowledge
cues.caption: 提交日志已持久，可以确认，旧数据页仍为 7。
cues.captionEn: The commit log is durable, so acknowledgement can precede the page write.
cues.zh: 现在两条日志都已持久，才确认成功。旧数据页仍然是七，也不必在这个时刻全部写完。恢复所需的信息已经保留下来，数据页写入与客户端确认因此可以分开。
cues.en: Now both log records are durable, so success can be acknowledged. The data page is still seven and need not be written at that moment. Recovery information has survived, allowing page writes and client acknowledgement to occur separately.

cues.title: 故障只留下持久部分
cues.titleEn: A crash leaves the durable parts
cues.caption: 内存消失；持久日志与值为 7 的旧页留下。
cues.captionEn: Memory disappears; the durable log and old page containing 7 remain.
cues.zh: 此时发生掉电。内存页消失，已经确认过的消息不能把内存留住；真正留下的是持久日志和旧数据页。故障恢复必须从这些实际幸存的信息出发。
cues.en: A crash now loses the memory page. An acknowledgement cannot preserve memory; the durable log and old data page are what remain. Recovery must use the information that actually survived.

cues.title: 按日志恢复已提交结果
cues.caption: 重放已提交 SET，页恢复为 11，并记录页 LSN。
cues.captionEn: Replay the committed SET to restore 11 and record the page LSN.
cues.zh: 恢复看到持久的提交标记，再重放这次逻辑修改，页变成十一。页 LSN 记录已应用的位置，重复恢复不会重复处理同一条变化。这里是禁止未提交页落盘的单页教学模型，真实数据库的物理恢复更复杂。
cues.en: Recovery finds a durable commit marker and replays this logical update, restoring eleven. The page LSN records applied progress so another recovery does not reapply the same change. This is a single-page no-steal teaching model; real physical database recovery is more complex.

cues.title: 无确认，不代表未提交
cues.titleEn: No acknowledgement does not mean no commit
cues.caption: 只有修改日志恢复为 7；提交持久但没确认，恢复为 11。
cues.captionEn: Update-only recovers 7; durable commit without acknowledgement recovers 11.
cues.zh: 比较两个故障边界。只有修改日志持久，没有提交标记，这里恢复七。提交已经持久，确认消息却没到客户端，这里恢复十一。没有收到成功，不能断言事务没有发生；重试还必须考虑重复执行。
cues.en: Compare two crash boundaries. A durable update without a commit marker recovers seven here. A durable commit whose acknowledgement never reached the client recovers eleven. Missing success does not prove nothing happened; retry must also account for duplicate execution.

cues.title: 把反馈路径连起来
cues.caption: 飞球 → 套筒 → 阀门 → 驱动力。
cues.captionEn: Flyballs → sleeve → valve → driving torque.
cues.zh: 先看这一整条连接。飞球随轴旋转，上下两组连杆把它们与滑动套筒连起来。外侧套环把套筒的升降传给阀门，而阀门控制驱动力。调速器并不是让飞球直接把轴刹住；它把转速变成位置，再用位置调节动力输入。
cues.en: Follow the complete connection. Rotating flyballs join the upper pivot and sliding sleeve through two sets of links. A collector collar transfers sleeve motion to a valve, which controls driving torque. The balls do not directly brake the shaft. They turn speed into position, and that position adjusts power input.

cues.title: 外部改变转速
cues.caption: 转速提高，飞球展开，套筒升高，阀口减小。
cues.captionEn: Higher speed spreads the balls, raises the sleeve and reduces opening.
cues.zh: 现在由外部驱动逐渐提高转速，先只看位置关系。飞球展开，等长连杆把套筒抬高，连接杆把阀门向关闭方向推动。这就是负反馈需要的方向：转得更快时，减小动力输入。如果把阀门方向接反，作用就会助长原来的变化。
cues.en: An external drive now raises speed so we can inspect the position relationship. The balls spread, equal-length links raise the sleeve, and the connected gate reduces the opening. This is the direction needed for negative feedback: faster rotation reduces driving input. Reversing the valve action would reinforce the original change.

cues.title: 负载增加后，阀门再响应
cues.titleEn: Add load, then watch the response
cues.caption: 负载↑ → 转速↓ → 阀口↑ → 驱动力↑。
cues.captionEn: More load → lower speed → more opening → more drive.
cues.zh: 接通反馈，在第二秒给轴增加负载。先看转速向下走，随后套筒降低，阀门开得更大。增加的驱动转矩抵消一部分额外负载，转速下降受到抑制。这个过程有先后顺序，调速器需要先感受到速度变化，才能通过阀门作出反应。
cues.en: Connect feedback and add load at two seconds. Speed first falls; the sleeve then lowers and the valve opens farther. Additional driving torque counters part of the added load and limits the speed decrease. This sequence matters: the governor must experience a speed change before its valve response can correct it.

cues.title: 断开连接，固定阀门
cues.titleEn: Disconnect the linkage and hold the valve
cues.caption: 相同负载，固定开度不足以维持转动。
cues.captionEn: Under the same load, fixed opening cannot sustain rotation.
cues.zh: 保持同样的初始条件和负载变化，这次断开套筒到阀门的连接。飞球仍会随转速改变位置，但阀门保持原开度。驱动转矩不再补偿增加的负载，轴继续变慢，最终停下。感知部件在动，并不代表整个反馈回路已经闭合。
cues.en: Repeat the same initial condition and load change with the sleeve-to-valve linkage disconnected. The balls still respond to shaft speed, but the valve stays at its original opening. Driving torque cannot compensate for the added load, so this model slows to a stop. A moving sensor alone does not close a feedback loop.

cues.title: 稳定之后，仍有偏差
cues.titleEn: Settling can leave a speed error
cues.caption: 接通反馈后稳定，但低于原先72 rpm。
cues.captionEn: Feedback settles the speed below its original 72 rpm.
cues.zh: 重新接通反馈，把观察时间拉长。曲线最终稳定，却没有回到七十二转的虚线。新增负载需要更大的阀口，而这个直接位置反馈需要套筒降到新位置才能保留更大开度。于是，稳定后的转速略低。稳定性和没有稳态偏差，是两个不同要求。
cues.en: Reconnect feedback and watch longer. The curve settles but does not return to the dashed seventy-two-rpm reference. Added load needs a larger sustained opening. This direct position feedback requires a new sleeve position to maintain that opening, leaving a slightly lower speed. Stability and zero steady error are different requirements.

cues.title: 响应变慢，偏离更大
cues.caption: 相同负载，3秒响应比0.4秒响应偏离更大。
cues.captionEn: The same load causes a larger excursion with a three-second response.
cues.zh: 最后只把调速器的响应变慢。浅线保留原来零点四秒的响应，深线使用三秒。阀门来得更迟，转速先偏离得更多，再慢慢恢复，并出现更明显的起伏。这里的一阶响应是教学近似；真实调速器还要分析多部件惯量、阻尼和阀门负载。
cues.en: Change only the governor response time. The pale curve retains the original zero-point-four-second response; the dark curve uses three seconds. Later valve action lets speed deviate farther before recovering, with more pronounced oscillation. This first-order response is a teaching approximation. Real governors require inertia, damping and valve-load analysis.

cues.title: 红与绿相遇
cues.caption: 两束光到达同一点，能量相加，不是相互涂掉。
cues.captionEn: Two lights at one place add energy rather than covering each other.
cues.zh: 先打开红色光束，再逐渐加入绿色。两束重叠的位置从红色走向黄色。下面的通道条分别记录红与绿的线性光强，没有用两种颜料的规则去平均它们。黄色是这组光刺激产生的外观，红光与绿光仍同时存在，并没有变成一条新的黄色波长。
cues.en: Start with red light and gradually add green. Their shared region moves toward yellow. The bars track their separate linear-light contributions. The two lights coexist and add; they are not averaged as paint colours. A yellow appearance does not mean red and green have changed into a new single yellow wavelength.

cues.title: 第三束补上蓝
cues.caption: 合适的红绿蓝比例，可以匹配白色外观。
cues.captionEn: A suitable balance of red, green and blue can match white.
cues.zh: 保持红绿光不变，逐渐加入蓝光。中央共同照亮的位置逐渐接近白色，但周围只有两束相遇的地方仍保留各自的混合色。这里采用显示器的标准红绿蓝原色，三个通道都达到参考强度时给出参考白；并不是说自然界的白光只能由这三种光谱组成。
cues.en: Keep red and green fixed and add blue. The central common region approaches white, while two-beam overlaps retain other mixtures. These are standard display RGB primaries. Their reference balance makes reference white, but natural white light can have many different spectra. Three primaries are one way to match its appearance.

cues.title: 一半能量的灰
cues.caption: 三个通道同减为一半，色相不变，显示编码不是128。
cues.captionEn: 50% linear light → sRGB 188, not 128.
cues.zh: 把三个通道都设为一半。中央仍然是中性灰，相对亮度变成参考白的一半。此时标准显示编码约是一百八十八，而不是直接把二百五十五除以二。因为光强相加发生在线性能量中，显示编码采用另一条曲线。通道条表示的是光强，因此它与视觉上读到的数字不是同一种量。
cues.en: Set all three channels to half. The centre stays neutral and has half the reference luminance. Its sRGB display code is about 188, rather than half of 255. Physical light adds in linear energy, while display encoding follows a different curve. The bars represent light intensity, so their percentages and display codes measure different quantities.

cues.title: 改走同一条路
cues.titleEn: Send one beam through a filter
cues.caption: 青色滤片保留绿蓝，减少红通道。
cues.captionEn: An ideal cyan filter keeps green and blue while reducing red.
cues.zh: 现在换一种情况：同一束白光依次通过滤片。光路从左向右，三条线分别追踪红绿蓝的剩余能量。让青色滤片逐渐生效，红通道变细，绿与蓝继续通过，结果偏向青色。这里是在输入光里筛选通道，增加滤片不会给光束补充新的能量。
cues.en: Now send one white beam through filters in sequence. The three paths track remaining red, green and blue energy from left to right. As the cyan filter takes effect, the red channel narrows while green and blue pass. The output becomes cyan. A filter selects from the incoming light; it does not add energy.

cues.title: 青与黄留下绿
cues.caption: 串联的透射率相乘，只有共同能通过的部分保留。
cues.captionEn: Serial transmissions multiply, retaining what can pass both filters.
cues.zh: 保持青色滤片，加入黄色滤片。黄色继续滤除蓝通道，而红色早已被青色滤掉，于是只剩绿色通过。每一段线宽都接着前一段的剩余能量计算。所谓减色，数学上是透射比例的连续相乘，而不是把滤片自己的外观颜色加到白光里。
cues.en: Keep cyan and add yellow. Yellow rejects blue, while cyan has already rejected red, leaving green. Each path segment starts from the energy remaining after the previous filter. Subtractive mixing is multiplication of transmission fractions. It is not addition of the colours the filters appear to have on their own.

cues.title: 最后一个通道也被挡住
cues.caption: 再加品红，理想三通道都不能通过。
cues.captionEn: Magenta rejects the last remaining channel in this ideal model.
cues.zh: 再让品红滤片逐渐生效。它减少绿色，所以最后一个仍然通过的通道也逐渐变细，输出走向黑色。同样是三种颜色参与，三束色光叠加可以变白，三张理想滤片串联却能变暗到零。前者增加到达同一点的光，后者不断减少同一束光里还能通过的部分。
cues.en: Now introduce magenta. It rejects green, so the last surviving channel narrows and the output approaches black. Three lights can add to white, while three ideal filters can reject everything. The difference is in the operation: adding contributions at one point versus repeatedly reducing what remains in one beam.

cues.title: 照明也是条件
cues.caption: 滤片不变，换掉输入光谱，输出也会改变。
cues.captionEn: The filters stay fixed, but changing the input changes the result.
cues.zh: 恢复青与黄的组合，并把输入从白光逐渐改成红光。滤片本来能够保留的绿色，在新照明里越来越少，输出也随之消失。滤片不能创造输入中没有的光。因此描述材料的颜色或混合结果时，还必须说明照明。本篇的滤片是三通道理想化，真实颜料还有复杂的吸收与散射。
cues.en: Restore cyan and yellow, then change white illumination toward red. These filters can pass green, but the new input contains less and less of it, so the output disappears. Filters cannot create light missing from the source. Colour therefore depends on illumination as well as material. Real pigments also involve more complex absorption and scattering.

cues.title: 三票才当选
cues.caption: 五节点的多数是 3；A 先取得三票。
cues.captionEn: A majority of five is 3; A obtains three votes.
cues.zh: 五个节点里，三票构成多数。A 增加任期，给自己投票，再取得另外两票。节点每任期只能投一位候选者，还要检查候选日志是否足够新，不能只凭最先喊话就当选。
cues.en: Three votes form a majority of five. A increments its term, votes for itself and gains two more votes. Each server votes for at most one candidate per term and checks log freshness. Merely requesting leadership first is not enough.

cues.title: 两份复制，不够提交
cues.titleEn: Two copies are not a commit
cues.caption: x 只在 A、B，确认数 2/5，提交索引仍为 0。
cues.captionEn: Only A and B hold x: 2/5 confirmed, commit index still 0.
cues.zh: A 把命令 x 写入自己的日志，再复制到 B。两份日志已经存在，但还没有三份确认，因此提交索引仍是零。复制和提交是两个不同状态，不能把收到一份副本直接画成成功。
cues.en: A appends command x locally and copies it to B. Two logs hold the entry, but there are not three acknowledgements, so commitment stays at zero. Replication and commitment are different states; one received copy is not success.

cues.title: 多数分区选出新任期
cues.titleEn: The majority partition elects a new term
cues.caption: A、B 被隔离；C、D、E 以三票选出任期 2 的 C。
cues.captionEn: A,B are isolated; C,D,E elect C in term 2 with three votes.
cues.zh: 网络分成 A、B 和 C、D、E。C 在更高任期取得三票。A 没听见新任期，仍自认为领导者，但少数侧拿不到三份确认。不同节点的看法暂时不同，不等于双方都能安全确认命令。
cues.en: The network separates A,B from C,D,E. C obtains three votes in a higher term. A has not learned the new term and still believes it leads, but its minority cannot obtain three acknowledgements. Different local beliefs do not let both sides safely acknowledge commands.

cues.title: 当前任期取得多数
cues.caption: C 的 y 复制到三份后，提交索引才能推进。
cues.captionEn: C advances commitment after three copies of current-term y.
cues.zh: C 追加当前任期的 y，并依次复制到 D、E。确认数到三后，C 才推进提交索引。追随者已经持有日志，却可能还不知道它已提交，要等后续通知再更新本地已知的绿色前缀。
cues.en: C appends current-term y and replicates to D and E. Only after three acknowledgements does C advance commitment. Followers already hold the entry but may not yet know it committed; a later notification updates their locally known green prefix.

cues.title: 修复未提交冲突
cues.caption: 恢复连接后，A 接受更高任期，未提交 x 被 y 替换。
cues.captionEn: After healing, A accepts the higher term and pending x is replaced by y.
cues.zh: 恢复连接。A 收到更高任期，退回追随者。日志同一位置的旧 x 与新 y 任期冲突，未提交的旧后缀被替换。其余节点也追上新日志与提交通知；这里不是任意撤销已经提交的命令。
cues.en: Heal the network. A learns the higher term and becomes a follower. Old x conflicts with y by term at the same index, so the uncommitted suffix is replaced. Other servers catch up with logs and commit notifications. This does not freely revoke committed commands.

cues.title: 旧任期不能只数副本
cues.caption: 另一条序列中，旧 x 有三份确认，提交仍为 0。
cues.captionEn: In a separate sequence, inherited x has three acknowledgements but commit stays 0.
cues.zh: 换一条操作序列。B 当选新任期领导者，继承旧任期的 x。即使再把 x 复制到多数，也不能只靠这次计数直接提交旧条目。Raft 还有当前任期条件，副本数不是唯一判断。
cues.en: Consider a separate sequence. B becomes leader in a new term and inherits old-term x. Even replicating x to a majority cannot directly commit that older entry by counting alone. Raft also requires a current-term entry; copy count is not the only condition.

cues.title: 当前条目提交旧前缀
cues.titleEn: A current entry commits the older prefix
cues.caption: 当前任期 no-op 取得多数，提交索引到 2，旧 x 间接提交。
cues.captionEn: A current-term no-op reaches a majority; commit index 2 includes old x.
cues.zh: B 追加当前任期的 no-op，再复制到多数，才能把提交索引推进到二。旧 x 作为前缀随之间接提交。no-op 占据日志位置，却不增加应用命令；任期和多数条件一起保护提交规则。
cues.en: B appends a current-term no-op and replicates it to a majority, allowing commit index two. Earlier x commits indirectly as part of that prefix. The no-op occupies a log position but adds no application command. Term and majority conditions work together to protect commitment.

cues.title: 同一点，不同位置
cues.caption: 对齐注视点后，位于同一深度的中央物点没有相对视差。
cues.captionEn: After registration, a central target at fixation depth has zero relative disparity.
cues.zh: 从俯视图看，两只眼睛之间有一段基线，都在观察同一个空间点。浅绿色是注视参照，橙色是物点。下面把左右两幅虚拟图对齐到注视点，两个橙点因此重合在共同的零位。这里展示的是校正后的几何位置，不是画出眼球内部的视网膜。
cues.en: From above, the two eyes are separated by a baseline and observe one spatial point. Pale green marks the fixation reference and orange the target. Below, the virtual views are registered to fixation, placing this target at their shared zero. These are rectified geometric image coordinates, rather than a drawing of the retina inside an eye.

cues.title: 比注视点更近
cues.caption: 物点移近，左右登记位置向相反方向分开。
cues.captionEn: A nearer point separates in opposite directions in the registered views.
cues.zh: 让橙色物点移近，注视参照保持原处。上方两条视线张开得更多，下方左图的点向右移，右图的点向左移。在这里定义的左减右坐标中，相对视差为正。相同基线和焦距下，物点越近，原始视差越大，因为两只眼睛看它的方向差得更多。
cues.en: Move the orange target closer while fixation remains fixed. The sight lines spread more. In the registered views, its left-image position moves right and its right-image position moves left. With disparity defined as left minus right, relative disparity is positive. For the same baseline and focal length, a nearer point has larger raw disparity.

cues.title: 比注视点更远
cues.caption: 物点移远，视差方向反过来。
cues.captionEn: A farther point reverses the sign of relative disparity.
cues.zh: 把物点移到注视参照后方。两条视线更接近平行，左图与右图的相对移动方向也反过来。相对视差变为负数，但物体并没有跑到眼睛后面：负号只表示它比当前注视点更远。反推深度时，需要把注视参照对应的原始视差加回去。
cues.en: Move the target beyond fixation. The sight lines become more parallel and the registered image shifts reverse. Relative disparity becomes negative. That does not place the object behind the eyes; it means farther than the chosen fixation. Recovering absolute depth requires adding back the raw disparity associated with the registration reference.

cues.title: 基线缩到零
cues.caption: 相同观察位置产生相同投影，双目深度信息消失。
cues.captionEn: Coincident viewpoints give identical projections and no stereo depth information.
cues.zh: 保留物点的真实位置，让两处观察位置逐渐靠拢。视差随基线一起缩小。到完全重合时，两幅投影完全相同，不能再只靠它们分辨这个点的深度。模型显示无法确定，而不是把零视差误算成零距离。人眼还会使用遮挡、大小和运动等其他线索，它们不在这一次几何比较里。
cues.en: Keep the target fixed and bring the viewpoints together. Disparity shrinks with baseline. At zero separation their projections coincide, so these two observations alone no longer determine depth. The model reports an undetermined result rather than zero distance. Human vision also uses occlusion, size and motion cues, which are outside this geometric comparison.

cues.title: 同样间隔，远处更难分
cues.caption: 保持200mm深度间隔，整体移远后相对视差缩小。
cues.captionEn: The same 200 mm depth gap gives less disparity farther away.
cues.zh: 现在让物点始终比注视参照远二百毫米，把两者一起向远处移动。真实深度间隔没有改变，下方两点的位置差却逐渐缩小。因为视差与深度的倒数相关，同样一段距离在远处造成更小的投影差。这里说明几何灵敏度的变化，并没有设定人眼实际能够分辨的最小阈值。
cues.en: Keep the target two hundred millimetres beyond fixation and move both farther away. Their physical separation stays constant, yet their registered image difference becomes smaller. Disparity depends on inverse depth, so the same depth gap produces a smaller projection change at greater distance. This shows geometric sensitivity without imposing a human perception threshold.

cues.title: 还要先配对
cues.caption: 交换右图配对，同样的观测可被算成错误深度。
cues.captionEn: Swapping right-view matches reconstructs different, incorrect depths.
cues.zh: 最后给出两个同深度的点。正确配对时，两组观测都反推到八百毫米。随后交换右图中的对应关系：同样的图像位置，却算出一近一远的两个深度。公式本身并不知道哪两个点属于同一物体。因此双目测深先要解决对应关系，重复纹理和相似物点会让这一步变得困难。
cues.en: Finally observe two points at the same depth. Correct matches reconstruct both at eight hundred millimetres. Swap the right-view correspondences and the same image positions yield one much nearer and one much farther depth. The formula does not know which observations belong together. Stereo must establish correspondence first, and repeated patterns can make that ambiguous.

cues.title: 内容先成为叶哈希
cues.caption: 每项使用 00 前缀；显示短码，内部保留完整 SHA-256。
cues.captionEn: Each leaf uses prefix 00; short labels represent full SHA-256 digests.
cues.zh: 四项内容先分别成为叶哈希。叶输入前加零零，区分内容与内部节点。画面只显示短码方便辨认，真正参与计算和核对的是全部二百五十六位。
cues.en: The four contents first become leaf hashes. Prefix zero-zero separates a content leaf from an internal node. Short display codes help recognition; computation and comparison use all two hundred fifty-six bits.

cues.title: 有序地合成父节点
cues.caption: 01 前缀后拼接左、右哈希原字节，得到 AB 与 CD。
cues.captionEn: Prefix 01 plus raw left/right digests creates AB and CD.
cues.zh: A 和 B 按顺序合成 AB，C 和 D 合成 CD。内部输入前加零一，再拼接左右哈希的原始字节，不是拼接屏幕上的短字符。交换左右，通常就会得到不同结果。
cues.en: A and B combine in order into AB; C and D into CD. Internal input begins with zero-one, followed by raw left and right digest bytes, not the short characters on screen. Swapping order generally changes the result.

cues.title: 根绑定整组顺序
cues.titleEn: The root binds the ordered group
cues.caption: AB 与 CD 再合成根，根承诺四项内容及其顺序。
cues.captionEn: AB and CD combine into a root binding all four ordered contents.
cues.zh: 再把 AB 与 CD 合成根。每一层都把更大一段有序内容压成固定长度摘要。这个根可以用来核对内容是否与先前承诺一致，但它不是加密后的原文，也不判断内容说的事情是真是假。
cues.en: Combine AB and CD into the root. Each level summarizes a larger ordered range into a fixed-size digest. The root can check agreement with an earlier commitment. It is not encrypted original content and does not judge whether a statement is true.

cues.title: 只带必要的兄弟
cues.caption: 验证 C，只需 D 和 AB 两个兄弟哈希，不用其余原文。
cues.captionEn: Verifying C needs D and AB as sibling hashes, not the other payloads.
cues.zh: 现在只验证 C。已有 C 的内容后，先需要 D 的叶哈希，再需要整个 AB 子树的哈希。这两个兄弟就补齐了通向根的路径，不必传来 A、B、D 的全部原文。
cues.en: Now verify only C. Given its content, obtain D’s leaf digest and the digest of the entire AB subtree. These two siblings complete the route to the root without sending the full A, B and D payloads.

cues.title: 左右次序不能乱
cues.caption: 先 C 与右侧 D 合成 CD，再把左侧 AB 加回来。
cues.captionEn: Combine C with right sibling D, then prepend left sibling AB.
cues.zh: 从 C 的叶哈希开始。D 是右兄弟，所以 C 在前、D 在后，重建 CD。下一层 AB 是左兄弟，必须放在 CD 前面。两次完整哈希之后，得到与事先可信根相同的结果；索引和树大小也要一起核对。
cues.en: Start with C’s leaf digest. D is its right sibling, so C precedes D when reconstructing CD. At the next level AB is the left sibling and must precede CD. Two full hashes reproduce the already trusted root; index and tree size must also be checked.

cues.title: 修改沿祖先传播
cues.caption: gamma 改成 Gamma，只改动 C、CD 与根，原根验证失败。
cues.captionEn: Changing gamma to Gamma alters C, CD and the root; original-root verification fails.
cues.zh: 把 gamma 的首字母改成大写。C 的哈希改变，影响 CD，再影响根；不相关的子树仍旧不变。拿原来的两个兄弟重建，结果不再匹配原先可信根，因此这份修改无法通过验证。
cues.en: Capitalize the first letter of gamma. C’s digest changes, then CD, then the root; unrelated subtrees stay unchanged. Rebuilding with the original two siblings no longer matches the original trusted root, so the altered payload fails verification.

cues.title: 根也要有可信来源
cues.caption: 连根一起替换可以自洽，却不能认证来源或证明内容真实。
cues.captionEn: Replacing the root too can be self-consistent without authenticating its origin or truth.
cues.zh: 如果对方连根也换掉，新内容和新根又能彼此吻合。但自洽不等于可信。根必须通过签名或可信通道另行认证。包含证明只回答与这个根是否一致，不独自证明发布者身份、内容真实或整个日志一直只追加。
cues.en: If the peer replaces the root too, the new content and root can agree. Self-consistency is not trust. Signatures or trusted channels must authenticate the root separately. Inclusion proves agreement with that root, not the publisher’s identity, the content’s truth or the log’s entire append-only history.

cues.title: 先认清细纹
cues.caption: 一层透射率周期为4mm，还没有两层的差频。
cues.captionEn: One layer repeats every 4 mm; no two-layer difference yet.
cues.zh: 先看一张周期四毫米的细纹光栅。明处透光较多，暗处较少，下方横切曲线记录同一条中央横线的透射率。只有这一层时，出现的是它本身的细周期。接下来叠加第二层，比较哪些位置同时透光，哪些位置一亮一暗。
cues.en: Start with one grating repeating every four millimetres. Bright regions transmit more and dark regions less. The lower curve traces transmission along the same central line. This single layer has its own fine period. We will add another layer and compare where their transmitting regions agree or disagree.

cues.title: 慢慢错开的重合
cues.caption: 4mm与4.4mm细纹的乘积，含44mm的大周期。
cues.captionEn: 4 mm and 4.4 mm pitches produce a 44 mm coarse period.
cues.zh: 叠上周期四点四毫米的第二层。两层细纹有时接近重合，有时逐渐错开，整体透过的光因此出现更大的明暗起伏。下面把这个缓慢变化的差频成分单独分出来。细纹周期只有几毫米，差频周期却是四十四毫米；大条纹来自许多细纹之间累计的相对位置变化。
cues.en: Overlay a second grating with a 4.4-millimetre period. The fine patterns gradually move between alignment and misalignment, producing much broader variations in transmission. The lower curve isolates that slow difference-frequency term. Fine periods of only a few millimetres produce a 44-millimetre coarse period through accumulated relative phase.

cues.title: 越接近，粗纹越宽
cues.caption: 细纹频率越接近，差频越小，周期越长。
cues.captionEn: Closer pitches produce a wider coarse pattern.
cues.zh: 让第二层周期逐渐接近第一层的四毫米。两层之间每走一段距离积累的错位变少了，需要更长的距离才走完一次重合到错开再重合。大条纹因此变宽，差频曲线也变缓。比较的关键是每毫米有多少周期的差，而不是简单把两层的周期相减当成大条纹间距。
cues.en: Bring the second pitch closer to four millimetres. Relative alignment now changes more slowly with position. A longer distance is needed to complete one cycle of agreement and disagreement, so the coarse fringes widen. The relevant difference is cycles per millimetre; subtracting the two pitches does not directly give the coarse spacing.

cues.title: 转角也能产生差频
cues.caption: 周期相同，方向不同，空间频率向量仍有差。
cues.captionEn: Equal pitches can still form moiré when rotated.
cues.zh: 这次两层都用四毫米周期，只旋转第二层。虽然细纹疏密相同，方向已经不同，因此沿平面移动时，两层仍然逐渐错开。大条纹出现新的方向和间距。这里必须比较二维的空间频率向量；只有一个周期数字，还不足以描述叠加结果。
cues.en: Give both layers the same four-millimetre pitch and rotate the second. Their line densities match, but their orientations differ, so their alignment still changes across the plane. Coarse fringes acquire a new direction and spacing. In two dimensions we compare spatial-frequency vectors, not just one pitch number.

cues.title: 小移动，大响应
cues.caption: 第二层向右4.4mm，差频峰向左44mm。
cues.captionEn: Move the layer 4.4 mm right; its coarse peak moves 44 mm left.
cues.zh: 恢复四与四点四毫米的周期，向右平移第二层。蓝色虚线追踪它的一条细纹，金色线追踪由两层相对相位确定的一个差频峰。小细纹只走一点，大峰却向反方向移动很多。在这组条件下，第二层移动一个自己的周期，大峰正好走过四十四毫米。移动的是重合位置，不是某个材料部件被放大了。
cues.en: Restore the unequal pitches and translate the second layer rightward. Blue tracks one fine stripe; gold tracks one difference-phase peak. A small stripe motion produces a larger peak motion in the opposite direction. After one 4.4-millimetre translation, that peak has moved 44 millimetres. This is motion of an alignment pattern, not an enlarged material object.

cues.title: 完全相同的边界
cues.caption: 两层同周期同方向并对齐，仍有细纹，但没有独立粗周期。
cues.captionEn: Aligned, equal pitches leave no independent coarse period.
cues.zh: 最后把两层都设为四毫米，方向相同并对齐。主图仍然有细纹，叠层还会改变它的透射形状，但空间频率之差为零，下方的差频成分成为常数。不是大条纹变成零间距，而是没有独立的有限大周期。自由探索可以分别改变周期、转角和平移，观察它们怎样影响重合。
cues.en: Finally align identical four-millimetre gratings. Fine structure remains and stacking changes its transmission profile, but the difference vector is zero. The isolated slow term becomes constant. The coarse period is not zero; there is no separate finite coarse period. Explore pitch, rotation and translation independently to see how each changes alignment.

cues.title: 输入起伏，负载平稳
cues.caption: 转矩差让飞轮加速或减速。
cues.captionEn: The torque difference speeds up or slows down the rotor.
cues.zh: 看输入转矩的绿条，它不断变长和变短，负载的金条则保持不变。两者有差额，飞轮的转速就会改变。这里让输入按两秒一个周期变化，用一个明确的理想驱动来观察飞轮。轮子正面和右侧剖面属于同一个转子。
cues.en: The green input-torque bar grows and shrinks while the gold load bar stays steady. Their difference changes the flywheel speed. This example programs the drive over a two-second cycle, giving a clear view of the energy exchange. The front view and axial section show the same rotor.

cues.title: 输入多出的部分存起来
cues.caption: 输入大于负载，转速与储能一起上升。
cues.captionEn: Surplus input raises both speed and stored energy.
cues.zh: 先只看前半个周期。输入转矩高于负载转矩，飞轮一边带动负载，一边加速。增加的转动动能来自输入做的额外功。转得更快，储存的能量也更多。因此，飞轮减小速度波动，依靠的是允许转速发生一定变化。
cues.en: Watch the first half-cycle. Input torque exceeds load torque, so the wheel drives the load while accelerating. Extra input work increases its rotational kinetic energy. Higher speed means more stored energy. The flywheel reduces a speed fluctuation by allowing a limited speed change to absorb that surplus.

cues.title: 输入不足，释放储能
cues.caption: 输入仍在做功，飞轮补上暂时的差额。
cues.captionEn: The drive still supplies work; stored energy covers the shortfall.
cues.zh: 后半个周期，输入条短于负载条。驱动仍在做功，但不足以单独承担负载。飞轮开始减速，把刚才储存的能量交出来。到周期结束，它回到原来的速度和储能。重复的存入与取出平缓了运动，却没有创造额外能量。
cues.en: In the second half-cycle, the input bar is shorter than the load bar. The drive still does work but cannot meet the load alone. The flywheel slows and returns stored energy. At the cycle end, speed and energy return to their starting values. Repeated storage and release smooth motion without creating energy.

cues.title: 同样重量，放得更靠外
cues.titleEn: Move equal mass toward the rim
cues.caption: 保持质量和平均速度，惯量越大，波动越小。
cues.captionEn: At equal mass and mean speed, more inertia gives less ripple.
cues.zh: 现在比较不同形状的飞轮，质量和外半径都相同。中心空得更多，材料更靠外，右侧剖面也变厚，保持总质量不变。转动惯量随之增加。实线的速度波动比原转子的虚线更小。这里比较相同平均速度的运行状态，初始能量随惯量改变。
cues.en: Compare separate rotors with equal mass and outer radius. A larger opening places material farther out; the thicker axial section preserves mass. Rotational inertia increases, and the solid speed curve varies less than the original dashed curve. These operating states share a mean speed, with different initial energies.

cues.title: 切断驱动，能转多久
cues.titleEn: Cut the drive and watch stored energy run out
cues.caption: 负载持续取走能量，飞轮最终停止。
cues.captionEn: The load keeps taking energy until the flywheel stops.
cues.zh: 在储能最多的位置切断驱动，输入条变为零。负载仍然取走能量，飞轮越来越慢，最后停下。停止之前，负载得到的功等于转子失去的动能。飞轮可以跨过短暂的动力不足，却不能长期维持一个没有能量来源的负载。
cues.en: Cut the drive at the maximum-energy state. The input bar falls to zero while the load continues taking energy. The flywheel slows to a stop. Work delivered before stopping equals its lost kinetic energy. A flywheel can bridge a temporary input shortage, but cannot sustain a load indefinitely without an energy source.

cues.title: 更稳，也更难加速
cues.caption: 相同启动转矩下，较大惯量加速更慢。
cues.captionEn: The same starting torque accelerates the larger inertia more slowly.
cues.zh: 最后从静止开始，用相同的恒定转矩启动两个转子，这次不加阻力负载。较大惯量的实线上升得更慢。让转速不容易变化，既能减小周期波动，也会增加启动所需的时间和能量。飞轮负责短时储能，持续的速度调节还需要改变驱动或负载。
cues.en: Start both rotors from rest under the same constant torque, with no resisting load in this test. The larger-inertia solid curve rises more slowly. Resistance to speed change reduces cyclic ripple but increases the time and energy required to reach a chosen speed. Sustained speed regulation must also adjust input or load.

cues.title: 私钥签，公钥验
cues.caption: 私钥 137 对应公钥 y；演示小群没有安全性。
cues.captionEn: Private scalar 137 gives public y; this tiny group is insecure.
cues.zh: 签名者保留私钥，验证者使用公钥。先用可检查的小整数群看两者的关系：私钥一百三十七映射成公钥。这里的群太小，没有实际安全性；接下来只观察签名关系怎样成立。
cues.en: A signer holds a private key; a verifier uses the public key. Start with an inspectable tiny group: private scalar one hundred thirty-seven maps to its public key. This group has no practical security; it only makes the signing relation visible.

cues.title: 消息参与挑战
cues.caption: nonce 形成 R，R、公钥与消息一起形成挑战 e。
cues.captionEn: A nonce gives R; R, the public key and message determine challenge e.
cues.zh: 公开的 HELLO 没有被隐藏。签名者先用 nonce 形成 R，再把 R、公钥和消息编码进哈希挑战。消息因此参与签名关系，而不是只给一把与消息无关的钥匙盖章。
cues.en: Public HELLO remains visible. The signer uses a nonce to form R, then hashes an encoding of R, the public key and message into a challenge. The message participates in the relation, rather than receiving a stamp unrelated to its contents.

cues.title: 生成两个签名量
cues.caption: s 将 nonce、挑战和私钥合入模 q 的关系。
cues.captionEn: s combines nonce, challenge and private key modulo q.
cues.zh: 接着把 nonce 与挑战乘私钥合起来，得到 s，所有标量计算都模五百零九。公开发送的是消息与签名 R、s。验证者接下来无需获得私钥，也无需解密消息。
cues.en: Next combine the nonce with challenge times private key to obtain s, using scalar arithmetic modulo five hundred nine. Publish the message and signature pair R,s. Verification needs neither the private key nor message decryption.

cues.title: 公开核对等式
cues.caption: 用公钥比较两边，原消息的验证关系成立。
cues.captionEn: The public key makes both sides equal for the original message.
cues.zh: 验证者从消息重新计算挑战，再比较这两边的群运算。原消息、签名和正确公钥使结果相等。公开可核对的关系，替代了把私钥交给每位验证者。
cues.en: The verifier recomputes the challenge from the message and compares the two group expressions. The original message, signature and correct public key make them equal. A publicly checkable relation avoids giving every verifier the private key.

cues.title: 固定签名，改动消息
cues.titleEn: Keep the signature, edit the message
cues.caption: HELLO 变成 HELLO!，右侧改变，原签名验证失败。
