cues.en: The points form a line that does not pass through the origin. An electron must first overcome the work function; the remaining energy becomes kinetic energy. The slope is Planck’s constant divided by elementary charge, and the horizontal intercept gives threshold frequency.

cues.title: 从小孔观察热腔
cues.caption: 小孔近似黑体；分光后可比较不同波长的辐射。
cues.captionEn: A small cavity aperture approximates a blackbody; dispersion separates wavelengths.
cues.zh: 想比较热辐射，先找一个接近理想黑体的光源。一个加热的空腔开一个小孔，从孔中射出的辐射近似黑体辐射。分光装置把不同波长分开，探测器逐段测量。图中的曲线按波长表示，不是肉眼看见的颜色亮度。
cues.en: Begin with an approximately ideal source: a small hole in a heated cavity. Radiation leaving the hole approximates blackbody radiation. A spectrometer separates wavelengths and a detector samples the spectrum. The graph shows spectral radiance per wavelength, not perceived color brightness.

cues.title: 升高炉温
cues.caption: 温度提高，曲线整体升高，峰值向更短波长移动。
cues.captionEn: Heating raises the spectrum and shifts its peak toward shorter wavelengths.
cues.zh: 现在提高炉温。注意曲线发生两种变化：辐射增强，峰值也向较短的波长移动。两条浅色曲线保留三千开尔文和五千开尔文的参照，所有曲线使用同一个纵轴刻度，因此曲线高度可以直接比较。
cues.en: Raise the furnace temperature. Two changes occur: radiation strengthens and the peak moves toward shorter wavelengths. Pale curves retain the reference spectra at three thousand and five thousand kelvin. All curves share one vertical scale, so their heights can be compared directly.

cues.title: 追踪同一条曲线的峰值
cues.caption: 峰值波长与温度的乘积近似为常量。
cues.captionEn: Peak wavelength times temperature is approximately constant.
cues.zh: 暂停在这个温度，沿着峰值标记读出对应的波长。再与低温参照比较，就会发现温度越高，峰值波长越短。这里显示的是以波长为横轴的谱；如果改用频率为横轴，不能直接把峰值位置简单取倒数。
cues.en: Hold the temperature and read the wavelength at the peak marker. Compare it with the cooler references: higher temperature gives a shorter peak wavelength. This is a wavelength spectrum. A frequency spectrum has a different density, so its peak is not obtained by simply taking the reciprocal.

cues.title: 用同一条定律描述各温度
cues.caption: 普朗克分布在短波端下降，避免经典预测的发散。
cues.captionEn: Planck’s distribution falls at short wavelengths instead of diverging.
cues.zh: 继续加热，峰值移动，但短波一侧始终下降。普朗克辐射定律能够同时描述这些温度下的光谱，这是能量量子化的重要历史线索。当前曲线由该定律计算；真实实验还需要校准探测器对不同波长的响应，才能与理论作定量比较。
cues.en: Continue heating. The peak moves, but the short-wavelength side still falls. Planck’s radiation law describes these spectra across temperatures, a key historical clue to energy quantization. These curves are calculated. A real experiment must calibrate detector response before comparing measured intensities with theory.

cues.title: 同质量，换形状
cues.caption: 纸张质量不变，揉成团后下落可以更快。
cues.captionEn: Crumpling paper can change its fall without changing its mass.
cues.zh: 拿两张相同的纸，一张保持平展，另一张揉成团。从同一高度同时释放，纸团会更快接近底部。两份纸的质量相同，结果却不同，这已经提醒我们：空气中的下落快慢，不能只看轻重。改变形状，也改变了空气阻力对运动的影响。
cues.en: Take two identical sheets. Keep one flat and crumple the other, then release both from the same height. The paper ball reaches the bottom sooner even though the masses match. This already shows why falling speed in air cannot be judged from mass alone. Shape changes how air resistance affects the motion.

cues.title: 再与橡皮比较
cues.caption: 纸团更接近橡皮的下落，但仍受空气影响。
cues.captionEn: The paper ball falls more like the eraser, while air still matters.
cues.zh: 再把橡皮加入对照。平纸片落得慢，揉成团的纸却更接近橡皮的运动。我们始终保持释放高度和时刻一致。这里的轨迹用固定姿态作近似，真实纸片还会翻滚。把阻力设成零时，三个物体恢复相同的自由落体规律，不能把空气中的差异带进真空结论。
cues.en: Now include an eraser. Flat paper falls slowly, while the crumpled paper moves more like the eraser. Keep the release height and instant unchanged. These paths assume fixed orientations; real paper also flutters. Setting drag to zero returns all three to the same free-fall rule, separating the air comparison from the vacuum limit.

cues.title: 两石捆绑的反证
cues.caption: 同一个组合，原假设却推出更慢和更快两种结论。
cues.captionEn: The same pair receives contradictory slower and faster predictions.
cues.zh: 换一种研究方式：先假设重石必定落得更快。把轻石和重石捆起来，轻石应拖慢重石，所以组合应该更慢。但组合的总质量更大，按原假设又应该更快。同一个组合不能同时满足两个相反的结论。这是逻辑反证，指出假设有问题，不是实际测出了一条下落轨迹。
cues.en: Try reasoning instead. Assume that a heavier stone must fall faster. Tie a light stone to a heavy one. The light stone should slow the heavy one, making the pair slower. Yet the pair is heavier, so the original assumption also predicts a faster fall. The same pair cannot satisfy both. This is a logical contradiction, not a measured trajectory.

cues.title: 把距离读成时间
cues.titleEn: Read a distance as a time
cues.caption: 接尺前的下落距离，可以换算成反应延迟。
cues.captionEn: The distance fallen before the catch gives a delay estimate.
cues.zh: 最后，用一把尺来测时间。尺子从静止释放，手指在看到它运动后才合拢。等待期间落下的距离越大，延迟就越长。镜头跟着尺子，所以手指相对尺面向上移动。接住的位置对应这段下落距离，再用自由落体关系换算时间。屏幕展示的是模拟，不是在测你的真实反应。
cues.en: Finally, use a ruler to measure time. It starts falling from rest; the fingers close after the observer sees it move. A longer delay means a greater falling distance. This view follows the ruler, so the fingers move upward relative to its scale. Read the catch position, then use free fall to infer the delay. The screen is a simulation, not your reaction test.

cues.title: 时间刻度为什么不等距
cues.titleEn: Why the time marks are uneven
cues.caption: 延迟翻倍，下落距离变为四倍。
cues.captionEn: Double the delay and the falling distance becomes four times larger.
cues.zh: 注意尺上的时间刻度。零点一秒对应四点九厘米，零点二秒对应十九点六厘米。时间翻倍，距离变成四倍。因为从静止下落时，距离与时间的平方成正比，所以越靠后的等时间刻度间隔越大。实际接尺还会受预判和起始位置影响，需要统一条件、重复测量。
cues.en: Look at the time scale. One tenth of a second corresponds to four point nine centimetres; two tenths corresponds to nineteen point six. Twice the time gives four times the distance. For release from rest, distance grows with time squared, so equal-time marks spread farther apart. Real ruler catches also require consistent starting positions and repeated measurements.

cues.title: 先看到排斥
cues.caption: 距离变近，悬球偏转；最终距离也随之改变。
cues.captionEn: As the source moves nearer, the suspended sphere deflects and changes the final separation.
cues.zh: 先看丝线下的小球。另一个同号带电球慢慢移近，小球受到排斥，偏角增大。可是它也向外移动了，所以最终的球心距离并不是支架间的距离。这能帮助我们发现力与距离有关，要精确比较，还需要更严格地控制位置。
cues.en: Watch the suspended sphere. As another like-charged sphere moves nearer, repulsion increases its deflection. But the sphere also moves outward, so its final separation is not simply the spacing between supports. This reveals a distance dependence; a precise comparison needs tighter position control.

cues.title: 先回零，再比较
cues.caption: 转动悬丝上端，使 A 球回到原位。
cues.captionEn: Rotate the upper suspension until A returns to its reference position.
cues.zh: 现在换成扭秤。A 球受到 C 球排斥，绝缘摆臂转开。我们缓慢旋转悬丝上端，使 A 回到虚线标出的原位。此时距离与力臂重新确定，悬丝回复力矩平衡静电力矩。上端扭角越大，所平衡的静电力也越大。
cues.en: Now use a torsion balance. C repels A and turns the insulating arm. Slowly rotate the upper end of the suspension until A returns to the dashed reference line. Separation and lever arm are now controlled. The suspension torque balances electric torque, and a larger upper twist represents a larger force.

cues.title: 距离减半，力怎样变？
cues.caption: 保持电荷和回零状态，距离减半，力变为四倍。
cues.captionEn: Keep charges fixed and maintain null: halving separation gives four times the force.
cues.zh: 保持两球电荷不变，也保持 A 在原位。把 C 移近，让球心距离从十二厘米减到六厘米。看力和扭角的变化：它们都增大到原来的四倍。这里比较的是距离的平方反比关系，而不是简单地距离减半、力就加倍。
cues.en: Keep both charges fixed and A at its reference position. Bring C closer, reducing the centre separation from twelve to six centimetres. Force and twist both grow to four times their original values. The comparison is inverse-square: halving separation does not merely double the force.

cues.title: 相同小球分走一半电荷
cues.titleEn: Share charge with an identical sphere
cues.caption: 中性球接触后分开，A 的电荷与回零扭角都减半。
cues.captionEn: After contact and separation, A retains half its charge and needs half the nulling twist.
cues.zh: 距离不变，这次让同样大小的中性球 D 接触 A，再把 D 移开。在相同孤立导体的近似下，电荷平分，A 留下一半。重新回零时，需要的扭角也减半。接触分电的结论依赖小球相同且外界影响足够小，真实装置还要处理漏电等误差。
cues.en: Keep separation fixed. Touch A with an identical neutral sphere D, then move D away. In the identical isolated-conductor approximation, charge divides equally and A retains half. Returning to null now needs half the twist. Equal sharing depends on identical spheres and weak external influence; real apparatus also faces leakage and other errors.

cues.title: 磁体在场，电流为何为零
cues.titleEn: A magnet is present, but current is zero
cues.caption: 磁通存在，不等于磁通正在变化。
cues.captionEn: Flux can exist without changing.
cues.zh: 先把磁体停在线圈旁。磁场穿过线圈，可是电流表不偏转。关键并不是磁场有没有，而是穿过这个回路的磁通量有没有改变。这个静止对照，要一直记在心里。
cues.en: Hold the magnet beside the coil. Magnetic flux passes through, yet the galvanometer stays at zero. The key is not whether a field exists, but whether the flux through this circuit changes. Keep this stationary comparison in mind.

cues.title: 靠近和远离，方向相反
cues.titleEn: Approaching and withdrawing reverse the response
cues.caption: 磁极不变，运动反向，感应电流反向。
cues.captionEn: With the pole fixed, reversing motion reverses induction.
cues.zh: 让同一个磁极靠近线圈，再远离。电流表在两段运动中向相反方向偏转，停住时又归零。线圈中的感应电流产生磁场，阻碍原来磁通量的变化，而不是简单地反对原磁场。
cues.en: Move the same pole toward the coil, then withdraw it. The galvanometer reverses between the two motions and returns to zero when motion stops. The induced field opposes the change of flux, not simply the original magnetic field.

cues.title: 保持运动，反转磁极
cues.titleEn: Keep the motion and reverse the pole
cues.caption: 同样的运动，翻转磁极会怎样？
cues.captionEn: Same motion: what if the pole reverses?
cues.zh: 现在保留相同的靠近和远离过程，只把磁体翻转。磁通变化的符号反了，电流方向也随之反转。把磁极和运动方向分开比较，就能把教材的四种情况逐一核对。
cues.en: Repeat the same approach and withdrawal with the magnet reversed. The sign of the flux change reverses, and so does the current. Comparing pole direction separately from motion accounts for all four textbook cases.

cues.title: 让闭合铝环回应磁体
cues.caption: 闭合电流阻碍磁体和铝环的相对运动。
cues.captionEn: The closed current loop opposes relative motion.
cues.zh: 换成悬挂的铝环。磁体靠近时，闭合环受到排斥；磁体离开时，环被带向磁体。反对的是相对运动造成的磁通变化。环的位移为观察而放大，感应电流和作用方向来自同一个磁通模型。
cues.en: Use a suspended aluminium ring. It is pushed away when the magnet approaches and pulled toward a withdrawing magnet. The response opposes the flux change caused by relative motion. Ring displacement is enlarged; current and force share one flux model.

cues.title: 切断一处，环流消失
cues.titleEn: Break the ring and remove the loop current
cues.caption: 缺口切断的是什么？
cues.captionEn: What does the gap interrupt?
cues.zh: 让磁体做同样的运动，但把铝环切开。磁通仍然改变，回路却不能流过完整的环电流，明显的机械响应消失。这说明观察到的作用需要电流路径，不能解释成磁体天生吸引所有金属。
cues.en: Repeat the same motion with a split ring. Flux still changes, but the complete circulating current cannot flow and the mechanical response disappears. The effect needs an electrical path; it is not universal magnetic attraction of metals.

cues.title: 同一线圈，改变释放高度
cues.titleEn: Change release height, keep the coil
cues.caption: 下落更快，磁通变化也更快。
cues.captionEn: Faster passage changes flux more rapidly.
cues.zh: 先从较低位置放开磁体，再提高释放位置。线圈保持八十匝，电压传感器记录两个方向的脉冲。提高位置改变了通过线圈时的速度。我们测的是电动势，传感器几乎不取电流，因此这里忽略电磁制动。
cues.en: Drop the magnet from a lower position, then release it higher. Keep eighty turns. The voltage sensor records a two-sided pulse; the higher release changes the speed through the coil. Its high input impedance draws little current, so this model neglects magnetic braking.

cues.title: 同一次运动，增加匝数
cues.titleEn: Keep the motion and increase turns
cues.caption: 匝数加倍，脉冲怎样变？
cues.captionEn: Double the turns: how does the pulse change?
cues.zh: 现在固定释放高度和磁体，把线圈增到一百六十匝。浅色曲线保留八十匝的结果，深色曲线来自相同的下落轨迹。比较对应时刻，两倍匝数给出两倍电动势；这与改变速度是两个独立的对照。
cues.en: Fix the release height and magnet, and double the winding to one hundred sixty turns. The pale curve keeps the eighty-turn result. Both use the same trajectory: at corresponding instants, double the turns gives double the emf. This is separate from changing speed.

cues.title: 圆盘怎样连接外电路
cues.titleEn: How the disc connects to a circuit
cues.caption: 轴与边缘电刷，连接径向电动势。
cues.captionEn: Axle and rim brushes connect the radial emf.
cues.zh: 看铜质圆盘。磁场穿过圆盘，转动使各处导体切过磁场，电荷受到径向作用。中心轴和边缘电刷分别接向负载，形成完整电流路径。每个半径处的速度不同，不能把整片圆盘当成一根同速导线。
cues.en: The magnetic field crosses a copper disc. Rotation gives the conductor a velocity and separates charge radially. Brushes at the axle and rim connect the load. Different radii have different speeds; the disc is not one straight wire moving at a single speed.

cues.title: 停转与反转是关键对照
cues.titleEn: Stop and reverse as controlled comparisons
cues.caption: 停转则电动势为零，反转则极性反向。
cues.captionEn: Stopping removes emf; reversing rotation reverses polarity.
cues.zh: 反转圆盘，轴与边缘之间的电动势也反向。如果停下，电动势归零。维持负载电流需要持续的外部机械功，磁场没有凭空提供能量。模型的机械输入功率与电阻消耗功率相等。
cues.en: Reverse the disc and the axle-to-rim polarity reverses. Stop it and emf vanishes. Sustaining load current requires mechanical input; the field supplies no free energy. The model balances mechanical input with power dissipated in the resistor.

cues.title: 偏着挂，为什么会转？
cues.titleEn: Why does the tilted lamina turn?
cues.caption: 力臂决定重力的转动作用。
cues.captionEn: Lever arm sets gravity’s turning effect.
cues.zh: 夹子先把薄板偏着固定。看金色的重力线：它没有通过悬点，两条竖线之间的距离就是力臂。松开夹子，重力使板转动，力臂也跟着改变。板可能越过平衡位置，这时重力的转动方向反过来，让它往回摆。阻力逐渐消耗摆动的能量。真正停稳后，重力线通过悬点，重心在悬点下方。不是任意一个速度为零的瞬间，都已经平衡。
cues.en: The clamp holds the lamina at an angle. Follow the gold weight line: it misses the suspension pin. The perpendicular distance between the vertical lines is the lever arm. Release the clamp. Gravity turns the lamina and the lever arm changes. It can overshoot; then gravity turns it back. Drag gradually removes energy from the swing. Once it settles, the weight line passes through the pin, with the centre below it. Zero speed at a turning point alone does not mean equilibrium.

cues.title: 一条线，够不够？
cues.caption: 第一条墨迹只限定一条直线。
cues.captionEn: One ink mark constrains only a line.
cues.zh: 现在薄板已经停稳。铅垂线保持竖直，我们沿它在板上留下一条墨迹。稳定平衡告诉我们，重心一定在这条线上。但看这几个候选位置，只凭一条线，还分不出究竟是哪一个。墨迹画在材料上，会跟着板转；真正的铅垂线却一直竖直。要把一条线缩小成一个点，还需要一次独立的观察。
cues.en: The lamina has settled. The plumb line is vertical; transfer that direction onto the board as an ink mark. Stable equilibrium says the centre of gravity lies somewhere on this line. But several candidate points remain. One line cannot distinguish them. The ink belongs to the material and will turn with it, while the plumb line stays vertical. To narrow a line down to one point, we need an independent observation.

cues.title: 换孔后，什么没有变？
cues.titleEn: What stays fixed after changing holes?
cues.caption: 旧墨迹随板转，新悬线提供第二个约束。
cues.captionEn: Old ink turns; a new plumb supplies another constraint.
cues.zh: 保留第一条墨迹，把板换到另一个孔，夹住后再释放。注意棕色的旧线：它随着薄板转动，没有偷偷变成新的竖直线。等板再次停稳，沿现在的铅垂线留下第二条墨迹。两条不同方向的记录相交，才把位置确定下来。这个交点是板上的同一个材料位置。悬点改变了停稳朝向，没有改变板内的质量分布，也就没有改变重心。若两次记录恰好重合，就要换一个更合适的孔。
cues.en: Keep the first ink mark and rehang the board from another hole, holding it before release. Watch the brown line: it turns with the board instead of silently becoming vertical again. After the board settles, mark the new plumb direction. Two records in different directions intersect and locate one point. That point belongs to the material. Changing the support changes the resting orientation, but not the mass distribution or the centre of gravity. If two records coincide, choose a more useful hole.

cues.title: 加配重后，旧交点还对吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the old crossing survive an added mass?
cues.caption: 轮廓不变，配重仍会移动组合重心。
cues.captionEn: The outline stays, but added mass shifts the centre.
cues.zh: 均匀三角形纸板可以先用三条中线预测重心，再用不同悬点的记录检验。现在先夹住板，在一侧装上配重。它的质量是原板的四分之三。旧墨迹和中线交点都没有移动，可整个组合的重心还在那里吗？质量加权预测：新重心沿着旧重心到配重的方向，走过这段距离的七分之三。空心圈标出预测位置。释放后，新的重力线使板转动。停稳画线，再换孔复查，两条新的蓝线交在预测位置附近。旧墨迹一直没改；改变的是质量分布。因此，几何中心只有在相应的均匀条件下，才能代表重心。
cues.en: A uniform triangular card lets us predict its centre from the medians, then test it with suspension records. Clamp the card and attach a mass on one side, three quarters of the original board mass. The old ink and median crossing stay fixed. Does the combined centre stay there too? Mass weighting predicts a shift toward the added mass, through three sevenths of the distance from the old centre. The hollow circle marks that prediction. Release the card: the new weight line turns it. Let it settle and record a line, then check another hole. Two new blue marks meet near the predicted point. The old ink never changed; the mass distribution did. A geometric centre represents the centre of gravity only under the appropriate uniformity conditions.

cues.title: 从碎屑的转向开始
cues.caption: 极化后的碎屑逐渐沿局部电场取向。
cues.captionEn: Polarized fragments gradually align with the local field.
cues.zh: 先看油盘里的短短碎屑。接入单个带电电极后，它们逐渐转向，形成放射状图样。这里我们看见的是碎屑的轴向，不是电荷正在沿一条线流动。细线随后叠加上来，帮助我们把分散的局部取向连成完整图像。
cues.en: Look at the short fragments in the oil tray. With a single charged electrode, they gradually turn into a radial pattern. What we observe is their orientation, not charges flowing along lines. Thin calculated lines then connect these separate local observations into a field picture.

cues.title: 异号电荷之间
cues.caption: 取向连接两端，正试探电荷的受力规定箭头方向。
cues.captionEn: The pattern connects the electrodes; a positive test charge defines arrow direction.
cues.zh: 换成一正一负两个电极。两端之间的碎屑逐渐连成弯曲的图样。碎屑本身没有箭头，电场方向要另作规定：想象放入一个很小的正试探电荷，它受到电力的方向就是电场方向。所以计算箭头从正电荷指向负电荷。
cues.en: Now use one positive and one negative electrode. Fragments between them form a curved connecting pattern. Fragments themselves have no arrows. Direction requires a definition: imagine a very small positive test charge. Its electric-force direction defines the field, so calculated arrows run from positive to negative.

cues.title: 同号电荷之间
cues.caption: 中央场互相抵消，周围的取向向外弯开。
cues.captionEn: The fields cancel at the midpoint and surrounding orientations bend outward.
cues.zh: 把第二个电极也改成正电。图样发生了明显变化：两者之间的取向向外弯开。在完全对称的中央，两份电场方向相反、大小相等，合电场为零。这不是电势也为零。自由探索里，可以用虚拟探针比较这两个不同的量。
cues.en: Make the second electrode positive too. The pattern changes: orientations between the charges bend outward. At the exact symmetric midpoint, equal opposite field contributions cancel. This does not mean potential is zero. In exploration, the virtual probe lets you compare these different quantities.

cues.title: 平行板中部
cues.caption: 只看远离边缘的区域，碎屑近似平行。
cues.captionEn: Away from the edges, fragments are approximately parallel.
cues.zh: 最后换成相对的平行电极板。观察两板中部，碎屑的取向近似平行，表示电场方向较一致。这里用理想均匀场说明中央区域，边缘处的弯曲没有计算。记住：碎屑是可观察的物体，电场线则是我们描述电场的一种工具。
cues.en: Finally use opposing parallel plates. In their central region, fragments are approximately parallel, showing a consistent field direction. This uses an ideal uniform-field approximation and does not calculate edge fringing. The fragments are observable objects; field lines are a tool for describing the field.

cues.title: 接通的瞬间
cues.caption: 原线圈电流变化，副线圈才响应。
cues.captionEn: Changing primary current induces an emf.
cues.zh: 沿着铁环认出两组导线：它们彼此绝缘。合上开关，原线圈的电流开始建立，穿过副线圈的磁通也随之改变。留意电流计的偏转，以及两条波形不同的形状。
cues.en: Follow the two insulated windings around the iron ring. Closing the switch builds the primary current and changes the flux linking the secondary. Notice the meter response and the different shapes of the two traces.

cues.title: 电流稳定以后
cues.caption: 有磁场，不等于持续产生电动势。
cues.captionEn: Steady flux gives zero induced emf.
cues.zh: 电源仍然接通，原线圈仍有电流，铁环里的磁通也没有消失。但副线圈的电动势已经归零。互感响应的是磁通的变化，而不是磁通本身有多大。
cues.en: The source remains connected. Primary current and magnetic flux remain present, yet the secondary emf is zero. Mutual induction responds to changing flux, not simply to the amount of flux present.

cues.title: 断开后反向
cues.caption: 磁通减小，感应电动势方向反转。
cues.captionEn: Decreasing flux reverses the emf.
cues.zh: 现在断开电源。原线圈电流衰减，磁通随之减小。电流计向另一侧偏转。比较接通和断开：原电流并没有反向，改变的是它增加还是减少。
cues.en: Open the switch. Primary current decays and the linked flux decreases. The meter deflects the other way. The primary current has not reversed; its rate of change has.

cues.title: 连续传送音频信号
cues.caption: 变化的原电流，不需要电接触就能传递信号。
cues.captionEn: Changing flux transfers a signal.
cues.zh: 换成套在一起的两个线圈。内线圈接音频信号源，外线圈接接收装置。画面慢放几个周期：每当原电流变化最快，副线圈电动势最大；在原电流达到峰值的瞬间，电动势反而经过零。
cues.en: Now nest one coil inside another. The inner winding receives an audio-frequency signal and the outer winding feeds a receiver. In slow motion, the secondary emf peaks when primary current changes fastest. At the current peak, emf crosses zero.

cues.title: 抽出以后比较
cues.caption: 相同信号源，更小的耦合带来更弱的接收信号。
cues.captionEn: Weaker coupling gives a weaker signal.
cues.zh: 把内线圈抽出一些，并在新的位置停稳。保持原信号的频率和幅度，观察副线圈电动势减小。不是电子跨过了间隙，而是两线圈共享的变化磁通减少了。
cues.en: Withdraw the inner coil and let it stop at the new position. Keep the source frequency and amplitude unchanged. The secondary emf is smaller because less changing flux links both coils; electrons do not jump across the gap.

cues.title: 一个亮点，怎样称出重量？
cues.titleEn: How can a bright spot reveal weight?
cues.caption: 匀速下落给出阻力与重量的约束。
cues.captionEn: Steady falling constrains drag and weight.
cues.zh: 怎样称出一颗油滴的电荷？先别给它指定几个电子。看这颗亮点：没有电场，它匀速走过半毫米，用了大约六点八七秒。匀速意味着什么？不是没有重力，而是空气阻力已经平衡了重力减去浮力。亮点是散射像，不能拿它的宽度直接量半径。我们换一个办法：让三个半径候选面对同一个观测速率。小的候选，阻力大于有效重力，会慢下来；大的候选会加速。只有中间这个约零点八微米的半径，能保持眼前的匀速。结合密度、黏度和空气滑移修正，就得到这颗教学油滴的有效重量。电荷还没有进入这次推断。
cues.en: How could we weigh the charge on a tiny oil drop? Do not assign it an electron count. Watch one bright spot: with no electric field, it travels half a millimetre steadily in about six point eight seven seconds. Steady motion does not mean gravity has disappeared. Air drag now balances gravity minus buoyancy. The spot is scattered light, so its width is not a direct radius measurement. Instead, test three radius candidates against the same observed speed. The small candidate has too much drag for its effective weight and would slow down. The large one would accelerate. Only the middle radius, about zero point eight micrometres, permits steady falling. Density, viscosity and the air-slip correction then give this teaching drop’s effective weight. Its charge has not entered that inference.

cues.title: 电压怎样把电荷变成可测量？
cues.titleEn: How does voltage make charge measurable?
cues.caption: 悬停由电场力与有效重力平衡决定。
cues.captionEn: Hovering requires electric force to balance effective weight.
cues.zh: 现在给极板加电压。上正下负，电场向下，负电油滴受到向上的电场力。还是这颗油滴：电压太大，它向上走；把电压调到大约一百四十一伏，它停住了。注意，悬停时没有黏滞阻力，电场力才单独平衡有效重力。电场等于电压除以板间距，所以电荷大小等于有效重量乘板间距，再除以悬停电压。本教学试验算得约六点四乘十的负十九次方库仑，没有预先要求它是某个整数倍。接下来先预测：只把同一滴的电荷翻倍，原电压还能让它停住吗？先看原电压，向上的力变大了。要恢复悬停，电压应减半，约七十点五伏。重量、电场和运动，给出了可以检验的联系。
cues.en: Now apply a voltage. A positive upper plate and negative lower plate make the field point down, so a negatively charged drop feels an upward electric force. Follow the same drop. Too much voltage makes it rise; near one hundred forty-one volts, it stops. At rest, viscous drag is zero. The electric force alone balances effective weight. Field strength is voltage divided by plate spacing, so charge magnitude is effective weight times spacing, divided by the balance voltage. This teaching trial gives about six point four times ten to the minus nineteen coulombs, without requiring an integer multiple beforehand. Now predict: if only the charge doubles, can the old voltage still hold the drop? It now pulls too strongly upward. Restoring balance requires half the voltage, about seventy point five volts. Weight, field and motion have given us a testable connection.

cues.title: 什么记录支持电荷一步一步地变？
cues.titleEn: What records support stepwise changes of charge?
cues.caption: 固定计时记录约束电荷的共同增量。
cues.captionEn: Fixed timing records constrain charge increments.
cues.zh: 模型还不能证明电荷是离散的。现在换到密立根一九一三年的原始记录，第六号油滴。同一滴的下落时间保持在约十一点八八秒，上升时间却大幅变化。上升匀速时，电场力既要克服有效重力，又要克服向下的阻力。因此，对同一滴和同一电场，上升时间倒数的变化，正比于电荷变化。这里保留作者校正后的倒数，不把推断出的整数当观测输入。先用前八次变化比较共同步长。绿色点不动，候选刻度改变；一个小步能容纳大约一、三、六步这些变化。把步长加倍，小跳变就对不上。锁定较小的候选，再看最后一次未参与拟合的变化：若从第十二组增加两步，预测倒数约为每秒零点零二三六一。揭开原记录，是零点零二三六四，两者接近。这支持反复出现的小增量，但更细的子步长仍能容纳有限记录，不能靠这张表独自证明最小单位。绝对元电荷还需要阻力校准和多滴比较，现代精确值也不是这次历史测量的精度。
cues.en: A model cannot establish that charge is discrete. Now open Millikan’s original nineteen thirteen records for Drop Number Six. The same drop’s fall time stays near eleven point eight eight seconds, while its rise times change greatly. During steady rising, electric force must overcome both effective weight and downward drag. For the same drop and field, changes in reciprocal rise time are therefore proportional to changes in charge. These are the author’s corrected reciprocals; inferred integers are not supplied as observations. Compare a common increment using the first eight changes. The green points stay fixed while candidate marks move. One small increment accommodates changes of about one, three and six steps. Doubling it misses the small jump. Lock the smaller candidate, then test the final change, which was not used in the fit. Two steps above state twelve predict about zero point zero two three six one per second. Reveal the original record: zero point zero two three six four. They are close. This supports recurring small increments, but finer substeps also accommodate finite data. This table alone cannot prove the smallest unit. Absolute elementary charge also needs drag calibration and comparisons across drops; today’s exact value is not the precision of this historical measurement.

cues.title: 让粒子穿过薄金箔
cues.titleEn: Send particles through a thin foil
cues.caption: 绝大多数粒子近乎直行；图中放大展示不同入射偏距。
cues.captionEn: Most particles pass nearly straight; enlarged paths compare impact parameters.
cues.zh: α粒子从窄束射向很薄的金箔，周围的探测屏记录散射。真实实验中绝大多数粒子近乎直行。这里把一个原子核附近的相遇放大，四条轨迹只是挑出的对照，不代表四种轨迹一样常见。先追踪离原子核较远的那一条。
cues.en: A narrow alpha-particle beam strikes a thin gold foil, and a surrounding screen detects scattering. Most particles pass almost straight. The view enlarges encounters near one nucleus. Its four selected paths are comparisons, not equally probable outcomes. First follow the most distant encounter.

cues.title: 把入射偏距逐渐减小
cues.caption: 越接近集中的正电荷，库仑斥力造成的偏转越大。
cues.captionEn: Closer encounters with concentrated positive charge produce stronger deflection.
cues.zh: 把注意力移到更靠近原子核的轨迹。带正电的α粒子受到斥力，运动方向连续改变；入射偏距越小，最终偏转越明显。轨迹来自同一个库仑力模型，不能用粒子碰到金箔就随机拐弯来解释这个实验。
cues.en: Now compare paths that pass closer to the nucleus. Repulsion continuously changes the direction of the positively charged alpha particle. A smaller impact parameter gives a larger final deflection. These paths follow one Coulomb-force model rather than random turns at the foil.

cues.title: 解释少量大角度散射
cues.caption: 少量大角度散射要求正电荷和大部分质量集中在很小区域。
cues.captionEn: Rare large deflections reveal concentrated positive charge and mass.
cues.zh: 最靠近的相遇甚至可以让粒子向后返回。少量这样的大角度事件，难以用弥散的正电荷解释，却符合很小、很重、带正电的原子核。结合大量近乎直行的事件，才能形成核式结构图景。仅看四条示意轨迹，不能读出真实计数比例。
cues.en: The closest encounter can turn a particle backward. Rare large-angle events are difficult to explain with diffuse positive charge but fit a small, massive positive nucleus. Combine them with the many nearly straight tracks to infer atomic structure. These four paths do not provide measured count ratios.

cues.title: 测量散射后的X射线
cues.caption: 固定入射波长，在不同散射角度比较谱线位置。
cues.captionEn: Keep incident wavelength fixed and compare spectral lines at different angles.
cues.zh: 换一套装置：X射线照射石墨，探测器围绕样品改变观察角度。我们测量的是散射光谱的波长，不是α粒子的偏转角。先看近乎向前的方向，散射线与入射参考线几乎重合。曲线的横坐标表示波长。
cues.en: Switch apparatus: X-rays illuminate graphite, and a detector changes its observation angle around the target. We now measure wavelength, not alpha-particle deflection. In the nearly forward direction, the shifted line almost coincides with the incident reference. The graph’s horizontal coordinate is wavelength.

cues.title: 增大散射角度
cues.caption: 散射角增大，散射峰向长波移动；电子获得反冲动量。
cues.captionEn: A larger angle shifts the peak toward longer wavelengths and gives the electron recoil momentum.
cues.zh: 逐渐增大散射角。暖色的散射峰向长波一侧移动，入射参考线留在原处。光子把部分能量和动量交给电子，电子沿虚线方向反冲。根据能量和动量守恒，波长的增加由散射角决定，不是把光强调暗造成的。
cues.en: As the angle increases, the warm-colored shifted peak moves toward longer wavelengths while the incident reference stays fixed. The photon transfers energy and momentum to an electron, whose recoil direction is dashed. Energy and momentum conservation link the wavelength shift to angle, not to dimmer illumination.

cues.title: 比较最大波长改变
cues.caption: 反向散射的波长增加最大；峰位遵循同一守恒关系。
cues.captionEn: Backscattering gives the largest wavelength increase under the same conservation law.
cues.zh: 探测器继续转向反向散射位置，波长增加达到最大值。康普顿效应支持光具有动量的粒子性描述。图中散射峰的宽度和高度只是为了辨认，真正计算的是峰的位置以及电子的反冲方向；真实物质中还会出现未移位的散射成分。
cues.en: Continue toward backscattering, where the wavelength increase is greatest. The Compton effect supports a particle description of light carrying momentum. Peak widths and heights are illustrative; peak positions and electron recoil directions are calculated. Real materials can also produce an unshifted scattering component.

cues.title: 先记录光点零位
cues.caption: 没有按压时，记录光点最初的位置。
cues.captionEn: Record the initial unloaded spot.
cues.zh: 桌面看起来很坚固，受到按压时却仍可能发生微小形变。先不要施力，观察这束光的完整路线：从光源到右侧镜面，再折回左侧镜面，最后射向远处的墙。在墙上记录光点的初始位置。有了这个零位，之后的变化才有可靠的比较基准，而不是只凭印象判断。
cues.en: A tabletop looks rigid, yet pressure may deform it slightly. Begin without pressing. Follow one continuous ray from the source to the right mirror, back to the left mirror, then toward the distant wall. Record its initial spot. This zero gives later changes a reliable reference instead of relying on memory.

cues.title: 按压两镜之间
cues.caption: 桌面局部倾斜，使反射方向发生变化。
cues.captionEn: Local table slopes change the reflected direction.
cues.zh: 现在缓慢按压两面镜之间的桌面。主图里的弯曲很难直接看见，但镜架会跟随桌面的局部方向略微倾斜。这一点转角改变了反射光的方向，墙上光点开始离开零位。下方把纵向形变明确放大五百倍，帮助你看见原因；它不是桌面真的弯出了图中那么大的幅度。
cues.en: Press gently between the mirrors. The bend is difficult to see in the main view, but the mirror supports tilt with the local tabletop slope. This small rotation changes the reflected direction and moves the spot from zero. The lower profile explicitly magnifies vertical deformation five hundred times to reveal the cause; that is not the actual bending amplitude.

cues.title: 让光走得更远
cues.caption: 按压力不变，墙移远后光点偏移更大。
cues.captionEn: At fixed force, a farther wall gives a larger spot displacement.
cues.zh: 保持按压力不变，单独把观察墙移远。桌面的下沉量没有增加，两面镜的方向也没有继续改变，但光点相对零位的偏移更大了。这说明放大来自观察几何：微小角度经过更长的路程，就能形成更容易分辨的位移。我们放大的是读数信号，不是被研究物体本身的形变。
cues.en: Keep the force fixed and move only the wall farther away. The table does not sink farther and the mirrors do not tilt more, but the displacement from zero increases. The amplification comes from observation geometry: a tiny angular difference accumulates over a longer path. We enlarge the measurable signal, not the deformation of the object.

cues.title: 松手检验恢复
cues.caption: 弹性范围内，卸载后回到初始状态。
cues.captionEn: Within the elastic model, unloading restores the initial state.
cues.zh: 最后松开按压力。桌面恢复，镜面回到原来的方向，光点也回到零位。重复加载和卸载，可以检查变化是否能够恢复。这里把桌面简化为弹性梁，数值只是教学设定。教材同页还介绍有机玻璃的光学花纹法，那是另一种显示内部受力的方法，不能把它和两面镜的反射放大混为一谈。
cues.en: Release the pressure. The table recovers, the mirrors return to their original orientations, and the spot returns to zero. Repeated loading checks reversibility. This scene uses an illustrative elastic beam model. The textbook also mentions optical patterns in loaded acrylic: a different way to display internal stress, distinct from the two-mirror amplification shown here.

cues.title: 先调至稳态等亮
cues.caption: 控制稳态电流，才有可比较的两盏灯。
cues.captionEn: Match steady current before comparing the lamps.
cues.zh: 先让开关保持闭合，调节对照支路，使两盏同规格灯泡一样亮。线圈除了自感也有电阻，所以不能直接拿没有匹配电阻的另一盏灯比较。现在两条支路稳态电流相同。
cues.en: Keep the source connected and adjust the reference branch until identical lamps have equal brightness. A coil has resistance as well as inductance, so the resistive reference must be matched. Both steady branch currents now agree.

cues.title: 重新接通
cues.caption: 线圈支路电流逐渐增加。
cues.captionEn: Current in the inductive branch rises gradually.
cues.zh: 重新接通电源。对照灯很快亮起，串有线圈的灯泡逐渐变亮。变化的电流在线圈自身产生电动势，阻碍这次增加。最终电流稳定，两盏灯又回到相同亮度。
cues.en: Reconnect the source. The reference lamp responds promptly while the coil-branch lamp brightens gradually. Changing current induces an emf in the coil that opposes this increase. At steady current, equal brightness returns.

cues.title: 传感器显示上升过程
cues.caption: 保持总电阻相同，比较有无电感。
cues.captionEn: Keep total resistance fixed when removing inductance.
cues.zh: 把灯光换成电流传感器的曲线。绿色曲线显示串有线圈时的电流，浅色虚线是总电阻相同的纯电阻对照。自感改变达到稳态的过程；相同电源和总电阻仍然给出相同的最终电流。
cues.en: Replace the light observation with a current sensor. The green trace includes the coil; the pale reference removes inductance while preserving total resistance. Inductance changes the approach to steady current, while the same source and resistance determine the final value.

cues.title: 断开后的通路
cues.caption: 电源退出，线圈与灯泡仍然闭合。
cues.captionEn: The source leaves, but the coil–lamp loop stays closed.
cues.zh: 注意这次接线已经不同：线圈与灯泡并联，开关只切断电源支路。开关断开后，沿着导线追踪，线圈和灯泡仍组成闭合回路。线圈电流保持原方向，经过灯泡时却与原来方向相反。
cues.en: This circuit is different: the coil and lamp are parallel, and the switch opens only the source branch. Follow the wires after opening. A closed coil–lamp loop survives. Coil current keeps its direction, but it passes through the lamp opposite to the previous lamp current.

cues.title: 低电阻线圈的闪亮
cues.caption: 断开前线圈电流更大，才可能暂时更亮。
cues.captionEn: A larger initial coil current permits a brighter flash.
cues.zh: 线圈电阻只有两欧，低于灯泡的六欧。电源断开前，线圈中储存的电流比灯泡原来的电流大。它转入灯泡，功率短时增加，然后随着磁场能耗散而衰减。能量来自原来储存在磁场中的能量。
cues.en: The two-ohm winding has less resistance than the six-ohm lamp. Before opening, it carries more current than the lamp. That current enters the lamp and briefly raises its power, then decays as stored magnetic energy dissipates.

cues.title: 不是每次都会闪亮
cues.titleEn: Opening need not produce a flash
cues.caption: 增大线圈电阻，反向仍在，闪亮消失。
cues.captionEn: Higher winding resistance removes the flash, not reversal.
cues.zh: 把线圈电阻增加到十欧，再重复同样步骤。原线圈电流更小，断开后灯泡不会比原来更亮。这个反例提醒我们：自感保证电流不能突变，并不保证每次断电都会看见闪亮。
cues.en: Increase winding resistance to ten ohms and repeat. The initial coil current is smaller, so the lamp does not become brighter on opening. This counterexample separates continuity of current from a flash: self-induction does not guarantee brighter light.

cues.title: 测出电流反向
cues.caption: 电流传感器保留电流的正负号。
cues.captionEn: The current sensor preserves the sign.
cues.zh: 最后用电阻和电流传感器替代灯泡观察。开关断开以前规定电阻电流为正方向，断开后的曲线落到负值，再逐渐回到零。曲线直接显示亮度无法区分的方向变化。
cues.en: Finally observe a resistor with a current sensor. Define the original resistor current as positive. After opening, the trace is negative and gradually returns to zero. The signed measurement exposes a reversal that brightness alone cannot show.

cues.title: 先充电，再隔离
cues.caption: 开关断开后，极板保留原来的电荷。
cues.captionEn: Opening the switch preserves charge on the isolated plates.
cues.zh: 先给平行板电容器充电，让静电计显示电压。现在断开电源，注意开关的缺口。忽略漏电，极板保留同一份电荷。接下来的比较，都要守住这个条件。电压发生变化时，才能据此判断电容怎样改变。
cues.en: First charge the parallel plates and observe the electrometer voltage. Now open the switch; notice the gap. Neglecting leakage, the isolated plates retain the same charge. Keep that condition for the following comparisons, so a voltage change can reveal a capacitance change.

cues.title: 只减小板距
cues.caption: 电荷不变；板距减半，电容加倍，电压减半。
cues.captionEn: At fixed charge, halving separation doubles capacitance and halves voltage.
cues.zh: 先只改变两板之间的距离。把板距从十毫米减到五毫米，正对面积和介质保持不变。电容增大到两倍，原来的电荷只需要一半电压。静电计指针回落。这个结论来自断开电源后的固定电荷条件。
cues.en: Change only the distance between the plates, from ten to five millimetres. Keep overlap and material unchanged. Capacitance doubles, so the original charge now needs only half the voltage, and the pointer falls. This conclusion depends on charge remaining fixed after disconnection.

cues.title: 只减小正对面积
cues.caption: 错开一块板，电容减小，电压升高。
cues.captionEn: Offset one plate: capacitance falls and voltage rises.
cues.zh: 恢复原来的板距。这次把一块板向上错开，注意两块板仍然一样大，变小的只是彼此正对的面积。当正对面积减到一半，电容也减半。同一份电荷对应的电压升到两倍，静电计指针张开得更大。
cues.en: Restore the original separation. This time offset one plate upward. Both plates remain the same size; only their facing area shrinks. At half the overlap, capacitance is halved. The same charge then produces twice the voltage, and the electrometer pointer opens farther.

cues.title: 再插入介质
cues.caption: 几何不变；介质使电容增大，电压降低。
cues.captionEn: With geometry unchanged, dielectric insertion raises capacitance and lowers voltage.
cues.zh: 把两板重新对齐，保持原来的距离。将介质板插入两板之间。随着介质覆盖更多正对面积，电容逐渐增大，电压降低。三个比较分别改变板距、面积和介质。自由探索时也可以接回电源，看看固定电压的情形为什么不同。
cues.en: Realign the plates and keep their original separation. Insert a dielectric sheet. As it fills more of the overlapping area, capacitance increases and voltage falls. The three comparisons separately changed separation, overlap and material. In exploration, reconnect the source to see why fixed-voltage conditions differ.

cues.title: 先找到伸长零点
cues.caption: 伸长量等于总长度减去原长。
cues.captionEn: Extension is total length minus natural length.
cues.zh: 研究弹簧时，第一步不是加很多砝码，而是先测没有载荷时的原长。图中的虚线保留这个位置。加上载荷后，尺子读到的是总长度；我们要研究的伸长量，是总长度减去原长。若把这两个量混在一起，后面的图像即使画得很整齐，也不能正确说明弹力关系。
cues.en: Begin a spring experiment by measuring its unloaded natural length. The dashed line preserves that reference. With a load attached, the ruler gives total length; extension is total length minus natural length. Confusing these quantities would invalidate the interpretation, however tidy the graph looks.

cues.title: 逐次加挂砝码
cues.caption: 每次静止后，才用重力代表弹力。
cues.captionEn: Use load weight as spring force only after it settles.
cues.zh: 现在逐次增加砝码。每一次都等到静止，再记录伸长量。静止时砝码的重力和弹簧拉力大小相等，所以质量乘以重力加速度，就得到这一点的弹力。图上的点随实验记录逐个出现。我们在比较多次测量，而不是用一个点就宣布整个关系必然成立。
cues.en: Add masses in steps and wait for rest before recording each extension. At equilibrium, the spring force equals the load weight, so mass times gravitational acceleration gives the corresponding force. Points appear as records are taken. Several measurements are needed to investigate the relationship rather than declaring a rule from one point.

cues.title: 检查比例关系
cues.caption: 线性范围内，伸长翻倍，弹力翻倍。
cues.captionEn: In the linear range, doubling extension doubles force.
cues.zh: 把这些记录放在力与伸长量的坐标中，可以看到直线通过原点。这里弹力与伸长量成正比，直线的斜率表示劲度系数。载荷翻倍时，伸长量翻倍，但弹簧总长度并不翻倍。这个结论有适用范围，不能继续外推到弹簧已经发生永久形变或断裂的情况。
cues.en: The records form a straight line through the origin: force is proportional to extension, and the slope gives stiffness. Doubling the load doubles extension, not total length. This conclusion has a range of validity; it cannot simply be extended to permanent deformation or breakage.

cues.title: 换材料，重新测
cues.titleEn: Change the material and measure again
cues.caption: 橡皮筋的加载曲线可以是弯曲的。
cues.captionEn: Rubber can have a curved loading relation.
cues.zh: 换成橡皮筋，保留测原长、加荷载、读长度的思路。下方容器代表可连续调整的载荷。随着伸长增加，所需拉力的增长不一定均匀，记录可能组成一条弯曲的线。这里的曲线是示意模型，不是某根橡皮筋的实测数据；材料改变后，关系需要重新检查。
cues.en: Replace the spring with rubber while keeping the same measurement logic. The vessel represents a continuously adjustable load. As extension increases, force need not grow uniformly, and the records can form a curve. This is an illustrative constitutive model, not measured data from a particular band. Changing material requires a fresh investigation.

cues.title: 沿卸载路径返回
cues.caption: 相同伸长处，卸载力可以小于加载力。
cues.captionEn: At the same extension, unloading force can be lower.
cues.zh: 不要马上取下橡皮筋，而是逐渐减小载荷，同时记录返回过程。在同一伸长量处，卸载时需要的力可能和加载时不同，两条曲线不再重合。这种路径依赖叫滞回。它提醒我们，除了当前伸长量，还要知道材料经历过什么过程，不能只用一个固定劲度系数概括全部行为。
cues.en: Reduce the load gradually and record the return path. At the same extension, unloading may require a different force, so the curves do not coincide. This path dependence is hysteresis. Besides the current extension, the material history matters; one fixed spring constant cannot summarize the entire response.

cues.title: 重复以后再比较
cues.caption: 比较各轮记录，检查软化与重复性。
cues.captionEn: Compare cycles to check softening and repeatability.
cues.zh: 最后比较多次完整循环之后的记录。虚线保留第一次的加载曲线，当前曲线显示这一示意材料的循环软化。真实橡皮筋还会受到温度、拉伸速度和疲劳影响，并不保证每根都会按同样方式变化。课题研究要把这些条件记录下来，再用重复实验区分稳定规律和偶然差异。
cues.en: Compare records after repeated complete cycles. The dashed curve preserves the first loading trace; the current curve illustrates cycle softening. Real rubber also depends on temperature, speed and fatigue, and different bands need not change in the same way. Record these conditions and repeat measurements to distinguish a stable trend from variation.

cues.title: 先用电场偏转
cues.caption: 电子向电场的反方向偏转，显示射线带负电。
cues.captionEn: The beam deflects opposite the electric field, indicating negative charge.
cues.zh: 放电管中的阴极射线在荧光屏上留下亮斑。加入电场，电子朝电场的反方向偏转，显示它们带负电。这里的亮线是帮助追踪的轨迹，荧光屏上的光点才代表可观察的位置。极板之间受力，离开极板后继续沿切线前进。
cues.en: Cathode rays produce a spot on a fluorescent screen. An electric field deflects the beam opposite the field direction, indicating negative charge. The drawn line helps us track motion; the screen spot represents the observation. After leaving the plates, particles drift along the outgoing tangent.

cues.title: 换成磁场
cues.caption: 磁场改变运动方向，轨迹弯曲；所受力与速度垂直。
cues.captionEn: A magnetic field bends the beam with a force perpendicular to velocity.
cues.zh: 关掉电场，只保留指向画面外的磁场。负电电子向另一侧偏转，磁场中的轨迹弯曲。改变磁场强度，光点的位置随之改变。磁力本身不做功，改变的是速度方向。装置的尺寸和粒子运动已放大、放慢，以便看清过程。
cues.en: Turn off the electric field and keep a magnetic field pointing out of the picture. The negative electrons bend the other way. Changing field strength moves the screen spot. Magnetic force does no work: it changes direction rather than speed. The apparatus and motion are displayed at teaching scales.

cues.title: 让两种偏转抵消
cues.caption: 电场力与磁场力抵消时，电子束恢复直线。
cues.captionEn: When electric and magnetic forces balance, the beam becomes straight.
cues.zh: 同时打开电场和磁场，让两个力大小相等、方向相反。电子束恢复直线时，电子速度等于电场强度除以磁感应强度。再结合单独磁场中的弯曲半径，就能求出电荷量与质量的比。画面用同一运动方程计算三种情况，没有另外画一条直线替代平衡结果。
cues.en: Apply both fields and balance their opposite forces. For an undeflected beam, speed equals electric field divided by magnetic flux density. Combining that speed with magnetic curvature gives charge-to-mass ratio. One equation of motion generates all three views, including the straight balanced trajectory.

cues.title: 把比荷与电荷量区分开
cues.caption: 偏转测量先给出比荷；结合元电荷才可求电子质量。
cues.captionEn: Deflection first gives charge-to-mass ratio; elementary charge is needed to infer mass.
cues.zh: 汤姆孙比较不同阴极材料和管内气体，得到相同的比荷，支持电子是普遍存在的组成部分。偏转测量本身给出的是比荷，不能单独分出电荷与质量。后来结合元电荷的测量，才可以确定电子质量。当前模拟采用已知电子常量，是对方法的重建。
cues.en: Thomson found the same charge-to-mass ratio using different cathode materials and gases, supporting electrons as common constituents of matter. Deflection measures a ratio, not charge and mass separately. Combining it with elementary-charge measurements determines mass. This reconstruction uses the known electron constants.

cues.title: 让射线穿过金属窗
cues.titleEn: Transmit rays through a metal window
cues.caption: 薄金属窗维持管内真空，同时允许一部分电子穿出。
cues.captionEn: A thin metal window preserves the vacuum while transmitting some electrons.
cues.zh: 勒纳德在管壁设置很薄的金属窗。薄膜仍隔开管内与外部环境，却能让一部分阴极射线穿出，外面的观察屏也出现信号。这使研究者能够改变射线穿过的介质。这里用示意观察室表示窗外空间，不能把它理解为电子在空气中永远无损地直线传播。
cues.en: Lenard used a thin metal window in the tube wall. It separated the tube from the outside while transmitting some cathode rays to an external observation screen. That enabled studies in different media. The external chamber is schematic; electrons do not travel indefinitely through air without scattering or energy loss.

cues.title: 比较薄膜的阻挡
cues.caption: 加厚示意薄膜，透过信号减弱；原子并非不可穿透的实心球。
cues.captionEn: A thicker foil weakens transmission; atoms are not impenetrable solid spheres.
cues.zh: 逐渐增加薄膜的相对厚度，透过的信号减弱。电子能够穿透一定厚度的物质，为认识原子的内部空间提供了线索。不过只凭穿透现象，还不能确定核式结构；那需要进一步的散射证据。透过率采用教学衰减模型，不是勒纳德历史数据的拟合。
cues.en: Increase the relative foil thickness and transmission weakens. Penetration provided clues that atoms were not impenetrable solid spheres, but did not by itself establish the nuclear model. Scattering supplied further evidence. Transmission here uses an illustrative attenuation model rather than a fit to Lenard’s historical data.

cues.title: 断开的微安表
cues.caption: 相同初始偏转下，指针来回摆动。
cues.captionEn: The same initial deflection produces oscillation.
cues.zh: 先晃动微安表，使内部运动部分偏离平衡。接线柱断开时，指针来回摆动，只有较弱的机械耗散。浅色曲线记录同一次初始偏转，接下来只改变电路是否闭合。
cues.en: Disturb the sensitive meter so its moving system leaves equilibrium. With terminals open, the pointer oscillates with weak mechanical damping. The pale trace records this initial disturbance; the next comparison changes only the electrical connection.

cues.title: 短接两个接线柱
cues.caption: 感应电流的转矩加快稳定。
cues.captionEn: Induced-current torque makes the pointer settle sooner.
cues.zh: 用导线连起两个接线柱，再给出相同的初始偏转。线圈运动时产生电流，磁力转矩阻碍运动，指针更快稳定。短接没有输入电能；被耗散的是最初摆动的机械能。
cues.en: Join the terminals and repeat the same initial deflection. Motion now induces current in a closed circuit, producing an opposing torque. The pointer settles sooner. Shorting supplies no electrical energy; initial mechanical energy is dissipated.

cues.title: 旋转磁体驱动铝框
cues.titleEn: A rotating magnet drives the frame
cues.caption: 相对转动产生电流，转矩带动铝框。
cues.captionEn: Relative rotation induces current and drives the frame.
cues.zh: 换到可以自由转动的铝框。外部转动蹄形磁体，变化的磁通产生感应电流，铝框随之转动。追踪磁体和铝框各自的角度，铝框并不是被固定在磁体上一起转。
cues.en: Switch to a freely rotating aluminium frame. An external drive rotates the horseshoe magnet, changing flux and inducing current. Torque starts the frame turning. Track the two angles separately: the frame is not mechanically attached to the magnet.

cues.title: 反转与零转差
cues.caption: 铝框跟随磁体时，能量从哪里来？
cues.captionEn: Where does the driven frame get its energy?
cues.zh: 另一次试验，把磁体的转动方向反过来，铝框也反向跟随。两个角度并不相同；相对转动使穿过铝框的磁通变化。假如让它们完全同步，磁通就不再随时间变化，持续驱动转矩也消失。正常驱动时，外部机械功一部分推动铝框，一部分成为电阻热。
cues.en: In a new trial, reverse the magnet. The frame follows in the opposite direction. Their angles differ: relative rotation changes the flux through the frame. Imagine exact synchronism. The flux then stops changing and sustained driving torque vanishes. During normal drive, external mechanical power is divided between mechanical output and electrical heating.

cues.title: 先让铜盘自由转动
cues.caption: 同样的初始角速度，先记录自然减速。
cues.captionEn: Record natural deceleration at a fixed initial speed.
cues.zh: 轻轻拨动铜盘，让它以相同的初始角速度开始转动。先把磁体移开，铜盘只受到较弱的阻力，会转动较长时间。圆盘上的标记帮助我们追踪真实的角位移。
cues.en: Give the copper disc the same initial angular speed and keep the magnet away. Weak drag lets it coast for a long time. The mark on the disc tracks its calculated angular position.

cues.title: 涡流怎样制动
cues.caption: 同一盘面两处电流，怎样改变运动？
cues.captionEn: How do two local currents change the disc’s motion?
cues.zh: 让磁极靠近铜盘边缘，但不接触。近看同一盘面：进入磁场的局部环磁通增加，离开的局部环磁通减小，两处电流方向相反，合起来却阻碍转动。减少的转动能进入电阻热。预测一下：把磁场反过来，会变成加速吗？电流也反向了，制动转矩仍然反向于运动；速度降低以后，制动也减弱。
cues.en: Bring the poles near the disc without contact. On the same moving surface, flux increases at one field edge and decreases at the other. Opposite local currents together oppose rotation. Lost rotational energy becomes electrical heat. Now predict: reverse the field. Will the disc accelerate? The currents also reverse, so the braking torque still opposes motion. Braking weakens as speed falls.

cues.title: 管壁里的环流
cues.caption: 磁体靠近或远离同一管环，电流方向改变。
cues.captionEn: Approaching or leaving a ring reverses its current.
cues.zh: 同一枚磁体在完整铝管中慢慢下落，没有贴住管壁。跟着磁体近看：前方管环的磁通增加，后方管环的磁通减小，电流方向因此相反，两边的作用却都阻碍下落。近似稳定后，重力释放的能量主要变成管壁的电阻热。少数画出的环只是取样，整体阻力使用长管的有效近似。
cues.en: The magnet falls slowly inside the intact aluminium tube without touching its wall. Follow it closely. Flux increases in rings ahead and decreases in rings behind. Their currents reverse direction, yet both oppose the fall. Near steady speed, gravity supplies mainly electrical heating in the wall. The few visible rings are samples; the overall drag uses a long-pipe approximation.

cues.title: 开缝与停住的反例
cues.titleEn: A slit and a stationary magnet
cues.caption: 开缝和停住，怎样改变感应？
cues.captionEn: How do a slit and a stop change induction?
cues.zh: 先预测：在管壁纵向开缝，同一枚磁体会怎样下落？完整环流被切断，磁体落得更快，但缝两侧仍可有局部回流，不能说所有涡流都为零。再看另一个检验：把磁体固定在完整管内。磁通仍然存在，却不再变化，感应电动势和持续电流都归零。因此制动依赖磁通的变化，不是磁体静静吸住铝管。
cues.en: Predict the fall after cutting a longitudinal slit. Breaking the large loops makes the same magnet fall faster. Local return paths can remain on either side, so not every eddy is eliminated. Try a different test: hold the magnet still inside an intact tube. Flux remains, but no longer changes. Induced voltage and sustained current become zero. Braking depends on changing flux, not static attraction.

cues.title: 弹簧磁体自由振动
cues.caption: 断开线圈，先保留同一初始位移。
cues.captionEn: Start with the coil open and the same displacement.
cues.zh: 弹簧下端悬挂磁体，下面放着线圈。先断开线圈，从固定初始位置释放磁体。它在平衡位置附近反复振动。浅色曲线保留这次对照，便于比较闭合以后发生的变化。
cues.en: Suspend the magnet from a spring above a coil. Open the coil and release from a fixed displacement. The magnet oscillates around equilibrium. The pale trace preserves this reference for the closed-circuit comparison.

cues.title: 闭合线圈后的衰减
cues.caption: 振动能经感应电流耗散，衰减加快。
cues.captionEn: Induced current dissipates oscillation energy more quickly.
cues.zh: 保持弹簧和初始位置不变，只闭合线圈。磁体上下运动使磁通反复变化，感应电流的作用始终阻碍运动，因此振幅更快减小。不同装置中的制动，最终都能用能量去向来检验。
cues.en: Keep the spring and initial displacement unchanged, then close the coil. Up-and-down motion changes the flux repeatedly. The induced response opposes motion in either direction, reducing amplitude faster. Energy accounting unites these different damping apparatuses.

cues.title: 记录同一次放电
cues.caption: 电流逐渐减小，电容器两端电压同时降低。
cues.captionEn: Current declines as the capacitor voltage falls.
cues.zh: 看已经充电的电容器。开关闭合，电荷经过传感器和电阻流动，传感器留下电流随时间变化的曲线。开始时电压较高，电流较大。随着电荷减少，电压降低，电流也逐渐变小。曲线尾部趋近零，但有限时间后仍有少量电荷留下。
cues.en: Watch the charged capacitor. When the switch closes, charge passes through the sensor and resistor, producing a current-time record. Initial voltage and current are high. As charge decreases, voltage falls and current declines. The tail approaches zero, but some charge remains at every finite time.

cues.title: 把面积加起来
cues.caption: 面积给出已释放电荷。
cues.captionEn: Area gives released charge.
cues.zh: 重新看同一次放电，这次关注曲线下面的阴影。一个很短的时间内，电流乘以时间就是流过的电荷。把所有小面积相加，得到已经放出的电荷量。下面同时保留剩余电荷的读数，两部分合起来，才是开始时储存的总量。
cues.en: Replay the discharge and watch the shaded area. Over a short interval, current times time gives transferred charge. Adding the small areas gives the charge already released. The remaining-charge reading stays visible too. Released and remaining portions together make the initial total.

cues.title: 接到相同的空电容器
cues.caption: 达到共同电压后，电荷与电压都各减半。
cues.captionEn: At a common voltage, each has half the original charge and voltage.
cues.zh: 换一种方法观察电荷与电压。A 原先带电，B 是相同的空电容器。闭合连接开关，电荷重新分配，直到两端电压相同。再断开连接，A 和 B 各得到一半电荷，电压也都是原来的一半。电荷守恒，但连接过程中会损失一部分电场能。
cues.en: Now compare charge and voltage another way. A is charged and B is an identical empty capacitor. Close the switch and charge redistributes until their voltages match. Disconnect them: each retains half the original charge and half the voltage. Charge is conserved, but some field energy is lost during connection.

cues.title: 再换一只新的空电容器
cues.caption: B 保留自己的电荷，A 接到新 C 后再次减半。
cues.captionEn: B retains its share; connecting A to a new C halves A again.
cues.zh: 把上一只 B 移走，它仍然保留自己的电荷。现在拿来一只新的空电容器 C，接到同一只 A 上。达到共同电压后再断开，A 的电荷与电压又减半。关键是每次接入的电容器都相同，而且原先没有充电，不能把已经带电的 B 当作新的空电容器。
cues.en: Remove the previous B; it still holds its share. Bring in a new empty capacitor C and connect it to the same A. After they reach a common voltage, disconnect them. A’s charge and voltage halve again. Each receiving capacitor must be identical and initially uncharged; the already charged B is not a fresh empty capacitor.

cues.title: 先保证匀速
cues.caption: 匀速水平拖动时，拉力等于滑动摩擦力。
cues.captionEn: A steady horizontal pull equals kinetic friction.
cues.zh: 把木块放在水平桌面上，用测力计沿水平方向匀速拉动。镜头跟着木块，所以桌面纹理向后移动。匀速是这一测量的重要条件：加速度为零，水平方向的拉力和摩擦力大小相等，读数才可以代表滑动摩擦力。如果木块正在明显加速，就不能直接这样读数。
cues.en: Pull a block horizontally at steady speed. The view follows the block, so the table marks move backward. Constant speed matters: zero acceleration means the horizontal pull balances friction, allowing the meter to measure kinetic friction. A clearly accelerating block would not satisfy that reading rule.

cues.title: 增加正压力
cues.caption: 材料相同，增加载荷后摩擦力增大。
cues.captionEn: For the same surfaces, added load increases friction.
cues.zh: 保持相同接触材料与匀速拉动方式，在木块上加砝码。桌面承受的正压力增加，测力计的读数也增大。在这里的干摩擦模型中，正压力翻倍，滑动摩擦力也翻倍。我们改变的是压紧程度，而不是把木块拉得更快；比较时要把这两个条件分清。
cues.en: Keep the surfaces and steady pulling method unchanged, and add a mass. The normal load rises, as does the force reading. In this dry-friction model, doubling normal load doubles kinetic friction. We changed how strongly the surfaces press together, not how quickly the block is pulled; keep these conditions separate.

cues.title: 用手体验压力变化
cues.caption: 按压更大时，滑动的阻碍更明显。
cues.captionEn: Stronger pressure produces more sliding resistance.
cues.zh: 换成手压桌面的体验。手沿桌面滑动，同时改变向下的压力，就能比较压紧程度对滑动阻碍的影响。这里的数字仍然来自模型，并不是对真实手感的测量。这个小活动和木块实验有相同的控制思路：接触材料不变，专门改变正压力，再观察或感受摩擦的变化。
cues.en: Try the related hand-on-table activity. Move the hand while changing downward pressure to compare sliding resistance. These numerical values remain model predictions, not measurements of a real sensation. Like the block experiment, the comparison keeps the contact materials fixed and changes normal load.

cues.title: 留下起滑峰值
cues.caption: 静摩擦随拉力增加，纸团保留最大读数。
cues.captionEn: Static friction grows with pull; the paper keeps the peak.
cues.zh: 现在从静止开始，缓慢增大拉力。木块还没动，静摩擦力已经随着拉力一起增大，并不是始终等于一个固定最大值。到达起滑边界之后，木块开始运动，读数向下回落。小纸团留下刚才的最大位置，指针可以返回。注意刚起滑时还有加速度，要到接近匀速时，拉力才接近滑动摩擦力。
cues.en: Start from rest and gradually increase the pull. Static friction grows with it while the block remains still; it is not always a fixed maximum. At the breakaway threshold, motion begins and the reading falls. The paper keeps the highest position while the pointer returns. Immediately after breakaway the block accelerates, so pull approaches kinetic friction only as the speed settles.

cues.title: 看完整时间记录
cues.caption: 传感器同时保留增长、峰值和回落。
cues.captionEn: The sensor preserves the rise, peak and falling reading.
cues.zh: 用力传感器重新观察同一个过程。曲线先随时间上升，在起滑附近达到峰值，再降向较低的稳定读数。它比一个最大值保留了更多过程信息。暂停在不同位置，把曲线、木块运动和仪器读数相互核对。最大静摩擦力与滑动摩擦力是不同概念，不能把静止阶段全部涂成峰值。
cues.en: A force sensor records the same process continuously: a rising force, a peak around breakaway, then a lower steady reading. It retains more information than a maximum alone. Pause at different times and compare graph, block motion and instrument reading. Maximum static friction and kinetic friction are distinct; the whole stationary interval must not be represented by the peak value.

cues.title: 先观察电池
cues.caption: 同一极性，稳定电压。
cues.captionEn: One polarity, steady voltage.
cues.zh: 把示波器接在电池两端，观察电压随时间的记录。曲线停留在零线上方，表示这个理想电池的电压保持同一极性和大小。注意波形的纵轴，不要只把它看成一条线。
cues.en: Connect the oscilloscope across a battery. Its trace stays above zero, representing a constant voltage with one polarity. Read the vertical axis: the line records a physical quantity over time.

cues.title: 换成交流电源
cues.caption: 跨过零线，极性反转。
cues.captionEn: Crossing zero reverses polarity.
cues.zh: 换接学生电源的交流输出。电压周期性跨过零，上下两部分分别代表相反的极性。这里交流有效值仍是三伏，但峰值更大。有效值相同，不等于每一瞬间的电压相同。
cues.en: Switch to the teaching supply’s AC output. Voltage crosses zero periodically, so the two halves represent opposite polarities. Its RMS value is still three volts, while its peak is larger. Equal RMS values do not imply equal instantaneous voltages.

cues.title: 发电机的一半周期
cues.caption: 电流方向决定哪只LED发光。
cues.captionEn: Current direction selects the LED.
cues.zh: 转动教学发电机，跟随磁极之间的线圈。滑环使两个线圈端点各自保持连接。两个LED反向并联，电流朝一个方向时只有对应的LED导通并发光。
cues.en: Turn the teaching generator and follow its coil between the poles. Separate slip rings preserve contact with both winding ends. The LEDs are antiparallel: a given current direction lights only the appropriately oriented LED.

cues.title: 另一半周期
cues.caption: 电流反向，另一只LED亮起。
cues.captionEn: Reverse current lights the other LED.
cues.zh: 继续转动，线圈中感应电动势反向，另一只LED亮起。对照电流读数的正负号，两个发光方向与同一转子相位对应。滑环只是保持连接，并没有把交流变成直流。
cues.en: Continue turning. The induced emf reverses and the other LED lights. Compare the signed current readout with the shared rotor phase. Slip rings maintain electrical contact; they do not turn this AC output into DC.

cues.title: 电流为什么不能突变？
cues.caption: 自感阻碍电流的变化。
cues.captionEn: Induction opposes changing current.
cues.zh: 刚接上三伏直流，电流没有立即达到稳态。跟着导线上的箭头看：电流增长时，线圈磁场增强，变化的磁场产生反向自感电动势。等电流稳定，磁场不再变化，自感电动势趋于零。线圈阻碍的是电流的变化；稳态电流仍由总电阻限制。
cues.en: Watch the arrows after three-volt DC is connected. Current builds rather than jumping to its final value. The growing magnetic field induces an opposing emf. Once current becomes steady, that induced emf approaches zero. An inductor opposes change in current; lamp and winding resistance still limit the final current.

cues.title: 频率为什么影响线圈？
cues.titleEn: Why does frequency matter to a coil?
cues.caption: 同有效值，频率越高电流越小。
cues.captionEn: Higher frequency lowers the current.
cues.zh: 保持三伏有效值，换成交流。电流不断变化，线圈磁场也随之变化，自感电动势不再一直为零。灯泡的平均功率比稳态直流时小。现在把频率从五十赫兹提高到一百赫兹，变化更快，感抗更大，电流有效值进一步减小。
cues.en: At the same three-volt RMS supply, AC keeps changing the current. The coil’s field changes too, so self-induced emf never stays zero. The lamp receives less average power than on steady DC. Now frequency rises from fifty to one hundred hertz. Faster change produces stronger opposition; RMS current falls.

cues.title: 电荷为什么让电流变小？
cues.titleEn: Why does accumulated charge reduce current?
cues.caption: 电荷积累，充电电流减小。
cues.captionEn: Charge builds; current fades.
cues.zh: 盯住电容的两块极板。接上直流后，正负电荷分别积累，电容两端电压升高。留给灯泡的电压越来越小，充电电流便逐渐减小。等电容电压接近电源电压，电流趋于零。电容隔直流，说的是最后的稳态，不能抹掉开始时的充电过程。
cues.en: Follow the charges on the capacitor plates. After DC is connected, opposite charges accumulate and capacitor voltage rises. Less voltage remains across the lamp, so charging current falls. When capacitor voltage approaches the supply voltage, current approaches zero. Blocking DC describes this final state, not the initial charging process.

cues.title: 绝缘间隙怎样允许外电流？
cues.titleEn: How can outside current persist across an insulating gap?
cues.caption: 极板换号，介质仍然绝缘。
cues.captionEn: The dielectric stays insulating.
cues.zh: 改接交流，继续跟着同一对极板。电荷多少和正负不断改变，导线中的电流也反向。请看绝缘间隙：没有电荷穿过它。一块极板上增加电荷，同时另一块极板上移走电荷。反复充电、放电，让外电路持续有变化的电流，灯泡获得平均功率。
cues.en: Switch to AC and follow the same plates. Their charge and polarity reverse as current in the outside wires reverses. Nothing carries conduction current across the insulating gap. Charge moving onto one plate is accompanied by charge leaving the other. Repeated charging and discharging lets the lamp receive average power.

cues.title: 为什么电容的趋势相反？
cues.titleEn: Why is a capacitor’s frequency trend opposite?
cues.caption: 同有效值，频率越高电流越大。
cues.captionEn: Higher frequency raises the current.
cues.zh: 保持同一个电容和三伏电源有效值，把频率从五十赫兹提高到一百赫兹。换向更快，极板电荷也要更快地变化。容抗随频率升高而减小，电流有效值增大，灯泡平均功率增加。线圈阻碍快速变化，而电容更容易在较高频率下维持外电路电流。
cues.en: Keep the capacitor and three-volt RMS supply unchanged. Raise frequency from fifty to one hundred hertz. Faster cycling requires plate charge to change more rapidly. Capacitive reactance falls, so RMS current and average lamp power increase. This is the opposite frequency trend to the coil: reactive components cannot all be treated as fixed resistors.

cues.title: 电容里储存了什么？
cues.titleEn: What has the charged capacitor stored?
cues.caption: 电容已充电，能量在电场中。
cues.captionEn: Charge stores electric energy.
cues.zh: 电容已经充到五伏。两块极板上的相反电荷建立电场，储存十二点五毫焦耳能量。线圈没有电流，也就没有磁场储能。此时开关仍接向电源。接下来提供自由振荡能量的，是这只预先充电的电容，不是持续工作的电源。
cues.en: The capacitor has already been charged to five volts. Opposite plate charges store electric-field energy: twelve and a half millijoules. The coil carries no current, so it stores no magnetic energy. The switch still selects the supply. This charged capacitor, not a running power supply, will provide the energy for free oscillation.

cues.title: 电压为零，电流为何不停？
cues.titleEn: Why does current continue at zero voltage?
cues.caption: 能量往返，电容极性反转。
cues.captionEn: Energy swaps; polarity reverses.
cues.zh: 开关切向线圈，电源退出回路。先把电阻设为零。电容放电，电流和磁场能增大。停在电容电压为零的这一刻：电流恰好最大。电流继续流动，使电容反向充电，能量又回到电场。电压为零不代表能量消失，它已经转移到了线圈的磁场中。
cues.en: Move the switch onto the coil; the supply is out of the loop. We first set resistance to zero. Discharge builds current and magnetic energy. Pause when capacitor voltage reaches zero: current is at its maximum. It keeps flowing, charges the capacitor with opposite polarity, and returns energy to the electric field. Zero voltage does not mean zero stored energy.

cues.title: 衰减的能量去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does the lost oscillation energy go?
cues.caption: 振幅衰减，电磁能转成热。
cues.captionEn: Lost field energy becomes heat.
cues.zh: 现在加入一欧电阻，把观察时间拉长。每当电流通过电阻，就有一部分电磁能转变成热。电场能和磁场能的份额逐渐缩小，热的份额增大，三者总和始终等于初始能量。在自由探索里把电阻降回零，就可以预测：没有电阻耗散，理想振荡将持续下去。
cues.en: Now add one ohm of resistance and watch more cycles. Each time current flows, some field energy becomes heat. The electric and magnetic parts shrink while the heat portion grows. Their sum stays equal to the initial energy. Set resistance back to zero in exploration to predict continuing oscillation with no resistive heating.

cues.title: 把两只挂钩相连
cues.caption: 两只表同时变化，读数大小相等。
cues.captionEn: Both readings change together with equal magnitude.
cues.zh: 把两只弹簧测力计的挂钩相连，缓慢拉动右端。左边仪器受到右边的拉力，右边仪器也受到左边的拉力。两表读数一起增大，大小相等。先把每个力的受力对象说清楚，就不会只凭谁主动拉、谁看起来没有动，来猜测哪一个力更大。这是一对同时存在的相互作用。
cues.en: Connect the hooks of two spring balances and pull the right end slowly. The right instrument pulls the left, and the left pulls the right. Their readings rise together with equal magnitude. Identify the recipient of each force before judging from who initiates the pull or appears to remain still. These forces are one simultaneous interaction.

cues.title: 伸长不同不是力不同
cues.titleEn: Unequal stretch is not unequal force
cues.caption: 分别标定的刻度，把不同伸长换成相同力值。
cues.captionEn: Separate calibrations turn unequal extensions into equal forces.
cues.zh: 换一只劲度系数不同的仪器。现在两根弹簧可以伸长得不一样，读出的力却仍然一样大。因为测力计刻度按各自的弹性关系标定，伸长量不是力本身。画面把作用在A上的力和作用在B上的力分开标出：它们方向相反，作用对象不同，不能在同一个物体的受力图里直接相互抵消。
cues.en: Use a balance with different stiffness. Its spring can extend by a different amount while measuring the same force. Each scale follows its own calibration; extension is not force itself. The arrows distinguish the force on A from the force on B. They point oppositely but act on different objects, so they are not a balanced pair on one free-body diagram.

cues.title: 统一符号再记录
cues.caption: 以向右为正，两条记录关于零线对称。
cues.captionEn: With rightward positive, the traces mirror about zero.
cues.zh: 再换成力传感器，保留整个变化过程。为了比较方向，我们把向右统一规定为正，所以B对A的力在零线上方，A对B的力在零线下方。要配对的是同一时刻的两个值，不是任意找两个峰值。实际仪器还要检查零点、安装方向和采样同步，才能把记录正确放到一起。
cues.en: Force sensors retain the full history. Define rightward as positive for both: B’s force on A lies above zero, and A’s force on B below it. Compare values at the same instant, not arbitrary peaks. Real instruments also require zeroing, mounting-direction checks and synchronized sampling before their records can be compared.

cues.title: 两端都动仍然配对
cues.caption: 移动状态不会改变作用力与反作用力的配对。
cues.captionEn: Motion does not remove the action–reaction pairing.
cues.zh: 最后让两端都改变位置。装置不必静止，两个相互作用力仍然同时相等、方向相反。这里为了清楚显示仪器内部，用的是忽略内部惯性的准静态近似；这不表示第三定律只在慢速或静止时成立。判断一个物体怎样运动，还要继续把它受到的其他力一起列出，而不是只看这一对分属于两个对象的力。
cues.en: Now move both endpoints. Rest is not required: the interaction forces remain simultaneous, equal and opposite. The instrument internals use a quasistatic approximation that neglects their inertia; this does not limit the third law to slow or stationary motion. To predict one object’s motion, include all its other forces as well, not just this pair acting on two different objects.

cues.title: 发射与传播
cues.caption: 迅速变化的电磁场带走能量。
cues.captionEn: Rapidly changing fields carry energy outward.
cues.zh: 先看发射间隙。高压放电激起快速变化的电磁场，能量向外传播。画面把纳秒级过程大幅放慢，波前不是空气中的实体圆环，而是帮助追踪传播位置的标记。
cues.en: Watch the transmitter gap. A discharge excites rapidly varying electromagnetic fields that carry energy outward. Nanosecond motion is greatly slowed. The drawn fronts track propagation; they are not physical rings in the air.

cues.title: 另一处间隙响应
cues.caption: 接收环在传播延迟之后响应。
cues.captionEn: The loop responds after the travel delay.
cues.zh: 跟随波到达另一个开口导线环。变化的磁通激起电动势，间隙出现响应。注意没有导线连接两套装置，而且接收不能早于传播时间。真实火花阈值很复杂，这里只用亮度提示响应强弱。
cues.en: Follow the wave to the separate gapped loop. Changing linked flux induces an emf and a response at its gap. No wire connects the devices, and reception cannot precede travel time. Brightness here indicates response rather than a detailed spark-breakdown threshold.

cues.title: 反射产生干涉
cues.caption: 同一空间出现固定的强弱位置。
cues.captionEn: Fixed nodes and antinodes appear in space.
cues.zh: 加入金属反射面，入射波与反射波叠加。有些位置始终很弱，邻近位置振幅很大，形成驻波。这样的空间干涉结构，把接收到电信号进一步连接到可测量的波长。
cues.en: Add a metal reflector. Incident and reflected waves combine into a standing pattern with fixed nodes and antinodes. This spatial interference links electrical reception to a measurable wavelength.

cues.title: 进入另一种介质
cues.caption: 传播方向改变，满足折射关系。
cues.captionEn: The direction changes according to refraction.
cues.zh: 让电磁波进入另一种介质。保持同一频率，传播速度和波长改变，方向向法线偏折。这里用平面界面简化折射装置，改变入射角仍能检验同一个折射关系。
cues.en: Let the wave enter another medium. Frequency stays the same while speed and wavelength change, and the direction bends toward the normal. This planar-interface model isolates refraction and lets different incidence angles test the same relation.

cues.title: 转动接收环
cues.caption: 接收响应取决于方向投影。
cues.captionEn: Reception depends on directional projection.
cues.zh: 回到发射器与接收环。改变接收环法线相对磁场的方向，穿过环的变化磁通减小，接收响应也减弱。方向选择性说明电磁波具有偏振性质，而不只是任意方向都相同的扰动。
cues.en: Return to the transmitter and loop. Rotate the loop normal relative to the magnetic field. Less changing flux links the loop, weakening its response. This directional selectivity reveals polarization rather than a disturbance identical in every orientation.

cues.title: 通过有限狭缝
cues.caption: 波长相同，狭缝越窄，衍射展开越明显。
cues.captionEn: At fixed wavelength, a narrower slit spreads the wave more.
cues.zh: 最后让波通过有限宽度的狭缝。观察归一化接收强度：狭缝相对波长变窄，中央主瓣展开得更明显。反射、干涉、折射、偏振与衍射共同构成了电磁波的证据链。
cues.en: Finally pass the wave through a finite slit. In the normalized intensity profile, a slit narrower relative to wavelength produces a broader central lobe. Reflection, interference, refraction, polarization and diffraction form a connected body of wave evidence.

cues.title: 先看火焰的颜色
cues.caption: 钠原子发出的强黄光，让食盐焰色显得鲜明。
cues.captionEn: Strong yellow emission from sodium gives the flame its characteristic color.
cues.zh: 把少量食盐放入火焰，受激的钠原子发出显著的黄光。颜色是第一条线索，但肉眼把许多波长混合在一起。画面从火焰取出一束光，经过狭缝再进入分光装置；这才把颜色观察变成波长的比较。
cues.en: A small amount of salt gives a flame a strong yellow color as excited sodium atoms emit light. Color provides a clue, but the eye combines wavelengths. A slit selects light from the flame and sends it through the spectroscope, turning a color impression into a wavelength comparison.

cues.title: 把黄光再展开
cues.caption: 放大黄色区域，两条相邻的钠谱线才被分开。
cues.captionEn: Enlarge the yellow region to separate two nearby sodium lines.
cues.zh: 展开黄色附近的波长刻度，原来的一束黄光分成两条邻近的谱线。这里采用钠的两条可见强线，空气中的波长约为五百八十九点零和五百八十九点六纳米。光谱线位置可以识别元素；线宽和相对亮度只作教学显示，不是火焰的实测结果。
cues.en: Expand the wavelength scale around yellow. Two nearby sodium lines become distinguishable, at about five hundred eighty-nine point zero and five hundred eighty-nine point six nanometers in air. Their positions help identify the element. Displayed widths and relative brightness are illustrative rather than measured flame data.

cues.title: 氢灯只留下几条亮线
cues.caption: 可见的巴耳末谱线，来自不同高能级向同一低能级的跃迁。
cues.captionEn: Visible Balmer lines correspond to transitions ending at the same lower level.
cues.zh: 换成低压氢放电灯，分光后不再是连续的彩带，而是几条分立亮线。这里展示巴耳末系中四条可见谱线，都以第二能级为终点。画面以不同的入射颜色表示各条谱线，并不表示氢原子内存在这些彩色轨道。
cues.en: Replace the flame with a low-pressure hydrogen discharge lamp. The spectrum contains separate bright lines rather than a continuous band. Four visible Balmer lines are shown, all ending at the second energy level. Their colors identify wavelengths; they do not depict colored orbits inside the atom.

cues.title: 用共同规律比较谱线
cues.caption: 改变初始能级，谱线位置按同一里德伯关系变化。
cues.captionEn: Changing the upper level moves the selected line according to one Rydberg relation.
cues.zh: 依次选择第三到第六能级，观察被选中的谱线位置。能级越高，相邻谱线越密，逐渐趋向谱系极限。数值由同一个里德伯公式计算，使用真空波长；它忽略精细结构等小修正，因此不能拿来解释下一段的精密谱线差异。
cues.en: Select upper levels three through six and follow the highlighted wavelength. Successive lines approach one another toward the series limit. One Rydberg relation calculates the vacuum wavelengths. This approximation omits fine structure and smaller corrections, so it cannot explain the precision discrepancy examined later.

cues.title: 连续光谱里缺了哪些颜色
cues.caption: 太阳光谱中的暗线，是特定波长被较冷气体吸收的结果。
cues.captionEn: Dark solar lines mark wavelengths absorbed by cooler gas.
cues.zh: 太阳的可见光近似形成连续背景，穿过外层较冷的气体后，某些波长被吸收，形成夫琅禾费暗线。这里突出显示与氢的巴耳末谱线对应的位置，真实太阳光谱还有大量其他元素的谱线。暗线不是光完全消失，而是相对邻近波长变弱。
cues.en: Sunlight forms an approximately continuous visible background. Cooler gas in the outer layers absorbs selected wavelengths, producing Fraunhofer lines. This view highlights positions corresponding to hydrogen Balmer lines; the real solar spectrum includes many other elements. A dark line is reduced intensity relative to nearby wavelengths, not necessarily zero light.

cues.title: 把实验室亮线叠上去
cues.caption: 同一元素的发射线与吸收线，在相应跃迁波长处对齐。
cues.captionEn: Emission and absorption from the same transition align in wavelength.
cues.zh: 把实验室氢灯的谱线叠在太阳暗线之上，相同跃迁对应的位置对齐。这样就能从远处的光推断物质组成，不必把太阳物质带回实验室。实际分析还需要校准、线形以及多种元素的比对，本页只保留位置匹配这一证据链。
cues.en: Overlay the laboratory hydrogen lines on the selected solar absorption lines. Matching transitions align in wavelength, allowing composition to be inferred from distant light. Real analysis also requires calibration, line profiles and comparisons among many elements. This demonstration isolates the evidence provided by matching positions.

cues.title: 精密测量暴露小偏差
cues.caption: 早期精密氢光谱发现的偏差，超出了简单能级公式。
cues.captionEn: Early precision measurements revealed departures from simple level formulas.
cues.zh: 教材提到谢玉铭与休斯敦在一九三三年对氢光谱的精密研究。更细的测量暴露出已有理论未充分解释的差异。这里先比较简化理论中重合的能级与后来确认的微小分裂；这张能级图是教学整理，不冒充当年原始光谱。
cues.en: The textbook mentions the precision hydrogen measurements by Houston and Hsieh in nineteen thirty-three. Such measurements exposed discrepancies beyond the existing description. We first compare coincident levels in a simplified prediction with the small separation later established. This teaching diagram is not a reproduction of their original optical data.

cues.title: 后来用微波直接比较能级
cues.titleEn: Later probe the levels with microwaves
cues.caption: 扫描微波频率，亚稳态氢原子的存活信号在共振附近下降。
cues.captionEn: A microwave scan reduces the surviving metastable-atom signal near resonance.
cues.zh: 到一九四七年，兰姆与雷瑟福采用微波方法研究氢能级。亚稳态原子经过微波场，共振会把它们转到迅速衰变的状态，下游探测到的亚稳态信号减弱。扫描频率时出现的凹口，提供了两个能级之间差值的证据。这与早期光学实验是不同装置。
cues.en: In nineteen forty-seven, Lamb and Retherford studied hydrogen with microwaves. Resonant radiation transfers metastable atoms into a rapidly decaying state, reducing the surviving metastable signal downstream. A dip during the frequency scan identifies the energy separation. This is a different apparatus from the earlier optical measurements.

cues.title: 频率差对应能量差
cues.caption: 共振频率约为1058 MHz；曲线宽度与深度在这里仅作示意。
cues.captionEn: The separation is about 1058 MHz; this curve’s width and depth are illustrative.
cues.zh: 把频率停在共振附近，亚稳态探测信号最低。频率约为一千零五十八兆赫，通过普朗克关系对应很小的能量差。页面用洛伦兹形曲线说明扫描方法，宽度和深度不是历史测量数据。精密实验的价值，正是让原本隐藏在近似之下的差别成为可以检验的证据。
cues.en: Stop near resonance, where the metastable signal is lowest. A frequency of about one thousand fifty-eight megahertz corresponds through Planck’s relation to a small energy separation. The Lorentzian width and depth are illustrative, not historical data. Precision measurements make differences hidden by an approximation experimentally testable.

cues.title: 先有可重复基线
cues.caption: 先固定频段、信号和传输条件。
cues.captionEn: Fix the band, signal and traffic conditions first.
cues.zh: 开始之前，先区分连接蓝牙和蓝牙正在持续传输。这个基线没有蓝牙流量，宽条表示同一个Wi-Fi信道的传输时隙。接下来的对照保持同一套输入，只改变我们要研究的条件。
cues.en: Distinguish being connected to Bluetooth from actively transmitting. This baseline has no Bluetooth traffic. Wide marks show transmission slots in the same Wi-Fi channel. The next comparisons preserve the inputs and change one selected condition.

cues.title: 同频与同时
cues.caption: 只有交叠的数据包才满足碰撞条件。
cues.captionEn: Only overlapping packets meet the collision condition.
cues.zh: 加入蓝牙传输。窄点在频率之间跳动，只有同时落在Wi-Fi占用范围内的活动被标成碰撞。即使共享二点四吉赫频段，也不是每个数据包都相撞。这里的首次送达率是模型结果，不是真实网速。
cues.en: Add Bluetooth traffic. Narrow marks hop between frequencies. Only simultaneous marks within the Wi-Fi allocation are flagged as collisions. Sharing 2.4 GHz does not make every packet collide. The first-attempt delivery rate is a model result, not measured speed.

cues.title: 避开拥挤频点
cues.caption: 跳频策略可以减少同频碰撞。
cues.captionEn: Adaptive hopping can reduce frequency collisions.
cues.zh: 开启示意的自适应跳频，把正在被Wi-Fi占用的频点排除。蓝牙仍在传输，但更多活动离开冲突区域。真实设备还可能协调两种无线电的工作时间，所以干扰程度取决于具体实现。
cues.en: Enable illustrative adaptive hopping and exclude occupied Wi-Fi frequencies. Bluetooth continues transmitting, but activity moves outside the conflict region. Real devices may also coordinate radio timing, so interference depends on implementation.

cues.title: 把Wi-Fi移到另一频段
cues.caption: 频段分开，消除这个模型中的同频碰撞。
cues.captionEn: Separate bands remove this model’s frequency collisions.
cues.zh: 把Wi-Fi改到五吉赫频段，蓝牙仍留在二点四吉赫。这里画出的同频碰撞不再出现。不过这并不保证实际测速必定更快，信号衰减、设备和网络负载仍然重要。
cues.en: Move Wi-Fi to 5 GHz while Bluetooth remains at 2.4 GHz. The frequency collisions shown here disappear. That does not guarantee a faster real speed test: propagation, hardware and network load still matter.

cues.title: 回到手机做重复对照
cues.caption: 多次交替测量，区分效应与波动。
cues.captionEn: Alternate repeated measurements to distinguish effect from variation.
cues.zh: 回到真实手机，固定地点和测速服务器，在蓝牙传输前后交替测量多次。保留原始结果，再比较平均值和波动。自由探索可以输入自己的测速数据，但不会自动访问你的网络，也不会把模拟值冒充实测。
cues.en: On the real phone, keep position and test server fixed and alternate repeated measurements before and during Bluetooth transfer. Retain the raw results and compare averages and variation. Exploration accepts your measurements; it does not access your network or pass simulated values off as observations.

cues.title: 先选择正确的测量面
cues.caption: 外测量爪贴住小球两侧，才能读取外径。
cues.captionEn: External jaws must contact both sides before reading the diameter.
cues.zh: 先看卡尺的两片外测量爪。小球放在它们之间，缓慢移动游标，让两侧测量面刚好贴住小球。没有贴合时，刻度表示的只是量爪间距，不是小球直径。位置对正以后，再把目光移到主尺和游标。
cues.en: Watch the external caliper jaws. Place the sphere between them and move the slider until both faces just touch it. Before contact, the scale shows only jaw separation, not the sphere diameter. Once aligned and touching, look at the main and vernier scales.

cues.title: 找第几条刻度对齐
cues.caption: 主尺 23 mm，加上第七条对应的 0.7 mm。
cues.captionEn: Add 23 mm on the main scale to 0.7 mm from the seventh aligned line.
cues.zh: 放大同一组刻度。游标零线已经越过主尺的二十三毫米，但还不到二十四毫米。再看游标，第七条线与主尺对齐。十格游标的每一格比主尺少零点一毫米，所以小数部分是零点七毫米，总读数为二十三点七毫米。
cues.en: Magnify the same scales. The vernier zero has passed twenty-three millimetres but has not reached twenty-four. The seventh vernier line aligns with a main-scale line. Each of ten vernier divisions is one tenth of a millimetre shorter, giving a fractional reading of point seven and a total of twenty-three point seven millimetres.

cues.title: 换成内测量爪
cues.caption: 量槽宽时，让内测量爪向两侧撑开。
cues.captionEn: To measure a slot, expand the internal jaws against both walls.
cues.zh: 要测槽的宽度，就换用上方的内测量爪。把两片爪放进槽内，缓慢撑开，使外侧测量面贴住两边内壁。读数原理仍是主尺加游标，但接触的是另一组测量面。量爪不能歪斜，也不需要用力挤压。
cues.en: For a slot width, use the upper internal jaws. Place them inside the slot and expand them gently until their outer measuring faces contact both walls. The reading still combines main and vernier scales, but the contact faces are different. Keep the tool aligned and avoid squeezing.

cues.title: 一圈只前进半毫米
cues.titleEn: One turn advances half a millimetre
cues.caption: 螺杆平移与微分筒旋转来自同一螺距。
cues.captionEn: Spindle translation and thimble rotation share one screw pitch.
cues.zh: 现在看螺旋测微器。旋转微分筒，测微螺杆沿轴线移动。这里转过一整圈，开口只改变零点五毫米。圆周再分成五十格，每格对应零点零一毫米。细小的直线位移被转成较容易观察的转动，而不是凭空增加数字。
cues.en: Now watch the micrometer. Turning the thimble moves the spindle along its axis. One complete turn changes the opening by only half a millimetre. Fifty divisions around the circumference therefore represent one hundredth of a millimetre each. Tiny translation becomes a more observable rotation.

cues.title: 半毫米线有没有露出？
cues.caption: 固定刻度与微分筒相加，并保留一位估读。
cues.captionEn: Add sleeve and thimble readings, retaining one estimated digit.
cues.zh: 轻轻接触样品后读数。先看固定刻度，六点五毫米的半毫米线已经露出。再看参考线对应的微分筒位置，在二十二与二十三格之间，大约是二十二点五格。两部分相加，得到六点七二五毫米。最后一位是估读，不代表仪器绝对准确。
cues.en: Read after gently contacting the specimen. The sleeve exposes the six point five millimetre half-mark. The reference line meets the thimble about halfway between divisions twenty-two and twenty-three, or twenty-two point five divisions. Adding both parts gives six point seven two five millimetres. The last digit is estimated, not a guarantee of absolute accuracy.

cues.title: 先检查零点，再量薄样品
cues.titleEn: Check zero before a thin specimen
cues.caption: 示数减去零点读数，才得到修正后的厚度。
cues.captionEn: Subtract the zero reading to obtain corrected thickness.
cues.zh: 先让两个测量面闭合，发现示数是零点零三毫米，这就是本次的零点读数。再放入薄纸，靠近时改用微调机构，避免继续挤压。接触处已经另外放大。最后把纸张的示数减去零点零三毫米，得到修正后的厚度；头发也可以用同样的步骤测量。
cues.en: Close the measuring faces first. The instrument indicates point zero three millimetres, its zero reading in this example. Insert thin paper and use the fine mechanism near contact to avoid further squeezing. The contact is separately magnified. Subtract point zero three millimetres from the indicated thickness; hair can be measured with the same procedure.

cues.title: 把十圈看成一个总长度
cues.titleEn: Measure ten turns as one span
cues.caption: 密绕后测总长，再除以圈数；间隙会带来偏大。
cues.captionEn: Measure the tightly wound span and divide by turns; gaps cause overestimation.
cues.zh: 如果只有普通刻度尺，可以把铜丝密密绕在木棒上。先看一圈，再逐渐增加到十圈。用同一把尺测量总长度，然后除以圈数。假设总长读数的误差仍是零点一毫米，分到每圈就只剩零点零一毫米。但必须密绕；圈间的缝隙也会被量进去，不能靠增加圈数自动消除。
cues.en: With only an ordinary ruler, wind the wire tightly around a rod. Start with one turn and increase to ten. Measure the total span with the same ruler, then divide by turn count. If the total-length reading error remains one tenth of a millimetre, its per-turn contribution becomes one hundredth. Winding must be tight: gaps add to the measured span and do not automatically disappear with more turns.

cues.title: 记录两个力的共同效果
cues.titleEn: Record the effect of two forces
cues.caption: 记住O点、两条方向和两个读数。
cues.captionEn: Record O, two directions and both readings.
cues.zh: 把橡皮条固定一端，另一端接小圆环。用两只测力计沿不同方向拉，让圆环停在O点。现在要记录三类信息：O点的位置、两条拉力方向和两个读数。仅仅记下两个数字还不够，因为方向也是力的一部分。橡皮条此时的伸长与方向，给接下来的替换提供了共同的效果标准。
cues.en: Fix one end of an elastic strip and attach a ring to the other. Pull in two directions with force meters until the ring rests at O. Record the position, both force directions and both readings. Two numbers alone are insufficient because direction matters. The strip extension and orientation establish the effect the replacement must reproduce.

cues.title: 单力恢复同一O点
cues.caption: 同一位置，使橡皮条对圆环的力相同。
cues.captionEn: The same position restores the same strip force.
cues.zh: 改用一只测力计，沿合适方向把圆环拉回刚才的O点。固定端没动，O点也没动，橡皮条的伸长和方向就恢复原样。因此这个单独的力，与原来的两个力产生相同效果。注意这里比较的是同一个位置，不能只凭看起来差不多，也不能先把两个读数直接相加再当成答案。
cues.en: Replace the pair with a single meter and bring the ring back to O. The fixed anchor and ring position are unchanged, restoring the same extension and orientation. This single force reproduces the original pair’s effect. Restore the actual point rather than relying on a visual approximation or assuming the two numerical readings should simply be added.

cues.title: 比较矢量记录
cues.caption: 两个力作邻边，等效单力对应对角线。
cues.captionEn: The pair forms adjacent sides; the single force matches the diagonal.
cues.zh: 把器材暂时退到背景，看留在纸上的矢量记录。两个力从同一个O点出发，用相同标度画出大小和方向，再补成平行四边形。它的对角线与单力的大小和方向吻合。对角线是等效合力，不是又多加了第三个实际拉力；如果把三个箭头都当作同时存在的拉力，就改变了原实验。
cues.en: Read the vector record separately from the apparatus. Draw both forces from O using one scale, then complete the parallelogram. Its diagonal matches the single force in magnitude and direction. This is an equivalent resultant, not an additional third pull. Treating all three arrows as simultaneous physical forces would describe a different experiment.

cues.title: 交换操作研究分解
cues.caption: 同一合力可由不同方向的一对分力实现。
cues.captionEn: Different directed pairs can reproduce the same resultant.
cues.zh: 最后交换操作顺序。先用一个力确定O点，再用两个力把圆环恢复到这里，就是研究力的分解。改变两条方向，各自读数会改变，但橡皮条的同一效果可以保持。只有合力还不够，通常还需要规定分力的方向才能确定一组答案。自由探索中再改变O点高度，你会看到此时连等效单力也必须改变。
cues.en: Reverse the order: establish O with one force, then restore it with two. This investigates resolution. Changing the directions changes the individual readings while preserving the same strip effect. A resultant alone usually needs additional direction constraints to identify a pair. In exploration, changing O itself also changes the required equivalent single force.
