cues.title: 晶体让某些方向增强
cues.caption: 晶面之间的相位关系，使散射强度随角度出现峰值。
cues.captionEn: Phase relationships between planes produce angular intensity peaks.
cues.zh: 戴维孙和革末研究电子被单晶散射，发现特定方向的信号增强。这里用简化的晶面反射几何说明相干叠加：电子束从晶面散射，探测器接收相应方向的信号。掠射角改变时，晶面间的路程差改变，强度并不均匀。
cues.en: Davisson and Germer observed enhanced electron scattering in selected directions from a single crystal. This simplified plane-reflection geometry explains coherent addition. The detector receives the scattered beam while changing grazing angle changes the path difference between planes. The resulting intensity is strongly directional.

cues.title: 寻找相长叠加的位置
cues.caption: 相邻晶面的路程差接近波长的整数倍时，信号增强。
cues.captionEn: A path difference near an integer number of wavelengths enhances the signal.
cues.zh: 继续扫描角度，曲线出现清楚的峰。当相邻晶面的路程差等于波长的整数倍，各部分波同相叠加。电子波长由动量决定。模型采用一百伏加速电压和八个等距晶面，用来解释方法，不能把这些教学参数当成原始镍单晶测量的复刻。
cues.en: Scan through the angular peak. Contributions add in phase when adjacent-plane path difference equals an integer number of wavelengths. Electron momentum sets that wavelength. This model uses one hundred volts and eight equally spaced planes to explain the method, not to reproduce the original nickel-crystal apparatus or data.

cues.title: 多种晶粒方向形成环
cues.caption: 改变电子动量，会怎样改变衍射环？
cues.captionEn: How does changing electron momentum affect the rings?
cues.zh: 汤姆孙让高能电子穿过薄晶体膜。许多不同取向的晶粒，把相同散射角展开为圆锥；屏幕截到圆锥，就出现衍射环。提高加速电压，电子动量增大，波长缩短，环半径随之减小。这里使用两组示例晶面间距，环的位置由同一布拉格关系计算。
cues.en: Thomson transmitted energetic electrons through thin crystalline films. Many grain orientations spread a common scattering angle into a cone, whose intersection with the screen forms a ring. Increasing accelerating voltage shortens the wavelength and contracts the rings. Two example plane spacings determine the displayed radii through the same Bragg relation.

cues.title: 零散事件积累成条纹
cues.caption: 一次次局域探测，积累后仍呈现干涉概率分布。
cues.captionEn: Localized detections accumulate into an interference probability distribution.
cues.zh: 后来的电子干涉实验进一步显示，探测事件可以逐个出现，而积累的分布具有明暗相间的条纹。这里用电子双棱镜的等效双源模型展示这种区别，不把它说成教材中的原始单晶实验。光点按概率分布作确定性教学采样，既不是真实记录，也不是电子经过仪器时的可见轨道。
cues.en: Later interference experiments showed localized electron detections accumulating into alternating fringes. An equivalent two-source model of an electron biprism illustrates this distinction; it is not the original single-crystal experiment. The points are deterministic teaching samples from the probability distribution, not historical records or visible trajectories through the apparatus.

cues.title: 用晶体检验X射线
cues.caption: 多色X射线通过规则晶格，只在满足条件的方向形成斑点。
cues.captionEn: Polychromatic X-rays form spots in directions allowed by the crystal lattice.
cues.zh: 劳厄实验把多色X射线射向晶体，在探测板上得到离散斑点。这同时关联了X射线的波动性与晶体内部的规则排列。画面采用简单立方晶格，逐个计算满足弹性散射条件的方向与波长；斑点随晶体转角变化，不是固定装饰纹理。
cues.en: Laue diffraction sends polychromatic X-rays into a crystal and records discrete spots. It connects the wave nature of X-rays with regular atomic arrangement. This view uses a simple cubic lattice and calculates allowed directions and wavelengths from elastic scattering. Rotating the crystal changes the spots rather than rotating a decorative texture.

cues.title: 把斑点背后的相位展开
cues.caption: 相邻晶面的路程差为2d sinθ；相位相合才持续增强。
cues.captionEn: Adjacent-plane path difference is 2d sinθ; matching phases reinforce the signal.
cues.zh: 放大两层相邻晶面，比较上下两条散射路径。多出的路程由晶面间距和掠射角决定，等于两倍间距乘以掠射角的正弦。当这个路程差正好容纳整数个波长，两个贡献同相。图下方把相位展开比较；这一局部图帮助理解规律，并不替代三维晶格的完整衍射条件。
cues.en: Enlarge two adjacent planes and compare their scattering paths. The extra distance equals twice the plane spacing times the sine of the grazing angle. An integer number of wavelengths gives matching phases. The lower traces unfold that phase comparison. This local picture explains the principle but does not replace the full three-dimensional diffraction condition.

cues.title: 转动晶体，追踪斑点
cues.titleEn: Rotate the crystal and track spots
cues.caption: 波段不变，转动晶体会怎样改变斑点？
cues.captionEn: With the spectrum fixed, how does rotation change the spots?
cues.zh: 回到探测板，慢慢转动晶体，追踪斑点的移动、出现与消失。入射光的波长范围没有改变，改变的是晶格相对于入射方向的位置。模型只计算单原子简单立方结构的允许位置，不计算真实材料的原子散射因子、吸收和多重散射，因此不能把点的亮度用作结构精修数据。
cues.en: Return to the detector and rotate the crystal. Spots move, appear and disappear as lattice orientation changes within a fixed wavelength band. The model predicts allowed positions for a one-atom simple cubic structure. It omits atomic form factors, absorption and multiple scattering, so displayed brightness cannot be used for quantitative structure refinement.

cues.title: 磁场控制接触
cues.titleEn: A magnetic field closes the contact
cues.caption: 磁体靠近，软磁簧片相吸接通。
cues.captionEn: A nearby magnet magnetizes the reeds and closes them.
cues.zh: 观察玻璃管内的两片簧片。磁体靠近时，它们被磁化而相互吸引，触点闭合，灯泡回路接通。磁体离开，簧片弹开。这里转换的是磁场与电路通断，不需要外露的机械按钮。
cues.en: Look inside the glass tube. A nearby magnet magnetizes the two reeds so they attract and close the lamp circuit. Moving the magnet away lets them spring apart. Magnetic field controls electrical contact without an exposed push button.

cues.title: 光敏电阻的明暗对照
cues.caption: 遮光使电阻增大，强光使电阻减小。
cues.captionEn: Shade raises resistance; stronger light lowers it.
cues.zh: 把光敏电阻接到电表电阻挡。依次比较强光、自然光和遮光，跟随同一敏感面的照度与电阻读数。光照改变材料中的载流子状况，因此它能把光学量转换成电学量。
cues.en: Connect the photoresistor to the resistance meter. Compare stronger light, room light and shade on the same sensitive surface. Illumination changes carrier availability, converting an optical input into an electrical resistance.

cues.title: 换成普通电阻
cues.caption: 相同照度变化，不应让所有电阻都同样响应。
cues.captionEn: The same illumination change need not affect every resistor.
cues.zh: 保持相同照度变化，把敏感元件换成普通电阻。这个对照的电阻读数不随遮光明显改变。区别来自材料的光敏性质，不能把看见光就降阻当作所有电阻的共同特征。
cues.en: Keep the illumination comparison and substitute an ordinary resistor. Its resistance stays essentially fixed in this model. The contrast comes from the photosensitive material; light does not lower every resistor’s resistance in the same way.

cues.title: 手温与冷水
cues.caption: 这种NTC升温时降阻，降温时增阻。
cues.captionEn: This NTC decreases resistance when warmed.
cues.zh: 把热敏电阻接到电表，比较冷水和手温。这里选用负温度系数的NTC元件，温度升高时电阻减小，冷却后电阻增大。金属热电阻可能具有相反趋势，所以先说明元件类型。
cues.en: Connect the thermistor to the meter and compare cold water with hand warmth. This is an NTC device: warming lowers its resistance, while cooling raises it. A metal resistance thermometer can behave oppositely, so the component type matters.

cues.title: 水浴建立特性曲线
cues.caption: 温度和电阻同时记录，建立对应关系。
cues.captionEn: Record temperature and resistance together.
cues.zh: 进一步把绝缘探头浸入水浴，改变水温，同时读取温度计和电阻表。把每个温度与电阻配对，才能建立定量曲线。演示采用指定NTC参数，并不是所有热敏电阻都具有同一条曲线。
cues.en: Place an insulated probe in a water bath. Change water temperature and read both thermometer and resistance meter. Paired observations establish a quantitative curve. The demonstration uses stated NTC parameters; other devices need their own characterization.

cues.title: 开门改变继电器输出
cues.titleEn: Opening the door changes relay output
cues.caption: 干簧管控制线圈，继电器选择指示或报警。
cues.captionEn: The reed controls the coil; relay contacts select indication or alarm.
cues.zh: 门关闭时，磁体靠近干簧管，继电器线圈通电，触点接到指示灯。门打开，磁体移开，继电器释放到常闭端，报警器工作。沿着传感、线圈和触点三个环节分别追踪。
cues.en: With the door shut, the magnet closes the reed and energizes the relay, selecting the indicator. Opening the door removes the magnet and releases the relay to its normally closed alarm contact. Track sensor, winding and switched output separately.

cues.title: 微小信号控制LED
cues.titleEn: A small signal controls an LED
cues.caption: 分压与晶体管放大共同决定点亮条件。
cues.captionEn: Divider loading and transistor gain determine the light threshold.
cues.zh: 光敏电阻与可调电阻构成分压器。环境变暗，光敏电阻增大，基极获得足够电流，晶体管导通并点亮LED。调节上臂电阻，可以改变点亮阈值；输出支路的电阻限制LED电流。
cues.en: The photoresistor and adjustable resistor form a divider. Darkness raises photoresistance, providing enough base current to turn the transistor on and light the LED. The upper resistor adjusts the threshold, while an output resistor limits LED current.

cues.title: 用继电器控制灯泡
cues.titleEn: Use a relay to control a lamp
cues.caption: 传感回路与执行触点承担不同任务。
cues.captionEn: The sensing circuit and load contacts serve different roles.
cues.zh: 把LED输出换成继电器线圈，让触点控制另一条灯泡通路。光敏元件不直接承受灯泡的工作电流。线圈旁反向并联的二极管，为关断时的自感电流提供释放通路，保护晶体管。
cues.en: Replace the LED output with a relay winding and use its contacts to control the lamp path. The sensitive element does not carry lamp current. A reverse diode across the coil provides a release path for inductive current when the transistor turns off.

cues.title: 形变控制加热
cues.caption: 感温触点接通，可让常闭加热回路断开。
cues.captionEn: Closing the sensing contact can open the heater path.
cues.zh: 两层金属的热膨胀系数不同，升温后贴合的金属片弯曲。调到六十摄氏度时接触，继电器线圈通电，常闭加热触点反而断开。区分感温触点与执行触点，才能正确解释自动停热。
cues.en: Bonded metals expand by different amounts, bending as temperature rises. At the calibrated sixty-degree contact, the relay energizes and opens its normally closed heater path. Distinguish the sensing contact from the actuator contact to explain heating cutoff.

cues.title: 逐级均匀加载
cues.caption: 框架初始载荷也必须计入总压力。
cues.captionEn: Include the fixture in the total applied force.
cues.zh: 圆柱体通过垫片把力均匀传到薄膜敏感面。框架、垫片和圆柱体先提供零点五牛，每增加一个钩码再加零点五牛。电表与曲线使用教材给出的十六组数据，不是假装现场产生的新测量。
cues.en: The cylinder and pad distribute force across the sensitive film. Fixture, pad and cylinder initially apply half a newton; each hook mass adds another half. Meter values and plotted points come from the textbook’s sixteen observations, not invented live measurements.

cues.title: 比较不同工作区间
cues.caption: 相同力变化，在不同区间产生不同电阻变化。
cues.captionEn: Equal force changes produce different resistance changes.
cues.zh: 比较约一牛和五牛附近的数据。低压力区间的曲线更陡，单位力变化对应更大的电阻变化。这里读出的是相邻数据的割线斜率，帮助理解灵敏度，并不冒充光滑拟合曲线的精确切线。
cues.en: Compare observations near one and five newtons. The lower-force region is steeper: a given force change produces a larger resistance change. The displayed local secant slope illustrates sensitivity without pretending to be an exact tangent to a fitted curve.

cues.title: 把测量用于分拣
cues.caption: 压力阈值驱动通道选择。
cues.captionEn: A pressure threshold selects the sorting path.
cues.zh: 最后把压力信号用于苹果分拣。小苹果的压力不足以触发，沿上通道通过；大苹果达到阈值，继电器改变通道。真实装置还需要保持电路，让苹果经过挡板期间维持动作。
cues.en: Finally use pressure to sort apples. A small apple stays below the threshold and follows the upper path. A larger apple triggers the relay and enters the lower path. A real implementation also needs a holding circuit to retain the action while the apple passes.

cues.title: 用缓坡把运动变慢
cues.titleEn: Slow motion with a shallow slope
cues.caption: 缓坡延长可测时间，流水提供计时参照。
cues.captionEn: A shallow slope lengthens the measurable time; water gives a reference.
cues.zh: 自由下落很快，怎样在计时工具有限时研究它？让铜球沿缓坡从静止滚下，运动就慢了下来。这里重建一种流水计时的思路：放球时开始接水，到测量终点停止。只要流水足够稳定，收集的水量就与时间成正比。画面到终点后定格，展示这一次已经取得的记录。
cues.en: Falling is fast. How can it be studied with limited timekeeping? Release a ball from rest on a shallow ramp to slow the motion. This reconstruction uses collected water as a timer: begin collecting at release and stop at the endpoint. With stable flow, collected mass is proportional to time. The endpoint freezes to show the completed record.

cues.title: 比较等时间记录
cues.caption: 时间翻倍，路程变为四倍。
cues.captionEn: Doubling time produces four times the distance.
cues.zh: 在相同倾角下，比较从静止开始的一组记录。等时间间隔里，小球走过的路程越来越大。把总时间取成两倍，距离成为四倍；取成三倍，距离成为九倍。流水把时间变成能够比较的水量，而距离记录帮助我们检查平方关系。真正实验还需要重复测量，并检查水流与释放条件是否一致。
cues.en: At one fixed angle, compare records from release at rest. The ball travels farther during each equal-time interval. Twice the elapsed time gives four times the distance; three times gives nine times. Water provides a measurable time proxy, while distance records test the square relationship. Physical experiments require repeated runs and consistent flow and release conditions.

cues.title: 分清滚动与自由落体
cues.caption: 历史外推需要推理，滚动系数不能直接当作g。
cues.captionEn: Historical extrapolation needs reasoning; the rolling coefficient is not g.
cues.zh: 斜面实验使缓慢运动的规律能够被测量，再与数学推理和外推结合，研究下落问题。不过，这个重建中的铜球还在转动，部分运动能量用于自转，因此滚动加速度并不就是自由落体加速度。不能把实心球的滚动公式一路推到竖直角度，就当作测得了g。实验、模型和推理各自的边界，需要保留清楚。
cues.en: An incline makes slower motion measurable, supporting mathematical reasoning about falling. But this reconstructed ball also rotates, so rolling acceleration is not free-fall acceleration. Extending a solid-sphere rolling formula to a vertical angle does not directly measure g. Keep the experimental observation, the model and the historical inference distinct.

cues.title: 在另一坡回到原高度
cues.caption: 忽略耗散，回升最高点与释放高度相同。
cues.captionEn: Without losses, the return peak matches the release height.
cues.zh: 现在换一个问题：小球沿一边滚下，再沿另一边升高。保持同样的释放位置，在忽略损耗的理想条件下，它能够回到同样高度。真实轨道有阻力，回升会低一些，所以这里明确标为理想实验。中间的平滑过渡让小球连续转向，不通过一个尖角碰撞来偷偷改变它的运动。
cues.en: Ask a different question: a ball rolls down one side and rises on the other. From the same release position, it can regain the original height in the ideal absence of losses. Real resistance lowers the return peak, so the scene is explicitly idealized. A smooth joining curve turns the ball continuously without an unmodeled corner collision.

cues.title: 把右坡逐次放缓
cues.caption: 更缓需要更远；水平极限继续匀速。
cues.captionEn: A gentler slope requires more distance; the horizontal limit continues uniformly.
cues.zh: 依次改变右边的坡度，每次都从同样高度重新释放。右坡越缓，小球就要走更远，才能升回原来的高度。若右侧变成水平延伸，沿途不再升高，在忽略阻力的极限中，小球就会继续前进。这个结论来自理想化推理，不是声称已经做出一条无限长、完全没有损耗的真实轨道。
cues.en: Change the return slope in separate releases from the same height. A gentler incline requires a longer journey to regain that height. If it becomes a horizontal continuation, the ball no longer rises and continues moving in the ideal absence of resistance. This is a limiting argument, not a claim that an infinite, completely loss-free track has been built.

cues.title: 后续：寻找守恒量
cues.caption: 势能与滚动动能此消彼长，总量不变。
cues.captionEn: Potential and rolling kinetic energy exchange while their total stays fixed.
cues.zh: 到机械能这一章，再用同一装置寻找守恒量。下坡时高度降低，速度增加；上坡时相反。能量条把这两部分合在一起，理想总量保持不变。因为这里是滚动球，动能既包含整体前进，也包含自身转动，不能漏掉后一部分。这个能量解释补充了先前的理想实验，而不改变同高释放与回升的观察条件。
cues.en: In the later energy chapter, revisit the same apparatus. Going downhill trades height for speed; uphill reverses the exchange. The energy strip shows their fixed ideal total. A rolling sphere has both translational and rotational kinetic energy, so neither can be omitted. This later explanation supplements the earlier ideal experiment while keeping its release and return conditions unchanged.

cues.title: 遮光纸后的感光板
cues.caption: 铀盐附近的感光板变暗，说明有能穿过遮光纸的作用。
cues.captionEn: A plate near uranium darkens despite its opaque wrapping.
cues.zh: 贝克勒尔把铀盐放在包着黑纸的感光板附近。显影后，板上仍出现影像，说明某种作用能够穿过挡住可见光的包裹。中间的金属形状改变了透过强度。起初，这还不能区分它来自日照激发，还是物质本身。
cues.en: Becquerel placed uranium salts near a photographic plate wrapped in opaque paper. An image still developed, revealing an influence that could pass through the wrapping. A metal shape changed its transmission. This observation alone did not establish whether sunlight excited the emission or the material emitted spontaneously.

cues.title: 撤去日照，信号仍在
cues.caption: 没有日照激发，铀盐仍能使感光板留下信号。
cues.captionEn: Without sunlight, uranium still leaves a photographic signal.
cues.zh: 把日照关掉，保留铀盐和遮光板。感光作用仍然出现，排除了必须先吸收阳光才能发射的解释。这一对照支持天然放射性是物质自身的性质。画面只重建证据关系；黑化程度使用教学响应函数，不是历史照片或放射强度标定。
cues.en: Remove sunlight while keeping the sample and wrapped plate. The signal persists, ruling out a requirement for prior illumination. This comparison supports spontaneous radioactivity as a property of the material. The plate darkness follows an illustrative response function, not a historical photograph or calibrated radiation measurement.

cues.title: 把看不见的射线变成电流
cues.caption: 射线使空气电离，微弱电流成为可比较的信号。
cues.captionEn: Radiation ionizes air, producing a measurable weak current.
cues.zh: 居里夫人使用电离测量，把放射作用变成可以比较的微弱电流。样品放在电极附近，射线使空气产生离子，在电场中形成电流。比较不同物质时，必须同时考虑样品质量和测量条件，不能仅凭某次指针偏转较大就宣布发现新元素。
cues.en: Curie used ionization measurements to compare radiation quantitatively. Radiation from a sample creates ions in air; an electric field collects them as a weak current. Comparisons require controlled geometry and sample mass. A larger pointer deflection alone does not identify a new element.

cues.title: 跟随活度寻找成分
cues.caption: 分离后某些组分的单位质量活度升高，指导后续化学鉴定。
cues.captionEn: Increased activity per mass in a fraction guides further chemical identification.
cues.zh: 对矿物反复进行化学分离，再测各个组分。某些很少量的组分仍保留强烈活度，单位质量的信号因此升高。这条线索与化学性质、光谱等证据结合，才支持钋和镭的发现。这里用示例富集程度说明比较方法，不模拟具体化学配方或历史产率。
cues.en: Separate mineral fractions and compare their activity again. A small fraction can retain substantial activity, increasing signal per unit mass. Combined with chemical behavior and other evidence, this guided the discoveries of polonium and radium. The displayed enrichment is illustrative, without a chemical recipe or historical yield claim.

cues.title: 用磁场分开三种射线
cues.titleEn: Separate radiation in a magnetic field
cues.caption: α与β⁻向相反方向弯曲，γ保持直行。
cues.captionEn: Alpha and beta-minus bend oppositely; gamma continues straight.
cues.zh: 三种射线进入同一个垂直画面的磁场。正电的阿尔法粒子与负电的贝塔电子弯向相反方向，不带电的伽马光子不受洛伦兹磁力。画面采用示例能量计算动量与曲率，所以阿尔法轨迹的弯曲很小，并没有为了对称美观把两条曲线画成一样。
cues.en: Three kinds of radiation enter the same perpendicular magnetic field. Positive alpha particles and negative beta electrons bend oppositely, while neutral gamma photons experience no Lorentz magnetic force. Example energies determine momentum and curvature. Alpha curvature is small; the two charged paths are not made artificially symmetric.

cues.title: 反转磁场再检验
cues.caption: 磁场反向，带电轨迹的弯曲方向互换，γ仍不偏转。
cues.captionEn: Reversing the field reverses charged curvature but leaves gamma unchanged.
cues.zh: 把磁场反向，带电粒子的弯曲方向随之交换，伽马射线仍然直行。比较时还要记住，曲率同时取决于电荷、动量和磁场，不能只凭弯得更厉害判断质量更小。轨迹是帮助观察的计算线，真实装置通过感光、计数或径迹等方法记录信号。
cues.en: Reverse the field and the charged paths reverse their curvature. Gamma remains straight. Curvature depends jointly on charge, momentum and field; stronger bending alone is not a mass measurement. The drawn paths are calculated guides. Actual observations require photographic, counting or track detectors.

cues.title: 先让气体膨胀冷却
cues.caption: 膨胀降温使水汽达到过饱和，电离路径成为凝结线索。
cues.captionEn: Expansion cooling creates supersaturation, allowing ionization paths to seed droplets.
cues.zh: 威耳逊膨胀云室用活塞迅速增加气体体积。气体做功、温度下降，水汽可能进入过饱和状态。此时穿过的带电粒子沿途造成电离，离子有利于小液滴凝结。没有合适的过饱和条件，粒子即使经过，也不一定留下可见的云迹。
cues.en: A Wilson expansion chamber rapidly increases gas volume with a piston. Work done by the gas lowers its temperature and can make water vapor supersaturated. A charged particle ionizes the gas along its path, helping droplets condense. Without suitable supersaturation, a passing particle need not leave a visible track.

cues.title: 看见液滴，追踪粒子
cues.titleEn: Read droplets as evidence of a path
cues.caption: 径迹由许多液滴组成，不是放大的实体粒子。
cues.captionEn: A track consists of droplets, not an enlarged material particle.
cues.zh: 现在凝结的液滴把路径显现出来。粗而较直的轨迹与细而较曲折的轨迹，提示不同粒子的电离能力和散射行为。形状仅作代表性说明，不能靠这张示意图鉴定未知粒子。图中的液滴和轨迹尺寸都被放大，粒子本身仍远小于可见结构。
cues.en: Condensed droplets reveal the paths. A relatively dense, straight track and a finer irregular track illustrate differing ionization and scattering. These are representative shapes, not a method for identifying an unknown particle from this picture alone. Droplets and track dimensions are enlarged; the particles themselves remain far smaller.

cues.title: 电子在靶上产生X射线
cues.caption: 高速电子在靶中减速，可产生穿透性X射线。
cues.captionEn: Fast electrons decelerating in a target can produce penetrating X-rays.
cues.zh: 伦琴研究放电管时发现新的穿透性辐射。这里用现代简化管示意它的来源：电子从阴极加速，撞到靶后产生包括制动辐射在内的X射线。射线穿过不同物质后留下强弱不同的透射信号。装置解释的是原理，不是伦琴原管的逐部件复原。
cues.en: Röntgen discovered penetrating radiation while studying discharge tubes. A simplified modern tube illustrates its origin: accelerated electrons strike a target and produce X-rays, including bremsstrahlung. Different materials transmit different fractions. This apparatus explains the principle rather than reconstructing every part of Röntgen’s original tube.

cues.title: 比较透过与阻挡
cues.caption: 不同衰减形成影像；提高能量不等于所有细节都更清楚。
cues.captionEn: Differential attenuation forms an image; higher energy does not guarantee clearer detail.
cues.zh: 比较软组织与较密骨性结构的示意透射。较强的衰减留下不同的影像对比。提高示例管电压，最短可能波长变短，穿透能力也会改变。本模型用单一代表能量和示意衰减系数，不模拟真实连续谱、剂量或医学成像质量。
cues.en: Compare illustrative transmission through soft tissue and denser bone-like structure. Different attenuation creates contrast. Raising the example tube voltage shortens the minimum possible wavelength and changes penetration. A representative photon energy and illustrative coefficients are used, not a full spectrum, dose calculation or medical image-quality model.

cues.title: 同一导体的一条直线
cues.caption: 温度不变时，U–I 图像的斜率表示电阻。
cues.captionEn: At fixed temperature, the U–I slope represents resistance.
cues.zh: 保持同一根导体和近似不变的温度，慢慢改变电源电压。电流表和电压表同时变化，记录点落在一条过原点的直线上。电压除以电流保持不变，这个比值就是电阻。换一种材料，斜率可以改变；单纯改变电源，并不会改变同一导体的电阻。
cues.en: Keep the same conductor at approximately constant temperature and vary source voltage. Both meters change, and recorded points lie on a line through the origin. Voltage divided by current stays constant: that ratio is resistance. A different material can change the slope; changing the source alone does not change this conductor’s resistance.

cues.title: 只改变长度
cues.caption: b 的长度加倍，电压与电阻都加倍。
cues.captionEn: Doubling b’s length doubles its voltage and resistance.
cues.zh: 现在把四段导体串联。它们流过同一电流，电压之比就等于电阻之比。先比较 a 和 b：材料与粗细相同，只有 b 的长度是两倍。观察各自的电压表，b 的电压也为两倍，说明电阻随长度成正比。
cues.en: Connect four wires in series. They carry equal current, so voltage ratios equal resistance ratios. Compare a and b first: material and thickness match, but b is twice as long. Its voltage is also twice as large, revealing resistance proportional to length.

cues.title: 只改变横截面积
cues.caption: c 的横截面积加倍，电压与电阻减半。
cues.captionEn: Doubling c’s cross-sectional area halves voltage and resistance.
cues.zh: 再比较 a 和 c。两段长度、材料相同，c 的横截面积是两倍，它的直径只是根号二倍。相同电流下，c 两端电压减半，电阻也减半。这里比较的是面积，不要把直径加倍误认为面积也只加倍。
cues.en: Compare a with c. Length and material match, while c has twice the cross-sectional area, meaning only the square root of two times the diameter. At equal current its voltage and resistance are halved. The comparison concerns area; doubling diameter would quadruple area.

cues.title: 只更换材料
cues.caption: 长度和面积相同，不同材料仍有不同电阻。
cues.captionEn: Equal length and area can still give different resistance for different materials.
cues.zh: 最后比较 a 和 d。长度和横截面积都相同，只更换材料，电压表仍给出不同的读数。我们用电阻率描述这种材料差异。在同一温度下，把材料、电阻、长度与横截面积联系起来，就得到电阻率的测量方法。
cues.en: Finally compare a and d. They have equal length and area but different materials, and their voltage readings differ. Resistivity describes this material dependence. At a specified temperature, combining resistance with length and cross-sectional area gives a way to measure resistivity.

cues.title: 只加热另一段灯丝
cues.caption: 被加热灯丝电阻增大，串联指示灯变暗。
cues.captionEn: The heated filament’s resistance rises and the series indicator dims.
cues.zh: 换成两段串联的用电器。酒精灯加热的是裸露灯丝，旁边的小灯泡只用来显示电流变化。被加热灯丝温度升高，电阻增大，整个电路电流减小，所以指示灯变暗。材料电阻率表必须注明温度，不能忽略这个实验条件。
cues.en: Now use two series devices. The burner heats the exposed filament; the separate lamp indicates current changes. Heating raises the filament’s resistance, reducing current through the whole circuit and dimming the indicator. A resistivity table must specify temperature because this condition matters.

cues.title: 测电阻，再测几何
cues.caption: 由图像斜率、有效长度与平均直径求电阻率。
cues.captionEn: Infer resistivity from slope, active length and mean diameter.
cues.zh: 回到金属丝测量。改变电源，取得多组电压和电流，用图像斜率求电阻。再量两接线夹之间的有效长度，而不是整根线的总长；在不同位置量直径并取平均。把这些量代入公式，得到电阻率。直径要平方，因此它的读数误差需要特别留意。
cues.en: Return to the wire measurement. Vary the source, collect voltage-current pairs and obtain resistance from their slope. Measure the active length between the clips, not the entire wire, and average diameter readings from several positions. These determine resistivity. Diameter is squared, making its reading error particularly important.

cues.title: 电表也改变了测量
cues.caption: 外接包含电压表电流，内接包含电流表压降。
cues.captionEn: External placement includes voltmeter current; internal placement includes ammeter drop.
cues.zh: 最后检查接法。电流表外接时，它测到导线电流和电压表支路电流之和，用电压除以这个电流，电阻偏小。改为内接，电压表又把电流表两端的压降算了进去，电阻偏大。实际实验要结合电表内阻与被测电阻，判断哪一种误差更小。
cues.en: Check the meter connection. With external placement, the ammeter includes both wire and voltmeter currents, so voltage divided by its reading underestimates resistance. With internal placement, the voltmeter includes the ammeter’s voltage drop, overestimating resistance. The better choice depends on meter resistances and the specimen.

cues.title: 先看一组核的变化
cues.caption: 不能预报哪个核先衰变，但可以统计剩余数量。
cues.captionEn: The next nucleus to decay is unpredictable, but the remaining number can be counted.
cues.zh: 把视线放到一组氡原子核。各个核的衰变时刻不相同，不能提前指出下一个是谁。固定同一组模拟原子，观察剩余数量逐渐下降。经过大约一个半衰期，预期剩余一半；小样本的实际剩余数可以偏离这个比例，半衰期不是每个核的寿命。
cues.en: Follow one ensemble of radon nuclei. Individual decay times differ; the next event cannot be predicted. Keep the same simulated ensemble and count the survivors. After one half-life, half are expected to remain, but a small sample may differ. A half-life is not the lifetime of every nucleus.

cues.title: 把计数与期望曲线比较
cues.caption: 每经过同样的半衰期，剩余数量的期望再减半。
cues.captionEn: Each equal half-life halves the expected remaining population.
cues.zh: 延长观察时间，把离散计数与平滑的期望曲线放在一起。经过两个半衰期，预期剩下四分之一；三个半衰期，剩下八分之一。换一组原子，细小起伏会改变，统计规律仍然相同。本页用氡二二二约三点八天的半衰期作教学时间标尺，忽略后续子体的计数贡献。
cues.en: Extend the observation and compare discrete counts with the smooth expectation. Two half-lives leave one quarter on average, and three leave one eighth. Another ensemble changes the fluctuations but retains the law. Radon two-twenty-two’s roughly three-point-eight-day half-life sets the teaching timescale; daughter contributions are omitted.

cues.title: 给磷的迁移加上标记
cues.caption: 放射性磷随磷的化学过程迁移，探测信号显示它到达哪里。
cues.captionEn: Radioactive phosphorus follows phosphorus chemistry and reveals where it travels.
cues.zh: 教材用放射性磷研究棉花吸收磷肥。示踪原子随土壤中的磷进入根，再迁移到茎叶。我们比较各部分信号，而不是把整株植物画成可见发光。右侧比例采用分区迁移模型；它说明示踪思路，不代表某种棉花在真实土壤中的吸收速率。
cues.en: The textbook uses radioactive phosphorus to investigate fertilizer uptake by cotton. Tracer atoms move from soil into roots and then shoots. Measurements compare signals in the compartments; the plant does not visibly glow. A compartment model illustrates tracing, without claiming a measured uptake rate for a crop or soil.

cues.title: 迁移之外，还要校正衰变
cues.caption: 各部位总信号会随衰变减少，不能把减少全当成养分流失。
cues.captionEn: Total signal decreases through decay as well as movement between compartments.
cues.zh: 观察右侧三部分的总和，它会随着放射性衰变下降。某一部位的信号减少，既可能因为迁移，也可能因为核已经衰变。把同一时刻的各部位作归一化比较，才能分清这两个原因。模型把磷三十二的衰变与土壤、根、茎叶之间的迁移同时计算。
cues.en: The sum of the three signals decreases as the tracer decays. A falling signal in one compartment can reflect transport or radioactive decay. Comparing normalized compartment fractions at the same time separates these effects. The model calculates phosphorus thirty-two decay together with transport among soil, roots and shoots.

cues.title: 停止交换以后，比例下降
cues.titleEn: After exchange stops, the ratio falls
cues.caption: 古木与环境停止交换碳后，碳14相对含量逐渐降低。
cues.captionEn: After a wood sample stops exchanging carbon, its relative carbon-fourteen content decreases.
cues.zh: 活着的植物与环境交换碳。死亡后，理想封闭样品不再补充新的碳十四，而原有的碳十四继续衰变。比较样品与参考的同位素比例，就可以在这个理想模型中反推经过的时间。木头的年轮只是样品外形，页面计算使用同位素比例，并不是数年轮。
cues.en: Living plants exchange carbon with their environment. After death, an ideally closed sample receives no replacement carbon fourteen while its original carbon fourteen decays. Its isotope ratio relative to a reference gives elapsed time in this ideal model. The wood rings depict the sample; the calculation uses isotope ratios, not ring counting.

cues.title: 加入一点现代碳，再算一次
cues.caption: 现代碳提高测得的碳14比例，使理想推断年龄偏年轻。
cues.captionEn: Modern carbon raises the measured carbon-fourteen ratio and biases the inferred age younger.
cues.zh: 保持古木的真实模型年龄不变，逐渐混入少量现代碳。测得的碳十四比例升高，按纯样品公式推断的年龄就偏年轻。真实测年还要处理初始比例变化、储库效应和校准。本页的年数是简化衰变年龄，不是经过校准的考古年代。
cues.en: Keep the sample’s true model age fixed and mix in a small modern-carbon fraction. The measured carbon-fourteen ratio rises, so a pure-sample inversion gives a younger age. Real dating also addresses changing initial ratios, reservoir effects and calibration. These displayed years are ideal decay ages, not calibrated archaeological dates.

cues.title: 从桌面看抽纸
cues.caption: 快抽纸：纸移动很远，球只移动很少。
cues.captionEn: Quick pull: paper moves far, ball moves little.
cues.zh: 把钢球放在纸上，较快地抽动纸张。先从桌面的参考系观察：纸向右移动了很远，钢球只产生很小的位移。这里没有强行把球锁在原地，摩擦仍然会改变它的平动和转动。所谓球近似保持原位，是对这组快速抽纸条件的观察，不能替代对实际接触作用的分析。
cues.en: Place a steel ball on paper and pull quickly. From the table frame, the paper travels far right while the ball moves only slightly. The ball is not artificially fixed: friction changes translation and rotation. Approximate rest is an observation for this rapid pull, not a replacement for analyzing actual contact forces.

cues.title: 跟随纸张再看
cues.caption: 同一颗球，纸面坐标 x′ = x − X。
cues.captionEn: Same ball: x′ = x − X.
cues.zh: 现在把观察位置移到纸面上，重看同一个过程。纸面坐标不动，桌面纹理向后移动，钢球也相对纸面后退。两个画面并不矛盾，因为它们使用不同的参考系。纸面读数等于球的桌面坐标减去纸张坐标。比较运动之前，必须先说明位置和速度是相对于谁测量的。
cues.en: Follow the paper and replay the same process. Paper coordinates remain fixed while the table marks and ball move backward. The views do not contradict each other; their reference frames differ. Subtract paper position from the ball’s table position to obtain its paper coordinate. State the reference before comparing positions or velocities.

cues.title: 去掉摩擦看边界
cues.titleEn: Remove friction for the ideal comparison
cues.caption: 无摩擦时，x不变，x′仍会改变。
cues.captionEn: Zero friction: x stays fixed; x′ changes.
cues.zh: 把纸面摩擦设为零，单独检查参考系效应。钢球在桌面系中真正保持静止，但纸面正在加速或减速时，球的相对速度仍会改变。纸面加速阶段不是惯性参考系，不能把这样的相对加速度直接当作某个真实力的证据。只是换了观看坐标，并没有凭空出现另一只手去推球。
cues.en: Set paper friction to zero to isolate the frame effect. The ball truly remains at rest relative to the table, yet its relative velocity changes as the paper accelerates or slows. Accelerating paper is not an inertial frame. Its observed relative acceleration is not by itself evidence of a new real force; changing coordinates does not create another hand pushing the ball.

cues.title: 慢拉检验接触作用
cues.titleEn: Test contact with a slow pull
cues.caption: 慢抽纸与摩擦会改变球的真实运动。
cues.captionEn: Slower pulling changes the ball’s real motion.
cues.zh: 最后保留摩擦，把抽纸过程放慢。钢球与纸面的作用持续更久，球的实际移动与滚动也更明显。纸边经过球以后，接触面还会改成桌面。这个比较把两类变化分开：改变摩擦和抽纸方式，改变真实运动；更换参考系，只改变同一运动的描述。理解惯性参考系，要始终保留这条区别。
cues.en: Keep friction and pull more slowly. Contact acts longer and the sphere’s actual movement and rolling become clearer. Once the paper edge passes, contact changes to the table. This separates two changes: friction and pulling conditions alter the physical motion; a new reference frame changes the description of that same motion.

cues.title: 追踪可见的炭粒
cues.caption: 不均衡的撞击，使炭粒不断改变运动方向。
cues.captionEn: Unequal impacts change the tracer’s direction.
cues.zh: 盯住金圈里的炭粒，它不断改变方向。旁边不是显微镜放大照片，而是撞击机制的示意：水分子从四周撞来，瞬间的合效应却不均衡。金色箭头与炭粒这一步的方向相联系。可见的是炭粒，推知的才是分子热运动。
cues.en: Follow the carbon tracer inside the gold ring. It keeps changing direction. The other view is a mechanism sketch, not a microscope photograph. Water molecules strike from all around, but their combined effect is briefly unbalanced. The gold arrow follows that step’s direction. We see the tracer, and infer molecular thermal motion.

cues.title: 同一炭粒与更高温度
cues.titleEn: The same tracer at higher temperature
cues.caption: 同一粒径与随机输入：升温使扩散更明显。
cues.captionEn: Same tracer: warmer water increases diffusion.
cues.zh: 两次模拟保留相同的粒径与随机输入。青色是二十摄氏度，金色是五十摄氏度。升温后分子运动更剧烈，水的黏度也降低，扩散系数随之增大。三十秒记录点的连线不是期间的真实路径。先预测再试试：减小炭粒半径，运动会怎样改变？
cues.en: Both simulations keep the same particle size and random inputs. Teal shows twenty degrees Celsius; gold shows fifty. Warming increases thermal motion and lowers water viscosity, increasing diffusion. The thirty-second position links are not the intervening path. Make a prediction, then explore: what happens when the tracer radius becomes smaller?

cues.title: 分别量取两种液体
cues.caption: 两只量筒各有50毫升。
cues.captionEn: Each cylinder begins with 50 millilitres.
cues.zh: 先在两个量筒中分别量取五十毫升水和五十毫升酒精。记录初始体积，再作出直接相加会到一百毫升的预测。比较必须使用相同的刻度和接近室温的条件。
cues.en: Measure fifty millilitres each of water and ethanol in separate cylinders. Record their initial volumes and predict the one-hundred-millilitre sum. Use consistent graduations and comparable near-room-temperature conditions.

cues.title: 混合后的体积收缩
cues.caption: 分子身份和数量不变；相互作用与空间排布改变。
cues.captionEn: Same molecules and counts; new neighbours.
cues.zh: 把水倒入酒精，稳定后约九十六毫升，低于一百毫升虚线。追踪结构图：水仍是水，酒精仍是酒精，示意分子一颗没少；改变的是相邻关系和相互作用。液体不是刚性小球的固定空隙。结构重排可以改变总体积，而总质量守恒。这里的结构图不用于计算收缩量。
cues.en: Pour the water into ethanol. The settled volume is about ninety-six millilitres, below the dashed sum. Now follow the structure sketch. Water stays water, ethanol stays ethanol, and no molecule disappears. Neighbours and interactions change. A liquid is not a set of rigid balls with fixed gaps. Rearrangement can change volume while mass is conserved. This sketch does not calculate the contraction.

cues.title: 先校准每滴体积
cues.caption: 用总量除以滴数，再乘油酸比例。
cues.captionEn: Divide total volume by drop count, then apply dilution.
cues.zh: 先用一毫升稀释液数出液滴总数。总量除以滴数，得到每滴溶液体积，再除以稀释倍数，才是一滴里的纯油酸体积。不要把整滴酒精溶液都当成油酸。
cues.en: Count the drops in one millilitre of diluted solution. Total volume divided by count gives each solution drop. Applying the dilution factor gives its pure oleic-acid volume. The entire solvent drop is not oil.

cues.title: 油膜在水面铺展
cues.caption: 溶剂处理以后，观察单层膜的稳定边界。
cues.captionEn: Observe the stabilized monolayer boundary.
cues.zh: 在水面撒少量粉末帮助看清边界，滴入稀释液。油酸铺展把粉末推开，溶剂溶入水中并挥发。等待边界稳定，再开始面积测量；均匀单层是后续估算的关键前提。
cues.en: Dust the water surface lightly to reveal the boundary, then add a diluted drop. Spreading oil displaces the powder while the solvent dissolves and evaporates. Wait for a stable outline before measuring area. A uniform monolayer is the key assumption.

cues.title: 用方格估计面积
cues.caption: 统一边界计数规则，得到膜面积。
cues.captionEn: Apply a consistent boundary-cell rule.
cues.zh: 把方格板放在油膜上方，描出轮廓。完整方格直接计数，边界附近按半格规则估计。这里示意的面积是二百平方厘米。面积和体积必须先换成一致的单位才能相除。
cues.en: Place a grid over the film and trace its outline. Count complete cells and estimate boundary cells consistently. This illustrated area is two hundred square centimetres. Convert volume and area to compatible units before dividing.

cues.title: 由体积与面积估测尺度
cues.titleEn: Estimate a scale from volume and area
cues.caption: 单层近似下，厚度等于体积除以面积。
cues.captionEn: For a uniform monolayer, thickness is volume divided by area.
cues.zh: 看局部放大的单层结构。纯油酸体积除以面积，给出约二纳米的厚度尺度。油酸分子并非真正的球体，这只是有前提的估测。自由探索改变测量读数，可以检查滴数、稀释或面积误差怎样改变结果。
cues.en: Inspect the enlarged monolayer section. Pure oil volume divided by area gives a thickness scale of about two nanometres. Molecules are not literal spheres; this is an assumption-dependent estimate. Vary measurement readings to inspect drop-count, dilution and area errors.

cues.title: 从远处的闪烁发现异常
cues.titleEn: Notice scintillations beyond the usual range
cues.caption: 信号能告诉我们什么，不能告诉什么？
cues.captionEn: What does the signal establish?
cues.zh: 卢瑟福用阿尔法粒子轰击氮，观察到超出原有阿尔法粒子射程的闪烁信号。结合吸收、射程等比较，这些信号被归因于氢核。画面上方用气体室、吸收层与闪烁屏说明观察方法，下方才是后来建立的核反应解释。我们不是直接看见氮核内部裂开。
cues.en: Rutherford bombarded nitrogen with alpha particles and observed scintillations beyond the usual alpha range. Comparisons of absorption and range attributed them to hydrogen nuclei. The upper apparatus illustrates the observation; the lower view is a later reaction interpretation. It is not a direct view inside a nitrogen nucleus.

cues.title: 把产物放进守恒关系
cues.caption: 两种产物，必须同时满足守恒。
cues.captionEn: Both products must conserve momentum and energy.
cues.zh: 后来的云室研究补充了反应路径的证据。反应不是简单从氮核中拿走一个质子：阿尔法粒子参与形成氧十七，另一颗质子飞出。比较上下标，可以核对核子数和电荷数。下方所选事件还满足二维动量与能量关系，出射角改变时，两种产物的运动共同改变。
cues.en: Later cloud-chamber work supplied further evidence for the reaction path. It is not simply removal of one proton from nitrogen: the alpha particle participates in forming oxygen seventeen while a proton emerges. Nucleon number and charge balance. The selected event also conserves two-dimensional momentum and energy as its emission angle changes.

cues.title: 让看不见的中性辐射撞击石蜡
cues.titleEn: Use paraffin to reveal neutral radiation
cues.caption: 看不见的入射粒子，由带电反冲显现。
cues.captionEn: Charged recoil reveals the neutral projectile.
cues.zh: 阿尔法粒子打到铍后，产生很有穿透力的中性辐射。把含氢的石蜡放在它前面，可以打出高速质子，使后方电离探测器信号增加。虚线表示推断出的中性传播路径，不是云室里直接看见的中子径迹。查德威克进一步比较不同靶核的反冲。
cues.en: Alpha bombardment of beryllium produces penetrating neutral radiation. Paraffin supplies hydrogen nuclei that can recoil as fast protons, increasing the downstream ionization signal. The dashed neutral path is inferred, not a directly visible neutron track. Chadwick extended the comparison to recoil from different target nuclei.

cues.title: 用不同靶核检验质量
cues.caption: 用固定反冲记录检验候选质量。
cues.captionEn: Test a candidate mass against fixed recoil records.
cues.zh: 把靶核从氢换成较重的氮，最大反冲能量比例显著降低。弹性碰撞关系显示，质量相近时最容易传递较大比例的动能。这类跨靶核证据支持质量接近质子的中性粒子解释。图中使用正碰上限，不把所有真实碰撞都画成最大能量传递。
cues.en: Replace hydrogen with a heavier nitrogen target. The maximum recoil-energy fraction falls. Elastic-collision kinematics shows that similar masses permit efficient energy transfer. Comparisons across targets supported a neutral particle with mass near the proton’s. The bars show head-on upper bounds, not the energy of every real collision.

cues.title: 先在产物中认出钡
cues.titleEn: First identify barium among the products
cues.caption: 同一分离方法，为什么它不像已知的镭？
cues.captionEn: Why does the unknown behave differently from radium?
cues.zh: 哈恩与施特拉斯曼研究中子轰击铀后的产物，通过化学分离鉴定出钡。这个结果不同于只在铀附近得到新元素的预期。随后迈特纳与弗里施给出核裂变解释。画面先呈现产物鉴定，再转到核模型，避免把后来理解的过程当成当时肉眼所见。
cues.en: Hahn and Strassmann chemically separated products of neutron-irradiated uranium and identified barium. The result challenged expectations of products near uranium in the periodic table. Meitner and Frisch then interpreted nuclear fission. We show identification before the nuclear model, separating the observed evidence from its later explanation.

cues.title: 核裂变不只有一个通道
cues.caption: 留下未知碎片，先用两本账预测。
cues.captionEn: Predict the missing fragment from two ledgers.
cues.zh: 用教材这一条反应检查账目：铀二三五吸收一个中子后，形成钡一四四、另一碎片和三个中子。先用核子数与电荷数预测未知碎片，再揭晓：质量数八十九，电荷数三十六，所以是氪。真实裂变有多种产物组合，不是每次都走这条通道。释放的中子还可能引发后续反应。
cues.en: Check the textbook channel: uranium two-thirty-five captures a neutron and forms barium one-forty-four, an unknown fragment and three neutrons. Predict that fragment from nucleon and charge accounting. Then reveal mass number eighty-nine and charge thirty-six: krypton. Real fission has many channels. The released neutrons can initiate further reactions.

cues.title: 在重径迹之外寻找轻碎片
cues.titleEn: Look beyond the two heavy tracks
cues.caption: 投影相交，还要检查深度。
cues.captionEn: A projected crossing also needs a depth check.
cues.zh: 钱三强、何泽慧等用核乳胶研究裂变径迹。常见事件有两条重碎片径迹；少数事件还出现来自同一顶点的轻带电碎片。要检查共同顶点、方向与深度，排除无关径迹的偶然交叉。图中三条线是有意放大的示例，不是原始照片，也不表示三块等大的碎片。
cues.en: Qian Sanqiang, He Zehui and collaborators studied fission tracks in nuclear emulsions. Alongside the usual two heavy tracks, rare events contain an additional light charged fragment from the same vertex. Vertex, direction and depth help exclude accidental crossings. These enlarged example tracks are not an original photograph or three equal fragments.

cues.title: 进一步检查四条相关径迹
cues.caption: 共同顶点与动量闭合，约束同一事件。
cues.captionEn: A common vertex and momentum closure constrain one event.
cues.zh: 切换到四条带电碎片径迹的教学例子。两条较粗轨迹与两条较细轨迹从共同位置出发。动量向量在示意事件中闭合，但真实鉴定还需要三维显微观察、射程和电离密度等信息。这里保留三分裂、四分裂的历史意义，不用示意图给出发生概率或具体核素分支。
cues.en: Switch to an illustrative four-track event. Two heavier and two lighter tracks share one origin. The example momentum vectors close, but real identification also needs three-dimensional microscopy, ranges and ionization density. The scene preserves the historical distinction without assigning event probabilities or specific nuclide branches from this drawing.

cues.title: 比较相邻两代的规模
cues.caption: 去向不同，中子仍各有自己的身份。
cues.captionEn: Follow each neutron to its own outcome.
cues.zh: 裂变放出的中子可能引发新的裂变，也可能被吸收或逃逸。把这些结果汇总成平均再生数：大于一时，下一代的平均规模增长；小于一时减少。页面用同一纵轴比较各代期望计数，避免把缩放变化误当成稳定。它不是具体反应堆的设计计算。
cues.en: Fission neutrons may trigger another fission, be absorbed or escape. Summarize those outcomes with a mean reproduction factor. Above one, average generation size grows; below one, it falls. The bars share a vertical scale, so rescaling cannot create apparent stability. This is not a reactor-design calculation.

cues.title: 让平均规模保持稳定
cues.caption: 先预测下一代，再揭晓期望计数。
cues.captionEn: Predict the next generations before revealing them.
cues.zh: 费米团队实现可控自持链式反应，关键是把过程维持在可控制的状态。图中把平均再生数调到一，各代期望计数保持一致。真实系统还有时间延迟、反馈和随机起伏，稳定平均值不意味着每一颗中子的经历相同。这里的方块只提示实验堆的概念外形，不给出实际结构参数。
cues.en: Fermi’s team achieved a controlled self-sustaining chain reaction. Set the mean reproduction factor to one and expected generation counts remain equal. Real systems include delays, feedback and fluctuations; a stable mean does not imply identical neutron histories. The blocks evoke a pile conceptually without specifying an actual physical design.

cues.title: 追踪一颗小球
cues.caption: 每次左右偏转，都改变最后的落槽。
cues.captionEn: Each left or right choice changes the final bin.
cues.zh: 先只跟随一颗小球。经过一层钉子，它可能偏向左边，也可能偏向右边。把整条路径连起来，最后的落槽取决于这些选择的总结果。一次结果没有告诉我们全部统计规律。
cues.en: Follow a single ball. At each row it can deflect left or right. Its complete sequence of choices determines the final bin. One outcome alone does not reveal the whole statistical pattern.

cues.title: 累计大量小球
cues.caption: 中央落槽对应更多可能路径。
cues.captionEn: Central bins can be reached by more paths.
cues.zh: 让大量小球依次落下。靠近中间的槽通常积累更多小球，因为通向这些槽的左右组合更多。分布还会波动，但随机的单次选择与整体的统计规律并不矛盾。
cues.en: Release many balls. Central bins usually collect more because more left–right combinations lead there. Counts still fluctuate. Random individual choices and a regular overall distribution are compatible.

cues.title: 四枚硬币投十次
cues.caption: 五种正面数不是等可能的。
cues.captionEn: The five possible head counts are not equally likely.
cues.zh: 每次同时投掷四枚公平硬币，记录正面数。零到四这五个类别并不等可能：恰好两枚正面有六种排列，全正面只有一种。十次投掷仍然可能偏离理论比例很多。
cues.en: Toss four fair coins together and record the head count. The five categories are not equally likely: exactly two heads has six arrangements, while all heads has one. Ten trials can still differ substantially from theory.

cues.title: 汇集更多实验数据
cues.caption: 更大样本通常减小比例的波动。
cues.captionEn: Larger samples usually reduce proportion fluctuations.
cues.zh: 汇集更多同学的试验，相当于增大样本。柱形的比例通常更靠近虚线给出的理论值。注意不是每新增一次都一定更接近，统计规律描述的是大样本的整体行为。
cues.en: Pool more classmates’ trials to increase the sample. Relative bar heights usually move closer to the theoretical dashed marks. Every new trial need not improve agreement; the law concerns overall behaviour at large sample size.

cues.title: 一颗豆子的撞击
cues.caption: 短时冲量与落下后的重量要分开。
cues.captionEn: Separate the brief impulse from the later weight.
cues.zh: 把一颗豆子从二十厘米高度释放。它在秤盘上停止，短时间把动量传给台秤，指针出现响应。随后撞击贡献消失，但豆子留在盘中，它的重量仍然存在。
cues.en: Release one bean from twenty centimetres. Stopping on the pan transfers momentum briefly and the pointer responds. The impact contribution then vanishes, while the bean’s retained weight remains.

cues.title: 连续落下许多豆粒
cues.caption: 许多离散撞击形成更平稳的平均作用。
cues.captionEn: Many separate impacts form a smoother average effect.
cues.zh: 从同一高度连续、均匀地落下许多豆粒。一个个撞击的响应叠加，动态作用更平稳。读数同时包含积累重量，所以模型把两部分分开，避免把越来越重误当成气体压强的全部原因。
cues.en: Release many beans uniformly from the same height. Individual impact responses overlap into a smoother dynamic effect. The scale also carries growing retained weight, so the model separates these contributions rather than mistaking increasing load for the whole pressure analogy.

cues.title: 只增加释放高度
cues.caption: 更高落速带来更大的单次动量变化。
cues.captionEn: Higher arrival speed transfers more momentum per bean.
cues.zh: 保持豆粒质量和每秒数量，只提高释放高度。落速增大，每次停止时传递的动量也更大，平均撞击贡献随之增加。气体分子撞墙会反弹而不是留下，这个类比必须保留差别。
cues.en: Keep bean mass and release rate fixed, then increase height. Higher impact speed transfers more momentum when each bean stops, raising the average impact contribution. Gas particles rebound rather than remain on a wall, so retain that distinction.

cues.title: 一个表头，怎样测电压？
cues.titleEn: One head: how does it measure voltage?
cues.caption: 串联电阻分担电压，表头仍只读小电流。
cues.captionEn: A series resistor limits head current.
cues.zh: 同一根指针，怎么能测三种量？它始终只响应表头电流。先把电表跨接灯泡。看表内：串联电阻分担大部分电压，只有很小的电压留给敏感表头。这里满偏只需五十微安。五伏挡把这个小电流换算成外部电压。若灯泡电压几乎不变，换到十伏挡，指针会怎样？先预测。串联电阻增大，电流和偏转约减半；按新量程读，电压几乎不变。
cues.en: How can one pointer measure three quantities? It always responds to current through its head. Connect the meter across the lamp. Inside, a series resistor takes most of the voltage, limiting head current. Full scale needs only fifty microamps. Now predict a change from five volts to the ten-volt range. The larger resistance reduces head current and deflection to about one half. Reading the new scale gives almost the same lamp voltage.

cues.title: 大电流怎样绕过表头？
cues.titleEn: How does large current bypass the head?
cues.caption: 总电流在表头与分流支路之间分配。
cues.captionEn: Total current splits between head and shunt.
cues.zh: 测电流，要把电表串入灯泡支路。但灯泡电流远大于表头的满偏电流，能全部挤过表头吗？看内部的并联岔路：低电阻支路分走绝大部分电流，表头只分到很小一份。两支路再汇合，总电流没有丢失。电表仍有小电阻，接入后会稍微改变电流。现在换到更小的零点一安量程，先预测。分流电阻增大，表头分到更多电流，这个电路会超量程。
cues.en: Insert the meter into the lamp branch. Can all that current pass through its sensitive head? Look at the parallel paths. A low-resistance shunt carries most of it; only a small share enters the head. The currents rejoin, so none is lost. The meter still adds a small resistance. Predict the smaller, zero-point-one-amp range. Its larger shunt resistance sends more current through the head, exceeding full scale in this circuit.

cues.title: 电阻测量的电流从哪来？
cues.titleEn: Where does resistance-test current come from?
cues.caption: 内电池驱动回路；短接时偏转最大。
cues.captionEn: The internal cell drives the test current.
cues.zh: 灯泡已经断电，欧姆挡为什么还有读数？电流来自表内电池。沿黑表笔、待测物、红表笔，再经过表内支路追踪闭合路径；这是本示例模拟表的极性。表笔分开，电流为零，指向无穷大；短接，电流最大，指向零欧姆。调零改变内部电阻，让同一表头恰好满偏。更换倍率后还要重新检查。待测物必须先与外部电源分离。
cues.en: Why can the ohms range work with external power disconnected? Its own battery supplies current. Follow this modeled meter’s black lead, specimen and red lead, then the internal return paths. Open probes mean no current and infinite resistance. Shorted probes give maximum current and zero ohms. Zero adjustment changes internal resistance until the same head reaches full scale. Recheck after changing range. The specimen must be isolated from external power.

cues.title: 为什么欧姆刻度不均匀？
cues.titleEn: Why is the ohm scale nonlinear?
cues.caption: 外部电阻与内阻共同决定表头电流。
cues.captionEn: External and internal resistance both matter.
cues.zh: 现在接入电阻。外部电阻等于内部等效电阻时，电流变成短接时的一半。把外部电阻再加倍，指针会再减半吗？先预测。总电阻只从两份变成三份，所以指针到三分之一，不是四分之一。这就是欧姆刻度不均匀的原因。换回四百七十欧姆，在乘十挡读四十七，再乘十。
cues.en: When external resistance equals internal resistance, current falls to half its short-circuit value. Double the external resistance: will the pointer fall to one quarter of full scale? Predict first. Total resistance grows from two parts to three, so deflection becomes one third, not one quarter. That makes the ohm scale nonlinear. Back at four hundred seventy ohms, the times-ten scale reads forty-seven.

cues.title: 灯丝也能测电阻
cues.caption: 冷态电阻不能代替正常发光时的电阻。
cues.captionEn: Cold resistance differs from hot resistance.
cues.zh: 换成一只没有接通外部电源的小灯泡。表内的小电流经过灯丝，仍能测到电阻，但它不会像正常工作时那样发光。这里得到的是冷态电阻，不能直接拿它代替灯泡发光、温度很高时的电阻。
cues.en: Replace the resistor with a lamp disconnected from external power. A small meter current passes through the filament and measures resistance without making it glow normally. This is cold resistance; it should not be substituted for the resistance of a hot, operating filament.

cues.title: 接触条件也重要
cues.caption: 同一条手部路径，接触条件改变读数。
cues.captionEn: Contact changes the path’s resistance.
cues.zh: 再观察手部接触的示意。两只手分别接触表笔，欧姆挡测到的是这条接触路径的等效电阻。接触面积、压力和皮肤状态都会影响结果。因此这不是一个人的固定常数。画面只用可调电阻表示这种差异，不用它判断健康状态。
cues.en: Now consider the hand-contact diagram. Each hand touches a probe, and the meter reads the equivalent resistance of that contact path. Area, pressure and skin conditions affect the result, so it is not a fixed personal constant. This diagram uses a variable resistor to represent that variation, not to assess health.

cues.title: 交换表笔，读数变了
cues.caption: 此表型的黑表笔为内部正极。
cues.captionEn: This model’s black lead is positive.
cues.zh: 换成二极管，先认清带色环的一端是阴极。这个模拟式欧姆挡的黑表笔接表内电源正极：黑接阳极，红接阴极，正向电流较大。交换表笔后，电流很小，指针靠近无穷大。二极管不是固定电阻，读数还会随表内电源和倍率变化，也不要把这种极性约定套到所有数字表上。
cues.en: The band marks the diode’s cathode. In this particular analog ohmmeter, the black lead is connected to the internal positive supply. Black on anode and red on cathode produces more forward current. Swap them, and very little current flows, moving the pointer toward infinity. A diode is not a fixed resistor: its apparent resistance depends on the meter and range. Other meters can use different polarity conventions.

cues.title: 灯不亮，先检查电源
cues.caption: 同样灯不亮，电池电压可能不同。
cues.captionEn: The same dark lamp can have different causes.
cues.zh: 现在是故障电路：开关已经闭合，灯却不亮。先用二点五伏电压挡跨接电池。电池耗尽时，读数接近零。换成有电但别处接触不良的情形，灯仍不亮，电池两端却有电压。相同现象，不一定有相同原因。
cues.en: The switch is closed, but the lamp is dark. Begin by probing the battery on the two-point-five-volt range. A depleted source reads near zero. With an energized battery and a bad contact elsewhere, the lamp stays dark but battery voltage remains. The same visible symptom can have different causes.

cues.title: 寻找异常电压降
cues.caption: 电表接入后，测量支路也通过电流。
cues.captionEn: The meter also loads the tested circuit.
cues.zh: 把表笔移到开关两端。正常闭合触点两端的电压很小；如果触点几乎断开，大部分电压反而落在这里。接着换成导线断路的情形，沿同样的电路路径检查导线两端。表笔移动改变的是测量位置，电表也已经参与了这个电路。
cues.en: Move the probes to the switch. A good closed contact has little voltage across it; a nearly open contact can carry most of the source voltage. Next consider a broken wire and test its two ends along the same circuit path. Moving the probes changes the measured section, and the voltmeter itself is part of the circuit.

cues.title: 有电压，仍可能不发光
cues.caption: 有电压，不保证有正常工作电流。
cues.captionEn: Voltage does not guarantee working current.
cues.zh: 最后换成灯座接触不良。检查开关，两端电压很小；把表笔移到灯座外侧，电压却接近电源电压，但灯仍不亮。题目限定的几个故障中，这支持灯座接触不良。真实维修还有灯丝断裂等其他可能，单凭这个读数不能把它们一概排除。
cues.en: Finally use a bad lamp-socket contact. The closed switch shows little voltage, but probing the outer socket terminals gives almost the source voltage while the lamp remains dark. Among the specified candidate faults, this supports a bad socket contact. In real diagnosis a broken filament and other possibilities remain; this reading alone cannot exclude them.

cues.title: 有推力，也能匀速
cues.titleEn: A push can coexist with constant velocity
cues.caption: 合力为零，速度不变。
cues.captionEn: Zero net force preserves velocity.
cues.zh: 推着购物车匀速前进，手还在用力，为什么车没有越来越快？看这辆已有速度的小车：绿色推力和橙色阻力大小相等、方向相反。蓝色速度箭头没有伸长，速度曲线保持水平。有推力，不等于有合力；要看所有外力合起来还剩多少。
cues.en: You can push a shopping cart at a steady speed without letting go. Why does it not keep getting faster? This cart already has a velocity. The green push and orange resistance are equal and opposite. Its blue velocity arrow keeps the same length, and the trace stays level. A push is one force; what matters is the sum of all external forces.

cues.title: 看速度怎样改变
cues.caption: 看同一秒内速度增加多少。
cues.captionEn: Compare velocity gained in one second.
cues.zh: 轨道先补偿阻力，再用槽码牵引小车从静止出发。绳子张紧后，小车向右，槽码向下；两个位移受同一根绳约束。盯住蓝箭头：它逐渐伸长，速度图向上爬。我们要比较的是相同时间里的速度增量，不是车已经跑得多快。速度变化的快慢，就是加速度。
cues.en: With track resistance compensated, let a hanging mass pull the cart from rest. The cart moves right as the hanging mass descends. One taut string constrains both displacements. Watch the blue arrow grow and the velocity trace rise. We need to compare how much velocity is gained in the same time, rather than just how fast the cart is already moving. That rate of change is acceleration.

cues.title: 同质量，合力翻倍
cues.titleEn: Same mass, twice the net force
cues.caption: 同质量：合力翻倍，加速度翻倍。
cues.captionEn: Same mass: twice the force, twice the acceleration.
cues.zh: 怎样知道变快是拉力造成的？保留同样质量，从静止同步计时，只把实际合力增加一倍。看A、B两车：一秒后，速度分别增加零点二和零点四米每秒。质量不变时，合力翻倍，加速度也翻倍。这里展示的是模型预测；真实实验要从运动记录中取得证据。
cues.en: To isolate the effect of force, keep the cart mass unchanged and start both trials from rest. Double only the actual net force. After the same one second, cart A has gained zero point two metres per second, and cart B zero point four. Twice the net force gives twice the acceleration. These are model predictions; a real experiment must obtain evidence from recorded motion.

cues.title: 同合力，质量翻倍
cues.titleEn: Same net force, twice the mass
cues.caption: 同合力：质量翻倍，加速度减半。
cues.captionEn: Same force: twice the mass, half the acceleration.
cues.zh: 这次保持相同的实际合力，把小车质量从零点四千克增加到零点八千克。同一秒内，重车得到的速度增量只有一半，加速度也只有一半。把两组关系合起来，就是合力等于质量乘加速度。这里略调了槽码，保证控制的是拉力，而不只是槽码重力。
cues.en: This time keep the actual net force equal and increase cart mass from zero point four to zero point eight kilograms. Over the same second, the heavier cart gains half as much velocity: its acceleration is halved. Combining both comparisons gives net force equals mass times acceleration. The hanging masses are adjusted slightly to keep tension equal, rather than merely keeping hanging weight equal.

cues.title: 撤力不等于停止
cues.caption: 撤力仍匀速；反向合力使车减速。
cues.captionEn: Release preserves velocity. Braking changes it.
cues.zh: 先推小车，让它获得速度。现在推杆撤开了：理想轨道上阻力忽略，合力归零。看，小车没有突然停下，蓝箭头保留原来的长度，图线也变平。接着制动片接触小车，产生向后的合力。车仍向前走，却逐渐减速。合力决定速度怎样变，不负责维持速度。
cues.en: First the pusher gives the cart some velocity. Now it withdraws. On this ideal track, resistance is negligible, so net force becomes zero. The cart does not suddenly stop: its blue arrow keeps its length and the trace becomes level. Next the brake engages and a backward net force appears. The cart still moves forward, but slows down. Net force changes velocity; it does not maintain it.

cues.title: 槽码也需要加速度
cues.caption: 槽码向下加速，mg必须大于T。
cues.captionEn: The falling mass needs mg > T to accelerate.
cues.zh: 最后看槽码本身。它也在向下加速，所以重力必须大于绳子向上的拉力。轻槽码时，两者相差较小；换成重槽码，差别就明显了。不能总把槽码重力当作拉力。回到购物车：匀速时推力和阻力怎样比较？撤手后慢下来，是因为哪一个力还在？
cues.en: Finally, examine the hanging mass. It accelerates downward, so its weight must exceed the upward string tension. With a light hanging mass the difference is small. A heavier one makes the gap clear. Hanging weight cannot always stand in for tension. Return to the shopping cart: how do push and resistance compare at constant velocity? When it slows after release, which force is still acting?

cues.title: 光子能量怎样变成质量
cues.caption: 总动量也要计入，才能重建质量。
cues.captionEn: Mass requires total momentum as well as energy.
cues.zh: 看量能器里的两处沉积：两个光子没有留下内层带电轨迹。先把能量相加，再合成方向相反的动量。母粒子运动时，两束光子的能量变得不等；总能量增加，重建质量却仍是一百二十五吉电子伏每光速平方。这是运动学示例，单个候选还不是发现。
cues.en: Two calorimeter deposits reveal photons, with no charged inner tracks. Add their energies and their vector momenta. A moving parent gives unequal photon energies: total energy increases, yet the reconstructed mass stays one hundred twenty-five gigaelectron-volts per c squared. This is a kinematic example; one candidate is not a discovery.

cues.title: 同一质量尺度反复出现
cues.caption: 固定观测记录检验拟合，再比较另一探测器。
cues.captionEn: Keep the data fixed; check another detector.
cues.zh: 金点是ATLAS发表图的近似读数。减去联合拟合的背景分量，一百二十五附近还有额外事件；加入共振峰可以解释这个结构。先留下问题：另一台探测器会看到吗？CMS也报告了相近质量的新粒子。两组记录分别取得；这张简图不能算出发现显著性。
cues.en: Gold points are approximate readings of the published ATLAS figure. Subtract the background component of its joint fit: an excess remains near one hundred twenty-five. A resonance explains that structure. Would another detector see it? CMS independently reported a nearby mass. These small plots do not reproduce discovery significance.

cues.title: 先看到额外吸收
cues.caption: 某些高能γ射线的透过信号，比简单基线预期更弱。
cues.captionEn: Some energetic gamma-ray transmission is weaker than a simple baseline predicts.
cues.zh: 赵忠尧的早期研究发现伽马射线的反常吸收和额外散射。先比较透射信号与原有解释的预期：异常是一条需要进一步核查的线索。页面用简化基线与附加吸收作对照，不声称复原当年的吸收系数或原始数据。
cues.en: Chao’s early work found anomalous gamma absorption and additional scattering. Compare transmission with an existing expectation: an anomaly is evidence requiring further investigation. The baseline and added absorption here are illustrative, not reconstructed historical coefficients or data.

cues.title: 后来用成对产生解释线索
cues.titleEn: Later interpret the clue through pair creation
cues.caption: 超过能量阈值后，光子可在核场中产生电子与正电子。
cues.captionEn: Above threshold, a photon can create an electron–positron pair in a nuclear field.
cues.zh: 后来建立的理论把这些线索与电子、正电子的成对产生和湮灭联系起来。产生一对粒子至少需要两份电子静能，核的反冲参与动量收支。不能把早期异常直接说成已经看到了正电子。画面下方是后来的过程解释。
cues.en: Later theory connected such clues with electron–positron pair creation and annihilation. Creating the pair requires at least two electron rest energies; nuclear recoil participates in momentum balance. The early anomaly was not direct observation of a positron. The lower view is a later process interpretation.

cues.title: K俘获后，核为什么反冲
cues.titleEn: Why does the nucleus recoil after electron capture?
cues.caption: 捕获内层电子后，发出的中微子带走动量，子核反向运动。
cues.captionEn: After inner-electron capture, a neutrino carries momentum and the daughter recoils.
cues.zh: 王淦昌提出利用K俘获后的核反冲检验中微子。以铍七为例，核捕获内层电子后变成锂七，并发出中微子。若中微子带走动量，子核就应反向反冲。虚线表示不可见粒子的推断方向，不代表探测器直接抓到了它。
cues.en: Wang proposed testing neutrinos through recoil following K capture. Beryllium seven captures an inner electron, producing lithium seven and a neutrino. Momentum carried away implies opposite nuclear recoil. The dashed direction is inferred; the detector does not directly capture the neutrino.

cues.title: 用阻挡电势读出反冲尺度
cues.titleEn: Probe recoil with a retarding potential
cues.caption: 反冲离子能否越过电势门槛，提供动能的信息。
cues.captionEn: Whether recoil ions cross a retarding barrier constrains their kinetic energy.
cues.zh: 后续反冲实验把微小动能转为可测的离子信号。升高阻挡电势，能通过的离子减少。所选基态支的反冲能约五十七电子伏。这里是假设单电荷离子和理想平面电场的补充模型，忽略原子退激发、其他衰变支和表面效应。
cues.en: Later experiments turned small recoil energies into measurable ion signals. A higher retarding potential transmits fewer ions. The selected ground-state branch gives about fifty-seven electron-volts. This supplementary model assumes singly charged ions and a planar field, omitting atomic relaxation, other branches and surface effects.

cues.title: 弯曲和缺失动量留下什么线索
cues.titleEn: What curvature and missing momentum reveal
cues.caption: 正电母粒子留下正电介子，仍有动量缺口。
cues.captionEn: A positive parent leaves a positive pion—and missing momentum.
cues.zh: 这条母粒子轨迹带正电，衰变后继续的是正电派介子。电荷账本允许另一个产物不带电，但可见介子带不走全部动量。把两条切线的动量作差，得到缺失方向。随后，远处B点出现新的相互作用。A到B之间没有连续气泡，是中性路径的线索。
cues.en: The parent track is positive, and the departing pion is positive too. Charge balance allows a neutral product, but the pion does not carry all the momentum. Subtract the tangent momentum vectors to infer a missing direction. A later interaction at B, with no continuous bubble trail from A, supplies another constraint.

cues.title: 中子还是反中子
cues.caption: A 点约束质量；B 点的能量提供新的区分。
cues.captionEn: A constrains the mass; B supplies new energy evidence.
cues.zh: 用实测AB方向参与动量重建，可得到约一点一八吉电子伏的母粒子质量。但质量和电荷不能区分中子与反中子。B点已测产物的最低能量约一千四百八十三兆电子伏，超过普通中子约九百四十的动能。反中子湮灭可以释放额外静能，支持这个关联解释。
cues.en: Using the measured AB direction reconstructs the parent mass near one-point-one-eight gigaelectron-volts. Mass and charge alone cannot distinguish neutron from antineutron. At B, the measured product-energy minimum exceeds the ordinary neutron’s kinetic energy. Antineutron annihilation can release additional rest energy, supporting the linked interpretation.

cues.title: 先建立核自旋方向
cues.caption: 核极化程度改变，电子计数的不对称也改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing nuclear polarization changes the counting asymmetry.
cues.zh: 吴健雄与合作者在低温条件下极化钴六十核，建立可比较的自旋方向。比较沿自旋与反方向的贝塔电子计数，发现不对称。极化消失时，这种方向差异也消失。页面用归一化角分布表达规律，不模拟低温装置的热学过程。
cues.en: Wu and collaborators polarized cobalt-sixty nuclei at low temperature. Beta counts along and opposite the spin direction were unequal. Removing polarization removes the directional asymmetry. A normalized angular model illustrates the result without simulating the cryogenic apparatus or reproducing its measured counting efficiency.

cues.title: 比较整个过程的空间反演
cues.caption: 空间反演改变电子动量方向，自旋方向保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Spatial inversion reverses electron momentum while leaving spin unchanged.
cues.zh: 把整个过程作空间反演。电子动量反向，但自旋是轴矢量，在空间反演下不变。如果两种过程完全等价，沿自旋与反方向就不应有这种偏好。实验的不对称表明这一弱相互作用过程不守恒宇称，不是说所有物理过程都失去镜像对称。
cues.en: Under spatial inversion, electron momentum reverses but axial-vector spin does not. Equivalent reflected processes would not show this directional preference. The observed asymmetry demonstrates parity violation in this weak process. It does not claim that every physical interaction lacks reflection symmetry.

cues.title: 改磁场，质量峰应怎样变
cues.titleEn: What should a changed field do to the mass peak?
cues.caption: 磁场改变轨迹，正确重建的质量应保持。
cues.captionEn: The field changes tracks, not a correctly reconstructed mass.
cues.zh: 先看电子对：已知磁场和曲率，就能求出动量，再合成母粒子质量。把磁场减小，弯曲半径变大，正确重建的质量应保持。丁肇中团队改变谱仪设定，让粒子走过不同位置。揭开第二组历史记录，质量仍集中在三点一附近，支持真实粒子的解释。
cues.en: Known field and curvature give the electron pair’s momenta, then its parent mass. A weaker field increases the bending radii; correct reconstruction should preserve mass. Ting’s team changed the spectrometer setting so tracks passed through different detector regions. Reveal the second historical sample: it still concentrates near three-point-one, supporting a real particle.

cues.title: 用对撞能量再找一次
cues.titleEn: Find it again by scanning collision energy
cues.caption: 对撞质心能量扫描给出另一条证据链。
cues.captionEn: A collision-energy scan supplies a different evidence chain.
cues.zh: 换一种测法。两束等能量的正负电子迎面相撞，总动量抵消，质心能量是单束的两倍。里克特团队扫描能量，强子截面在三点一附近骤增。这与固定靶重建质量是不同测量，却指向相近尺度。图上的宽度受束流与仪器影响，不等于自然线宽。
cues.en: Try a different measurement. Equal electron and positron beams collide head-on, cancelling momentum: center-of-mass energy is twice one beam’s energy. Richter’s scan shows a sharp rise in hadronic cross section near three-point-one. This differs from pair-mass reconstruction but supports the same scale. Observed width includes beam and detector effects.

cues.title: 先让金属与沸水平衡
cues.caption: 沸水充分加热后，金属的初温才可取100摄氏度。
cues.captionEn: After equilibration, metal starts at 100 °C.
cues.zh: 先把已知质量的金属浸在沸水里。这里假定当地气压下水的沸点是一百摄氏度，并留足热交换时间。金属只有与沸水达到热平衡，才能把水温作为金属的初始温度。
cues.en: Immerse a known metal mass in boiling water. Assume its local boiling temperature is one hundred degrees Celsius and allow sufficient time. Only after thermal equilibrium can the water temperature stand for the metal’s initial temperature.

cues.title: 转入量热杯
cues.caption: 热量从金属传向水和杯，两个温度逐渐靠近。
cues.captionEn: Energy passes from metal to water and cup until temperatures agree.
cues.zh: 迅速把热金属放入已知质量的冷水。金属降温，水与杯一起升温。温度计逐渐稳定时，读到的共同温度对应热平衡；模型同时计算两边的能量变化。
cues.en: Transfer the hot metal quickly into a known mass of cool water. The metal cools while water and cup warm together. When the thermometer stabilizes, the common temperature marks equilibrium; the model balances energy on both sides.

cues.title: 量热杯也吸收能量
cues.caption: 同样的金属和水，杯的热容会改变平衡温度。
cues.captionEn: Cup heat capacity changes the final temperature.
cues.zh: 比较忽略杯与计入杯的两种计算。同样的热金属和冷水，有热容的杯也需要能量，最终温度会更低。如果把这些能量全部遗漏，就会低估金属的比热容。
cues.en: Compare calculations with and without cup heat capacity. The same hot metal and cool water finish at a lower temperature when the cup also needs energy. Omitting that energy would underestimate the metal’s specific heat capacity.

cues.title: 缓慢改变封闭气体体积
cues.caption: 温度近似不变时，总体积减小，绝对压强增大。
cues.captionEn: At constant temperature, reducing total volume raises absolute pressure.
cues.zh: 换成封闭的注射器。缓慢推拉柱塞，让气体有时间与环境交换热量，温度近似不变。读取体积和绝对压强，并计入与压力表相连的一毫升管路体积。
cues.en: Now use a sealed syringe. Move the plunger slowly so gas can exchange heat with the surroundings and stay nearly isothermal. Read volume and absolute pressure, including the one-millilitre connection volume leading to the pressure gauge.

cues.title: 用体积倒数检验
cues.caption: 同一批状态在p与1/V图上排成直线。
cues.captionEn: The same states form a straight line when plotting p against 1/V.
cues.zh: 压强与体积的曲线弯曲，并不直接证明反比。把横轴改为总体积的倒数，观察这些状态排成直线。固定气体量和温度时，压强乘总体积保持相同。
cues.en: A curved pressure–volume graph alone does not prove inverse proportionality. Replace the horizontal axis with reciprocal total volume: the same states lie on a straight line. With fixed gas amount and temperature, pressure times total volume stays constant.

cues.title: 快速压缩会升温
cues.caption: 绝热近似下，压强比等温预测更高。
cues.captionEn: An adiabatic compression gives higher pressure than the isothermal prediction.
cues.zh: 现在改为快速压缩的理想化比较。来不及向外传热时，外界做功使气体升温，压强比等温预测更高。这个反例说明，检验玻意耳定律必须先维持温度条件。
cues.en: Switch to an idealized rapid compression. With little time for heat to escape, work raises gas temperature and pressure exceeds the isothermal prediction. This counterexample shows why temperature control is essential when testing Boyle’s law.

cues.title: 水柱封住一定量气体
cues.titleEn: A plug seals a fixed gas amount
cues.caption: 水柱可移动，让内外压强近似平衡。
cues.captionEn: The movable plug keeps inside and outside pressure nearly balanced.
cues.zh: 烧瓶通过塞子连接一根水平玻璃管，小水柱封住一定量空气。水柱轻且能自由移动时，内外压强近似相同。先记录室温下的初始位置，作为体积变化的参照。
cues.en: A stoppered flask connects to a horizontal glass tube. A small water plug seals a fixed amount of air. When the plug moves freely, inside and outside pressures remain nearly equal. Mark its room-temperature starting position as a volume reference.

cues.title: 手捂烧瓶
cues.caption: 气体升温膨胀，水柱向外移动。
cues.captionEn: Warming expands the gas and moves the plug outward.
cues.zh: 用手捂住烧瓶，气体逐渐升温并推动水柱向外。增大的体积等于管截面积乘水柱位移。等压关系使用开尔文温度，不能把摄氏温度直接代入体积比。
cues.en: Warm the flask by hand. Gas expands and pushes the plug outward. The volume increase equals tube area times plug displacement. The constant-pressure relation uses Kelvin temperature, not a ratio of Celsius readings.

cues.title: 冷却回到原状态
cues.caption: 温度降低，体积缩小，水柱回移。
cues.captionEn: Cooling contracts the gas and returns the plug.
cues.zh: 移开热源，让烧瓶回到室温。气体体积减小，水柱向内回移。只要没有漏气，且摩擦和蒸发可忽略，回到相同温度与压强时也应回到相同体积。
cues.en: Remove the warming source and return the flask to room temperature. Gas contracts and the plug moves inward. Without leakage, and neglecting friction and evaporation, the same temperature and pressure recover the same volume.

cues.title: 失重仍有惯性
cues.caption: 不依赖重力读数，改测已知力引起的加速度。
cues.captionEn: Replace a weight reading with acceleration under a known force.
cues.zh: 空间站和宇航员一起绕地球自由下落，普通体重秤不能像地面上一样给出体重。但失重不等于质量消失。教材介绍的太空测质量装置，把宇航员固定在折叠支架上，向指定方向施加已知的恒定拉力。我们要观察的是他有多难被加速，而不是他在支架上压得有多重。
cues.en: The station and astronaut fall together around Earth, so an ordinary scale does not work as it does on the ground. Weightlessness does not erase mass. The textbook’s apparatus fixes the astronaut to a folding support and applies a known constant pull. We measure resistance to acceleration rather than pressure on a weighing scale.

cues.title: 恒力牵引支架
cues.titleEn: Pull the support with constant force
cues.caption: 从静止释放，同一根绳带动平台和人体。
cues.captionEn: Released from rest, one cable accelerates the platform and person.
cues.zh: 从规定位置静止释放，拉绳收回，支架折叠，宇航员和随动平台一起加速。画面中的连杆保持长度不变，光栅读取头也固定在平台上。这里用二十五牛的恒定拉力作教学示例，不能把它理解为普通弹簧越拉越长、拉力随伸长增加的过程。装置和读数必须对应同一段运动。
cues.en: Release from rest at a specified position. The cable retracts, the support folds, and the person accelerates with the moving platform. Rigid links keep their lengths and the grating reader stays attached to the platform. This example uses a constant twenty-five-newton force, not an ordinary spring whose force increases with extension. Apparatus motion and readings describe the same trajectory.

cues.title: 把位置转成加速度
cues.caption: 同样的距离，越来越短的时间，形成上升的速度记录。
cues.captionEn: Equal distances in shorter times produce rising velocity readings.
cues.zh: 光栅的相邻标记相隔两厘米。读取头经过每个位置，都留下一个时间记录。随着运动加快，同样距离花费的时间越来越短。先用距离除以时间求出每一小段的平均速度；对这里的匀加速运动，这个平均速度等于该段中间时刻的瞬时速度。再比较两个速度和对应时刻，就能求出加速度。
cues.en: Adjacent grating marks are two centimetres apart. Passing each position records a time. As motion speeds up, the same distance takes less time. Divide distance by each interval to obtain an average velocity. For this constant-acceleration motion, that average equals the instantaneous velocity at the interval’s midpoint. Comparing velocities and their midpoint times gives acceleration.

cues.title: 从整体质量到人体质量
cues.titleEn: From total moving mass to body mass
cues.caption: 先算F/a，再扣除平台；同样的力，较大质量加速较小。
cues.captionEn: Compute F/a and subtract the platform; greater mass accelerates less.
cues.zh: 用恒定拉力除以测得的加速度，得到的是全部随动部分的质量。我们的示例还要扣除六千克的平台质量，才得到人体质量。随后换成质量较大的人，同样的力使他加速得更慢，光栅记录也更疏。真实装置需要校准、控制振动并处理误差；这个原理重建说明，测质量可以依靠惯性，并不一定依靠重量。
cues.en: Force divided by measured acceleration gives the mass of everything moving together. Subtract this example’s six-kilogram platform to obtain body mass. Repeating with a heavier person gives less acceleration under the same force, and more widely spaced timing pulses. Real equipment requires calibration and vibration control. This reconstruction shows that mass can be measured through inertia without relying on weight.

cues.title: 比较食盐与松香
cues.caption: 盐粒常有平直晶面，松香碎片外形不规则。
cues.captionEn: Salt grains show crystal faces; rosin fragments are irregular.
cues.zh: 先观察食盐和松香。食盐颗粒常能看出平直的晶面和较规则的形状，松香碎片则没有固定的几何外形。外形给出了线索，但破碎的晶体也可能显得不规则。
cues.en: Compare salt with rosin. Salt grains often reveal flat faces and regular shapes, while rosin fragments lack a fixed geometric form. Shape is a clue, though a broken crystal can also look irregular.

cues.title: 把结构与外形区分
cues.caption: 晶体内部有周期排列；示意粒子不是显微镜可见的原子。
cues.captionEn: Crystalline order is periodic; these particles are schematic.
cues.zh: 下方用结构示意补充外形观察：晶体内部存在周期排列，非晶体缺少这种长程周期性。普通光学显微镜看不到图示的单个原子，不能把结构示意误作直接照片。
cues.en: The structural inset adds something external appearance cannot show: crystals have periodic internal order, while amorphous solids lack long-range periodicity. An ordinary optical microscope does not resolve these individual atoms; the inset is a diagram, not a direct photograph.

cues.title: 用熔化边界显出热传播
cues.titleEn: Reveal heat flow with melting wax
cues.caption: 同样从一点加热，玻璃与云母出现不同的熔化区域。
cues.captionEn: Point heating produces different melting regions on glass and mica.
cues.zh: 在玻璃和云母薄片上涂一层薄石蜡，用热烙铁从背面接触一点。颜色变化表示达到同一个熔化温度。随加热继续，玻璃近似形成圆形，云母的边界沿某一方向伸得更远。
cues.en: Coat glass and mica sheets with thin wax and heat one point from the back. The changing region reaches the same melting temperature. Glass produces a nearly circular boundary, while mica spreads farther along one direction.

cues.title: 同一温度，不同方向
cues.caption: 圆形对应面内各向同性，椭圆反映面内各向异性。
cues.captionEn: A circle indicates in-plane isotropy; an ellipse reveals anisotropy.
cues.zh: 停在同一加热时刻比较边界。圆形表示这个平面内各方向的热传播相近，椭圆则表明不同方向不同。并非所有晶体的每一种性质都各向异性，实验要说明测量的性质和方向。
cues.en: Pause at one heating time. A circle means similar thermal spreading in all directions within the sheet; an ellipse reveals a directional difference. Not every property of every crystal is anisotropic: specify both the property and directions being tested.

cues.title: 胶带带走更薄的片层
cues.caption: 层间分离，可以保留片层内部的碳原子网络。
cues.captionEn: Separating layers can preserve each sheet’s carbon network.
cues.zh: 胶带粘住石墨表面，再揭起时会带走薄片。重复处理并选择较薄的区域，可以得到越来越少的层数。图中追踪一个理想化等分薄片，真实剥离并不保证每次减半，也不保证每片都成为单层。
cues.en: Adhesive tape lifts thin flakes from graphite. Repeated peeling and selection can leave progressively fewer layers. We track an idealized equally split flake; actual peeling neither halves every flake nor guarantees that each becomes a monolayer.

cues.title: 留下单层蜂窝网络
cues.caption: 单层石墨烯保留二维蜂窝排列。
cues.captionEn: A graphene monolayer retains a two-dimensional honeycomb network.
cues.zh: 放大最终选中的单层，碳原子连成蜂窝状网络。这里的层间距尺度约为零点三三五纳米，画面为可观察而大幅放大。实际研究还要转移到合适衬底，并用独立方法鉴定是否真的是单层。
cues.en: Enlarge the selected monolayer: carbon atoms form a honeycomb network. The associated graphite layer-spacing scale is about zero point three three five nanometres, enormously enlarged here. Real experiments transfer flakes to a suitable substrate and independently identify monolayers.

cues.title: 多接灯泡，反而变暗
cues.caption: 相同电源增加并联负载，路端电压降低。
cues.captionEn: Adding parallel loads to the same source lowers terminal voltage.
cues.zh: 先用同一节电池点亮一只灯泡，再逐个接入相同的并联灯泡。支路增多，总电流增大，但电池内部也有电阻。内部的电压降增大，留给每只灯泡的路端电压反而降低，所以它们一起变暗。
cues.en: Start with one lamp, then connect identical lamps in parallel to the same source. More branches draw more total current. But the source has internal resistance. Its internal voltage drop grows, leaving less terminal voltage across each lamp, so they become dimmer together.

cues.title: 比较理想电源
cues.caption: 只有内阻参与，才能解释这里的电压下降。
cues.captionEn: Internal resistance explains this terminal-voltage decrease.
cues.zh: 保持四只灯泡，先把电源内阻设为零。即使总电流较大，灯泡两端仍有完整的三伏。再逐渐加入内阻，下面的电压条把三伏分成路端电压和内阻压降。灯泡变暗的原因是电源实际输出发生了变化。
cues.en: Keep four lamps and first set internal resistance to zero. Even with substantial current, each lamp receives the full three volts. Gradually add internal resistance. The bar divides that three volts into terminal voltage and internal drop. Dimming comes from a change in the source’s actual output.

cues.title: 改变负载，记录点
cues.caption: 每次同时记录 U 和 I。
cues.captionEn: Record U and I together at each load.
cues.zh: 换成干电池的测量装置。电流表串联，电压表跨接电源两端。移动滑动变阻器触点，外部电阻减小，电流增大，而路端电压下降。用多个负载取得一组数据，比只凭两次读数求解更有利于检查趋势。
cues.en: Switch to the dry-cell measurement apparatus: an ammeter in series and voltmeter across the source. Move the rheostat contact to reduce the load resistance. Current rises while terminal voltage falls. Multiple loads provide a set of points, helping reveal the trend beyond a calculation from only two readings.

cues.title: 从直线求参数
cues.caption: U = E − Ir；截距是 E，斜率是 −r。
cues.captionEn: U = E − Ir: intercept E, slope −r.
cues.zh: 把电压放在纵轴、电流放在横轴。近似直线延伸到电流为零处，其电压截距给出电动势；斜率的绝对值给出内阻。再放大电压轴，原来挤在一起的变化更容易比较。坐标轴从非零值开始时，要看清截断标记，不能把图框边缘当作零电压。
cues.en: Plot voltage vertically against current horizontally. Extending the near-straight line to zero current gives the EMF intercept; the slope’s magnitude gives internal resistance. Magnifying the voltage axis makes small changes easier to compare. When that axis starts above zero, notice the break mark: the frame edge no longer represents zero voltage.

cues.title: 铜锌插入梨
cues.titleEn: Copper and zinc in a pear
cues.caption: 水果电池是电源，几何改变也会影响内阻。
cues.captionEn: The fruit cell is a source whose geometry affects internal resistance.
cues.zh: 把铜片和锌片插入梨中，形成一个简单电源。铜片是正极，锌片是负极。观察电极插得更深时的模型变化：有效接触增加，内阻减小，带负载时的电压提高。真实水果还受成分、极化和时间影响，不能只靠几何公式精确预测。
cues.en: Insert copper and zinc electrodes into a pear to form a simple source. Copper is positive and zinc negative. Deeper insertion increases effective contact in this model, reducing internal resistance and raising loaded voltage. Real fruit also depends on composition, polarization and time, so geometry alone cannot predict it precisely.

cues.title: 用已知电阻推电流
cues.titleEn: Infer current from a known load
cues.caption: 电阻箱 R 和电压 U，给出 I = U/R。
cues.captionEn: Known box resistance R and voltage U give I = U/R.
cues.zh: 这次只有电压表和电阻箱，没有串联电流表。每次设定已知电阻，读出电压，就能用电压除以电阻求出负载电流，再画出电压电流图像。水果电池的内阻可能随时间变化，所以同一组测量要在条件相对稳定时完成。
cues.en: Here there is a voltmeter and resistance box but no series ammeter. Set a known resistance, read the voltage and divide voltage by resistance to infer load current. Those pairs form the voltage-current plot. Fruit-cell resistance can drift with time, so one data set requires reasonably stable conditions.

cues.title: 另一条测量路径
cues.caption: U = IR；拟合斜率还包含微安表内阻。
cues.captionEn: U = IR; the fitted slope also includes microammeter resistance.
cues.zh: 橙汁电池换成另一条路径：只有微安表和电阻箱。用电流乘以电阻箱阻值得到它两端的电压。金色点来自教材数据。注意，电流表的一百欧姆内阻也串在回路中，所以直线斜率的大小等于电池内阻加上这一百欧姆，求电池内阻时还要减去它。
cues.en: The orange-juice cell uses a different path: a microammeter and resistance box. Multiply measured current by box resistance to obtain the box voltage. Gold points are textbook data. The meter’s one hundred ohms is also in series, so the slope magnitude includes both cell resistance and meter resistance. Subtract the meter contribution to infer the cell alone.

cues.title: 先测充电宝输出端
cues.caption: 教材样例的输出曲线在所测范围内近似直线。
cues.captionEn: The textbook output curve is nearly linear over its measured range.
cues.zh: 充电宝内部还有升压和稳压电路，不能直接把输出口当成裸锂电池。先按教材方案改变外部负载，保护电阻保留在回路中。这里的金色点是教材百分之百电量时的数据。在这段测量范围内，它们近似成直线，可以定义输出端的等效参数。
cues.en: A power bank includes boost and regulation circuits, so its output is not a bare lithium cell. Vary the external load while retaining the series protection resistor. Gold points reproduce the textbook’s full-charge data. They are nearly linear over this measured range, allowing equivalent parameters for the output terminals.

cues.title: 电量变化，输出不同
cues.caption: 比较教材同一研究中的六种电量。
cues.captionEn: Compare six charge states from the same textbook study.
cues.zh: 再看教材研究的六种电量。内部锂电池的电动势随剩余电量下降，而充电宝输出端的拟合截距仍在五伏附近。这是稳压电路作用后的外部表现。两条曲线来自同一教材样例，不是所有产品的保证，也不能用输出端的斜率直接代替电芯内阻。
cues.en: Compare six charge levels from the textbook study. The lithium cell’s EMF decreases with remaining charge, while the fitted power-bank output intercept stays near five volts. That is the external behavior after regulation. These curves describe this study, not every product, and the output slope is not the bare cell’s internal resistance.

cues.title: 直线有适用范围
cues.titleEn: A line has a valid range
cues.caption: 限流后的示意曲线不能继续用同一条直线描述。
cues.captionEn: The illustrative current-limited curve no longer follows that line.
cues.zh: 最后做一个模型边界检查。继续减小示意负载，电源进入设定的限流区：电流不再按原来直线增长，输出电压明显下降。这里是另行设定的调节器示意，不是教材追加的实测数据。测到一段近似直线，只能支持那段工作范围内的等效模型。
cues.en: Finally test a model boundary. Reduce the illustrative load until the source reaches its imposed current limit. Current stops following the original line and output voltage drops. This is a separately specified regulator demonstration, not extra textbook measurements. A nearly straight measured segment supports an equivalent model only within that operating range.

cues.title: 水滴仍受重力
cues.caption: 没有向上支持力，水滴会落下。
cues.captionEn: Without an upward supporting force, the drop falls.
cues.zh: 先关闭磁场，观察水滴释放后落到支撑位置。它并没有失去重力。所谓悬浮，需要另一种向上的力与重量平衡，不能只因为装置里没有看见支架就叫失重。
cues.en: Start with the field off: the released water drop falls onto a support. Gravity has not vanished. Levitation requires another upward force to balance weight; the absence of a visible support does not remove gravity.

cues.title: 强场本身还不够
cues.caption: 理想均匀磁场没有产生所需的净平移磁力。
cues.captionEn: An ideal uniform field supplies no net translational lift here.
cues.zh: 把理想磁场强度设为十六特斯拉，但让它处处相同。水具有微弱抗磁性，却仍不会因此向上悬浮。平移磁力取决于磁场在空间的变化，只有强度这一项不够。
cues.en: Set an ideal field to sixteen tesla but make it uniform. Water is weakly diamagnetic, yet this alone does not lift it. Translational force depends on spatial variation of the field; strength by itself is insufficient.

cues.title: 非均匀强磁场提供升力
cues.caption: 抗磁物体趋向较弱场区，升力可以平衡重力。
cues.captionEn: Diamagnetic material moves toward weaker field and can balance gravity.
cues.zh: 换成沿高度变化的强磁场。水滴受到指向较弱磁场区域的力，在这里方向向上。观察两根受力箭头：在一定高度，向上磁力与向下重力相等，水滴就能停留。
cues.en: Now let the strong field vary with height. The drop is pushed toward weaker field, upward in this region. Compare the force arrows: at one height, upward magnetic force equals downward weight and the drop can remain suspended.

cues.title: 偏离后能否回来
cues.caption: 稳定位置附近，偏离会产生恢复作用。
cues.captionEn: Near a stable position, displacement produces a restoring response.
cues.zh: 让水滴受到一次很小的扰动。往下偏一点，磁力大于重量；往上偏一点，磁力小于重量。它在阻尼下回到平衡附近。这里只检验竖直稳定，真实装置还必须满足横向稳定条件。
cues.en: Give the drop a small disturbance. Slightly below equilibrium, magnetic force exceeds weight; slightly above, it is smaller. Damping brings it back. This model tests only vertical stability; the real apparatus must also provide transverse stability.

cues.title: 从水滴到科学史中的青蛙
cues.titleEn: From water to the historical frog
cues.caption: 生物组织的抗磁性让强场悬浮成为可能。
cues.captionEn: Diamagnetism of biological tissue allows strong-field levitation.
cues.zh: 科学史上的研究把这一原理用于含水的生物体，曾在约十六特斯拉磁场中使青蛙悬浮。画面以水的参数近似其整体响应，强调相同的受力原理；它不是精确的动物组织或三维磁场计算。
cues.en: The historical experiment extended this principle to water-rich organisms, including a frog levitated in a field of about sixteen tesla. This illustration uses water-like properties to explain the same force balance, not a detailed tissue or three-dimensional magnet calculation.

cues.title: 下蹲时先轻后重
cues.caption: 两段都向下，支持力却一小一大。
cues.captionEn: Both stages move down, but support force first falls and then rises.
cues.zh: 站在体重计上缓慢下蹲。开始向下加速时，秤的支持力小于重力，读数变小。接近蹲下的终点，人仍然向下运动，却开始减速，加速度已经朝上，读数反而变大。最后停稳，读数回到原来的值。判断超重还是失重，不能只看人正在向上走还是向下走。
cues.en: Stand on a scale and squat. At first, downward acceleration requires support force smaller than gravity, lowering the reading.
