Near the bottom, you are still moving down but slowing; acceleration is upward and the reading rises. Once stationary, the original reading returns. Direction of travel alone cannot determine apparent weight.

cues.title: 力平台记录蹲起
cues.titleEn: Record the full squat and rise
cues.caption: 仪器记录支持力；质量与重力未改变。
cues.captionEn: The instrument records support force; mass and gravity do not change.
cues.zh: 把体重计换成力传感器，记录完整的下蹲和站起过程。曲线的虚线是静止时的重力，绿色曲线是支持力。站起时先向上加速，支持力大于重力；接近站稳时向上减速，支持力小于重力。这里的曲线来自一个平滑的示例动作，真实人体的晃动和仪表滤波会让细节不同，但受力关系不变。
cues.en: Replace the scale with a force platform and record a complete squat and rise. The dashed baseline is weight at rest; the green trace is support force. Rising begins with upward acceleration and greater support, then upward braking and smaller support. This smooth example is not a recorded human trial. Real sway and filtering change details but not the force relationship.

cues.title: 电梯上升的三个阶段
cues.titleEn: Three stages of an upward journey
cues.caption: 上升启动偏重，匀速恢复，上升制动偏轻。
cues.captionEn: Heavier at upward start, normal at cruise, lighter while braking.
cues.zh: 现在人保持站立，让电梯完成运动。上升启动时，电梯、人和秤一起向上加速，读数高于静止值。进入匀速段，加速度为零，读数恢复正常，即使电梯仍在上升。制动时加速度向下，读数变小。井道刻线显示运动方向，速度和加速度分开显示，帮助你把三种状态对应到同一条曲线。
cues.en: Keep the passenger standing while the lift moves. At upward start, lift, person and scale accelerate upward together and the reading exceeds its rest value. During constant speed, acceleration is zero and the normal reading returns despite continued ascent. Braking has downward acceleration and a smaller reading. Shaft marks reveal travel, while separate velocity and acceleration readings explain the trace.

cues.title: 换成下降再检验
cues.caption: 下降减速时，加速度向上，仍然超重。
cues.captionEn: A descending lift is heavier while braking upward.
cues.zh: 换成下降过程。启动向下加速，读数变小；匀速下降，读数正常；向下减速时，加速度向上，读数变大。用向上为正方向，支持力减去重力就等于质量乘加速度。体重计上标着千克，是把支持力除以标定的重力加速度后的显示，不代表运动过程中人的真实质量发生变化。
cues.en: Reverse the journey. Downward acceleration lowers the reading; steady descent restores it; downward braking raises it because acceleration points up. With upward positive, support minus weight equals mass times acceleration. A scale labelled in kilograms divides support force by its calibration gravity. That display does not mean the person’s actual mass changes during motion.

cues.title: 静止水瓶为什么漏水
cues.caption: 水面通气，孔口处的压差驱动水流。
cues.captionEn: A vented surface permits a pressure difference that drives the jet.
cues.zh: 在通气的水瓶侧壁开小孔，静止时水会流出。小孔上方的水柱形成压力差，推动水从孔口喷出，再受重力作用沿弯曲路径下落。本例把短时间内的水位变化忽略，先建立静止时的对照。请注意水滴离开瓶子以后已经是独立运动的物体，瓶子的后续动作不会让旧水滴凭空消失。
cues.en: Make a small side hole in a vented bottle. At rest, the water head produces a pressure difference and drives an outward jet, which then curves downward under gravity. Over this short comparison, level change is neglected. Once a droplet leaves, it moves independently: later bottle motion cannot erase water that has already been emitted.

cues.title: 瓶和水一起自由落下
cues.titleEn: Let bottle and water fall together
cues.caption: 持续压差消失；旧水滴仍按原来的速度和重力运动。
cues.captionEn: Sustained pressure vanishes; earlier droplets retain their motion under gravity.
cues.zh: 释放水瓶，瓶和水一起以重力加速度下落。相对于瓶子，维持原来水柱压差的有效重力降为零，持续喷流因而消失。已经喷出的水滴仍继续飞行。这里忽略刚释放时很短的流体惯性过程，所以停止新水流是理想化处理。完全失重说的是支持或压迫作用消失，绝不是地球的引力突然消失。
cues.en: Release the bottle. It and the water accelerate downward at g. Relative to the bottle, effective gravity sustaining the original pressure head becomes zero, so the sustained jet ceases. Earlier droplets keep flying. The brief fluid-inertia transient at release is omitted, so the cutoff is idealized. Complete weightlessness means loss of support or pressure effects, not disappearance of Earth’s gravity.

cues.title: 记录不跟着模型走
cues.titleEn: Records do not follow the model
cues.caption: 先固定记录，再比较同一时刻的预测。
cues.captionEn: Fix the records, then compare predictions.
cues.zh: 一个星点不在预测的位置，该改记录，还是改模型？第谷的精密记录给开普勒提出了这个问题。先用一张明确的合成表看清方法：五个日期，各有一个方向，金色实点固定不动。现在叠加简单圆轨道的空心预测。同一天的两个标记没有重合，而且偏差随日期改变。移动模型时，不能让证据跟着移动。这张表不是第谷的原始数据，也不复现历史上的八角分。
cues.en: If a planet misses its predicted position, should we change the record or the model? Tycho’s precise observations posed this challenge to Kepler. Here, a synthetic table makes the method visible. Five dates have five fixed gold records. Add the hollow predictions of a simple circular orbit. On the same dates, the marks disagree, and the discrepancy changes. Moving the model must not move the evidence. This is teaching data, not Tycho’s table or the historical eight-arcminute reconstruction.

cues.title: 把新记录留到最后
cues.titleEn: Save new records for the test
cues.caption: 参数先锁定，余下记录后揭晓。
cues.captionEn: Lock the parameters before revealing unused records.
cues.zh: 让两个候选面对同样五条记录。圆轨道和指定椭圆都只调整初相位，采用相同的比较规则。圆轨道留下成串的偏差；椭圆更接近这些记录，但这还不够。现在锁定椭圆的参数，把后面两次方向先画成空心预测。暂停判断：新记录会落在哪里？揭开原本保留的两个金点。它们接近预测，为这个候选增加证据。这里只比较两种指定模型，不能说靠七个点重做了开普勒的发现。
cues.en: Give both candidates the same five records. Fit only their starting phase, using the same rule for the circle and the specified ellipse. The circle leaves a pattern of errors; the ellipse comes closer. But a close fit is not enough. Lock its parameters and draw hollow predictions for two unused dates. Pause: where should the new records lie? Reveal the two gold points that were held back. Their agreement adds evidence for this candidate. Comparing two specified models does not recreate Kepler’s discovery.

cues.title: 让望远镜延伸视线
cues.caption: 凸物镜与凹目镜把远方光束送入眼睛。
cues.captionEn: A positive objective and negative eyepiece deliver distant light to the eye.
cues.zh: 伽利略式望远镜使用凸物镜和凹目镜。下方追踪平行入射光束，物镜使它趋向会聚，凹目镜在焦点之前让光束重新平行。上方呈现木星附近的光点。光学剖面取理想近轴模型，放大率为五；观察窗口另放大，不能当成真实视场大小。
cues.en: A Galilean telescope combines a positive objective and negative eyepiece. The objective converges incoming parallel rays; before they reach the focus, the eyepiece makes them parallel again. The paraxial diagram has magnification five. The upper observation window is enlarged independently and is not a true field-of-view scale.

cues.title: 连续记录光点换位
cues.caption: 反复围绕木星换位的光点，支持卫星解释。
cues.captionEn: Points repeatedly changing position around Jupiter support the moon interpretation.
cues.zh: 一次看到几个光点还不够。连续观察，光点反复出现在木星两侧，远近次序改变，有时被木星遮住。下方把五个相邻日期并排成记录。四颗卫星采用近似圆轨道和各自周期；初始相位为教学选值，不是伽利略一六一零年的原始观测复原。
cues.en: One glimpse is insufficient. Repeated observations show points on both sides of Jupiter, changing order and occasionally disappearing behind it. Five adjacent dates are recorded below. The four moons use approximate circular orbits and their distinct periods. Initial phases are illustrative, not a reconstruction of Galileo’s original observations.

cues.title: 偏差能由额外引力解释吗？
cues.titleEn: Can extra gravity explain the discrepancy?
cues.caption: 候选要解释固定偏差，还要预测新记录。
cues.captionEn: Explain fixed discrepancies, then predict new records.
cues.zh: 天王星偏离预测，可能是观测、模型，或遗漏的引力。这里先固定一张合成偏差表，检查最后一种可能。远方行星不只吸引天王星，也吸引太阳；金色箭头表示两者加速度之差，它才改变日心相对运动。回到同一刻度的记录：半份示例质量解释不够，另一候选更接近前五次。锁定这个候选，先预测后面三次，再揭开保留记录。吻合支持这个有条件的解释，却不能仅靠这几个候选确定一颗真实行星；还需要独立的天空观测。
cues.en: Uranus missed predictions: perhaps the observations, the model, or an omitted pull were responsible. Freeze this synthetic residual table to test the last possibility. A distant body pulls both Uranus and the Sun. The gold arrow is the difference between their accelerations, changing their relative motion. Back on the same plot scale, half the example mass falls short; another candidate fits the first five records better. Lock it, predict three later records, then reveal them. Agreement supports this conditional model. A limited candidate grid cannot establish a real planet: independent sky observations are still needed.

cues.title: 让下一晚检验新光点
cues.titleEn: Let the next night test the new point
cues.caption: 真实记录独立于模型，下一夜检验是否移动。
cues.captionEn: Independent records test whether the new point moves.
cues.zh: 清掉合成坐标，换成恩克在一八四六年发表的真实报告。同一历元的地心黄经，计算位置与观测位置相差五十四点七五角分：接近，但并不相等。再看九月二十三日到二十五日的三夜坐标。第二夜，光点已经离开第一夜的位置，恒星不动的解释受到检验。现在只用前两夜做一次事后的课堂直线外推，先锁定第三夜的空心预测，再揭晓实际记录。新记录靠近运动预测。这个练习不是勒维耶的原始计算，三夜也不足以确定完整轨道。
cues.en: Clear the synthetic axes and open Encke’s actual eighteen-forty-six report. At the same epoch, the calculated and observed geocentric longitudes differ by fifty-four point seven five arcminutes: nearby, not identical. Now inspect three nights, September twenty-third through twenty-fifth. By the second night the point has moved, testing the fixed-star explanation. Use just those two nights for a retrospective classroom linear extrapolation. Lock the hollow third-night prediction, then reveal the actual record. It lies near the moving prediction. This is not Le Verrier’s original calculation, and three nights do not determine a complete orbit.

cues.title: 把多次彗星记录联系起来
cues.titleEn: Connect records of a returning comet
cues.caption: 相似轨道使多次出现可以被解释为同一天体。
cues.captionEn: Similar orbital records can connect separate appearances to one body.
cues.zh: 哈雷把历史上的几次彗星记录联系起来，提出它们可能是同一颗彗星的反复回归。图中太阳位于椭圆焦点，彗星靠近太阳时更快，远离时更慢。时间等速推进，运动速度由开普勒方程决定，不沿椭圆均匀移动；尾巴方向背离太阳，是简化方向提示。
cues.en: Halley connected several comet records as possible returns of one body. The Sun lies at an ellipse’s focus. The comet moves faster nearby and slower far away. Time advances uniformly while Kepler’s equation determines position, rather than uniform motion along the ellipse. The tail only indicates the antisolar direction.

cues.title: 用未来回归检验判断
cues.titleEn: Test the judgment with a future return
cues.caption: 预测的回归到来，才为判断增加新的证据。
cues.captionEn: A later observed return adds new evidence for the prediction.
cues.zh: 从一五三一、一六零七和一六八二年的记录出发，哈雷预言彗星再次回归；一七五八年它果然被重新发现。下方列出这些历史年份。模型取固定的七十五点三年周期，只演示重复轨道；真实回归日期受其他行星摄动，不能靠这个固定周期逐次外推。
cues.en: Records from fifteen thirty-one, sixteen oh-seven and sixteen eighty-two led Halley to predict another return. The comet was rediscovered in seventeen fifty-eight. These historical dates appear below. The fixed seventy-five-point-three-year model illustrates recurrence; actual return dates depend on perturbations and cannot be extrapolated from this fixed period.

cues.title: 先建立实验参照
cues.caption: 摩擦电可以储存，也能使带电指示器响应。
cues.captionEn: Frictional electricity can be stored and produce an indicator response.
cues.zh: 先看摩擦来源这一侧。电荷逐渐积累到储存装置，连接的带电指示器随之张开。画面用现代等效模型把这种关系放大：电荷能被转移和储存，也能产生可重复的电学现象。这为比较另一个来源建立了参照。
cues.en: Start with the frictional source. Charge accumulates in storage and the connected indicator opens. This modern equivalent model enlarges that relationship: charge can be transferred and stored, producing repeatable electrical effects. That establishes a reference for comparing another source.

cues.title: 比较历史报告
cues.caption: 云中来源也能用于储存与同类电学实验。
cues.captionEn: The reported cloud source also supported storage and similar electrical effects.
cues.zh: 富兰克林一七五二年的报告提到，云中取得的电可以存入瓶中，并重复通常由摩擦玻璃产生的电学现象。现在用相同的模型装置表现这条证据。教材本页没有给出风筝装置，这里也没有把示意图说成历史现场的精确复原。
cues.en: Franklin’s 1752 report describes electricity obtained from clouds being stored in a phial and used for electrical effects normally produced with rubbed glass. The same model apparatus now represents that evidence. This textbook passage gives no kite apparatus, and our diagram is not presented as a precise reconstruction of the historical event.

cues.title: 相同性质，不等于相同数值
cues.caption: 正负两种电荷都可能使指示器张开。
cues.captionEn: Either charge sign can open an indicator.
cues.zh: 两侧都能储存电荷、使指示器张开，但注意正负符号并不相同。张开程度不能单独判定电荷的种类，更不能证明两次实验有完全相同的电量。历史推断关注的是可重复的共同电学性质，而不是要求所有细节和数值相等。
cues.en: Both sides store charge and open an indicator, but their signs differ. Opening alone cannot identify charge type or establish exactly equal quantities. The historical inference concerns repeatable shared electrical properties, not a requirement that every detail and numerical value match.

cues.title: 断开来源后仍能释放
cues.caption: 接入释放支路，两路储存电荷都逐渐减少。
cues.captionEn: Connect release paths and both stored charges decrease.
cues.zh: 最后隔离两路来源，再接通释放支路。指示器逐渐合拢，说明之前储存的电荷正在释放。这样的共同性质把来源不同的现象联系起来。现代图只是帮助理解历史证据；它既不是历史测量记录，也不是在雷暴天气复现实验的操作指南。
cues.en: Finally isolate both sources and connect the release paths. The indicators close as stored charge is released. Shared properties connect phenomena with different origins. This modern diagram helps explain the historical evidence; it is neither a historical measurement record nor a guide to recreating a storm experiment.

cues.title: 同一种引力，能解释月球吗？
cues.titleEn: Can one gravity explain the Moon?
cues.caption: 先锁定平方反比的预测，再检查轨道。
cues.captionEn: Lock the inverse-square prediction before checking the orbit.
cues.zh: 苹果落地，月球却一直绕行，真是同一种引力吗？先只用地面自由落体的已知加速度。月球离地心约六十个地球半径；若引力按距离平方减弱，月球处的加速度就应约为地面的三千六百分之一。先把这个预测留下。月球并不是朝地面直直掉落，我们要检查的是：引力能否不断改变它的速度方向。
cues.en: An apple falls, but the Moon keeps orbiting. Could the same gravity explain both? Start with the known acceleration of free fall at the surface. The Moon is about sixty Earth radii away. If gravity weakens with distance squared, acceleration there should be about one thirty-six-hundredth as large. Keep that prediction. The Moon does not drop straight toward Earth: the question is whether gravity can continually turn its velocity.

cues.title: 用距离与周期独立核对
cues.caption: 轨道给出的加速度接近预测，并不完全相等。
cues.captionEn: The orbital estimate is close to the prediction, not exactly equal.
cues.zh: 现在才打开月球距离和公转周期的参考数据，不使用引力常量。把轨道近似为圆，从一周路程和所需时间求速度，再求改变速度方向所需的加速度。结果约为零点零零二七二米每二次方秒，与预测接近，却不完全相等。真实月球轨道不是理想圆，地球也会运动。若另一个物体离地心更远一倍，平方反比模型又预测什么？加速度变为四分之一；月球的原参考数据没有改变。
cues.en: Now reveal the reference distance and orbital period, without using G. Approximate the orbit as circular: distance per revolution gives speed, and the changing direction gives acceleration. The result is about zero point zero zero two seven two metres per second squared: close to our prediction, but not identical. The real orbit is not a perfect circle, and Earth moves too. What if another object were twice as far from Earth’s centre? The model predicts a quarter of the acceleration. The fixed lunar record stays unchanged.

cues.title: 把微弱引力变成光点位移
cues.titleEn: Turn a tiny attraction into a moving spot
cues.caption: 引力使杆扭转，同一转角改变反射光的方向。
cues.captionEn: Attraction twists the rod; the same angle turns the reflected beam.
cues.zh: 两颗小球悬在细丝下，模型只考虑旁边大球的引力吸引，球面没有接触。沿着每一对球的连线看，四组力共同产生转动作用；细丝越扭，反向恢复力矩越大。杆中央的镜子跟着转动。入射光真的碰到镜面，反射方向随镜面转角改变两倍；远处刻度尺上的光点因此移动。我们放大的是刻度尺细节，不是假装小球转过很大的角度。这样的位移，怎样用来求引力常量？
cues.en: Two small spheres hang from a fine fibre. Nearby large spheres attract them without touching. Follow the four pairwise force directions: together they turn the rod, while the twisting fibre supplies an opposing torque. A mirror attached to the rod turns with it. Light reaches the mirror and reflects toward a screen; its direction changes by twice the mirror angle. The ruler detail is enlarged, not the physical rotation. How can this displacement give us the gravitational constant?

cues.title: 先校准，再反求引力
cues.caption: 发表的位移和振动记录给出带不确定度的G。
cues.captionEn: Published displacement and oscillations give G with an uncertainty.
cues.zh: 这里换成现代实验发表的记录，不是卡文迪许的原始读数。大球两种位置对应不同的平衡位置；两者相差一点八七厘米。振动周期与衰减给出细丝恢复作用相对于转动惯量的大小。再把光点位移换成转角，结合球的质量和距离，就能反求G。采用论文的近邻两对恒力矩近似，结果约为六点五，不确定度零点五，再乘十的负十一次方。它不是预先塞进记录的答案。若细丝刚度加倍呢？转角约减半，但重新校准后，求出的引力常量不变。
cues.en: These are published records from a modern experiment, not Cavendish’s original readings. The two attractor positions have different equilibrium spot positions, separated by one point eight seven centimetres. The oscillation period and decay calibrate restoring torque relative to inertia. Convert displacement into angle, then use the measured masses and geometry to infer G. Under the paper’s constant-torque approximation using the two nearest pairs, the result is six point five, plus or minus zero point five, times ten to the minus eleven in SI units. It was not planted in the records. Double the fibre stiffness: the angle roughly halves, but after recalibration the inferred G stays the same.

cues.title: 先看较慢的水平发射
cues.titleEn: Begin with a slower horizontal launch
cues.caption: 引力不断改变速度方向，轨迹最终与地表相交。
cues.captionEn: Gravity continually turns velocity until the trajectory meets the surface.
cues.zh: 想象在没有空气的地球上方水平发射一个物体。速度较小时，它的弯曲轨迹会与地面相交。画面从三百千米高度出发，只是牛顿思想实验的数值版本，并非可以建造的高山大炮。引力始终指向地心，大小随距离改变。
cues.en: Imagine launching horizontally above an airless Earth. At a lower speed, the curved path intersects the surface. This numerical thought experiment starts at three hundred kilometres altitude; it is not a buildable mountain cannon. Gravity always points toward Earth’s centre and varies with distance.

cues.title: 提高横向速度，落下却绕过地球
cues.titleEn: Increase tangential speed and keep falling around Earth
cues.caption: 轨道运动仍是自由落体，引力没有消失。
cues.captionEn: Orbital motion remains free fall; gravity has not disappeared.
cues.zh: 把初速度调到这一高度的圆轨道速度，物体一边落下一边绕过弯曲地表，持续处于自由落体。绿色短线指向地心，表示加速度方向。自由探索可以继续改变速度，看落地、近圆和椭圆路径；轨迹由同一个中心引力模型积分，预览时长有限。
cues.en: Set the speed to the circular-orbit value at this altitude. The object falls while continually missing the curved surface. The short green line indicates acceleration toward the centre. Exploration changes speed between impact, near-circular and elliptical paths, all integrated from central gravity over a finite preview interval.

cues.title: 同时发射两种信号
cues.caption: 红外提供起点，超声提供可测的延迟。
cues.captionEn: An infrared reference times the slower sound.
cues.zh: 把发射器固定在小车上，接收器留在轨道端，并连接计算机。发射器同时发出红外脉冲和超声脉冲。红外传播极快，先到达接收器，启动计时；超声传播慢得多，随后到达。教材用这两种信号的时间差来测距离。单次测量首先给出位置，速度还需要另一次位置记录。
cues.en: Fix the emitter to the cart and connect a stationary receiver to the computer. Infrared and ultrasound are emitted together. Infrared arrives first and starts the timer; much slower ultrasound follows. The textbook uses their arrival-time difference to measure range. One measurement gives position; velocity requires a second position record.

cues.title: 一次单程测距
cues.caption: x约等于声速乘时差，不需要除以二。
cues.captionEn: One-way range ≈ sound speed × delay.
cues.zh: 把短暂的传播过程放慢，跟着超声脉冲走到接收器。小车仍在运动，但这一脉冲从发射时的位置出发，之后在空气中独立传播。超声到达后，距离才显示出来。由于红外传播时间远小于声传播时间，教材近似用声速乘以这段时差。这里声波只走了一程，不能再除以二。
cues.en: Slow the propagation and follow the ultrasonic pulse to the receiver. The cart keeps moving, but the pulse starts at the emission position and then travels independently through the air. Range appears only after arrival. Infrared travel time is tiny compared with sound, so the textbook multiplies the delay by sound speed. This is a one-way path; do not divide by two.

cues.title: 连续位置生成速度
cues.caption: 0.02秒一次测距，位移除以对应时间。
cues.captionEn: Position differences reveal velocity.
cues.zh: 让传感器每隔零点零二秒重复测量，屏幕上逐步出现位置点。比较相邻两个点，位置差是这小段时间里的位移，位移除以时间就是平均速度。对于匀速小车，这个结果就是它的速度；对于变速运动，足够短的区间平均速度才可近似瞬时速度。计算机不会跳过位置信息，直接凭空知道速度。
cues.en: Repeat the measurement every 0.02 seconds. Position points accumulate on the screen. The difference between two positions is displacement; divide by their interval for average velocity. For this constant-speed cart the result is exact. During changing motion, a sufficiently short interval average only approximates instantaneous velocity. The computer derives velocity from positions rather than knowing it independently.

cues.title: 改为发射与接收同一探头
cues.titleEn: Use one transducer for the round trip
cues.caption: 超声碰到反射面后返回，路程约为两倍距离。
cues.captionEn: An echo travels out and back.
cues.zh: 换成反射式传感器，固定探头发射超声，小车上的反射面把它送回同一个探头。现在计时包含去程和回程，声速乘总时间给出往返路程，所以距离计算要除以二。运动目标的位置在反射时刻确定；本模型也保留了传播期间的微小移动。两种装置都能连续测速，但计时起点和声波路径不同，计算式不能混用。
cues.en: Switch to a reflected-echo sensor. A fixed transducer sends ultrasound to the cart and receives its return. Timing includes both outbound and inbound legs, so sound speed times total time gives a round-trip distance; divide by two. Range belongs to the reflection instant, and the model retains the cart’s small motion during flight. Both arrangements measure velocity repeatedly, but their timing references and paths differ.

cues.title: 先算出可以被检验的预期
cues.caption: 转动仪器，检验以太风的预言。
cues.captionEn: Rotate to test the ether-wind prediction.
cues.zh: 光在分束片分成两路，分别沿互相垂直的臂往返，再合并到探测端。假如地球穿过静止以太，沿风和横风的往返时间应不同。转动仪器，假设模型预期条纹会移动。上栏条纹由这个历史假设的往返时间计算，不能当成真实观察结果。
cues.en: A beam splitter sends light along perpendicular arms and recombines the returning beams. A stationary-ether hypothesis predicts different round-trip times along and across Earth’s motion. Rotating the apparatus should move the fringes. The upper strip calculates that historical hypothesis, not an actual observation.

cues.title: 把预期与实验结果比较
cues.titleEn: Compare the expectation with the result
cues.caption: 条纹没有按预期移动。
cues.captionEn: The fringes did not shift as predicted.
cues.zh: 迈克耳孙和莫雷没有观察到预期大小的条纹变化。下栏用理想不移动条纹示意这个零结果，不伪造原始噪声或误差条。它对当时的解释构成重要约束，但不能单凭一幅理想图就推导出完整相对论。光程取十一米的等效单臂长度，图形折叠被简化。
cues.en: Michelson and Morley did not observe the expected fringe change. The lower stationary strip illustrates an ideal null result without inventing historical noise or error bars. It constrained contemporary explanations, but one ideal image does not derive all of relativity. Each effective arm is eleven metres; optical folding is simplified.

cues.title: 同一次闪光，两次到壁
cues.caption: 比较的是光到壁的事件。
cues.captionEn: Compare the events where light meets each wall.
cues.zh: 车厢中央发出同一次闪光。先跟着车厢看：两边路程相等，光速相同，两壁同时亮起。换到地面看，列车向右运动，后壁迎向光，前壁却在远离光。光仍然以同样的速度传播，于是先到后壁，后到前壁。注意，比较的是光与墙壁相遇的两个事件，不是某个人后来收到消息的时刻。
cues.en: A single flash leaves the middle of the carriage. In the train frame, equal distances and equal light speeds give simultaneous arrivals at the two walls. In the ground frame, the train moves right. The rear wall approaches its light pulse while the front wall moves away. Light still travels at the same speed, so it reaches the rear wall first. These are wall-arrival events, not the times when a distant observer receives their messages.

cues.title: 同一事件，换一个参考系
cues.caption: 换参考系，不换那两个事件。
cues.captionEn: Change the frame, not the two events.
cues.zh: 保留两个到壁标记，只换坐标。这个归一化例子中，地面记录的到达时刻是零点二五和一；车厢记录却都是零点五。不是改了实验，而是不同参考系的同时不再相同。现在先猜：列车向左开，地面上哪一端先到光？右端成了后壁，所以先亮。最后让车静止，两路重新同时到达。
cues.en: Keep both arrival-event labels and change coordinates. In this normalized example, ground times are zero point two five and one. The train assigns zero point five to both. We have not changed the experiment: different frames disagree about simultaneity. Now predict what happens if the train moves left. The right wall becomes the rear wall and lights first. With the train stationary, both arrivals are simultaneous again.

cues.title: 相同粒子群，两种存活预言
cues.caption: 寿命相同，代入的时间不同。
cues.captionEn: Same lifetime, different elapsed time.
cues.zh: 先看真实记录。弗里施和史密斯在山顶与海平面多次计数，平均每小时五百六十三和四百零八；这不是逐个跟踪同一批粒子。现在另建一百个粒子的教学对照：同样的初始身份、速度和路程。经典算法让衰变经历全部地面时间，相对论则使用更短的固有时间。到达地面时，经典对照几乎全无，相对论还留下约一成。变的是经历的时间，平均固有寿命并没有变长。
cues.en: First, actual records. Frisch and Smith measured average rates of five hundred sixty-three per hour on the mountain and four hundred eight at sea level. They did not track individual particles between stations. Now use a separate teaching population of one hundred, with identical starting identities, speed and distance. The classical calculation uses the full ground time for decay. Relativity uses the shorter proper time. At arrival, the classical population is practically gone, while about one tenth survives relativistically. The proper mean lifetime itself has not changed.

cues.title: 为什么是固有时间
cues.caption: 换参考系，幸存的身份不变。
cues.captionEn: A change of frame preserves the survivors.
cues.zh: 用光钟作类比：跟着钟看，光上下走；在地面看，钟向前运动，光走更长的斜线。光速相同，因此同一拍对应更长的地面时间。这不是说μ子内部真的有两面镜子。回到μ子自身参考系，地面迎面而来，路程缩短，算出的固有时间和幸存身份完全相同。再预测：路程不变，速度从零点九九倍光速增加到零点九九五倍，会剩下更多吗？固有时间进一步缩短，这组教学粒子由十一颗增加到二十二颗。
cues.en: A light clock illustrates the geometry. With the clock, light travels vertically. From the ground, the moving clock makes that path diagonal and longer. With the same light speed, one tick takes more ground time. This is an analogy, not mirrors inside a muon. In the muon frame, the ground approaches over a contracted distance, giving the same proper time and survivors. Predict a faster trip over the same distance: increase the speed from zero point nine nine to zero point nine nine five times light speed. Less proper time passes, and this teaching population leaves twenty-two survivors instead of eleven.

cues.title: 东行：两种效应竞争
cues.caption: 速度与高度，共同决定钟差。
cues.captionEn: Speed and height both contribute.
cues.zh: 一九七一年，同一组四台铯原子钟先向东环球飞行，再与美国海军天文台的基准比较。要解释钟差，先看不随地球自转的参考系：东行把飞机速度加到地面自转速度上，运动项让飞行钟少走一些；较高的引力势却让它多走一些。按实际航线计算，预言净差约负四十纳秒。揭开四台钟经速率变化分析后的记录：平均负五十九纳秒，在报告的不确定度内与预言相容。
cues.en: In nineteen seventy-one, the same four cesium clocks first flew east around the world and were compared with the US Naval Observatory reference. In a frame that does not rotate with Earth, eastward flight adds to the ground speed. Motion reduces elapsed time, while greater gravitational potential adds time. Using the actual route, the published prediction was about minus forty nanoseconds. Now reveal the four clock offsets after rate-change analysis: their reported mean was minus fifty-nine nanoseconds, compatible with the prediction within the stated uncertainties.

cues.title: 西行与新条件的检验
cues.caption: 换向改变运动项，不反转高度项。
cues.captionEn: Reversal changes motion, not the height effect.
cues.zh: 随后仍是这四台钟，改向西环球飞行。先别揭答案：飞机速度抵消了一部分地面自转速度，运动项会怎样？它转为增加时间，高度项也仍是正的。实际航线预言约正二百七十五纳秒，记录的平均值是正二百七十三纳秒。最后换成明确的恒高教学模型：若只把高度降到零，高度项消失，东西方向的运动差别仍在。真实记录不会跟着滑块改变，东行也不是任何条件下都必然少走。
cues.en: The same four clocks later flew west. Before revealing the result, predict the motion term. Westward speed cancels part of Earth’s surface speed, so it adds elapsed time; the height term remains positive. The actual-route prediction was about plus two hundred seventy-five nanoseconds, and the reported mean was plus two hundred seventy-three. Finally, use a clearly labeled constant-height teaching model. Lowering only the height to zero removes that contribution, while the east–west motion difference remains. Sliders never change the historical records, and eastward flight does not always mean a time loss.

cues.title: 沉入曲别针，水面隆起
cues.caption: 曲别针排开的水形成杯口上方的微小隆起。
cues.captionEn: Water displaced by submerged clips raises the surface above the brim.
cues.zh: 先把杯子盛满，再让曲别针一枚枚沉入。曲别针排开水，却不一定立刻溢出：杯口固定住液面边缘，表面张力让上方保留小小的隆起。下方近景只放大纵向变化。
cues.en: Fill the glass to its brim, then submerge paper clips one by one. Their displaced water need not spill immediately: the rim pins the interface while surface tension supports a small rise. The detail view enlarges only the vertical change.

cues.title: 表面张力也有极限
cues.caption: 边缘不能继续固定液面时，更多水会溢出。
cues.captionEn: When edge pinning fails, additional displaced water spills.
cues.zh: 继续加入曲别针。达到示例设定的边缘斜率后，液面不能再无限抬高，新增排水量转为溢出。实际能放多少枚还取决于杯口、清洁度、曲别针体积和操作扰动，并不是固定常数。
cues.en: Add more clips. At the model’s limiting rim slope, the surface cannot rise indefinitely and additional displacement becomes spillage. The real count depends on rim shape, cleanliness, clip volume and disturbances; it is not a universal constant.

cues.title: 完整薄膜中的松弛棉线
cues.titleEn: A slack thread in intact film
cues.caption: 两侧都有薄膜时，牵拉可以相互平衡。
cues.captionEn: With film on both sides, the pulls can balance.
cues.zh: 把略微松弛的棉线两端系在铁丝环两侧，再形成完整肥皂膜。棉线两边都有薄膜，牵拉可以相互抵消，因此它不必立刻变成圆弧。先记住这条线的长度和两个固定端点。
cues.en: Tie a slightly slack cotton thread across a wire ring and form an intact soap film. Film on both sides can exert balancing pulls, so the thread need not immediately form an arc. Note its fixed length and endpoints.

cues.title: 刺破棉线一侧薄膜
cues.caption: 剩余薄膜把固定长度的棉线拉成弧线。
cues.captionEn: The remaining film pulls the fixed-length thread into an arc.
cues.zh: 刺破棉线上方的薄膜，另一侧仍然存在。剩余薄膜沿界面牵拉棉线，使它向薄膜一侧弯曲。注意端点没有移动，线也没有变长；变的是它的形状与剩余膜的面积。
cues.en: Puncture the film above the thread while leaving the other side intact. The remaining film pulls the thread toward itself. Endpoints stay fixed and the thread does not lengthen: its shape and the remaining film area change.

cues.title: 换成闭合棉线圈
cues.caption: 线圈内外都有薄膜时，形状可以不规则。
cues.captionEn: With film both inside and outside, the loop can remain irregular.
cues.zh: 再换一个装置：把闭合棉线圈系在铁丝环上，让线圈内外都覆盖薄膜。两侧牵拉平衡时，线圈可以保持不规则的形状。这与跨接两端的棉线是两种不同约束。
cues.en: Use a different arrangement: attach a closed thread loop to the ring, with film both inside and outside. Balanced pulls allow an irregular loop. Its constraint differs from the thread tied between two fixed endpoints.

cues.title: 刺破圈内薄膜
cues.titleEn: Puncture the film inside the loop
cues.caption: 同样长度的线圈张成圆形，外侧膜面积减少。
cues.captionEn: A fixed-length loop becomes circular and reduces outer film area.
cues.zh: 刺破线圈内部的薄膜，外侧薄膜把线圈向外拉开。在长度相同的闭合曲线中，圆形围成的面积最大，因此外侧剩余膜面积较小。这里线长保持不变，不是棉线被拉伸了。
cues.en: Puncture the film inside the loop. The outside film pulls it outward. Among closed curves of the same length, a circle encloses the greatest area, reducing the remaining outer film area. The thread length stays fixed; it is not stretched.

cues.title: 洁净玻璃上的水滴
cues.caption: 水滴摊开时，体积保持相同。
cues.captionEn: The drop spreads while keeping its volume.
cues.zh: 把一小滴水放在洁净玻璃上。界面的相互作用使它更容易铺展，接触角较小。演示保持水滴体积不变，所以横向变宽时，高度会相应降低。
cues.en: Place a small water drop on clean glass. Interfacial interactions favor spreading and a smaller contact angle. The model keeps its volume fixed, so a wider footprint is accompanied by lower height.

cues.title: 涂蜡表面的同体积水滴
cues.caption: 较大接触角对应更收拢的水滴。
cues.captionEn: A larger contact angle gives a more compact drop.
cues.zh: 在涂蜡玻璃上比较相同体积的水滴。它不易铺展，接触角较大，看起来更收拢。真实角度受表面处理和污染影响，画面中的数值是为了比较形状选取的示例。
cues.en: Compare an equal-volume drop on waxed glass. It spreads less and has a larger contact angle, appearing more compact. Real angles depend on treatment and contamination; the values here are illustrative choices for the comparison.

cues.title: 用纸托住缝衣针
cues.caption: 纸湿后下沉，针仍可由界面支持。
cues.captionEn: The tissue sinks after wetting, while the interface can support the needle.
cues.zh: 用一小片纸把针轻放在水面。纸吸水后逐渐下沉，针却可能留在界面。放大的横截面显示水面在针旁下凹，沿界面的张力具有向上的分量，能够支持针的重量。
cues.en: Use a small tissue to place a needle gently on water. The wetted tissue sinks while the needle can remain at the interface. In the enlarged cross-section, the depressed surface gives tension an upward component that can support the needle’s weight.

cues.title: 把针完全按入水下
cues.caption: 界面支持消失后，针的浮力不足以平衡重力。
cues.captionEn: After interface support disappears, buoyancy cannot balance its weight.
cues.zh: 把针完全按入水下，界面对针的支持随之消失。钢针排开水产生的浮力小于它的重量，因此继续下沉。不能因为它曾停在水面，就认为钢的密度变小或者针在水里也能浮起来。
cues.en: Push the needle fully underwater and its interface support disappears. The buoyancy of the displaced water is less than the steel needle’s weight, so it sinks. Its earlier surface support does not mean steel became less dense or can float when submerged.

cues.title: 把热气体封在碗内
cues.caption: 刚合拢时，内部压强近似等于大气压。
cues.captionEn: At sealing, inside pressure is approximately atmospheric.
cues.zh: 教材用纸燃烧加热碗内空气，再迅速合拢两个钢碗。这里按照题设，把刚密封的内部压强近似取为大气压。随后保持气体量和容积不变，观察冷却造成的变化。
cues.en: The textbook heats the bowl’s air by burning paper, then closes the two bowls. Following its assumptions, pressure at sealing is approximately atmospheric. Hold gas amount and volume fixed, then observe what cooling changes.

cues.title: 外部浇水冷却
cues.caption: 温度降低，内部压强下降，外界空气压紧钢碗。
cues.captionEn: Cooling lowers internal pressure and outside air presses the bowls together.
cues.zh: 从外部浇水使钢碗冷却到环境温度。在等容近似下，内部压强随开尔文温度降低。外面的大气压更大，作用在碗口投影面积上的压强差形成吸合效果。
cues.en: Cool the bowls toward room temperature by cooling their exterior. At fixed volume, internal pressure falls with Kelvin temperature. Higher atmospheric pressure outside produces the holding force over the projected opening area.

cues.title: 逐渐增加两侧拉力
cues.caption: 比较每侧拉力与压强差乘碗口面积。
cues.captionEn: Compare each side’s pull with pressure difference times opening area.
cues.zh: 现在两侧同时增加拉力。每侧五人，每人约二百牛，对应每侧约一千牛。要把它与压强差乘碗口面积比较，不能把左右两边的力相加。超过吸合条件时，密封边缘开始分开。
cues.en: Increase the equal opposing pulls. Five people at about two hundred newtons each provide roughly one thousand newtons on each side. Compare that single-side pull with pressure difference times opening area; do not add both sides together. Once the seal yields, the rims separate.

cues.title: 空气进入后容易分开
cues.titleEn: Air entry removes the holding force
cues.caption: 内外压强恢复相同，压强差支持消失。
cues.captionEn: Equalized pressure removes the pressure-difference holding force.
cues.zh: 碗口出现缝隙后，外界空气进入，内外压强很快趋同，继续分开就容易了。真正压紧钢碗的是外部空气与内部气体的压强差，不是里面有一种额外的吸力物质。
cues.en: Once a gap opens, outside air enters and pressures quickly equalize, making separation easier. The bowls were held together by the pressure difference between outside air and enclosed gas, not an extra substance producing suction.

cues.title: 同一气球控制条件
cues.caption: 体积和形状尽量不变，铁丝让重物便于读数。
cues.captionEn: Keep volume and shape fixed; wire makes the load easier to track.
cues.zh: 研究阻力怎样随速率变化，先把其他条件控制好。教材使用同一个近似球形的气球，在气嘴下面连接硬铁丝和重物，旁边固定刻度尺，用相机记录下落。读数追踪重物的同一个位置。我们保留气球的大小，只改变悬挂负载；画面根据教材数据重建，不是原始实验录像。
cues.en: To investigate drag against speed, first control other conditions. The textbook uses one roughly spherical balloon, a rigid wire and hanging load, a fixed ruler, and video of the fall. Track the same point on the load. This reconstruction keeps balloon size fixed while changing load; it is not the original experimental footage.

cues.title: 先找等间距帧
cues.caption: 相邻帧时间相同，位移相近才支持匀速判断。
cues.captionEn: Equal frame times and nearly equal displacements support steady motion.
cues.zh: 不能刚释放就把阻力当作重力。先检查相邻视频帧：它们的时间间隔相同，只有重物的位移也近似相同，才能把这段运动看作匀速。选择起止两帧，用总位移除以间隔数，得到平均每帧位移。本片把已选出的终端段逐帧重建；自由探索还可以切到加速反例，观察间距仍然增大的情况。
cues.en: Do not equate drag with weight immediately after release. Check successive frames: equal time intervals must also have nearly equal displacements before treating the segment as steady. Divide displacement between two selected frames by the number of intervals for mean displacement per frame. The scene reconstructs a selected terminal segment; exploration also offers an explicitly illustrative accelerating comparison.

cues.title: 改变负载重复记录
cues.caption: 七组总重力与每帧位移，来自教材原表。
cues.captionEn: Seven weights and frame displacements come from the textbook table.
cues.zh: 现在改变悬挂重物，用原气球重复实验，得到七组总重力和每帧位移。不同负载对应不同的匀速下落速率。教材表格没有给出视频帧率，所以横坐标保留厘米每T零，不能随意补一个帧率再写成米每秒。只要同一次研究使用相同帧间隔，这样的单位仍可以比较速率与阻力之间的关系。
cues.en: Change the hanging load and repeat with the same balloon, producing seven weight and frame-displacement pairs. Different loads yield different terminal speeds. The source table gives no frame rate, so the horizontal axis remains centimetres per T-zero. Do not invent a frame rate and report metres per second. A common frame interval still allows the speed–drag relationship to be compared.

cues.title: 让数据选择关系
cues.titleEn: Let the measurements choose a relation
cues.caption: 本组数据的过原点线性拟合明显优于平方拟合。
cues.captionEn: An origin-constrained linear fit describes this dataset much better than a quadratic fit.
cues.zh: 按教材忽略浮力的近似，匀速时阻力约等于总重力。把这七组点画出来，再分别拟合过原点的直线和平方曲线。直线与这些点更接近，均方根误差也更小。这支持教材在这组范围内得到的近似线性关系，而不是先认定阻力必须与速度平方成正比，再让数据迁就预设答案。
cues.en: Using the textbook’s approximation that neglects buoyancy, steady drag is approximately total weight. Plot the seven points and fit both a line and a quadratic through the origin. The line lies closer and has a smaller root-mean-square error. This supports the textbook’s approximate linear relation over this range; the data should not be forced to follow a preselected square-speed law.

cues.title: 检验遗漏的条件
cues.caption: 匀速、浮力、气球姿态与速度范围共同限制结论。
cues.captionEn: Steady motion, buoyancy, posture and speed range limit the inference.
cues.zh: 最后检查结论的边界。如果气球仍在加速，阻力就不能直接用重力代替；如果浮力不可忽略，匀速时阻力应等于重力减去浮力。画面给出一个假设浮力校正，让你看到同一组数据的纵坐标会怎样改变，但并不声称教材已经测出了这个浮力。气球姿态、形状和速度范围也需要控制，不能把七个点直接推广成所有球形物体的普遍定律。
cues.en: Finally examine the limits. If the balloon is accelerating, weight alone cannot determine drag. With appreciable buoyancy, steady drag equals weight minus buoyancy. A hypothetical correction shows how the same points shift vertically; it is not a claimed textbook buoyancy measurement. Posture, shape and speed range also matter. Seven measurements cannot establish a universal law for every spherical object.

cues.title: 用共振放大微弱响应
cues.titleEn: Amplify a weak response with resonance
cues.caption: 驱动频率接近共振频率时，金属棒的机械响应增强。
cues.captionEn: Resonance magnifies a weak drive.
cues.zh: 韦伯尝试用大型金属棒响应引力波引起的微小形变，再用传感器转成电信号。驱动频率接近棒的共振频率，响应会增强。形变在画面里极度放大，数值仍按小应变模型计算。这里是装置原理示意，并不表示这根棒实际收到了引力波。
cues.en: Weber used large metal bars to seek tiny deformations from gravitational waves, converting motion into an electrical signal. Response increases near mechanical resonance. The drawing greatly magnifies deformation while the readout uses a small-strain model. It illustrates the proposed detector principle, not an actual detection.

cues.title: 共同出现，还要独立复核
cues.caption: 早期韦伯棒的探测宣称，没有获得独立实验确认。
cues.captionEn: Weber’s claim was not independently confirmed.
cues.zh: 把远处两个探测器的信号放到一起，是排查局部干扰的方法之一，但相似波形本身还不够。下方两条曲线人为加入共同的阻尼振动和不同背景，用来说明比较方法。韦伯早年的引力波探测宣称没有被独立证实，不能把这段科学史讲成引力波已经被发现。
cues.en: Comparing separated detectors can help reject local disturbances, but similar traces are not enough. These curves deliberately combine a common damped oscillation with different backgrounds to explain the method. Independent experiments failed to confirm Weber’s early claims. This history must not be presented as an established gravitational-wave discovery.

cues.title: 把脉冲星当作计时信号
cues.titleEn: Use a pulsar as a timing signal
cues.caption: 轨道运动改变脉冲到达间隔，连续计时约束双星轨道。
cues.captionEn: Orbital motion changes pulse intervals.
cues.zh: 双星中的脉冲星提供反复到达的射电信号。它沿视线靠近和远离时，脉冲到达间隔发生周期变化。图中两星按偏心轨道绕质心运动，底部周期来自视线速度的低速多普勒近似。它只说明计时原理，真实脉冲星分析还包含传播、引力和参考系校正。
cues.en: A pulsar supplies repeated radio pulses. As it approaches and recedes along the line of sight, arrival intervals change periodically. The stars follow eccentric barycentric orbits and the plotted period uses a low-speed Doppler approximation. Real timing also corrects propagation, gravity and reference-frame effects.

cues.title: 每一圈略早，几十年会怎样？
cues.titleEn: A little earlier each orbit: what accumulates?
cues.caption: 周期略短，近星点更早到达。
cues.captionEn: Shorter periods make periastron arrive earlier.
cues.zh: 这些点来自已发表的脉冲星计时记录。横线表示轨道周期不变的参考。为什么测得的到达时刻越来越早？引力辐射带走能量，轨道结合得更紧，间距减小，每圈时间就更短。金色曲线是论文另外给出的广义相对论预测。先想一想，后来的记录应该靠近哪条线？现在揭开原有的后段观测点。这里累计提前约一分钟，并不是每圈的周期缩短了一分钟。它来自许多次很小的提前，是射电计时提供的间接证据。
cues.en: These are published pulsar timing records. The horizontal reference assumes an unchanged orbital period. Why do arrivals become earlier? Radiation carries away energy, leaving a more tightly bound, smaller orbit with a shorter period. The gold line is the paper’s separately published general-relativity prediction. Which line should the later records approach? Now reveal those original observations. About a minute of accumulated early arrival does not mean that each orbit became a minute shorter. Many tiny advances add up. Radio timing supplies indirect evidence.

cues.title: 跟光走一趟，再看合成
cues.titleEn: Follow the round trip, then combine the fields
cues.caption: 光程差改变回程相位，合成光场决定读出。
cues.captionEn: Path → phase → combined field → power.
cues.zh: 先跟着同一束光：分成两路，遇到端镜返回，再汇合到探测器。这里用较大的教学位移和明确的偏置工作点，把原理看清。一臂伸长，另一臂缩短，往返光程不同，两路返回光的相位就错开。合成的波改变，探测器的光强也改变。先预测：如果两臂一起等量伸长呢？相位一起变，相对差不变，差分信号为零。反转差分位移，偏置读出的变化也反向。回到真实量级，四千米光臂的差分只有四阿米，相位变化约四点七二乘十的负十一次方弧度。真实LIGO还需要光学腔、反馈和校准。
cues.en: Follow one beam: split it, reflect both parts from the end mirrors, then recombine them at the detector. Larger teaching displacements and an explicit biased operating point make the mechanism visible. Opposite arm changes alter round-trip path difference, shifting the returning phases. Their summed field changes the detected power. Predict what happens if both arms lengthen equally. Both phases change together: their difference, and the differential signal, stay unchanged. Reverse the differential motion and the biased signal reverses. At the physical scale, four-kilometre arms differ by just four attometres, a phase change of roughly four-point-seven-two times ten to the minus eleven radians. Real LIGO adds optical cavities, feedback and calibration.

cues.title: 两站真实记录，保留各自的噪声
cues.titleEn: Two real records, with their independent noise
cues.caption: 两站记录可比较，但不是同一条理论曲线的复制。
cues.captionEn: Two real signals retain different noise.
cues.zh: 现在看二零一五年九月十四日的真实记录，已按论文的方法滤波。两站的波形相近，细小噪声却各不相同。为了叠放比较，官方图把汉福德记录前移七毫秒，并按两站的相对朝向反号。观察前后几个周期：后面的间隔更短。致密双星失去轨道能量，间距减小、绕转加快，旋近的引力波频率随之上升。这里的轨道模型用于解释，不是重新拟合事件。回到记录，利文斯顿先收到信号；论文测得的时差约六点九毫秒。两站一致性还要结合仪器检查和噪声统计，不能只凭一段相似波形宣布发现。
cues.en: Now inspect the actual records from September fourteenth, twenty fifteen, filtered as in the paper. Similar waveforms retain different noise. For comparison, the official plot moves Hanford’s record seven milliseconds earlier and reverses its polarity for the detectors’ relative orientation. Compare early and late cycles: the later spacing is shorter. A compact binary loses orbital energy, moves closer and orbits faster, increasing the inspiral-wave frequency. This separate orbit model explains the trend; it does not refit the event. Back in the records, Livingston received the signal first. The paper reports a delay of about six-point-nine milliseconds. Consistency also needs instrument checks and noise statistics; similar traces alone do not establish a discovery.

cues.title: 先看无遮罩的响应
cues.caption: 带电球靠近，验电器内部电荷重新分布。
cues.captionEn: As the sphere approaches, charge redistributes within the detector.
cues.zh: 先不放网罩，让同一个带电金属球逐渐靠近验电器，保持不接触。箔片张开，是因为外部电场使验电器内部电荷重新分布。这个响应是接下来比较网罩作用的参照；不是金属球把电荷直接送进了验电器。
cues.en: First leave the detector uncovered. Bring the same charged sphere closer without contact. The leaves open because the external field redistributes charge within the electroscope. This is the reference for the cage comparison; the source sphere has not directly transferred charge into the detector.

cues.title: 罩上金属网
cues.caption: 表面电荷重排，使内部的外加场被抵消。
cues.captionEn: Redistributed surface charge cancels the applied field inside.
cues.zh: 保持带电球和验电器不变，罩上金属网。现在自由电荷先在网罩表面重新分布，它们产生的场抵消内部的外加电场，箔片保持闭合。箭头显示外部电场依然存在，所以屏蔽不是让外面的电消失。模型把足够细的网近似成闭合导体壳，网孔附近的细节没有计算。
cues.en: Keep the source and detector unchanged and add the metal mesh. Free charge redistributes on its surface, canceling the applied field inside, so the leaves stay closed. Field arrows still exist outside: shielding does not erase the external electricity. The model approximates a sufficiently fine mesh by a closed conductor and omits details near individual holes.

cues.title: 形状相同还不够
cues.caption: 绝缘网缺少自由电荷重排，不能提供同样的屏蔽。
cues.captionEn: An insulating mesh cannot provide the same free-charge redistribution.
cues.zh: 换成相同外形的绝缘网，箔片又张开了。网的外形和位置都相似，但它没有金属中能重新分布的自由电荷。再换回金属网，内部响应恢复到闭合。这个对照指出了原因：起作用的是导体的电学性质，不能只看有没有罩住。
cues.en: Replace the cage with an insulating mesh of the same shape. The leaves open again. Geometry and position are similar, but the freely redistributing charges of a metal are absent. Switching back to metal closes the detector. The comparison identifies the cause: conducting behavior matters, not simply whether something surrounds the detector.

cues.title: 烟先进入瓶内
cues.caption: 未起电时，烟粒随空气运动。
cues.captionEn: Before energizing, smoke follows the air.
cues.zh: 换一套装置：无底塑料瓶里，锯齿电极和金属收集片彼此分开，下面的蚊香持续产生烟。先不摇动起电机，烟粒随空气进入并悬浮。图中的颗粒已经放大，只代表可追踪的烟粒，不是真实烟粒的尺寸和数量。
cues.en: Now use a different apparatus. A serrated electrode and collecting plate are separated inside a bottomless plastic bottle, while an incense coil supplies smoke below. Before the generator is operated, particles enter with the air and remain suspended. The enlarged dots are representative traceable particles, not their actual size or count.

cues.title: 荷电后向收集片迁移
cues.titleEn: Charge and migrate to the collector
cues.caption: 负烟粒受力方向与电场方向相反。
cues.captionEn: Negative particles move opposite the field direction.
cues.zh: 摇动起电机，让锯条接负极、金属片接正极。锯齿尖端附近场强较大，有利于形成使烟粒荷电的放电过程。带负电的烟粒受到指向正收集片的电场力，逐渐迁移并附着在片上。追踪同一个颗粒，会看到它停在收集片上，而不是凭空消失。
cues.en: Operate the generator with the serrated electrode negative and plate positive. The stronger field near sharp tips supports the discharge that charges smoke. Negative particles feel force toward the positive collector, migrate and attach. Track one particle: it stops on the plate instead of disappearing from the model.

cues.title: 停止起电后再看
cues.caption: 新烟仍进入，先前收集的烟粒仍留在片上。
cues.captionEn: New smoke continues entering while earlier particles remain collected.
cues.zh: 停止起电，电迁移不再继续，但蚊香还在供烟，悬浮烟粒重新增多。先前沉积的颗粒仍保留在收集片上。这个过程说明，静电除尘把颗粒从空气转移到表面；它没有消灭物质，也不能据这幅简化图给出真实设备的收集效率。
cues.en: Stop energizing the electrodes. Electrical migration ends, but the coil keeps supplying smoke and suspended particles accumulate again. Earlier deposits remain on the collector. Electrostatic precipitation transfers particles from air to a surface; it does not destroy matter, and this simplified diagram does not predict a real device’s collection efficiency.

cues.title: 同一谱线图样，为什么一起变长？
cues.titleEn: Why does one line pattern stretch together?
cues.caption: 同一比例，先预测第三条线。
cues.captionEn: One ratio predicts the third line.
cues.zh: 实验室里的这组三条谱线，是同一种原子的指纹。教学生成的星系光谱里，前两条波长都变成原来的1.05倍。第三条应该在哪里？它也要乘同一个比例，出现在约689纳米，而不是简单加上同一段波长。再盯住这几个波峰：空间尺度增长，波峰间距随之变大，当地测得的光速仍是光速。单独的红移也可能包含特有运动；还需要另一类证据：距离。
cues.en: The laboratory pattern has three lines: an atomic fingerprint. In this illustrative galaxy spectrum, the first two wavelengths are each one point zero five times their laboratory values. Where should the third appear? Apply the same ratio: about six hundred and eighty-nine nanometres, not the same additive shift. Now follow the crests. As the scale grows, their separation increases while local light speed stays constant. A redshift can also include peculiar motion. We need another kind of evidence: distance.

cues.title: 为什么越远，距离增加越快？
cues.titleEn: Why does a larger distance grow faster?
cues.caption: 记录不动；尺度增长解释距离增量。
cues.captionEn: Fixed records; growing scale explains the increments.
cues.zh: 这24个点来自哈勃1929年的原表：距离和径向速度分别估计、测量。换一条候选线，记录不跟着移动。正比关系描述了总体趋势，散布和负速度仍然保留；这是旧距离尺度，也没有做太阳运动修正。现在换成均匀膨胀模型。相同尺度变化，让原本更远的星系增加更多距离。换一颗星系作原点，关系依旧。于是同一时刻，距离加倍会怎样？膨胀贡献的速度也加倍。这就是速度等于H乘距离，不是地球占据特殊中心。
cues.en: These twenty-four points are from Hubble’s original nineteen twenty-nine table: estimated distances and measured radial velocities. Change the candidate line; the records stay put. A proportional relation describes the broad trend, with scatter and negative velocities retained. This historical distance scale has no solar-motion correction applied here. Now consider uniform expansion. The same scale change adds more distance to an initially larger separation. Choose another origin: the relation survives. At the same epoch, what happens at twice the distance? The expansion contribution doubles. That is H times distance, without a privileged Earth-centered origin.

cues.title: 信号来自天空，还是器材？
cues.caption: 共用接收机比较，再检查大气路径。
cues.captionEn: Compare through one receiver; check the air path.
cues.zh: 天空输入沿天线和开关进入接收机。现在切换到已知的冷负载：仍是同一台接收机，这个比较帮助校准系统。天空读数还包含大气和天线自身的贡献。把仰角放低，同样厚度的大气就有更长的穿行路径，读数会增大。图中的非天顶值是气层模型；1965年天顶方向6.7开尔文的记录不变。要解释天空，不能只看一个总数。
cues.en: Trace the sky input through the horn and selector into the receiver. Switch to a known cold reference: it uses that same receiver, helping calibrate the system. The sky reading still includes atmospheric and antenna contributions. Lower the elevation. The same atmospheric depth now gives a longer path and a larger reading. The non-zenith values shown here are an airmass model; the nineteen sixty-five zenith record remains six point seven kelvin. One total is not yet an explanation.

cues.title: 扣除已知来源，还剩什么？
cues.caption: 单频余量，还要接受整个频谱的检验。
cues.captionEn: A one-frequency excess needs a spectrum test.
cues.zh: 原论文在4.08吉赫兹记录了6.7开尔文。扣去大气2.3，再扣天线和旁瓣0.9，还剩多少？3.5开尔文，报告的不确定度是正负1.0。这是等效天线噪声温度，不是后来精确的背景温度。单一频率还不能证明黑体谱。后来FIRAS测量了多个频率。这里保留43行处理数据和发表残差：档案频谱由2.725开尔文参考黑体加残差组成，不能拿它再独立发现同一个温度。放大残差，可以看见并非完美零值的记录。
cues.en: At four point zero eight gigahertz, the original total was six point seven kelvin. Remove two point three for atmosphere and zero point nine for antenna and backlobes. What remains? Three point five kelvin, with a reported uncertainty of one kelvin. This is antenna noise temperature, not the later precise background temperature. One frequency cannot establish a blackbody spectrum. FIRAS later measured many frequencies. These forty-three processed rows preserve the published residuals. The archive spectrum is a two point seven two five kelvin reference plus residuals, not a new independent temperature discovery. Magnify the residuals: they are not all zero.

cues.title: 热辐射怎样变成冷微波？
cues.titleEn: How does thermal radiation become cold microwaves?
cues.caption: 膨胀拉长波长，黑体温度随之降低。
cues.captionEn: Longer wavelengths accompany a colder blackbody.
cues.zh: 背景为什么指向更热的过去？跟住同一光波：膨胀拉长波长，降低单个光子的能量，也稀释单位体积里的光子。热辐射保持黑体形状，温度按尺度的倒数变化。先从今天约2.725开尔文出发，预测一个假想的进一步膨胀：尺度加倍，波长和温度各会怎样？波长加倍，温度减半，成为1.3625开尔文。曲线的峰向低频移动，也确实变矮，没有偷偷重新放大。最后回到今天：平均温度之上还有微开尔文级的小起伏。这里的全天图是合成示意，颜色经过放大，不是实测地图。
cues.en: Why does this background point to a hotter past? Follow the same light wave. Expansion lengthens its wavelength, lowers each photon’s energy, and dilutes the photon number per volume. Thermal radiation retains a blackbody shape, with temperature inversely proportional to scale. Starting from today’s approximate two point seven two five kelvin reference, predict a hypothetical further doubling of scale. What happens to wavelength and temperature? Wavelength doubles and temperature halves, to one point three six two five kelvin. The peak moves to lower frequency and really gets smaller; the curve is not renormalized. Finally return to today. Tiny microkelvin variations sit above the mean. This amplified-color sky is synthetic, not a measured map.

cues.title: 从弧形轨道滚出
cues.titleEn: Roll out of a curved track
cues.caption: 出口后的印迹沿该点切线，而不是沿半径。
cues.captionEn: The trace beyond the exit follows the tangent, not the radius.
cues.zh: 在白纸上摆好分段弧形轨道，让沾有红色印泥的钢球从一端滚入。轨道持续改变小球的速度方向。到了出口，约束消失，水平面上又没有显著阻力，球便沿离开瞬间的速度方向前进。红色印迹把这个方向留下来，它与出口处的曲线相切，并不朝向圆心或沿半径飞出。
cues.en: Place a segmented curved track on paper and roll an inked steel ball into it. The track continually changes velocity direction. At the exit, constraint ends; with negligible horizontal resistance the ball continues with its departure velocity. The red trace preserves that direction: tangent to the curve at the exit, rather than toward the centre or radially outward.

cues.title: 拆去一段再比较
cues.caption: 新出口的位置改变，切线方向随之改变。
cues.captionEn: A new exit location has a new tangent direction.
cues.zh: 拆去最后一段轨道，让钢球更早离开。球的速率保持同样的示例值，出口后的直线方向却改变了。比较两次记录，决定飞出方向的是离开那一点的瞬时速度。轨迹是许多位置的集合，速度则是每一点的局部方向；要理解曲线运动，需要沿着轨迹逐点看，而不是把整条弯道当成一个方向。
cues.en: Remove the final segment so the ball leaves earlier. Its example speed stays the same, but its outgoing straight-line direction changes. Departure is determined by instantaneous velocity at that particular point. A trajectory collects many positions, while velocity has a local direction at each. Follow the curve point by point rather than assigning one direction to the whole bend.

cues.title: 磁铁放在正前方
cues.caption: 力与速度共线，速度大小改变，路径仍直。
cues.captionEn: Collinear force changes speed while the path remains straight.
cues.zh: 让钢球沿水平面运动，把磁铁放在它运动路线的正前方。磁力沿前进方向拉动钢球，球越来越快，但轨迹仍然是一条直线。可见，有力、有加速度，并不自动意味着轨迹弯曲。判断转弯时，还要看这个力相对于当前速度的方向，而不只是判断合力是否为零。
cues.en: Roll the steel ball horizontally and place the magnet directly ahead. Attraction acts along its forward motion, increasing speed while the path stays straight. A force and acceleration do not automatically imply a curved trajectory. To judge turning, compare force direction with the current velocity, rather than merely asking whether net force is zero.

cues.title: 把磁铁移到旁边
cues.titleEn: Move the magnet to the side
cues.caption: 力有垂直于速度的分量，速度方向改变。
cues.captionEn: A component perpendicular to velocity changes its direction.
cues.zh: 把磁铁移到旁边，钢球逐渐偏离原来的直线。速度方向沿当前轨迹，合力方向由磁铁的作用决定，二者不在同一条直线上。合力中垂直于速度的部分改变速度方向，轨迹因此弯曲。本模型从力积分出运动，而不是预先画好一条曲线让球照着走；接近磁铁时停止展示，避免把远场近似用于吸附碰撞。
cues.en: Move the magnet aside and the ball bends away from its original line. Velocity follows the local trajectory; force follows the magnetic interaction, so they are not collinear. The perpendicular force component changes velocity direction. The model integrates motion from force rather than prescribing a drawn path. It stops near the magnet before its far-field approximation would be used for capture or collision.

cues.title: 用尾翼显示方向
cues.titleEn: Use a tail to reveal direction
cues.caption: 飞镖上升与下降时，杆轴都近似沿轨迹切线。
cues.captionEn: During ascent and descent, the shaft approximately follows the trajectory tangent.
cues.zh: 教材还提出用带铁钉和尾翼的细杆做飞镖，观察曲线运动的速度方向。这里用模型观察同一原理：尾翼使杆轴趋向对齐运动方向，上升时指向斜上方，越过最高点后逐渐指向斜下方。重力一直向下，飞镖却不会全程竖直朝下；速度方向和合力方向是两个不同的量。
cues.en: The textbook suggests a shaft with a nail and tail fins to reveal velocity direction. In this model, tail stabilization aligns the shaft approximately with motion: upward during ascent, then progressively downward after the apex. Gravity always points down, but the dart does not point straight down throughout. Velocity and net-force direction are distinct quantities.

cues.title: 改变投射角再观察
cues.titleEn: Change launch angle and observe again
cues.caption: 轨迹改变，瞬时速度沿切线这一点不变。
cues.captionEn: The trajectory changes; the tangent-velocity relationship does not.
cues.zh: 把投射角调大，飞镖上升得更高，最高点和落地位置都改变。暂停在任意一点，看杆轴与附近轨迹的关系。模型把尾翼对齐视为快速完成，忽略真实空气动力造成的转动滞后；落地时以尖端首次接触地面为止。即使改变发射条件，瞬时速度沿轨迹切线这个结论仍然适用。
cues.en: Increase launch angle. The dart rises higher and its apex and landing position change. Pause anywhere to compare its shaft with the nearby path. Orientation assumes rapid tail stabilization and omits real aerodynamic angular lag. Flight ends at first tip contact with the ground. Changing launch conditions does not alter the tangent relationship of instantaneous velocity.

cues.title: 快速压缩气体
cues.caption: 来不及向外传热，外界做功使气体升温。
cues.captionEn: With little time for heat loss, work raises gas temperature.
cues.zh: 迅速压下引火仪的活塞，气体体积减小。来不及向外传热时，外界做功主要增加气体内能，温度迅速升高，底部少量易燃物可能被点燃。这里升温的起因是压缩做功，不是从外部火焰传热。
cues.en: Push the fire-piston plunger rapidly. Gas volume decreases. With little time for heat to escape, work increases internal energy and temperature can become high enough to ignite the small material at the bottom. Compression, not an external flame, causes the initial heating.

cues.title: 同样压缩，改变传热条件
cues.titleEn: Compress with time for heat exchange
cues.caption: 缓慢等温近似中，做功的能量传给环境。
cues.captionEn: In the slow isothermal limit, work is transferred to the surroundings as heat.
cues.zh: 用相同的体积变化作缓慢压缩对照。若气体能充分与环境交换热量，温度就近似不变。外界仍然做了功，但这些能量传给环境，不能把所有压缩都看成同样的绝热升温。
cues.en: Compare the same volume change performed slowly. If the gas exchanges heat sufficiently with its surroundings, temperature stays nearly constant. Work is still done, but that energy leaves as heat. Not every compression produces the same adiabatic temperature rise.

cues.title: 重物下降带动叶片
cues.caption: 重力势能经搅拌转为水与容器的内能。
cues.captionEn: Potential energy becomes internal energy through stirring.
cues.zh: 跟随两侧重物和连接绳：重物下降，带动中间轴与水中的叶片转动。流体中的运动逐渐耗散，水与杯升温。理想隔热时，减少的重力势能等于这套量热系统增加的内能。
cues.en: Follow the two weights and ropes. Their descent turns the central shaft and submerged paddles. Fluid motion dissipates and warms water and cup. In the ideal insulated model, lost gravitational potential energy equals the calorimeter’s internal-energy increase.

cues.title: 换质量和高度，保持功相同
cues.titleEn: Change mass and height, retain equal work
cues.caption: 质量减半、落高加倍，最终温升相同。
cues.captionEn: Half the mass and twice the drop give the same final rise.
cues.zh: 把重物总质量减半，同时把下降高度加倍。运动路程改变了，但质量乘重力加速度再乘高度保持相同。最终温升也相同，显示状态变化取决于传入的功，而不是选用了哪一组质量和高度。
cues.en: Halve the total falling mass and double its descent. The motion changes, but mass times gravity times height stays equal. The same final temperature rise shows that the energy delivered matters, not the particular mass and height combination.

cues.title: 把机械功先转为电功
cues.titleEn: Convert mechanical work into electrical work
cues.caption: 重物驱动发电机，闭合电路中的电阻丝加热水。
cues.captionEn: The weight drives a generator and the closed heater circuit warms water.
cues.zh: 现在保留下降重物，但让它带动发电机。沿两根导线追踪闭合电路，电流通过浸在水里的电阻丝，把能量传入量热系统。理想情况下，同样的重力势能损失仍对应同样的最终温升。
cues.en: Keep the falling weight, but let it drive a generator. Trace the two wires through a closed circuit and the immersed resistor. Electrical work transfers energy to the calorimeter. Ideally, the same potential-energy loss gives the same final temperature rise.

cues.title: 电流与时间可以不同
cues.caption: 较小电流持续更久，也能传入相同电能。
cues.captionEn: A smaller current for longer can deliver equal electrical energy.
cues.zh: 让同一重物用更长时间下降。发电功率降低，电流也较小，但通电时间更长。比较电流平方乘电阻再乘时间，累计电能相同，最终温升仍相同；真实损耗会使实验偏离这个理想结果。
cues.en: Let the same weight descend more slowly. Generator power and current decrease, but current flows longer. Current squared times resistance times duration gives the same accumulated energy and final temperature rise. Real losses can cause departures from this ideal comparison.

cues.title: 先准备湿润的压缩空气
cues.caption: 少量水提供水汽，瓶中压强升高。
cues.captionEn: A little water supplies vapor while pressure rises.
cues.zh: 透明瓶中保留少量水，使空气含有水汽。通过带气门的塞子向瓶内打气，压强升高。这里把较慢准备阶段近似看作室温，随后观察短时间释放时会发生什么。
cues.en: Leave a little water in the transparent bottle to moisten its air. Pump through the valve in the stopper to raise pressure. The slower preparation stage is approximated at room temperature; next observe a rapid release.

cues.title: 塞子跳出，瓶内起雾
cues.titleEn: The stopper leaves and fog forms
cues.caption: 快速降压使剩余气体降温，水汽可凝结成小滴。
cues.captionEn: Rapid blowdown cools the remaining gas and can condense vapor.
cues.zh: 塞子跳出后，气体快速排出，剩余气体温度降低。较冷空气容纳的饱和水汽压更低，水汽可能凝结成细小液滴，形成白雾。瓶子已经是开口系统，不能还把气体质量当成不变。
cues.en: When the stopper leaves, gas escapes rapidly and the remaining gas cools. Saturation vapor pressure falls, allowing vapor to condense into fine droplets and form fog. The bottle is now an open system; its gas mass is not constant.

cues.title: 炮筒加工持续生热
cues.caption: 接触处摩擦把外界机械功转为内能。
cues.captionEn: Contact friction converts supplied mechanical work into internal energy.
cues.zh: 伦福德观察炮筒加工时，注意到摩擦能使周围的水明显升温。剖面中追踪固定刀具与转动炮筒的接触位置。持续输入的机械功在接触处转为内能，随后传给周围的金属与水。
cues.en: Rumford observed water warming during cannon boring. In the cutaway, track contact between the fixed tool and rotating barrel. Continuing mechanical work becomes internal energy at the contact, then spreads into surrounding metal and water.

cues.title: 刀具变钝，仍然生热
cues.titleEn: A blunt tool still produces heat
cues.caption: 热量不只来自切下的碎屑，持续做功能持续供能。
cues.captionEn: Heating is not limited to removed chips; continued work supplies energy.
cues.zh: 刀具变钝、切下的碎屑减少时，摩擦仍能不断生热。这个观察挑战了把热看作有限储存流质的解释。画面继续累计机械功，水达到沸点后，后续能量主要用于汽化，而不是无限升温。
cues.en: Even with a blunt tool producing fewer chips, friction continues heating. That challenged the idea of heat as a finite stored fluid. The model keeps accumulating mechanical work; after water reaches its boiling point, further energy mainly drives vaporization instead of unlimited temperature rise.

cues.title: 先观察竖直上升
cues.caption: 先加速，再接近稳定上升。
cues.captionEn: Rise accelerates, then settles.
cues.zh: 把玻璃管注满清水，放入红蜡块，用橡胶塞封好开口，再把管倒置。蜡的密度略小于水，蜡块会向上运动。刚开始它会加速，随后水的阻力增大，上升逐渐接近匀速。教材的运动合成分析从这个稳定阶段开始，不能把整个倒置和启动过程都当成匀速运动。
cues.en: Fill the tube with water, insert the red wax float, seal the opening, and invert it. Wax is slightly less dense than water, so it rises. Initially it accelerates; growing water resistance makes its rise approach a steady speed. The textbook’s composition analysis begins in that steady regime, not during the whole inversion and startup process.

cues.title: 边上升边匀速移管
cues.titleEn: Translate the tube while the wax rises
cues.caption: 两个方向，使用同一个时间。
cues.captionEn: Both components share one time.
cues.zh: 蜡块稳定上升时，把玻璃管紧贴黑板向右匀速移动。对着黑板看，蜡块既向右又向上。相同一秒内，水平和竖直方向各增加固定的位移，两者必须使用同一个时间。把每秒的位置点连接起来，会得到一条斜直线。分运动同时发生，不是先横着走，再竖着走。
cues.en: While the wax rises steadily, move the tube right at constant speed against the board. Relative to the board, the wax moves both right and up. Each second adds fixed horizontal and vertical displacements using the same elapsed time. Successive positions form a straight diagonal. Components happen simultaneously, not as a horizontal move followed by a vertical one.

cues.title: 合成位移和速度
cues.caption: 分速度比例不变，轨迹为直线。
cues.captionEn: Fixed component ratio: straight path.
cues.zh: 从原点到蜡块的位置，可以沿水平和竖直方向作投影。水平位移等于水平速度乘时间，竖直位移等于上升速度乘同一个时间。速度也按矢量合成，合速度大小由两个分速度的平方和开方得到。只要两个分速度都保持不变，比例就不变，所以轨迹方向保持不变，合运动也是匀速直线运动。
cues.en: Project the wax position onto the two axes. Horizontal displacement is horizontal velocity times time; vertical displacement is rise velocity times the same time. Velocities also add as vectors, with combined magnitude from the square root of the sum of their squares. Fixed components keep their ratio and direction fixed, producing uniform straight-line motion.

cues.title: 改成横向匀加速
cues.caption: 竖直等间隔，水平间隔增大。
cues.captionEn: Equal rise; growing horizontal gaps.
cues.zh: 现在按教材的理想条件，保持蜡块竖直上升速度不变，让玻璃管从静止开始向右匀加速移动。每秒上升的距离相同，水平位移却依次增大。图上采用练习中的数据：每秒上升十厘米，水平每秒位移依次是四、十二、二十、二十八厘米。合运动不再沿直线，但同一时刻分运动相加的方法仍然成立。
cues.en: Under the textbook’s ideal conditions, keep vertical rise speed fixed and accelerate the tube right from rest. Each second gives the same rise but increasing horizontal travel. This example matches the exercise: ten centimetres upward each second and horizontal increments of four, twelve, twenty and twenty-eight centimetres. The combined path curves, while simultaneous component addition remains valid.

cues.title: 导线使磁针偏转
cues.caption: 通电前指南北，通电后跟随合场。
cues.captionEn: Before current it points north–south; afterward it follows the combined field.
cues.zh: 先让直导线沿南北方向，放在小磁针上方。未通电时，小磁针沿地磁场方向；闭合电路后，它向一侧偏转。导线没有碰到磁针，偏转来自电流产生的磁场。画面保留地磁场，所以磁针并不一定恰好转过九十度。
cues.en: Place a north–south wire above a compass. Without current, the needle follows Earth’s field. Closing the circuit deflects it to one side. The wire does not touch the needle: current produces the magnetic influence. Earth’s field remains in the model, so the needle need not turn exactly ninety degrees.

cues.title: 断电，再反向通电
cues.caption: 电流方向反转，磁针向另一侧偏转。
cues.captionEn: Reversing current deflects the needle to the other side.
cues.zh: 先断开电路，磁针回到地磁场方向。再反接电源，让导线中的电流反向，磁针转向另一侧。这一对照说明，偏转不是导线本身的位置造成的，而与电流有关。自由探索中还可以增大导线高度，观察同样电流的影响为什么变弱。
cues.en: Open the circuit and the compass returns to Earth’s field direction. Reverse the source connection and current, and the needle deflects to the other side. The comparison links the effect to current rather than the wire’s mere presence. In exploration, raise the wire and observe why the same current has a weaker influence.

cues.title: 条形磁体上的铁屑
cues.caption: 排列给出轴线，小磁针给出有向信息。
cues.captionEn: Filings give local axes; a compass supplies directional information.
cues.zh: 换到撒有细铁屑的观察平面。轻敲后，铁屑沿局部磁场排列，组成条形磁体周围的纹理。但一条铁屑没有标出哪个方向是北。加入小磁针，棕色的北极端才告诉我们磁场方向。这里显示的是磁体外部的场。
cues.en: Now examine a plane sprinkled with iron filings. Tapping lets the filings align with local field axes around the bar magnet. A filing alone does not label which way is north. A small compass adds that information through its brown north tip. This view samples the field outside the magnet.

cues.title: 蹄形磁体的间隙
cues.caption: 把两极靠近，观察间隙中的场。
cues.captionEn: Bring the poles near each other and inspect their gap.
cues.zh: 蹄形磁体把两极放得较近。观察开口之间的铁屑与小磁针，磁场从北极一侧指向南极一侧。装置形状变了，探测方法没有变。图中偶极分布只用来表现整体方向，不把示意数值当成实际磁体的测量结果。
cues.en: A horseshoe magnet brings its poles closer. Filings and a compass show the field across the opening directed from the north pole toward the south. The source shape changes, but the probing method remains. The dipole model illustrates the overall pattern; its values are not measurements of a real magnet.

cues.title: 直导线周围的环绕
cues.caption: 反向电流使方向反转，环绕形状保留。
cues.captionEn: Current reversal reverses direction while preserving the circular pattern.
cues.zh: 让直导线垂直穿过观察平面。铁屑沿同心圆的切线排列，小磁针沿圆周指向。圆点表示电流朝向我们，叉号表示背向我们。反向电流后，磁针北极反转，但铁屑的排列轴线几乎不变。这就是为什么判断方向还需要小磁针或右手定则。
cues.en: Pass a straight wire perpendicularly through the observation plane. Filings align tangentially to circles and the compass points around them. A dot means current toward us; a cross means away. Reverse current: the compass north end reverses, while filing axes remain almost unchanged. Direction therefore needs a compass or the right-hand rule.

cues.title: 环形电流的轴线
cues.titleEn: The axis of a current loop
cues.caption: 观察切面经过线圈轴线，电流方向决定轴向磁场。
cues.captionEn: The section contains the loop axis; current determines the axial field.
cues.zh: 现在弯成一个圆环，观察平面经过圆环轴线。圆点和叉号表示导线穿过这个切面的两处方向。各段电流的磁场在轴线上相加，形成清晰的轴向方向；外部又绕回。线圈形状和场的计算来自同一几何，不是另外画一组装饰曲线。
cues.en: Bend the wire into a loop and observe a plane containing its axis. Dot and cross mark the two current directions through that section. Fields from the wire segments add along the axis and return around the outside. The source geometry and field calculation agree; the pattern is not a separate decorative set of curves.

cues.title: 多匝电流的叠加
cues.caption: 多匝线圈的场叠加，外部形态类似条形磁体。
cues.captionEn: Several turns superpose into an external pattern resembling a bar magnet.
cues.zh: 把多个环形电流沿轴线排在一起，就得到螺线管的近似模型。内部各匝贡献沿相近方向叠加，外部场的整体形态像条形磁体。反向电流，轴向磁场也反转。这里把螺旋导线近似成七个圆环，保留有限长度的边缘变化，并没有把整个内部都强行设成完全均匀。
cues.en: Arrange current loops along one axis to approximate a solenoid. Their interior contributions reinforce one another, while the external pattern resembles a bar magnet. Reverse current and the axial field reverses too. Seven circular turns approximate the helical wire, retaining finite-length edge variation rather than imposing a perfectly uniform field everywhere inside.

cues.title: 描边界，确定入射光线
cues.titleEn: Trace the faces and incident ray
cues.caption: 两个针的位置确定入射方向，玻璃边界确定入射点。
cues.captionEn: Two pins set the incident direction and the block face sets the entry point.
cues.zh: 在纸上描出玻璃砖的两条平行边，在一侧插入A、B两根针。两针连线与第一条边相交，确定入射点。俯视图里的光线用于分析，不意味着空气中能直接看见这束光。实验应以针的位置和观察到的针像为依据，避免挪动玻璃砖后丢失原来的边界。
cues.en: Trace both parallel faces on paper and place pins A and B on one side. Their line meets the first face at the entry point. The top-view ray is an analysis aid, not visible light in air. The experiment relies on pin positions and images; moving the block would lose the traced boundaries.

cues.title: 让第三根针遮住前面的针像
cues.titleEn: Align the third pin with the earlier images
cues.caption: C针偏离时，眼端视图中不能完全重合。
cues.captionEn: An offset pin C fails to overlap the earlier images in the eye view.
cues.zh: 从另一侧观察，让第三根针C遮住前面的针像，再用D针确定出射方向。右上角把眼端的对准状态展开，C的横向偏离逐渐减小，直到重合。模型保留固定眼位，投影偏差由C针的实际位置算出；真实操作还要轻移视线排查视差，并让针保持竖直。
cues.en: From the other side, align pin C with the earlier images and use D to establish the outgoing direction. The eye-view inset shows the error shrinking as C moves into alignment. The fixed-eye model calculates its angular offset from position. Real alignment also checks parallax with small eye movements and keeps pins vertical.

cues.title: 连接两个界面上的交点
cues.titleEn: Connect the intersections on both faces
cues.caption: 砖内光线由入射点与出射点连接，再测角求折射率。
cues.captionEn: Connect the entry and exit points, then measure angles to infer index.
cues.zh: 入射线和出射线分别与玻璃边界相交，连接这两个点，重建砖内光线。角度都从法线量起，用入射角正弦除以折射角正弦求折射率。改变入射角，光路侧移变化，但同一玻璃的推算折射率不变。这里没有随机测量误差，不能把显示的小数位当成实验精度。
cues.en: Intersect the incoming and outgoing lines with their faces and connect those points to reconstruct the internal ray. Measure both angles from the normal and divide their sines. Changing incidence changes lateral displacement while the inferred index stays fixed. The model has no random measurement error; displayed decimals are not experimental precision.

cues.title: 沿圆柱杯的曲面追踪光线
cues.titleEn: Trace rays through curved cup interfaces
cues.caption: 水、玻璃与空气的两个弯曲界面共同改变出射方向。
cues.captionEn: Curved water–glass and glass–air interfaces jointly change the outgoing direction.
cues.zh: 水平看水中的筷子，需要考虑杯子的弯曲侧壁。上方取水平横截面，从筷子上的一点发出两条光线，依次穿过水到玻璃、玻璃到空气的界面，最后进入观察者附近。虚线是出射光的反向延长，它们交会的位置给出这小束光对应的虚像。
cues.en: A horizontal view through a cup must account for its curved sidewall. The upper horizontal slice traces two rays from one chopstick point through water–glass and glass–air interfaces to the observer. Dashed backward extensions locate the virtual image associated with this small ray bundle.

cues.title: 移动筷子，看侧移与宽度一起变化
cues.titleEn: Move the chopstick and compare shift with width
cues.caption: 筷子两侧边缘分别成像，得到侧移和局部放大。
cues.captionEn: Images of both edges determine displacement and local magnification.
cues.zh: 分别追踪筷子两侧边缘，再比较它们在观察方向上的间隔，就得到下方看起来的宽度。移动筷子，侧移和放大一起变化，而不是把原来的图形随意拉宽。这里用理想同心圆柱杯壁和窄观察光束，忽略色散、散射、杯口与底部；较大视场会出现不能用单一像点描述的像差。
cues.en: Trace both chopstick edges and compare their separation in the viewing direction. Moving the chopstick changes apparent displacement and width together rather than stretching an image arbitrarily. The model uses concentric cylindrical walls and a narrow bundle, omitting dispersion, scattering, rim and base. Wider fields introduce aberrations beyond one image point.

cues.title: 反向延长出射光，找到浅一些的像
cues.titleEn: Extend outgoing rays backward to find a shallower image
cues.caption: 透过玻璃看到的字，似乎比真实位置更靠近上表面。
cues.captionEn: Text seen through glass appears closer to the upper surface.
cues.zh: 把厚玻璃板压在字上，从上方看。来自字的两条光在上表面折射，进入空气后离法线更远。沿出射方向反向延长，它们在真实字的上方相交，因此字看起来变浅。深色表示实际位置，浅棕色表示这对光线的虚像；虚线不是额外传播的光。
cues.en: Place a thick glass plate on printed text and look from above. Rays refract away from the normal at the upper face. Their backward extensions meet above the actual text, so it appears shallower. Dark text marks the object and pale text the virtual image for this ray pair. Dashed extensions are not additional propagating light.

cues.title: 把近轴公式与较大角度比较
cues.titleEn: Compare the paraxial formula with larger angles
cues.caption: 接近正视时，像深约为厚度除以折射率。
cues.captionEn: Near normal viewing, apparent depth is approximately thickness divided by index.
cues.zh: 接近法线观察时，像深约等于实际深度除以折射率。角度变大后，用精确折射角求交点，会偏离这个近轴公式。页面把两种结果并列显示，强调公式的适用条件。玻璃下表面与文字视为贴合，真实纸面间隙、有限瞳孔和多次反射都没有加入。
cues.en: Near normal viewing, apparent depth is approximately real depth divided by index. At larger angles, exact Snell refraction gives a different ray intersection. Both results are displayed to show the approximation’s limits. Text is assumed flush with the lower glass face; paper gaps, finite-pupil blur and multiple reflections are omitted.

cues.title: 干头为什么不动
cues.caption: 头身温度相同，没有驱动液柱的压强差。
cues.captionEn: At equal head and body temperatures, no pressure difference lifts the liquid.
cues.zh: 先看干燥的饮水鸭。鸭身密封，里面装着易挥发的工作液。头和身体温度相同时，液柱不会自己持续上升。杯里的水也不是供鸭子喝进身体的燃料。
cues.en: Begin with the dry bird. A volatile working liquid is sealed inside its body. Equal head and body temperatures give no sustained pressure difference to lift that liquid. Water in the cup is not a fuel that the bird drinks into its body.

cues.title: 湿头蒸发带走热量
cues.caption: 头部外面的水蒸发，内部蒸气压下降。
cues.captionEn: External water evaporates; the head’s internal vapour pressure falls.
cues.zh: 把头部绒布湿润，外面的水蒸发吸热，头部逐渐降温。内部工作液的部分蒸气凝结，头部蒸气压随之下降。注意清水仍在外面，与密封工作液分开。
cues.en: Wet the felt on the head. Evaporation removes heat and cools it. Some internal vapour condenses, reducing vapour pressure in the head. The external water remains separate from the sealed working liquid.

cues.title: 压强差抬升液体
cues.caption: 身体内较高的蒸气压推动液体上升。
cues.captionEn: Higher vapour pressure in the body pushes liquid up the neck.
cues.zh: 身体接近室温，蒸气压比冷却后的头部高。这个压强差推动工作液沿细管上升。追踪红色液柱，身体中的液体减少，质量逐渐转移到支点上方。
cues.en: The body stays near room temperature, with higher vapour pressure than the cooled head. That pressure difference pushes liquid up the narrow neck. Track the red column as liquid leaves the lower bulb and mass shifts above the pivot.

cues.title: 质量上移后倾倒
cues.titleEn: The raised mass tips the bird
cues.caption: 液体分布改变重力矩，鸟喙接触清水。
cues.captionEn: The new mass distribution changes gravitational torque and tips the beak into water.
cues.zh: 随着液体上移，绕支点的重力作用不再把鸭子扶正。鸭身向前倾斜，鸟喙接触杯中的清水，为绒布补水。倾倒角度和液柱来自同一个运动模型。
cues.en: As liquid rises, gravity no longer restores the bird upright. It tips forward until the beak touches the water and rewets the felt. The liquid column and tipping angle are coupled in the same motion model.

cues.title: 管口露出后复位
cues.titleEn: An exposed tube resets the cycle
cues.caption: 管口离开液面，两端连通，液体回落。
cues.captionEn: The tube opening emerges, pressure equalizes and the liquid drains.
cues.zh: 倾倒时，细管下端露出身体里的液面，头身蒸气得以连通。压强差消失，工作液回落到身体，重心降低，鸭子重新直立。留意管口与水平液面的相对位置。
cues.en: When the bird tips, the bottom of the tube emerges above the liquid surface. Vapour connects the two bulbs and their pressure difference collapses. Liquid drains into the lower bulb and gravity restores the bird. Watch the tube opening relative to the horizontal liquid surface.

cues.title: 环境维持的循环
cues.titleEn: A cycle powered by the environment
cues.caption: 持续蒸发才有循环；它不是永动机。
cues.captionEn: Continued evaporation sustains the cycle; this is not perpetual motion.
cues.zh: 湿头继续蒸发，循环再次开始。它把环境提供的一部分热量转成机械运动。自由探索把相对湿度调到百分之百，或换成干头，没有蒸发降温就不能启动；模型没有把时间周期当成真实产品的测量值。
cues.en: Evaporation resumes and another cycle begins. Part of the heat supplied by the environment becomes mechanical motion. In exploration, select a dry head or saturated air: without evaporative cooling the engine does not start. The model explains the cycle rather than measuring a commercial toy’s timing.

cues.title: 同一串等时点
cues.caption: 同一时钟：水平等距，竖直间距增大。
cues.captionEn: One clock: equal horizontal steps, growing vertical steps.
cues.zh: 先用频闪或逐帧视频记录小球的位置。本例每零点零五秒留下一个位置点。把抛出点的球心作为原点，向右和向下建立坐标。相同时间内，水平位移相同，竖直位移却逐次增大。这些位置记录让我们分别研究两个方向，而不是仅仅凭一条弯曲的外形猜测运动规律。
cues.en: Begin with strobe photography or video frames. This example records a point every 0.05 seconds. Use the ball centre at launch as the origin, with axes right and down. Equal intervals have equal horizontal travel but increasing vertical travel. Position records let us study each direction separately rather than guessing a law from the curve’s appearance.

cues.title: 抛得更快，会落得更晚吗？
cues.caption: 同高度、同时释放，两球始终同高。
cues.captionEn: Same height and release time: both balls stay level.
cues.zh: 教材的弹性金属片同时完成两件事：把一球水平抛出，并释放另一球自由下落。两球起始高度相同，竖直初速度都为零。虽然水平位置越来越远，它们的高度始终相同，并且同时触地。改变水平投射强度会改变落点，却不改变同高度的下落时间；这为平抛的竖直分运动提供了直接对照。
cues.en: The spring-strip apparatus launches one ball horizontally while releasing another vertically. Both start at the same height and instant, with zero vertical velocity. Their horizontal positions separate, but their heights match and they land together. Changing horizontal launch strength changes range, not fall time from the same height. This directly tests the vertical component.

cues.title: 轨迹怎样给出时间
cues.caption: 下落量给出时间，再检验水平位移。
cues.captionEn: Recover time, then compare horizontal steps.
cues.zh: 轨迹本身不带时钟。用竖直自由落体规律，把球心下降量换成飞行时间。这组理想教学坐标中，时间每次增加零点一秒，水平位移每次增加零点一四米，所以水平速度保持一点四米每秒。真实描点必须保持同一初速度，不能把不同条件的印迹拼在一起。
cues.en: A path has no clock. Use vertical free fall to convert centre drop into flight time. In these ideal teaching coordinates, time increases by zero point one seconds, while horizontal position increases by zero point one four metres. Horizontal speed is therefore constant at one point four metres per second. Real marks must share the same launch conditions.

cues.title: 为什么只改变一个分量
cues.caption: 重力改变竖直速度，水平速度保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Gravity changes vertical velocity; horizontal velocity stays constant.
cues.zh: 跟住同一个球。离开装置后，忽略空气阻力，只有重力向下。水平合力为零，加速度也为零，已有的水平速度不需要持续推力来维持。重力使竖直速度每秒增加九点八米每秒。看速度三角形：水平边不变，竖直边变长，总速度转向下方。两个分运动共用一个时钟，合成这个球的运动。
cues.en: Follow the ball. After release, ignoring air resistance, only gravity acts downward. Zero horizontal force means zero horizontal acceleration; existing horizontal velocity needs no sustained push. Gravity increases vertical velocity by nine point eight metres per second each second. In the velocity triangle, the horizontal side stays fixed, the vertical side grows, and their sum turns downward. Both components share one clock.

cues.title: 新高度的新落点
cues.caption: 降低接球板后，新的落点在哪里？
cues.captionEn: Lower the catcher: where will the ball land?
cues.zh: 先看小球落到较高的接球板上。初速度不变，把球心下降量变成四倍，水平距离也会变成四倍吗？先停一下。下降量与时间平方成正比，所以飞行时间只加倍；水平速度不变，水平距离也只加倍。放好空心预测标记，再释放小球。它到达标记处才接触接球板。
cues.en: First the ball reaches the higher board. Keep launch speed, but quadruple the centre drop. Will horizontal distance also quadruple? Pause here. Drop grows with time squared, so flight time only doubles. Unchanged horizontal speed then doubles the range. Place the outlined prediction, then release the ball. It reaches the mark at first contact.

cues.title: 墙移远以后
cues.caption: 墙移远以后，小球会多下降多少？
cues.captionEn: Move the wall farther: how much farther will the ball drop?
cues.zh: 保留近处的撞点，把到墙前的球心水平位移加倍。下降量会加倍，还是变成四倍？水平速度不变，飞行时间加倍；下降量随时间平方变化，因此变成四倍。空心标记先预测，随后释放检验理想模型。墙面距离要扣除球半径，才是球心位移。首次接触就停下，不模拟碰撞后的运动。
cues.en: Keep the first mark and double the centre travel to the wall. Will the drop double or quadruple? Constant horizontal velocity doubles flight time. Drop grows with time squared, so it quadruples. Place the prediction, then release to check the ideal model. Subtract the ball radius from wall-surface distance to obtain centre travel. Stop at first contact; post-impact motion is not modeled.

cues.title: 为什么是抛物线
cues.caption: 用两个分运动推导轨迹，再预测新点。
cues.captionEn: Derive the path from both motions, then predict a new point.
cues.zh: 一条线看起来弯曲，还不能说明它就是抛物线。把原点放在抛出时的球心，向下为正，看这组固定的理想教学坐标。先试竖直位移与水平位移成正比，直线跟不上后面的点。再除以水平位移的平方，比值都为二点五每米。为什么？水平位移等于初速度乘时间，竖直位移等于二分之一重力加速度乘时间平方。消去同一个时间，就得到竖直位移与水平位移平方成正比。现在先遮住最后一点：水平位移零点五六米，预测下降零点七八四米。再揭开这个固定点。它展示模型的预测关系，不是新增的实验证据。
cues.en: A curved line is not automatically a parabola. Put the origin at the launch centre, with downward positive, and inspect these fixed ideal teaching coordinates. First try a linear relation. The line misses the later points. Dividing vertical displacement by horizontal displacement squared gives two point five per metre. Why? Horizontal displacement is launch speed times time; vertical displacement is half gravity times time squared. Eliminate the shared time to obtain the quadratic relation. Keep the last point hidden. At a horizontal distance of zero point five six metres, predict a drop of zero point seven eight four metres. Now reveal it. This illustrates the model, not new experimental evidence.

cues.title: 刻度尺看见初速度
cues.caption: 高度给出时间，距离给出速度，再预测新高度。
cues.captionEn: Height gives time, range gives speed, then predict a new height.
cues.zh: 如果没有计时器，只有刻度尺，能求出离桌速度吗？先测桌面到水平接球面的高度零点八零米，以及从抛出点正下方到落点的水平距离零点五六米。对同一个球，起点和终点的半径偏移相互抵消，这个高度正是球心下降量。因为球水平离桌，竖直初速度为零，高度给出飞行时间，约零点四零四秒。水平距离除以时间，得到初速度约一点三八六米每秒，不需要知道斜槽中的摩擦。现在保持这个速度，把接球面提高到下降量只有零点二零米。先预测：时间变成一半，落点应在零点二八米处。放好空心标记，再让小球飞出。
cues.en: Can a ruler reveal launch speed without a timer? Measure a height of zero point eight zero metres and a horizontal range of zero point five six metres. With the same ball on horizontal support surfaces, the radius offsets at both ends cancel, so this height is also the centre drop. A horizontal launch has zero initial vertical velocity. The height gives a flight time of about zero point four zero four seconds. Range divided by time gives about one point three eight six metres per second, without knowing ramp friction. Keep that speed and raise the catcher so the drop is only zero point two zero metres. Predict first: half the time means a range of zero point two eight metres. Place the outline, then launch.

cues.title: 在清水中滴入颜料
cues.caption: 颜料起初集中，个体运动没有统一方向。
cues.captionEn: Dye starts concentrated; individual motion has no common direction.
cues.zh: 一滴红色颜料进入水中，起初只占很小一块区域。放大的示踪点各自作随机运动，圈出的粒子也不会知道哪里更稀。这里加速显示纯扩散，实际水中的对流另当别论。
cues.en: A drop of dye initially occupies a small region. Each magnified tracer moves randomly; the highlighted particle does not know where concentration is lower. This accelerated model isolates diffusion, leaving real-water convection aside.

cues.title: 均匀并不意味着静止
cues.caption: 粒子持续运动，统计分布逐渐均匀。
cues.captionEn: Particles keep moving while their statistical distribution becomes more uniform.
cues.zh: 有颜色的粒子逐渐进入原来清澈的区域。浓处有更多粒子可向外运动，因此整体看起来从浓处扩散到稀处。即使颜色已经较均匀，粒子仍不停运动；把画面停住只是暂停观察。
cues.en: Dye spreads into regions that were initially clear. More particles can leave a concentrated region, producing net spreading without directed individual motion. Even when concentration is roughly uniform, particles keep moving; pausing the display only pauses our observation.

cues.title: 先用隔板限制气体
cues.caption: 四个有颜色编号的粒子都在A内，B为空。
cues.captionEn: Four identified particles occupy A while B is empty.
