cues.zh: 换成教材的隔板思想实验。四个颜色不同的粒子都在A室，B室空着。粒子碰壁反弹，隔板限制了它们能到达的空间。颜色用于跟踪身份，不表示四种不同气体。
cues.en: Now consider the textbook’s partition thought experiment. Four identifiable particles occupy chamber A; chamber B is empty. Reflecting walls, including the partition, restrict their accessible space. Colours identify particles rather than different gases.

cues.title: 撤去隔板后进入另一半
cues.caption: 粒子进入更大的空间，能量无需凭空增加。
cues.captionEn: Particles gain access to more space without an extra energy input.
cues.zh: 撤去隔板后，原来的粒子延续运动，进入B室。图中没有加热，也没有向外推动活塞。四个粒子仍会出现数量起伏；不要用这一瞬间的左右数量判断大量气体的平衡分布。
cues.en: After removing the partition, the same particles continue into B. No heater or moving piston supplies extra energy here. Four particles show large number fluctuations; a single instantaneous count is not the equilibrium behaviour of a macroscopic gas.

cues.title: 逐一列出十六种归属
cues.caption: 每个粒子可在A或B，共有2的4次方种归属。
cues.captionEn: Each particle may be in A or B, giving two to the fourth assignments.
cues.zh: 把每个粒子只记作在A或在B，四个粒子就有十六种归属。每张小图上排是A，下排是B，同一种颜色始终代表同一粒子。逐张计数，会发现两边各两个粒子有六种归属。
cues.en: Record only whether each particle is in A or B. Four particles give sixteen assignments. In every small diagram, the upper row is A and the lower row is B; colours preserve particle identity. Count the diagrams with two particles in each half: there are six.

cues.title: 少量起伏与宏观概率
cues.caption: 全部回到A的概率是2的负N次方，随粒子数迅速下降。
cues.captionEn: The probability that all return to A is two to the minus N.
cues.zh: 在平衡、等体积、独立粒子的假设下，十六种归属等可能。四个全在A的概率是十六分之一，不能说绝不发生。增加粒子数后，全部回到A的概率按二的负N次方下降。极小的概率解释宏观复原为何难以观察。
cues.en: For equal-volume halves and independent particles at equilibrium, the sixteen assignments are equally likely. All four in A has probability one sixteenth, so it is not forbidden. As particle count grows, all-in-A probability falls as two to the minus N, making macroscopic returns unobservable in practice.

cues.title: 只增加电流
cues.caption: 接点和磁场不变，比较偏转。
cues.captionEn: Keep contacts and field fixed; compare deflection.
cues.zh: 看悬线上的直导线。三个相同磁体在导线处近似给出同一个匀强场，四个接点让我们选择通电区间。先保持外侧接点不变，逐渐增加电流。磁力随电流增大，导线的平衡偏转也增大。这里先固定长度和场强，只考察电流。
cues.en: Look at the suspended straight wire. Three identical magnets approximate one uniform field, while four contacts select the live interval. Keep the outer contacts fixed and gradually increase current. Magnetic force and equilibrium deflection grow together. Length and field strength remain fixed, isolating the current dependence.

cues.title: 改变通电长度
cues.caption: 接点 2–3 与 1–4 使用相同电流。
cues.captionEn: Both contact pairs carry the same current.
cues.zh: 保持电流不变，先接中间的二、三接点，再换成外侧的一、四接点。金色部分是既通电又处在磁区内的导线。它的长度变为原来的三倍，磁力也变为三倍。三个磁体并排提供更宽的磁区，不能把磁体个数直接当成场强倍数。
cues.en: Keep current unchanged. First use contacts two and three, then the outer pair, one and four. Gold marks wire that carries current inside the field. Its length triples and the force triples. Side-by-side magnets extend the field region; their number is not a multiplier for field strength.

cues.title: 区分总长与有效长
cues.caption: 接点间距没变，浸场长度可以减小。
cues.captionEn: Contact spacing can stay fixed while immersed length decreases.
cues.zh: 现在保持外侧接点，慢慢把导线横向移出一部分磁区。两个接点之间仍是原来的长度，但是只有与磁区重叠的通电部分参与这里的受力。读数中的有效长度减小，磁力也随之减小。因此公式里的长度，不能直接拿整根导线的长度代替。
cues.en: Keep the outer contacts and shift the wire partly outside the field. Their spacing is unchanged, but only the live portion overlapping the field contributes to this force. Effective length and force decrease together. The length in the equation is therefore not necessarily the full wire length.

cues.title: 比较不同场强
cues.caption: 相同 Iℓ 下，受力比值给出 B。
cues.captionEn: At fixed Iℓ, the force ratio gives B.
cues.zh: 最后保持电流和有效长度不变，比较两种磁场强度。场越强，同一段通电导线的受力越大。把磁力除以电流与有效长度的乘积，就得到磁感应强度。自由探索中可以反向或关断电流，检查受力反向与零电流这两个边界。
cues.en: Finally hold current and effective length fixed while comparing two field strengths. A stronger field exerts more force on the same live segment. Dividing force by current times effective length gives magnetic flux density. In exploration, reverse or stop the current to check opposite-force and zero-current limits.

cues.title: 先让后轮离地
cues.caption: 同一传动，比较转角和路程。
cues.captionEn: Compare angle and distance in one drive.
cues.zh: 把自行车后轮架起，转动脚踏板，观察大齿轮、小齿轮和后轮。它们确实一起运动，但问哪个更快之前，要先说明比较什么。每秒绕轴转过多少角度，和齿轮边缘每秒走过多少路程，是两种不同的快慢。教材用这个熟悉的装置，把角速度和线速度的区别变得可以观察。
cues.en: Raise the rear wheel and turn the pedals. The large sprocket, small sprocket and rear wheel all move together. Before asking which is faster, specify what is compared: angle turned per second and distance travelled along a rim per second are different quantities. This familiar apparatus makes the distinction between angular and linear speed observable.

cues.title: 跟随同一段链条
cues.caption: 同一链长通过两轮，链速不突变。
cues.captionEn: One chain length passes both sprockets.
cues.zh: 靠近链传动，跟着标记链节走一圈。闭合链条不能在一处积起来、另一处缺一段，因此大、小齿轮每秒输送的链长相同。在教材采用的连续节圆近似下，这对应两个齿轮边缘相同的线速度。小齿轮转得快，并不意味着链条到它那里就突然加速；两处描述的是同一条传动路径。
cues.en: Move closer and follow the marked link around the closed loop. Chain cannot accumulate at one sprocket and vanish at the other, so both transport the same chain length per second. In the textbook’s continuous pitch-circle approximation, their peripheral linear speeds match. Faster rotation of the small sprocket does not mean the chain suddenly accelerates there; it is one transmission path.

cues.title: 比较同一时间的转角
cues.titleEn: Compare angles over the same interval
cues.caption: 40齿转一圈，20齿转两圈。
cues.captionEn: 40 teeth turn once; 20 teeth turn twice.
cues.zh: 在同样短的一段时间里，大齿轮转过较小角度，小齿轮转过较大角度。本例前面四十齿，后面二十齿，大齿轮转一圈输送四十个节距，小齿轮就必须转两圈。相同线速度下，半径较小的轮子角速度更大。改变后齿轮齿数时，角速度比和后轮转速会一起改变，链条的几何与啮合相位也同步更新。
cues.en: Over the same short interval, the large sprocket turns through a smaller angle. Here forty front teeth feed forty pitches per revolution, so the twenty-tooth rear sprocket makes two revolutions. For equal transport speed, smaller effective radius means greater angular speed. Changing rear tooth count updates the ratio, rear-wheel rotation, chain geometry and engagement phase together.

cues.title: 比较同轴的两个点
cues.titleEn: Compare two points on one wheel
cues.caption: 同轴点：半径两倍，线速度两倍。
cues.captionEn: Same wheel: twice the radius, twice the speed.
cues.zh: 最后只看同一只后轮。轮缘的点和半径中点固定在同一个轮子上，所以它们每秒转过的角度相同，角速度相同。轮缘的半径是另一点的两倍，每圈走过的路程也是两倍，线速度便是两倍。链传动中比较的是相同线速度下的不同角速度；同轴车轮比较的是相同角速度下的不同线速度，都符合速度等于角速度乘半径。
cues.en: Now compare two points on the same rear wheel. A rim point and a halfway point are fixed to one wheel, so they sweep the same angle each second and share angular speed. The rim has twice the radius and twice the distance per revolution, hence twice the linear speed. Chain transmission compares different angular speeds at common transport speed; one wheel compares different linear speeds at common angular speed. Both follow v equals omega r.

cues.title: 把两条散热途径分开
cues.caption: 水的升温是有用部分，热水和火焰还会向环境散热。
cues.captionEn: Water heating is useful output; hot water and flames also heat the surroundings.
cues.zh: 先看水壶和火焰。燃气提供的能量，一部分增加水的内能，一部分由热水散给空气，另一部分直接由火焰加热周围空气。箭头只说明流向，没有用未经测量的宽度假装能量比例。
cues.en: Follow the kettle and flame. Some fuel energy increases the water’s internal energy. Other energy leaves the hot water or heats the surrounding air directly from the flame. These arrows identify paths; their widths do not pretend to show unmeasured energy proportions.

cues.title: 读取原始冷却记录
cues.caption: 相同二十分钟，高温段散热约为低温段的六倍。
cues.captionEn: Over equal twenty-minute intervals, the hotter water loses about six times as much heat.
cues.zh: 教材记录四千克水在二十六摄氏度环境中冷却。零到二十分钟降温十一点九度，一百八十到二百分钟降温两度。相同水量、相同时长，前者散热接近六倍。初始一百零一点九度是原始记录，页面保留而不擅自改写。
cues.en: The textbook records four kilograms of water cooling in a room at twenty-six degrees. In the first twenty minutes it cools by eleven point nine degrees, versus two degrees between minutes one hundred eighty and two hundred. Equal mass and time make the first heat loss nearly six times larger. The original initial reading is preserved.

cues.title: 同样从26°C加热到50°C
cues.caption: 相同水量和温升，中火耗气少于大火。
cues.captionEn: For equal water amounts and temperature rise, medium flame uses less gas in these measurements.
cues.zh: 接着比较同样四千克水从二十六度升到五十度。燃气表的终值减去初值，大火用零点零四五三立方米，中火用零点零二七八立方米。这个温区的实测对照支持减少过大火焰造成的浪费，不意味着所有条件下火越小越好。
cues.en: Next compare four kilograms heated from twenty-six to fifty degrees. Subtract each initial gas reading from its final value. High flame uses zero point zero four five three cubic metres, and medium flame zero point zero two seven eight. This measured comparison supports avoiding oversized flames here, not making every flame as small as possible.

cues.title: 检验三种烧开策略
cues.caption: 教材这组条件下，先中火后大火耗气最少。
cues.captionEn: For this textbook setup, medium then high uses the least gas.
cues.zh: 三种方案保持水量、初温和沸腾终点相同。全程大火、全程中火、先中火后大火的耗气分别是零点零八八三、零点零八四五和零点零七八四立方米。第三种比全程大火少约百分之十一点二。这是该组实验证据，不是所有灶具的通用最优设置。
cues.en: Compare three strategies with the same water amount, initial temperature and boiling endpoint. Their measured gas volumes are shown below. Medium followed by high uses about eleven point two percent less gas than high throughout. That is evidence for this experimental setup, not a universal optimum for every stove.

cues.title: 第一次收集38°C出水
cues.caption: 记录进水温度、相同水量与燃气表前后读数。
cues.captionEn: Record inlet temperature, collected water amount and both gas-meter readings.
cues.zh: 热水器研究换一套装置。先测进水温度，把出水调到三十八度，收集一定水量，并记录燃气表前后读数。这里用十千克水、二十度进水示范记录方法；教材没有给耗气结果，因此表盘保留问号。
cues.en: The water-heater investigation uses a different apparatus. Measure the inlet temperature, set the outlet to thirty-eight degrees, collect a fixed water amount and record both gas-meter readings. Ten kilograms with a twenty-degree inlet are example conditions. The textbook supplies no consumption result, so the meter remains unknown.

cues.title: 第二次收集相同水量
cues.titleEn: Repeat with the same water amount
cues.caption: 出水升到50°C时，有用能量也随温升增加。
cues.captionEn: At 50°C, the useful energy increases with the temperature rise.
cues.zh: 第二次把出水设为五十度，收集相同水量，保持相同进水温度，并重新测量耗气。水量相同不等于有用能量相同，因为温升变大。不能只凭第二次燃气用得更多，就判断效率更低。
cues.en: For the second trial, set the outlet to fifty degrees, collect the same water amount and retain the same inlet temperature. Measure gas again. Equal water mass does not mean equal useful energy: the temperature rise is larger. Greater gas consumption alone does not establish lower efficiency.

cues.title: 用实测量计算效率
cues.caption: 效率等于水吸收的能量除以燃气提供的能量。
cues.captionEn: Efficiency is useful water heating divided by fuel energy.
cues.zh: 把两次实测耗气填入自由探索，再使用当地燃气热值，分别计算水的内能增量与燃气提供的能量。缺少耗气量时，页面不会替你生成结论。五十度热水兑冷水可以增加适温水量，但这个混水事实本身并不能证明热水器效率提高。
cues.en: Enter both measured gas consumptions in exploration and use the local fuel’s heating value. Compare each water-energy increase with fuel energy. Missing consumption data produces no invented efficiency. Mixing fifty-degree water with cold water yields more usable warm water, but that mixing fact alone does not prove a more efficient heater.

cues.title: 沿半径入射，看平面的分光
cues.titleEn: Enter radially and watch the flat face
cues.caption: 反射光增强，透射光逐渐贴近界面。
cues.captionEn: Reflection grows while transmission approaches the interface.
cues.zh: 光先沿半径进入半圆玻璃块，在曲面处不改变方向。到达平面后，入射角逐渐增大，出射光离法线越来越远。图中两条光的亮度由菲涅耳公式计算，反射与透射功率之和保持为一。射线加粗便于观察，不代表束宽或绝对亮度。
cues.en: Light enters the semicircular block radially, so the curved face does not change its direction. At the flat face, increasing incidence bends the transmitted ray farther from the normal. Fresnel equations determine both branch powers; they sum to one. Enlarged rays indicate direction rather than actual beam width.

cues.title: 越过临界角
cues.caption: 透射光消失，能量留在反射光中。
cues.captionEn: Transmission vanishes and the reflected beam retains the power.
cues.zh: 玻璃折射率取一点五，射向空气的临界角约为四十一点八度。越过这个角，平面界面没有传播到空气中的透射光，出现全反射。这个结论有方向条件：必须从折射率较大的介质射向较小的介质。模型忽略吸收，也不画界面外不携带法向净能流的倏逝场。
cues.en: For glass of index one point five into air, the critical angle is about forty-one point eight degrees. Beyond it, no propagating transmitted beam crosses the flat interface. This requires travel from higher to lower refractive index. Absorption and the evanescent field outside the interface are omitted.

cues.title: 逐次追踪弯棒中的光
cues.titleEn: Trace successive reflections inside a curved rod
cues.caption: 每段光路是直线，每次转向发生在边界。
cues.captionEn: Each segment is straight; direction changes occur at the boundary.
cues.zh: 光进入弯曲有机玻璃棒后，在两侧界面间多次反射。边界处的局部法线由实际几何计算，不是让光沿棒的中心线自动拐弯。缓弯时，各次入射满足全反射条件，光可以沿棒传到另一端。逐段显现只用于追踪路径，不把这段动画的播放速度当作真实光速。
cues.en: Inside the acrylic rod, light reflects repeatedly between its boundaries. Each local normal comes from the actual geometry; the beam does not simply follow the centerline. A gentle bend can preserve total reflection along the route. Progressive drawing reveals the path, not the physical speed of light.

cues.title: 弯得太急，光会漏出
cues.titleEn: A tight bend can leak light
cues.caption: 曲率改变入射角，漏光由同一光路计算。
cues.captionEn: Curvature changes incidence; the traced path determines leakage.
cues.zh: 现在保持棒宽不变，逐渐减小弯曲半径。边界法线改变，一些入射角降到临界角以下，部分光透射到外面，后续反射光相应变暗。因此能导光不等于任意弯曲都没有损耗。这里计算二维光线与理想光滑界面，未加入真实材料的散射、吸收和表面粗糙。
cues.en: Now reduce the bend radius while retaining the rod width. Some incidence angles fall below critical, allowing light to escape and weakening later reflections. Guiding does not guarantee lossless transmission through every bend. The two-dimensional smooth-interface model excludes material scattering, absorption and surface roughness.

cues.title: 用弯曲水流引导光
cues.titleEn: Guide light through a falling water jet
cues.caption: 重力弯曲水流，界面反射改变光的方向。
cues.captionEn: Gravity bends the jet; boundary reflections redirect the light.
cues.zh: 水从侧孔水平射出后，在重力作用下向下弯曲。激光从对面沿孔口方向进入水流，在水与空气的界面反射。模型先计算水流抛物线和随流速变化的宽度，再逐次求光线与边界的交点。水流中的光路仍是一段段直线，不能把它画成与水完全相同的连续曲线。
cues.en: Water exits the side hole horizontally and falls under gravity. A beam enters from the opposite side and reflects at water–air boundaries. The model first computes the ballistic jet and its changing width, then intersects each light ray with that boundary. Light follows straight segments, not the water’s smooth curve.

cues.title: 改变水头，比较导光路径
cues.titleEn: Change water head and compare the guide
cues.caption: 水头决定流速，流速改变水形与反射位置。
cues.captionEn: Water head sets outlet speed and changes the jet and reflection points.
cues.zh: 水头升高时，孔口流速增大，同一水平距离内下落得更少。水柱几何改变后，反射位置和漏光也随之改变。每一停帧表示理想恒定水头下的准稳态，动画并非一个排空瓶子的全过程。忽略黏性、收缩和破碎；实际水流过细或变成液滴时，连续导光模型就不再适用。
cues.en: Higher water head increases outlet speed, reducing the fall over a given horizontal distance. Reflection points and leakage change with the jet. Each frame represents a quasi-steady ideal constant-head state, not a draining-bottle history. Viscosity, outlet contraction and breakup are omitted; droplets do not form this continuous guide.

cues.title: 让软木塞挡住小角度光
cues.titleEn: Let the cork block small-angle rays
cues.caption: 从针尖到塞缘的光，决定最小可出射角。
cues.captionEn: The tip-to-rim ray sets the smallest unblocked incidence.
cues.zh: 把针垂直穿过圆软木塞，针尖位于水下。塞子挡住朝上、小角度入射的光。能够从塞子外到达水面的光，其最小入射角由针尖、塞缘和法线构成的直角三角形决定。较深时仍有部分光折射出水，观察者可在合适方向看到针尖。
cues.en: A vertical pin passes through a circular floating cork with its tip underwater. The cork blocks near-normal upward rays. The triangle from tip to cork rim determines the minimum unblocked incidence angle. When the tip is deep, some rays still emerge outside the cork and can reach a suitably placed observer.

cues.title: 找出刚好看不见的临界深度
cues.caption: 只有刚好消失时，几何比值才给出折射率。
cues.captionEn: The geometric ratio gives the index only at disappearance.
cues.zh: 逐渐减小针尖深度，塞缘外光线的最小入射角增大。刚好达到临界角时，更外侧光线也全反射，针尖从水面上方消失。记录这一临界深度和塞子半径，可求折射率。任意深度下页面显示的试算值不是测量结果；必须先找到刚好消失的边界。
cues.en: Reduce tip depth until the minimum unblocked incidence reaches the critical angle. Every farther ray also reflects internally, hiding the tip from above. The threshold depth and cork radius determine index. The displayed trial ratio at an arbitrary depth is not a measurement: first locate the disappearance boundary.

cues.title: 滑杆静止
cues.caption: 磁通量存在，但没有变化。
cues.captionEn: Flux exists, but does not change.
cues.zh: 先看闭合的导轨回路。金属杆停在匀强磁场中，穿过回路的磁通量并不是零，但是灵敏电流表指在零位。这个现象提醒我们，不能把有磁场或有磁通量，直接当成产生感应电流的条件。接下来只改变运动方式。
cues.en: Begin with the closed rail loop. The metal rod rests in a uniform magnetic field. Magnetic flux through the loop is not zero, yet the sensitive meter reads zero. A field or a flux alone is therefore insufficient to induce current. Next, change only the motion.

cues.title: 沿磁场平移
cues.caption: 整个回路保持闭合，面积与磁通量不变。
cues.captionEn: The loop stays closed with unchanged area and flux.
cues.zh: 让导轨和金属杆一起沿磁场方向平移，保持所有接触闭合。回路确实运动了，但面积、方向和场强都没有变化，所以磁通量保持不变，电流表仍在零位。这是为保持接触而安排的整体平移对照，不能把任何运动都叫作切割磁场。
cues.en: Translate the rails and rod together along the field, preserving every electrical contact. The loop moves, but its area, orientation and field strength remain unchanged. Flux stays constant and the meter remains at zero. Moving the whole assembly preserves contact: motion alone is not necessarily cutting across a field.

cues.title: 改变回路面积
cues.caption: 滑杆前进与返回，电流方向相反。
cues.captionEn: Outward and return strokes give opposite current directions.
cues.zh: 现在让金属杆沿着导轨横向滑动，回路的面积随位置改变。电流表在运动时偏转，停下时回到零。杆返回时，面积变化方向反过来，感应电流也反向。这里磁场始终不变，变化的是穿过闭合回路的磁通量。
cues.en: Now slide the rod along the rails. The enclosed area changes with its position. The meter deflects during motion and returns to zero at rest. On the return stroke, area changes in the opposite sense and the current reverses. The field remains constant; the changing quantity is flux through the closed loop.

cues.title: 闭合线圈开关
cues.caption: 初级电流增长，次级出现短暂感应。
cues.captionEn: Primary current growth briefly induces a secondary current.
cues.zh: 换到两个互相套入的线圈。内线圈连接电源、开关和变阻器，外线圈单独连接灵敏电流表。闭合开关时，内线圈电流从无到有，外线圈的磁通量随之改变，出现短暂感应。电流稳定后，磁场仍在，但感应电流回到零。
cues.en: Switch to nested coils. The inner coil connects to a source, switch and rheostat; the outer coil separately connects to the sensitive meter. Closing the switch builds primary current and changes flux through the outer coil, briefly inducing current. Once primary current is steady, the field remains but induction returns to zero.

cues.title: 断开线圈开关
cues.caption: 同一装置，磁通量减小使感应方向反转。
cues.captionEn: Decreasing flux reverses induction in the same apparatus.
cues.zh: 再看断开开关的过程。内线圈的电流减小，穿过外线圈的磁通量也减小，电流表向相反方向偏转。为了看清变化窗口，画面把电流变化平滑放慢；它不重建真实触点火花和自感瞬态。要比较的是变化前、变化中和变化后的条件。
cues.en: Now open the switch. Primary current and the outer coil’s flux decrease, so the meter deflects in the opposite direction. The current-change window is smoothed and slowed for observation; this does not reconstruct actual contact arcing or self-inductive transients. Compare conditions before, during and after the change.

cues.title: 移动变阻器滑片
cues.caption: 开关保持闭合，滑片动作改变电流。
cues.captionEn: The switch stays closed while the slider changes current.
cues.zh: 保持开关闭合，移动变阻器滑片。电阻改变，内线圈的电流改变，外线圈出现感应。滑片停下后，电流稳定，感应再次消失。把滑片移回去，电流变化方向相反，感应方向也反转。关键不是开关这个动作本身，而是穿过外回路的磁通量是否改变。
cues.en: Keep the switch closed and move the rheostat slider. Resistance changes primary current, producing induction in the outer coil. Stop the slider: current becomes steady and induction vanishes. Moving it back reverses the current change and the induced direction. Switching itself is not essential; changing flux through the outer circuit is.

cues.title: 电流不变，插拔线圈
cues.caption: 相对位置改变，也能改变磁通量。
cues.captionEn: Relative position can change flux too.
cues.zh: 最后保持内线圈的供电电流不变，把它插入外线圈，再拔出来。电流没有变化，两线圈的位置关系却改变了，穿过外线圈的磁通量仍会变化。插入与拔出的感应方向相反，停留时归零。这一补充对照把电流变化与几何耦合变化分开。
cues.en: Finally hold primary current constant while inserting the inner coil and withdrawing it again. Current is unchanged, but relative position changes how much magnetic flux links the outer coil. Insertion and withdrawal give opposite currents; holding still gives zero. This added comparison separates changing current from changing geometric coupling.

cues.title: 同一束光，为什么有明暗？
cues.titleEn: Why does one source make bands?
cues.caption: 传播光程与界面反射共同决定相位差。
cues.captionEn: Path length and reflection set the phase difference.
cues.zh: 同一束黄光照在肥皂膜上，为什么有亮纹也有暗纹？跟住一个位置，放大膜的剖面。一路在前界面反射，另一路进入薄膜，在后界面反射后返回。前一路反射时翻转半周，后一路还多走一段光程。比较同一波面的光，两路的相位差才有意义。现在看同一时刻的场：前界面反射，加上膜内返回，得到总场；总场的强弱决定反射亮暗。先猜一猜，厚度趋近零会怎样？这时两路抵消，反射变暗。剖面放大了路径，计算包含后续的多次返回。
cues.en: Why does one yellow source make both bright and dark bands on a soap film? Follow one location and enlarge the section. One part reflects at the front boundary. Another enters the film, reflects at the back, and returns. The front reflection reverses by half a cycle; the returning light also travels an extra optical path. Compare them at the same wavefront. Now add the fields at one instant: the front reflection plus the internal returns gives the total field. Its strength sets the reflected brightness. Predict what happens as thickness approaches zero. The fields cancel and reflection becomes dark. Paths are enlarged; the calculation includes later internal returns.

cues.title: 跟住一条亮纹
cues.caption: 同一亮纹对应的膜厚，在新的位置出现。
cues.captionEn: The same bright-fringe thickness moves to a new position.
cues.zh: 重力排液会让竖直肥皂膜的厚度随高度和时间变化。页面改变一个简化的厚度分布，看同一明条纹移到新的位置。前表面反射还会发生半周相位变化，所以膜厚趋近零时反射变暗。厚度的变化是教学输入，不是完整求解肥皂液流动；真实膜还会受表面活性剂和空气扰动影响。
cues.en: Drainage changes a vertical soap film’s thickness with height and time. Vary a prescribed thickness profile and watch equal-phase contours move. The front reflection adds a half-cycle shift, making a nearly zero-thickness film dark. Thickness evolution is a teaching input, not a fluid simulation including surfactants and air disturbances.

cues.title: 同一厚度，不同波长
cues.caption: 不同波长的反射率不同，形成颜色。
cues.captionEn: Different reflectances across wavelengths create color.
cues.zh: 换成白光后，不同波长在同一厚度处有不同的相位差。某些颜色增强，另一些颜色减弱，于是出现彩色条纹。画面只用红绿蓝三个采样波长近似显示颜色，不把这些颜色当作真实光谱测量。自由探索中可以回到单色光，改变波长并追踪条纹的位置。
cues.en: Under white illumination, different wavelengths have different phase differences at the same thickness. Some strengthen while others weaken, producing color. Three sampled wavelengths provide an illustrative display, not a measured spectrum or calibrated color prediction. Exploration returns to monochromatic light so you can move the fringes by changing wavelength.

cues.title: 空气劈尖的暗纹
cues.titleEn: Dark fringes in an air wedge
cues.caption: 相邻同类条纹的厚度差是半个波长。
cues.captionEn: Like neighboring fringes differ by half a wavelength of gap thickness.
cues.zh: 两块玻璃夹着两张纸，接触端的空气膜最薄，向纸片一端逐渐增厚。先斜着看清两路反射：从玻璃到空气的前路不翻相，空气到玻璃的后路翻转半周。两路相差仍随空气膜厚度改变。回到垂直入射，在接触端两路抵消，出现暗纹。沿劈尖前进，膜厚每增加半个波长，就回到下一个同类条纹。上图只展开接触端起的四毫米，下图夹角放大。纸片厚度减半、玻璃长度不变，先用这个规律预测新间距。
cues.en: Two glass plates are separated by two paper sheets. The air gap is thinnest at contact and grows toward the spacer. First use an oblique section to distinguish the reflections: glass to air gives no phase reversal; air to glass gives a half-cycle reversal. Their phase difference also depends on gap thickness. Return to normal incidence. At contact the fields cancel, making a dark fringe. Each additional half-wavelength of gap thickness gives the next like fringe. Above, only the first four millimeters are displayed; below, the wedge angle is enlarged. If spacer thickness halves while plate length stays fixed, predict the new spacing.

cues.title: 少一张纸，条纹怎样变？
cues.caption: 纸片少一张，同样的厚度差要走多远？
cues.captionEn: With one sheet fewer, how far to gain the same gap thickness?
cues.zh: 抽去一张纸片后，支撑厚度减半，玻璃长度不变。相邻同类条纹对应的厚度差仍然是半个空气中波长，因此水平间距加倍。模型只比较支撑后的静态状态，过渡表示上板落到新的位置，不计算纸片抽动和玻璃弹性。改变支撑不会把波长也改变。
cues.en: After removing one sheet, support thickness halves while plate length remains fixed. Neighboring like fringes still differ in thickness by half a wavelength in air, so their horizontal spacing doubles. The model compares static supported states; the transition indicates settling, not paper friction or glass elasticity. Wavelength does not change.

cues.title: 沿遮光筒轴线对准器件
cues.caption: 光源、透镜、滤片、单缝、双缝与屏依次连接。
cues.captionEn: Align the source, lens, filter, single slit, double slit and screen.
cues.zh: 先让光束沿遮光筒轴线照亮屏，再放入互相平行的单缝与双缝。透镜使光更集中，滤片选出窄波段，单缝为双缝提供相干照明。上方显示装置顺序，下方展开测量头视野。器件纵向距离经过压缩，双缝到屏的实际计算距离为一点二米。
cues.en: First illuminate the screen along the tube axis, then align parallel single and double slits. A lens concentrates light, the filter selects a narrow band, and the single slit supplies coherent illumination. The lower circle unfolds the measuring eyepiece. Bench distances are compressed visually; the calculation uses a slit-to-screen distance of one point two meters.

cues.title: 把分划线对准第一条亮纹
cues.titleEn: Align the reticle with the first bright center
cues.caption: 记录亮纹中心，而不是亮暗交界。
cues.captionEn: Record the bright center, not a bright–dark boundary.
cues.zh: 转动测量头手轮，让分划线对准选定亮纹的中心，记下第一读数。示意采用连续位移读数，省去不同型号手轮的刻度结构；分划线的位置真实改变，不是自动贴到条纹上。自由探索时可以主动记录，所以偏离中心也会产生相应的测量偏差。
cues.en: Move the eyepiece reticle onto a chosen bright center and record its position. A continuous position readout replaces model-specific handwheel graduations. The reticle actually moves and does not automatically snap to a fringe. In exploration, recording an off-center position produces a corresponding measurement error.

cues.title: 跨过五个间隔，记录第六条
cues.titleEn: Span five intervals to the sixth center
cues.caption: 总距离除以五，得到平均条纹间距。
cues.captionEn: Divide the total distance by five to obtain mean fringe spacing.
cues.zh: 从第一条数到第六条亮纹，实际跨过五个间隔。保持同一方向转动，记录最后读数，用总距离除以五求平均间距，再由缝距和屏距反推波长。多间隔测量减小单次对准误差的相对影响，但不能消除刻度或距离的系统误差。
cues.en: The first through sixth bright centers span five intervals. Continue in one direction, record the final position and divide the distance by five. Combine mean spacing with known slit separation and screen distance to infer wavelength. Multiple intervals reduce relative alignment error but do not eliminate systematic calibration errors.

cues.title: 换滤片，比较条纹间距
cues.caption: 较长波长形成更大的间距；换缝距也会改变间距。
cues.captionEn: Longer wavelengths give wider spacing; slit separation also matters.
cues.zh: 保持装置距离不变，逐渐从短波长比较到长波长，条纹间距增大。探索中还可把双缝间距从零点一八毫米改为零点三六毫米，间距就减半。每次更换波长或缝距会清除先前读数，避免用不同配置的数据拼成一个测量。画面亮度是归一化值，不是光源功率。
cues.en: With the apparatus distances fixed, longer wavelengths produce wider fringes. Doubling slit separation from point one eight to point three six millimeters halves spacing. Exploration clears recorded positions whenever wavelength or separation changes. Display brightness is normalized rather than a prediction of lamp power.

cues.title: 让光照到固定的光敏阵列
cues.caption: 教材的光路自上而下，各光敏单元同时接光。
cues.captionEn: The textbook uses a downward beam and simultaneously illuminated detector elements.
cues.zh: 教材把光源放在支架上端，双缝在中间，线阵光传感器在下面。长条区域分布许多光敏单元，它们同时接收到不同位置的光。这里没有移动探头：曲线上的高亮点只是逐个查看固定单元的读数。每个单元记录自己有限宽度内的平均强度。
cues.en: The textbook places the source above the double slit and a linear sensor below. Many photosensitive elements receive light at their fixed positions simultaneously. No probe moves: the highlighted graph point reads successive fixed elements. Each detector value averages intensity over its finite active width.

cues.title: 从强度曲线读取空间周期
cues.titleEn: Read spatial period from the intensity curve
cues.caption: 亮纹中心对应峰值，读数受像元宽度限制。
cues.captionEn: Bright centers correspond to peaks; finite pixels limit resolution.
cues.zh: 把各单元的位置和强度依次排成曲线，明暗条纹就成为周期起伏。传感器既能找间距，也能显示各点的强度。若条纹过密，有限像元会把峰谷平均得更平，不能只凭曲线光滑就宣称测量准确。模型采用一百六十个等宽单元，未加入噪声、饱和与校准误差。
cues.en: Plotting detector position against intensity reveals the fringe period and local brightness. Finite pixels smooth closely spaced peaks and valleys, so a smooth curve does not prove accuracy. This model uses one hundred sixty equal-width elements and excludes noise, saturation and calibration errors.

cues.title: 用单面镜得到第二条路径
cues.titleEn: Create a second path with one mirror
cues.caption: 实源直达与经镜反射的光相遇，镜像只是构图工具。
cues.captionEn: Direct and reflected light meet; the virtual source constructs the reflected path.
cues.zh: 单色光源一部分光直接到屏，另一部分经平面镜反射后到达同一位置。把反射光反向延长，会指向镜后的虚像，因此可以用实源和虚像分析两条路径。图中的反射点由源高与接收位置计算；虚线不表示镜后有真实光传播。
cues.en: Some source light reaches the screen directly while another part reflects from a plane mirror. Backward extension points to a virtual source, which helps compare paths. The reflection point is calculated from source height and receiver position. Dashed lines behind the mirror are constructions, not real propagation.

cues.title: 计入反射相位，比较条纹
cues.titleEn: Include reflection phase in the fringe pattern
cues.caption: 零路程差处为暗纹，源与虚像距离决定间距。
cues.captionEn: Zero path difference is dark; source–image separation sets spacing.
cues.zh: 理想掠入射镜面反射给这条路径增加半周相位，因此零路程差附近出现暗纹，而不是直接照搬双缝中心亮纹。改变光源离镜面的高度，实源与虚像间距改变，条纹间距随之变化。模型取相等振幅和理想反射相位；真实镜面的材料、偏振和有限长度会影响对比度与重叠范围。
cues.en: Ideal grazing reflection adds half a cycle, making zero path difference dark rather than copying the double-slit central bright fringe. Changing source height changes source–image separation and fringe spacing. Equal amplitudes and ideal reflection phase are assumed; real mirror material, polarization and length affect contrast and overlap.

cues.title: 开口缩小，光斑也缩小吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a smaller slit make a smaller patch?
cues.caption: 同一开口连续改变，屏图也由同一波场计算。
cues.captionEn: One continuously changing opening, one field calculation.
cues.zh: 平行单色光照向挡板狭缝，后方一米处放屏。开口较宽时，几何光学可以给出大致轮廓，但边缘仍有衍射。页面从有限距离的菲涅耳积分计算强度，因此不是在某个宽度突然换成另一张图。器材缝隙为便于观察被放大，下方屏幕坐标使用毫米。
cues.en: Parallel monochromatic light illuminates a slit with a screen one meter behind it. A wide opening roughly follows geometric expectations but still diffracts at its edges. A finite-distance Fresnel integral calculates the pattern continuously rather than switching pictures at a threshold. Apparatus gaps are enlarged; screen coordinates are in millimeters.

cues.title: 从各带相加到首暗预测
cues.titleEn: From band sums to a minimum
cues.caption: 配对的场会怎样随路径差相加？
cues.captionEn: How do paired fields add as path delay changes?
cues.zh: 为什么缝越窄，光反而铺得越宽？把同一个开口分成八条带，看它们在同一个屏点的场。正中央，各带几乎同相，场相加很强。沿屏幕移开，较远的路径逐渐落后。把相隔半个缝宽的两带配成一对：在远场近似下，如果它们多走半个波长，每一对就近乎抵消，形成首个暗纹。所以首暗方向取决于波长除以缝宽。现在把一百微米的缝减到五十微米，先预测首暗会移近还是移远。再揭开屏图：大约从五点五毫米移到十一毫米。中央亮区更宽，透过的总光却更少。屏图仍用有限距离积分，因此暗处不冒充数学上的严格零。
cues.en: Why does a narrower gap spread light farther? Divide the same opening into eight bands and follow their fields at one screen point. At the center they are nearly in phase and add strongly. Move along the screen and path delays grow. Pair bands separated by half the slit width. In the far-field approximation, a half-wavelength path difference makes every pair nearly cancel: the first dark band. Its direction therefore depends on wavelength divided by slit width. Now halve a one-hundred-micrometer slit. Predict whether the first minimum moves inward or outward. Reveal the screen: it moves from about five point five to eleven millimeters. The center broadens while less total light passes. The finite-distance calculation does not pretend this minimum is an exact zero.

cues.title: 不同波长，分别算强度
cues.caption: 中央重合，旁侧随波长分开。
cues.captionEn: Colors overlap centrally and separate at the sides.
cues.zh: 白光包含许多波长，它们彼此不相干，应该把强度相加，而不是把不同颜色的振幅当成同一列波。中央位置各波长重合，旁侧条纹的位置不同，出现颜色分离。画面用三个波长近似颜色，保留波长依赖的传播计算，不声称精确再现真实白光光谱。
cues.en: White light contains mutually incoherent wavelengths, so their intensities add rather than their amplitudes. They overlap centrally but have different side-fringe positions. Three sampled wavelengths illustrate color while retaining wavelength-dependent propagation; this is not a calibrated reproduction of a real white-light spectrum.

cues.title: 圆孔需要不同的积分
cues.titleEn: A circle needs a different integral
cues.caption: 圆形开口的各处共同决定环纹。
cues.captionEn: The whole circular aperture determines its rings.
cues.zh: 教材还比较小圆孔的衍射。圆孔与狭缝的形状不同，不能把单缝曲线简单旋转就当成结果。这里对圆形开口积分，得到中央区域和周围环纹。孔变小时传播范围扩大。画面仍计算有限距离；只有充分满足远场条件时，才得到通常所说的艾里斑近似。
cues.en: A circular aperture differs from a slit: its pattern cannot be obtained by simply rotating the slit curve. Integrating over the circular opening gives a central region and surrounding rings. Smaller holes spread light farther. This remains a finite-distance calculation; the familiar Airy approximation requires the far-field limit.

cues.title: 铅笔缝减半，先预测
cues.titleEn: Halve the pencil gap: predict first
cues.caption: 同一波长下，首暗位置往哪里移？
cues.captionEn: At fixed wavelength, where does the minimum move?
cues.zh: 两支铅笔的细缝也遵守同一规律。先保留一百微米开口的结果，再把理想缝宽减半。不要先看新图，预测暗纹怎样移动。揭晓后，首暗位置约翻倍。这里用一米等效屏展开眼睛看到的角分布；真实铅笔边缘并不完全笔直。
cues.en: The gap between two pencils follows the same rule. Keep the one-hundred-micrometer reference, then halve the ideal gap. Predict the new minimum before revealing the screen: its distance approximately doubles. A one-meter equivalent screen unfolds the angular view; real pencil edges are not perfectly straight.

cues.title: 缝不变，只改变波长
cues.caption: 更长波长会把暗纹移向哪里？
cues.captionEn: Where does a longer wavelength move the minimum?
cues.zh: 卡脚固定缝宽，这次只改变光的波长。绿光换成更长波长的红光，首暗位置应往哪边移？先用同一个路径差条件预测，再揭晓：位置向外移，但缝没有变窄。这能区分改变光与改变器材。卡脚只画局部，微米读数是模型输入。
cues.en: Keep the caliper gap fixed and change only wavelength. If green light is replaced by longer-wavelength red light, where should the first minimum move? Predict using the same path-difference condition, then reveal it: outward, although the gap never narrowed. This separates a change of light from a change of apparatus. The micrometer readout is a model input.

cues.title: 圆盘中央一定是暗的吗？
cues.titleEn: Must the disk shadow center be dark?
cues.caption: 先保留几何预测，再比较波场结果。
cues.captionEn: Keep the ray prediction, then test the wave result.
cues.zh: 用不透明小圆盘挡住光，几何光线会预言中央是暗的。先保留这个预测，不急着揭开屏。现在跟踪圆周到轴线上同一点的路径：因为旋转对称，路径一样长，对应的绕射贡献具有相同相位。相同相位说明可以相长，但亮度还得把完整波场相加来算。这里先求互补圆孔的场，再从没有遮挡的场中减去它。揭开结果，几何阴影中央出现亮斑，并不是另画一个亮点。教材中的阿拉果观察支持了这个波动预言；本图是理想相干平面波的计算，不是历史照片。
cues.en: An opaque disk blocks the beam. Geometrical rays predict a dark center. Keep that prediction before revealing the screen. Now trace paths from the circular rim to one axial point. Rotational symmetry makes their lengths equal, so the corresponding diffracted contributions share a phase. Equal phase allows constructive addition, but brightness still requires the full field calculation. We calculate the complementary aperture field and subtract it from the unobstructed field. Reveal the result: a bright spot appears inside the geometric shadow without an extra painted dot. Arago’s observation supported this wave prediction; this image is an ideal coherent-plane-wave calculation, not a historical photograph.

cues.title: 盘变大，中央亮点会消失吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a larger disk remove the axial spot?
cues.caption: 轴上强度与周围尺度是不同问题。
cues.captionEn: Axial intensity and surrounding scale are distinct.
cues.zh: 改变圆盘半径，中央亮区和环纹的空间尺度随之变化。理想平面波模型中，轴上强度等于没有圆盘时的入射强度，但这不意味着整个阴影区都一样亮。真实光源大小、偏心、支架和探测分辨率会降低亮点可见度；本页不把理想强度当成真实仪器的保证。
cues.en: Changing disk radius alters the central spot and ring scales. In the ideal plane-wave model, axial intensity equals the unobstructed incident intensity, although the rest of the shadow is not equally bright. Finite sources, misalignment, supports and detector resolution can reduce visibility; the ideal result is not an instrument guarantee.

cues.title: 让绳的振动沿狭缝通过
cues.titleEn: Align transverse motion with the slit
cues.caption: 横波的振动方向在传播方向的垂直平面内。
cues.captionEn: Transverse motion lies in the plane perpendicular to propagation.
cues.zh: 绳上的波沿水平方向传播，绳元上下振动。把木板狭缝竖直放置，这个振动方向可以通过。画面保留连续的绳路，下方是沿传播方向看过去的端视图。这里把狭缝理想化为允许一个横向分量的约束，不模拟木板摩擦和绳的有限直径。
cues.en: A wave travels horizontally along the rope while its elements move vertically. A vertical slit permits that transverse direction. The rope remains connected and the lower diagram looks along propagation. The slit is idealized as a one-direction constraint, omitting board friction and finite rope diameter.

cues.title: 旋转狭缝，分开透过和反射
cues.titleEn: Rotate the slit to separate transmission and reflection
cues.caption: 与狭缝垂直的分量不能通过。
cues.captionEn: The component perpendicular to the slit is blocked.
cues.zh: 逐渐转动狭缝，绳的振动在狭缝方向上的分量变小。被挡住的分量反射回去，与入射波叠加；因此左侧不再只是一列简单前进波。转到垂直时，透过振动消失。页面用同一个向量投影计算右侧运动和左侧反射，确保约束处绳路连续。
cues.en: Rotating the slit reduces the component along its permitted direction. The blocked component reflects and interferes with the incident wave on the left. At perpendicular alignment, transmission vanishes. One vector-projection model determines both transmitted and reflected motion and preserves continuity at the constraint.

cues.title: 换成弹簧纵波
cues.caption: 沿轴的位移不随横向狭缝的方向改变。
cues.captionEn: Axial displacement does not depend on transverse slit orientation.
cues.zh: 在弹簧中沿轴向推拉，疏密变化沿弹簧传播，线圈位移也沿同一轴。转动狭缝不会像横波那样筛掉这个方向。图中的螺旋线连续连接，各圈的轴向位置来自同一个纵向位移场。假设开口允许线圈沿轴运动，不能把真实装置卡住弹簧的机械阻挡当成偏振。
cues.en: Push and pull the spring axially. Compression travels along it and each coil also moves along that axis. Rotating a transverse slit does not select this direction as it does transverse motion. A continuous helix follows one displacement field. The opening is assumed to allow axial motion; physically jamming a spring is not polarization.

cues.title: 先看窗中自然光
cues.titleEn: Start with natural light through a window
cues.caption: 转动一片理想偏振片，平均亮度不变。
cues.captionEn: Rotating one ideal analyzer leaves average unpolarized brightness unchanged.
cues.zh: 先通过偏振片看从窗户进入的自然光，再缓慢转动片子。理想自然光在各横向方向的平均强度相同，所以一片偏振片始终透过一半，转动不会出现周期明暗。这里取未偏振入射；实际窗玻璃的反射和斜向透射可能带来偏振，观察结果要结合具体方向。
cues.en: View natural window light through one rotating analyzer. Ideal unpolarized light has equal average transverse components, so an ideal analyzer always transmits half. This comparison assumes unpolarized incidence. Real window reflection and oblique transmission can introduce polarization, making viewing geometry relevant.

cues.title: 观察玻璃表面反光
cues.caption: 玻璃对两个偏振分量的反射率不同。
cues.captionEn: Glass reflects the two polarization components differently.
cues.zh: 再看玻璃表面的反光。对同一个入射角，垂直和平行入射面的偏振分量有不同反射率，因此转动偏振片会看到明暗变化。示例接近布儒斯特角，理想玻璃的一种反射分量消失，对比特别明显。探索中改变入射角，反光的偏振程度与透过亮度都会重新计算。
cues.en: Glass reflects the polarization components perpendicular and parallel to the incidence plane differently. Rotating an analyzer therefore changes brightness. Near Brewster incidence, one ideal reflected component vanishes and contrast is strong. Exploration recalculates both polarization and analyzer transmission when incidence changes.

cues.title: 比较光滑桌面
cues.caption: 未偏振的漫反射成分会留下不能完全消掉的亮度。
cues.captionEn: An unpolarized diffuse component leaves residual brightness.
cues.zh: 光滑桌面也可能显示随偏振片转动的反光变化，但不一定完全变黑。页面用光滑介质反射，加上一小部分未偏振漫反射作对照，展示残余亮度从哪里来。这些材料参数是教学示例，不是任意桌面的实测值。粗糙度、涂层和观察方向都会改变结果。
cues.en: A glossy tabletop can also vary with analyzer rotation without becoming completely dark. The example combines dielectric reflection with a small unpolarized diffuse contribution to explain residual brightness. These are illustrative parameters, not measurements of every table. Roughness, coatings and viewing direction matter.

cues.title: 转向液晶屏，跟踪文字亮度
cues.caption: 出射光有固定偏振方向，文字和背景一起变化。
cues.captionEn: A preferred output polarization makes text and background dim together.
cues.zh: 液晶显示器的出射光常有很强的偏振。透过旋转的偏振片看文字，会出现明显明暗变化。图中预设一个显示器偏振方向，并保留少量漏光，所以最暗时仍不严格为零。实际手机可能使用不同显示技术、补偿膜和偏振结构，不能用这一理想液晶例子判断所有屏幕。
cues.en: LCD output is often strongly polarized. Viewing text through a rotating analyzer produces pronounced brightness changes. This example assigns an output axis and a small leakage component, so the minimum is not exactly zero. Real phones use different display technologies and optical films; this LCD example does not characterize every screen.

cues.title: 向上抖动一次
cues.caption: 一个凸起向前传播，红色标记只上下运动。
cues.captionEn: A raised pulse travels while the red marker moves vertically.
cues.zh: 握住长绳的一端，向上抖动一次。形成的凸起沿绳传播，红色标记却停留在同一段绳上，只在波到来时向上再回落。空心圆跟随凸起，与红色的物质标记区别开。
cues.en: Move one end of the rope upward once. The raised pulse travels along it, but the red marker remains on the same material segment, rising and returning as the pulse arrives. The hollow circle follows the pulse rather than a piece of rope.

cues.title: 向下抖动一次
cues.caption: 向下的位移也向前传播，波的方向不随上下改变。
cues.captionEn: A downward displacement also travels forward.
cues.zh: 现在向下抖动一次，凹下的波形仍向绳的另一端传播。上下是绳上质点的运动方向，向前是波形的传播方向。把这两个方向分开，才不会以为波谷是在向下传播。
cues.en: Now make one downward motion. The depression still travels toward the other end. Up and down describe material displacement; forward describes propagation. Separating these directions prevents mistaking a downward displacement for a downward-travelling wave.

cues.title: 连续振动形成波列
cues.titleEn: Continuous driving makes a wave train
cues.caption: 后面的绳段重复前面的动作，但开始得更晚。
cues.captionEn: Each later segment repeats the source motion after a delay.
cues.zh: 连续上下抖动，形成一列凹凸相间的波。每一段绳重复振源的动作，距离越远，开始得越晚。暂停后看红色标记的位置，再推进一小段时间，区分一个点的振动与整条绳的波形。
cues.en: Drive the end continuously to form a wave train. Every rope segment repeats the source motion with a delay that grows with distance. Pause and inspect the red marker, then advance slightly to distinguish one point’s oscillation from the rope’s overall shape.

cues.title: 同学依次起蹲
cues.caption: 相邻同学稍迟重复动作，形成移动的人浪。
cues.captionEn: Delayed standing and crouching form a travelling human wave.
cues.zh: 一排同学手挽手，从第一位开始起立、下蹲。后一位稍迟重复前一位的动作。凹凸相间的轮廓沿队伍移动，每个人却仍在自己的位置上。这个活动让传播延迟变得直接可见。
cues.en: Students link hands and begin standing and crouching in sequence. Each responds slightly later than the neighbour. The rising-and-falling outline travels along the row while every student keeps their place, making propagation delay visible.

cues.title: 只看红衣同学
cues.caption: 红衣同学没有沿队列走动，传播的是动作状态。
cues.captionEn: The highlighted student stays in place while the action pattern travels.
cues.zh: 现在只盯住红衣同学和脚下的短线。动作继续，脚位没有向队伍前方移动。人浪是状态传播的类比，帮助我们观察先后关系；它不意味着人体和绳子的弹性运动机制完全相同。
cues.en: Focus on the highlighted student and the short mark beneath their feet. The action continues without movement along the row. This is an analogy for a travelling state and its delay, not a claim that people follow the same elastic dynamics as a rope.

cues.title: 沿弹簧轴向推拉
cues.titleEn: Push and pull along the spring
cues.caption: 疏密交替向前传播，弹簧圈沿轴线往复。
cues.captionEn: Compressions and rarefactions travel while coils oscillate along the axis.
cues.zh: 把长而软的弹簧放在光滑平面上，沿轴线推拉一端。相邻线圈的间距交替减小、增大，形成传播的密部和疏部。每个线圈的运动方向与波传播方向平行，所以这是纵波。
cues.en: Place a long soft spring on a smooth surface and push and pull one end along its axis. Neighbouring coil spacing alternately decreases and increases, forming travelling compression and rarefaction. Coil motion is parallel to propagation: a longitudinal wave.

cues.title: 跟踪同一个弹簧圈
cues.caption: 放大的红色标记往复回到原位，并不随密部迁移。
cues.captionEn: The magnified marker oscillates around its original position, rather than following a compression.
cues.zh: 最后追踪红色标记所在的线圈。局部放大显示它向前、向后往复，随后回到同一个平衡位置。传播出去的是压缩和伸展的状态，不是这个弹簧圈一路向前。横波和纵波都要区分物质运动与波的传播。
cues.en: Follow the marked coil. The magnified local view shows it moving forward and backward around the same equilibrium position. Compression and stretching travel onward, rather than carrying that coil along. Both transverse and longitudinal waves require this distinction between material motion and propagation.

cues.title: 电流加倍的量热对照
cues.caption: 相同电阻、相同时间，比较四倍发热。
cues.captionEn: Same resistance and time: compare four times the heating.
cues.zh: 先看两套相同的量热器。电阻都相同，右侧电流是左侧的两倍，同时开始通电。相同时间后，右侧输入的热量是四倍。温度计记录的是量热器升温，部分能量同时散向环境。这套现代示意装置用于理解焦耳定律，不冒充焦耳当年的原始仪器。
cues.en: Compare two identical calorimeters with equal resistance. The right current is twice the left, and both run for the same duration. Right-hand input energy is four times greater. Thermometers record warming while some energy escapes to the environment. This modern teaching apparatus explains Joule’s law; it is not Joule’s original instrument.

cues.title: 电阻加倍的对照
cues.caption: 保持电流相同，热量与电阻成正比。
cues.captionEn: At equal current, heating is proportional to resistance.
cues.zh: 这一次让两侧电流相同，把右侧电阻改为两倍。相同通电时间内，右侧输入热量变为两倍。电流、电阻和时间必须分开控制，才能判断各自的关系。对这里的纯电阻，电功转化为内能；不能把所有用电器的总功率都直接当成电阻发热功率。
cues.en: This time keep both currents equal and double the right-hand resistance. For the same duration, its input energy doubles. Current, resistance and time need separate control to identify each relation. Here a pure resistor converts electrical work to internal energy; not every appliance converts all input power into resistive heating.

cues.title: 热鸡蛋放入冷水
cues.titleEn: A hot egg enters cold water
cues.caption: 鸡蛋降温、水升温，共同趋于平衡。
cues.captionEn: The egg cools and the water warms toward equilibrium.
cues.zh: 把刚煮好的热鸡蛋放入冷水。鸡蛋温度下降，水温上升，能量从较热的一侧传向较冷的一侧。在这个理想隔热模型里，鸡蛋失去的能量正好等于水获得的能量。共同温度由两者的热容量决定，不一定是起始温度的简单平均。
cues.en: Place a freshly cooked hot egg in cold water. The egg cools while the water warms: energy moves from hotter to colder. In this ideal insulated model, the egg’s energy loss equals the water’s gain. Their shared equilibrium temperature depends on both heat capacities, not necessarily the arithmetic mean of initial temperatures.

cues.title: 从相同温度开始
cues.caption: 能量守恒并不保证任意过程都能自发发生。
cues.captionEn: Energy conservation does not make every process spontaneous.
cues.zh: 现在重新设置一组同温的鸡蛋和水。没有温差，就没有净传热，也不会过一会自动变成热鸡蛋和冷水。假想的反向过程未必违反能量守恒，却不会自发发生。这正是教材用鸡蛋冷却讨论的另一层条件：宏观热过程具有方向性。
cues.en: Now reset the egg and water to the same temperature. Without a temperature difference, there is no net heat transfer and no spontaneous separation into hot egg and cold water. That imagined reverse process need not violate energy conservation, yet it does not occur spontaneously. Macroscopic thermal processes also have directionality.

cues.title: 不发可见光也有辐射
cues.caption: 室温辐射以红外为主。
cues.captionEn: Room-temperature thermal radiation is mainly infrared.
cues.zh: 换到炉膛中的铁块。室温时看不到它自己发出的可见辉光，但它仍在辐射电磁波，主要分布在红外波段。下方光谱的浅色区域表示可见光，峰值在更长的波长处。我们平常看到冷铁块，主要依靠它反射的环境光。
cues.en: Move to an iron block in a furnace. At room temperature it has no visible self-emitted glow, yet it radiates electromagnetic energy, mainly infrared. The shaded spectrum band marks visible wavelengths; the peak lies farther out. Ordinary viewing of a cool block depends mainly on reflected environmental light.

cues.title: 可见辐射增强
cues.caption: 温度升高，短波部分显著增强。
cues.captionEn: Heating strengthens the shorter-wavelength portion.
cues.zh: 逐渐提高铁块温度。可见波段的辐射越来越强，铁块开始出现暗红的辉光。光谱峰值向较短波长移动，但出现可见光并不意味着峰值已经进入可见区。曲线分别按峰值归一化，只用来比较形状；相同曲线高度不代表相同的总辐射功率。
cues.en: Raise the iron’s temperature. Visible radiation strengthens and a dim red glow appears. The spectral peak shifts toward shorter wavelengths, but visible emission does not mean the peak has entered the visible band. Curves are individually normalized to compare shape; equal plotted peak heights do not mean equal total emitted power.

cues.title: 更热的铁块
cues.caption: 可见占比继续增加，屏幕颜色不是温度计。
cues.captionEn: Visible fraction rises; screen color is not a thermometer.
cues.zh: 继续升温，可见辐射显著增强，屏幕上的亮部逐渐饱和。教材描述了由暗红到更明亮颜色的变化，但实物颜色还受表面、环境和观察曝光影响。这里保持在铁熔点以下，光谱峰值仍在红外。用波长分布解释现象，比把颜色直接对应一个精确温度更可靠。
cues.en: At higher temperature, visible radiation strengthens and bright display channels approach saturation. The textbook describes the progression from dark red to brighter colors, but real appearance also depends on surface, surroundings and exposure. This model stays below iron’s melting point, with an infrared spectral peak. Use the spectrum rather than treating color as an exact thermometer.

cues.title: 发射与到达
cues.caption: 电磁波传播需要时间。
cues.captionEn: Propagation takes time.
cues.zh: 教材的两组铜管分别组成发射和接收天线。发射端间隙放电后，变化向外传播，接收端要等波到达才有响应。这里把纳秒过程极度放慢。场的线段表示极性和到达顺序，不是空气或电荷从发射管一路流到接收管。
cues.en: The textbook’s copper-tube pairs form transmitting and receiving antennas. After a discharge at the transmitter gap, the disturbance travels outward and the receiver responds only after arrival. Nanosecond events are greatly slowed here. Field strokes indicate polarity and arrival, not air or electric charges flowing all the way between antennas.

cues.title: 改变天线距离
cues.caption: 对齐同一波包阶段，再比较响应。
cues.captionEn: Align the packet phase before comparing response.
cues.zh: 保持两组铜管平行，逐渐增大距离。为了公平比较，画面对齐同一脉冲到达后的相同时刻。理想远场的电场振幅随距离减小，平方律检波后的相对响应下降得更快。实际房间里还会有反射和近场影响，不能把这里的精确比例直接当成实测结果。
cues.en: Keep both antenna pairs parallel and increase separation. For a fair comparison, observations use the same time after packet arrival. Ideal far-field electric amplitude falls with distance, and square-law detected response falls faster. Reflections and near-field effects can alter classroom measurements; the model’s exact ratio is not claimed as measured data.

cues.title: 发射停止之后
cues.caption: 在途电磁波继续前进，接收响应随后衰减。
cues.captionEn: The wave continues in transit; the detected response then decays.
cues.zh: 发射端的这一次放电已经结束，正在途中传播的波却不会立刻消失。波包继续到达接收天线，随后接收指示逐渐衰减。这里使用带检波与平滑的射频指示模型，因为普通直流表不能直接把高频交变电流读成稳定示数。教材没有给出表内电路，所以这项假设单独说明。
cues.en: Emission has ended, but the wave already in transit does not vanish instantly. The packet continues to the receiver, followed by a decaying indication. This model includes RF detection and smoothing because a bare DC meter cannot directly display stable high-frequency AC strength. The textbook does not specify its internal circuit, so that assumption is explicit.

cues.title: 只改变亮度
cues.caption: 相同内容与时间，分开比较一个因素。
cues.captionEn: Hold content and duration fixed to isolate one factor.
cues.zh: 把同一部模型手机分两次测试。两次播放相同视频，音量和网络条件也一样，只改变屏幕亮度。画面的组件功率随设置变化，耗能则随时间累积。所有数值是合成教学数据，用来练习研究设计，不代表任何一款手机的实际耗电。
cues.en: Test the same model phone in two runs. Both play the same video at equal volume and network conditions; only brightness changes. Component power responds to settings while energy accumulates over time. All values are synthetic teaching data for study design, not actual energy use of a particular phone.

cues.title: 只改变音量
cues.caption: 有声内容保持相同，才是音量对照。
cues.captionEn: Keep audible content identical for a volume comparison.
cues.zh: 恢复相同亮度，这次只改变音量。两次必须播放同一段有声内容，不能一边静音浏览，一边播放音乐。在模型里，没有声音输出的浏览任务不会因为音量设置改变就增加音频功率。控制变量不仅是滑块数值相同，也要保证实际执行的内容相同。
cues.en: Restore equal brightness and change only volume. Both runs must play the same audible content; silent browsing versus music is not a volume-only comparison. In this model, a browsing task without sound does not gain audio power merely from changing volume. Controlled settings must also correspond to identical actual content.

cues.title: 比较不同任务
cues.caption: 固定设置与时长，再观察任务差异。
cues.captionEn: Fix settings and duration before comparing tasks.
cues.zh: 比较浏览、聊天、电话、视频、录音重放或游戏时，保持亮度、音量和网络条件一致，并使用相同测量时长。处理器、无线通信和音频的工作情况不同，组件贡献也不同。这里的任务档案是示例，不能把演示中的顺序当作所有手机通用的耗电排名。
cues.en: When comparing browsing, chat, calls, video, audio playback or games, keep brightness, volume, connectivity and duration fixed. Processor, radio and audio activity differ, changing component contributions. These task profiles are examples; their order is not a universal energy-use ranking for all phones.

cues.title: 识别混杂与读数限制
cues.caption: 同时改变多个条件，就不能做单一归因。
cues.captionEn: Multiple changed conditions prevent a single-factor conclusion.
cues.zh: 现在把亮度和网络负载同时提高。即使耗能变多，也不能说全部差异来自亮度。短时间内，两次电池图标还可能显示同一个整数百分比，掩盖真实的能量差。真实研究需要足够分辨率的测量、相同初始状态和重复比较；记录设置与不确定度，才能给出有边界的结论。
cues.en: Now increase brightness and network load together. Higher energy use cannot all be attributed to brightness. Over short durations, both battery icons may show the same integer percentage despite different energies. A real study needs adequate measurement resolution, equal initial states and repeated comparisons. Record settings and uncertainty to support a conclusion with clear limits.

cues.title: 剪绳看离开方向
cues.titleEn: Cut the string and observe departure
cues.caption: 拉力消失，瞬时速度沿切线保留下来。
cues.captionEn: Tension vanishes while tangent velocity remains.
cues.zh: 细线牵引小球在光滑水平桌面上转动，拉力一直指向中心。把细线剪断以后，小球不再沿圆周走，也不是沿半径向外飞出，而是保持剪断瞬间的速度，沿切线前进。这个观察说明，维持圆周运动需要不断改变速度方向的力；一旦这项约束消失，就不再发生同样的转弯。
cues.en: A string pulls a ball around a smooth horizontal table, with tension directed inward. Cutting it ends the circle. The ball neither continues curving nor departs radially: it retains its instantaneous tangent velocity. Circular motion requires a continuing force to change direction; removing that constraint removes the turn.

cues.title: 辨认手感中的张力
cues.titleEn: Identify the tension felt by the hand
cues.caption: 张力还有竖直分量，不能完全当成向心力。
cues.captionEn: Tension also has a vertical component and is not entirely centripetal.
cues.zh: 在绳的一端悬挂小沙袋，让它在水平面内转动。教材提醒我们，手感受到的张力并不完全等于向心力，因为沙袋还受到重力。实际绳子略向下倾斜，张力的竖直分量托住沙袋，水平分量才使它转弯。改变绳长和转速时，本片同时计算倾角和圆周半径，不把任意水平半径强加给受力不平衡的沙袋。
cues.en: Swing a small bag on a string in a horizontal circle. The textbook notes that hand tension is not entirely centripetal because gravity also acts. The inclined string has an upward component supporting the bag and a horizontal component turning it. Changing string length or angular speed recomputes inclination and orbit radius rather than imposing an arbitrary unbalanced circle.

cues.title: 看清演示器如何测力
cues.caption: 球压挡板，经杠杆改变测力套筒位置。
cues.captionEn: Ball pressure moves a spring sleeve through a lever.
cues.zh: 向心力演示器用塔轮带动两个旋转槽。小球随槽转动，挡板向内推小球；球对挡板的反作用通过推杆和杠杆传到弹簧测力套筒。套筒位置经校准后显示力的大小。先让两边质量、半径和角速度都相同，检查两边读数一致，再开始控制变量比较。不能只看到套筒运动，就跳过球受到哪个力的问题。
cues.en: Stepped pulleys drive two rotating channels. A stop pushes each ball inward; the ball’s reaction passes through a pushrod and lever to a spring sleeve. Calibrated sleeve position indicates force. Begin with identical masses, radii and angular speeds and check equal readings. Follow which force acts on the ball rather than treating sleeve movement as an unexplained measurement.

cues.title: 只改变质量
cues.caption: 同半径、同角速度，质量加倍使力加倍。
cues.captionEn: At fixed radius and angular speed, doubling mass doubles force.
cues.zh: 保持两边转动半径和角速度相同，换上一颗质量为原来两倍的球。它的转弯方式没有改变，但维持同样加速度需要的合力加倍。仪器右侧的读数因此变为左侧的两倍。这个比较隔离了质量的影响，不能同时换更大的半径或改变塔轮档位，否则就不再是单一变量实验。
cues.en: Keep radii and angular speeds equal and double one ball’s mass. Its acceleration pattern is unchanged, but twice the mass requires twice the net force. The right reading doubles. This isolates mass: changing radius or pulley ratio at the same time would destroy the single-variable comparison.

cues.title: 只改变半径
cues.caption: 同质量、同角速度，半径加倍使力加倍。
cues.captionEn: At fixed mass and angular speed, doubling radius doubles force.
cues.zh: 把两球质量调回相同，保持角速度相同，只把右侧轨道半径加倍。右侧向心力也加倍。这里保持的是角速度，不是线速度；较大半径的球每秒走过更长的弧，线速度也变大。讨论半径增大时力如何改变，必须明确还保持了哪个速度量，不能脱离控制条件单独判断。
cues.en: Restore equal masses and angular speeds, then double the right orbit radius. Its force doubles. Angular speed is held fixed, not linear speed; the larger circle carries the ball farther each second. Any statement about increasing radius must specify which speed quantity remains controlled.

cues.title: 只改变角速度
cues.caption: 塔轮使角速度加倍，向心力变为四倍。
cues.captionEn: A pulley change doubles angular speed and quadruples force.
cues.zh: 保持质量和半径相同，把传动带移到另一档塔轮，使右侧角速度变成左侧两倍。测力结果变成四倍，说明这里的角速度关系是平方关系。结合前面的质量和半径比较，可以用质量乘角速度的平方再乘半径表达向心力。三次比较分别改变一个量，才构成相互支持的证据。
cues.en: Keep mass and radius fixed and change the stepped-pulley ratio so the right angular speed doubles. Its force becomes four times larger, revealing a square dependence on angular speed. Together with the mass and radius comparisons, this gives force equal to mass times angular speed squared times radius. Each controlled comparison supplies a distinct part of the evidence.

cues.title: 漏斗里是谁推球转弯
cues.titleEn: What turns the ball inside a funnel?
cues.caption: 斜向支持力与竖直重力同时存在。
cues.captionEn: Oblique support and vertical gravity act together.
cues.zh: 在光滑玻璃漏斗内，小球可以短时间沿某一水平圆周运动。它没有连着绳子，却仍然需要向心合力。漏斗壁对球的支持力斜向上、斜向内，重力竖直向下。观察球与漏斗面的接触位置：支持力沿表面法线，并不是沿轨迹的切线。这个装置帮助我们识别不同场景里由谁提供转弯的作用。
cues.en: A ball can briefly orbit horizontally inside a smooth glass funnel. No string is attached, but a radial resultant is still needed. Surface support points upward and inward while gravity points down. Support is normal to the funnel surface, not tangent to the path. This apparatus identifies a different interaction providing the turn.

cues.title: 向心力是合力的名称
cues.caption: 竖直分量抵消，水平向内分量留下。
cues.captionEn: Vertical components cancel, leaving the inward horizontal part.
cues.zh: 把两种力一起看，支持力的竖直分量与重力抵消，剩下的水平向内分量使小球转弯。因此不能在重力和支持力之外再画一个独立的向心力；向心力只是这些真实相互作用合成后的作用效果。本片选择满足水平匀速圆周条件的角速度，改变圆周半径时也同步更新它，使轨迹与受力保持一致。
cues.en: Combine the forces. The vertical part of support cancels gravity, leaving an inward horizontal resultant that turns the ball. Do not add another independent centripetal force to support and gravity; the term describes their combined effect. The model chooses an angular speed satisfying horizontal circular balance and updates it when radius changes, keeping force and motion consistent.

cues.title: 把细绳的两端固定
cues.caption: 绳长必须大于两个图钉的距离。
cues.captionEn: Thread length must exceed pin separation.
cues.zh: 把白纸铺在木板上，按上两枚图钉，再把同一根细绳的两端分别系在图钉上。铅笔顶住绳子，使它始终张紧。注意这里的细绳只有从第一个图钉到笔尖、再到第二个图钉的两段，没有沿两图钉之间再绕一段。绳长要大于图钉间距，笔尖才能围出一条闭合曲线。
cues.en: Place paper on a board and attach the two ends of one thread to two pins. Push a pencil against the thread to keep it taut. The thread runs from the first pin to the pencil and then to the second pin; no extra segment joins the pins. Its length must exceed their separation so the pencil can trace a closed curve.

cues.title: 两段长度相加
cues.caption: 一段变长，另一段相应变短。
cues.captionEn: As one segment grows, the other shortens.
cues.zh: 移动铅笔，观察两段绳长。靠近一个图钉时，这一段变短，另一段就变长。画面下方把两段长度接成同一条长度带，它们的总和始终等于细绳长度。正是这个约束决定笔尖能到哪些位置。两枚图钉的位置叫作焦点，椭圆的中心则在两个焦点的中点。
cues.en: Move the pencil and watch both thread segments. Approaching one pin shortens that segment while lengthening the other. The length ribbon joins both contributions, keeping their sum equal to the thread length. This constraint determines every reachable pencil position. The pins are the foci; the center lies halfway between them.

cues.title: 留下完整轨迹
cues.caption: 到两焦点距离之和不变，形成椭圆。
cues.captionEn: A constant sum of distances to two foci traces an ellipse.
cues.zh: 让铅笔绕着两个图钉走完一周，始终保持细绳张紧。每一个留下的点都满足同样的距离和条件，因此形成椭圆。经过长轴端点时，两段绳长相加正好等于长轴长度。所以绳长的一半就是半长轴。这个作图帮助理解教材中的椭圆形状，但没有给出天体运行的动力学。
cues.en: Guide the pencil once around both pins without letting the thread slacken. Every drawn point has the same sum of distances to the foci, producing an ellipse. At a major-axis endpoint, the two segments sum to the full major-axis length. Half the thread length is therefore the semimajor axis. This construction explains the geometry, without supplying planetary dynamics.

cues.title: 让焦点逐渐靠近
cues.caption: 保持绳长，焦点重合时得到圆。
cues.captionEn: With fixed thread length, coincident foci give a circle.
cues.zh: 现在仍用同样长的绳，把两个图钉逐渐向中心移近。长轴没有改变，短轴却逐渐变长，椭圆越来越圆。最后两个焦点重合，两段绳都从同一个位置到达笔尖，长度相同，各占总绳长的一半。此时半长轴成为圆的半径。自由探索可以改变焦点距离，检查每种形状是否仍满足同一个距离和。
cues.en: Keep the same thread and move the pins toward the center. The major axis stays fixed while the minor axis grows, making the curve rounder. When both foci coincide, the two segments run from the same point to the pencil and have equal length. Each is half the total thread, and the semimajor axis becomes the circle radius. Explore other separations and check the same distance sum.

cues.title: 让下落留下位置记录
cues.caption: 先通电，再释放；等时间隔打点。
cues.captionEn: Start the timer before release; dots mark equal time intervals.
cues.zh: 先接通打点计时器，再让重物带着纸带自由下落。点与点的时间间隔相同，但间距逐渐增大。纸带首先记录的是位置，不是直接记录能量。量出两点的距离，就得到重物下降的高度差；接下来还要独立求速度。画面是按运动方程生成的示例记录，用来说明测量方法，并非某次真实实验的数据。
cues.en: Start the ticker timer before releasing the load. Equal time intervals produce growing dot spacing. The tape records positions, not energy directly. Distance between selected dots gives the drop in height; speed must also be obtained independently. These example records are generated from motion equations to explain the method, not taken from a physical experiment.

cues.title: 用相邻三点求速度
cues.caption: 中间时刻速度等于前后两点间平均速度。
cues.captionEn: Middle-time speed equals the average across its two neighboring dots.
cues.zh: 在两处各选相邻三个点。计时器每零点零二秒打一个点，因此前后两点相隔零点零四秒。用这段距离除以时间，就得到中间时刻速度；对于匀变速运动，这个关系严格成立。再分别计算单位质量的势能减少和动能增加。质量会在等式两边约掉，所以这套比较可以不另测重物质量。
cues.en: Choose neighboring triplets at two locations. At fifty dots per second, the outside dots are separated by forty milliseconds. Their displacement divided by that interval gives the middle-time speed exactly for constant acceleration. Calculate potential and kinetic changes per unit mass separately. Mass cancels from both sides, so this comparison does not require weighing the load.

cues.title: 保留不相等的结果
cues.caption: 阻力使机械能减少，不把差值强行归零。
cues.captionEn: Resistance removes mechanical energy; do not force the difference to zero.
cues.zh: 现在加入一个小的向上阻力，重新生成纸带。速度仍从位置点算出，但重力势能的减少大于动能的增加。两者之差对应阻力做的负功。真实装置中的空气阻力、纸带摩擦和测量误差都值得检查，不能为了验证定律而把差值改成零。这里的恒定阻力只是帮助辨认影响的教学模型。
cues.en: Add a small upward resistance and generate a new tape. Speeds still come from positions, but gravitational energy lost now exceeds kinetic energy gained. The difference corresponds to negative work by resistance. Air drag, tape friction and measurement errors deserve investigation in real apparatus; the difference must not be edited away. Constant resistance here is an illustrative model.

cues.title: 让空气层减小阻力
cues.titleEn: Reduce resistance with an air layer
cues.caption: 滑块和遮光条一起沿倾斜气轨运动。
cues.captionEn: The slider and flag move together along the inclined air track.
cues.zh: 第二种方案把气垫导轨略微倾斜。气泵通过小孔送出空气，在滑块和导轨之间形成薄空气层，减小接触阻力。滑块经过两道光电门时，遮光条依次挡住光束。测量滑块连同遮光条的质量、两次测量位置的高度差以及两个速度，就能比较这段过程的机械能变化。
cues.en: The second design slightly tilts an air track. A pump feeds holes that form a thin air layer beneath the slider, reducing contact resistance. Its flag blocks each photogate in turn. Measure the slider and flag together, the vertical separation of the two measurement positions, and the two speeds to compare mechanical-energy changes during the descent.

cues.title: 挡光时间怎样变成速度
cues.caption: d/Δt 是过门平均速度，窄条才近似瞬时速度。
cues.captionEn: d/Δt is a passage average; a narrow flag approximates instantaneous speed.
cues.zh: 数字计时器记录的是光束被挡住的时间。遮光条宽度除以这段时间，得到通过光电门期间的平均速度。当遮光条很窄时，才把它近似当作门处的瞬时速度。模型按前后边缘实际到达的时刻计时，因此即使没有阻力，也保留有限宽度造成的小偏差。自由探索可以改变遮光宽度，检查偏差怎样缩小。
cues.en: The timer records how long the beam is blocked. Flag width divided by this interval is the mean speed during passage. Only a sufficiently narrow flag makes this a good approximation to instantaneous speed at the gate. The model computes actual edge arrival times, retaining a small finite-width bias even without resistance. Change flag width to see that bias shrink.

cues.title: 先选对研究系统
cues.caption: 滑块与悬挂物通过同一根不可伸长的绳相连。
cues.captionEn: Slider and hanging load share one inextensible cord.
cues.zh: 练习中的装置把气轨调成水平，由托盘和砝码拉动滑块。滑块本身不降低高度，失去重力势能的是悬挂物。但悬挂物和滑块都在加速，不能只计算滑块的动能。绳长不变，两端移动相同距离，速率也相同。画面用同一位移驱动两端，并用光电门记录通过速度。
cues.en: The exercise levels the air track and drives the slider with a hanging tray and masses. The slider loses no height; the hanging assembly supplies gravitational energy. Both accelerate, so both acquire kinetic energy. An inextensible cord gives equal travel and speed at both ends. One displacement drives the connected apparatus while the photogate records passage speed.

cues.title: 把两部分动能相加
cues.caption: 势能看悬挂质量；动能看全部运动质量。
cues.captionEn: Potential loss uses hanging mass; kinetic gain uses all moving mass.
cues.zh: 从静止释放到遮光条中心到达光电门，悬挂物下降的距离等于滑块的行程。势能减少用悬挂物总质量乘重力加速度和下降高度。动能却要用滑块、遮光条、托盘和砝码的总质量。只算滑块，会出现明显缺口；把悬挂物动能补齐后，理想模型只剩有限遮光宽度的小近似误差。
cues.en: From release to the flag center reaching the gate, the hanging assembly descends by the slider’s travel. Potential loss uses hanging mass times gravity and that distance. Kinetic gain uses the total mass of slider, flag, tray and weights. Counting only the slider leaves a visible gap. Including the hanging assembly leaves only the small finite-flag approximation error in this ideal model.

cues.title: 把摆动保留为可检验方案
cues.titleEn: Keep the pendulum as a testable proposal
cues.caption: 理想摆动说明条件，实际验证仍需测量。
cues.captionEn: An ideal pendulum illustrates conditions; verification still requires measurement.
cues.zh: 教材还提出用细线悬挂的小球作为方案。固定支点下，张力与瞬时运动方向垂直，不做功；忽略阻力时，重力势能和动能相互转化。这里从摆动方程求出位置和速度，再分别计算两种能量。但要完成真实实验，还必须设计高度和速度的测量，减小阻力，估计误差。不能把播放理想动画当成完成验证。
cues.en: The textbook also proposes a suspended bob. With a fixed pivot, tension stays perpendicular to motion and does no work. Ignoring resistance, potential and kinetic energies exchange. Here the pendulum equation supplies position and speed before energies are calculated. A physical test still needs height and speed measurements, resistance reduction and uncertainty estimates. Ideal animation is not experimental verification.

cues.title: 笔尖轻点水面
cues.caption: 波纹向外，纸屑在原位附近运动。
cues.captionEn: Ripples travel outward while paper moves near its mean position.
cues.zh: 先在水面放一片小纸屑，用笔尖轻点水面。波纹从接触位置向外传播，纸屑在波经过时局部起伏。下面放大的侧面显示这次起伏；纸屑不会一直跟着某一道波峰走向盆边。
cues.en: Place a small piece of paper on the water and tap once with a pen. Ripples move outward while the paper responds locally as they pass. The magnified side view reveals that motion: the paper does not keep following one crest to the rim.

cues.title: 重复轻点同一处
cues.caption: 振源不断产生波纹，纸屑仍只作局部运动。
cues.captionEn: Repeated waves do not carry the paper along with each crest.
cues.zh: 让笔尖周期性轻点同一位置。新的波纹不断产生，纸屑仍在同一片区域附近运动。这里保留小幅水平往复，并放大竖直起伏，不把真实水面运动简单画成永远只上下移动。
cues.en: Tap the same point periodically. New crests keep appearing while the paper remains near its mean position. The model retains small horizontal motion and magnifies vertical movement rather than claiming that real surface particles only move straight up and down.

cues.title: 平面波遇到挡板
cues.caption: 反射改变传播方向，入射角等于反射角。
cues.captionEn: Reflection changes direction, with equal incident and reflected angles.
cues.zh: 换成发波水槽。平板产生的平面波斜向到达挡板，再向另一方向传播。图中的短线表示法线，两条传播线分居法线两侧。角度都要从法线量起，不能从挡板表面量起。
cues.en: Now use a ripple tank. A plate produces plane waves that meet a barrier obliquely and reflect. The dashed line is the normal; the incident and reflected directions lie on its two sides. Both angles are measured from that normal, not from the barrier surface.

cues.title: 改变入射方向
cues.caption: 入射方向改变，反射方向按相同角度响应。
cues.captionEn: The reflected direction responds by the same angle.
cues.zh: 逐次改变入射方向，再比较两侧角度。建立后的波场由入射波与反射波叠加，表面高低在变化，但反射角始终等于入射角。自由探索可以停在任一角度检查传播线和波面。
cues.en: Change the incidence angle between trials. The established field contains incident and reflected waves together, so surface height changes in time. The reflected angle nevertheless remains equal to the incident angle. Pause to compare the rays and wavefronts.

cues.title: 波进入较浅水域
cues.caption: 频率不变，波速和波长减小，传播方向偏折。
cues.captionEn: Frequency stays fixed while speed, wavelength and direction change.
cues.zh: 水槽一侧放入浅水板，让水波跨越深浅交界。浅水侧的波速较小，波长也变短，斜向入射时方向向法线偏折。振源没有换频率，改变的是介质条件。
cues.en: A submerged plate makes one side shallower. Across the depth boundary, wave speed and wavelength decrease, and an oblique wave bends toward the normal. The source frequency stays unchanged; the medium has changed.

cues.title: 对比深度差
cues.caption: 深度差越小，方向和波长的变化也越小。
cues.captionEn: Smaller depth contrast produces smaller changes in direction and wavelength.
cues.zh: 改变浅水板上方的水深，每次都比较建立后的波场。深浅差别减小，传播方向和波长的差别也减小。在这里使用的长波近似下，波速与水深平方根成正比。
cues.en: Change the water depth above the plate and compare established fields. A smaller depth contrast produces smaller changes in direction and wavelength. In this long-wave approximation, speed is proportional to the square root of depth.

cues.title: 固定波长，改变狭缝
cues.titleEn: Vary the gap at fixed wavelength
cues.caption: 狭缝与波长接近时，缝后的展开更明显。
cues.captionEn: Spreading becomes more pronounced when gap width approaches wavelength.
cues.zh: 放入两块挡板，中间留下狭缝。保持波长不变，逐渐缩小缝宽。缝后波面向两侧展开得更明显，不能只按原来的直线传播方向猜测阴影区。这里比较方向展开，不用颜色强度比较能量。
cues.en: Place two barriers around a gap. Keep wavelength fixed and narrow the opening. The transmitted wave spreads more strongly to the sides, beyond a straight-line shadow prediction. Compare angular spreading here, not energy from colour intensity.

cues.title: 固定狭缝，改变波长
cues.caption: 决定明显程度的是缝宽与波长的相对大小。
cues.captionEn: Relative gap width and wavelength determine the visible spreading.
cues.zh: 这次保持狭缝不动，只改变波长。较短的波长使传播更接近直行，较长的波长让横向展开更明显。两条操作路径共同检验的是缝宽与波长的比值，而不是单独看缝有多宽。
cues.en: Keep the gap fixed and vary wavelength instead. Shorter wavelengths travel more nearly straight; longer ones spread more visibly sideways. Together these two trials test the ratio of gap width to wavelength, rather than gap width alone.

cues.title: 同一振动片带动双源
cues.caption: 固定相位差的双源形成稳定强弱区。
cues.captionEn: A fixed phase relationship creates stable reinforcement and cancellation regions.
cues.zh: 两根细杆连在同一振动片上，同步触动水面。颜色显示两列波相加后的瞬时高低。固定的M处起伏明显，N处相对平静。减弱不必完全静止，完全抵消还要求两列波在该点的振幅相等。
cues.en: Two rods attached to one driver dip together. Colour shows the instantaneous sum of both waves. The fixed M probe oscillates strongly, while N remains relatively quiet. Weakening need not mean perfect cancellation, which also requires equal amplitudes at that point.

cues.title: 分开驱动作对照
cues.caption: 改变相位会移动强弱区；频率不同则不再保持稳定图样。
cues.captionEn: Changing phase moves the pattern; different frequencies prevent a fixed pattern.
cues.zh: 将两根杆改为独立驱动。先改变固定相位差，强弱区的位置改变；再让频率略有不同，原先安静的N处开始随时间变化。不能让连接在同一刚性振动片上的杆凭空具有不同频率，所以装置也随对照更换。
cues.en: Use separate drivers for the comparison. A changed fixed phase difference shifts reinforcement and cancellation regions. A slight frequency mismatch makes the formerly quiet N probe vary with time. Independent frequencies require independent driving, so the apparatus changes too.

cues.title: 先观察静止振源
cues.caption: 相同周期发出的波峰有相同的圆心。
cues.captionEn: Crests emitted periodically by a still source share a centre.
cues.zh: 先让振源留在原位，周期性触动水面。每一道波峰都从同一个位置出发，在相同时间内传播相同距离，因此前后波峰间距相同。圆圈表示波峰，不表示一圈水同时向外搬走。
cues.en: Start with a source that stays in place. Every crest begins at the same point and travels the same distance in equal time, giving equal spacing ahead and behind. Circles mark crests, not rings of water moving bodily outward.

cues.title: 再让振源移动
cues.caption: 前方波峰更密，后方波峰更疏。
cues.captionEn: Crests are closer ahead and farther apart behind.
cues.zh: 振源边振动边移动，每个新波峰的出发位置都不同。已经发出的波峰仍以各自的发射位置为圆心向外传播，不会跟着振源改圆心。于是前方间距变短、后方变长，这与水质点的局部运动是不同的事情。
cues.en: Move the vibrating source. Each new crest starts from a different position, while earlier crests continue expanding about their original emission centres. They do not follow the moving source. Spacing contracts ahead and expands behind, a separate idea from local water-particle motion.

cues.title: 接住直径约一米的气球
cues.caption: 封闭空气也随气球运动，不能只算乳胶质量。
cues.captionEn: Enclosed air moves with the balloon and contributes inertia.
cues.zh: 教材要求接住一个充到直径约一米的大气球，再与同一乳胶放气后的情况比较。气球内空气并非没有质量：按球形体积和示例空气密度估算，内部空气约六百多克。这里从接触前速度相同开始比较，把乳胶与空气都计入动量；数值是教学估算，并非教材实测。
cues.en: The textbook compares catching an approximately one-meter inflated balloon with the same deflated latex. Its enclosed air has mass: spherical volume and an illustrative density give a little over six hundred grams. Starting from equal contact speed, the model includes both latex and air momentum. These numbers are teaching estimates, not measured textbook data.

cues.title: 放气后，用相同速度比较
cues.titleEn: Compare the deflated balloon at equal speed
cues.caption: 减少质量会减少需要改变的动量。
cues.captionEn: Less mass means a smaller momentum change to stop.
cues.zh: 放掉空气后，保留同一份乳胶。为了分开质量和接触时间的影响，先规定两次接触前速度和停止时间相同，所需冲量与力便随质量减小。真实投接还会受到空气阻力、形状和手的退让影响，因此只说充气气球更大，不能直接推出每次接球的力一定多大。
cues.en: Deflation retains the same latex. First prescribe equal incoming speed and stopping time so reduced mass lowers both impulse and force. Real catches also depend on drag, shape and hand motion. Size alone therefore cannot determine the exact force experienced in every catch.

cues.title: 保持动量变化，延长停止时间
cues.titleEn: Keep momentum change fixed and lengthen the stop
cues.caption: 冲量相同，平均力和峰值力可以改变。
cues.captionEn: The same impulse can accompany different average and peak forces.
cues.zh: 现在保持充气质量和初速度，改变接住它所用的时间。总动量变化保持不变，力作用得更久时，平均力减小。图中采用同一半正弦力脉冲，峰值也相应下降。气球外形只作保持体积的接触示意，未求解乳胶弹性、气压与手部组织的完整耦合。
cues.en: Hold inflated mass and incoming speed fixed while changing stopping duration. Momentum change stays constant while a longer stop lowers average force. The prescribed half-sine pulse also lowers its peak. Balloon deformation preserves volume as a contact illustration, not a coupled model of latex, pressure and hand tissue.

cues.title: 跟踪车辆在刚性壁障前的停止
cues.titleEn: Track a vehicle stopping at a rigid barrier
cues.caption: 车体位移、减速度与受力来自同一停止过程。
cues.captionEn: Vehicle motion, deceleration and force follow one stopping history.
cues.zh: 教材介绍约每小时五十千米的整车碰撞试验。这里以一千千克示例车的半余弦速度曲线示意，积分得到车体前进距离，求导得到减速度和合力。前端逐渐缩短表示压溃空间；这个过程没有真实材料和结构参数，不能冒充某辆车的碰撞测试。
cues.en: The textbook discusses vehicle impacts at about fifty kilometers per hour. A one-thousand-kilogram example uses a half-cosine velocity history. Integration gives displacement and differentiation gives acceleration and net force. Front shortening indicates crush space, without real structural or material parameters; it is not a specific vehicle test.

cues.title: 比较不同停止时间的力脉冲
cues.titleEn: Compare force pulses for different stop durations
cues.caption: 相同车速与质量给出相同总冲量，脉冲形状尺度不同。
cues.captionEn: Equal speed and mass give equal total impulse with different pulse scales.
cues.zh: 改变车辆停止时间，比较完整力曲线。车最终都停下，所以力对时间的积分相同；时间越短，峰值越高，同时停止距离更小。黄色线固定在同一观察时刻，用于比较不同输入。页面仅展示这种力学关系，不能据此完成乘员保护、车身完整性或碰撞安全等级评价。
cues.en: Changing stopping time changes the force pulse. Every vehicle ends at rest, so the integrated impulse is the same, while shorter duration gives a higher peak and shorter distance. The yellow line holds one observation time for comparison. This relation alone cannot evaluate occupant protection, structural integrity or crash ratings.

cues.title: 分开车辆受力与乘员受力
cues.titleEn: Separate vehicle force from occupant force
cues.caption: 乘员相对车体的运动由约束模型另行计算。
cues.captionEn: A separate restraint model determines occupant motion relative to the vehicle.
cues.zh: 乘员不是车体合力除以人数。示意乘员用七十千克集中质量，通过理想弹簧和阻尼与座椅连接，随车辆减速产生相对位移和约束力。上方读乘员约束力，下方仍画车辆合力，二者不能混用。真实试验要测头部、胸部等多处响应；本模型不预测伤害，也没有模拟气囊展开。
cues.en: An occupant’s force is not vehicle force divided by passenger count. A seventy-kilogram point mass couples to the seat through an ideal spring and damper. Its relative motion produces a separate restraint force. The upper readout shows that force; the lower plot remains vehicle force. Real tests measure multiple body responses. Injury and airbag deployment are not modeled.

cues.title: 先跟踪指尖和水滴
cues.caption: 关节相连，水滴脱离后继承释放速度。
cues.captionEn: Connected joints move together; a detached drop keeps release velocity.
cues.zh: 把一次甩手动作慢下来，跟踪肩、肘、腕和指尖。上臂、前臂与手掌都有自己的转动，但指尖同时继承这些运动。水滴脱离后不再跟着手指拐弯，而是沿脱离时的速度运动，再受重力改变方向。这里用独立关节模型解释过程，释放时刻预先指定，不能把它当作对液滴何时甩脱的预测。
cues.en: Slow a flick and follow shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingertip. Upper arm, forearm and hand all rotate, and the fingertip inherits their combined motion. Once detached, a drop no longer follows the hand’s turn. It keeps release velocity before gravity changes its path. This independent joint model prescribes detachment time; it does not predict an adhesion threshold.

cues.title: 速度方向也要相加
cues.titleEn: Add directions as well as magnitudes
cues.caption: 把每一段速度贡献首尾相接。
cues.captionEn: Join each velocity contribution head to tail.
cues.zh: 把上臂、前臂和手掌的速度贡献画成箭头，再首尾相接。合速度从第一个箭头的起点指向最后一个箭头的终点。即使几个贡献都很大，方向不同也不能直接相加速率。自由探索固定腕关节后，指尖轨迹和速度都会改变。模型中的分段长度与角度是教学示意，不是从教材原始照片拟合得到。
cues.en: Represent each link’s contribution as a velocity arrow and join the arrows head to tail. The resultant runs from the first start to the final endpoint. Large contributions with different directions cannot be combined by simply adding their magnitudes. Locking the wrist changes both fingertip path and speed. The illustrated lengths and angles are not fitted to the textbook photographs.

cues.title: 从照片读出速度
cues.caption: 实际长度标定比例，帧率给出时间。
cues.captionEn: A physical length calibrates scale; frame rate supplies time.
cues.zh: 现在回到教材实际给出的数据。先测肩膀到指尖的自然下垂长度，为六十五厘米，用它标定照片与实物的比例。视频每秒二十五帧，相邻两帧相隔零点零四秒。最后阶段指尖相邻位置相距二十六厘米，除以时间，得到平均速度六点五米每秒。画面只是把这组数据重新标明，并非原始照片。
cues.en: Return to the textbook’s reported data. A measured shoulder-to-fingertip length of sixty-five centimetres calibrates the photograph. Twenty-five frames per second gives forty milliseconds between frames. A final fingertip displacement of twenty-six centimetres then gives an average speed of six point five metres per second. The diagram restates these values rather than reproducing the original photograph.

cues.title: 局部圆周近似得到25g
cues.caption: 6.5²/0.17 约为249 m/s²。
cues.captionEn: 6.5²/0.17 is about 249 m/s².
cues.zh: 教材把运动末段近似为绕腕关节的圆周运动，测得腕到指尖约十七厘米。将六点五米每秒的速度平方除以这个半径，得到约二百四十九米每二次方秒，约为重力加速度的二十五倍。这是局部近似。一般情况下腕关节也在加速，严格的法向加速度需要从整个指尖轨迹求得，不能总把手掌长度当作曲率半径。
cues.en: The textbook approximates the final segment as circular motion about the wrist, with a measured radius of seventeen centimetres. Squared speed divided by that radius gives about two hundred forty-nine metres per second squared, roughly twenty-five g. This is a local approximation. A moving wrist can also accelerate, so exact normal acceleration requires the full fingertip trajectory, whose curvature radius need not equal hand length.

cues.title: 手机测的是手腕
cues.caption: 先确认测点、坐标轴和重力处理。
cues.captionEn: Establish measurement point, axes and gravity handling.
cues.zh: 手机不方便固定在指尖，教材改测手腕，并要求腕关节保持不转，手机长边与前臂平行。读数必须结合传感器位置、坐标轴和应用的处理方式理解。原始加速度计包含重力相关贡献，静止时也可能读到一个重力加速度；去除重力后的运动加速度才为零。画面比较这两种模型读数，不把它们伪装成教材的实测曲线。
cues.en: A phone is difficult to attach at the fingertip, so the textbook measures the wrist with wrist rotation suppressed and the phone aligned to the forearm. Interpretation needs sensor position, axes and app processing. A raw accelerometer includes a gravity-related contribution and reads about one g while stationary; gravity-corrected motion acceleration is zero. These displayed model readings are not the textbook’s recorded trace.

cues.title: 用手腕测量作量级检验
cues.caption: 约8×32，与约249量级接近。
cues.captionEn: About 8×32 is comparable to about 249.
cues.zh: 教材的另一次手腕测量给出约三十二米每二次方秒。照片估计指尖速率约为手腕的二点二倍，局部运动半径约为五分之三。按相同圆周近似，向心加速度比约为八，于是指尖约为二百五十六米每二次方秒，与前面的估算接近。这是带有共同假设的量级检验，不能因此忽略切向加速度、测量误差或增加有效数字。
cues.en: A separate textbook wrist measurement gives about thirty-two metres per second squared. Photographs suggest fingertip speed is about two point two times wrist speed, with a local radius about three-fifths as large. Under the same circular approximation, the acceleration ratio is about eight, giving roughly two hundred fifty-six. This is an order-of-magnitude cross-check with shared assumptions, not permission to ignore tangential acceleration or measurement error.

cues.title: 把问题延伸到投掷
cues.caption: 先跟踪出手前的手和枪，不虚构飞行数据。
cues.captionEn: Track the hand and spear before release without inventing flight data.
cues.zh: 书后把掷标枪列为参考研究选题。可以把助跑、躯干带动肩部，以及肘腕的运动分别记录，再讨论它们怎样影响出手速度。画面先固定肩的位置，观察手臂相对肩部的速度贡献。枪身与手保持连接，位置随关节计算。这只是用来组织研究问题的构型示意，并非运动员动作复现或训练指导。
cues.en: The book proposes javelin throwing as a further research topic. Record run-up, trunk and shoulder transport, and elbow and wrist motion before asking how they influence release velocity. First hold shoulder position fixed and inspect the hand’s relative velocity. The spear stays connected to the computed hand. This configuration organizes a research question; it is not an athlete reconstruction or coaching advice.

cues.title: 加入向前运动并提出测量
cues.titleEn: Add forward motion and define measurements
cues.caption: 同一关节动作，加上肩部平移速度。
cues.captionEn: Add shoulder translation to the same joint motion.
cues.zh: 保持同样的关节构型和相对运动，逐渐加入肩部向前的速度。手对地面的速度是相对肩部的速度加上肩部平移速度，两支箭头仍按矢量相加，方向也会改变。真实标枪研究还需测出出手方向、动作时序以及各段相互影响，不能只凭速率较大就宣称投得更远。本片到出手速度为止，不模拟离手后的空气动力。
cues.en: Keep joint configuration and relative motion unchanged while adding forward shoulder velocity. Ground-relative hand velocity is the vector sum of relative hand velocity and shoulder translation; the direction can change as well. A real javelin study must measure release direction, timing and segment interactions. Greater speed alone does not establish a longer throw. The model stops at release velocity and omits post-release aerodynamics.

cues.title: 先保存一个do音
cues.caption: 这条图线是同一测量位置的信号随时间变化。
cues.captionEn: The trace shows a signal at one measuring point changing over time.
cues.zh: 教材建议录下两个乐音，再暂停观察振动图像。先看这里明确标注的合成do示例，频率是二百六十四赫兹。横轴是时间，曲线不是声音在空间中走过的道路。自由探索可以真正采集自己的短片段。
cues.en: The textbook suggests recording two notes and pausing their waveforms. Begin with this explicitly synthetic do example at two hundred sixty-four hertz. The horizontal axis is time: the curve is not the sound’s path through space. Exploration can capture a real short microphone clip.

cues.title: 并排保存一个sol音
cues.caption: 同样的时间宽度里，sol完成更多次振动。
cues.captionEn: Over the same duration, sol completes more oscillations.
