cues.zh: 再加入三百九十六赫兹的sol示例。两条图使用完全相同的时间宽度，因此可以比较周期的长短。sol在同样时间里完成的振动更多，说明频率更高；不要把波形在竖直方向的高低当成音调。
cues.en: Add the sol example at three hundred ninety-six hertz. Both traces share exactly the same time width, allowing a fair period comparison. More sol oscillations fit into that duration, showing a higher frequency. Vertical amplitude should not be mistaken for pitch.

cues.title: 框住do的十个周期
cues.caption: 同一窗口中do有10个周期，sol有15个周期。
cues.captionEn: The same window contains ten do cycles and fifteen sol cycles.
cues.zh: 把矩形时间窗设成do的十个完整周期，约三十七点八八毫秒。在同一时间内，sol完成十五个周期，所以频率比是十五比十，也就是三比二。这采用教材列出的某种乐律数值，不把它说成所有调律都完全相同。
cues.en: Set the rectangular window to ten complete do cycles, about thirty-seven point eight eight milliseconds. Fifteen sol cycles fit into that same interval, giving a frequency ratio of three to two. These are the textbook’s particular tuning values, not a claim about every tuning system.

cues.title: 同时发出光与水下钟声
cues.titleEn: Emit a flash and underwater sound together
cues.caption: 接收船看到闪光后立即开始计时。
cues.captionEn: The receiving boat starts timing when it sees the flash.
cues.zh: 换成教材模拟的湖上实验。两条船相距十四千米，发射船敲响水下钟，同时发出闪光。另一船通过水下听音器接收钟声，并在看到光时开始计时。光的传播时间相对于十秒的声延迟很小。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s simulated lake experiment. Two boats are fourteen kilometres apart. Strike the submerged bell and emit a flash together. The receiving boat listens through an underwater horn and starts its clock on seeing the light, whose travel time is tiny compared with the sound delay.

cues.title: 等待水下声音到达
cues.caption: 钟声在水中传播，计时器记录两次接收之间的延迟。
cues.captionEn: Sound travels through water while the clock measures the arrival delay.
cues.zh: 观察水下波前向听音器靠近。画面压缩了船间的巨大距离，纵向水深也不是同比例。计时器显示的是模拟的实际秒数。钟声到达听音器时停止计时，教材给出的等待时间是十秒。
cues.en: Watch the underwater front approach the listening horn. The drawing compresses the large boat separation and uses a different vertical scale. The clock shows the simulated elapsed seconds. Stop when the bell is heard; the textbook gives a ten-second delay.

cues.title: 用路程除以传播时间
cues.caption: 14千米除以10秒，得到约1400米每秒。
cues.captionEn: Fourteen kilometres divided by ten seconds gives about 1400 metres per second.
cues.zh: 忽略约四十七微秒的光程，十四千米除以十秒得到约每秒一千四百米。这里复现的是教材模拟数据，不是把它当作当年原始记录。自由探索可改变距离与接收延迟，检查计算中千米和米是否统一。
cues.en: Neglecting about forty-seven microseconds of light travel, divide fourteen kilometres by ten seconds to obtain about fourteen hundred metres per second. These are the textbook’s simulated values, not the historical raw record. Change distance and delay in exploration while keeping the units consistent.

cues.title: 相同发声，不同到达相位
cues.caption: 到达相位还取决于传播路程。
cues.captionEn: Arrival phase also depends on path length.
cues.zh: 两只相同扬声器连到同一个信号源，同相发声。即使接收点到达的两个声音频率相同，传播路程也可能不同。因此它们到达时的相位关系要由路程共同决定，不能只看扬声器是否同时振动。
cues.en: Connect two identical speakers to one signal source so they emit in phase. The received sounds share a frequency, but their travel distances can differ. Their relative arrival phase therefore depends on both paths, not only on whether the speakers move together.

cues.title: 同一点，两路声压相加
cues.caption: 相反相位能抵消；振幅不等会留下残余。
cues.captionEn: Opposite phases cancel; unequal amplitudes leave a residual.
cues.zh: 接收点从中央稍稍移开，声音就明显减弱。放大同一个点，三条曲线共用一个时钟：第一路声压、第二路声压，以及它们的和。一边增压、另一边减压时，合声压变小。路程差为半个波长，两路相位相反。但距离不同，振幅不等，所以不能完全抵消。下方比较声压均方，不是声能的净流量。
cues.en: Move the receiver a little away from the centre: the sound weakens. Now zoom in on that same point. Three traces share one clock: pressure from source one, pressure from source two, and their sum. A pressure increase and a decrease partly cancel. A half-wavelength path difference puts them in opposite phase. Unequal distances mean unequal amplitudes, so a small residual remains. The indicator compares mean-square pressure, not net energy flow.

cues.title: 标出模型中的强弱位置
cues.titleEn: Mark the model’s loud and quiet points
cues.caption: 小范围寻位后，保留相同的标旗。
cues.captionEn: Search nearby, then preserve the same flags.
cues.zh: 按教材分成两组，同学们在附近小范围移动。白旗组寻找较强的位置，黑旗组寻找较弱的位置，找到后举旗。标旗的位置由同一个声场模型计算，保留下来就能看到空间中稳定的强弱分布。
cues.en: Divide students into the textbook’s two groups and let them move within a small neighbourhood. White flags seek louder positions and dark flags seek quieter ones. Once found, the flags are raised. These positions come from the same calculated sound field, revealing its stable spatial pattern.

cues.title: 旧弱点还能保持安静吗？
cues.titleEn: Will the old quiet point stay quiet?
cues.caption: 位置不动，波长改变会改变到达相位差。
cues.captionEn: At a fixed point, wavelength changes the phase difference.
cues.zh: 最后保留原来的标旗，只改变共同频率。两只扬声器仍然相干，但波长改变，同一条路程差对应的相位差也改变。原来的黑旗位置可能不再安静。这说明标旗不是器材固定的属性，而取决于当前声场。
cues.en: Leave the flags at their old positions and change the shared frequency. The speakers remain coherent, but wavelength changes, so the same path difference gives a different phase difference. A former quiet location may become loud. The pattern belongs to the current field, not permanently to the room’s positions.

cues.title: 等质量悬球
cues.caption: 一个特殊现象，先不要直接推广。
cues.captionEn: Observe the special case before generalizing.
cues.zh: 先让两个等质量的小球并排悬挂。拉起左球，再释放，理想弹性碰撞后左球停下，右球以相同速度离开，最终摆到原来的释放高度。看起来像是速度从一个球传给了另一个球。但要找普遍规律，还需要改变质量再试。
cues.en: Suspend two equal-mass balls side by side. Release the left ball: after ideal elastic impact it stops, while the right leaves at the same speed and rises to the original height. Velocity appears to transfer between balls. A general law needs another comparison with changed mass.

cues.title: 同大小，不同质量
cues.caption: 较重入射球可使轻球摆得更高。
cues.captionEn: A heavier incident ball can send the lighter one higher.
cues.zh: 把左球换成同样大小、质量更大的球，仍从相同高度释放。碰后左球继续运动，右球获得更大的速度，摆到更高的位置。速度之和已经不再与碰前相同。因此不能只看一个等质量案例就宣布速度守恒，需要把质量也纳入候选量。
cues.en: Replace the left ball with a heavier ball of the same size and release it from the same height. It keeps moving after impact, while the lighter ball leaves faster and rises higher. The velocity sum is no longer unchanged. Mass must enter the search for an invariant.

cues.title: 保留教材实测值
cues.caption: 动量近似相同，动能明显减少。
cues.captionEn: Momentum is approximately unchanged while kinetic energy decreases.
cues.zh: 再看教材给出的三组小车粘连数据。两车碰后共同运动，速度并不是原来速度的简单复制。按原值计算，质量与速度乘积之和近似不变，而动能明显减少。第一组的动量偏差约百分之二点二，画面保留这个偏差，不把实验数据改成完美守恒。
cues.en: Now examine the textbook’s three sticking-cart trials. The carts move together after impact, with a speed different from the incident speed. Using the printed values, total mass-times-velocity is approximately unchanged while kinetic energy decreases. The first momentum residual is about2.2 percent; it is retained rather than replaced by perfect conservation.

cues.title: 弹性架与光电门
cues.caption: 从完整遮光时间得到带方向的速度。
cues.captionEn: Use full flag transit and visible direction to obtain velocity.
cues.zh: 在调平的气垫导轨上安装弹性碰撞架。两个滑块接触后分开，较轻的左滑块反弹。光电门记录遮光片完整通过的时间，片宽除以时间给出速度大小；反弹方向让左滑块的碰后速度带负号。把这些有向速度乘以各自质量，再比较总动量。
cues.en: Fit elastic frames on a level air track. The gliders separate after contact, with the lighter left glider rebounding. Photogates record full flag transit time; width divided by time gives speed. Rebound makes the left final velocity negative. Multiply signed velocities by their masses and compare total momentum.

cues.title: 撞针插入橡皮泥
cues.caption: 粘连后，两滑块保持共同速度。
cues.captionEn: After sticking, both gliders share a velocity.
cues.zh: 换下弹性架，装上撞针与橡皮泥。碰撞后两滑块连成一体，间距保持不变，以共同速度继续前进。系统的水平动量仍守恒，却不意味着两个滑块的动能也守恒。装置中能看到的粘连，正对应模型中的完全非弹性碰撞。
cues.en: Replace the elastic frames with a pin and putty. After impact the gliders remain connected at fixed spacing and move with a shared velocity. Horizontal system momentum remains conserved, but kinetic energy need not. The visible sticking corresponds to the perfectly inelastic model.

cues.title: 由静止弹开
cues.caption: 动量相反，动能来自弹性势能。
cues.captionEn: Opposite momenta draw kinetic energy from the spring.
cues.zh: 把轻弹簧压在两个静止滑块之间，释放约束。两滑块向相反方向运动，较轻的一块速度更大，两个动量大小相等、方向相反。弹簧伸到自然长度后脱离并落下。滑块获得的动能来自弹簧原先的弹性势能，整个过程不能只检查动能一项。
cues.en: Compress a light spring between stationary gliders and release the constraint. They move oppositely, with the lighter glider faster and equal opposite momenta. At natural length the spring detaches and falls. The gliders’ kinetic energy comes from stored elastic potential energy, so kinetic energy alone is not the complete energy account.

cues.title: 用纸带读速度
cues.caption: 选取碰撞前后各自稳定的点距。
cues.captionEn: Select steady spacing before and after impact.
cues.zh: 换成小车和打点纸带，记录粘连碰撞。这里每五次打点取一个计数点，相邻计数点相隔零点一秒。碰前点距较大，碰后点距较小。测速必须选各自稳定的一段，不能把跨越碰撞过程的区间当成碰前或碰后的瞬时速度。
cues.en: Use carts and ticker tape to record a sticking collision. Every fifth dot gives counting points0.1 seconds apart. Spacing is larger before impact and smaller afterward. Choose stable sections on each side; an interval spanning the collision cannot represent either immediate pre- or post-collision velocity.

cues.title: 分别核对动量与动能
cues.caption: 理想弹性碰撞保持两种总量。
cues.captionEn: Ideal elastic impact conserves both totals.
cues.zh: 最后回到弹性碰撞架，分别计算总动量和总动能。两滑块的速度和方向都可能改变，但是理想弹性碰撞使这两个总量保持不变。动量是有方向的代数和，动能由速度平方计算；它们不是同一个量，也不能互相替代。
cues.en: Return to elastic frames and calculate total momentum and kinetic energy separately. Speeds and directions can change, but ideal elastic impact conserves both totals. Momentum is a signed sum, whereas kinetic energy depends on squared speed. They describe different quantities and cannot replace each other.

cues.title: 粘连时动能去哪了
cues.caption: 动量守恒不等于动能守恒。
cues.captionEn: Momentum conservation is not kinetic-energy conservation.
cues.zh: 再改为粘连，保持入射条件相同。总动量仍然相等，总动能却降低了。减少的机械能进入形变、内能等过程，能量并没有消失。真实弹性架也会有损耗，所以理想模型与实验测量应分开比较，并检查外力冲量是否足够小。
cues.en: Switch to sticking with the same incident conditions. Total momentum remains equal but total kinetic energy decreases. Mechanical energy goes into deformation, internal energy and other processes; it does not disappear. Real elastic frames also have losses, so distinguish ideal predictions from measurements and check that external impulse is negligible.

cues.title: 先把几何条件固定
cues.caption: 同直径、重球入射、出口水平。
cues.captionEn: Equal diameters, heavier incident ball, horizontal outlet.
cues.zh: 先选大小相同、质量不同的两球，让较重的一球作为入射球。把斜槽末端调成水平，用铅垂线在地面标出原点O。相同直径使碰撞时两球心处于同一高度，速度沿水平方向交换。画面中球真正接触时，球心相距一个直径，而不是让两个球重叠在同一点。
cues.en: Choose equal-size balls with different masses, using the heavier one as the incident ball. Level the outlet and use a plumb line to mark O on the floor. Equal diameters put the centers at the same height for horizontal head-on impact. At contact, the centers remain one diameter apart instead of overlapping at a single point.

cues.title: 拿走靶球，留下P
cues.titleEn: Remove the target and record P
cues.caption: 标记释放位置，建立碰前速度基准。
cues.captionEn: Mark the release point to establish the incident-speed baseline.
cues.zh: 先拿走靶球，让入射球从标记位置由静止滚下。它离开水平出口后做平抛运动，在纸面留下P。真实实验应多次释放，找出落点的代表位置并估计误差。这一次不需要知道具体速度，只要记录从铅垂原点O到P的水平距离。以后碰撞前的速度，必须与这一次保持相同。
cues.en: Remove the target and release the incident ball from rest at a marked point. It leaves horizontally and lands at P. A physical experiment repeats releases to find a representative landing position and estimate uncertainty. For now, record horizontal distance OP without calculating speed. The later collision must use the same incident speed as this baseline.

cues.title: 放回靶球，记录M和N
cues.titleEn: Replace the target and record M and N
cues.caption: 仍从同一高度释放，分别跟踪两球。
cues.captionEn: Release from the same height and track both balls separately.
cues.zh: 把轻球放回出口，仍从原标记高度释放重球。发生碰撞后，入射球速度减小，靶球向前飞出。镜头放大接触附近，两球的球心保持真实间距。入射球随后经过很短的水平托口，也从同一个出口飞出。两球起飞时刻略有先后，但从出口到地面的下落高度与初始竖直速度相同。
cues.en: Replace the lighter target and release the heavier ball from the same mark. The incident ball slows and the target flies forward. The contact detail preserves finite ball separation. The incident ball then crosses a very short horizontal lip before leaving from the same outlet. Launch times differ slightly, but both have equal drops and zero initial vertical velocity.

cues.title: 把速度比换成射程比
cues.titleEn: Replace speed ratios with range ratios
cues.caption: 同样的飞行时间，是换算成立的关键。
cues.captionEn: Equal flight time is the key to the substitution.
cues.zh: 把三组轨迹叠在同一个装置上。O是出口的铅垂投影，M和N是碰后两球的落点，P来自没有靶球的基准试次。三次飞行的竖直条件相同，所以飞行时间相同。水平距离等于水平速度乘飞行时间，于是三个距离可以按相同比例代表碰前和碰后的三个速度。
cues.en: Overlay the three paths on one apparatus. O is the outlet’s vertical projection; M and N are post-collision landings, while P comes from the target-free baseline. Equal vertical conditions give equal flight times. Since horizontal distance equals horizontal speed times flight time, the three distances represent the three velocities on one common scale.

cues.title: 比较质量加权距离
cues.caption: m₁·OP 对应 m₁·OM + m₂·ON。
cues.captionEn: Compare m₁·OP with m₁·OM + m₂·ON.
cues.zh: 把入射球质量乘OP，与入射球质量乘OM、靶球质量乘ON的和比较。这些量是质量乘距离，除以共同的飞行时间后才是动量。理想模型中两边相等。改变恢复系数，会改变速度分配和动能损失，却不改变水平方向动量守恒。真实测量应比较误差范围，不能强行把落点改到等式成立。
cues.en: Compare incident mass times OP with the sum of incident mass times OM and target mass times ON. These are mass-distance quantities; dividing by the common flight time gives momentum. The ideal model balances them. Restitution changes speed sharing and kinetic-energy loss without changing horizontal momentum conservation. Real measurements must be assessed with uncertainty, not adjusted to force equality.

cues.title: 故意改变一次释放高度
cues.caption: 基准不匹配，不能据此否定动量守恒。
cues.captionEn: A mismatched baseline cannot disprove momentum conservation.
cues.zh: 现在保留原来的P，却把碰撞试次的释放位置降低。两球碰后的射程都变短，质量加权距离之和也减小，看起来与原基准不相等。真正的碰撞仍满足动量守恒，问题出在P代表的速度已经不是本次碰前速度。每次比较都要保留相同释放位置、水平出口和相同落高，这些实验条件正是推理的一部分。
cues.en: Retain the old P but lower the release point for the collision trial. Both post-impact ranges shrink, reducing their mass-weighted sum relative to the old baseline. The actual collision still conserves momentum. The problem is that P no longer represents this trial’s incident speed. Matching release position, horizontal outlet and drop height is part of the experimental reasoning.

cues.title: 水平频闪记录
cues.caption: 水平频闪记录。
cues.captionEn: Horizontal strobe recording.
cues.zh: 把带孔的小球套在光滑水平杆上，连接轻弹簧。每隔零点零五秒取一次位置，下面的记录保留相同的时间间隔。把球心相对平衡位置的位移放到时间轴上，就得到振动图像。小球实际仍沿直线来回运动，图上的曲线不是它在空间中的运动路径。
cues.en: A light spring moves a pierced ball along a smooth horizontal rod. Record its position every zero point zero five seconds. The frames retain equal time intervals. Place displacement from equilibrium against each sampling time to obtain the oscillation graph. The ball still travels along a straight line; the curve is not its spatial path.

cues.title: 竖直录像记录
cues.caption: 竖直录像记录。
cues.captionEn: Vertical video recording.
cues.zh: 换成竖直悬挂的钢球，向上托起后释放。相机每隔零点零四秒拍一帧，把照片上端对齐，再比较钢球中心的位置。零位是钢球悬挂后静止的位置。重力已经让弹簧静态伸长，因此不能把弹簧原长的末端当成振动的零位。
cues.en: Hang a steel ball vertically, lift it and release. The camera takes a frame every zero point zero four seconds. Align the top edges and locate each ball centre. The origin is the loaded equilibrium position. Gravity has already stretched the spring, so its unstretched end is not the displacement origin.

cues.title: 铅笔与匀速拖纸
cues.caption: 铅笔与匀速拖纸。
cues.captionEn: Pencil and moving paper.
cues.zh: 笔尖只沿竖直方向往复运动，另一个人把纸向左匀速拉动，纸上便留下波形。这里纸速是每秒五厘米，所以纸面横向五厘米对应一秒。改变纸速会拉长或压缩图像的横向尺度，但不会改变笔尖本身振动的周期。
cues.en: The pencil moves only vertically while a second person pulls the paper left at constant speed, leaving a trace. At five centimetres per second, five centimetres along the paper represents one second. Changing paper speed stretches or compresses the horizontal scale without changing the pencil’s oscillation period.

cues.title: 累计十次计时
cues.caption: 累计十次计时。
cues.captionEn: Time ten oscillations.
cues.zh: 把钢球从向下拉开的位置释放，从同一个运动状态开始计时，计满十个全振动。完整往返才算一次，不能把每次经过零位都算成一个周期。累计时间除以十，得到本次周期。较长的累计时间有助于减小启停反应对单个周期的影响。
cues.en: Pull the ball down, release it, and time ten complete oscillations from the same motion state. A full return counts once; every passage through equilibrium is not a complete period. Divide total time by ten. Timing more cycles reduces the effect of start and stop reactions on one period.

cues.title: 振幅减半
cues.caption: 振幅减半。
cues.captionEn: Halve the amplitude.
cues.zh: 保持钢球质量和同一根弹簧不变，把初始振幅减半，再计十次。你会看到运动范围缩小，计得的周期保持相同。这一结论适用于线性回复力的简谐运动。真实弹簧在大变形时可能偏离胡克定律，因此实验还需要检查适用范围。
cues.en: Retain the mass and spring, halve the initial amplitude, and time another ten cycles. The range becomes smaller while the period stays the same. This result applies to simple harmonic motion with a linear restoring force. Real springs can depart from Hooke’s law at large deformations, so experiments must check that range.

cues.title: 同时释放
cues.caption: 同时释放。
cues.captionEn: Release together.
cues.zh: 把两个相同弹簧上的小球拉到同一高度，同时释放。它们一起到达端点、一起经过平衡位置，而且运动方向也相同。相同频率说明重复运动的快慢相同；此时连运动步调也一致，因此两球具有相同的相位。
cues.en: Pull two identical spring-mounted balls to the same height and release them together. They reach turning points together, cross equilibrium together and travel in the same direction. Equal frequency describes how often the motion repeats. Here the timing within each cycle also agrees, so their phases match.

cues.title: 延迟四分之一周期
cues.caption: 延迟四分之一周期。
cues.captionEn: Delay by a quarter-period.
cues.zh: 这次先释放左球，右球仍被托住。等左球第一次到达平衡位置，再释放右球，间隔正好是四分之一周期。之后两球的周期仍然相同，但端点和过零时刻都错开。右球的振动落后四分之一周期，不能因为频率相同就说相位也相同。
cues.en: Release the left ball while the right remains supported. Release the right when the left first reaches equilibrium, one quarter-period later. Both still have the same period, but their turning points and equilibrium crossings differ. The right oscillator lags by a quarter-cycle; equal frequency does not require equal phase.

cues.title: 保持弹簧改变质量
cues.caption: 保持弹簧改变质量。
cues.captionEn: Change mass with one spring.
cues.zh: 进入课题研究，先保留同一根弹簧，依次改变悬挂质量。每组都重新确定平衡位置，计十个全振动，完成后才把结果写入表格。质量增加时，周期变长，周期的平方与质量成正比。这里显示的是理想模型计时数据，真正实验需要称量负载，并记录自己的测量结果。
cues.en: For the research project, retain one spring and change only the hanging mass. Establish the new equilibrium, time ten complete oscillations, and enter the result after timing finishes. Increasing mass lengthens the period; period squared is proportional to mass. These are ideal model timings. A physical experiment requires weighing the load and recording independent measurements.

cues.title: 保持质量改变弹簧长度
cues.titleEn: Change spring length at fixed mass
cues.caption: 保持质量改变弹簧长度。
cues.captionEn: Change spring length at fixed mass.
cues.zh: 保持负载质量不变，取同一根均匀弹簧的不同长度。较短的一段有效圈数较少，因此劲度系数更大，振动周期更短。每一组仍然从完整计时得到周期，不把计算公式直接当成测量。这个模型忽略弹簧自身质量，实际研究还要用静态拉伸校准各段的劲度系数。
cues.en: Retain the load mass and select different lengths of the same uniform spring. A shorter segment has fewer active coils, greater stiffness and a shorter period. Each row still comes from complete timing, rather than treating a formula as a measurement. The model neglects spring mass; real research should also calibrate each segment’s stiffness using static extension.

cues.title: 固定蜂鸣器，建立基准
cues.caption: 声源和听者静止，收到的频率与发声频率相同。
cues.captionEn: A stationary source and listener give the same emitted and received frequency.
cues.zh: 竹竿端固定着电池和蜂鸣器，听者站在转轴外五米处。先让竹竿保持不动。每一个波面都从同一个位置发出，相邻波峰等间隔到达。这里发声频率设为六百赫兹，接收频率也是六百赫兹。画面已经放慢，便于观察波峰。
cues.en: A battery powers the buzzer at the end of a bamboo rod. The listener stands five metres from the pivot. First hold the rod still. Each wavefront leaves the same position, and successive crests arrive at equal intervals. Both emitted and received frequencies are six hundred hertz. Motion is slowed so the crests can be followed.

cues.title: 把蜂鸣器举过头顶旋转
cues.caption: 杆端靠近和远离听者，接收频率交替升高和降低。
cues.captionEn: As the rod end approaches and recedes, received frequency rises and falls.
cues.zh: 现在转动竹竿，蜂鸣器自身仍然每秒振动六百次。留意每个声波圆心，它停留在当初发出的位置，不会被竹竿拖着走。声源向听者靠近时，波峰到达得更密；远离时更疏。改变的是听者接收到的频率。
cues.en: Rotate the rod while the buzzer continues to oscillate six hundred times each second. Each circular front keeps its own emission centre; the rod does not drag an old front around. Approaching motion brings arrivals closer together, while receding motion spreads them apart. The changing quantity is the frequency received by the listener.

cues.title: 比较同一批波峰的到达记录
cues.caption: 发出间隔相同，到达间隔随传播路程改变。
cues.captionEn: Equal emission intervals become different arrival intervals as paths change.
cues.zh: 把同一批连续波峰排成两行刻度，并各自对齐第一条刻度。发出的时间间隔始终相等，到达的一行却会压缩或展开。声音需要传播时间，所以收到这一刻的频率，取决于那一声发出时蜂鸣器的运动，而不是画面此刻的位置。
cues.en: Compare two rows for the same consecutive crests, aligning the first tick in each row separately. Emission intervals stay equal, while arrival intervals contract or expand. Sound takes time to travel. The frequency heard now therefore depends on the buzzer’s motion when that sound was emitted, rather than its current displayed position.

cues.title: 站在队列旁数经过的人
cues.caption: 每人间隔2米、每秒前进1米：每分钟经过30人。
cues.captionEn: At 2 m spacing and 1 m/s, thirty people pass each minute.
cues.zh: 再换一种教材模拟。队伍匀速行走，相邻两人间隔两米，速度每秒一米。观察者站着不动，每两秒就有一人经过，对应每分钟三十人。这里的人代表向前传播的波峰，不能把他们当成原地振动的介质质点。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s queue analogy. People march at one metre per second with two metres between neighbours. A stationary observer encounters one person every two seconds, or thirty per minute. In this analogy people stand for travelling wave crests. They do not represent material particles oscillating around fixed positions.

cues.title: 观察者逆着队伍走
cues.caption: 间隔和队速未变，观察者每分钟遇到45人。
cues.captionEn: Spacing and queue speed stay fixed, but forty-five people are met per minute.
cues.zh: 让观察者以每秒半米逆着队伍走。队伍本身没有加速，人员间隔也没有改变；只是观察者和迎面的人更快相遇。相遇间隔缩短到三分之四秒，折合每分钟四十五人。虚线标出观察者当时的位置，计数来自真实经过它的人。
cues.en: Let the observer walk against the queue at half a metre per second. Neither marching speed nor spacing changes. The observer simply meets the approaching people sooner. Encounters are four-thirds of a second apart, giving forty-five per minute. The dashed line follows the observer, and the counter records people actually crossing that position.

cues.title: 顺着队伍走，但走得更慢
cues.titleEn: Follow more slowly than the queue
cues.caption: 观察者每分钟只遇到15人，接收频率降低。
cues.captionEn: Only fifteen people are met per minute, representing a lower received frequency.
cues.zh: 最后让观察者以每秒半米顺着队伍走，仍然慢于队伍。身后的人需要更长时间才能追到他，四秒才有一人经过，折合每分钟十五人。三个比较保留同一队伍和同样间隔，只改变观察者速度，就改变了单位时间接收的波峰数。
cues.en: Finally the observer walks with the queue at half a metre per second, still slower than the marchers. People behind take longer to catch up. One passes every four seconds, or fifteen per minute. All three comparisons preserve the same queue and spacing. Changing only observer velocity changes the number of crests received per unit time.

cues.title: 提起后释放
cues.caption: 提起后释放。
cues.captionEn: Lift and release.
cues.zh: 在均匀木筷的下端绕上铁丝，让它竖直浮在水中。向上提起一小段后释放，木筷开始上下振动。先只观察位置：高于平衡位置时，它会加速向下；低于平衡位置时，又会加速向上。接下来要用排水体积解释这种回复趋势。
cues.en: Wind iron wire around the lower end of a uniform wooden rod and float it upright. Lift it slightly and release. Above equilibrium it accelerates down; below equilibrium it accelerates up. First observe the motion, then explain this restoring tendency through displaced water.

cues.title: 浸入长度与回复力
cues.caption: 浸入长度与回复力。
cues.captionEn: Immersion and restoring force.
cues.zh: 木筷向上移动时，浸入长度变短，排水体积减少，浮力小于重力。向下移动时则相反。只要水面仍切过均匀的横截面，浮力的变化与位移成正比、方向相反。平衡位置的浮力已经抵消重力，所以这个变化量正是静水回复力。
cues.en: Upward motion reduces immersion and displaced volume, making buoyancy smaller than weight. Downward motion does the reverse. While the waterline cuts the uniform cross section, buoyancy changes proportionally and oppositely to displacement. Equilibrium buoyancy already cancels weight, leaving this change as the hydrostatic restoring force.

cues.title: 阻力与衰减
cues.caption: 阻力与衰减。
cues.captionEn: Damping and decay.
cues.zh: 真实水中运动会损失机械能。加入线性阻力后，木筷仍然来回运动，但每次到达的最高点和最低点越来越靠近平衡位置。图中的曲线只表示浮力减重力；合力读数还包含阻力。这个近似用来解释衰减，不模拟水花和复杂涡流。
cues.en: Motion in water loses mechanical energy. With linear drag, the rod continues oscillating but its extrema approach equilibrium. The graph shows buoyancy minus weight, while the net-force reading also includes drag. This approximation explains decay without simulating splashes or complex vortices.

cues.title: 完全浸没的边界
cues.caption: 完全浸没的边界。
cues.captionEn: The submersion boundary.
cues.zh: 增大初始提起距离，让木筷在向下运动时完全浸没。此时排水体积已经达到整根木筷的体积，再往下移动也不会继续增加。回复力图像变成平台，不能继续套用负的劲度系数乘位移。这个反例说明，简谐近似需要水面始终切过木筷的均匀截面。
cues.en: Increase the initial lift until the downward motion fully submerges the rod. Displaced volume then equals the entire rod volume and cannot increase with further depth. The restoring-force graph becomes flat, so a linear negative stiffness-times-displacement law fails. Harmonic behaviour requires the waterline to keep cutting the uniform rod section.

cues.title: 松开气口
cues.caption: 气体向后喷，气球向前加速。
cues.captionEn: Backward gas flow accelerates the balloon forward.
cues.zh: 把气球吹起来，捏住通气口，再松开。气体从开口喷出，剩余气球朝相反方向运动。画面保留喷口方向上的理想运动，镜头随后跟随气球，地面刻度继续向后移动。真实气球会摆动，压力也会变化；这里固定朝向、忽略阻力，只用来辨认喷出气体与气球之间的动量交换。
cues.en: Inflate a balloon, pinch its neck, then release it. Escaping gas sends the remaining balloon in the opposite direction. The illustration isolates motion along the nozzle axis; a following camera keeps the balloon visible as ground marks move backward. Real balloons wobble and change pressure. Fixed orientation and omitted drag here isolate momentum exchange, rather than predict a full trajectory.

cues.title: 把喷出的气体算进系统
cues.caption: 气球本身质量改变，完整系统动量仍平衡。
cues.captionEn: Balloon mass changes while complete-system momentum balances.
cues.zh: 随着气体离开，气球体积和剩余质量都减小。只看气球，会发现它的动量增加；把已经喷出的气体也算进来，两部分的动量变化互相对应。气体离开时的对地速度，需要用气球速度减去相对喷口的排气速度。模型按照每份气体的释放时刻累加动量，不能把它们都当作以同一个对地速度离开。
cues.en: Gas loss reduces volume and remaining mass. The balloon alone gains momentum; including all expelled gas restores the balance. Each parcel’s ground-relative exit velocity is balloon velocity minus exhaust speed relative to the neck. Momentum accounting uses each parcel’s own release time, rather than assigning all expelled gas one common ground-relative velocity.

cues.title: 在同一时刻比较喷口
cues.titleEn: Compare nozzle sizes at one time
cues.caption: 同压差，面积加倍，初始推力加倍。
cues.captionEn: Same pressure excess, twice the area, twice the initial thrust.
cues.zh: 现在比较两只初始条件相同的理想气球，只把其中一只的喷口面积加倍。压差相同时，相对排气速度相同，但较大喷口每秒排出的气体更多，初始质量流率和推力都加倍。两幅画面使用相同的时间与长度尺度，所以位移可以直接比较。这不是说喷口越大，最终一定飞得更远；实际压力、阻力与姿态还会影响过程。
cues.en: Compare identical ideal balloons, changing only one nozzle to twice the area. Equal pressure excess gives the same relative exhaust speed, but the larger opening passes more gas per second, doubling initial mass flow and thrust. Both views share time and distance scales. This does not establish that a larger opening always gives a longer real flight; pressure evolution, drag and orientation also matter.

cues.title: 让盛水容器自由转动
cues.titleEn: Let the water vessel rotate freely
cues.caption: 弯管沿切向喷水，容器绕悬点转动。
cues.captionEn: Bent pipes eject tangential jets and rotate the suspended vessel.
cues.zh: 换成教材中的可旋转盛水容器。水从下部两根弯管喷出，喷口朝向相反的切向，容器开始朝相反方向转动。两个喷口的平动效果相互抵消，但对竖直轴的力矩同向相加。跟踪同一根弯管，它的出口位置和水流方向一起转动，水滴离开后则按当时的绝对速度飞出并下落。
cues.en: Switch to the freely rotating water vessel. Two low bent pipes eject opposing tangential jets, turning the container oppositely. Net translation cancels while torques about the vertical axis add. Follow one pipe: its outlet position and direction rotate together. A released droplet keeps the outlet’s absolute velocity and then falls under gravity.

cues.title: 换一组反向弯管
cues.caption: 重新从静止开始，喷流和转向一起反向。
cues.captionEn: Start again from rest; reversing the jets reverses rotation.
cues.zh: 把两根弯管换成相反朝向，重新从静止开始这次试验。水位与孔径保持相同，喷出水携带的角动量方向改变，容器转向也随之反过来。水持续流出，剩余水量和转动惯量不断变化。容器转起来之后，水面略呈抛物面，这些变化都参与模型计算，不是只让外壳按固定速度旋转。
cues.en: Reverse both bends and start a new trial from rest. Keep water level and hole size unchanged. The expelled water’s angular momentum changes sign, so container rotation reverses. Continuous drainage changes remaining water and inertia. Rotation also makes the free surface slightly parabolic. These effects enter the calculation instead of merely spinning a decorative shell at fixed speed.

cues.title: 看角动量怎样流出
cues.caption: 出口绝对速度包含容器的转动速度。
cues.captionEn: Absolute exit velocity includes transport by container rotation.
cues.zh: 最后把容器与剩余水、已经喷出的水分开记账。绕竖直轴，它们的角动量变化彼此相反。出口相对流速还要加上容器旋转带来的速度，才能求出每秒带走多少角动量。这里同时更新排水量和转动惯量，并忽略轴承力矩。它与气球反冲有共同的动量交换思想，但转动装置不能直接套用一维火箭速度公式。
cues.en: Account separately for the container with remaining water and the water already expelled. Their angular-momentum changes about the vertical axis oppose each other. Relative jet speed must be combined with rotational transport to determine outgoing angular momentum per second. The model updates drainage and inertia while omitting bearing torque. The exchange idea resembles balloon recoil, but the one-dimensional rocket formula does not describe this rotating apparatus.

cues.title: 电机驱动两组弹簧
cues.caption: 电机驱动两组弹簧。
cues.captionEn: One motor drives two springs.
cues.zh: 电机曲柄上的销钉在横槽中滑动，让横梁上下运动。两组劲度不同的弹簧连接同一个横梁，下端钩码因此受到周期驱动。起动时，两组运动还混有各自的暂态响应。经过阻尼衰减后，它们都跟随电机频率，但振幅和相位可以不同。
cues.en: The crank pin slides inside a horizontal slot, moving the support vertically. Two springs with different stiffnesses connect to this shared support, driving the hanging weights periodically. Startup includes each system’s transient response. After damping removes those transients, both follow the motor frequency, although amplitude and phase can differ.

cues.title: 改变电机转速
cues.caption: 改变电机转速。
cues.captionEn: Change motor speed.
cues.zh: 提高电机转速，观察两组钩码都按新的频率振动。下面的测频来自后段运动实际经过零位的时刻间隔。两组弹簧的固有频率并不相同，但稳定受迫振动的频率都等于驱动频率。接近某一组的固有频率时，那一组的响应还可能明显增强。
cues.en: Increase motor speed and both weight systems follow the new frequency. The displayed measurements use later equilibrium-crossing intervals. The two springs have different natural frequencies, yet their settled forced frequency equals the drive frequency. A system’s response can also become stronger as the drive approaches its natural frequency.

cues.title: 重摆经横梁传能
cues.titleEn: A heavy pendulum drives the support
cues.caption: 重摆经横梁传能。
cues.captionEn: A heavy pendulum drives the support.
cues.zh: 换成共用横梁的七个摆，D 的摆球较重。把 D 拉开后释放，其他摆起初静止，随后通过横梁的微小运动获得能量。局部图把横梁位移放大二十倍，主图仍保留统一尺度。这里所有摆与横梁一起计算，所以轻摆的运动也会反过来影响重摆。
cues.en: Now use seven pendulums on a shared support, with a heavier bob at D. Release D while the others start at rest. Small support motions transfer energy to them. The inset enlarges support displacement twentyfold while the main view retains one scale. All pendulums and the support are solved together, including back reaction on the driver.

cues.title: 同长轻摆响应
cues.caption: 同长轻摆响应。
cues.captionEn: Matching-length pendulums respond.
cues.zh: A、D、G 的摆长相同，固有频率接近。观察一段时间，A 和 G 的响应比其他轻摆更明显。这个装置展示了频率接近时的能量传递。重摆释放后没有持续补能，能量会在各部分之间交换并逐渐损失，不能把某个瞬间的最大振幅理解成永久稳态。
cues.en: A, D and G have equal lengths and similar natural frequencies. Over the observation window, A and G respond more strongly than the other light pendulums. This demonstrates energy transfer between nearby frequencies. The released heavy pendulum receives no continuing energy input; energy exchanges and dissipates, so a momentary maximum is not a permanent steady state.

cues.title: 改变重摆长度
cues.caption: 改变重摆长度。
cues.captionEn: Retune the heavy pendulum.
cues.zh: 将重摆 D 缩短到与 B 相同的摆长，再重新释放。响应较强的轻摆也随之改变。判断共振时，不能只看摆球是否在动，而要控制驱动条件，比较一段时间内的振幅。真实装置的峰值还受阻尼和耦合影响，教材的同频最强是弱阻尼条件下的近似。
cues.en: Shorten heavy pendulum D to match B and release it again. The strongest responding light pendulum changes. To assess resonance, control the drive and compare amplitudes over a time window rather than merely checking whether a bob moves. Real peak response also depends on damping and coupling; the textbook’s matching-frequency rule is a weak-damping approximation.

cues.title: 滴墨摆与木板
cues.caption: 滴墨摆与木板。
cues.captionEn: Ink pendulum and board.
cues.zh: 用细线悬挂装有墨汁的注射器，让它来回摆动。木板沿着垂直于摆动的方向匀速移动，于是不同落墨时刻在板上对应不同的位置。墨滴离开针尖时还带有切向速度，经过一小段飞行才落下，所以画面把这些速度和延迟也算在里面。
cues.en: Suspend an ink-filled syringe and let it swing. The board moves uniformly perpendicular to the swing, giving different landing times different positions on the board. Drops retain the needle’s tangential velocity and take time to fall, so the scene calculates both the initial velocity and the flight delay.

cues.title: 墨迹与时间轴
cues.caption: 墨迹与时间轴。
cues.captionEn: Ink marks and time.
cues.zh: 木板速度保持每秒十厘米，板上的距离便可以标成时间。注意，这条曲线不是摆球走过的路径，而是墨滴落点随时间的记录。真实实验还要保持滴墨连续、木板匀速，并让注射器的运动尽量稳定；图像的形状不能脱离记录装置来解释。
cues.en: At a constant ten centimetres per second, board distance can be calibrated as time. This curve is not the bob’s spatial trajectory; it records ink landings over time. A physical experiment also needs consistent ink flow, uniform board motion and stable syringe motion. Interpret the graph together with the apparatus that produced it.

cues.title: 不同摆长累计计时
cues.caption: 不同摆长累计计时。
cues.captionEn: Time different lengths.
cues.zh: 分别选取零点四、零点七和一米的摆长，每组都保持小偏角，计满五个全振动。计时从过零开始，下一次同向经过零位才算完成一次。完整计时后才得到这一组的周期。三组记录来自同一个非线性运动模型，这里明确标作模型计时。
cues.en: Choose lengths of zero point four, zero point seven and one metre. Retain a small angle and time five full oscillations for each. Start at equilibrium; the next crossing in the same direction completes one cycle. Obtain each period only after timing finishes. All three rows come from the same nonlinear trajectory and are explicitly model timings.

cues.title: 比较周期平方与摆长
cues.caption: 比较周期平方与摆长。
cues.captionEn: Compare period squared and length.
cues.zh: 将不同摆长对应的周期平方画在纵轴，摆长画在横轴。小偏角下，这些点接近一条过原点的直线，支持周期平方与摆长成正比。用真实器材实验时，应先测量和作图，再用理论关系核对结果，而不是把公式计算值当成自己的实验数据。
cues.en: Plot period squared vertically and pendulum length horizontally. At small angles the points lie close to a line through the origin, supporting proportionality between period squared and length. With physical equipment, measure and plot first, then compare with theory; calculated values are not your own experimental measurements.

cues.title: 把长度量到球心
cues.caption: 把长度量到球心。
cues.captionEn: Measure to the centre.
cues.zh: 要用单摆测重力，首先把支点固定清楚，再量到球心。摆长等于摆线长度加上小球半径。右边放大图说明这一点，但主装置中的摆球保持比例。只量到小球上端会少算半径，后面代入周期公式时，就会让测得的重力加速度偏小。
cues.en: To measure gravity, establish a fixed pivot and measure to the bob centre. Pendulum length equals string length plus bob radius. The enlarged inset explains the radius while the main apparatus keeps scale. Measuring only to the top of the bob omits the radius and biases the inferred gravitational acceleration downward.

cues.title: 计二十个全振动
cues.caption: 计二十个全振动。
cues.captionEn: Time twenty full oscillations.
cues.zh: 保持小偏角，从摆球经过平衡位置开始计时，数二十个完整往返。总时间除以二十得到周期，再和支点到球心的长度一起计算重力加速度。教材提到惠更斯用过这种方法；这里展示的是模型测量过程，不把本页数值声称为巴黎的历史记录。
cues.en: Keep a small angle, start at equilibrium and count twenty full oscillations. Divide total time by twenty to obtain the period, then combine it with pivot-to-centre length to infer gravity. The textbook notes that Huygens used this method. These model measurements are not presented as historical records from Paris.

cues.title: 检查半径与计时误差
cues.caption: 检查半径与计时误差。
cues.captionEn: Audit radius and timing error.
cues.zh: 先看只量摆线时的结果，再把小球半径补上，比较重力反演值怎样改变。这里还保留零点三秒的累计启停误差，除以二十后，对单个周期的影响变小了。增加次数能减小这一项误差，却不能修正长度端点量错的问题。
cues.en: Compare the estimate using string length alone with the result after adding the bob radius. This example also retains a total start-stop timing error of zero point three seconds; dividing by twenty reduces its contribution to one period. Counting more cycles reduces this timing contribution but cannot correct a wrong length endpoint.

cues.title: 用杆线限制倾斜平面
cues.caption: 用杆线限制倾斜平面。
cues.captionEn: Constrain an inclined plane.
cues.zh: 最后看教材的杆线摆：轻杆和细线连接到同一转轴上的两个位置，共同约束摆球的运动平面。倾斜立柱，平面便相对水平面倾斜。铅垂线提供角度参照，静止杆与铅垂线的夹角为贝塔，平面倾角就是九十度减贝塔。
cues.en: The textbook’s rod-and-string pendulum connects a light rod and a string to two points on the same axis, constraining the bob’s motion plane. Tilting the support inclines that plane above horizontal. A plumb line provides the angle reference. If beta is the angle between the resting rod and vertical, plane inclination is ninety degrees minus beta.

cues.title: 计时检验等效重力
cues.caption: 计时检验等效重力。
cues.captionEn: Time effective-gravity motion.
cues.zh: 沿倾斜平面的重力分量提供回复作用，对应的等效重力加速度是重力加速度乘倾角的正弦。固定杆长，仍计二十个全振动。改变倾角就能在地面上改变等效重力，而不必假装真的改变了当地重力。若平面完全水平，这种重力回复作用就消失了。
cues.en: The gravity component within the inclined plane supplies restoring acceleration, equal to gravity times the sine of the inclination. Keep rod length fixed and time twenty full oscillations. Changing inclination varies effective gravity on Earth without changing local gravity itself. A fully horizontal plane removes this gravitational restoring action.

cues.title: 核对教材六组原始数据
cues.caption: 核对教材六组原始数据。
cues.captionEn: Audit six printed data rows.
cues.zh: 这张图使用教材第一百一十九页的六组原始数据，纵轴是周期，横轴是等效重力加速度平方根的倒数。数据点靠近一条过原点的直线，但并不精确落在线上，原来的偏差全部保留。它们支持反平方根关系，同时提醒我们区分真实记录、拟合直线和理想模型。
cues.en: This plot uses the six original rows on textbook page one hundred and nineteen. Period is plotted against the reciprocal square root of effective gravity. The points lie near a line through the origin rather than exactly on it, and their residuals are retained. They support the inverse-square-root relation while distinguishing recorded evidence, a fitted line and an ideal model.

cues.title: 慢动作与快振动
cues.caption: 手掌动作缓慢，不能把它的往复频率当成盆的声音频率。
cues.captionEn: Slow hand strokes are not the basin’s sound frequency.
cues.zh: 盆中倒入清水，两侧盆耳等待手掌摩擦。教材用这个古老器物提出问题：手动得很慢，为什么盆会嗡嗡作响，甚至喷水？先记住，手的往复频率，不能直接当作盆体的发声频率。
cues.en: Water sits in a bronze basin with a handle on each side. The textbook asks why slowly rubbing those handles can produce a hum and fountains. Keep one distinction in mind: the slow rate of hand strokes is not the frequency of the vibrating basin.

cues.title: 摩擦使微扰增长
cues.caption: 摩擦供能超过耗散时，小扰动逐渐变成明显振动。
cues.captionEn: A disturbance grows when friction supplies more energy than is lost.
cues.zh: 开始摩擦。注意能量条先缓慢上升，盆壁的振动也逐渐明显。适当的摩擦反馈可以给振动供能，这叫自激振动。非线性耗散限制继续增长，所以振幅不会无限增大。盆壁运动已经放慢并放大。
cues.en: Begin rubbing and watch the energy bar rise. Initially small wall motion becomes visible. Suitable frictional feedback supplies energy to the vibration: this is self-excitation. Nonlinear losses eventually limit its amplitude. The wall motion is deliberately slowed and enlarged so you can follow it.

cues.title: 四处强响应
cues.caption: 盆壁模态决定强弱分布，水花集中在四处强响应区。
cues.captionEn: The shell mode organizes four regions of strong water response.
cues.zh: 保持同一个铜盆，追踪水面四处增强的波纹。所选盆壁模态有四个振动腹，虚线投影标出它的节线。真实水面还有更细的波动；这里的水花只突出强响应的位置，不把喷水高度当成实测值。
cues.en: Track the four regions where the surface response strengthens. The selected shell mode has four antinodes; dashed lines project its nodal lines onto the water. Real surface motion contains finer waves too. These spray markers identify strong-response regions; their heights are not measured predictions.

cues.title: 对照六腹模态
cues.caption: 另一种耦合模态出现六处强响应，不等于加快手的往复。
cues.captionEn: Another coupled mode gives six regions, not simply faster hand strokes.
cues.zh: 现在切换所选模态。强响应区变成六处，空间分布随之改变。研究确实观察到不同数量的水花，也发现手部弹性会参与选模。这个按钮用于对照模态，不表示把手摩擦得更快，就一定会出现六处喷水。
cues.en: Now select another mode. Six regions replace the previous four. Experiments have observed different fountain counts and found that elastic hand dynamics can influence mode selection. This controlled comparison does not mean that merely moving your hands faster will reliably produce six fountains.

cues.title: 放开后逐渐衰减
cues.caption: 摩擦停止，供能归零，已有振动与水花逐渐消退。
cues.captionEn: Rubbing stops; stored vibration and spray gradually fade.
cues.zh: 停止摩擦，手掌不再继续供能。盆和水已经储存的振动能量不会瞬间消失，而是通过耗散逐渐减少。水花先变弱，随后不再形成。自由探索可以降低摩擦供能，检验弱供能无法让小扰动持续增长的边界。
cues.en: Stop rubbing. The energy already stored in the basin and water does not disappear instantly; losses gradually remove it. Spray weakens and ceases. In exploration, reduce the friction input and check the boundary: an input below the losses cannot sustain the growth of a small disturbance.

cues.title: 木栓小室说明了什么？
cues.titleEn: What do cork chambers tell us?
cues.caption: 先看隔壁和空腔，别把一张图当成整个学说。
cues.captionEn: Walls and cavities are evidence, not a whole theory.
cues.zh: 木栓里这些小室，足以说明所有生物的结构吗？先看留下的证据：一道道隔壁，围住了空腔。胡克在薄木栓片里看到的，主要是死细胞留下的细胞壁。这幅观察并没有告诉我们活细胞怎样工作，更没有显示新细胞从哪里来。要走向细胞学说，还得比较更多材料。
cues.en: Do these cork chambers tell us how all organisms are built? Look at the evidence: partitions enclose empty spaces. Hooke mainly saw walls left by dead cork cells. This observation does not show how living cells work, or where new cells come from. A broader theory needs comparisons with more material.

cues.title: 共同结构，新的来源解释
cues.caption: 比较支持共同基础；分裂证据修正细胞来源。
cues.captionEn: Comparison supports unity; division evidence revises cell origins.
cues.zh: 换成活的植物组织和动物上皮。形状不同，仍能辨认一个个细胞；多种材料的比较支持共同的细胞基础。但共同结构，不等于已经解释了细胞来源。曾有人认为新细胞像结晶一样形成。现在追踪一个已有细胞：这里略去核分裂，只看新隔壁逐渐把原来的空间分成两部分。这样的分裂观察，推动了细胞来源解释的修正。再看到组织生长，你会去找已有细胞的分裂，而不是只凭两张静态图片猜新细胞怎样出现。
cues.en: Compare living plant tissue with animal epithelium. Their shapes differ, yet individual cells remain recognizable. Many such comparisons supported a common cellular basis. But shared structure does not explain cell origins. One former idea pictured cells forming like crystals. Now follow an existing cell. Nuclear division is omitted here: a new partition divides its original space. Observations of division helped correct the explanation of new cell formation. When a tissue grows, follow existing cells through division; two unrelated still images cannot establish their lineage.

cues.title: 目标真的消失了吗？
cues.caption: 同一个目标还在，变小的是视野。
cues.captionEn: The target remains; the field becomes smaller.
cues.zh: 盯住带环的这一个细胞。低倍视野里能看见它，换到高倍，它却不见了。先别说细胞消失：在同一标本上，高倍只看见更小的一圈。目标原来的位置落在圈外。回到低倍，把它移到中央，再换高倍，同一个标记就留住了。变化的是我们能看见的范围，不是细胞凭空出现或消失。
cues.en: Follow the ringed cell. It is visible at low power, but disappears at high power. Has the cell vanished? On the same specimen, high power shows a smaller circle, and the target lies outside it. Return to low power, center the target, and switch again. The same marker remains. The visible region changed; the cell did not appear or disappear.

cues.title: 放大后，哪些推断成立？
cues.titleEn: What can a larger image establish?
cues.caption: 像变大，不等于细胞变大，也不保证新增细节。
cues.captionEn: A larger image is not a larger cell or guaranteed new detail.
cues.zh: 同一个细胞在高倍下占据更多画面，比例尺也一起变了。这里物镜从十倍到四十倍，视野直径变成四分之一，细胞尺寸没有改变。再比较叶细胞和动物上皮：绿色小体、形状和外壁可以不同，共同的细胞结构并不要求样样相同。最后，把同一幅模糊图像继续放大，原来分不开的细节并不会自动分开。所以，看不清的地方，不能直接说没有结构。
cues.en: The same cell fills more of the high-power image, and the scale bar changes with it. Here, a forty-times objective gives one quarter of the field diameter of a ten-times objective; the cell itself has not grown. Leaf cells and animal epithelium differ in shape and visible structures, yet share cellular organization. Now enlarge the same blurred image. Enlargement alone cannot recover missing detail. An unclear image is not evidence that a structure is absent.

cues.title: 绿色小体在哪里？
cues.caption: 叶绿体在细胞质中，中央液泡留下另一片空间。
cues.captionEn: Chloroplasts occupy cytoplasm around the central vacuole.
cues.zh: 选定一个叶细胞。绿色小体是叶绿体，中央淡色区域表示液泡。这个结构近景把不易看清的边界标出来：叶绿体在液泡周围的细胞质里，不在液泡里面。留下带环的叶绿体和同一处细胞壁，接下来比较它们的位置。这是解释图，不是新的显微照片。
cues.en: Choose one leaf cell. The green bodies are chloroplasts; the pale central region represents the vacuole. This explanatory overlay clarifies the boundaries. Chloroplasts occupy cytoplasm around the vacuole, not its interior. Keep the ringed chloroplast and a wall landmark for comparison. This close-up does not imply improved optical resolution.

cues.title: 整片在动，还是细胞里面在动？
cues.titleEn: Is the slide moving, or the cell interior?
cues.caption: 相对细胞壁的位置变化，揭示细胞内的运动。
cues.captionEn: Motion relative to the wall reveals movement inside the cell.
cues.zh: 叶绿体在画面里移动，细胞壁也跟着移动，这可能只是整张装片在漂移。现在固定同一处细胞壁作参照。带环的叶绿体沿周边改变位置，中央液泡仍在原处。这样的相对运动，支持这份黑藻材料中细胞质流动的观察。如果整张装片同时漂移，先扣掉细胞壁的共同位移，再判断内部有没有运动。
cues.en: A moving chloroplast can mislead us if the wall moves with it: the whole slide may be drifting. Now hold the same wall landmark fixed. The ringed chloroplast changes position around the periphery while the vacuole stays put. This relative motion supports the Hydrilla streaming observation. If both move across the screen, subtract the wall's displacement. What remains reveals movement inside the cell.

cues.title: 红色从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where does the red solid come from?
cues.caption: 红色固体中的铜，来自原来的蓝色试剂。
cues.captionEn: The red solid contains copper from the blue reagent.
cues.zh: 梨样液变红，是被试剂染红了吗？先看同样处理的水空白，它没有出现红色沉淀。放大红色颗粒，追踪其中的铜：它们来自原先含铜的蓝色试剂。还原性成分提供电子，铜的价态从正二变为正一，进入砖红色的氧化亚铜固体。这里显示的是净变化，糖的后续反应没有逐一画出。新物质的形成，才是这一现象的关键。
cues.en: Did the reagent simply dye the pear sample red? The water blank receives the same treatment, yet forms no red precipitate. Zoom into a particle and follow its copper. It came from the blue copper-containing reagent. Reducing components supply electrons; copper changes from oxidation state plus two to plus one in the brick-red copper(I) oxide. This is a net account, with the later sugar reactions omitted. The key is the formation of a new substance.

cues.title: 蔗糖为什么不变红？
cues.caption: 检测识别反应性质，不能只凭“糖”的名字。
cues.captionEn: The test responds to chemical behavior, not the name “sugar”.
cues.zh: 蔗糖明明也是糖，却没有同样的红色沉淀。区别藏在连接方式里：葡萄糖保留了能开环、进入反应性形式的结构；蔗糖把两个这样的中心连接在一起。现在先单独水解蔗糖，再恢复相同的检测条件。你预测会怎样？水解得到的葡萄糖和果糖能够呈阳性。不是糖的名字变了，而是结构和反应性质变了。所以一次阴性，不能推出没有糖；判读之前，还要确认阳性对照确实有效。
cues.en: Sucrose is a sugar, yet it gives no comparable red precipitate. Look at the connections. Glucose retains a center that can open its ring and access reactive forms. In sucrose, both such centers participate in the glycosidic link. Hydrolyze sucrose separately, then restore the same test conditions. What do you predict? The resulting glucose and fructose can give a positive test. The changed structure changes the response. A negative result therefore does not mean no sugar, and the positive control must work before we interpret it.

cues.title: 橙色去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does the orange dye go?
cues.caption: 有颜色的染料，更容易分配到脂肪中。
cues.captionEn: The colored dye preferentially partitions into lipid.
cues.zh: 花生薄片变橙，原因与刚才不同。看，苏丹染料还没接触脂肪就已经有颜色。放大一滴脂肪：这种亲脂性染料能在脂肪和周围液体之间来回交换，但会更多地分配到脂肪里。我们追踪的染料还是原来的染料，并没有把脂肪变成一种橙色新物质。富集的颜色让脂肪滴显形，不过周围的染液也会遮住细节。
cues.en: The orange peanut section tells a different story. Sudan dye is colored before it reaches the fat. Zoom into a lipid droplet. This lipophilic dye exchanges between the droplet and the surrounding liquid, but preferentially partitions into lipid. The tracked dye remains the same substance; the fat has not become a new orange product. The concentrated color reveals the droplets, although dye in the surrounding liquid can still hide their boundaries.

cues.title: 洗淡了，为什么更清楚？
cues.titleEn: Why does rinsing make the droplets clearer?
cues.caption: 背景变淡了，脂肪的数量没有增加。
cues.captionEn: The background fades; the amount of fat has not increased.
cues.zh: 洗过以后，脂肪滴更清楚了，是脂肪变多了吗？跟住同一颗脂肪滴，它的边界没有变。变的是背景：周围液体中的染料随着清洗液被带走，而脂肪暂时保留了较多染料。对比因此更明显。可是染料并没有永久锁在脂肪里。继续清洗，它也能逐渐离开。清楚的图像来自合适的对比，不等于样品含量增加。
cues.en: After rinsing, the droplets stand out. Has more fat appeared? Follow the same droplet: its boundary has not changed. Dye in the surrounding liquid leaves with the rinse, while the lipid temporarily retains more. That improves contrast. But the dye is not locked into the fat forever. With continued rinsing, it too can leave. A clearer image reflects better contrast, not an increase in the amount of fat.

cues.title: 紫色的铜，还是原来的价态吗？
cues.titleEn: Does violet copper have a new oxidation state?
cues.caption: 新物质、再分配、配位：变色的原因并不相同。
cues.captionEn: New substances, redistribution, coordination: color changes have different causes.
cues.zh: 最后看蛋清：双缩脲检测出现紫色，却没有刚才的砖红色固体。放大蛋白质的一段长链。在碱性条件下，链上的多个结合位置可以参与铜的配位，改变铜周围的环境和吸收光的方式。注意这个标记，铜仍然是正二价，并没有变成氧化亚铜中的正一价。现在回看三种颜色：新固体形成，原有染料重新分配，铜的配位环境改变。仅凭变色，不能判断是哪一种原因；还要看对照和发生变化的对象。
cues.en: Finally, the egg-white sample turns violet in the Biuret test, without the brick-red solid seen earlier. Zoom into a segment of the protein chain. Under alkaline conditions, several binding positions can coordinate copper, changing its surroundings and how the complex absorbs light. Watch the oxidation-state label: copper remains at plus two, rather than becoming plus one in copper(I) oxide. The three colors now have three causes: a new solid, redistribution of an existing dye, and a changed coordination environment. Color alone cannot tell them apart; the controls and the changing objects matter.

cues.title: 看不见，不等于没有光
cues.caption: 后方光屏亮着：两种样品都有光通过。
cues.captionEn: Both rear screens are lit: light passed through.
cues.zh: 同样的红光穿过两份样品。先别盯着烧杯，看看后方的光屏：两块都亮着，说明光都穿过了样品。可是从侧面看，氢氧化铁胶体中有明显光路，盐溶液中却不明显。为什么光明明在这里，我们却看不见它？眼睛要看见某处，必须有来自那里的光进入眼睛。接下来要追踪的，就是从原来向前的光束，到旁边眼睛的这段路。
cues.en: The same red light passes through two samples. Before looking inside them, inspect the rear screens. Both are lit, so light passed through both samples. Yet a side view reveals a clear path in the iron hydroxide colloid and no obvious path in the salt solution. How can light be there without being visible? To see a place, your eye must receive light from it. We need to trace the route from the forward beam to an eye beside it.

cues.title: 只挡住通往眼睛的光
cues.titleEn: Block only the route to the eye
cues.caption: 挡住侧向路径，眼睛变暗；直穿的光仍到达光屏。
cues.captionEn: Block the side path: the eye darkens, but the screen stays lit.
cues.zh: 现在从上方放大一个散射位置。跟着这段路径：光先从光源到达微粒，一部分继续向前，另一小部分向侧面传播，进入眼睛。只有到达眼睛的那一小部分，才让我们看见这里。检验这个解释，只需在微粒和眼睛之间插入遮挡片。看，侧面的眼睛收不到光了，后方光屏却仍然亮着。光没有在样品里消失，是入眼的路线被截断了。移开遮挡片，这条路线恢复，眼睛也重新收到光。
cues.en: Look down on one enlarged scattering site. Follow the route: light reaches the particle. Some continues forward, while a small part travels sideways into the eye. Only the part reaching that eye makes the location visible to this observer. We can test the explanation by inserting a blocker between particle and eye. The side observer now receives no light, yet the rear screen stays lit. Light has not disappeared inside the sample. Its route to the eye has been intercepted. Remove the blocker and that route opens again.

cues.title: 微粒怎样响应入射光
cues.titleEn: How the particle responds to light
cues.caption: 入射电场驱动电荷响应，变化的极化产生散射光。
cues.captionEn: The incident field drives a charge response that produces scattered light.
cues.zh: 微粒不是把光弹开的硬墙。再放大一点，光带来的电场先到达微粒，使里面的正负电荷分布发生相对位移。这里画出一种偏振下的响应，整个胶粒并没有这样上下运动。变化的极化产生向外传播的电磁场；看，其中一路到达了眼睛。散射光的能量来自入射光，频率也保持相同。现在关闭光源。先是入射的最后一段波到达，接着电荷响应停止，已经离开的散射波再传播到眼睛。最后眼睛变暗：微粒不会脱离光源继续发光。图中的速度和位移都经过了放大。
cues.en: The particle is not a hard wall bouncing light away. Zoom closer. The arriving electric field drives a relative displacement of positive and negative charge distributions. We show one polarization; the whole particle is not bobbing up and down. This changing polarization produces an outward electromagnetic field. One route reaches the eye. Its energy comes from the incident light, and its frequency stays the same. Now switch off the source. The final incoming wave arrives, the charge response stops, and the last scattered wave travels onward to the eye. Then the eye darkens. The particle does not keep glowing independently. Speeds and displacements are greatly exaggerated.

cues.title: 让解释预测新的现象
cues.caption: 同一个散射解释，接受稀释、换色与新场景的检验。
cues.captionEn: Test the same explanation by dilution, color and a new setting.
cues.zh: 一个解释如果有用，就应该能预测还没有看过的结果。现在换成透明小球的类比模型，保持大小和光源不变，减少颗粒。侧面收集的光变少，原方向直穿的比例却增大。下方同一份入射能量被分成直穿和首次散射两份，并没有凭空增加。再保持颗粒和入射功率相同，比较红光和蓝光。小粒子模型预测蓝光更容易被散射；这里侧向接收约是红光的三点八倍。最后离开烧杯，看暗室里的窗口光柱。沿着窗口、尘埃、眼睛这条路，仍然能解释为什么路径显现。但大尘粒、雾滴或多次散射不能套用刚才的数值比例。可迁移的是因果解释，数值模型要守住它的条件。
cues.en: A useful explanation should predict something we have not yet seen. Switch to an analogy of transparent small spheres. Keep size and illumination fixed while removing particles. Side collection falls, while more light continues unscattered. The strip divides the same incident energy into unscattered light and light scattered once; it creates no extra energy. Next, keep particles and incident power fixed and compare red with blue. The small-particle model predicts stronger blue scattering: about three point eight times as much side collection here. Finally leave the beaker for a shaft of window light. Trace window, dust and eye: redirected light still explains the visible path. But large dust, fog droplets and multiple scattering cannot use the same numerical ratio. Transfer the causal explanation while respecting the model’s limits.

cues.title: 固体中的离子
cues.caption: 干燥盐有离子，晶格却限制了它们的自由移动。
cues.captionEn: Dry salts contain ions, but the lattice prevents free movement.
cues.zh: 先把两根电极放入干燥氯化钠，再换成干燥硝酸钾。教材中检测灯都没有亮。两种盐都是由离子构成的，为什么还不能导电？关键在于晶体把离子约束在晶格位置附近。存在带电粒子只是一个条件；这些粒子还必须能够在整个样品中自由移动。图中的检测器只模拟这种响应。
cues.en: First compare dry sodium chloride with dry potassium nitrate. The textbook indicator does not light for either sample. Both salts contain ions, so what is missing? In the crystal, ions remain bound near lattice positions. Charged particles must also be able to move through the sample. Our ideal detector represents the contrast; it is not a calibration of the textbook bulb.

cues.title: 灯不亮的边界
cues.caption: 蒸馏水只有很少的离子，微弱电流可能低于显示阈值。
cues.captionEn: Distilled water has few ions, so its tiny current may be below the indication threshold.
cues.zh: 再看蒸馏水。画面中的检测灯没有亮，但精细的模型读数仍然不是零。水会微弱地自电离，所以绝对纯净的水也有少量可移动离子。教材特别提醒，蒸馏水导电能力很弱，灯泡不能显示，不代表完全没有电流。现实中的水还会受到溶入气体和杂质的影响。
cues.en: Now inspect distilled water. The light remains off, yet the model shows a small nonzero current. Water weakly self-ionizes, so even ideally pure water contains a few mobile ions. As the textbook notes, a bulb may fail to reveal such weak conduction. Real water can also acquire dissolved gases and impurities. A detection limit is a limit of the observation, not proof of an absolute zero.

cues.title: 溶解释放可移动离子
cues.caption: 两种盐溶于水后，原有离子分散到溶液中。
cues.captionEn: Dissolving either salt disperses its existing ions through water.
cues.zh: 把干燥盐换成盐溶液。观察放大图：原先整齐排列的正负离子分散开来，并没有凭空产生新的电子。氯化钠给出钠离子和氯离子，硝酸钾给出钾离子和硝酸根离子。在同样的电路里，溶液能够传递电荷。模型电流取决于离子浓度和迁移能力，数值是稀溶液近似，不是教材的实测记录。
cues.en: Replace the dry salt with its solution. In the enlarged view, the ordered ions disperse; dissolution has not created new electrons. Sodium chloride supplies sodium and chloride ions. Potassium nitrate supplies potassium and nitrate ions. Both solutions carry charge in the same circuit. Model current depends on ion concentration and mobility, using a dilute-solution approximation rather than claimed textbook measurements.

cues.title: 接通后才有定向迁移
cues.caption: 电离先于通电；正负离子向相反电极移动。
cues.captionEn: Dissociation precedes connection; opposite ions drift toward opposite electrodes.
cues.zh: 最后把已经溶解的样品暂时断开电路。离子仍然存在，只是没有外电场造成的定向迁移。重新接通后，阳离子向负极偏移，阴离子向正极偏移，两者都贡献同一个方向的电流。这里仅观察局部的短时间位移，省略电极表面的反应，不把离子画成永远穿过金属或在电极上无限堆积。
cues.en: Open the circuit after the salt has dissolved. The ions remain present; connection did not cause their formation. Close it again and positive ions drift toward the negative electrode while negative ions drift toward the positive electrode. Both motions contribute to the same conventional current. We show only a local, short-time displacement. Electrode reactions are omitted, rather than depicting ions passing through metal or accumulating indefinitely.

cues.title: 三份新鲜样液
cues.caption: 起始值相同，先保留可比的条件。
cues.captionEn: Begin at the same pH under comparable conditions.
cues.zh: 先把三份样液放在一起：水、磷酸盐缓冲液，以及生物材料的简化模型。每份都是二十五毫升，起始酸碱值也相同。玻璃探头读取的是同一个计算状态。这里的生物材料曲线不是肝匀浆实测值，而是用来比较缓冲作用的等效模型。
cues.en: Begin with water, phosphate buffer and an effective model of biological material. Each fresh sample contains twenty-five milliliters and starts at the same pH. The probe readings and curves share one calculated state. The biological curve represents buffering qualitatively; it is not a measured liver-homogenate result.

cues.title: 相同的酸进入
cues.caption: 水迅速变化，缓冲样液暂时变化较小。
cues.captionEn: Water changes sharply; buffer samples resist the addition.
cues.zh: 给三份样液加入相同浓度、相同滴数的酸。注意水的读数迅速降低，缓冲样液的变化较小。不是酸消失了，而是缓冲对中的一部分接受了氢离子。比较必须保持样液体积和滴加量一致，才能把不同响应归因于材料。
cues.en: Add the same concentration and number of acid drops to every sample. Water changes quickly, while the buffered samples change less. The acid has not vanished: one member of the conjugate pair accepts hydrogen ions. Equal volume and equal additions make the comparison meaningful.

cues.title: 继续滴加并记录
cues.caption: 缓冲对的组成在变，pH也逐步改变。
cues.captionEn: The buffer pair changes composition as pH moves.
cues.zh: 继续加到三十滴。缓冲不是把读数锁在七，而是让同样的扰动造成较小变化。每一个曲线点都来自电荷平衡；一对缓冲物质的总量保持不变。两条缓冲曲线并不相同，因为这里给它们设定了不同的有效容量。
cues.en: Continue to thirty drops. Buffering does not lock the reading at seven; it reduces the response to an addition. Every plotted point comes from charge balance, while the total conjugate-pair amount stays fixed. Different effective capacities give the two buffer samples different curves.

cues.title: 换新样液再加碱
cues.caption: 加碱比较必须从新鲜样液重新开始。
cues.captionEn: Compare base additions using fresh aliquots.
cues.zh: 现在重新取三份新鲜样液，再加入碱。不要把这一段理解成给刚才的酸性样液直接加碱，那会混入酸碱中和的影响。缓冲对可以朝相反方向转化，因此对加入碱也有缓冲作用，但容量依然有限。
cues.en: Start again with three fresh aliquots before adding base. This is not base added to the previously acidified samples, which would introduce neutralization of that added acid. The conjugate pair interconverts in the opposite direction, resisting the base addition within a limited capacity.

cues.title: 越过缓冲容量
cues.caption: 超过容量后，缓冲样液也会明显变酸。
cues.captionEn: A sufficiently large addition overwhelms the buffer.
cues.zh: 最后故意超出教材记录的三十滴范围，继续加酸。缓冲样液的读数也开始明显降低，说明缓冲作用有边界。真实生物体还依靠呼吸、排泄等调节维持内环境。这三个烧杯只解释化学缓冲，不能代表完整的人体调节系统。
cues.en: Now extend beyond the textbook’s thirty-drop record. Continued acid addition also drives the buffered samples to a much lower pH. Buffer capacity is finite. Living organisms additionally regulate their internal environment through processes such as respiration and excretion; these beakers isolate chemical buffering.

cues.title: 兴奋先到电极a
cues.caption: 两处都在膜外，读数是两点之差。
cues.captionEn: Two outside points; one difference.
cues.zh: 两个电极都放在神经表面。静息时，两处状态相同，电表没有偏转。兴奋从一端传来，先到达电极甲附近。这时甲与乙处的表面电位不同，指针才发生偏转。电表读的是两处之差，不是神经膜内外的电位差。
cues.en: Both electrodes sit on the nerve surface. Their resting states match, so the meter initially reads zero. Excitation reaches electrode a first, creating a difference from electrode b. The deflection reports that extracellular difference, not the voltage across the nerve membrane.

cues.title: 兴奋再到电极b
cues.caption: 同一束兴奋，先后产生相反偏转。
cues.captionEn: One excitation; opposite deflections.
cues.zh: 跟住同一条颜色带。当它越过甲、到达乙时，甲已经恢复，乙正在变化，于是差值换了符号。两次偏转不是两股相反传播的信号。探索时可以改变电极间距；把两点重合，差值归零，但这不表示神经没有活动。
cues.en: Follow the same colored band. By the time it reaches b, the surface near a has recovered, reversing the measured difference. Two deflections do not mean two oppositely traveling signals. Coincident electrodes read zero even when the nerve remains active, because they sample the same location.

cues.title: 跨膜电位改变
cues.caption: 离子流改变电荷，电荷变化产生电压。
cues.captionEn: Ion flow changes charge and voltage.
cues.zh: 现在换一个观察对象：膜内相对膜外的电位。兴奋时钠离子通道的变化允许钠离子内流，局部膜电位升高；随后恢复过程让它回到静息附近。曲线是标明尺度的教学波形，不是把表面电表的读数直接当成跨膜电位。
cues.en: Now observe voltage inside the membrane relative to outside. Increased sodium permeability permits inward sodium movement and depolarization, followed by recovery toward rest. This is a declared teaching waveform. It must not be confused with the two-electrode surface reading from the preceding experiment.

cues.title: 信号到达突触末梢
cues.caption: 递质穿过间隙，电压不直接跨过去。
cues.captionEn: Transmitter crosses the gap.
cues.zh: 来到两个神经元之间。末梢内的小泡靠近前膜，释放棕色递质示踪物。它们穿过突触间隙，接近另一侧的受体。这里跨越间隙的是化学信号，不是把前一个神经元的电位曲线原样搬进后一个神经元。
cues.en: At the junction between neurons, vesicles approach the presynaptic membrane and release the brown transmitter markers. The markers cross the cleft toward receptors on the other cell. A chemical messenger bridges this gap; the first neuron’s voltage waveform is not simply copied across it.

cues.title: 受体响应，再清除
cues.caption: 有递质，还需要受体能够响应。
cues.captionEn: Transmitter also needs a responsive receptor.
cues.zh: 递质与受体结合，改变突触后膜的通道状态，膜电位随之变化。接着递质被清除，作用减弱。探索中可以关闭释放，也可以让受体不响应。第二种情况下，间隙里仍有递质，却不能产生同样的突触后反应。
cues.en: Receptor binding changes postsynaptic channel state and membrane voltage. Clearance then reduces the effect. Exploration separates failure to release transmitter from an unresponsive receptor. With an unresponsive receptor, transmitter can still reach the other membrane without producing the same postsynaptic response.

cues.title: 金属连接的歧义
cues.caption: 出现收缩，仍需区分电的来源。
cues.captionEn: Contraction does not identify its source.
cues.zh: 回看生物电研究的历史。金属连接神经和肌肉时出现收缩，这是一项观察。但金属接触本身也可能引入电势差，仅凭收缩，还不能断定电只来自生物组织。下一步需要改变接触材料，让不同解释作出不同预期。
cues.en: Return to the historical experiment. A metal connection accompanies muscle contraction, but that observation alone does not uniquely locate the electrical source. Metal contacts can contribute a potential difference. Changing the contact condition lets competing explanations make different predictions.

cues.title: 去掉金属再比较
cues.caption: 去掉金属、断开通路，分别比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare no metal with no connection.
cues.zh: 再比较适当的组织接触，以及接触被断开的条件。无金属时仍然出现效应，说明金属不是所有这类现象的必要条件。断开通路又没有收缩。这里比较的是历史证据的逻辑，不是保证任意组织接触都会成功，也不演示动物操作。
cues.en: Compare appropriate tissue contact without metal with an interrupted connection. An effect without metal shows that a metal bridge is not always necessary. Breaking the route removes the effect in this comparison. These are historical evidence conditions, not animal procedures or a promise that arbitrary tissue contacts work.

cues.title: 先刺激心脏A
cues.caption: A变慢；B尚未接收到营养液。
cues.captionEn: A slows before any fluid reaches B.
cues.zh: 两颗保持活性的心脏各在一份营养液中，只有心脏甲保留这里要刺激的神经。刺激后，甲的跳动变慢，乙仍保持原来的相对频率。棕色标记表示释放到营养液中的信号，画面先把直接刺激和远处响应分开。
cues.en: Two viable hearts sit in separate fluid compartments. Only heart A has the nerve being stimulated here. A slows while B initially keeps its previous relative rate. Brown markers identify a signal entering the surrounding fluid, separating the directly stimulated heart from the recipient.

cues.title: 让液体去到B
cues.caption: 转移液体后，未连接神经的B也变慢。
cues.captionEn: After fluid transfer, the unconnected heart B also slows.
cues.zh: 把甲的一部分营养液转移给乙。甲的液面降低，乙的液面升高，同一份标记也跟着移动。乙没有连接甲的神经，却随后变慢。这支持某种可溶性化学信号随液体到达乙；转移本身还不能告诉我们它是哪一种分子。
cues.en: Transfer part of A’s fluid to B. The liquid levels change consistently and the same marked substance travels with that fluid. B has no nerve connection to A, yet its rate decreases. This supports a soluble messenger, although transfer alone does not identify its molecular structure.

cues.title: 稀释与对照
cues.caption: 液体不转移，或没有释放，B就缺少该信号。
cues.captionEn: Without release or transfer, B lacks the signal.
cues.zh: 转移之后，信号还会被清除，效应逐渐减弱。自由探索可以分别关闭刺激和转移：只让甲变慢，并不能让乙自动变化；转移未受刺激的液体，也不会带来同样的信号。显示的相对心率是模型结果，不是历史测量记录。
cues.en: Clearance gradually reduces the transferred signal. Exploration can independently remove stimulation or fluid transfer. Slowing A does not automatically slow B, and transferring unstimulated fluid lacks this released messenger. The relative-rate display is model output, not an original historical trace.

cues.title: 酸放在哪里
cues.caption: 小肠内加酸与血液内加酸产生不同结果。
cues.captionEn: Acid in the intestine and acid in blood give different outcomes.
cues.zh: 再看促胰液素的研究。把酸放进小肠，胰液分泌增加；直接把酸放进血液，不能得到相同结果。因此不能把酸本身当成沿血液传递的那个信号。画面中的收集杯只表示分泌是否增加，没有伪装成原始定量数据。
cues.en: Compare acid introduced into the intestine with acid introduced directly into blood. The intestinal route increases pancreatic secretion; the direct blood route does not give that result. The transported signal therefore cannot simply be identified with the acid itself. The collection vessel depicts a normalized outcome.

cues.title: 去掉神经保留血流
cues.titleEn: Remove the nerve, retain blood flow
cues.caption: 小肠神经被切断，分泌增加仍然出现。
cues.captionEn: Secretion still increases after denervation.
cues.zh: 保留血液联系，去掉小肠相关的神经联系，再把酸放进小肠。分泌增加仍然出现。这个对照削弱了只有神经才能传递这条信息的解释，但并没有证明真实消化过程完全不受神经调节。结论要紧贴实验改变的条件。
cues.en: Retain circulation while removing the relevant nerve connection, then introduce acid into the intestine. Secretion still increases. This challenges an exclusively neural explanation for the observed response; it does not show that the entire digestive system is independent of neural regulation.

cues.title: 转移黏膜提取物
cues.caption: 提取液进入血液后，胰腺作出响应。
cues.captionEn: A blood-borne mucosal extract produces a pancreatic response.
cues.zh: 把小肠黏膜相关的提取物送入血液，胰腺又出现响应。与前面的路径比较相连，这组证据支持小肠产生化学信使，再由血液把信息送到胰腺。我们追踪的是证据链，而不是让所有进入血液的物质都被叫作激素。
cues.en: A mucosal extract delivered through blood produces a pancreatic response. Combined with the route and denervation comparisons, this supports a chemical messenger originating in the intestinal mucosa and traveling in circulation. The conclusion comes from the linked controls, not from calling every circulating substance a hormone.

cues.title: 为什么有的分子更容易进去？
cues.titleEn: Why do some molecules enter more readily?
cues.caption: 先进入脂质，再穿膜：这是成分线索。
cues.captionEn: Entering lipid helps a molecule cross.
cues.zh: 同样的条件下，有的物质更容易进入细胞。欧文顿注意到，容易溶于脂质的物质往往也更容易穿膜。把屏障放大：在这个被动扩散模型里，分子要先进入脂质，再从另一面离开。其它条件相同时，更容易进入脂质，初始穿越也就更快。这支持膜含脂质，却不能告诉我们它排了几层。
cues.en: Under matched conditions, some substances enter cells more readily. Overton connected this behavior with lipid solubility. Zoom into an explanatory barrier: in this passive diffusion model, a molecule enters the lipid phase before leaving from the other side. With other factors fixed, easier entry into lipid increases initial passage. This supports a lipid component, but does not tell us how many layers there are.

cues.title: 为什么约两倍面积支持双层？
cues.titleEn: Why does roughly twice the area support two layers?
cues.caption: 先测面积，再检验一层和两层的预测。
cues.captionEn: Measure first; test one or two layers.
cues.zh: 膜太薄，看不清层数，可以先量面积。原研究把红细胞的总表面积，与提取脂质铺成单层的面积比较，后者约是前者的两倍。现在才比较假说：若原来只有一层，同样的分子占地应得到一倍面积；若有两层，就应得到两倍。把同一批分子折回两排，恰好说明这个关系。头接触水，尾藏在内部，也符合磷脂的两亲性。但如果提取时丢失脂质，面积比就会偏小，所以约两倍是有前提的证据。
cues.en: The membrane is too thin to resolve, so measure areas first. The original study compared estimated red-cell surface area with the area of extracted lipids spread into one layer. The latter was roughly twice as large. Now compare hypotheses. With equal molecular footprints, one original layer predicts one area; two layers predict twice that area. Folding the same molecules into two rows explains the relationship. Water-facing heads and inward tails also suit their amphiphilic nature. But losing lipid during extraction lowers the ratio: this evidence depends on its assumptions.

cues.title: 张力低，就能画出蛋白质外套吗？
cues.titleEn: Does low tension prove a protein coat?
cues.caption: 吸附能改变张力，却不能唯一确定排列。
cues.captionEn: Lower tension does not locate proteins.
cues.zh: 细胞表面的张力较低，是什么改变了界面？比较同样的油水界面：蛋白质吸附后，张力可以降低。这给研究者一个解释，膜中可能还有蛋白质。注意，能解释张力降低，并不等于已经看见蛋白质在哪里。同一个宏观结果，可能对应不同排列。要画出膜的结构，还需要新的证据。
cues.en: What changes an interface with low tension? Compare matched oil–water interfaces: adsorbed protein can lower their tension. This suggested a protein contribution to the cell surface. But explaining a lower tension does not locate the proteins. The same macroscopic result can be compatible with different arrangements. A structural model needs further evidence.

cues.title: 看见三条带，就知道三层成分吗？
cues.titleEn: Do three image bands identify three chemical layers?
cues.caption: 明暗不是成分标签，还需独立证据。
cues.captionEn: Contrast alone cannot name a substance.
cues.zh: 电镜里出现暗、亮、暗三条带，是否就能说两边都是蛋白质？先区分图像与解释。下面的曲线只记录明暗变化；让成像变模糊，条带也跟着改变，膜的成分却没有因此变化。过去的三层假说试图解释这幅图，但暗带本身没有写着蛋白质。更清楚的图像仍要和其它证据一起判断。
cues.en: Dark, light, dark: does that prove a protein layer on each side? Separate the image from its interpretation. The profile records contrast. Broaden the imaging response and the bands blur, without changing the modeled composition. The historical layered hypothesis tried to explain such images, but a dark band does not carry a chemical name. Even sharper images need independent evidence.

cues.title: 颜色混合，排除了哪一种膜？
cues.titleEn: What does marker mixing rule out?
cues.caption: 固定预测仍分区，混合观察支持可动。
cues.captionEn: Fixed markers stay apart; observed markers mix.
cues.zh: 在不同时间取样，融合细胞的两种来源标记，起初分区，后来混合。如果位置都固定，四十分钟后仍应分区，这与观察不符。现在换成侧向运动的解释模型：带环标记保留来源，只是随机改变位置。这条一维闭合路径不是原实验的连续轨迹。原研究还用抑制处理检验其它解释。可以移动，也不等于每个蛋白都毫无限制。固定一个，其余还会混合吗？
cues.en: Samples taken at different times show the two origins initially separated, then mixed. Fixed positions predict continued separation after forty minutes, unlike the observation. Now switch to an explanatory motion model. The ringed marker retains its origin while moving randomly. This one-dimensional closed path is not a continuous historical recording. The original study also tested alternatives with inhibitors. Mobility does not mean every protein is unrestricted. Anchor one: can the others still mix?

cues.title: 怎样把不同证据放进同一张膜？
cues.titleEn: How can one membrane model satisfy different evidence?
cues.caption: 面积、亲疏水与运动共同约束结构。
cues.captionEn: Area, water affinity and motion constrain structure.
cues.zh: 一个好的膜模型，要同时解释不同证据。提取脂质的约两倍面积支持双层；来源标记能混合，说明膜成分可以移动。再看分子的性质：亲水头接触两侧的水，疏水尾留在内部。蛋白质的性质和定位研究还支持不同嵌入方式，不能只靠融合实验确定它们的深度。流动镶嵌把这些约束放在一起：位置可以变，头尾方向和内外关系仍然保持。
cues.en: A membrane model must satisfy different evidence. The roughly doubled extracted-lipid area supports a bilayer; marker mixing supports mobility. Molecular properties add another constraint: hydrophilic heads contact water, while nonpolar tails remain inside. Protein properties and localization studies support different embedding arrangements; fusion alone does not establish their depth. The fluid mosaic combines these constraints. Positions may change while molecular orientation and the distinction between inside and outside remain.

cues.title: 做得像，还是解释得通？
cues.titleEn: Does the model explain, or merely resemble?
cues.caption: 用证据检验模型，也检验它的局限。
cues.captionEn: Evidence tests a model and its limits.
cues.zh: 用废旧材料做一张膜，怎样判断它解释得对不对？先把水的位置标出来：头应该接触水，尾不能朝外暴露。数量相同，方向错了仍然不合适。再用标记混合来检验：固定铁丝能表示双层，却不能展示分子换邻居。怎样让连接允许侧向移动，同时保持头尾方向？模型的价值，是保留要解释的关系，并说清它省略了什么。
cues.en: How do we judge a membrane built from reused materials? Mark the water first. Heads should contact it, with tails shielded inside. The same number of pieces in the wrong orientation is still unsuitable. Now test behavior against marker mixing. Rigid wire represents a bilayer but prevents components from changing neighbors. Could a movable connection preserve orientation while allowing lateral motion? A useful model retains the relationships it explains and states what it leaves out.

cues.title: 同样加水，为何一热一冷？
cues.titleEn: The same water, opposite temperature changes
cues.caption: 外观相似，加水后的变化不同。
cues.captionEn: Similar solids respond differently to water.
cues.zh: 两份白色固体，看起来很像。按教材比较，加少量水后，碳酸钠结块并放热，碳酸氢钠溶解时吸热；继续加水，剩余固体也不同。温度和溶解量给了两条线索，但还没有解释原因。先跟住其中一组离子，看看它与水的关系怎样改变。
cues.en: These two white solids look similar. In the textbook comparison, a little water makes sodium carbonate clump and release heat, while dissolving bicarbonate absorbs heat. More water also leaves different amounts of solid. Those are clues, not explanations yet. Follow one group of ions as its surroundings change.

cues.title: 能量的两笔账
cues.titleEn: Two sides of the energy balance
cues.caption: 分开原有作用需能；形成新的水合作用放能。
cues.captionEn: Separating interactions costs energy; hydration releases it.
cues.zh: 把离子从原有邻居中分开，需要能量；水分子转向阴离子，形成新的水合作用，又释放能量。两笔账相抵，决定净热方向。教材中，碳酸钠与水作用时净放热；换成碳酸氢钠，溶解时净吸热。箭头只表示方向，长度不是测得的热量。
cues.en: Separating ions from their old neighbours requires energy. Water turns toward the anion, forming new attractions and releasing energy. The balance determines the net heat flow. In this comparison, carbonate releases heat as it interacts with water; bicarbonate draws heat in as it dissolves. The arrows show direction, not measured amounts of heat.

cues.title: 名字里有氢，为什么仍显碱性？
cues.caption: 颜色是线索，名字不能决定酸碱性。
cues.captionEn: Colour is a clue; a name does not determine acidity.
cues.zh: 再看酚酞：两种盐的水溶液都呈碱性，碳酸氢钠的显色可以很淡。不要把名字中的氢当成酸性的保证。教材两份固体的质量相近，却不等于溶液浓度相同。为单独比较离子的作用，接下来另设两份等浓度的稀溶液。
cues.en: Both solutions are alkaline, although bicarbonate can give a very faint indicator colour. Having hydrogen in the name does not guarantee an acidic solution. Equal solid masses also do not give equal solution concentrations. We now switch to a separate comparison of dilute solutions at the same concentration.

cues.title: 跟住水中的这个氢
cues.caption: 碱性来自与水的平衡，钠离子不生成OH⁻。
cues.captionEn: Alkalinity comes from equilibrium with water, not from sodium making OH⁻.
cues.zh: 看被标记的氢从水移向碳酸根：它成为碳酸氢根，水的一部分则成为氢氧根。钠离子留在旁边，没有制造氢氧根。碳酸氢根既能接受也能给出质子。先看它从水接受一个质子，留下氢氧根；再看它把质子给水，形成水合氢离子。连同水和溶解二氧化碳的平衡，所示溶液最终仍略偏碱。画面追踪的是净变化和守恒，不是原子真实运动的录像。
cues.en: The marked hydrogen moves from water to carbonate. Carbonate becomes bicarbonate, leaving hydroxide. Sodium remains a spectator. Bicarbonate can both accept and donate protons. Watch it accept a proton from water, leaving hydroxide. Now let it donate a proton to water, forming hydronium. With water and dissolved carbon dioxide also in equilibrium, this solution is still mildly alkaline. These are conserved net changes, not a recording of atomic motion.

cues.title: 颜色变淡，离子就消失了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does fading colour mean the ions disappeared?
cues.caption: 加水降低浓度；同一份碳仍在体系中。
cues.captionEn: Water lowers concentration; the same carbon remains.
cues.zh: 现在给同一份溶液加水，不再添加盐。含碳粒子的总量保持，体积变大，各种离子的比例也重新调整。模型显示碱性减弱，酚酞可以变淡，甚至看不出颜色。由此预测：颜色消失不能证明盐已消失，也不能仅凭酚酞断言溶液恰好中性。
cues.en: Add water without adding more salt. The total carbon stays the same, while volume grows and the equilibrium readjusts. Alkalinity decreases, and the indicator may become too faint to see. Fading colour therefore does not prove that the salt vanished, or that the solution is exactly neutral.

cues.title: 加热后，白色固体还是原来的物质吗？
cues.titleEn: After heating, is the white solid unchanged?
cues.caption: 相同检验装置，先建立无明显分解的对照。
cues.captionEn: Use the same detector to establish the comparison.
cues.zh: 换到教材的加热实验。碳酸钠和碳酸氢钠原本都是白色，加热后也可能留下白色固体，所以外观不能作最后判断。先看碳酸钠：在教材条件下没有明显分解，石灰水保持澄清。保持同一条气路，再换成碳酸氢钠。
cues.en: Heating leaves another identification problem: a white residue need not be the original substance. Start with carbonate. Under the textbook conditions it shows no appreciable decomposition, and the limewater stays clear. Keep the same gas path and replace the sample with bicarbonate.

cues.title: 跟住离开的碳和氢
cues.titleEn: Follow the carbon and hydrogen that leave
cues.caption: 同一批原子分到残渣、水和CO₂中。
cues.captionEn: The original atoms enter residue, water and CO₂.
cues.zh: 这次有气体沿导管进入石灰水，产生白色沉淀，较冷处还可出现水滴。把两个碳酸氢钠单位放大：一个碳留在碳酸钠中，另一个进入二氧化碳；两个氢进入水。钠全部留在固体。原子只是重新分配，不能把这幅净变化图当成真实的一步反应机理。
cues.en: Gas now reaches the limewater and produces a white precipitate; water can condense in the cooler region. Enlarge two bicarbonate units. One carbon stays in carbonate, the other enters carbon dioxide, and the two hydrogens enter water. All sodium remains in the solid. This is a net atom account, not a one-step reaction mechanism.

cues.title: 用留下多少，检验你的解释
cues.titleEn: Test the explanation with the residue
cues.caption: 质量减少是产物离开；预测要与残渣核对。
cues.captionEn: Mass falls because products leave; check the predicted residue.
cues.zh: 如果一克纯碳酸氢钠完全按这条反应转化，应留下约零点六三一克碳酸钠。水和二氧化碳补足其余质量。只反应一部分时，残渣还含未反应物，质量应更大。这个预测可以检验反应解释；再加热不继续失重是完成的线索，但单凭恒重或白色外观仍不能证明产物纯度。
cues.en: One gram of pure bicarbonate should leave about 0.631 grams of carbonate after complete conversion by this reaction. Water and carbon dioxide account for the rest. Partial conversion leaves more solid because some bicarbonate remains. This mass prediction can test the explanation. Constant mass after further heating is a completion clue, not proof of product purity.

cues.title: 一颗分子往回走，整滴墨水却散开
cues.titleEn: One doubles back; the drop spreads
cues.caption: 无规则运动，形成有方向的净扩散。
cues.captionEn: Random motion produces net spreading.
cues.zh: 盐水为什么会让细胞变瘪？先从一滴墨水找线索。盯住金色的分子，它没有一直向外走，也会折回来。可看整批染料，原先挤在一起的分布逐渐摊开。下面每一条柱子统计同一批分子的位置。分子没有消失，也没有认路；无规则运动的群体结果，才是从浓到稀的净扩散。
cues.en: Why can salt water make a cell shrink? Start with a drop of dye. Follow the gold particle: it doubles back instead of always travelling away from the drop. Yet the whole population spreads. Each bar counts where these same particles are now. None has vanished, and none knows a destination. Random individual motion produces a directional change in the population.

cues.title: 水位停了，水分子没有停
cues.titleEn: The level stops; molecules do not
cues.caption: 混合降低水势，压力抬高水势，净流量由两侧之差决定。
cues.captionEn: Mixing lowers water potential; pressure raises it. Their difference drives net flow.
cues.zh: 漏斗为什么净吸水？看两侧的水势，它比较水发生转移的能量状态。同温同压下，溶质混合降低水势，所以内侧的水平线较低。膜把蔗糖留下，水仍来回运动，净转移却指向水势低的内侧。随着水柱升高，压力又把内侧水势抬高。最后，两侧水平线对齐，水位几乎不再上升。水分子没有停，只是净流量为零；两侧溶质浓度也不必相等。
cues.en: Why does the funnel gain water overall? Compare water potential, the energy condition for water transfer. At equal temperature and pressure, mixing with solute lowers it, placing the inner level below the outer one. The membrane retains sucrose. Water still moves both ways, but net transfer goes toward lower water potential. As the column rises, pressure lifts the inner potential. Eventually the levels align and the column barely rises further. Molecular motion continues, with zero net flow. Solute concentrations need not become equal.

cues.title: 盐没有抽走整个细胞
cues.titleEn: Salt does not remove the whole cell
cues.caption: 失水使细胞变小，也使胞内溶质更浓。
cues.captionEn: Water loss shrinks the cell and concentrates its contents.
cues.zh: 把相同的红细胞放进三种外液。等渗的一组，平均体积稳定；高渗的一组变小。注意里面的方块：膜未破裂时，不透膜的物质留着，离开的主要是水，所以胞内反而变浓。低渗的一组则吸水，可能胀破。不是盐把整个细胞吸走，而是膜两侧的条件改变了水的净转移。
cues.en: Put identical red cells in three baths. The isotonic cell keeps its average volume; the hypertonic cell shrinks. Watch its squares: while the membrane remains intact, retained solute stays inside as water leaves. The contents therefore become more concentrated. The hypotonic cell takes up water and may rupture. Salt has not pulled out the whole cell. Conditions across its membrane have changed the net water transfer.

cues.title: 把失水推理带进植物细胞
cues.titleEn: Bring the argument into a plant cell
cues.caption: 液泡和原生质体缩小，细胞壁留在外面。
cues.captionEn: The vacuole and protoplast shrink inside the wall.
cues.zh: 现在换成紫色洋葱细胞。高浓度蔗糖外液中，水净流出，紫色液泡和原生质体一起缩小。绿色的细胞壁伸缩较小，没有跟着退进去，间隙就出现了。棕色标记提醒我们，间隙里有外液，不是真空。这组可见变化，把细胞变瘪和渗透失水连在一起；所谓质壁分离，是原生质层与细胞壁分开。
cues.en: Now consider purple onion cells in concentrated sucrose solution. Net water loss shrinks the purple vacuole and the protoplast. The green wall is less extensible and stays outside, opening a gap. Brown markers show that external solution fills it: this is not a vacuum. The visible separation connects cell shrinkage with osmotic water loss. Plasmolysis separates the protoplast boundary from the wall.

cues.title: 复原之后，为什么不继续胀大
cues.titleEn: Why recovery does not mean endless swelling
cues.caption: 靠近细胞壁后，膨压抵消进一步吸水。
cues.captionEn: Wall contact builds turgor that opposes further uptake.
cues.zh: 再看同一个仍然存活的细胞，换成低渗外液。水的净转移反过来，液泡变大，原生质体重新靠近细胞壁。看接触处的反向箭头，以及逐渐增加的压力色带：壁的限制让膨压建立起来，继续吸水的驱动被抵消。现在可以预测，给这样的植物细胞更多清水，不等于它会无限膨胀。红细胞缺少这道壁，结果就可能不同。
cues.en: Follow the same viable cell after changing to a hypotonic bath. Net water transfer reverses. The vacuole expands and the protoplast approaches the wall. Notice the opposing contact arrows and the growing pressure bar. The wall supports turgor, which offsets further uptake. We can now predict that adding more fresh water will not make this plant cell swell indefinitely. A red cell lacks that wall and can have a different outcome.

cues.title: 水通道，改变快慢而不是方向
cues.titleEn: Channels change speed, not the driving direction
cues.caption: 水通道加快被动过水，反转梯度也加快失水。
cues.captionEn: Channels speed passive flow, including water loss after reversal.
cues.zh: 膜怎样让水通过？研究者把候选水通道的遗传信息放进卵母细胞，再与对照放入相同低渗外液。有水通道的一组更快膨胀，这支持蛋白质参与水通透的解释。现在做一个教学预测：另取相同起点，把外液改成高渗。两组都失水，有通道的一组仍然更快。通道降低通行阻力，没有给水供能，更不能替水选择永远向内的方向。
cues.en: How does water cross a membrane? Researchers expressed a candidate water-channel protein in oocytes and compared them in the same hypotonic bath. The expressing cells swelled faster, supporting the protein’s role in water permeability. Now make a teaching prediction: reset to identical starting cells and use a hypertonic bath. Both lose water, and the channel-bearing cell again changes faster. A channel reduces resistance. It does not supply energy or force water always inward.

cues.title: 蛋白质，不等于主动运输
cues.titleEn: A protein does not make transport active
cues.caption: 两条被动路径都消耗浓度差，平衡后仍能交换。
