cues.captionEn: Both passive routes reduce a gradient; exchange persists.
cues.zh: 把观察对象换成一种被运输的物质。直接穿脂质层，或者借助载体，都可以让浓度差逐渐减小。平衡之后，跟着金色和紫色标记看，物质仍能往返交换，平均分布却不再继续偏向一边。载体提供了一条路，并没有免费重建浓度差。因此，看见膜蛋白还不够；要判断主动还是被动，还得问，运输有没有与能量耦合。
cues.en: Now track a transported substance. Passage through lipids or through a carrier can both reduce a concentration difference. After equilibrium, follow the gold and purple markers: exchange continues, while the average distribution stays balanced. A carrier provides a route; it does not rebuild a gradient for free. Seeing a membrane protein is therefore not enough to identify active transport. We must ask whether the movement is coupled to energy.

cues.title: 用供能对照检验逆势运输
cues.titleEn: Test uphill transport with an energy control
cues.caption: 相同起点，供能的泵才能继续逆势积累。
cues.captionEn: From the same start, only the energized pump accumulates uphill.
cues.zh: 最后让胞内一开始就比胞外更多，两组起点相同。供给ATP的一组，标记物仍经过泵进入，胞内积累继续增加；没有ATP的对照停在起点。不是有一个蛋白就自动产生方向，而是能量释放与转运耦合，才允许这种逆势积累。把这点带回水通道：若没有额外供能，就不能把通道当作把水抽向任意一边的泵。
cues.en: Finally, start with more material already inside, using the same starting distribution in both groups. With A T P supplied, the marked cargo still passes through the pump and accumulates inside. Without that energy supply, the control stays at its starting state. A protein alone does not create uphill transport. Coupling movement to energy release makes this accumulation possible. Carry that distinction back to aquaporin: without an energy source, a channel is not a pump that sends water wherever we choose.

cues.title: 接触决定表面变化
cues.caption: 只有接触氧的表面生成新的氧化层。
cues.captionEn: Only oxygen-exposed metal forms new oxide.
cues.zh: 新切面为什么从外面开始变暗？把同样的新切面作比较：一面接触干燥的含氧空气，一面隔绝氧。只有接触氧的表层改变，内部仍是金属。教材用氧化钠表示初期产物；切断氧的接触能停止这里的新变化，却不会把已经生成的层变回钠。真实空气还可能有水分和二氧化碳参与。
cues.en: Why does a fresh face darken from the outside? Compare two fresh surfaces: one meets dry, oxygen-containing air; the other is kept from oxygen. Only the exposed layer changes, while the core remains metal. The textbook represents the initial product as sodium oxide. Removing oxygen stops new change in this model; it does not restore the old layer to metal. Real air can also involve moisture and carbon dioxide.

cues.title: 同样的钠，不同的含氧量
cues.caption: 氧化物与过氧化物的氧，记账不同。
cues.captionEn: Oxide and peroxide oxygen have different oxidation states.
cues.zh: 受热的钠熔化、燃烧，教材给出的淡黄色产物是过氧化钠。与常温氧化物比较，钠都记作正一价，差别在氧。氧化物中的氧是负二价；过氧化物保留氧氧单元，两颗氧合计带两个负电荷，每颗记负一价。跟住相同的四个钠：形成氧化物需一个氧分子，形成过氧化物需两个。这个差别由原子与电子账本检验，不是从黄色火焰猜出来的。
cues.en: Heated sodium melts and burns, leaving the pale-yellow peroxide identified in the textbook. Compare it with the room-temperature oxide. Sodium is plus one in both; oxygen differs. Oxide oxygen is minus two. A peroxide oxygen pair has a total charge of minus two, so each oxygen is minus one. Follow the same four sodium atoms: forming oxide needs one oxygen molecule; forming peroxide needs two. Atom and electron accounting checks that difference. Yellow flame alone does not establish it.

cues.title: 把浮、熔、运动分开解释
cues.caption: 浮入多少由密度决定；金属体积随消耗缩小。
cues.captionEn: Density sets ideal immersion; consumption reduces metal volume.
cues.zh: 先停在水面。钠的密度略小于水，浮起时仍有大部分体积在水下。反应放热又能使它熔成小球；气体生成伴随运动。这些现象各有原因，不能都用活泼两个字代替。画面中浸入的比例按浮力计算，球的体积跟着剩余钠变化。运动与熔化阶段是定性重建，没有把它们画成测得的速度或温度。
cues.en: Pause at the waterline. Sodium is slightly less dense than water, so it floats with most of its volume submerged. Reaction heat can melt it into a droplet, while gas formation accompanies motion. These observations need separate explanations. Ideal immersion follows buoyancy, and metal volume follows the amount remaining. Motion and melting stages are qualitative reconstructions, not measured speed or temperature histories.

cues.title: 氢气里的氢从哪里来
cues.caption: 跟住水中的同一颗氢。
cues.captionEn: Follow the same hydrogen in water.
cues.zh: 气体里的氢从哪里来？钠没有氢，先跟住水中的这颗氢。两个钠各失去一个电子，水中两颗氢各得到一个电子份额，氧化数从正一变为零，组成氢气。剩下的氧和氢成为两个氢氧根，与钠离子留在水里。画的是净反应记账，不是逐步机理。酚酞变色支持碱性，但不能单凭颜色鉴定气体。水过量时，把钠的量加倍，理论氢气量也加倍。
cues.en: Where does the gas hydrogen come from? Sodium contains none, so follow this hydrogen in water. Two sodium atoms each lose one electron unit. Two water hydrogen atoms each gain one in the account, changing from plus one to zero and forming hydrogen gas. The remaining oxygen and hydrogen form two hydroxide ions beside sodium ions. This is net accounting, not an elementary mechanism. Indicator colour supports alkalinity, not gas identity. With excess water, doubling sodium doubles the theoretical hydrogen amount.

cues.title: 这次改变的是氧的价态
cues.caption: 钠仍为正一价，过氧化物的氧一升一降。
cues.captionEn: Sodium stays +1 while peroxide oxygen is oxidized and reduced.
cues.zh: 过氧化钠遇水，气体却能使带火星的木条复燃。这次钠已经是正一价，不能照搬金属钠的失电子解释。看两份过氧化物中的四颗氧：它们原来都记负一价。按净反应分配，两颗升到零，成为氧气；另两颗降到负二，进入氢氧根，失去和得到的电子份额正好相等。水补上其余氧和氢。这里追踪的是守恒的净账本，不是声称观察到了唯一的微观路径。
cues.en: With sodium peroxide, the gas relights a glowing splint. Sodium is already plus one, so the metal-sodium explanation cannot simply be reused. Look at four oxygen atoms in two peroxide units, all initially minus one. In the net account, two rise to zero and form oxygen gas; two fall to minus two and enter hydroxide. Electron loss balances gain. Water supplies the remaining oxygen and hydrogen. This tracks a conserved net account, not a uniquely observed microscopic pathway.

cues.title: 碱性相同，气体可以不同
cues.titleEn: Alkalinity does not fix the gas
cues.caption: 相同钠原子数，可以对应不同气体。
cues.captionEn: The same sodium count can give different gases.
cues.zh: 木条、升温和试纸，分别回答气体、热效应和酸碱性的问题。现在用教材同页的氧化钠做预测：如果也生成氢氧化物，一定要放气吗？氧化物中的氧接受水的一个质子，就能得到两个氢氧根，不需要氧化数变化。用相同四个钠作比较：金属钠给两个氢分子，氧化钠不放气，过氧化钠给一个氧分子，而三者都给四个氢氧根。
cues.en: The splint, warming and test paper answer different questions about gas, heat and alkalinity. Now predict from sodium oxide, discussed on the same textbook page. Must forming hydroxide release gas? Oxide oxygen can accept a proton from water to form two hydroxides without a change in oxidation state. Compare the same four sodium atoms: the metal gives two hydrogen molecules, the oxide no gas, and the peroxide one oxygen molecule. Each gives four hydroxide ions.

cues.title: 同族相似，产物不能只靠颜色
cues.titleEn: A shared group does not fix every product
cues.caption: 同样一个价电子，先支持一价离子的判断。
cues.captionEn: One valence electron supports singly charged ions.
cues.zh: 学习碱金属时，再把钠与钾放在一起。它们最外层都只有一个电子，失去后形成一价离子，这解释了性质中的共同部分。钾受热也熔化燃烧，火焰颜色却不同。颜色不能替我们数出产物里的氧，教材还提醒钾可能形成多种氧化物。因此这里保留氧化产物的判断，不凭火焰指定唯一化学式。
cues.en: Compare sodium and potassium as alkali metals. Each has one outer electron and forms a singly charged ion on losing it, explaining part of their shared behaviour. Heated potassium also melts and burns, but its flame colour differs. Colour does not count oxygen in the product, and the textbook notes that potassium can form multiple oxides. We therefore retain oxidation products without assigning one formula from the flame alone.

cues.title: 更剧烈不等于更多氢气
cues.titleEn: More vigorous does not mean more hydrogen
cues.caption: 更剧烈，意味着更多氢气吗？
cues.captionEn: Does more vigour mean more hydrogen?
cues.zh: 钾与水的演示比钠更强烈，但这是否意味着最后氢气更多？先看结构：由锂到钠再到钾，电子层增多，第一电离能降低，支持最外层电子更容易移走的趋势。电离能描述的是孤立气态原子，不能单独当作水中反应速率。对锂较缓和的判断仍是教材中的预测。最后按电子账本核对：相同物质的量的钠和钾，都是两个金属对应一个氢分子，剧烈程度不同并不改变这个配比。
cues.en: Potassium reacts more vigorously with water than sodium. Does that mean more hydrogen at the end? From lithium to sodium to potassium, occupied shells increase and first ionization energy falls, supporting easier outer-electron removal. That energy concerns isolated gas-phase atoms; it is not an aqueous reaction-rate scale. A gentler lithium response remains the textbook prediction. Finally check the electron account: equal mole amounts of sodium and potassium both give one hydrogen molecule per two metal atoms. Different vigour does not change this ratio.

cues.title: 连成一条链，少了什么？
cues.titleEn: What changes when a chain forms?
cues.caption: 同一组原子，形成肽键与一份水。
cues.captionEn: Same atoms: a peptide bond and water.
cues.zh: 把氨基酸放在一起，就等于蛋白质了吗？先只看一个连接。跟住羧基上的氧和氢，再看另一个氨基提供的氢：它们合成一份水，碳与氮之间留下新的肽键。原子没有凭空消失。这是相对自由氨基酸的净组成示意，不是细胞里真正的合成步骤。把这个连接重复下去，一条含五个残基的开放肽链，会有几个肽键？数一数相邻的接头，只有四个。
cues.en: Does putting amino acids together already make a protein? Watch just one connection. Follow the oxygen and hydrogen from the carboxyl group, then a hydrogen from the other amino group. They account for water, while a new peptide bond joins carbon to nitrogen. No atoms disappear. This is net composition relative to free amino acids, not the actual cellular synthesis pathway. Now count the joins in an open chain of five residues. There are four, because each join connects two neighbors.

cues.title: 51个残基，为什么是49个肽键？
cues.titleEn: Why do 51 residues make 49 peptide bonds?
cues.caption: 两条开放链：20＋29＝49个肽键。
cues.captionEn: Two open chains: 20 + 29 = 49 joins.
cues.zh: 现在看牛胰岛素的两条链。A链二十一个残基，从头走到尾，经过二十个肽键；B链三十个残基，经过二十九个。加起来是五十一个残基，四十九个肽键。盯住标出的两个残基：调换它们的位置，总数没有变，排列顺序却变了。可见，数目相同只能说明账目相同，还不能说明是同一种蛋白质，更不能直接给它盖上“有活性”的章。
cues.en: Bovine insulin has two chains. Follow chain A: twenty-one residues and twenty peptide bonds. Chain B has thirty residues and twenty-nine bonds. Together, that is fifty-one residues and forty-nine peptide bonds. Now track the two highlighted residues as their positions are exchanged. The count stays the same, but the sequence changes. Matching the count does not establish the same protein, and it certainly cannot establish biological activity.

cues.title: 把两条链连起来的，不全是肽键
cues.titleEn: Different bonds constrain the same chains
cues.caption: 三处二硫键，肽键仍是49个。
cues.captionEn: Three disulfides; still 49 peptide bonds.
cues.zh: 回到天然牛胰岛素的连接方式。跟住六个半胱氨酸：一处二硫键连在A链内部，另外两处跨接A、B两链。放大后，真正相连的是侧链上的两个硫原子。它们没有把两条肽链的端点接成一条长链，所以肽键仍是四十九个。画面收回到后来测得的结构参照；重排只为追踪位置，不是折叠过程的录像。反过来，只去掉二硫键而不切肽键，链内连接数不变，空间约束却少了。功能是否也不变，要另找证据。
cues.en: Return to the connections in native bovine insulin. Follow six cysteines. One disulfide lies within chain A; two others link chains A and B. Close up, the joined atoms are sulfur atoms on the side chains. These links do not join the chain ends into one longer peptide, so there are still forty-nine peptide bonds. The view settles into a later measured structure. This rearrangement tracks positions; it is not a film of folding. Remove only the disulfides and the peptide count stays unchanged, but spatial constraints are lost. Does function stay unchanged too? That needs separate evidence.

cues.title: 它真的能工作吗？
cues.caption: 结构与功能，需要各自的证据。
cues.captionEn: Structure and function need separate evidence.
cues.zh: 把结构模型放在一旁，看真正的功能比较。研究者邹承鲁记述：一九六五年，纯化的全合成牛胰岛素经过小鼠生物测定，表现出与天然胰岛素相同的活性。这里按他的记述重构对照关系，不是原始数值记录。天然参照与合成样品各有自己的结果；结果不是旋转模型算出来的。再看刚才那个总数相同、顺序改变的候选：能把天然样品的结论直接复制给它吗？不能。它的活性仍是待测，必须用独立测定与参照比较。
cues.en: Set the structural model aside and look at a functional comparison. Cheng-Lu Tsou recalled that, in 1965, purified, fully synthetic bovine insulin showed the same activity as natural insulin in a mouse bioassay. This reconstructs the comparison from his account; it is not an original numerical record. The natural reference and synthetic sample each have their own reported result. Rotating a molecular model did not calculate those results. Return to the candidate with the same count but a changed sequence. Can we simply copy the natural sample’s result onto it? No. Its activity remains unmeasured and needs its own comparison.

cues.title: 先排除金属丝的干扰
cues.caption: 洁净金属丝不应引入明显焰色；钠盐使火焰显黄色。
cues.captionEn: A clean wire should add no conspicuous colour; sodium salt produces yellow.
cues.zh: 先看未带样品的洁净金属丝。教材要求排除金属丝本身和残留物的颜色，再观察钠盐引起的黄色。眼睛把许多光混合成一种焰色，光谱仪则能把波长分开。下面选取的钠谱线接近五百八十九纳米；它们的位置来自参考数据，画面的宽度和亮度只是为了看清。
cues.en: Begin with the clean wire so that residue does not masquerade as the sample’s colour. Sodium salt then produces yellow. The eye combines light into a flame colour, whereas a spectrometer separates wavelengths. The selected sodium lines lie near 589 nanometres. Their positions come from reference data; displayed width and brightness are enlarged for visibility.

cues.title: 钾的颜色可能被掩盖
cues.caption: 钾的紫色可被微量钠产生的强黄光干扰。
cues.captionEn: Potassium’s lilac appearance can be obscured by sodium’s strong yellow light.
cues.zh: 换成钾盐，观察原有的紫色与逐渐加入的黄光干扰。教材指出，微量钠盐也可能影响钾的焰色判断。图谱里钾的选取谱线没有因为混入钠而搬家，增加的是另一组波长的光。所以直接看混合颜色，与分开观察每组谱线，会得到不同清晰程度的证据。
cues.en: Switch to potassium and watch the growing yellow-light interference. As the textbook notes, even trace sodium can disturb a potassium flame test. The selected potassium lines do not move when sodium is added; light at another set of wavelengths is added. Looking at the combined colour and resolving the component lines therefore provide different levels of evidence.

cues.title: 钴玻璃选择透过的波长
cues.caption: 滤去大部分钠黄光后，更容易辨认钾的焰色。
cues.captionEn: Suppressing much of the sodium yellow makes potassium easier to distinguish.
cues.zh: 把蓝色钴玻璃放进观察光路。它改变的是透过光的组成，并没有改变样品中的元素，也没有把钠变成钾。注意黄色谱线变弱，而部分紫色和红端的光仍可透过。这里的透射曲线只是教学近似，真实玻璃的成分和厚度会影响结果。控制黄光干扰时，看到的变化来自同一个滤光模型。
cues.en: Insert cobalt-blue glass in the viewing path. It changes the transmitted light, not the elements in the sample. The yellow lines weaken while some violet and red-end light passes. This is an illustrative transmission curve, not a calibrated glass specification. Composition and thickness matter in real filters. The visible comparison and line attenuation follow the same model.

cues.title: 更大的能隙，会发出怎样的光？
cues.titleEn: What light comes from a larger gap?
cues.caption: 先预测波长，再比较两条允许跃迁。
cues.captionEn: Predict the wavelength, then compare two allowed transitions.
cues.zh: 把钠的一条黄光谱线接到两个能态。原子降到低能态，光子带走相同的能量。这两条线表示能量，不是绕核轨道。保持低能态不变，换一个更高的允许能态。先预测：能隙更大，波长更长还是更短？能量账本给出更短的波长。这条钠跃迁落在紫外区，眼睛看不见；灰色标记表示不可见光，不是更亮的黄光。
cues.en: Connect one sodium line to two energy states. A photon carries away the energy the atom loses. These lines show energies, not orbits. Keep the lower state and choose a higher allowed state. Predict first: does a larger gap mean a longer or shorter wavelength? Energy accounting gives a shorter wavelength. This sodium transition is ultraviolet, outside human vision. The neutral marker represents invisible light, not a brighter yellow flame.

cues.title: 有能量，还必须匹配
cues.titleEn: Energy must match an allowed gap
cues.caption: 匹配的光子可以改变原子能态。
cues.captionEn: A matching photon can change the atomic state.
cues.zh: 让光经过处在低能态的原子。先跟住不匹配的光子：在这个只选定一对能态的比较中，它通过，原子状态不变。再跟住匹配的一颗：光子被吸收，原子增加相同的能量。总能量没有消失，而是换了归属。能量更大的光子，也未必匹配这一次跃迁。真实吸收还取决于初态、跃迁规则和实验条件。
cues.en: Send light past an atom in the lower state. Follow an unmatched photon: in this selected-pair comparison, it passes and the state stays unchanged. Now follow a matching photon. It is absorbed, and the atom gains the same energy. The energy changes owner; it does not disappear. A higher-energy photon need not match this transition. Real absorption also depends on the initial state, transition rules and experimental conditions.

cues.title: 用多条固定谱线检验身份
cues.titleEn: Test identity with several fixed lines
cues.caption: 候选改变，未知样的谱线保持不动。
cues.captionEn: Changing the candidate does not move the unknown lines.
cues.zh: 保留这份固定的教学未知样。先只看黄光附近，几个候选可能难以分开。展开完整观察范围，再与教材中的锂、氦、汞参考图样比较。候选换了，未知样的谱线不动。多条位置一起吻合，才支持汞这个候选。每条线联系一种允许能量差，同一种元素可以有多条线。再加入钠的谱线：现在没有一个显示的纯元素能解释全部记录，需要考虑混合成分或更多参考数据。
cues.en: Keep this teaching unknown fixed. First look only near yellow, where candidates may be hard to separate. Reveal the full observed range and compare the textbook lithium, helium and mercury references. Changing candidates leaves the unknown unchanged. Several matching positions support mercury. Each line reflects an allowed energy difference; one element can have many lines. Add sodium lines: no displayed pure element now explains every record. Consider a mixture or more reference data.

cues.title: 暗线为什么只在特定位置出现？
cues.titleEn: Why do dark lines occur at particular positions?
cues.caption: 匹配的能隙与低能态占据，共同决定吸收。
cues.captionEn: Absorption needs both a matching gap and an occupied lower state.
cues.zh: 让连续光经过锂原子。跟住一颗匹配的光子：它被吸收，原子升到上能态，探测器方向就少了一颗。能量稍后还可以随光向其他方向释放，暗线不是能量消失。再看另一条锂跃迁，它从激发态出发。在刚准备好的基态样品中，这个起点空着，这条吸收就不出现。另做一次弱光探测，先准备一些原子在这个起点，暗线便能出现。能隙决定位置，起始状态也决定能否吸收。
cues.en: Pass continuous light through lithium atoms. Follow a matching photon: absorption raises the atom and removes a photon from the detector direction. Energy can later leave as light in another direction; a dark line does not destroy it. Another lithium transition starts from an excited state. In a freshly prepared ground-state sample, that starting state is empty, so this absorption is absent. In a separate weak-probe trial, populate that starting state first. The line can now appear. The gap sets its position; the initial state also controls absorption.

cues.title: 先看三个定位结果
cues.caption: 三个时点，标记的位置不同。
cues.captionEn: Three samples show changing label locations.
cues.zh: 这条运输路线，真的是直接拍到的吗？先只看证据。短时标记让一批新合成的蛋白质可以被追踪。教材的三个定位节点是：三分钟，粗面内质网；十七分钟，高尔基体；一百一十七分钟，靠近细胞膜的囊泡和胞外分泌物。停一下：这是不同时刻样本的定位图解，不是同一颗蛋白质的连续录像。
cues.en: Was this transport route actually filmed? Look at the evidence first. Brief labeling makes a cohort of newly made proteins traceable. The textbook presents three observations: rough ER at three minutes, Golgi at seventeen, then vesicles near the cell surface and extracellular secretion at one hundred seventeen. Pause here. These are location diagrams for samples taken at different times, not a movie following one protein.

cues.title: 从定位推断路径
cues.titleEn: Infer a route from the locations
cues.caption: 同一批标记，先后定位支持转运。
cues.captionEn: Follow one cohort to infer its route.
cues.zh: 关键是标记只在开头短时加入，后面换成未标记原料。高尔基体后来出现的这批标记，不能用“现在又给高尔基体加了标记”来解释。结合定位的先后，支持蛋白质从内质网经高尔基体继续转运。不过，三个点还没有拍出囊泡怎样交接。现在切换到解释模型：跟住带环的货物，检查每次转运有没有真实的膜边界。
cues.en: The label is supplied briefly at the beginning, then replaced with unlabeled material. Later Golgi labeling cannot be explained by adding a fresh label there. The ordered locations support transport from ER through the Golgi and onward. But three observations do not show every handoff. We now switch to an explanatory model. Follow the ringed cargo and check what happens at each membrane boundary.

cues.title: 隔开的腔室怎样交接
cues.titleEn: How separate compartments hand cargo over
cues.caption: 出芽与融合，使货物留在膜围成的空间。
cues.captionEn: Budding and fusion preserve the enclosed route.
cues.zh: 看货物周围这一圈膜。内质网膜出芽，货物随囊泡离开；到了高尔基体，膜融合使两个腔室接通，货物才进入新的空间。高尔基体与内质网不是一根常开水管，蛋白质也没有穿过完整双层。接着，新的分泌囊泡把货物带向细胞表面。图中放慢了膜的交接，只解释空间关系，不代表真实分子的速度或所有高尔基体内运输细节。
cues.en: Watch the membrane around the cargo. Budding packages it into an ER-derived carrier. Fusion at the Golgi connects the enclosed spaces, allowing the cargo to enter. ER and Golgi are not a permanently open pipe, and the protein has not passed through an intact bilayer. A secretory carrier then moves toward the cell surface. These slowed handoffs explain compartment relationships, not molecular speed or every detail of transport within the Golgi.

cues.title: 用阻断检验路线
cues.titleEn: Test the route with a block
cues.caption: 只堵住上游出口，会把标记留在哪里？
cues.captionEn: Block the exit. Where does cargo collect?
cues.zh: 最后一次融合，打开了囊泡腔通向胞外的出口；货物从开口释放，囊泡膜并入细胞膜。现在用这条路线作一个新预测：如果只阻断内质网出口，其他过程仍能进行，这批标记会在哪里？比较相同起点。正常模型继续向外运输；阻断模型把标记留在内质网，上游保留更多、下游新到达的更少。已经离开内质网的货物不会倒退。这是检验路径的条件性预测，不是三张历史图片直接测得的阻断结果。
cues.en: The final fusion opens a passage from the vesicle lumen to the exterior. Cargo leaves through that opening as vesicle membrane joins the cell surface. Now make a prediction: block only ER export while other processes continue. Where should this labeled cohort remain? From identical starting states, the control transports cargo onward, while the blocked model retains more in the ER and delivers less downstream. Cargo already exported does not move backward. This is a conditional prediction, not a blocking experiment measured in the three historical images.

cues.title: 让货物检验细胞模型
cues.titleEn: Let cargo test the cell model
cues.caption: 连接是否合理，让货物走一遍。
cues.captionEn: Test the connections by following cargo.
cues.zh: 这个细胞模型的连接合理吗？让一件分泌货物走一遍。先看一个反例：囊泡已经贴到细胞膜，但两层膜还完整，货物应当停在里面。只有膜融合形成开口，囊泡腔才与胞外接通。转动模型，开口仍属于同一处连接。再看内质网和高尔基体：它们可以通过载体交接，却不是一根永久连通的管道。用货物检查腔室和边界，比只把细胞器摆对位置，更能检验模型的科学性。
cues.en: Are the connections in this cell model plausible? Test them with a secretory cargo. Here is a counterexample: a vesicle touches the cell surface, but both membranes remain intact. Cargo must stay inside. Fusion must open a passage before the lumen connects to the exterior. Rotate the view: the opening must remain the same connection. ER and Golgi also exchange cargo through carriers, not a permanently open pipe. Testing compartments and boundaries reveals more than placing organelles in approximately the right positions.

cues.title: 同一个电子，换了归属
cues.caption: 同一份电子，失去与得到相对应。
cues.captionEn: The same electron is lost and gained.
cues.zh: 先只看钠和氯的一对原子。钠有一个最外层电子，氯有七个。跟住金色标记：它从钠的电子账本进入氯的账本。钠少了一个电子，记作正一价离子；氯多了一个，记作负一价离子。八个价电子没有增加，也没有减少。这条连线是归属变化的说明，不是真实电子的运动轨迹。
cues.en: Start with one sodium and one chlorine atom. Sodium has one outer electron and chlorine has seven. Follow the gold marker from sodium’s account into chlorine’s. Losing one gives sodium a positive ionic charge; gaining one gives chlorine a negative charge. The eight valence electrons are still accounted for. The connecting line illustrates changing allocation, not an electron’s measured path.

cues.title: 为什么需要两个钠？
cues.titleEn: Why are two sodium atoms needed?
cues.caption: 两个钠各给一个；两个氯各收一个。
cues.captionEn: Two sodium atoms supply one electron each.
cues.zh: 把局部的一对原子放回整个反应。一个氯分子有两个氯原子，每个各得到一个电子，所以需要两个钠原子，各给出一个电子。跟住这两个标记：失去两个，得到两个。方程式里的二不是随意添上的，它同时满足原子和电子的账本。生成的氯化钠是连续的离子晶格，画面只取其中两份来计数。
cues.en: Put the local pair back into the whole reaction. One chlorine molecule contains two chlorine atoms, each gaining one electron. It therefore needs two sodium atoms, each losing one. Follow both markers: two lost, two gained. The coefficient two satisfies the atom and electron accounts together. Sodium chloride forms an extended ionic lattice; the picture counts two formula units within it.

cues.title: 形式分配，不等于真实分离
cues.titleEn: Formal allocation is not physical separation
cues.caption: 共用电子对还在，氧化数按规则记账。
cues.captionEn: The pair remains shared; oxidation states follow a rule.
cues.zh: 氢和氯形成分子时，换一种图像。两个电子共同参与成键，分布偏向氯，但共用电子对仍然保留。现在只切换记账规则：把这对电子形式上分配给氯，氢的氧化数记为正一，氯记为负一。留意，分子图像没有变成分离的氢离子和氯离子。氧化数能帮助我们计数，却不是分子中每个原子真实电荷的测量值。
cues.en: Hydrogen and chlorine require a different picture. Two electrons participate in a shared bond whose distribution favours chlorine. Keep that shared pair in view while changing only the accounting rule: formally assign the pair to chlorine. Hydrogen’s oxidation state becomes plus one and chlorine’s minus one. The molecule has not turned into separated ions. Oxidation states help count electrons; they are not measured atomic charges inside the molecule.

cues.title: 用电子账本预测铜的数量
cues.caption: 先预测，再用电子账本检验。
cues.captionEn: Predict first, then check the electron account.
cues.zh: 现在回到教材同页的铁与硫酸铜。一个铁原子变成二价铁离子，电子账本记作失去两个电子。一个二价铜离子变成铜，也需要两个电子。先判断：一个铁能让一个，还是两个铜离子成为铜？把这两个电子的份额对应起来，只有一个铜离子被还原，另一个仍留在溶液中。再增加一个铁，才有足够的电子份额还原第二个。这里检验的是净反应计量，不是在描绘真实电子运动路径。
cues.en: Return to iron and copper sulfate on the same textbook page. One iron atom becoming iron two-plus loses two electrons in the account. One copper two-plus ion becoming copper also needs two. Predict first: can one iron reduce one copper ion, or two? Match the two electron units. One copper ion is reduced while the other stays dissolved. Adding another iron supplies enough electron units for the second. This tests net stoichiometry, not a microscopic electron trajectory.

cues.title: 蓝色菌落能证明什么？
cues.titleEn: What does a blue colony establish?
cues.caption: 合成基因组，不等于合成整个细胞。
cues.captionEn: A synthetic genome is not a whole cell.
cues.zh: 先看2010年研究的两种菌落：带合成基因组的菌落显蓝色，对照不显蓝色。一处菌落里有许多细胞。研究者还检测到人为设计的DNA标记，把这些细胞与新基因组联系起来。但这不等于细胞的每个部件都被人工合成了。看这些示意色段接成完整DNA环：颜色帮助追踪身份，环本身还不是能运转的细胞。变蓝时，究竟是谁在工作？
cues.en: Start with two colony types from the 2010 study. Colonies carrying the synthetic genome turned blue; the control did not. A colony contains many cells. Designed DNA markers linked the cells to the new genome, but did not show that every cellular component had been synthesized. Follow these illustrative segments into a complete DNA circle. Their colors track identity; the circle alone is not a functioning cell. What actually produced the blue color?

cues.title: 新信息，已有机器
cues.caption: 信息经过已有机器，转成可见的作用。
cues.captionEn: Existing machinery reads new information.
cues.zh: 看移植后的解释模型。细胞膜和这些分子机器原先就存在，不是DNA刚刚变出来的。跟住新DNA上的一段信息：已有机器读取它，合成一条新的RNA；核糖体再沿RNA工作，用氨基酸组装蛋白质。DNA和RNA都没有变成那条蛋白质。研究中的显色蛋白是一种酶，它让检测底物产生蓝色产物。因此，蓝色是基因表达发挥作用的线索。若只留下同一段DNA，拿走表达机器，这条过程就走不下去。原料与能量也必不可少，只是这里没有逐一展开。
cues.en: This is an explanatory model of the cell after transplantation. Its membrane and molecular machinery already existed; DNA did not turn into them. Follow one region of the new DNA. Existing machinery reads it to make a separate RNA molecule. A ribosome then follows that message, assembling protein from amino acids. Neither DNA nor RNA turns into the protein. In the study, a reporter enzyme made a blue product from an assay substrate: a visible consequence of gene expression. Keep the same DNA but remove the machinery, and this sequence cannot run. Substrates and energy are also required, though not shown individually.

cues.title: 十六变一，信息也少了十五份吗？
cues.titleEn: Sixteen to one: fifteen shares of information lost?
cues.caption: 染色体条数变少，不等于信息按比例减少。
cues.captionEn: Fewer chromosomes need not mean less information.
cues.zh: 现在换到2018年的另一项研究：酿酒酵母。跟住同一个被标出的基因区段，原有的十六条染色体逐步连接，代表性区段仍能追踪到。条数变少，不等于只剩一个基因，或丢掉了十五份信息。实际研究还删除了部分着丝粒、端粒等序列，所以也不能说每个碱基都原封不动。这是在已有酵母细胞中重排染色体，不是把新染色体放进空细胞。可连成一条以后，它真的还能生长吗？
cues.en: Now switch to a different study: budding yeast in 2018. Follow the highlighted gene region as sixteen existing chromosomes are joined. Representative regions remain traceable. Fewer chromosomes do not mean one remaining gene or fifteen lost shares of information. Some centromere, telomere and other sequences were removed, so not every base remained unchanged. This was chromosome reorganization within existing yeast cells, not a new chromosome placed in an empty cell. Could the resulting cells actually grow?

cues.title: 让独立观测回答
cues.caption: DNA的信息与细胞的功能，需要分别检验。
cues.captionEn: DNA information is not whole-cell function.
cues.zh: 让真实记录来回答。这是论文中的两组生长均值：正常酵母与单染色体酵母。横轴是时间，纵轴是培养液的光学密度，不是直接数出多少活细胞。看后面的点：单染色体酵母仍然生长，但曲线没有与正常酵母完全重合。论文还报告了其他功能上的差别，所以连成一条并不保证一切表现不变。最后回到那段DNA：信息相同，若周围没有读取和装配的机器，还会自动出现同样的蛋白质吗？
cues.en: Let the published observations answer. These are mean growth measurements for parental yeast and the single-chromosome strain. Time runs across the plot; optical density is not a direct count of living cells. Reveal the later points: the redesigned cells still grow, but their curve does not exactly match the parent. The paper reports differences in other functions too. One connected chromosome does not guarantee that everything stays unchanged. Return to the same DNA: without machinery to read and assemble from its information, would the same protein appear automatically?

cues.title: 从血浆到组织液
cues.caption: 位置改变，总示踪量不变。
cues.captionEn: Location changes; total tracer does not.
cues.zh: 先看血管中的两种标记。红色是红细胞，棕色是可交换溶质的相对密度。溶质沿通路进入组织细胞周围的液体，红细胞仍在血管中。下方读数核对三个隔室的总示踪量，它没有因位置改变而消失。
cues.en: Distinguish the red cells from the brown solute markers. The exchangeable solute reaches fluid around the tissue cells while red cells remain in blood. The displayed total accounts for all three compartments. Redistribution changes location, not the amount of tracer.

cues.title: 淋巴路径接回循环
cues.caption: 组织液经淋巴路径回到血液。
cues.captionEn: Lymph returns tissue fluid to blood.
cues.zh: 继续观察淋巴一侧。它与组织液之间有进入路径，再沿回流通路接回血液。小点表示浓度分布，不是每一个真实分子的运动轨迹。探索时可关闭这条交换路线，比较淋巴中的示踪量，同时核对总量仍然守恒。
cues.en: Follow the lymph compartment and its return route to blood. Its tracer comes from interstitial exchange. The dots show relative density rather than individual molecular tracks. Exploration can close this route; the lymph result changes while the tracer balance still closes.

cues.title: 按时刻留下记录
cues.caption: 练习数据：缺测保留为空。
cues.captionEn: Practice data: missing stays missing.
cues.zh: 接下来换成调查记录。按早晨、白天、晚间和睡前逐次记录体温，这些点才是作图依据。画面明确使用练习数据，没有冒充一次真实调查。自由探索可替换每一项观察，也可以标记缺测；缺失时刻不会被自动补成一条漂亮曲线。
cues.en: Now switch from a mechanism to an investigation. Individual observations collected through the day form the graph. These are explicitly practice data, not a real survey. You can replace a record or mark it missing. Missing observations are not filled just to produce a smooth curve.

cues.title: 比较成员与气温
cues.caption: 体温同尺度，气温另用尺度。
cues.captionEn: One body scale; a separate air scale.
cues.zh: 把三位成员的记录放在同一体温刻度上，再查看另用刻度的气温。练习记录展示怎样比较，不足以证明年龄或性别规律。真正调查要保留测量方法、活动和作息等条件。稳态允许一定范围内的变化，并不是每个时刻、每个人都完全相同。
cues.en: Compare the three household records on the same body-temperature scale, then inspect air temperature on its own scale. Practice data illustrate comparison; they cannot establish age or sex effects. A real investigation records method and context. Homeostasis allows variation within a range rather than identical values everywhere.

cues.title: 让热量收支重新接近
cues.caption: 热输入减去散热，决定储热变化。
cues.captionEn: Heat change equals input minus loss.
cues.zh: 现在观察一个独立的热量机制。热输入先增加，温差随之出现，调节响应再加强散热。输入停止后，温差逐渐缩小。这是归一化热量模型，不是刚才调查曲线的生成器。关闭响应可以比较调节作用，却不能把失去调节后的轨迹当作实际患者数据。
cues.en: A separate mechanism now adds a heat disturbance. The temperature deviation drives a heat-loss response. After the disturbance ends, the deviation diminishes. This normalized balance does not generate the preceding survey data. Disabling regulation tests the mechanism, not a clinical case.

cues.title: 少排出一些水
cues.caption: 通道透水，水势差驱动净回流。
cues.captionEn: Channels pass water; a gradient drives net flow.
cues.zh: 失水后，溶质量暂不变，浓度升高。下丘脑合成、垂体后叶释放的抗利尿激素增加。放大集合管：细胞把更多水通道放到面向滤液的一侧。水沿已有水势差返回体内，留在管腔、进入尿液的水减少。通道不是水泵；如果消除水势差，通道再多也不能产生净回流。最后比较同样失水、却不能响应激素的情况：尿中损失更多。保住水与补进水，是两件事。
cues.en: After water is lost, concentration rises while solute is held fixed. More ADH is synthesized in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary. Zoom into the collecting duct. Cells place more water channels in the membrane facing the tubular fluid. An existing water-potential difference drives net return to the body, leaving less water for urine. A channel is not a pump. Remove that difference, and open channels cannot create net flow. Finally compare the same loss when the kidney cannot respond to the hormone: more water leaves in urine. Retaining water is different from adding it.

cues.title: 再区分钠的收支
cues.caption: 钠穿过两侧膜，才算真正回收。
cues.captionEn: Sodium crosses both membranes to return.
cues.zh: 现在只核对钠的收支。肾上腺皮质的醛固酮作用于末段肾小管和集合管，增强钠的重吸收。跟住同一批钠：它们经管腔侧通道进入细胞，再由另一侧的钠钾泵送回体内。泵的转运与ATP水解耦联；这一循环还把钾带入细胞。进入的钠分成回收与随尿离开两路。若泵停下，即使通道仍在，也不能维持这股持续回收。真实调节还涉及肾素、血管紧张素和血钾；这里分开水与钠，只为看清收支。
cues.en: Now isolate sodium balance. Aldosterone from the adrenal cortex enhances sodium reabsorption in the terminal nephron. Follow the same sodium ions: channels admit them from the tubular fluid, then the sodium-potassium pump sends them across the other membrane toward the body. Transport is coupled to A. T. P. hydrolysis; the cycle also brings potassium into the cell. Delivered sodium divides between recovery and urine. Stop the pump, and open entry channels alone cannot sustain recovery. Real regulation also involves renin, angiotensin and blood potassium. Separating water and sodium here makes their balances visible.

cues.title: 来源与受体先分开
cues.caption: 结扎胰管的供体，与去胰腺的受体不同。
cues.captionEn: The duct-ligated donor differs from the pancreas-removed recipient.
cues.zh: 先分清两个角色。供体结扎胰管后，腺泡退化，绿色胰岛仍保留。另一只动物被去除胰腺后，血糖升高。上方画的是提取物来源，下方画的是受体血液，不能误以为结扎胰管就等于把整个胰腺拿走。
cues.en: Keep the two experimental roles separate. Duct ligation in the donor causes acinar regression while islets remain. A different animal loses its pancreas and develops high glucose. The source tissue and recipient blood are distinct. Blocking a duct is not equivalent to removing the entire pancreas.

cues.title: 让提取物改变受体
cues.titleEn: Test the extract in a recipient
cues.caption: 加入提取物后，相对血糖下降。
cues.captionEn: The recipient’s relative glucose falls after extract delivery.
cues.zh: 将供体来源的提取物给予去胰腺的受体，血糖下降。来源、处理与指标连成一条证据链，支持胰岛相关物质具有降血糖作用。曲线是示意比较，不是历史测量值；有效提取方法后来也能使用正常胰腺，结扎本身并不产生胰岛素。
cues.en: Deliver the source extract to the pancreas-removed recipient. Glucose falls, linking tissue source, intervention and outcome. This supports a glucose-lowering substance associated with islets. The curve is an illustrative comparison, not historical data, and improved extraction later also used normal pancreas.

cues.title: 先拿走分泌来源
cues.caption: 鸡冠逐渐退缩，正常对照仍保持。
cues.captionEn: The comb regresses while the intact control remains.
cues.zh: 对照三只公鸡的鸡冠。保留睾丸的一组保持原有状态，摘除后，雄性性征逐渐减弱。画面只选鸡冠作为观察指标，变化需要过程。摘除后的差异提示该组织与性征维持有关，但还需要恢复条件来进一步检验。
cues.en: Compare combs under matched conditions. The intact control remains stable, while removal of the testes is followed by gradual regression. Comb size is one selected observable. The loss implicates the tissue, but restoring a source provides an additional causal comparison.

cues.title: 移植后再观察恢复
cues.caption: 恢复来源后，表型逐步回升。
cues.captionEn: Restoring a source allows gradual phenotypic recovery.
cues.zh: 继续到移植后的阶段。移植组的鸡冠逐步恢复，摘除但没有恢复来源的一组仍然较小。减去与加回相互支持，帮助判断这个组织提供了维持性征的信号。这里重建历史对照，不演示动物操作，也没有把移植说成接通一条新神经。
cues.en: Continue into the post-graft period. The graft group recovers while the removal-only group stays reduced. Loss and rescue support one another in identifying a tissue-borne signal. This reconstruction compares historical conditions without demonstrating animal procedures or implying a new direct nerve connection.

cues.title: 观察不改写染色体
cues.caption: 去性腺后，XX与XY的外生殖器表现趋同。
cues.captionEn: After gonadal removal, the reported external outcomes converge.
cues.zh: 兔胚胎实验在分化之前去除性腺来源，再记录外生殖器表现。表中 XX 和 XY 的身份没有变化，但去除条件下都出现雌性外生殖器表现。这是教材给出的观察范围，不能因此把身体全部性分化都归结为单个激素开关。
cues.en: The rabbit comparison removes the gonadal source before differentiation and records external genital outcomes. XX and XY identities remain unchanged, while the reported removal conditions produce the same external pattern. The conclusion belongs to that specific outcome, not every aspect of sexual differentiation.

cues.title: 用假说预测补充条件
cues.caption: 补雄激素这一列是条件预测。
cues.captionEn: The androgen-supplemented column is a prediction.
cues.zh: 现在进入教材要求的预测。若缺少睾丸信号导致了前面的结果，那么补充雄激素，应改变这项外生殖器发育表现。表头明确写出预测，避免把推理冒充原表中的观测。内生殖道与其他组织还涉及不同信号，不能随此列一起推定。
cues.en: Now make the prediction requested by the textbook. If absence of the testicular signal explains the preceding outcome, androgen supplementation should change this selected external pattern. The heading marks a prediction rather than disguising it as an original observation. Other tissues require additional evidence.

cues.title: 进食后增加利用
cues.caption: 输入增加后，胰岛素响应减小血糖偏离。
cues.captionEn: After an input, insulin response reduces the glucose deviation.
cues.zh: 从同样的起点加入营养输入。血糖上升后，模型中的胰岛素响应提高组织利用，读数逐渐回落。图上的血管、胰岛和肝脏共享同一份收支计算。下降的葡萄糖进入利用项，不是反馈箭头把它从计算里抹掉。
cues.en: Start at the baseline and add a nutrient input. Rising glucose increases the modeled insulin response and utilization, reducing the deviation. Blood, islets and liver share one balance calculation. Glucose that disappears from blood is accounted for in a sink, not erased by a decorative feedback arrow.

cues.title: 禁食时增加输出
cues.caption: 低血糖方向的偏离引出胰高血糖素响应。
cues.captionEn: A downward deviation recruits the glucagon response.
cues.zh: 另起一组禁食条件，保持消耗却去掉额外营养输入。血糖下降后，胰高血糖素响应增加肝脏输出，减轻下降。探索中关闭反馈，可以核对调节改变了什么。真实血糖还受更多器官和激素共同影响，这里保留两条最基本的相反调节关系。
cues.en: Begin a separate fasting comparison with continued use and no extra meal input. A falling glucose level recruits glucagon and increases hepatic output. Disable feedback in exploration to compare the effect. This model isolates two opposing regulatory responses rather than reproducing the full endocrine system.

cues.title: 去掉中间一级
cues.caption: 垂体缺失后，TSH与下游激素降低。
cues.captionEn: Pituitary absence lowers TSH and downstream hormone.
cues.zh: 把下丘脑、垂体和甲状腺排成同一条轴。缺少垂体后，促甲状腺激素来源减少，下游甲状腺激素也下降。三个读数是归一化信号水平，不是器官大小。先用这一减法条件检验中间一级是否参与维持下游活动。
cues.en: Arrange the hypothalamus, pituitary and thyroid along one axis. Removing pituitary input lowers TSH and then thyroid hormone. The readouts are relative signals, not organ sizes. This subtraction tests whether the middle level helps maintain downstream activity.

cues.title: 补回中间信号
cues.caption: 补充TSH，在垂体缺失时部分恢复下游。
cues.captionEn: TSH supplementation partially restores downstream output.
cues.zh: 保持垂体缺失，再补充促甲状腺激素信号。下游活动得到部分恢复，与前一条件形成加回对照。教材中使用垂体提取物，这里把其中的有效作用简化为 TSH 输入，并没有说一种粗提取物只含有单一分子。
cues.en: Keep the pituitary absent but add an effective TSH input. Downstream output partially recovers, complementing the preceding loss condition. The textbook uses pituitary extract; the model isolates its relevant TSH action without claiming that a crude extract contains only one substance.

cues.title: 再检查上游刺激
cues.caption: TRH增加，推动垂体与甲状腺轴响应。
cues.captionEn: Additional TRH drives the downstream axis.
cues.zh: 恢复完整轴后，增加促甲状腺激素释放激素信号。先看垂体相关读数，再看甲状腺输出。这个条件说明上游可以调节中间一级，配合前面的缺失与补回，逐步建立分级关系。模型速率只是教学选值，不代表真实激素变化所需的分钟或天数。
cues.en: Return to an intact axis and add TRH input. Observe the pituitary-associated signal and the downstream thyroid response. Together with removal and rescue, this tests the hierarchical connection. Model rates are teaching parameters, not calibrated minutes or days.

cues.title: 下游再影响上游
cues.caption: 甲状腺激素增加，上游分泌受到抑制。
cues.captionEn: Extra thyroid hormone suppresses upstream output.
cues.zh: 最后直接增加甲状腺激素。虽然下游读数升高，上游 TRH 和 TSH 的相关水平却降低。返向路径表示负反馈，使分级刺激不会无限放大。干预结果支持关系的方向，不能把这三个简化读数当作临床诊断指标。
cues.en: Finally add thyroid hormone directly. The downstream level rises while upstream TRH- and TSH-associated levels decline. The returning inhibitory path represents negative feedback. These interventions test causal directions; the three simplified values are not diagnostic measurements.

cues.title: 分开三种来源
cues.caption: 核、卵细胞质、妊娠环境，来源各不同。
cues.captionEn: Nucleus, cytoplasm and gestation have different origins.
cues.zh: 克隆牛的例子先把三个来源分开。体细胞供体提供细胞核，去核卵细胞提供细胞质，另一个个体提供妊娠环境。后代许多性状接近核供体，支持细胞核在遗传中的重要作用，但不能推出细胞质和环境毫无影响。
cues.en: Separate three contributors in the cloned-cow example. A somatic donor supplies the nucleus. An egg whose nucleus was removed supplies the cytoplasm. Another animal supplies the gestational environment. Many traits resemble the nuclear donor, supporting nuclear inheritance without implying that cytoplasm and environment have no influence.

cues.title: 颜色跟随哪一个来源
cues.titleEn: Which source does the color follow?
cues.caption: 体色主要跟随核供体。
cues.captionEn: Pigmentation follows the nuclear donor.
cues.zh: 美西螈实验把黑色个体的胚胎细胞核，与白色个体的去核卵细胞组合。发育结果呈黑色。这个对照改变了核来源与卵细胞来源的配对，说明决定这一颜色性状的遗传信息主要跟随细胞核，而不是跟随卵细胞原来的体色。
cues.en: The axolotl comparison combines an embryonic nucleus from a dark animal with an enucleated egg from a pale animal. The resulting offspring are dark. Changing the pairing separates nuclear from egg origin and links this pigmentation outcome primarily to nuclear genetic information.

cues.title: 先有核，才继续分裂
cues.caption: 核进入后，原来停滞的一侧开始分裂。
cues.captionEn: Division begins after a nucleus arrives.
cues.zh: 细线把蝾螈受精卵缢成两部分，有核的一侧先分裂，另一侧暂时不分裂。随后一个细胞核进入另一半，那一半也开始分裂，但时间落后。这里的关键是同一受精卵内前后条件改变，不能把细胞质的存在等同于完整细胞的发育能力。
cues.en: A constriction separates a newt egg into two regions. The nucleated side divides first; the other waits. After a nucleus enters the other half, division begins there with a delay. This within-egg comparison distinguishes cytoplasm alone from a complete system capable of development.

cues.title: 残留活动与持续维持
cues.caption: 短暂消化，不等于持续生长。
cues.captionEn: Brief digestion is not sustained growth.
cues.zh: 切开的变形虫提供另一种比较。去核片段仍能短暂处理已经吞入的食物，却不能像有核部分那样持续摄食、生长和分裂。如果及时补入合适细胞核，一些生命活动可以恢复。细胞核很重要，但离开细胞质也不能独立完成生命活动。
cues.en: A cut amoeba offers another comparison. The fragment without a nucleus can briefly digest food already inside, but cannot sustain feeding, growth and division like the part with a nucleus. Timely nuclear replacement can restore activity. The nucleus matters, yet it also depends on cytoplasm.

cues.title: 帽形与基部细胞核
cues.titleEn: Cap shape and the basal nucleus
cues.caption: 柄不变，新帽主要跟随核来源。
cues.captionEn: The stalk stays; the new cap follows the nucleus.
cues.zh: 伞藻是一个很大的单细胞，核藏在基部假根。把一种伞藻的核与另一种柄组合，再观察新帽，最终帽形主要跟随核来源。我们保留了不同颜色的柄，避免误以为整株都换成了供核个体。细胞质中已有物质可能造成短期影响。
cues.en: Acetabularia is a large single cell with its nucleus in the basal rhizoid. Combining one nuclear origin with another stalk reveals that the eventual regenerated cap mainly follows the nucleus. The stalk keeps its original color here. Existing cytoplasmic products can still cause transient effects.

cues.title: 成功与困难一起记录
cues.caption: 不同统计对象，不能直接算通用成功率。
cues.captionEn: Different counts do not yield a universal success rate.
cues.zh: 克隆猴研究还需要解决核遗传物质移除、激活时机和重编程的问题。原论文的胎儿成纤维细胞组，二十一只代孕母猴中有六例妊娠，最终得到两只健康幼猴。这些是不同阶段和不同统计对象，不能随意相除当作通用成功率。
cues.en: Macaque cloning required control of enucleation, activation and reprogramming. In the original fetal-fibroblast group, twenty-one surrogates produced six pregnancies and two healthy infants. These figures describe different stages and units; dividing them arbitrarily does not yield a universal cloning success rate.

cues.title: 分化不等于丢失全部潜能
cues.titleEn: Differentiation does not erase all potential
cues.caption: 分化细胞核，仍保留发育所需的信息。
cues.captionEn: A differentiated nucleus retains developmental information.
cues.zh: 最后看非洲爪蟾。供核细胞已经是蝌蚪肠上皮细胞，核移入合适的去核卵后，部分重构卵能够发育成蝌蚪。这说明分化细胞的核仍保留重要的完整遗传信息；不是说单独培养这个肠细胞，就必然会长成一个新个体。
cues.en: In Xenopus, the donor nucleus comes from an already differentiated tadpole intestinal cell. In an appropriate enucleated egg environment, some reconstructed eggs develop into tadpoles. The nucleus retains extensive genetic information; this does not mean an isolated intestinal cell will automatically become a new animal.

cues.title: 白色固体从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where did the white solid come from?
cues.caption: 同一批 Ba²⁺ 与 SO₄²⁻，从水相进入固相。
cues.captionEn: Barium and sulfate enter the solid.
cues.zh: 把两份透明溶液混合，白色固体出现了。放大正在形成的沉淀：原先分散在水中的钡离子和硫酸根，进入同一固相。跟住有标记的这一组，它没有消失，只是换了所在的相。如果钡离子不足，剩下的硫酸根仍留在水中。
cues.en: Mixing two clear solutions produces a white solid. Enlarge the forming precipitate: barium and sulfate ions that were dispersed in water enter the solid phase. Follow the marked pair. It has changed location and phase, not disappeared. If barium runs out first, some sulfate must remain dissolved.

cues.title: 把没有反应的离子留下
cues.titleEn: Keep the ions that did not react
cues.caption: 方程式省略的离子，仍留在水里。
cues.captionEn: Spectator ions stay in the water.
cues.zh: 再跟住钠离子和氯离子。混合前后，它们都留在水里，没有进入硫酸钡。净离子方程式删去的是它们两边相同的记录，不是让离子凭空消失。现在只增加氯化钡：大部分硫酸根进入沉淀后，过量的钡也留在溶液里。固体出现，不能说明水中已经没有离子。
cues.en: Now follow sodium and chloride. They stay dissolved rather than entering barium sulfate. Cancelling their matching entries in the equation does not erase them from the solution. Add more barium chloride: once most sulfate has entered the solid, excess barium remains dissolved too. A precipitate does not mean the water is empty of ions.

cues.title: 固体还在，过程就停止了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does visible solid mean nothing is happening?
cues.caption: 外观不变，少量溶解与析出仍可相互抵消。
cues.captionEn: A steady solid can still exchange ions.
cues.zh: 这两份氢氧化镁加水后都仍能看到固体。放大其中一个表面：少量镁离子和氢氧根进入水，也有离子回到固体。平衡时两种过程相互抵消，固体总量可以不变。因此，看到沉淀仍在，不能推断它完全不溶。保留一份加水对照，再改变另一份的条件。
cues.en: Both portions of magnesium hydroxide still contain visible solid in water. At an enlarged surface, small amounts of magnesium and hydroxide enter solution while ions also return to the solid. At equilibrium these processes balance, so the total solid can remain steady. Visible solid does not mean zero solubility. Keep one water control while changing the other sample.

cues.title: 先移走 OH⁻，再看固体补充
cues.titleEn: Remove hydroxide, then follow the solid
cues.caption: 酸先消耗溶液中的 OH⁻，固体溶解补充离子。
cues.captionEn: Removing OH⁻ lets more solid dissolve.
cues.zh: 看酸带来的水合氢离子，与溶液中的氢氧根形成水。氢氧根减少，原来的溶液变得不饱和。接着追踪沉淀表面：更多镁离子和氢氧根进入水，固体减少。酸不足时还能剩下固体；足量时固体可以全部溶解，水对照却仍浑浊。总镁一直保留，只是固相与水相的分配改变。这里分步展示因果，不把动画速度当作真实反应速度。
cues.en: Follow hydrated hydrogen ions from the acid as they react with dissolved hydroxide to form water. Removing hydroxide makes the old solution undersaturated. More magnesium and hydroxide then leave the solid surface, reducing the precipitate. Too little acid leaves some solid; enough can dissolve it all while the water control stays cloudy. Total magnesium remains accounted for. These steps explain the cause; their animation does not measure reaction speed.

cues.title: 先固定这一份银
cues.caption: 白色固体中的银，是后续两次转化的同一份银。
cues.captionEn: Follow the same silver into new solids.
cues.zh: 银盐的比较从白色氯化银开始。把其中几份银作标记，接下来一直保留它们。氯化银虽然难溶，表面仍与少量溶液中的银离子和氯离子交换。后面加入的新试剂，能改变溶液里银的去向吗？
cues.en: Begin with white silver chloride and mark several silver units to follow. Although the solid is sparingly soluble, its surface exchanges with small amounts of dissolved silver and chloride. Keep the same silver labels. Can a new reagent change where dissolved silver goes?

cues.title: 新的固相接走银
cues.titleEn: A new solid takes up silver
cues.caption: AgI 接走溶液中的 Ag⁺，AgCl 继续溶解。
cues.captionEn: AgI takes up silver; AgCl dissolves.
cues.zh: 加入碘离子，先看溶液中的银：它进入新的黄色碘化银。溶液中的银被移走，氯化银就继续溶解补充。跟住标记，银进入新的固相，氯离子留在水里。碘离子不足时，两种固体可以并存；足量时，绝大部分氯化银能够转化。黄色不是给白色涂了颜料，而是组成发生了改变。
cues.en: Add iodide and watch dissolved silver enter yellow silver iodide. Removing silver from solution allows more silver chloride to dissolve. The marked silver enters the new solid while chloride stays in water. Too little iodide leaves both solids present; sufficient iodide can convert almost all the original chloride. The colour changes because the solid composition changes.

cues.title: 两个银，组成一份新固体
cues.titleEn: Two silvers in each new formula unit
cues.caption: 银总量不变；每份 Ag₂S 必须接收两个银。
cues.captionEn: Two silvers per Ag₂S; none are lost.
cues.zh: 再加入硫化物，银进入黑色硫化银。把标记两两配在一起：每个硫化银化学式单位需要两个银。原先十份一银单位，只能组成五份二银单位，银并没有少一半。碘离子回到溶液中。比较三种固体时，应该守住银原子的总量，不能只比较化学式单位的个数。
cues.en: With sulfide, silver enters black silver sulfide. Pair the marked silvers: each Ag₂S formula unit needs two. Ten one-silver units can make five two-silver units, without losing any silver. Iodide returns to solution. Compare the solids by their total silver, not by counting formula units alone.

cues.title: 褐色沉淀需要什么？
cues.titleEn: What does the brown precipitate need?
cues.caption: 先区分固体中的 OH 与原来额外加入的 OH⁻。
cues.captionEn: Where does the new solid get its OH⁻?
cues.zh: 最后回到教材的氢氧化物实验。先生成白色氢氧化镁，再准备加入三价铁。铁形成褐色沉淀需要氢氧根，但它从哪里来？教材的加碱量可能留下额外的游离氢氧根。为辨认原因，先看没有额外碱的一份，再与保留额外碱的一份比较。
cues.en: For the final textbook experiment, prepare white magnesium hydroxide before adding iron(III). The brown iron precipitate requires hydroxide, but where does it come from? The earlier base addition may leave extra hydroxide dissolved. First examine a sample without extra base, then compare it with one that retains extra base.

cues.title: 新沉淀促使旧沉淀溶解
cues.titleEn: A new precipitate draws on the old solid
cues.caption: Fe(OH)₃ 接走 OH⁻；镁转入水相。
cues.captionEn: Fe(OH)₃ forms; magnesium enters water.
cues.zh: 先看没有额外碱的比较。铁离子与溶液中的氢氧根形成褐色固体；氢氧根被消耗，氢氧化镁继续溶解补充。跟住镁：它没有变成铁，而是进入水中。按净计量，三份氢氧化镁提供的六份氢氧根，可以形成两份氢氧化铁。这个图记录物料去向，不声称展示真实的基元反应。
cues.en: In the comparison without extra base, iron takes up dissolved hydroxide to form the brown solid. Consuming hydroxide allows magnesium hydroxide to dissolve further. Follow magnesium: it enters water rather than turning into iron. In the net account, three magnesium hydroxide units supply six hydroxides for two iron hydroxide units. This is a material map, not an elementary reaction mechanism.

cues.title: 同样褐色，能证明同一路径吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the same brown colour prove the same route?
cues.caption: 相同 Fe(OH)₃，可以对应不同的镁去向。
cues.captionEn: Same brown solid, different Mg fate.
cues.zh: 两份样品加入同量的铁，最后都出现相同计量的褐色沉淀。一份要从原有氢氧化镁取得氢氧根，所以镁进入水中；另一份原先的额外氢氧根已经够用，便不必消耗那么多镁固体。因此，只看褐色不能确定转化了多少。要检验解释，应继续检查镁的去向和原先碱的余量。
cues.en: Give both samples the same amount of iron. They can produce the same amount of brown precipitate. One must draw hydroxide from magnesium hydroxide, releasing magnesium into water. The other already has enough extra hydroxide and need not consume that solid. Brown colour alone cannot reveal how much conversion occurred. Check magnesium’s destination and the initial excess base as well.

cues.title: 先看到三份沉淀
cues.caption: 出现沉淀，还不足以确定氯离子。
cues.captionEn: A precipitate alone does not identify chloride.
cues.zh: 先把盐酸、氯化钠溶液和碳酸钠溶液并排。加入硝酸银，三管都出现沉淀。前两管形成氯化银，第三管形成碳酸银。因此，仅凭有浅色沉淀，还不能把三管都判成含氯离子。教材把三者并排，正是为了先暴露这条判断的不充分之处。
cues.en: Compare hydrochloric acid, sodium chloride solution and sodium carbonate solution. Silver nitrate produces a precipitate in all three. The first two form silver chloride; the third forms silver carbonate. A pale precipitate alone therefore does not identify chloride. The side-by-side samples reveal the limitation of that first observation.

cues.title: 给沉淀第二次考验
cues.caption: 加稀硝酸：碳酸银消失，氯化银保留。
cues.captionEn: Acid removes Ag₂CO₃; AgCl persists.
cues.zh: 现在再加入稀硝酸。碳酸根被氢离子消耗，形成二氧化碳和水，碳酸银沉淀逐渐消失。前两管的氯化银在这个条件下保留。把第一步形成沉淀和第二步不溶于稀硝酸连在一起，才得到比颜色更有区分度的证据。这里用硝酸，避免把要检验的氯离子额外带进试样。
cues.en: Now add dilute nitric acid. Hydrogen ions consume carbonate to form carbon dioxide and water, so silver carbonate disappears. Silver chloride remains under these conditions. Combining precipitation with persistence in dilute nitric acid is more discriminating than colour alone. Nitric acid also avoids introducing the chloride being tested.

cues.title: 写出共同离子变化
cues.caption: 不同阳离子，给出同一氯离子证据。
cues.captionEn: Different cations; the same chloride evidence.
cues.zh: 停下来看前两管：它们原来的阳离子不同，却都由银离子与氯离子结合形成氯化银。净离子方程式删去了没有参与这一步的离子。第三管提供碳酸根的反例。这只是教材已知比较体系中的证据组合；面对任意复杂未知样品，还需要考虑其他干扰，不能把一管白色沉淀当成万能鉴定。
cues.en: Pause at the first two tubes. Their original cations differ, but silver and chloride ions form the same solid. The net ionic equation leaves out ions that do not participate. Carbonate supplies the counterexample. This evidence is valid for the textbook comparison; a complex unknown may require further separation and confirmation.

cues.title: 换成钡离子再比较
cues.caption: 两类阴离子，都能形成钡盐沉淀。
cues.captionEn: Both anions form barium precipitates.
cues.zh: 把试剂换成氯化钡，样品换成稀硫酸、硫酸钠和碳酸钠。三管同样都能出现白色沉淀。前两管是硫酸钡，第三管是碳酸钡。虽然它们外观相似，阴离子的化学性质并不相同。第一步只告诉我们形成了难溶物，还需要下一步来比较。
cues.en: Change the reagent to barium chloride and compare dilute sulfuric acid, sodium sulfate and sodium carbonate. All three can form white solids. The first two contain barium sulfate; the third contains barium carbonate. Similar appearance does not mean identical chemistry. Precipitation is only the first piece of evidence.

cues.title: 酸响应把证据分开
cues.caption: 加稀盐酸：碳酸钡消失，硫酸钡保留。
cues.captionEn: Acid removes BaCO₃; BaSO₄ persists.
cues.zh: 再加入稀盐酸。碳酸钡中的碳酸根被消耗，沉淀溶解，二氧化碳逸出；硫酸钡在教材所用的稀酸条件下保留。可见硫酸根检验与氯离子检验共享一种思路：先建立可见现象，再用另一个反应排除相似现象。它们的试剂和具体离子方程式仍然不同。
cues.en: Add dilute hydrochloric acid. Carbonate is consumed, barium carbonate dissolves, and carbon dioxide escapes. Barium sulfate persists in the dilute acid used here. The chloride and sulfate comparisons share an evidence strategy: create an observable change, then use another reaction to exclude a look-alike result. Their reagents and ionic equations remain distinct.

cues.title: 保留判断的适用范围
cues.titleEn: Keep the scope of the conclusion
cues.caption: 沉淀与加酸响应，共同构成证据。
cues.captionEn: Precipitation and acid response: two clues.
cues.zh: 最终保留下来的两管都包含硫酸钡。把它们与已经澄清的碳酸盐对照放在一起，才能看清酸这一步的价值。画面用一毫摩尔阴离子的计量模型追踪碳酸根和二氧化碳，不模拟真实沉淀速度或检出限。对于未知混合物，应使用适当空白、对照和完整分析顺序，避免试剂自身带来的离子干扰。
cues.en: Both persistent solids are barium sulfate. Comparing them with the cleared carbonate tube reveals why the acid step matters. The display follows a one-millimole stoichiometric model, not real precipitation rates or detection limits. For unknown mixtures, include suitable blank samples and comparison controls, and use an analysis sequence that avoids ions introduced by the reagents.

cues.title: 先分开两种刺激
cues.caption: 食物本来能引出反应，声音尚不能。
cues.captionEn: Food evokes a response before the sound acquires one.
cues.zh: 先分别测试食物与声音。食物能引起唾液反应，未经训练的声音还没有同样效果。留意杯中读数代表哪一种测试，不能把正在进食时的反应都归给声音。画面是相对反应的教学示意，并不是巴甫洛夫实验的原始测量记录。
cues.en: Test food and sound separately. Food evokes the basic salivary response; an untrained sound does not have the same effect. Notice which stimulus is being tested before interpreting the collection level. These relative responses illustrate a comparison rather than reproducing Pavlov’s measured volumes.

cues.title: 让声音预告食物
cues.caption: 重复配对后，声音单独测试的反应增强。
cues.captionEn: After repeated pairing, the sound-alone response grows.
cues.zh: 训练时，让声音先出现，食物随后到来。记录增加后，再单独测试声音，反应逐渐增强。关键是形成可以预测的关系，并非只要声音和食物都曾出现过就足够。自由探索可以去掉这种配对，观察模型中的声音反应是否仍然建立。
cues.en: During training, sound predicts the arrival of food. Subsequent sound-alone tests show an increasing learned response. Predictive pairing is the selected mechanism, not simply exposure to both events at unrelated times. Exploration can remove that pairing and test whether association develops.

cues.title: 声音不再得到强化
cues.caption: 声音反复不伴随食物，反应逐渐减弱。
cues.captionEn: Repeated sound without food reduces the response.
cues.zh: 保持之前的训练历史，再让声音出现却不提供食物。声音反应逐渐减弱，这叫消退。食物原有的反应没有因此消失。简化曲线只解释变化方向，不表示所有记忆被彻底擦除；真实条件学习还有复发、泛化等需要另外研究的现象。
cues.en: Preserve the training history, then repeatedly present sound without food. The sound response diminishes through extinction, while the basic food response remains. This curve illustrates a direction of change, not complete erasure of memory or every feature of real conditioning.

cues.title: 刺激位置与对侧响应
cues.caption: 皮层上部的表示联系对侧下肢。
cues.captionEn: An upper cortical representation relates to the opposite leg.
cues.zh: 换成运动皮层研究。给定刺激位置，再观察哪一侧、哪一部分躯体响应。这里先标出上部的下肢表示，对应对侧腿部。皮层、脑干和脊髓共同参与运动，图中一条定位关系不能理解为运动只靠皮层的一点独立完成。
cues.en: Now examine motor-cortex evidence. Specify the stimulated location before identifying the responding side and body region. The upper representation shown here relates to the opposite leg. Cortex, brainstem and spinal circuits contribute together; a mapped location does not act as an isolated movement switch.

cues.title: 换一个皮层位置
cues.caption: 位置改变后，对应的运动部位也改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing the cortical location changes the related body region.
cues.zh: 把刺激位置移到手部表示。手的标记改变，腿部不再是当前比较对象。精细控制需要较大的皮层表示，面积不按身体部位体积等比例分配。探索可以继续比较面部和另一侧皮层；这些色块只是示意定位，没有把真实边界说成几块整齐的按钮。
cues.en: Move the selected location to the hand representation and follow the corresponding body marker. Fine control can require a relatively large cortical representation, unrelated to physical body-part size. Exploration includes the face and the opposite hemisphere. Colored regions are schematic, not sharply separated buttons.

cues.title: 表达与理解可以分离
cues.caption: S病例理解保留，但流畅表达受损。
cues.captionEn: The S case preserves comprehension but impairs fluent expression.
cues.zh: 再看教材的病例证据。这个人能理解话语，听觉与发音器官也没有相应损坏，却难以流畅表达。保留功能与受损功能放在一起，比只说不会讲话更有解释力。教材把它与 S 区损伤相联系；这是病例观察，不是人为损伤人的实验。
cues.en: Consider the textbook’s first case. Comprehension, hearing and vocal organs are preserved, yet fluent expression is impaired. The combination is more informative than a general label of speech difficulty. Its association with the S-region lesion is observational case evidence, not an experiment that injures a person.

cues.title: 再比较另一组保留与受损
cues.caption: H病例能产生言语，却难以理解话语。
cues.captionEn: The H case can produce speech but has impaired comprehension.
cues.zh: 第二个病例能发出言语，听觉正常，但难以理解话语。与前一个病例对照，语言并不是一项不可拆分的能力。不过两个病例也不足以画出完整地图；真实语言依靠多个相互联系的区域，不能用左脑理性、右脑感性之类口号代替证据。
cues.en: The second case produces speech and has normal hearing but impaired comprehension. Contrasting the two profiles supports different functional contributions. It does not provide a complete language map: real language depends on connected regions, and simplistic left-brain versus right-brain slogans do not explain these observations.

cues.title: 笼子排除了哪一种解释？
cues.titleEn: Which explanation does the cage exclude?
cues.caption: 挡住直接研磨，仍允许胃液进入。
cues.captionEn: Block direct grinding; let gastric fluid through.
cues.zh: 肉块被金属笼保护，胃壁不能直接研磨它，胃液却能进入。笼子里的肉仍然消失了。这个对照排除了直接研磨是唯一原因，却没有认出胃液中的具体物质。下一步应把胃液分离出来，比较它与单独盐酸的作用。
cues.en: The cage protects one piece of meat from direct grinding, while gastric fluid can enter. The meat still disappears. This rules out grinding as the only cause, but does not identify the active substance. The next test separates gastric fluid and compares its action with acid alone.

cues.title: 加热和加酶，差别在哪里？
cues.titleEn: How do heating and catalysis differ?
cues.caption: 升温改变能量条件；催化改变反应路径。
cues.captionEn: Heating changes energy conditions; catalysis changes the pathway.
cues.zh: 四管从相同的过氧化氢开始，冒泡的快慢却不同。先看加热：原来的反应路径没变，分子获得能量，更容易越过能垒。再看催化：温度保持不变，催化体系提供另一条能垒较低的路径，本身在反应后恢复。它不是给反应补充燃料。回到试管，酶让氧气更快出现，却不会凭空增加过氧化氢能生成的氧气总量。若先把酶严重加热损伤，再在相同温度检测，你预测这条捷径还在吗？
cues.en: The tubes begin with equal peroxide, yet release bubbles at different rates. Heating keeps the original pathway but makes higher-energy states more accessible. Now hold temperature fixed. A catalyst provides another pathway with a lower barrier and is regenerated after turnover. It is not fuel for the reaction. Back in the tubes, oxygen appears sooner, but catalysis cannot create extra oxygen beyond the starting peroxide. If severe heating damages the enzyme before a matched-temperature assay, will that catalytic pathway remain available?

cues.title: 没有完整细胞，反应还会继续吗？
cues.titleEn: Can the reaction continue without intact cells?
cues.caption: 完整细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。
cues.captionEn: This reaction does not require intact cells.
cues.zh: 酵母经研磨、压榨和过滤，完整细胞留在滤渣，汁液中仍有溶出的成分。给汁液加糖，仍然形成酒精和二氧化碳。完整活细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。不过，滤液仍是复杂混合物，这还没有证明某一种纯酶的身份。
cues.en: Grinding, pressing and filtering yeast separates intact cells from dissolved material. Add sugar to the extract, and ethanol and carbon dioxide still form. This reaction does not require intact living cells to remain present. The extract is nevertheless a mixture; the experiment has not identified one purified enzyme.

cues.title: 结晶怎样同时连接成分与功能？
cues.titleEn: How do crystals link composition and function?
cues.caption: 蛋白性质和催化活性，需要两条证据。
cues.captionEn: Protein properties and catalytic activity require distinct evidence.
cues.zh: 把同一批脲酶结晶溶解，再分成两份。一份检验蛋白质性质，另一份检验它能否催化尿素分解。两条证据回答的是不同问题：有蛋白质，不等于已经证明催化；有催化，也不等于知道成分。萨姆纳把这些证据结合起来，确认了这份脲酶的蛋白质性质。
cues.en: Dissolve one batch of urease crystals and divide it into two samples. One tests protein properties; the other tests urea breakdown. These answer different questions. Protein does not by itself prove catalysis, and catalysis does not identify composition. Sumner combined such evidence to establish the protein nature of this urease.

cues.title: 同一种酶，为什么结果不同？
cues.titleEn: Why does the same enzyme give different outcomes?
cues.caption: 能结合并形成反应构型，才能走催化路径。
cues.captionEn: Productive binding needs the right chemical arrangement.
cues.zh: 同一种淀粉酶作用后，淀粉组出现还原性产物，蔗糖组却没有相同变化。把一小段淀粉放大：连续的葡萄糖单元在多个接触点定位，使要断开的连接靠近催化部位。水参与水解，链变短，酶还能继续工作。蔗糖的连接方式不同，不能形成这里所需的反应构型。专一性不是按颜色挑选，也不只是外形像钥匙。换一种能催化蔗糖水解的酶，结果就可能改变。
cues.en: After the same amylase treatment, starch yields reducing products while sucrose does not show the same change. Zoom into a short starch segment. Several contacts position its glucose units and bring the target linkage into a productive catalytic arrangement. Water participates in hydrolysis, shorter fragments leave, and the enzyme can work again. Sucrose has a different linkage and does not form this arrangement. Specificity is chemical as well as geometric. A different enzyme that hydrolyzes sucrose can change that outcome.

cues.title: 两支都慢的试管，原因一样吗？
cues.titleEn: Can two slow samples have different causes?
cues.caption: 低温减慢过程；强热还可能损伤催化结构。
cues.captionEn: Cold slows turnover; severe heat can damage catalytic structure.
cues.zh: 先看等时反应后留下的淀粉。低温组反应慢，强热组也可能留下很多，但原因未必相同。低温下，酶的结构仍能保持，只是反应过程较慢。强热还会逐渐破坏维持催化部位的结构，原来的接触关系不再合适。温度同时影响反应速度和结构保存，不能只记一个最高点。把各组都恢复到同一温度，再比较一次，能分开这两种解释。
cues.en: Equal-time samples can leave much starch after either cold or severe heat, but the causes need not match. In the cold, catalytic structure may remain intact while turnover slows. Severe heat can also progressively disrupt the arrangement that supports catalysis. Temperature affects both reaction speed and structural survival. A peak is specific to the enzyme and assay. Bringing all samples to one temperature gives a new test of the two explanations.

cues.title: 酸碱改变了酶的什么？
cues.titleEn: What does pH change in an enzyme?
cues.caption: 酸碱改变基团状态；极端条件还可能破坏结构。
cues.captionEn: pH changes group states; extremes may also damage structure.
cues.zh: 相同温度下改变酸碱，先与每种酸碱条件下的无酶空白比较，再判断酶带来的放氧。再看一个解释模型：酸碱会改变某些基团带不带氢、带什么电荷，影响催化所需的接触和反应状态。极端条件还可能破坏空间结构。所以活性降低不只有一种原因。恢复原来的酸碱条件后，活性是否回来，是下一条证据，不能只看原来那支冒泡少的试管。
cues.en: At a matched temperature, compare oxygen release across pH conditions with a no-enzyme blank for each. Now switch to an explanatory model. pH changes the protonation and charge of some chemical groups, altering contacts and reaction states needed for catalysis. Extreme conditions can also damage the fold. Reduced activity therefore has more than one possible cause. Restoring the original pH provides a further test; low bubbling alone cannot tell us which cause occurred.

cues.title: 回到相同条件，能恢复吗？
cues.titleEn: What recovers under the same conditions?
cues.caption: 统一检测条件，才能读出处理留下的影响。
cues.captionEn: A common assay condition reveals the effect of pretreatment.
cues.zh: 这次只先处理酶，之后三组都回到二十五摄氏度，再加入相同的新底物。低温组的催化结构还在，反应恢复；严重受热损伤的那一组仍然较慢。现在温度相同，差别来自之前留下的状态。这解释了为什么许多酶制品要低温保存，而不是使用前越烫越好。这里演示的是未恢复的热损伤，不代表所有酶在所有条件下都不能重新折叠。
cues.en: Pretreat the enzyme first. Then bring all three samples to twenty-five degrees and add equal fresh substrate. The cold sample retains its catalytic structure and recovers activity; the severely damaged sample remains slower. With the current temperature matched, the difference reflects prior history. This helps explain cold storage of many enzyme preparations. The model assumes persistent heat damage; it does not claim that every enzyme is unable to refold.

cues.title: 先确定溶质量
cues.caption: 100 mL、1.00 mol/L对应0.100 mol NaCl。
cues.captionEn: 100 mL at 1.00 mol/L requires 0.100 mol of NaCl.
cues.zh: 先算清需要多少溶质。浓度乘最终溶液体积，得到零点一摩尔氯化钠。沿用教材常用的相对原子质量，摩尔质量取五十八点五克每摩尔，需要五点八五克。固体先在烧杯中完全溶解。盐粒从视野中消失，不代表溶质消失；金色追踪点只是说明离子已分散，真实的盐水仍然无色。
cues.en: First determine the required solute amount. Multiplying concentration by final solution volume gives 0.100 mole of sodium chloride. Using the textbook rounded molar mass of 58.5 grams per mole requires 5.85 grams. Dissolve the solid completely in a beaker. Disappearing grains do not mean disappearing solute: the gold tracking marks represent dissolved material, while the real solution remains colourless.

cues.title: 追踪转移后的残留
cues.caption: 液体倒出后，原容器内壁仍可能留下溶质。
cues.captionEn: Pouring out the solution can leave solute on the original vessel walls.
cues.zh: 把溶液沿玻璃棒转入容量瓶，跟着溶质的账本看变化。大部分进入新容器，原烧杯与玻璃棒上仍可能留有少量溶液。这里故意用百分之九十五的回收率放大这种误差，它不是实测值。若忽略残留，后来即使把体积定得很准，得到的浓度仍会偏低。
cues.en: Transfer the solution along the glass rod into the volumetric flask. Most solute reaches the flask, but solution may remain on the beaker and rod. The demonstration deliberately uses 95 percent recovery to make this loss visible; that is an illustrative assumption, not a measured value. Even a perfectly adjusted final volume cannot correct for solute that never reaches the flask.

cues.title: 把洗涤液也转入
cues.caption: 洗涤把原容器中的溶质带回同一份溶液。
cues.captionEn: Rinsing returns residual solute to the same solution.
cues.zh: 教材要求用少量蒸馏水洗涤烧杯内壁和玻璃棒，并把洗涤液一并转入。观察原容器中的溶质量减少，容量瓶里的溶质量增加，总量保持不变。洗涤增加的是转移回收率，不是凭空增加氯化钠。用于洗涤的水最终也属于待定容的溶液，因此仍然要以容量瓶最后的体积为准。
cues.en: Rinse the beaker walls and glass rod with small portions of distilled water and transfer the rinsings too. Residual solute decreases as the amount in the flask increases, while the total stays constant. Rinsing improves recovery; it does not create sodium chloride. The rinse water becomes part of the solution, whose final volume is still set by the flask calibration mark.

cues.title: 体积以凹液面为准
cues.caption: 平视凹液面最低点，让它与刻度线相切。
cues.captionEn: View at eye level and align the meniscus bottom with the calibration line.
cues.zh: 接近刻度线时换用滴管，观察瓶颈局部。刻度线对应的是在标示温度下所容纳的溶液体积。平视凹液面最低点，把它调到与刻度线相切。注意，配制一百毫升溶液，不是向溶质中加入一百毫升水。最后液面过高，体积偏大，浓度就偏低；液面不足则相反。
cues.en: Near the calibration mark, add water with a dropper and inspect the neck closely. The mark specifies the contained solution volume at the stated temperature. View the bottom of the concave meniscus at eye level and align it with the line. Preparing 100 millilitres of solution does not mean adding 100 millilitres of water. An excessive final volume lowers concentration; an insufficient volume raises it.

cues.title: 混匀后才处处相同
cues.caption: 混匀改变局部分布，溶质总量与总体积保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Mixing changes local distribution while total solute and volume remain fixed.
cues.zh: 定容后还需要盖好瓶塞并充分混匀。这里用深浅不同的分层表示局部浓度，随着混匀逐渐变得一致。它不是盐水真的分成这些颜色，也没有模拟完整流体运动。总溶质量和总体积都没有改变，改变的是各处取样的浓度差别。完成后还要把溶液转入适当容器并标明名称和浓度。
cues.en: After setting the volume, stopper the flask and mix thoroughly. Shading represents unequal local concentrations becoming uniform. The salt solution does not literally have these colours, and the model does not solve the full fluid motion. Total solute and total volume stay fixed; what changes is the concentration difference between sampling locations. Transfer the finished solution to a suitable labelled container.

cues.title: 稀释时保留所取溶质量
cues.caption: 50.0 mL的1.00 mol/L母液，定容到100 mL后为0.500 mol/L。
cues.captionEn: 50.0 mL of 1.00 mol/L stock made up to 100 mL gives 0.500 mol/L.
cues.zh: 实验活动还要求由已有溶液进行稀释。量取五十毫升一摩尔每升的母液，其中含零点零五摩尔氯化钠。把这部分溶液完整转移，再定容到一百毫升，浓度变成零点五摩尔每升。稀释式两边相等的是溶质的物质的量。教材根据学校条件暂用量筒，并在脚注说明精确移取应使用移液管；量取和定容的精度都会影响最终结果。
cues.en: The practical activity also prepares a dilution. A 50 millilitre portion of 1.00 molar stock contains 0.050 mole of sodium chloride. Transfer that portion completely and make the final volume 100 millilitres: the result is 0.500 molar. The dilution equation equates solute amounts. The textbook permits a measuring cylinder for school conditions while noting that accurate transfer uses a pipette; transfer and final-volume precision both affect the result.

cues.title: ATP究竟改变了谁？
cues.caption: ATP具体改变了哪个分子？
cues.captionEn: What does ATP change?
cues.zh: ATP供能，究竟改变了什么？跟住末端这个磷原子。在己糖激酶中，它带着三个氧转移，原来连接前一个磷的氧留在ADP里。葡萄糖原来的氧接上磷，糖变成葡萄糖六磷酸。这是同一次酶反应中的耦联，不是一团能量先飞出来。游离无机磷酸不能替代这里的ATP。图中合并了质子和镁离子等细节。这是糖酵解的第一次ATP投入。
cues.en: When A. T. P. supplies energy, what changes? Follow its terminal phosphorus. In hexokinase, it transfers with three oxygen atoms. The oxygen linking it to the previous phosphorus stays in A. D. P.. The original oxygen on glucose joins the transferred phosphorus, forming glucose six-phosphate. These changes are coupled within one enzyme reaction; no energy packet flies between them. Free phosphate cannot replace A. T. P. here. Proton and magnesium details are omitted. This is the first A. T. P. investment in glycolysis.

cues.title: 两瓶都能让石灰水变浑吗？
cues.caption: 先排除空气带来的二氧化碳。
cues.captionEn: Exclude carbon dioxide already in the air.
cues.zh: 通气和密闭的两瓶酵母，为什么都可能产生二氧化碳？先别急着解释。通气瓶的气体还可能来自空气。跟住两种标记：外来的二氧化碳先被吸收，氧仍能进入培养瓶；新生成的二氧化碳再通向检测液。少了前面的吸收步骤，变浑就不能单独证明气体来自酵母。
cues.en: Why can both an aerated culture and a sealed culture produce carbon dioxide? First, check where the gas came from. In the aerated setup, incoming air already contains carbon dioxide. Follow the labels: that carbon dioxide is absorbed before oxygen reaches the culture. Newly produced carbon dioxide then reaches the detector. Without the first absorber, cloudiness alone cannot establish that the yeast made the gas.

cues.title: 密闭就等于没有氧吗？
cues.caption: 氧用尽后仍产气，才提出新问题。
cues.captionEn: Gas after oxygen depletion poses a new question.
cues.zh: 塞住瓶口，瓶里原来还有氧。看这份有限的氧逐渐减少：早期出现气体，仍可能有有氧呼吸的贡献。等氧已经耗尽，气体却还能继续产生，这才需要另一条解释。我们将这段状态和通气条件比较。瓶子是否密闭只是装置条件，细胞实际有没有氧，才是判断过程的重要证据。
cues.en: A stopper does not remove the oxygen already inside a flask. Watch that finite supply decline. Early gas production can still include aerobic respiration. When oxygen is depleted but gas continues, another explanation is needed. We compare that state with the aerated condition. A sealed container is a setup condition; whether oxygen remains available to the cells is the evidence that matters.

cues.title: 同样冒气，产物也一样吗？
cues.caption: 检验识别产物，不直接数出ATP。
cues.captionEn: Product tests do not count ATP.
cues.zh: 把两份培养液的身份保持不变，再检验产物。二氧化碳检验能说明产气；乙醇检验还要排除残余葡萄糖带来的变色干扰。教材的理想化对照把两种代谢路径分开，但实际高糖酵母即使有氧，也可能产生乙醇。于是，检测结果需要和条件一起判断。现在的问题更具体了：碳去了哪里？为什么没有氧，细胞还能获得少量ATP？
cues.en: Keep the identities of the two culture samples as we test their products. Carbon dioxide detection establishes gas production. Interpreting the ethanol test also requires excluding color change caused by residual glucose. The textbook contrast separates ideal metabolic routes; real yeast at high sugar concentrations can produce ethanol even with oxygen. Conditions and tests must therefore be interpreted together. Where did the carbon go, and how can A. T. P. still be obtained without oxygen?

cues.title: 六个碳与两份载体
cues.caption: 碳拆开；ATP和电子载体另记账。
cues.captionEn: Track carbon, ATP and electron carriers separately.
cues.zh: 先跟住同一葡萄糖的六个碳。糖酵解把它们分到两个丙酮酸里，这时还没有释放二氧化碳。全程先投入两个ATP，随后生成四个，净得两个。同时，两份NAD加接受还原当量，变成NADH。现在只留下这两份载体：如果它们一直保持NADH状态，下一批需要NAD加的反应就无法继续。持续获得ATP，还需要把载体再生回来。
cues.en: Follow the six carbon atoms of one glucose. Glycolysis distributes them into two pyruvates; no carbon dioxide is released at this stage. Two A. T. P. are invested and four are produced, giving a net gain of two. At the same time, two NAD-plus carriers accept reducing equivalents and become NADH. Now keep only these two carriers available. If both remain reduced, the next reaction requiring NAD-plus cannot continue. Sustained A. T. P. production needs a way to regenerate the carriers.

cues.title: 氧怎样接上ATP合成？
cues.titleEn: How does oxygen support ATP production?
cues.caption: 电子传递建立膜两侧的能量差。
cues.captionEn: Electron transfer builds a membrane energy difference.
cues.zh: 有氧时，碳可以进一步氧化成二氧化碳；但氧与ATP之间还有一段连接。看这个局部过程：载体交出电子，电子沿内膜上的传递链，最后交给氧，形成水。能量转移推动质子到膜的另一侧。质子再通过ATP合酶返回，推动ADP和无机磷酸生成ATP。突然停止供氧，电子传递受阻；已经建立的差异会逐渐消耗，ATP合成随之减慢，而不是瞬间清零。这里不按气泡数换算ATP。
cues.en: With oxygen, carbon can be oxidized further to carbon dioxide. But oxygen supports A. T. P. production through another connection. In this local view, a carrier passes electrons into a membrane transport chain. Oxygen ultimately accepts them to form water. Energy transfer moves protons across the membrane. Their return through A. T. P. synthase drives A. T. P. formation from A. D. P. and phosphate. Stop the oxygen supply: electron transfer is blocked, while the stored membrane difference gradually drains. A. T. P. production slows rather than vanishing instantly. Bubbles are not an A. T. P. counter.

cues.title: 没有氧，怎样让载体回来？
cues.titleEn: How are carriers recycled without oxygen?
cues.caption: 再生载体，让糖酵解继续。
cues.captionEn: Recycle carriers so glycolysis can continue.
cues.zh: 没有氧，酵母可以走另一条路。丙酮酸先失去一个碳，形成二氧化碳；留下的两个碳接受NADH带来的还原当量，成为乙醇。原来那份NAD加回来了，下一批糖酵解得以继续。这段发酵本身没有额外生成ATP。再看同型乳酸发酵：三个碳全部留下，同样再生载体，却不产生二氧化碳。所以，没看见气泡，不等于没有获得ATP；气体和乙醇检测，也不能替代能量收支。
cues.en: Without oxygen, yeast can take another route. Pyruvate loses one carbon as carbon dioxide. The two-carbon product accepts reducing equivalents from NADH and becomes ethanol. The same NAD-plus carrier is restored, allowing another glycolytic batch to proceed. This fermentation step adds no further A. T. P.. In homolactic fermentation, all three carbons stay together and the carrier is also regenerated, but no carbon dioxide is produced. No visible bubbles therefore does not mean no A. T. P. production. Gas and ethanol tests cannot replace an energy account.

cues.title: 把水作为唯一比较条件
cues.caption: 干纸条保留颜色，湿纸条褪色。
cues.captionEn: Dry paper keeps colour; damp paper fades.
cues.zh: 两个集气瓶都盛有干燥氯气，有色纸条的差别在于是否湿润。观察一段时间，干纸条基本保留颜色，湿纸条逐渐褪色。这组对照说明，在教材条件下，不能只把褪色归因于干燥氯气与纸条直接接触，还必须把水的参与考虑进去。比较的是含水状态，纸条材料和观察条件应保持相近。
cues.en: Both jars contain dry chlorine, while the coloured papers differ in whether they are damp. The dry paper retains its colour and the damp paper fades. Under the textbook conditions, contact with dry chlorine alone is therefore not a sufficient explanation: water must be included. A useful comparison keeps the paper material and observation conditions otherwise similar.

cues.title: 鲜花带着自己的水
cues.titleEn: A fresh flower brings its own water
cues.caption: 气体虽干燥，鲜花组织仍含水。
cues.captionEn: Dry gas; water inside the flower.
cues.zh: 再把有色鲜花作为观察对象。它在干燥氯气中也会变色。这并没有推翻前面的干湿对照，因为干燥说的是气体，鲜花组织本身仍含有水。不要把整瓶气体的状态，误当成瓶中每个物体都干燥。鲜花的例子把纸条实验中的水条件，迁移到了真实的含水组织。
cues.en: A coloured fresh flower also changes in dry chlorine. This does not contradict the paper comparison: dry describes the gas, while the tissue still contains water. The condition of the surrounding gas does not make every object inside the jar dry. The flower transfers the same water-dependent explanation from paper to living tissue.

cues.title: 把观察连接到化学变化
cues.caption: 水参与形成次氯酸，使着色结构改变。
cues.captionEn: Water enables HOCl formation and colour change.
cues.zh: 在湿润表面，氯气溶于水，并与水发生可逆反应，形成盐酸和次氯酸。教材把漂白作用联系到次氯酸的强氧化性：色素原来的着色结构被改变，颜色便可能减弱或消失。图中断开的圆点只是结构变化的概念示意，不能当成某一种真实色素的完整反应式。干湿对照支持水参与，至于各个实际产物，还需要更具体的化学分析。
cues.en: At a wet surface, chlorine dissolves and reacts reversibly with water to form hydrochloric acid and hypochlorous acid. The textbook connects bleaching to the strong oxidizing action of HOCl, which changes colour-bearing structures. The separated dots are a conceptual representation, not a complete reaction formula for a particular pigment. The dry–damp comparison supports the involvement of water; identifying actual molecular products requires further chemical analysis.

cues.title: 先确认结构身份
cues.caption: 淋巴内皮标记与血管标记相互区分。
cues.captionEn: Lymphatic identity markers differ from vascular labels.
cues.zh: 先在脑膜层内找结构，而不是到脑实质里寻找绿色管道。研究沿硬脑膜静脉窦比较了具有淋巴内皮特征的结构，LYVE一与PROX一等标记提供身份线索。画面是原创证据重建，颜色不等同于原图，也不能把一次染色阳性直接说成已经证明运输功能。
cues.en: Begin within the meningeal layer, outside the brain parenchyma. Lymphatic endothelial markers, including LYVE-one and PROX-one, help identify structures alongside dural sinuses. This is an original reconstruction rather than a microscopy image. Identity evidence alone does not establish transport function.

cues.title: 让另一种示踪物检验通路
cues.caption: 脑脊液示踪物沿路径到达引流方向。
cues.captionEn: A CSF tracer tests the drainage route.
cues.zh: 再加入功能证据。紫色标记代表脑脊液中引入的示踪物，与静脉内的血管标记不是同一批物质。它进入淋巴路径并朝颈深淋巴结方向移动。身份与运输两类证据相互补充；这里没有把所有脑内液体流动都称为淋巴管运输。
cues.en: Now add functional evidence. Purple markers represent a CSF-introduced tracer, distinct from the intravenous vascular label. Following the lymphatic route toward deep cervical lymph nodes complements the identity evidence. The model does not label every movement of fluid in the brain as lymphatic transport.

cues.title: 先呈递，再匹配
cues.caption: 辅助T细胞识别呈递的抗原信息。
cues.captionEn: Helper T cells recognize presented antigen information.
cues.zh: 来到适应性免疫。抗原呈递细胞先处理相关物质，再把抗原片段与呈递分子一起展示。所选辅助T细胞核对匹配关系后，才能进入相应的活化过程。画面中的三角形标明同一种抗原信息，不能把呈递细胞和受体之间的关系理解成随意碰撞就会响应。
cues.en: An antigen-presenting cell displays processed antigen information together with a presenting molecule. A matching helper T cell can then participate in the selected activation route. The triangle preserves antigen identity; arbitrary contact does not automatically activate every lymphocyte.

cues.title: 两个条件共同支持活化
cues.caption: 相应抗原与辅助信号促成B细胞克隆扩增。
cues.captionEn: Matching antigen and help support B-cell expansion.
cues.zh: 观察B细胞这一步。它识别相应抗原，并在这里选定的T依赖性途径中获得辅助信号，随后发生克隆扩增。关闭匹配或辅助条件，模型不会偷偷继续到抗体阶段。扩增的是相同特异性的细胞群，不是把一种受体瞬间改造成能识别所有病原体的受体。
cues.en: In the selected T-dependent route, B-cell antigen recognition and helper input precede activation and clonal expansion. Removing either condition blocks the subsequent modeled stage. Expansion preserves the clone’s specificity rather than converting one receptor into a universal pathogen detector.

cues.title: 抗体在细胞外结合
cues.caption: 浆细胞释放的抗体连续到达相应抗原。
cues.captionEn: Plasma-cell antibodies reach matching extracellular antigen.
cues.zh: 扩增后分化出的浆细胞分泌抗体。跟住每一个Y形标记，它从细胞外侧到达相应抗原并结合。抗体不是钻进感染细胞内部的清扫工具。结合可以阻断部分病原体的作用，并帮助后续清除；这里没有用小点瞬间消失来代替这些不同环节。
cues.en: Plasma cells produce antibodies. Follow each Y-shaped identity from the cell surface toward matching extracellular antigen. Antibodies are not shown entering infected cells. Binding can neutralize selected effects and support later clearance; disappearance is not used as a shortcut for these separate processes.

cues.title: 把目标换成感染细胞
cues.caption: 细胞毒性T细胞识别后诱导靶细胞凋亡。
cues.captionEn: Recognition can induce apoptosis of an infected target.
cues.zh: 现在看另一条路径。细胞毒性T细胞靠近感染细胞，识别其呈递的相关抗原，随后引导靶细胞进入凋亡。细胞内部的病原标记始终与细胞外抗体图区分开。靶细胞死亡之后，碎片和释放物还需要其他清除过程，并不等于病原体已经全部消失。
cues.en: A cytotoxic T cell contacts an infected cell and checks its presented antigen before inducing target-cell apoptosis. Intracellular markers remain distinct from the preceding extracellular antibody targets. Debris and released material still require additional clearance; target-cell death is not instant elimination of every pathogen.

cues.title: 同一抗原，再遇一次
cues.caption: 匹配的记忆缩短反应等待；异种抗原需初次反应。
cues.captionEn: Matching memory accelerates recall; a new antigen needs a primary response.
cues.zh: 最后比较初次和再次相遇。已有记忆且抗原匹配时，模型较早产生响应。若换成另一种抗原，原来的记忆不能直接代替新的识别，但机体仍可以建立新的初次反应。两条曲线的延迟和速率是教学选值，不能拿横轴去推算疫苗或感染的真实保护时间。
cues.en: Compare first encounter with recall. Existing matching memory produces an earlier modeled response. A different antigen does not use that specific memory, but can still initiate a new primary response. Delays and rates are declared teaching choices, not predictions of protection after vaccination or infection.

cues.title: 三个探头，为什么一起变？
cues.titleEn: Why do all three probes change?
cues.caption: 一个下降，两个上升：它们测的是什么？
cues.captionEn: One falls, two rise. What does each probe measure?
cues.zh: 光照后，同一瓶氯水里的三条读数都变了。液体的pH下降，氯离子浓度上升，上方气体中氧气的比例也上升。沿着探头找一找：两支在水里，一支在气体中。它们测的不是同一个量，为什么会一起变化？先跟着光，进入一个分子。
cues.en: After illumination, three readings from one chlorine-water sample change. Liquid pH falls, chloride concentration rises, and the oxygen fraction above the liquid rises. Follow the probes: two are in the liquid, one in the gas. They measure different quantities. What connects these changes? Follow the light into a molecule.

cues.title: 光吸收后，哪条键断开？
cues.caption: 盯住氧—氯键的两个电子。
cues.captionEn: Track the two electrons in the oxygen–chlorine bond.
cues.zh: 看这个被吸收的紫外光子。次氯酸的氧—氯键可以由此断开。盯住成键的两个电子：分开时，各有一个跟着自己的片段。氢仍连在氧上，形成羟基自由基；另一边是氯自由基。它们都是电中性的，还不是探头读到的氯离子。光先打开了一条反应通道。
cues.en: Watch this selected absorbed ultraviolet photon. It can open a channel that breaks the oxygen–chlorine bond. Track the two bonding electrons: one stays with each fragment as they separate. Hydrogen remains joined to oxygen, making a hydroxyl radical; the other fragment is a chlorine radical. Both are neutral. We have not yet made the chloride ion measured by the probe.

cues.title: 同一批原子，最后去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where do the same atoms end up?
cues.caption: 经过后续多步反应，再看净变化。
cues.captionEn: After further reactions, follow the net changes.
cues.zh: 断开这条键只是起点，并不是生成氧气的完整过程。现在把后续多步反应合成一张净变化账本。两份次氯酸减少，水中增加两份氢离子和两份氯离子；两个氧原子组成一份氧气。氢离子增多，对应pH降低；氯离子增多，对应另一支探头上升。再跟着同一对氧，越过液面，来到气体探头这一侧。
cues.en: Breaking that bond is a beginning, not the complete route to oxygen. Now combine subsequent reactions into a net account. Two hypochlorous acid units are consumed, adding two hydrogen ions and two chloride ions to the liquid; their oxygen atoms form one oxygen molecule. More hydrogen ions mean lower pH, while chloride concentration rises. Follow the same oxygen pair across the liquid surface to the gas probe’s side.

cues.title: 同一份变化，为什么读数增幅不同？
cues.titleEn: Why do the readings change by different amounts?
cues.caption: 先数物质的量，再看各自的刻度。
cues.captionEn: Count the amounts, then inspect each measurement scale.
cues.zh: 数一数：新增两份氯离子，对应一份氧气。这就是净反应给出的二比一关系。可别期待三条曲线长得一样。pH把氢离子浓度放到对数刻度上；氯离子探头读浓度；氧气探头读它占全部气体的比例。尤其是这个分母：原来有多少气体，也会改变最后的氧气读数。
cues.en: Count the products: two new chloride ions accompany one oxygen molecule. That is the net reaction’s two-to-one amount relation.
