But the three curves need not look alike. pH uses a logarithmic concentration scale, the chloride probe measures concentration, and the oxygen probe measures a fraction of all the gas. Notice that denominator: the amount of gas already there also affects the final reading.

cues.title: 氧气比例更小，就产得更少吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a smaller oxygen fraction mean less was made?
cues.caption: 同样产气，哪路读数会变？
cues.captionEn: With equal oxygen production, which reading changes?
cues.zh: 现在换两份独立样品：液体一样多，次氯酸净分解量也一样，只把B上方的气体体积加倍。先猜，哪路读数会变？两份新生成的氧气相同，B却有更多原有气体。混合后，B的氧气比例较小，液体的pH和氯离子浓度仍然相同。所以，看到比例较低，先问分母变了没有，再判断产量。
cues.en: Compare two separate samples with equal liquid volumes and equal net decomposition. Only B has twice the initial headspace. First predict: which reading changes? Both make the same amount of oxygen, but B starts with more gas. After mixing, B has the smaller oxygen fraction; liquid pH and chloride concentration remain equal. Before interpreting a lower fraction as lower production, check whether its denominator changed.

cues.title: 一杯绿色，只有一种色素吗？
cues.caption: 同一份绿色滤液，可能含有不同色素。
cues.captionEn: One green extract can contain several pigments.
cues.zh: 这份滤液看起来只有一种绿色，能说明里面只有一种色素吗？先跟住叶片中的几类标记。它们原本在细胞内部，研磨破坏结构，溶剂把色素提取出来。过滤留下较大的残渣，溶解的色素仍混在一起。所以，提取成功只是获得样品；要区分成分，还需要新的证据。
cues.en: This extract looks uniformly green. Does that establish that it contains only one pigment? Follow several marked pigment classes inside the leaf. Disrupting the tissue gives solvent access to them. Filtration retains larger debris, while dissolved pigments remain together. Extraction gives us a sample. Separating its components requires another piece of evidence.

cues.title: 为什么同一起点会丢失？
cues.titleEn: How can the shared origin be lost?
cues.caption: 共同且集中的起点，才能比较迁移。
cues.captionEn: Keep the origin shared and narrow.
cues.zh: 把同一份混合物集中在一条细线上。溶剂能沿纸上升，但色素线开始时应在液面上方。现在只升高液面：标记进入槽液，纸上的共同起点变弱了。恢复正常位置，起点才保持可比较。细线也很关键：一开始铺得太宽，后面即使迁移不同，色带仍可能重叠。
cues.en: Concentrate the same mixture at one narrow origin. Solvent can rise through the paper, while the pigment line begins above the liquid. Raise only the liquid level: marked pigment enters the reservoir and the controlled origin weakens. A narrow origin also matters. If the initial zone is too broad, components with different migration can still overlap.

cues.title: 不是跑得快，而是停留得不同
cues.titleEn: Different time spent moving and retained
cues.caption: 分配差异累积成迁移差异。
cues.captionEn: Different partition, different migration.
cues.zh: 前沿继续上升，色带却渐渐分开。放大纸上的一小段，跟住两种标记。处在流动相里的部分会被带走，留在固定环境里的部分暂时落后；交换反复发生。不同色素在这两种环境中的分配不同，许多次累积后，形成不同的迁移距离。这里用一个简化分配模型解释过程，不把色带位置当作分子大小排名。回到整张纸，四类主要色带分开了。再预测：如果两种色素在新的条件下分配相同，它们还能靠这次层析分开吗？
cues.en: The solvent front rises, yet the pigment bands separate. Zoom into one region and follow two marked pigments. The portion in the mobile phase is carried forward; the retained portion stays behind for a while. Repeated exchange accumulates into different migration distances. Our simplified distribution model explains that process. It does not rank molecules by size or claim universal migration ratios. Returning to the whole paper reveals the main bands. Now predict: if two pigments have the same distribution under new conditions, will this separation still distinguish them?

cues.title: 绿色是留下的光，还是吸收的光？
cues.titleEn: Is green light absorbed or left over?
cues.caption: 同波长比较入射与透过，才能判断吸收。
cues.captionEn: Match wavelength to compare absorption.
cues.zh: 另一条证据来自光。先看空白溶剂，再放入色素溶液，保持光程和浓度条件清楚。比较同一波长进入和离开的光，才能判断吸收。叶绿素a在蓝光和红光附近吸收较强，绿色区域透过较多，但并不是完全不吸收。图中比例来自测得的光谱系数。看见绿色，不能反过来说它最强地吸收绿色。
cues.en: Light provides a different kind of evidence. Compare a solvent blank with the pigment solution under stated concentration and path-length conditions. Incoming and transmitted intensity must be compared at the same wavelength. Chlorophyll a absorbs strongly near blue and red, while more green light passes. Green absorption is not zero. These fractions come from measured spectral coefficients. Seeing green does not mean that green is the strongest absorption region.

cues.title: 把光谱变成一个可检验的预测
cues.titleEn: Turn the spectrum into a testable prediction
cues.caption: 浓度加倍：透过率 T → T²。
cues.captionEn: Double concentration: T → T².
cues.zh: 三种色素的峰位不同，这也是独立区分样品的线索。这里比较的是指定溶剂中的测量，不是整片叶的光合效率。现在保留同一种色素和波长，只把浓度加倍。第二份相同的吸收作用再次减少剩余的光：透过比例要相乘，不是直接减去一半。预测之后再揭晓结果。色带位置回答如何分离，光谱回答哪些光被吸收，这两项证据不能互相替代。
cues.en: The three pigments have different spectral peaks, providing another way to compare samples. These measurements use specified solvents and do not directly measure whole-leaf photosynthesis. Keep one pigment and wavelength fixed, then double its concentration. An equal additional absorbing amount acts on the light that remains: transmission fractions multiply rather than simply halving. Predict before revealing the result. Migration and absorption answer different questions; neither measurement substitutes for the other.

cues.title: 气体不变，解释要接受检验
cues.titleEn: The gas stays fixed; test its explanation
cues.caption: 气体的组成，需要超越颜色的证据。
cues.captionEn: Composition needs evidence beyond colour.
cues.zh: 舍勒获得了黄绿色气体，但颜色不能告诉我们它由什么组成。后来，一种解释认为它含有容易转移的氧。这个解释应该经得起检验。戴维报告，预先除去氢和水分的炭，即使强烈加热，也没有使这种气体发生所期待的变化。画面保留这条观察，切换解释不会改写它。这使含氧的说法受到质疑，但一次没有反应，不能单独证明一种物质是元素。
cues.en: Scheele obtained a yellow-green gas, but its colour did not reveal its composition. A later explanation proposed that it contained readily transferable oxygen. That explanation needed a test. Davy reported that charcoal freed of hydrogen and moisture produced no expected change even under strong heating. Keep that observation fixed; changing the explanation must not rewrite it. The result challenged the oxygen claim, but one failed reaction cannot alone establish an element.

cues.title: 水里的氧，原来在哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where was the oxygen before the water formed?
cues.caption: 产物里有氧，不等于起始气体含氧。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen in a product need not come from the gas.
cues.zh: 还有一种看似有力的证据：氯化氢气体接触氧化铅后出现了水，于是有人认为原来的气体就含有结合水。戴维指出，氧化铅本身也带着氧。现在用现代原子账本重看：这个氧与酸提供的氢组成水，铅与氯形成盐。水仍然出现，氧的来源却换了一个解释。先预测：在这个只计算所列物质的模型里，去掉氧化铅，又没有外来水，还能生成水吗？氧的账本不允许凭空增加。
cues.en: Another observation seemed persuasive: hydrogen chloride gas produced water on contact with lead oxide. Some chemists inferred that the gas already contained combined water. Davy pointed out another oxygen source: the oxide itself. Use a modern atom account to reconsider the result. Its oxygen joins hydrogen from the acid; lead and chlorine form the salt. The water still appears, but its source has a different explanation. Predict: with no oxide and no external water in this listed-material model, can new water form? The oxygen account cannot create atoms.

cues.title: 用多种证据约束同一个解释
cues.titleEn: Constrain one explanation with several observations
cues.caption: 解释必须同时容纳不反应、生成物和元素来源。
cues.captionEn: An explanation must account for reactions and material sources together.
cues.zh: 把证据放在一起：没有从干燥气体中取得预期的氧，含氧产物又能由别的反应物提供氧来解释；氢与这种气体结合，得到氯化氢。不是每一条证据都能单独定案，而是同一个解释要同时说通它们。到一八一零年，戴维提出把这种物质看作一种元素。最后才叠加现代分子图：氢和氯结合成氯化氢，不需要氧。这个图是今天的解释，不是舍勒曾经直接看到的原子。
cues.en: Consider the observations together. The expected oxygen was not extracted from the dry gas. Oxygen-containing products could receive oxygen from other reactants. Hydrogen combined with this gas to form hydrogen chloride. No single observation settles the question alone; one explanation must account for them together. In 1810 Davy argued for treating the substance as an element. Only now overlay the modern molecular account: hydrogen and chlorine form hydrogen chloride without oxygen. These particles express today’s explanation, not atoms that Scheele directly observed.

cues.title: 追踪连续的气体路径
cues.caption: 发生瓶、收集瓶和尾气吸收装置必须形成连续路径。
cues.captionEn: Generator, collector and tail-gas absorber form one continuous path.
cues.zh: 回到教材的现代装置示意。气体从发生瓶进入导管，再从较长的管口进入收集瓶下部，原有气体由上部出口离开。沿着同一条连接继续追踪，流出的混合气体进入尾气吸收装置。收集瓶不是把后续气体全部吞下的容器；当其中氯气越来越多，离开收集瓶的气体也会含有氯气。
cues.en: Now examine the textbook’s modern apparatus. Gas leaves the generator through tubing and enters the lower part of the collecting jar through a long inlet. Existing gas leaves through the upper outlet and continues to the absorber. The collecting jar cannot retain unlimited gas. As its chlorine content rises, the departing gas also contains chlorine.

cues.title: 把尾气也纳入物质守恒
cues.titleEn: Include tail gas in the balance
cues.caption: NaOH把流出的Cl₂转变为溶液中的Cl⁻和ClO⁻。
cues.captionEn: Sodium hydroxide converts departing Cl₂ into dissolved Cl⁻ and ClO⁻.
cues.zh: 氢氧化钠溶液与氯气反应，把一份氯气转化为一份氯离子和一份次氯酸根，并消耗两份氢氧根。物质账本同时记录收集瓶内、已经吸收和未被吸收的部分，氯元素没有消失。演示用理想充分混合的模型说明守恒，不预测真实收集效率。氯气有毒，尾气处理是装置的一部分；这里不提供家庭制气条件或操作配方。
cues.en: Sodium hydroxide converts one amount of chlorine into one each of chloride and hypochlorite, consuming two amounts of hydroxide. The ledger follows chlorine retained, absorbed and unabsorbed; the element does not disappear. An ideal well-mixed model illustrates conservation rather than actual collection efficiency. Chlorine is toxic and tail-gas treatment is part of the apparatus. This visualization does not provide home generation conditions or recipes.

cues.title: 在氯气中观察火焰
cues.caption: 氢气可与氯气反应并出现苍白色火焰。
cues.captionEn: Hydrogen reacts with chlorine and produces a pale flame.
cues.zh: 教材把氢气在氯气中的燃烧与熟悉的含氧燃烧作比较。注意导管端附近的苍白色火焰：这里参与反应的是氢气和氯气，产物为氯化氢。这个现象说明，不能把所有燃烧都限定为与氧气反应。画面追踪的是一份物质的反应进程，火焰外形是观察示意，不是温度或光谱的计算结果。
cues.en: The textbook compares hydrogen burning in chlorine with familiar oxygen-based combustion. Notice the pale flame near the tube tip. Hydrogen and chlorine react to form hydrogen chloride. This demonstrates that combustion is not restricted to reactions with oxygen. The display follows a representative portion of material; flame shape is an observational diagram, not a calculation of temperature or spectrum.

cues.title: 白雾与无色气体分开看
cues.caption: HCl气体无色，遇湿空气可形成含酸的细小液滴。
cues.captionEn: HCl gas is colourless; in moist air it can form fine acid droplets.
cues.zh: 再看瓶口附近的白雾。生成的氯化氢气体本身并不是白色，遇到空气中的水形成细小的盐酸液滴，液滴散射光才成为可见的雾。局部放大图把水合离子所在的微滴与气体分子区分开。在理想无水对照中，氯化氢产物仍然存在，但不会因为缺少白雾就意味着反应没有发生。
cues.en: Now look near the jar opening. Hydrogen chloride gas itself is colourless. Contact with moisture can form fine hydrochloric-acid droplets that scatter light and become visible as mist. The close-up distinguishes droplets containing hydrated ions from gas molecules. In the ideal dry comparison the HCl product remains present, even though the visible mist is absent.

cues.title: 数清重组前后的原子
cues.caption: 一份H₂与一份Cl₂形成两份HCl，原子种类和数量守恒。
cues.captionEn: One amount of H₂ and one of Cl₂ form two of HCl, conserving both atom types.
cues.zh: 最后抽出一个氢分子和一个氯分子来记账。反应后得到两个氯化氢分子，氢原子和氯原子的总数都不变。移动轨迹只是帮助追踪身份，不是实际链反应路径。独立热化学数据表明，按一摩尔氢气完全反应计，标准反应焓约为负一百八十四点六千焦。放热与观察到的燃烧相符，但这个数值不能直接当成火焰温度。
cues.en: Track one hydrogen molecule and one chlorine molecule. Two HCl molecules form, preserving the number of hydrogen and chlorine atoms. Their paths illustrate identity, not the actual chain-reaction mechanism. Independent thermochemical data give a standard reaction enthalpy of about minus 184.6 kilojoules per mole of hydrogen reacted. The exothermic result is consistent with combustion, but it is not a flame temperature.

cues.title: 细菌围着光，还是围着氧？
cues.caption: 光改变产氧位置，细菌指示氧的分布。
cues.captionEn: Bacteria reveal where oxygen is produced.
cues.zh: 细菌聚在光斑旁，是因为它们喜欢光吗？在教材重构中，先给水绵一小束光，再看同一批需氧细菌怎样重新分布。它们指示的是氧。光照让附近叶绿体产氧，细菌在这些区域更集中。再改成全面照光，聚集区域也随之扩展。这个对照支持氧与受光叶绿体有关；细菌不是直接测光的仪器。
cues.en: Do these bacteria gather because they like light? In this textbook reconstruction, illuminate a small part of the alga and follow the same bacteria. They indicate oxygen. Illuminated chloroplasts release it, and bacteria become more concentrated nearby. Now illuminate the whole filament. The occupied region broadens. This links oxygen release to illuminated chloroplasts; the bacteria are not direct light meters.

cues.title: 哪一段光更能支持产氧？
cues.caption: 蓝紫光和红光区域，产氧指示更明显。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen gathers near blue and red light.
cues.zh: 把白光分成不同颜色，同时落在同一条水绵上。现在观察的是细菌分布，不是叶片看起来有多亮。蓝紫光和红光区域聚集较多，说明这些波段更能支持这个体系产氧。这是光合作用作用效果的证据；它不是直接测得的色素吸收曲线，更不能由细菌个数算出精确光合速率。
cues.en: Spread white light into colors across one filament. Watch the distribution of bacteria, not how bright the alga looks. More gather in blue and red regions, indicating stronger support for oxygen production in this system. This is evidence about photosynthetic action. It is not a direct pigment absorption spectrum, and bacterial counts here are not precise reaction rates.

cues.title: 没有二氧化碳，也能放氧吗？
cues.titleEn: Can oxygen appear without carbon dioxide?
cues.caption: 离体体系中，放氧可与固定 CO₂ 分开。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen release can occur without CO₂.
cues.zh: 两份离体叶绿体悬液都没有二氧化碳，也都有适宜的电子受体。一个照光，一个保持黑暗。照光组仍能检出氧气。这排除了什么？释放氧气不必等待二氧化碳先被固定。水被氧化时失去的电子还需要去处；拿掉适宜受体，持续放氧就受限制。这是离体体系的条件对照，并不说明完整植物不需要二氧化碳。
cues.en: Neither isolated chloroplast sample has carbon dioxide. Both have a suitable electron acceptor, but only one receives light. Oxygen is detected in the illuminated sample. What does that exclude? Oxygen release need not wait for carbon fixation. Electrons removed as water is oxidized still need an acceptor; removing it restricts sustained oxygen release. This isolated-system comparison does not make carbon dioxide unnecessary for a whole plant.

cues.title: 给两种氧换上不同标签
cues.titleEn: Label the two possible oxygen sources
cues.caption: 标记水，标记才出现在释放的氧气中。
cues.captionEn: Released oxygen comes from water.
cues.zh: 释放的氧来自水，还是二氧化碳？两组分别标记这两种原料中的氧。跟住水的两个氧：在这幅教材示意里，它们保持身份，进入释放的氧气。把标记放在二氧化碳上，氧气就不跟着变。这个对照辨别氧的来源；画面只追踪氧，不是完整反应机理。
cues.en: Does released oxygen come from water or carbon dioxide? Label the two inputs in separate samples. Follow water’s two oxygens into released oxygen. Labeling carbon dioxide instead does not label that product. This comparison distinguishes the source. We are tracing oxygen identities, not every atom or intermediate reaction.

cues.title: 光怎样推动 ATP 合成？
cues.titleEn: How does light support ATP synthesis?
cues.caption: 梯度驱动合成；从旁路泄漏不能代替耦联。
cues.captionEn: A coupled gradient drives ATP synthesis.
cues.zh: 阿尔农的离体叶绿体研究发现，光下可以形成ATP。光怎样推动合成？后来独立的酸碱实验中，两组进入同样的碱性环境，在黑暗里仍得到不同的ATP总量。切到现代模型：光提高电子能量，耦联传递让质子在类囊体腔积累，形成电化学差。跟住一个质子，经入口结合转子，随转子移动，再从另一个出口离开。转轴连接基质侧催化头，耦联ADP和磷酸合成ATP，质子并没有变成磷酸。同样的初始梯度若另开泄漏，更多能量散失，合成减少。
cues.en: Arnon’s isolated chloroplasts formed A. T. P. in light. How? A later acid–base experiment found different A. T. P. totals in darkness, after both samples entered the same alkaline stage. In the modern model, light raises electron energy; coupled transfer accumulates protons inside thylakoids, building an electrochemical gradient. Follow one proton into its rotor binding site, around the rotor, and through a separate exit. The shaft couples rotation to the stromal head, where A. D. P. and phosphate form A. T. P. The proton does not become phosphate. Repeat with the same starting gradient and a leak. More energy dissipates, leaving less for synthesis.

cues.title: 熄灯后，为什么还没有立刻停？
cues.titleEn: Why not stop immediately when light goes off?
cues.caption: 光反应补给载体，碳反应消耗有限存量。
cues.captionEn: Carrier stores keep reactions going briefly.
cues.zh: ATP给碳反应供能，另一种还原型载体提供还原力。用过后，ADP、磷酸和氧化型载体返回，再被补给。现在熄灯：已有存量不会立即消失，碳反应先继续，再随着存量耗尽而受限。可见“暗反应”并不是只在黑暗中进行。
cues.en: A. T. P. supplies energy for carbon reactions; N. A. D. P. H. supplies reducing power. Used carriers return for replenishment. Switch off the light. Stored carriers support reactions briefly, then run low. The so-called dark reactions are therefore not restricted to darkness.

cues.title: 碳的第一站，怎样被找到？
cues.titleEn: How was carbon’s early destination identified?
cues.caption: 独立取样与化学鉴定，约束碳的去向。
cues.captionEn: Trace carbon, then identify the products.
cues.zh: 给小球藻提供标记二氧化碳，在不同时刻分别终止反应、分离产物。这是五秒和三十秒独立样本的部分特征；斑点大小不表示含量。标准品和化学分析才能鉴定斑点。更早取样与碳位置证据支持三碳的磷酸甘油酸是早期稳定产物。看净碳骨架：五个原有碳接入一个新碳，形成两组三碳；新碳进入其中一组的羧基。完整循环还需要更多证据。若更早终止，应该优先寻找什么产物？
cues.en: Supply labeled carbon dioxide, stop separate algal samples, and separate their products. These are selected features from five- and thirty-second samples; spot sizes are not measured amounts. Standards and chemical analysis identify the spots. Earlier sampling and carbon-position evidence support phosphoglycerate as an early stable product. Now the net carbon map: five carbons receive one new carbon, producing two three-carbon groups. The new carbon enters a carboxyl. The full cycle required further evidence. With an earlier stop, which products should appear first?

cues.title: 先排除叶片原有的空气
cues.titleEn: First exclude air already inside the leaf
cues.caption: 减压排气，复压进水，建立共同下沉起点。
cues.captionEn: Replace trapped air with water first.
cues.zh: 叶片浮起来，一定是刚刚产生了氧气吗？先看叶片原有的含气间隙。拉动活塞降低压力，气体膨胀并排出；恢复压力后，水进入这些间隙，圆片才会下沉。这个处理的目的，是让各组有可比较的起点。若叶片本来就带着空气漂浮，就不能把上浮全部归因于这段时间的光合作用。
cues.en: Does a floating leaf disc necessarily contain newly produced oxygen? Look at the air already in its spaces. Lower pressure lets gas expand and escape. Restoring pressure lets water replace it, so discs sink. This establishes comparable starting conditions. If trapped air makes a disc float before illumination, that flotation cannot all be attributed to newly occurring photosynthesis.

cues.title: 光强怎样变成上浮差异？
cues.titleEn: How does light intensity change flotation?
cues.caption: 上浮取决于净积气，不等于总产氧或 ATP。
cues.captionEn: Net gas gain makes the discs rise.
cues.zh: 各组十片都先下沉，只改变光强。产氧减去呼吸等消耗，剩余气体积累，使圆片平均密度下降，越过上浮阈值。强光组因此较早上浮。预测一下：缺少二氧化碳，或者原有空气没有排出，结果还支持相同推断吗？上浮只是有条件的间接指标，不能换算总产氧或ATP数量。
cues.en: Each group starts with ten sunken discs; only light differs. Oxygen production minus consumption leaves net gas, lowering average density until discs float. Stronger light gives earlier flotation in this model. Predict the result without carbon dioxide, or without removing trapped air. This indirect indicator cannot be converted into total oxygen or A. T. P. counts.

cues.title: 先保留，再去掉尖端
cues.caption: 完整胚芽鞘向光弯曲；去尖端组不再出现相同反应。
cues.captionEn: The intact coleoptile bends toward light; removing its tip changes the response.
cues.zh: 先比较完整和去尖端的胚芽鞘。两组接受同样方向的光照，完整的一组逐渐向光弯曲。下段的两侧生长不再相等，弯曲由这个长度差产生。去掉尖端，反应改变；但这一步还不能独自确定究竟哪里感光。
cues.en: Compare intact and decapitated coleoptiles under the same unilateral light. Unequal growth bends the intact specimen toward the light. Removing its tip changes the response. This comparison establishes a role for the tip, but does not by itself locate light perception.

cues.title: 把遮光位置换一下
cues.caption: 尖端遮光与下段遮光，区分感光和弯曲部位。
cues.captionEn: Shading the tip or lower region separates sensing from bending.
cues.zh: 现在保留尖端，只改变遮光部位。尖端遮光时，两侧仍能一起伸长，却不出现同样的向光弯曲。只遮下段，则仍然弯曲。这组对照支持尖端感光、影响传到下段的解释，不能说成只有被光照到才产生生长素。
cues.en: Keep the tip and change only the shaded region. A shaded tip still supports elongation without the selected directional response. Shading the lower region preserves bending. The contrast separates sensing from growth; it does not mean light is required to produce auxin.

cues.title: 在尖端下放琼脂
cues.caption: 影响可以跨过琼脂间隔。
cues.captionEn: The growth-promoting influence can cross an agar gap.
cues.zh: 把尖端与下段之间加入琼脂。此时并非原来的完整组织直接相连，但下段仍然能够表现弯曲。琼脂这一条件支持某种可以传递的影响，画面中的棕色只是解释用的分布标记，不是历史实验直接拍到的分子。
cues.en: An agar layer separates the tip from the growing region. Bending can still occur across that gap, supporting a transferable influence. The brown pattern represents relative influence for explanation; it is not a claim that historical investigators directly imaged individual auxin molecules.

cues.title: 让通路受到阻隔
cues.caption: 允许传递与阻隔传递，形成路径对照。
cues.captionEn: Allowing and blocking passage provide a pathway comparison.
cues.zh: 把可透过的间隔与阻隔条件并排看。模型中阻断了影响的传递，下段便不再出现相同的差异生长。这里强调的是路径条件，而不是把所有接触材料都当作相同的处理。判断结论时，还要留意切割损伤和材料本身的影响。
cues.en: Compare the permissive gap with a barrier. Blocking the modeled influence removes the corresponding differential growth. The intervention concerns passage, so contact materials cannot be treated as interchangeable. Interpreting a real assay also requires considering injury and material effects.

cues.title: 黑暗中偏放尖端
cues.caption: 没有单侧光，偏置来源仍能形成两侧差异。
cues.captionEn: An off-center source produces asymmetric growth in darkness.
cues.zh: 关掉单侧光，把尖端放在下段的一侧。偏置来源让两侧得到不同的影响，生长较快的一边成为弯曲的外侧。因此即使在黑暗里，仍能观察到方向明确的弯曲。该结果把不均匀分布与两侧不同生长联系起来。
cues.en: In darkness, place the tip off-center. The source reaches the two sides unequally, and the faster-growing side becomes the outside of the bend. Directional bending without unilateral light connects source asymmetry to differential growth.

cues.title: 交换偏置的方向
cues.caption: 来源换到另一侧，弯曲方向随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Reversing the off-center source reverses the bend.
cues.zh: 再把偏放位置换到另一侧。光照条件仍是黑暗，改变的是来源位置。观察曲线怎样反向，尖端始终连接在生长段末端。两条边的长度共同决定形状，没有额外旋转植物来制造看起来合理的弯曲。
cues.en: Reverse the tip’s offset while retaining darkness. The bend reverses with the source position. The tip remains attached to the actual growing segment: both edge lengths determine its geometry, rather than an unrelated rotation that merely resembles bending.

cues.title: 让尖端先接触琼脂
cues.titleEn: Condition the agar with a tip
cues.caption: 代表标记跨过接触面，进入琼脂。
cues.captionEn: Persistent representative markers cross the tip–agar contact.
cues.zh: 温特实验先让尖端与琼脂接触。跟随棕色标记，它们从尖端内部穿过共同接触面，进入琼脂。数值给出教学模型中的相对量，总量保持一致。这一步准备可转移的材料，还需要后面的生物反应和空白对照。
cues.en: Went’s sequence first brings tips into contact with agar. Follow the same representative markers through the contact into the block. The displayed amounts conserve a normalized total. Preparing transferable material is one step; the biological response and blank control are still needed.

cues.title: 处理过与空白琼脂
cues.caption: 偏放处理过的琼脂与空白块，产生不同结果。
cues.captionEn: Offset conditioned and blank agar produce different responses.
cues.zh: 把接触过尖端的琼脂偏放到去尖端胚芽鞘上，再与空白琼脂比较。只有前者在模型中带来偏侧促进和弯曲。它支持琼脂带走了促进生长的物质，却不等于当时已经确定物质就是吲哚乙酸；化学身份来自后续研究。
cues.en: Place conditioned agar on one side of a decapitated coleoptile and compare blank agar. Only the conditioned block supplies the modeled asymmetric growth influence. This supports a transferable substance, while its chemical identification as IAA belongs to subsequent evidence.

cues.title: 同一浓度，不同器官
cues.caption: 根、芽、茎的响应区间不同。
cues.captionEn: Roots, buds and stems have different response ranges.
cues.zh: 现在把浓度从低处逐步增加。根、芽和茎使用不同的响应区间，所以不能只问这个浓度高不高，还要问对哪个器官、相对哪个对照。曲线零线表示相对无外加生长素没有变化，不是生长速度绝对为零。
cues.en: Increase concentration from the low range. Roots, buds and stems occupy different response ranges, so the organ and reference condition both matter. The zero line denotes no change from the untreated reference, not an absolute growth rate of zero.

cues.title: 促生长也有范围
cues.caption: 更高浓度可以越过促进区，进入抑制区。
cues.captionEn: Higher concentrations can move beyond promotion into inhibition.
cues.zh: 继续增加浓度，观察不同曲线先后跨过零线。同一种物质并非越多越有效，同一浓度也不能替所有器官作结论。这里的函数专门用来说明范围与敏感度，没有拟合某一品种，所以不提供实际用药或种植浓度。
cues.en: Continue toward higher concentrations and watch responses cross the reference. More is not necessarily more effective, and one concentration does not imply one response in every organ. These declared illustrative functions explain ranges and sensitivity; they are not fitted dosing recommendations.

cues.title: 只有正向阳性
cues.caption: 一个阳性结果同时符合两个方向假说。
cues.captionEn: One forward positive is compatible with both direction hypotheses.
cues.zh: 先只有形态学上端供体和下端接收块。接收块出现物质，证明在这些条件下能够这样运输。但如果两个方向都能运输，这个结果仍然会出现。因此，单独一个正向阳性不能证明只能沿这个方向。
cues.en: Begin with an apical donor and basal receiver. A positive receiver is consistent with transport under these conditions. It would also occur if transport were possible both ways. A single forward positive therefore cannot establish exclusive directionality.

cues.title: 补上反向和空白
cues.caption: 倒置茎段与无供体条件，帮助区分解释。
cues.captionEn: An inverted segment and no-donor condition distinguish explanations.
cues.zh: 再加入倒置茎段和无供体组。供体仍在画面上方，但倒置后它接触的是形态学下端。比较两个假说的预测，就能看出反向组为何关键。数值是条件预测，不是实测数据；真实根内还存在不同组织的循环运输，不能把这个实验扩大成全株唯一方向。
cues.en: Add an inverted segment and a no-donor control. The upper donor now contacts the segment’s morphological base. Comparing the hypotheses reveals why reverse transport matters. Values are conditional predictions, not measurements. Real root tissues have distinct transport routes, so this assay does not establish one universal direction throughout a plant.

cues.title: DNA 复制了，染色体数就翻倍吗？
cues.titleEn: Does DNA replication double chromosome number?
cues.caption: 先复制 DNA，再分配两个副本。
cues.captionEn: Copy DNA, then distribute the two copies.
cues.zh: 先看分裂间期。DNA被复制，每条染色体形成两条姐妹染色单体，但它们仍通过着丝粒区域联系，所以染色体数仍按原来的四条计算。这里用四条染色体讲机制，真实洋葱根尖细胞有十六条。
cues.en: During interphase, DNA is replicated into sister chromatids that remain associated at their centromeric region. Chromosome number is still counted as four in this model. Four chromosomes make the mechanism legible; an actual onion root-tip cell has sixteen.

cues.title: 怎样让两个副本去往不同方向？
cues.titleEn: How do sister copies head to opposite poles?
cues.caption: 姐妹连向两极，分开后各一份。
cues.captionEn: Sisters connect toward opposite poles.
cues.zh: 染色质逐渐凝缩，核膜解体。复制后的染色体移动到细胞中央，着丝粒区域排列在赤道位置，两侧分别与相对两极的纺锤丝联系。这是有丝分裂，不能把画面误认成同源染色体配对。
cues.en: Chromatin condenses and the nuclear envelope disassembles. Replicated chromosomes align centrally, with sisters linked toward opposite spindle poles. This is mitosis, not pairing of homologous chromosomes.

cues.title: 为什么暂时数到八条？
cues.titleEn: Why are there temporarily eight chromosomes?
cues.caption: 分离改变计数，DNA 没有再次复制。
cues.captionEn: Separation changes the count, not the DNA amount.
cues.zh: 姐妹染色单体分开后，各自成为一条染色体。看同一种颜色的两个副本分别移向两极。尚未分成两个细胞时，全细胞染色体数暂时为八；每一极仍只得到四条，并没有凭空再复制一次DNA。
cues.en: Separated sister chromatids become daughter chromosomes. The two copies of each color move to opposite poles. Before cell division, the single cell temporarily contains eight chromosomes, while each pole receives four. No additional DNA replication has occurred.

cues.title: 分成两份后，各剩多少？
cues.caption: 两子细胞各保留原来的染色体数。
cues.captionEn: Each daughter retains the original count.
cues.zh: 染色体到达两极后，逐渐恢复为染色质，两个细胞核重新建立。植物在中央形成细胞板并向外扩展，形成新的细胞壁。探索模式还可切换动物细胞，比较细胞膜向内收缩的分裂沟。每个子细胞得到相同的染色体数。
cues.en: At the poles, chromosomes decondense and new nuclei form. A plant cell plate expands outward into a new wall. Exploration also shows an animal cleavage furrow contracting inward. Each daughter receives the original chromosome number.

cues.title: 外层同样厚，大块为何覆盖更少？
cues.titleEn: Why does the same shell reach less of a larger cube?
cues.caption: 同样外层厚度，大块覆盖比例更小。
cues.captionEn: Equal shell thickness covers less of a larger cube.
cues.zh: 三个立方体边长分别是二、四和八毫米。每个表面都向内到达零点五毫米，外层厚度相同，但小立方体中覆盖的体积比例更大。模型计算的是几何关系，不能把毫米立方体当成真实细胞尺寸，也不能由此说细胞越小越好。
cues.en: The cubes have sides of two, four and eight millimeters. Material reaches half a millimeter inward from every surface. Equal shell thickness covers a larger fraction of the smaller cube. This is geometry, not actual cell size, and does not imply cells should be arbitrarily small.

cues.title: 这张装片保留了什么？
cues.titleEn: What does a fixed preparation preserve?
cues.caption: 形态保留，分散与染色让它可辨。
cues.captionEn: Spreading and staining reveal preserved shapes.
cues.zh: 同一片根尖里，为什么有些细胞像一团丝，有些却排成一列？先让细胞分散，再看染色体。跟住这十二个固定细胞：位置和显色改变，内部阶段没有继续推进。解离、漂洗、染色和压片，是为了看清原先被重叠遮住的结构。接下来比较不同细胞，不能等其中一个继续分裂。
cues.en: Why does one root tip contain tangled chromatin, a central band, and two separated groups? Follow these same twelve fixed cells. Spreading and staining reveal structures hidden by overlap; their stages do not advance. Dissociation, rinsing, staining and squashing improve visibility. We now compare different preserved cells, rather than waiting for one to divide.

cues.title: 形态、先后与时长是同一种证据吗？
cues.titleEn: Do shape, order and duration need the same evidence?
cues.caption: 形态、先后和时长，需要不同证据。
cues.captionEn: Shape, order and duration need different evidence.
cues.zh: 固定视野给出形态：凝缩、居中、分成两组，再出现两个核。这提示一个顺序，却不是同一细胞的录像。换看已发表的拟南芥活细胞记录概括：同一细胞先集中，随后分开，形成两个核区，时间顺序有了独立依据。再看统计反例：两个合成群体的周期设定相同，只把起点改成同步，中期比例就从四比五十变成五十比五十。比例变了，设定的时长没变。因此，不能仅凭一个固定视野直接算每期时长；先检验群体、取样与追踪证据。
cues.en: A fixed field reveals condensed chromosomes, central alignment, two separated groups, and two nuclei. These shapes suggest an order; they are not a movie of one cell. Now consider a published live record of an Arabidopsis cell, redrawn schematically. The same cell aligns its DNA, separates it, and forms two nuclear regions. Tracking supplies independent evidence of order. Next, compare two synthetic populations with identical cycle settings. Synchronizing their starting positions changes the metaphase fraction from four out of fifty to fifty out of fifty. The fraction changed; the programmed duration did not. A snapshot alone cannot establish stage duration. Population structure, sampling and live tracking matter.

cues.title: 红色在报告什么？
cues.caption: 同一检验条件下，红色报告含Fe³⁺的配合物。
cues.captionEn: Under the same test conditions, red reports Fe³⁺ complexes.
cues.zh: 两管都有铁，加入同一种试剂，却只有一管显红色。放大这份溶液：硫氰酸根与三价铁结合，形成能显红色的配合物；二价铁对照没有相同的响应。现在把两种铁离子放在同一份样品里，先猜它会不会变红。红色仍然出现，二价铁也仍在水里。所以这个检验报告三价铁的存在，不能据此说样品里只有三价铁。
cues.en: Both tubes contain iron, yet the same reagent turns only one red. Look closer: thiocyanate binds iron(III), forming coloured complexes. The iron(II) control lacks that response. Now predict the result when both ions share one sample. It still turns red, and the iron(II) remains. Under these test conditions, red indicates iron(III); it does not establish that every iron ion is iron(III).

cues.title: 多出来的亚铁来自哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does the extra iron(II) come from?
cues.caption: 一份金属铁给出两个电子，自己也进入溶液。
cues.captionEn: One iron atom supplies two electrons and joins the solution.
cues.zh: 先看铁粉与三价铁反应，这时还没有加入检验试剂。跟住这一个金属铁：它给出的两个电子，分别记到两个三价铁上。原来的两个离子成为二价铁，给出电子的金属铁自己也成为二价铁。于是水里多出一份铁，总共是三份，不是两份。再做硫氰酸根检验，红色没有出现。消失的是三价铁的显色响应，铁并没有从水中消失。
cues.en: First let iron powder react with iron(III), before adding the test reagent. Follow one metal atom. Its two donated electrons are credited to two iron(III) ions. Those ions become iron(II), and the metal atom also enters solution as iron(II). That makes three dissolved iron units, not two. The subsequent thiocyanate test gives no red response. Iron has not vanished; its oxidation state has changed.

cues.title: 为什么要留下铁粉？
cues.titleEn: Why leave the iron powder behind?
cues.caption: 清液移走，未反应的电子供体留在原管。
cues.captionEn: The liquid moves; the remaining electron donor stays behind.
cues.zh: 三个标记过的铁离子随清液进入另一管，底部没反应完的铁粉留下。移取没有改变这些离子的价态，却拿走了一个潜在的电子供体。想一想，如果剩余铁粉也跟过去，下一步的氧化剂就可能接收它给出的电子，或者新生成的三价铁又被还原。分开固体，是让后面的颜色更能说明清液中铁离子的变化。
cues.en: The three marked ions travel with the clear liquid, while unused metal stays behind. Moving the liquid does not change their oxidation state. It removes a possible electron donor. If metal came along, it could consume oxidizing capacity or reduce newly formed iron(III) again. Leaving the powder behind makes the next colour response easier to attribute to changes in the dissolved iron.

cues.title: 电子这次去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where do the electrons go now?
cues.caption: Fe²⁺给出电子；氯接收，配体重新结合。
cues.captionEn: Fe²⁺ donates electrons; chlorine accepts; ligands bind again.
cues.zh: 在分开的清液中，电子这次从二价铁移到氯。两份二价铁各给出一个电子，成为三价铁；一份氯分子接收两个电子，成为两个氯离子。先前留在水里的硫氰酸根重新参与配位，红色回来。再比较一个限量的净账本：同样的氧化剂，如果管里还留下金属铁，它的电子也能消耗这份氧化能力。仅仅加入氧化剂，并不保证得到相同的红色结果。
cues.en: In the separated liquid, electrons are now credited from iron(II) to chlorine. Two iron(II) ions each lose one electron; one chlorine molecule accepts two, yielding two chloride ions. The restored iron(III) binds thiocyanate already in the water, and red returns. Now compare a limited-dose account with leftover metal. Its electrons can consume the same oxidizing capacity. Adding an oxidant alone does not guarantee the same colour result.

cues.title: 红色稳定，粒子就停了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does steady colour mean particles have stopped?
cues.caption: 配体不断交换，平衡时各物种的比例稳定。
cues.captionEn: Ligands exchange while equilibrium proportions remain steady.
cues.zh: 三管来自同一份红色溶液，先把没有改动的一管留下作参照。放大里面的一小部分：有些硫氰酸根连在铁上，有些仍游离在水中。跟住其中一份，它可以离开，也可以重新结合。平衡时不是粒子停止交换，而是两边相互转化，没有净变化。接下来改变其中一边，看看为什么原来的配体分配不再保持。
cues.en: The three tubes begin with the same red solution. Keep one unchanged. Inside, some thiocyanate is bound to iron and some remains free. Follow one ligand as it leaves and another binds. Equilibrium does not mean these exchanges stop. Forward and reverse changes balance, leaving no net change in the proportions. Alter one part of this mixture and the original distribution need not persist.

cues.title: 红色变浅，配体去哪了？
cues.titleEn: Where do the ligands go as red fades?
cues.caption: Fe³⁺被还原，配体从配合物回到水中。
cues.captionEn: As Fe³⁺ is reduced, ligands return to the water.
cues.zh: 加入铁粉的这一管，先有一部分游离三价铁得到电子，变成二价铁。原来的配合物还在，自由三价铁却减少了，于是画出的第一步配位，浓度商高于平衡常数。跟住标记的配体：一份配合物解离，它回到水里，释放的三价铁补充了自由部分。重新分配后，有色物种总量减少。配体没有被铁粉吃掉，铁也没有凭空消失，只是重新分配到了不同状态。
cues.en: Iron powder first reduces some unbound iron(III). Complexes initially remain, but less free iron(III) makes the first-step formation quotient exceed its equilibrium value. Follow the marked ligand: a complex dissociates, returning the ligand to water and replenishing free iron(III). Redistribution lowers the total coloured population. The ligand has not been consumed by the powder, and iron has not vanished. Their distribution has changed.

cues.title: 红色加深，铁也增加了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does deeper red mean more iron?
cues.caption: 跟住新配体，看分配如何改变。
cues.captionEn: Follow the added ligand as the mixture redistributes.
cues.zh: 另一管只增加硫氰酸根。新配体先进入自由部分，这时配合物还没增加，浓度商低于原来的平衡值。随后，标记的配体进入铁的配位环境，更多铁进入有色物种。先猜：铁的总量会不会随颜色一起增加？账本没有增加一份铁，只有自由和结合的分配改变了。红色深浅取决于条件，不能脱离配体条件，直接当成铁总量的刻度。
cues.en: The other tube receives more thiocyanate. Free ligand rises before additional complexes form, lowering the formation quotient. The marked ligand then binds, shifting more iron into coloured species. Predict whether the total iron also increases. It does not: the iron account stays fixed while its distribution changes. Colour depends on the ligand conditions, so deeper red is not automatically a measure of more total iron.

cues.title: 配位为什么不是还原？
cues.caption: 跟住配体与共享的成键电子对。
cues.captionEn: Follow the ligand and its shared bonding pair.
cues.zh: 最后只跟住一个三价铁和一份配体。水中的铁本来就有配位环境；硫氰酸根通过氮这一端参与配位，一份水离开。画出的电子对属于配位键的成键表示，不会像前面的还原那样，把铁的形式氧化数从正三改成正二。一个负一价配体加入后，配离子的总电荷从正三变成正二，铁的形式氧化数却仍是正三。再结合第二份负配体，总电荷成为正一。电荷数字下降，不等于中心铁被还原。
cues.en: Follow one iron(III) centre and one ligand. The hydrated centre already has a coordination environment. Thiocyanate binds through nitrogen while a water ligand leaves. The bonding pair is shared; it does not turn formal iron(III) into iron(II). Adding one negatively charged ligand changes the complex charge from plus three to plus two, while iron remains formally plus three. A second ligand gives a plus-one complex. A lower complex charge does not mean the central iron has been reduced.

cues.title: 菌体留下，可溶物通过
cues.caption: 无菌体滤液把感染与可溶性作用分开。
cues.captionEn: Cell-free filtrate separates infection from a soluble effect.
cues.zh: 先跟随培养滤液的准备过程。菌丝停留在滤层，可溶性标记通过漏斗颈进入收集液。这里重建的是历史证据所需要的无菌体条件，不是一份实际培养和灭菌的操作规程。滤液没有菌体，是否仍然改变水稻生长，要继续与对照比较。
cues.en: Follow preparation of the culture filtrate. Hyphae remain at the filter while representative solutes pass through the neck into the collector. This reconstructs the cell-free condition required by the historical argument, not an operational sterilization protocol. Its effect still requires comparison with a control.

cues.title: 把滤液作用与感染分开
cues.caption: 同龄水稻接受不同液体，比较伸长。
cues.captionEn: Matched rice seedlings receive different liquids.
cues.zh: 把无菌体滤液与培养基对照施于同龄水稻，并保持其他培养条件一致。模型中滤液组出现更明显的伸长，说明可溶性物质也能造成这种生长效应。不能因此把变长本身当作已经发生菌体感染的证据；后来还需要分离和鉴定物质。
cues.en: Apply cell-free filtrate and a medium control to matched rice seedlings. Greater elongation in the filtrate reconstruction supports a soluble growth-promoting effect. Elongation itself does not prove infection. Isolation and chemical identification require additional evidence.

cues.title: 先用宽梯度摸索
cues.caption: 逐组观察三根插条，保留个体根数。
cues.captionEn: Observe three cuttings per dose and retain individual counts.
cues.zh: 先用较宽的浓度梯度做预实验。每一组都保留三根插条，而不是只留一条平均曲线。材料年龄与处理时长相同，改变的是浓度。画面中的根数为教学生成样本，浓度也是任意单位；真正实验要记录自己观察到的每根插条。
cues.en: Start with broadly spaced doses and three individual cuttings per group. Match material age and exposure time while changing concentration. These root counts are generated teaching specimens in arbitrary dose units. A real investigation records the observed count of each cutting.

cues.title: 缩小比较范围
cues.caption: 在预实验提示的范围附近增加比较。
cues.captionEn: Add comparisons near the promising preliminary range.
cues.zh: 预实验找到值得继续研究的范围后，再把梯度细化。新的相邻组帮助判断趋势，不代表预先知道哪一个数就是正确答案。观察根数的同时留意个体差异；如果所有材料条件并不一致，更密的浓度梯度也不能修复这个混杂。
cues.en: Refine the dose spacing around the promising range. Nearby comparisons test the trend rather than assume an exact answer in advance. Retain individual variation. Finer spacing cannot repair confounding caused by inconsistent plant material or exposure conditions.

cues.title: 从原始计数得到结论
cues.caption: 均值来自原始记录；最佳已测组仍需限定。
cues.captionEn: Means come from individual records; the best tested group has limits.
cues.zh: 把原始计数放到记录表中，再计算组均值。比较时看同组各根插条是否一致，而不只盯着最大的数字。最高的已测组只能支持当前材料和条件下的结论。进入探索可录入自己的实际计数，空白仍然是缺失，不会被当作没有生根。
cues.en: Inspect individual counts before group means. Variation within a group matters alongside the largest mean. The best tested dose supports a conclusion only for the selected material and conditions. Exploration accepts actual observations; blank entries remain missing rather than being interpreted as zero roots.

cues.title: 先看释放条件
cues.caption: 较低pH下较稳定，升高后释放更明显。
cues.captionEn: Lower pH favors stability; higher pH increases release.
cues.zh: 先比较乙烯利在不同酸碱条件下的分解。两组都加入相同的教学量，较低pH条件下释放较少，较高pH下释放更多。这里采用平滑的示意速率，并没有把某一个pH当作突然开启的绝对开关。释放的是乙烯，接下来再看水果的响应。
cues.en: Compare equal modeled ethephon amounts under two pH conditions. Acidic conditions retain more precursor while the higher pH produces greater ethylene release. The smooth teaching rate does not impose an absolute on–off threshold. Release and fruit response are separate steps.

cues.title: 处理组要配对应对照
cues.caption: 同一初始成熟度下，同时比较颜色与硬度。
cues.captionEn: At matched initial maturity, compare color and firmness.
cues.zh: 现在选择初始成熟度相同的水果，给处理组加入乙烯利，对照组保持其他条件一致。乙烯与水果自身响应共同影响模拟成熟过程。除了颜色，画面还保留相对硬度。真实探究应有重复样本和适合该种水果的多个指标，不能把变色当作全部品质变化。
cues.en: Begin with fruit at matched initial maturity. The treatment changes the ethylene source while the control retains the other conditions. Color and relative firmness show different aspects of the simulated response. Real investigations need replicates and indicators appropriate to the fruit; color is not complete quality.

cues.title: 检查起点是否相同
cues.caption: 初始成熟度不同，会混入处理效果。
cues.captionEn: Different starting maturity confounds the treatment effect.
cues.zh: 最后故意破坏一个条件，让对照水果一开始就更成熟。比较终点时，这个初始差别会混进结果。它提醒我们，看到处理后有差异还不够，必须问起点和储存条件是否匹配。网页的数值只用于说明这种判断，不是食用水果的处理建议。
cues.en: Now deliberately change the control fruit’s initial maturity. Its starting advantage contributes to the final difference. A difference after treatment is insufficient without matched starting and storage conditions. The normalized values demonstrate experimental reasoning rather than provide edible-fruit treatment guidance.

cues.title: 气体离开，固体一定变轻吗？
cues.titleEn: Gas leaves. Must the solid get lighter?
cues.caption: 气体离开了，固体会怎样？
cues.captionEn: Gas leaves. What happens to the solid?
cues.zh: 铁粉与水蒸气反应后，管内留下黑色固体，导出的气体具有可燃性。有东西跑掉了，固体就一定变轻吗？沿着装置看：湿棉花中的水成为蒸气，先到达热铁，再通向气体观察处。先别急着看答案，我们跟住水中的一个氧。
cues.en: After iron reacts with steam, a black solid remains and the departing gas is combustible. If something escapes, must the solid become lighter? Follow the apparatus: water from the damp cotton becomes steam, reaches the hot iron, then flows toward the gas observation. Before revealing the answer, follow an oxygen atom from water.

cues.title: 同一份水，分成两条去向
cues.caption: 氧留进固体，氢组成气体。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen joins the solid; hydrogen forms gas.
cues.zh: 把反应区放大成一张净变化图：三份铁与四份水，共有三个铁、四个氧和八个氢。盯住带光环的氧，它从水的一侧移到固体的一侧；另外三个氧也留下。八个氢则两两组成四份氢气。四氧化三铁表示固体的组成，不是一个孤立的小分子。原子没有消失，它们重新组合了。
cues.en: Zoom into a net account of the reaction region. Three iron atoms and four water units contain three iron, four oxygen and eight hydrogen atoms. Follow the highlighted oxygen from the water side into the solid. The other three oxygens also stay. Eight hydrogens pair into four hydrogen molecules. Magnetite’s formula describes the solid’s composition, not a separate little molecule. No atom disappears; the atoms are rearranged.

cues.title: 增重从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where does the extra solid mass come from?
cues.caption: 固体增加的质量，来自水中的氧。
cues.captionEn: The extra solid mass comes from oxygen in water.
cues.zh: 现在把同一关系放大成一克铁的计量算例。水足够、铁完全转化时，黑色固体约一点三八二克，多出的零点三八二克来自水中的氧。生成的氢气离开固体，但它的质量仍在总账里。没有反应完的水也要留下来。称量范围不同，读数会不同；把所有物质放回总账，质量始终对得上。
cues.en: Scale the same relation to an illustrative one gram of iron. With enough water and complete iron conversion, the solid is about 1.382 grams. Its extra 0.382 grams comes from oxygen in water. Hydrogen leaves the solid, but its mass remains in the total account. Any unreacted water also remains. Different weighing boundaries give different readings; counting every substance preserves the total mass.

cues.title: 气泡能证明什么？
cues.caption: 气泡说明有气体经过，还要结合其他证据。
cues.captionEn: Bubbles show gas passage; other evidence is needed.
cues.zh: 回到气体观察处。气泡只说明有气体经过，空气也能形成气泡。教材还给出可燃性检验，再结合反应物和产物的分析，支持氢气生成。黑色也不是四氧化三铁独有的颜色。我们用一组相互支持的证据解释反应，不能让一个气泡或一种颜色包办鉴定。
cues.en: Return to the gas observation. A bubble only shows gas passage; air can make bubbles too. The textbook also shows a combustibility test. Together with the reactants and products, that supports hydrogen formation. Black is not unique to magnetite either. The explanation rests on several supporting observations, not a single bubble or colour.

cues.title: 水加倍，产氢也加倍吗？
cues.titleEn: Twice the water, twice the hydrogen?
cues.caption: 先找出哪一种反应物先用完。
cues.captionEn: First find which reactant runs out.
cues.zh: 两份算例都用一克铁。一份有零点三克水，另一份把水加倍到零点六克，氢气也会加倍吗？先暂停想一想。第一份水先用完，还有铁留下；第二份却是铁先用完，仍有水剩余。氢气分别约十六点六五和二十三点八八毫摩尔，并没有加倍。多给水不能弥补已经用完的铁，这就是限量反应物的作用。
cues.en: Both examples use one gram of iron. One has 0.3 grams of water; the other doubles it to 0.6 grams. Will hydrogen also double? Pause and predict. In the first, water runs out and iron remains. In the second, iron runs out and water remains. Hydrogen amounts are about 16.65 and 23.88 millimoles, not double. More water cannot replace iron that has already been consumed. That is the role of the limiting reactant.

cues.title: 分化之后，信息还在吗？
cues.titleEn: After differentiation, is the information still there?
cues.caption: 再生支持信息保留；表达可以改变。
cues.captionEn: Regeneration supports retained information.
cues.zh: 先看一个结果：胡萝卜韧皮部培养物增殖，随后形成根、茎和叶，长成植株。这是经典过程概括。若发育所需的信息已经全部丢失，这个结果就难以解释；再生支持这些信息仍可保留。现代解释中，同一套遗传信息可以选择不同的表达，产生不同蛋白和结构。跟住图中的DNA程序：复制出来的是RNA，DNA本身没有变成RNA。图示解释原理，不是当年的基因测量。换一种细胞状态或培养条件，能保证再生吗？不能。
cues.en: Start with the outcome: cultured carrot phloem cells proliferate and form roots, shoots and a plant. This reconstructs the classic observation. Losing all information required for development would conflict with that result; regeneration supports retained information. In the modern explanation, different expression programs produce different proteins and structures. Follow the DNA programs: RNA is a separate copy, not DNA changing into RNA. This is an explanatory model, not gene measurements from that experiment. Would a different cell state or culture condition guarantee regeneration? No.

cues.title: 相同条件，比较增殖代数
cues.caption: 同条件比较增殖代数，不能换算个人寿命。
cues.captionEn: Culture generations do not predict lifespan.
cues.zh: 教材比较同样条件下培养的肺成纤维细胞：胎儿来源约五十代，中年来源约二十代，老年来源二到四代。这里保留教材给出的数值与范围。它们是这项比较中的增殖代数，不能换算成人的年龄或寿命，也不代表所有组织细胞。
cues.en: The textbook compares lung fibroblasts cultured under the same conditions: about fifty generations for fetal sources, twenty for middle-aged sources and two to four for older sources. These are the textbook values, not a formula for human age or lifespan and not a rule for every tissue.

cues.title: 分别追踪核与质
cues.caption: 核与质各保留来源；这是教材对照。
cues.captionEn: Track both origins in the textbook comparison.
cues.zh: 先看教材的描述。衰老细胞核移入年轻细胞质，细胞不分裂；年轻细胞核移入衰老细胞质，细胞分裂旺盛。颜色分别保留核和质的来源。这是教材用于讨论细胞核作用的对照。接下来再看原始研究为什么不能被简化成一条普遍的返老还童规则。
cues.en: First follow the textbook account: an old nucleus with young cytoplasm does not divide, while a young nucleus with old cytoplasm divides vigorously. Separate colors preserve nuclear and cytoplasmic origin. This comparison motivates a nuclear contribution; the next evidence shows why it is not a universal rejuvenation rule.

cues.title: 核与质都需要研究
cues.caption: 年轻核不保证恢复旺盛增殖。
cues.captionEn: A young nucleus does not guarantee renewal.
cues.zh: 一九七六年的重组实验中，年轻细胞核与老龄培养物细胞质组成的细胞，多数只有有限分裂。另一项一九八三年的研究发现，衰老细胞质与年轻细胞融合可抑制DNA合成。这些研究条件不同，不能混算结果。它们提醒我们：细胞核和细胞质都可能影响增殖，教材比较有适用边界。
cues.en: In a nineteen seventy-six reconstruction study, young nuclei combined with cytoplasts from older cultures mostly showed limited division. A separate nineteen eighty-three study found that fusion with senescent cytoplasts inhibited DNA synthesis. The experiments differ and their results must not be pooled. Both nucleus and cytoplasm can influence proliferation.

cues.title: 追踪每一个分支
cues.caption: 追踪母子关系，才能确定哪些分支结束。
cues.captionEn: Trace parentage before assigning a cell fate.
cues.zh: 透明的秀丽隐杆线虫让研究者连续追踪细胞来自哪个母细胞，又形成哪些后代。标准雌雄同体的体细胞谱系中，一共产生一千零九十个细胞，其中一百三十一个按程序死亡，保留九百五十九个。画面的小树只说明分支关系，不是完整的真实谱系图；计数也不包含生殖细胞。
cues.en: The transparent nematode allows researchers to trace parent cells and descendants. In the standard hermaphrodite somatic lineage, one thousand ninety cells are generated, one hundred thirty-one undergo programmed death and nine hundred fifty-nine remain. The small tree illustrates branching only; it is not the complete measured lineage, and these counts exclude germ cells.

cues.title: 改变执行，比较命运
cues.caption: 改变执行，同一分支的命运可以改变。
cues.captionEn: Altering execution changes the branch’s fate.
cues.zh: 现在比较同一个示意分支。正常执行时，细胞凝缩并走向凋亡；CED三功能缺失时，原本会死亡的细胞可以保留。这来自遗传干预的证据，不是根据颜色猜命运。这里把CED四到CED三的执行关系简化显示。自由探索还可改变CED四，检验执行是否受阻。改变的是死亡程序，不是让这个细胞从未产生；停止分裂也不等于已经死亡。完整调控网络和其他死亡途径，并没有全部画在这里。
cues.en: Compare the same illustrative branch. With normal execution, the cell condenses and undergoes apoptosis. Loss of CED three function can preserve a cell normally destined to die. Genetic intervention supplies the evidence; color alone does not establish a fate. The diagram simplifies execution from CED four to CED three. Exploration also changes CED four. The intervention alters a death program, not whether the cell was born. Stopping division is not the same as dying, and this diagram does not include every regulatory factor or mode of death.

cues.title: 同样滴碱，两种沉淀
cues.caption: Fe³⁺生成红褐色沉淀；新生Fe(OH)₂很快受空气影响。
cues.captionEn: Fe³⁺ gives a brown precipitate; freshly formed Fe(OH)₂ is quickly affected by air.
cues.zh: 两支试管分别装有氯化铁和硫酸亚铁。加入氢氧化钠，铁离子与氢氧根结合形成难溶沉淀。三价铁的一管出现红褐色，二价铁的一管在理想新生状态很浅，但在普通空气条件下，很难长时间保持这个起点。
cues.en: One tube contains iron three chloride, the other iron two sulfate. Added hydroxide forms insoluble precipitates. The iron three tube turns brown. Fresh iron two hydroxide is very pale in its ideal initial state, but that starting point is difficult to preserve under ordinary air exposure.

cues.title: 追踪空气带来的改变
cues.titleEn: Follow the change caused by air
cues.caption: O₂参与，Fe(OH)₂逐步转成含三价铁的沉淀。
cues.captionEn: O₂ participates as Fe(OH)₂ changes into a precipitate containing Fe(III).
cues.zh: 教材记录的是白色迅速变成灰绿色，之后出现红褐色物质。变化需要氧气参与，不能只把它理解为等待时间带来的自动变色。这里用颜色序列重现观察，用教材的净反应追踪二价铁转成三价铁；灰绿色并不是本画面鉴定出的某一种纯物质。
cues.en: The textbook records a pale precipitate rapidly becoming grey-green, followed by brown material. Oxygen participates in the change: it is not a colour switch triggered merely by waiting. The colour sequence represents the observation, while the textbook net equation tracks oxidation from iron two to iron three. Grey-green does not identify a single pure material here.

cues.title: 四个铁中心，一个氧分子
cues.titleEn: Four iron centres, one oxygen molecule
cues.caption: 每消耗1份O₂，最多使4份Fe(II)氧化成Fe(III)。
cues.captionEn: One amount of O₂ can oxidize at most four amounts of Fe(II) to Fe(III).
cues.zh: 放大的是计量关系，不是真实晶体结构。四个铁中心始终都在，氧气和水参与后，每个铁由二价转成三价。模型保留四比一的铁与氧气关系。若氧气不足，二价铁沉淀会有剩余；若没有先形成沉淀，也不能凭空出现这条转化路径。
cues.en: This close view shows stoichiometry, not the crystal structure. All four iron centres remain present as oxygen and water participate and iron two becomes iron three. The model preserves the four-to-one relation between iron and oxygen. Insufficient oxygen leaves iron two precipitate behind, and this pathway cannot create solid that was never precipitated.

cues.title: 把氧气作为对照条件
cues.titleEn: Use oxygen as the comparison condition
cues.caption: 隔绝O₂与有O₂的理想对照分离了沉淀和后续氧化。
cues.captionEn: An ideal comparison with and without O₂ separates precipitation from later oxidation.
cues.zh: 把两份相同的亚铁沉淀分开比较。理想隔绝氧气的一份保留二价铁；有足量氧气并完成转化的一份变成红褐色。实际制备还受溶解氧、杂质和操作条件影响，所以这里的无氧状态是机制对照，不是保证现实试管一定保持纯白的操作说明。
cues.en: Compare two otherwise identical portions of iron two precipitate. An ideal oxygen-free portion retains iron two; with sufficient oxygen and completed conversion, the other becomes brown. Dissolved oxygen, impurities and handling affect real preparation. The oxygen-free state is a mechanistic control, not a promise that a real tube will stay perfectly white.

cues.title: 先控制花粉来自哪里
cues.caption: 控制花粉，才能追溯亲本。
cues.captionEn: Control pollen to trace parentage.
cues.zh: 同一朵花，可能接受自己的花粉，也可能接受外来花粉。如果不知道父本是谁，就难以解释后代。去掉未成熟的雄蕊，排除自身花粉；隔离袋限制外来花粉。再把指定父本的花粉送到保留的柱头，并重新隔离。关键不是记住步骤，而是让后代的来源可以追溯。
cues.en: The same flower can receive its own pollen or pollen from elsewhere. Unknown parentage makes offspring hard to interpret. Removing immature stamens excludes self pollen; a bag restricts foreign pollen. Apply the chosen parent’s pollen to the retained stigma, then isolate it again. These controls make parentage traceable.

cues.title: 第一代为什么都是高茎
cues.titleEn: Why are the first offspring tall?
cues.caption: 先看高茎，再检验因子是否保留。
cues.captionEn: Tall offspring do not reveal every factor.
cues.zh: 先看观察：纯种高茎与纯种矮茎杂交，子一代都是高茎，交换父母本也一样。矮茎因子消失了吗？颗粒假说认为，两方各提供一个因子，在后代重新成对。D显性，可以解释高茎，却还不能单凭第一代证明小写d仍在。下一步要看，自交后矮茎能不能重新出现。
cues.en: First, the observation: pure tall and short parents produce tall offspring, in either direction of the cross. Has the short factor vanished? The particulate hypothesis gives the offspring one factor from each parent. Dominance explains the tall plant, but the first generation alone cannot show that lowercase d remains. Selfing will test whether the short trait returns.

cues.title: 隐性性状重新出现
cues.caption: 矮茎再现；分离假说推出新的测交预测。
cues.captionEn: Segregation explains the return and predicts a new cross.
cues.zh: 固定记录里，矮茎重新出现：高茎七百八十七株，矮茎二百七十七株。现在用分离假说解释。杂合子产生配子时，D与小写d分开，每种各占一半。两方随机结合，有四种等可能的组合；其中两种都是杂合子。于是基因型预期一比二比一，表型预期三比一。再提出新预测：如果改与矮茎纯合子杂交，高茎与矮茎应各占一半。后面的测交实验会检验它。
cues.en: The fixed record shows short plants returning: seven hundred eighty-seven tall and two hundred seventy-seven short. Now apply segregation. The hybrid separates D and lowercase d into equally likely gametes. Random union gives four equally likely combinations; two are heterozygous. That predicts one to two to one for genotypes, and three to one for phenotypes. A new cross with a short homozygote should instead give equal tall and short offspring. The later test cross checks this prediction.

cues.title: 每次取球，都放回
cues.titleEn: Replace the balls after each draw
cues.caption: 模拟会波动；同一球放回原桶。
cues.captionEn: Samples fluctuate; each ball returns to its bucket.
cues.zh: 两个桶各放十个D球和十个小写d球。每次从各桶随机取一个，记录组合，再把同一个球放回原桶并充分混匀。看球返回原来的桶后，下一次才开始。三十次的小样本可能偏离一比二比一。增加样本有助于稳定频率，但不保证每次新增样本都会更接近理论值。
cues.en: Each bucket contains ten D balls and ten lowercase d balls. Draw one from each, record the pair, replace both in their own buckets and mix again. Thirty draws can depart from the one-to-two-to-one genotype expectation. Larger samples tend to stabilize frequencies, but each additional draw need not move them closer to theory.

cues.title: 用新实验检验解释
cues.titleEn: Test the explanation with a new cross
cues.caption: 测试亲本只给d，后代显露另一方的因子。
cues.captionEn: The tester supplies d; offspring reveal the other factor.
cues.zh: 让杂合子与矮茎纯合子杂交。隐性纯合子只提供小写d，所以后代直接显示杂合亲本提供了哪一种遗传因子。理论上高茎与矮茎各占一半。教材记录八十七株高茎和七十九株矮茎。这项新预测与实验相符，增加了对分离假说的支持。
cues.en: Cross the hybrid with a recessive homozygote, which provides only lowercase d. Offspring therefore reveal which factor came from the hybrid. Tall and short are each predicted at one half. The textbook records eighty-seven tall and seventy-nine short offspring, supporting the segregation hypothesis with a new prediction.

cues.title: 同时追踪两对性状
cues.caption: 两对因子分别保留，不混成一种。
cues.captionEn: Two factor pairs retain their identities.
cues.zh: 现在同时看种子颜色与形状。黄色圆粒纯种的每个配子都携带两种显性因子，绿色皱粒纯种的配子都携带相应的隐性因子，子一代都是双杂合子，表现黄色圆粒。图中黄色或绿色表示子叶颜色，光滑或皱缩表示种子形状。这里研究的是两对可以独立遗传的性状。
cues.en: Now track seed color and shape. Each gamete from the pure yellow-round parent carries both dominant factors. Each gamete from the pure green-wrinkled parent carries the corresponding recessive factors. Every first-generation offspring is a yellow-round double heterozygote. Color represents cotyledon color and contour represents seed shape. The model concerns independently assorting loci.

cues.title: 四种配子，十六种结合
cues.caption: 新组合引出独立分配，再提出新预测。
cues.captionEn: New combinations motivate an independent-assortment prediction.
cues.zh: 先看固定观察：绿色圆粒与黄色皱粒，是亲本没有的组合。自由组合假说提出，两对因子各自分离，组合成四种等概率配子。跟住一行和一列进入同一个交点：四乘四得到十六种受精组合。按颜色和形状归类，预期九比三比三比一；这是模型推导，不是重新生成实验记录。再换成只提供这两种隐性因子的测试亲本，四种后代表型应当等概率。接下来的测交会检验这个新预测。
cues.en: First, the fixed observation: green-round and yellow-wrinkled seeds combine traits differently from the parents. Independent assortment proposes four equally likely gametes. Follow one row and one column into their intersection. Four by four gives sixteen fertilization combinations, grouped into a nine-to-three-to-three-to-one expectation. That is a model prediction, not regenerated experimental data. With a tester supplying the recessive factor at each locus, the four offspring phenotypes should instead be equally likely. The next test cross checks that new prediction.

cues.title: 让四种配子显露出来
cues.caption: 固定测交记录，检验四种配子的预测。
cues.captionEn: Fixed test-cross records check the four-gamete prediction.
cues.zh: 把双杂合子与双隐性个体测交，测试亲本只提供这两种隐性因子。四种后代表型便直接对应双杂合子的四种配子，理论比例为一比一比一比一。教材分别记录了子一代作母本和作父本的结果，探索时可以切换。这个结论依赖独立遗传、等概率配子和相近存活率等条件，并不适用于任意两对基因。
cues.en: Cross the double heterozygote with a double-recessive tester, which supplies the recessive factor at each locus. The four offspring phenotypes reveal the four hybrid gamete classes, predicted equally. Exploration switches the textbook’s reciprocal datasets. This result assumes independent assortment, equal gamete probabilities and comparable viability; it does not apply to arbitrary pairs of genes.

cues.title: 光先改变受体状态
cues.caption: 光敏色素在细胞内感受光信号。
cues.captionEn: Intracellular phytochrome responds to light.
cues.zh: 光不仅为光合作用提供能量，也能传递信息。先看细胞内的光敏色素，受光后，它的状态发生改变。这里选择红光相关的一条通路，不能把这个受体放在细胞膜外，也不能认为所有植物的光反应都只有这一种受体。
cues.en: Light carries information as well as energy for photosynthesis. In this selected pathway, intracellular phytochrome changes state after illumination. It is not a generic receptor outside the cell membrane, and it does not represent every photoreceptor or every plant light response.

cues.title: 状态变化连到表达
cues.caption: 光信号影响核内表达，并产生发育响应。
cues.captionEn: Light signaling influences nuclear expression and development.
cues.zh: 受体状态改变后，信息经过传递，影响细胞核中的表达。跟着示意的RNA输出，再看幼苗的发育响应。画面中的分子路线与最后的器官变化是不同尺度，不是RNA直接跑到叶片外面使它变绿。真实发育还要与营养和其他信号共同配合。
cues.en: The receptor response connects through signaling to nuclear expression. Follow the schematic RNA output, then the developmental response. These are different biological scales: RNA is not shown leaving the cell to paint a leaf green. Real development also depends on nutrition and other signals.

cues.title: 同样温暖，经历不同
cues.caption: 所选冬性类型需要先前低温经历。
cues.captionEn: The selected winter type depends on previous cold exposure.
cues.zh: 让两株冬性植物随后处在相同的生长条件，但只有一株先经历低温。能够进入后续开花过程的差别，来自此前的经历，而不是当前温度不同。春化要求随类型和品种变化，这里的相对量只说明机制，不能换算成真实需要的天数。
cues.en: Give two winter-type plants the same later growth conditions, but expose only one to prior cold. Their subsequent flowering competence differs because of that history. Vernalization requirements vary among types and cultivars; the normalized exposure is not a prediction of required days.

cues.title: 把季节变化留在木质部
cues.caption: 较大的早材与较致密的晚材构成环带。
cues.captionEn: Larger earlywood and denser latewood form contrasting bands.
cues.zh: 再看树干截面。一个生长季里，细胞的大小和排列会发生差别，较大的早材与较致密的晚材形成环带。这里画的是原创结构示意。温度参与其中，水分和树种也会影响结果，所以不能把一个环直接读成某一年的准确温度。
cues.en: A growing season produces differences in xylem cell size and structure. Larger earlywood contrasts with denser latewood in this original cross-section. Temperature contributes, but water availability and species also matter. An individual ring is not a direct reading of that year’s exact temperature.

cues.title: 在细胞里感受方向
cues.caption: 淀粉体沿重力方向沉降，保持在细胞内。
cues.captionEn: Amyloplasts sediment with gravity inside the cell.
cues.zh: 植物横放之后，重力仍然向下。观察平衡石细胞内的六个淀粉体，它们保持各自身份，沿重力方向沉降。这个变化提供感受方向的线索，再联系下游信号与生长素运输；沉降本身不是全部生长反应，也没有离开细胞去拖动根尖。
cues.en: After reorientation, gravity still points downward. Six persistent amyloplasts sediment within the statocyte. Their position contributes a directional cue that connects to downstream signaling and auxin transport. Sedimentation is not the entire growth response, and the plastids do not leave the cell to pull the root.

cues.title: 根与茎的响应不同
cues.caption: 同一方向的差异，产生相反的两侧伸长关系。
cues.captionEn: A shared directional asymmetry produces opposite elongation patterns.
cues.zh: 现在把根和茎放在同一重力方向下比较。根的下侧伸长较少，上侧成为弯曲外侧；茎的下侧伸长较多，弯曲方向相反。两条边的实际长度决定形状。关闭定向重力信号，模型仍然伸长，只是不再出现由这个信号引起的定向弯曲。
cues.en: Compare root and shoot under the same gravity vector. Less elongation below bends the root downward; greater elongation below bends the shoot upward. Edge lengths determine both shapes. Removing the modeled directional cue preserves growth while removing this cue’s directional bend.

cues.title: 处理根冠，也保留对照
cues.titleEn: Treat the cap and retain controls
cues.caption: 完整、去根冠与假处理，放在相同条件下。
cues.captionEn: Compare intact, decapped and sham-treated roots.
cues.zh: 要验证感受部位，先准备完整根、去根冠处理和假处理三组，横放后保持其余条件相同。假处理用于检查操作本身的影响。此时先确认处理条件，不急着只凭某一组看起来没有弯曲，就得出根冠是感受部位的结论。
cues.en: Compare intact roots, a root-cap intervention and a sham treatment under matched horizontal placement. The sham checks effects of handling itself. Establish the conditions first; an apparently unbent root is not sufficient on its own to locate the gravity sensor.

cues.title: 检查弯曲与继续伸长
cues.caption: 去根冠后弯曲减弱，同时仍能伸长。
cues.captionEn: Reduced bending is interpreted alongside continued elongation.
cues.zh: 观察一段时间后，去根冠组的定向弯曲明显减弱，而继续伸长这一点被保留下来。这样才能把感知变化与完全不能生长区分开。模型保留少量残余响应，因为真实材料还可能存在其他感知成分，不能把实验说成任何根都会绝对不弯。
cues.en: The decapped model bends much less while retaining elongation. Continued growth helps separate a sensing effect from complete inability to grow. A small illustrative residual response remains, reflecting the need to avoid claiming that every decapped root loses every gravity response under all conditions.

cues.title: 停长是另一种解释
cues.caption: 伤及生长区的不弯曲，不能定位感受部位。
cues.captionEn: No bending after growth injury cannot locate the sensor.
cues.zh: 最后换进一个伤及生长区的处理。它不再继续伸长，也没有明显弯曲。这个结果与正常伸长却定向响应减弱不同，不能被当作同样的感受部位证据。实验设计需要同时记录方向和生长能力，而不是只选择一个符合预期的外形。
cues.en: Replace the sham with an intervention that damages the growth zone. It neither elongates normally nor bends. That differs from reduced directional response in a growing root and cannot serve as equivalent evidence about sensor location. Record both direction and growth capacity.

cues.title: 先辨认三层材料
cues.caption: 保护层覆盖要保留的铜；绝缘板在铜箔下面。
cues.captionEn: Resist covers the copper to retain; the insulating board lies beneath the foil.
cues.zh: 覆铜板有一层金属铜，下面是绝缘基材。教材探究先用不透水的物料保护所需图案。深色路径是保护层，而不是已经分离出来的铜线。此时图案内外仍是同一整层铜，能否保留下来取决于它接下来是否接触腐蚀液。
cues.en: A copper-clad board has a copper foil bonded to an insulating substrate. The textbook inquiry protects the desired pattern with a water-resistant material. The dark path is the resist, not an already separated copper wire. Copper is still continuous beneath and around it. What survives depends on which areas contact the etching solution.

cues.title: 从剖面观察铜的去向
cues.caption: 裸露铜进入溶液；被完整保护的铜仍留在基材上。
cues.captionEn: Exposed copper enters solution; copper beneath intact resist remains on the board.
cues.zh: 剖面把铜箔厚度放大了。氯化铁溶液接触裸露铜，铜被氧化而进入溶液；保护层下的铜保留下来。这里画的是理想垂直蚀刻，真实加工还可能从图案边缘向下侧蚀。看到裸露区域变薄，比只看最后的图案更能解释材料去了哪里。
cues.en: The cross section exaggerates foil thickness. Ferric chloride solution contacts exposed copper, oxidizing it into solution, while copper beneath intact resist remains. This is ideal vertical etching; actual processing may also undercut the mask edges. Watching the exposed layer thin explains where the material goes before the final pattern appears.

cues.title: 一份铜对应两份三价铁
cues.titleEn: One copper amount uses two ferric amounts
cues.caption: Cu失去2个电子；2份Fe³⁺各接受1个电子。
cues.captionEn: Copper loses two electrons; two Fe³⁺ amounts each accept one.
cues.zh: 按教材净反应，每份铜进入溶液成为二价铜，需要两份三价铁转成二价铁。不是盐酸中的氢离子把铜置换出来，关键的氧化剂是三价铁。这里的数字是相对物质的量，初始总铜定为一。探索中限制三价铁，就会留下尚未蚀刻完的裸露铜。
cues.en: In the textbook net reaction, each amount of copper becoming copper two requires two amounts of iron three to become iron two. Ferric ions are the oxidant in this account. The displayed values are relative amounts with initial total copper set to one. Limiting ferric ions in exploration leaves some exposed copper unetched.

cues.title: 移去保护层，检查留下的铜
cues.titleEn: Remove the resist and inspect the copper
cues.caption: 图案来自选择性保留；没有保护层，铜会全部暴露。
cues.captionEn: The pattern comes from selective retention; without resist, all copper is exposed.
cues.zh: 蚀刻完成后移去保护层，才看见留下的铜路径。绝缘基材把这些路径与原来连续的铜箔区分开。改变保护条件，可以比较同一块铜板在有图案保护和完全裸露时的结果。这个视图解释形成原理，不提供实际电路加工尺寸或工艺配方。
cues.en: After etching, removing the resist reveals the retained copper path. Exposed insulating substrate distinguishes it from the original continuous foil. Compare the same board with a patterned resist and with no resist at all. The view explains the formation mechanism without supplying manufacturing dimensions or a fabrication recipe.

cues.title: 先遇到的是表面氧化膜
cues.titleEn: The solution first meets the oxide film
cues.caption: Al₂O₃溶于酸，这一步不生成H₂。
cues.captionEn: Al₂O₃ dissolves in acid without producing H₂ in this step.
cues.zh: 铝片表面有保护性的氧化膜。放大剖面把这层膜画得很厚，方便分清它与里面的金属。盐酸首先能与氧化铝反应，生成含铝离子的溶液和水。这一步消耗酸，却不产生氢气；没有气泡，并不一定说明没有发生化学变化。
cues.en: An aluminium surface carries a protective oxide film. The magnified section exaggerates its thickness so it remains distinct from the metal beneath. Hydrochloric acid can dissolve the oxide, producing dissolved aluminium species and water. This consumes acid without making hydrogen, so an absence of bubbles does not necessarily mean an absence of chemical change.

cues.title: 膜后面的金属开始产氢
cues.caption: 氧化膜去除后，Al与酸反应生成H₂。
cues.captionEn: Once the oxide is removed, Al reacts with acid to form H₂.
cues.zh: 膜被去除后，盐酸能接触金属铝，产氢才对应另一条反应。两份铝形成三份氢气，金属层逐渐减少。画面让两步分开，是为了说明证据来自哪个材料；现实表面的缺陷、膜再生和局部反应会让它们重叠，不能把动画时间当作实际等待时间。
cues.en: Once the oxide is removed, acid can contact metallic aluminium, and hydrogen belongs to this second reaction. Two aluminium amounts yield three hydrogen amounts as the metal decreases. The separated steps identify which material produces the evidence. Surface defects, film regrowth and local reactions can overlap in reality, so animation time is not an experimental induction time.

cues.title: 有膜与去膜的同条件比较
cues.titleEn: Compare coated and stripped surfaces in base
cues.caption: NaOH能溶解氧化膜；去膜铝更早显示产氢。
cues.captionEn: NaOH can dissolve the oxide; stripped aluminium shows hydrogen sooner.
cues.zh: 教材在氢氧化钠溶液中比较未打磨和打磨过的铝片。去膜对照先显示气泡，带膜铝片先经历保护层的变化，再产生氢气。两份样品的比较重点是表面状态。模型用同样的金属铝示例量，让膜的去向和产气的去向分别可见，不根据示意进度推算真实速率。
cues.en: The textbook compares untreated and abraded aluminium in sodium hydroxide solution. The stripped comparison shows bubbles first; the coated sample first loses its protective layer and then releases hydrogen. Surface condition is the variable. Equal illustrative amounts of metal make the film and gas pathways visible without treating the reaction coordinate as a measured rate.

cues.title: 酸与碱都能带走氧化膜
cues.titleEn: Both acid and base can dissolve the film
cues.caption: Al₂O₃具有两性；碱中用[Al(OH)₄]⁻表示溶解的铝。
cues.captionEn: Al₂O₃ is amphoteric; dissolved aluminium in base is represented by [Al(OH)₄]⁻.
cues.zh: 氧化铝既能与酸反应，也能与碱反应，教材据此称它为两性氧化物。酸中用三价铝表示溶解的铝，足量碱中用四羟基合铝酸根表示。配位图只帮助数出四个羟基，不是平面构型结论。氧化膜的酸碱反应与金属铝产氢，仍然是两件需要分别记录的事。
cues.en: Aluminium oxide reacts with both acid and base, which is why the textbook calls it amphoteric. Dissolved aluminium is represented by aluminium three in acid and tetrahydroxoaluminate in sufficient base. The coordination diagram counts four hydroxide groups; it does not claim a planar geometry. Dissolving the oxide and releasing hydrogen from the metal remain separate chemical events.

cues.title: 从食物得到试验样品
cues.titleEn: Obtain a sample from the food
cues.caption: 研磨与水提取，是把待检组分带入液体的准备步骤。
cues.captionEn: Grinding and water extraction prepare liquid containing recoverable components.
cues.zh: 教材的研究与实践以菠菜为例。研磨破坏组织，随后用水提取，目的是得到能够继续检验的液体样品。这里的铁标记表示食品中含铁组分，不是说叶片里存着一颗颗可见铁粉。能被提取出来多少，取决于方法与样品，不能预先认定百分之百回收。
cues.en: The textbook research activity uses spinach. Grinding disrupts tissue, then water extraction prepares a liquid sample for testing. Iron markers represent iron-bearing components, not visible iron powder stored in the leaf. Recovery depends on both the sample and the extraction method, so complete recovery cannot simply be assumed.

cues.title: 过滤分开了什么
cues.caption: 滤渣被截留；滤液只含被带出的部分待检组分。
cues.captionEn: Residue is retained; the filtrate carries only the recovered portion.
cues.zh: 沿着同一批示例标记观察过滤。留在固体残渣中的铁不会自动全部进入滤液。过滤把悬浮固体与液体分开，也使后续颜色更容易观察，但它不能保证把食品中的全部铁都测出来。标记数量是教学账本，不是菠菜成分的测定数据。
cues.en: Follow the same illustrative markers through filtration. Iron remaining with the solid residue does not automatically enter the filtrate. Filtration separates suspended solids and liquid and can make later colour easier to observe, but it does not guarantee recovery of all food iron. These markers are a teaching account, not measurements of spinach composition.

cues.title: 把显色所需的价态准备好
cues.titleEn: Prepare the oxidation state needed for the test
cues.caption: 稀硝酸的氧化作用，为Fe³⁺显色检验作准备。
cues.captionEn: The oxidizing action of dilute nitric acid prepares Fe³⁺ for the colour test.
cues.zh: 教材在滤液中加入少量稀硝酸，然后再加硫氰化钾。这里将可检部分中的二价铁转成三价铁，以突出氧化步骤的作用。画面的起始价态比例只是教学示例，真实食品中铁的配位状态与释放过程更复杂，不能由这些标记推断菠菜里二价铁和三价铁各占多少。
cues.en: The textbook adds a little dilute nitric acid before potassium thiocyanate. The diagram converts accessible iron two into iron three to highlight the oxidation step. Its initial oxidation-state proportions are illustrative. Food iron has more complex binding and release behaviour; these markers do not establish the actual iron two and iron three proportions in spinach.

cues.title: 显色证据与阴性结果
cues.titleEn: Colour evidence and a negative result
cues.caption: 显红支持可检Fe³⁺存在；不显红不能直接排除食品含铁。
cues.captionEn: Red colour supports accessible Fe³⁺; no red colour alone does not exclude iron in the food.
cues.zh: 硫氰酸根与可参与反应的三价铁形成红色配合物。旁边的试剂空白是补充的机制对照，用来区分样品信号与试剂自身背景。若没有明显红色，可能是提取不足、状态不合适或显色受干扰。教材活动用于定性检验，不能把动画颜色直接换算成营养含量。
cues.en: Thiocyanate forms red complexes with accessible iron three. The reagent blank is an added mechanistic comparison that separates sample signal from reagent background. No clear red colour can reflect insufficient recovery, unsuitable chemical state or interference. This textbook activity is qualitative; animated colour cannot be converted directly into nutritional content.

cues.title: 铜出现时，铁去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: When copper appears, where does the iron go?
cues.caption: 铜出现时，铁去了哪里？
cues.captionEn: When copper appears, where does the iron go?
cues.zh: 铁丝上长出了铜，铁丝本身去了哪里？跟住表面这个铁：它给出两个电子，进入水中成为二价铁。一份铜离子接收这两个电子，留在金属表面。把这次观察记在图上：铁从零价变成正二价，反应伙伴是铜离子。
cues.en: Copper grows on the iron wire. Where does the iron go? Follow one surface atom: it supplies two electrons and enters the water as iron two. One copper ion receives those credits and joins the surface. Record the observed route: iron goes from zero to plus two, with copper ions as its reaction partner.

cues.title: 还是铁和铜，为何方向变了？
cues.titleEn: Still iron and copper—why a different direction?
cues.caption: 铜会长出来，还是溶解？
cues.captionEn: Will copper grow or dissolve?
cues.zh: 现在换成铜片和三价铁溶液。先猜，铜会长出来，还是溶解？这一次，铜给出两个电子，两份三价铁各接收一个，成为二价铁；铜自己进入水中。图上新增正三价到正二价的路径。都是铁和铜，反应方向却要看具体是哪种粒子。
cues.en: Now use copper metal and iron three ions. Predict: will copper grow or dissolve? This time, copper supplies two electrons. Two iron three ions each receive one and become iron two, while copper enters solution. Add the route from plus three to plus two. The element names are unchanged, but the reacting species are different.

cues.title: 蓝色究竟在报告谁？
cues.titleEn: What does the blue actually report?
cues.caption: 蓝色在报告谁？
cues.captionEn: What does blue reveal?
cues.zh: 把电子提供者换成碘离子。两份碘离子各给出一个电子，形成碘；两份三价铁成为二价铁。加入淀粉后，蓝色出现在含碘的显色体系里。跟住铁：它仍留在水中，没有变成蓝色小球。这条证据指向碘的生成，不能直接当作二价铁的检验。
cues.en: Replace the donor with iodide. Two iodide ions each lose one electron, producing iodine as two iron three ions become iron two. Starch then reveals the iodine-containing system in blue. Follow the iron: it stays in the water, rather than turning into blue particles. This evidence identifies iodine formation; it is not a specific test for iron two.

cues.title: 二价铁还能再接受电子吗？
cues.titleEn: Can iron two accept more electrons?
cues.caption: 二价铁还能得电子吗？
cues.captionEn: Can Fe²⁺ gain electrons?
cues.zh: 二价铁是否只能作为终点？让锌与另一份二价铁溶液相遇，先作预测。锌给出两个电子，二价铁接收后成为金属铁。同一个铁从水里来到固体表面。新增的路径从正二价通向零价；面对锌，二价铁是电子的接受者。
cues.en: Must iron two be the endpoint? Predict what happens when zinc meets a fresh iron two solution. Zinc supplies two electrons, and iron two accepts them to become metal. The same iron moves from water to the solid surface. Add a route from plus two to zero: with zinc, iron two accepts electrons.

cues.title: 同一种二价铁，为什么又能交出电子？
cues.titleEn: How can the same iron two now donate electrons?
cues.caption: 二价铁也能给出电子吗？
cues.captionEn: Can Fe²⁺ also donate?
cues.zh: 换成酸性高锰酸根，二价铁的角色反过来。五份二价铁各给出一个电子，一份高锰酸根接收这五份电子。它的四个氧没有消失，净账本把它们和八份氢离子记入四份水。紫色退去后，再用硫氰酸根检验生成的三价铁。并排看这两条路径：面对不同伙伴，二价铁既能接受，也能给出电子。
cues.en: With acidified permanganate, iron two changes roles. Five iron two ions each donate one electron; one permanganate receives all five. Its four oxygens remain accounted for: the net balance combines them with eight hydrogen ions in four waters. After purple disappears, thiocyanate reveals the iron three product. Compare the two routes: with different partners, iron two can accept or donate electrons.

cues.title: 显红也一定转移了电子吗？
cues.titleEn: Does red always mean electron transfer?
cues.caption: 显红色，就有电子转移吗？
cues.captionEn: Red: must electrons move?
cues.zh: 再看三价铁的显色对照。硫氰酸根参与配位，红色出现，中心铁仍是正三价。这次应该增加一条得失电子的箭头吗？不应该。把显色记录留在正三价这个位置：颜色改变，不一定意味着价态改变。这个对照将帮助我们判断最后一份样品。
cues.en: Now examine the iron three colour control. Thiocyanate binds, red appears, and the central iron remains formally plus three. Should we add an electron-transfer arrow? No. Keep this colour record at the plus-three position: a colour change need not change oxidation state. This control will help us interpret the final sample.

cues.title: 铁粉不足，红色会全部消失吗？
cues.titleEn: Will a small iron dose remove every red response?
cues.caption: 加铁后，还会显红吗？
cues.captionEn: Can red remain?
cues.zh: 若一份金属铁面对五份三价铁，反应后还能显红吗？先别加检验试剂。金属铁提供的两个电子，只能还原其中两份三价铁；它自己也进入水中。数一数：三份二价铁，三份三价铁。再加检验试剂，红色仍可出现。判断铁的角色与反应结果，要一起看价态、反应伙伴和数量。
cues.en: Suppose one metal iron atom faces five iron three ions. Can the reacted sample still turn red? Keep the test reagent out for now. The metal supplies only two electrons, reducing two iron three ions; it also enters solution. Count three iron two ions and three iron three ions. The later test can still turn red. To predict the result, consider oxidation state, partner and quantity together.

cues.title: 沿诱捕装置进入
cues.caption: 同一批昆虫中，趋光反应不同。
cues.captionEn: The same insect population contains different light responses.
cues.zh: 先看黑光灯周围的同一批模拟昆虫。趋光反应较强的对象更容易靠近，碰到挡虫结构后沿漏斗进入收集容器。经过窄颈时翅会收拢，个体身份始终保留。灯下捕到的只是被这种装置检测到的部分，不是范围内全部昆虫的直接清单。
cues.en: Follow the same simulated insects toward the light, baffle, funnel and collector. More strongly attracted insects approach more readily, and wings fold through the neck. Identity remains continuous. A trap records the detected fraction rather than a complete census of all insects in the area.

cues.title: 环境改变检测机会
cues.caption: 种群未变，活动条件改变也会改变捕获量。
cues.captionEn: Catch can change while the underlying population stays fixed.
cues.zh: 现在保持昆虫数量、身份和装置不变，只比较活动条件。后半段条件变差，进入装置的个体减少。这不等于种群在这一刻突然变小。真正比较不同地点或日期，还要记录灯源、时长、天气和调查对象，才能解释捕获量的差别。
cues.en: Keep the insects and apparatus fixed while changing activity conditions. In the second comparison, fewer insects enter the trap. That does not mean the population suddenly shrank. Comparing sites or dates also requires recording light source, effort, weather and target organisms.

cues.title: 先捕获并标记
cues.caption: 首捕个体进入暂留区，再获得标记。
cues.captionEn: Initially captured individuals move to the holding area and receive marks.
cues.zh: 首捕时，观察选中的个体从栖息地进入暂留区。标记加在这些个体身上，不是在野外凭空多出另一批有色动物。这里首捕标记十六个体，整个模拟种群保持固定身份。标记还必须能保留，并尽量不改变个体后续被捕获的机会。
cues.en: Selected animals move from the habitat into the holding area before marking. Marked animals are not a newly created colored population. Sixteen individuals receive marks in this simulation. Marks must remain identifiable and should not change subsequent capture opportunities.

cues.title: 放回，再让它们混合
cues.caption: 标记个体回到原种群，身份保留。
cues.captionEn: Marked animals return to the same population.
cues.zh: 把标记个体放回原来的环境，跟住它们从暂留区回到种群。随后个体混合，下一次捕获才有机会提供有代表性的标记比例。混合并不自动保证所有假设成立；研究范围是否近似封闭、捕获机会是否改变，仍需检查。
cues.en: Follow marked animals back into their original population. Mixing allows the later sample to provide information about the marked fraction. Mixing alone does not guarantee every assumption: population closure and changes in capture opportunities still require assessment.

cues.title: 从重捕比例估算
cues.caption: 用首捕数、重捕数及其中标记数共同估计。
cues.captionEn: Use initial marks, total recaptures and recognized marks together.
cues.zh: 第二次捕获十二个体，数清其中有多少保留标记。用首捕标记数乘以重捕总数，再除以重捕中的标记数，得到比值估计。该模拟范围是一公顷，所以数量估计也对应每公顷的密度值。探索时让标记丢失，就能看见识别比例改变；零重捕不能给出有限的比值估计。
cues.en: Capture twelve animals again and count recognized marks. Multiplying the initial marked count by the second sample size and dividing by recognized marks gives the ratio estimate. The one-hectare area connects abundance to density. Mark loss changes recognition; zero recaptures cannot yield a finite ratio estimate.

cues.title: 先抽坐标，再数植物
cues.caption: 随机样方取自同一块固定草地。
cues.captionEn: Random quadrats sample one fixed meadow.
cues.zh: 换到草地调查。目标是黄花双子叶植物，背景草本不计入。先随机选坐标，再放一平方米的样方。每加一个样方，都从实际植物位置重新计数。草地始终不变，抽样结果却可能变化；这正是要保留每个样方记录的原因。
cues.en: The yellow-flowered target plants are counted separately from background herbs. Choose random coordinates before placing one-square-meter quadrats. Each plot contributes counts from actual simulated positions. The meadow stays fixed while the sampled estimate can vary, so individual plot records matter.

cues.title: 给边界一个一致约定
cues.caption: 按根基部计上左，不计下右。
cues.captionEn: Count stem bases on top and left, excluding bottom and right.
cues.zh: 近看同一草地的一处固定样方。按根基部决定是否在边界上，计上边和左边，不计下边和右边。相邻样方采用同样规则，就不会把共享边界上的植物重复计数。这里特意放大边界案例来练习规则，不把这个固定位置冒称为随机抽样。
cues.en: Inspect a fixed quadrat in the same meadow. Classify each plant by its stem base, including top and left edges but excluding bottom and right. Adjacent plots then avoid double-counting. This deliberately chosen boundary example is a teaching close-up rather than a claimed random draw.

cues.title: 样方多，也不能只挑密集区
cues.titleEn: More plots do not repair biased selection
cues.caption: 只挑茂盛位置改变了取样机会。
cues.captionEn: Choosing dense patches changes inclusion probabilities.
cues.zh: 比较随机位置和只挑茂盛位置。画面仍是同一块草地，但后者专门挑了目标植物密集的格子，结果随之改变。增加这样的样方并不能消除选择偏差。随机抽样也不保证某一次完全准确；真实记录还要保存地点、面积、日期与调查对象。
cues.en: Compare random locations with deliberately selected dense patches in the same meadow. Selecting plots because they contain many target plants changes the estimate. More such plots cannot remove selection bias. Random sampling still has variation, and real records need coordinates, area, date and target identity.

cues.title: 一只动物可以留下多张影像
cues.titleEn: One animal can produce many images
cues.caption: 同侧花纹帮助辨认重复记录。
cues.captionEn: Same-flank patterns help identify repeated records.
cues.zh: 同一个体可能多次触发相机。先比较同一侧的花纹，再换成另一个体的图案。记录次数不能直接相加成动物只数。这里的动物与花纹是原创示意，没有假装野外照片。下方六条记录里，未知的一条保持未知，已确认身份也只是检测到的下限。
cues.en: An individual may trigger a camera repeatedly. Compare same-flank patterns, then replace one with a different pattern. Record count is not animal count. These are original illustrations rather than field photographs. The unresolved record stays unresolved, and confirmed identities provide only a detected minimum.

cues.title: 比较多个DNA位点
cues.caption: 多位点组合用于归并样本，缺失不能强行匹配。
cues.captionEn: Multilocus combinations support matching; missing evidence stays unresolved.
cues.zh: 粪便样本可以在不直接捕获动物的情况下提供DNA。比较多个微卫星位点，而不是凭一个数字就宣布找到同一个体。示意中同组样本的组合相同，换一个体后部分位点不同。真实应用还要处理降解、分型错误与巧合匹配，证据不足时不能强行归并。
cues.en: Scat can provide DNA without directly capturing the animal. Compare multiple microsatellite loci rather than treating one value as sufficient identity evidence. The illustrative combinations change between individuals. Real applications must address degradation, genotyping error and chance matching; insufficient evidence should remain unresolved.

cues.title: 声纹也要经过验证
cues.caption: 声音特征可辅助识别，漏检仍需处理。
cues.captionEn: Acoustic features can support identification; incomplete detection remains.
cues.zh: 最后比较声音特征。对适合的动物，某些稳定特征可以辅助辨认个体，但声音相似并不自动保证身份相同。曲线只是教学示意，不是真实录音。无论用相机、DNA还是声音，确认了几个体与整个种群有多少个体之间，仍然隔着漏检和识别误差。
cues.en: For suitable animals, stable vocal features can support individual identification. Similar sound does not automatically prove identity. These curves are illustrations, not recordings. Camera, DNA and acoustic methods all leave a distinction between confirmed individuals and total abundance, requiring detection and error models.

cues.title: 复制一次，同源配对
cues.caption: 先复制，再联会：四分体有四条染色单体。
cues.captionEn: Replicate, then pair: four chromatids in one tetrad.
cues.zh: 用两对同源染色体讲清过程。长的一对和短的一对，各包含来自父方和母方的一条。DNA先复制，每条染色体形成两条姐妹染色单体。随后同源染色体联会，形成四分体。四分体里的四，是四条染色单体，不是四条染色体。
cues.en: Follow two homologous pairs, one long and one short. Each pair contains a chromosome inherited from each parent. DNA replicates to form sister chromatids, and homologs then pair into a tetrad. Four in a tetrad refers to four chromatids, not four chromosomes.

cues.title: 保留身份，交换对应片段
cues.caption: 跟住片段：仅非姐妹参与这次互换。
cues.captionEn: Follow two non-sister segments through the exchange.
cues.zh: 放大一个四分体。两个内侧的非姐妹染色单体靠近，在对应位置交换片段。跟住带横线的两个远端片段：它们保持原来的颜色，却连接到另一条染色单体上。另两条没有参与这次互换。这是染色体片段层次的示意，并未展开DNA修复酶的全部分子过程。
cues.en: Zoom into one tetrad. Two inner non-sister chromatids exchange corresponding segments. Follow the marked distal pieces: each retains its color but becomes attached to the other chromatid. The other two chromatids do not participate. This shows chromosome-level exchange, not every molecular step of DNA repair.

cues.title: 第一次，分开同源染色体
cues.caption: 同源分离，姐妹仍相连。
cues.captionEn: Homologs separate; sisters stay together.
cues.zh: 同源染色体在细胞中央排列，分别连接向相对的两极。第一次分裂把每一对中的一条送入一侧，另一条送入另一侧。看着丝粒，两条姐妹仍然相连。每个次级精母细胞得到两条复制过的染色体，染色体组数在这一步减半。
cues.en: Homologs align centrally and attach toward opposite poles. The first division sends one member of each pair to each side. Sister chromatids remain associated at their centromeric region. Each secondary spermatocyte receives two replicated chromosomes; the chromosome-set number is reduced in this division.

cues.title: 第二次，分开姐妹
cues.caption: 不再复制：姐妹分离，形成四个细胞。
cues.captionEn: No new replication: sisters separate into four cells.
cues.zh: 两个细胞继续第二次分裂，中间没有再复制DNA。这一次姐妹染色单体分开，各自成为染色体，分别进入子细胞。最终四个细胞，每个都有一长一短两条染色体。整个谱系的DNA总量保持复制后的总量，分配到四个细胞中。这里演示精细胞形成；卵细胞的胞质分配不均等。
