cues.en: The two cells divide again without another round of DNA replication. Sisters now separate into daughter chromosomes. Each of four cells receives one long and one short chromosome. Total DNA across the lineage is conserved after replication. This illustrates spermatid formation; egg formation distributes cytoplasm unequally.

cues.title: 改变朝向，改变配套
cues.caption: 一次分裂的产物，不等于所有可能组合。
cues.captionEn: One division is not every possible combination.
cues.zh: 把第二对同源染色体的朝向反过来，比较两种分裂结果。为了只看独立分配，这里暂时不加入互换。一次这样的减数分裂产生四个细胞，却只有两种互补的组合；把两种可能朝向合起来，才看到四种配子组合。不能把一个细胞的产物和所有可能性混为一谈。
cues.en: Reverse the orientation of the second homologous pair and compare the outcomes. Crossing over is omitted here to isolate independent assortment. One such meiosis yields four cells but only two complementary combinations. Combining both orientations reveals four possibilities. Products of one cell are not the same as all possible outcomes.

cues.title: 两套汇合，恢复成对
cues.titleEn: Combine two sets and restore pairing
cues.caption: 两套来源会合，恢复成对状态。
cues.captionEn: Two sources restore a paired chromosome set.
cues.zh: 切换到受精的染色体配套图。卵细胞和精子各提供一套，在同一个受精卵中恢复成对状态。这里的两色区分两套来源，不能把前面某次减数分裂的两种配子直接指定为雌和雄。画面解释数量与来源，不模拟精子穿膜，也不声称所有物种的前核膜都会直接融合。
cues.en: Now use a separate chromosome-complement diagram for fertilization. Egg and sperm each provide one set in the same zygote. Colors distinguish the two sources here; the gamete classes from one earlier meiosis are not assigned female and male identities. The diagram explains number and origin, not membrane entry or universal pronuclear fusion.

cues.title: 在不同细胞中寻找时期
cues.titleEn: Find stages in different fixed cells
cues.caption: 细胞已经固定，移动的是观察位置。
cues.captionEn: Fixed cells stay fixed; the observer moves.
cues.zh: 教材要求先用低倍镜找细胞，再用高倍镜辨认同源配对、排列和分离。这里固定视野里的每个位置保持同一时期，移动的是观察框。放大后比较第一次和第二次分裂的特征。画面是两对染色体的辨认模式图，既不是实际蝗虫照片，也不据此报告真实物种的染色体总数。
cues.en: The textbook first locates cells at low power, then examines pairing, alignment and segregation at higher power. Every position in this fixed field retains its stage; only the observation marker moves. The enlarged view uses two homologous pairs as a recognition schematic, not a grasshopper micrograph or a measured species karyotype.

cues.title: 平行行为支持新假说
cues.caption: 基因与染色体的平行行为，支持假说。
cues.captionEn: Parallel behaviour supports a hypothesis.
cues.zh: 萨顿研究染色体的行为时，注意到它们与孟德尔遗传因子的行为平行。看D和小写d标记：在体细胞中成对，形成配子时各取一个，受精时重新配套。这种平行关系支持基因位于染色体上的假说，但还不是对某个基因位置的直接实验验证。后面摩尔根的果蝇研究会继续检验这条解释。
cues.en: Sutton noticed parallels between chromosome behavior and Mendelian factors. Follow D and lowercase d: paired in body cells, separated into gametes and combined again at fertilization. These parallels supported the chromosome hypothesis, but did not directly locate a particular gene. Morgan’s later fly experiments test that next step.

cues.title: 新颜色从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where does the new colour come from?
cues.caption: 新颜色，是谁失去了电子？
cues.captionEn: Whose electrons produce the new colour?
cues.zh: 把氯水的原色留作参照。加入溴离子后出现了新的橙色，不能只用稀释来解释。跟住两个溴离子：它们各交出一个电子，成为一份溴；氯接受这两个电子，变成氯离子。小点记录电子收支，不是水中电子飞行的路线。新生成的溴，让第一条比较成立：在这些水溶液条件下，氯的氧化能力比溴强。
cues.en: Keep the original chlorine water as a reference. Adding bromide produces a new orange colour; dilution alone cannot explain it. Follow two bromide ions. Each gives up one electron, together forming bromine. Chlorine accepts the two electrons and becomes chloride. The dots record electron accounting, not free electrons flying through water. The product establishes our first comparison: under these aqueous conditions, chlorine is the stronger oxidant.

cues.title: 换成碘离子，还能交换吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the exchange work with iodide?
cues.caption: 换一种离子，追踪同一笔电子账。
cues.captionEn: A new ion; the same electron account.
cues.zh: 现在只把溴离子换成碘离子，仍保留氯水参照。棕色出现了。两个碘离子失去两个电子，氯接受它们。这笔净账把产物写成一份碘；含碘离子的水里还会有三碘离子，不能把颜色当成纯碘分子的计数器。第二条证据说明氯也能氧化碘离子，但单凭这两次比较，还排不出溴和碘谁更强。
cues.en: Now replace bromide with iodide, keeping the chlorine-water reference. Brown colour appears. Two iodide ions lose two electrons, which chlorine accepts. The net account records one iodine equivalent. In iodide-containing water, triiodide can also form, so colour is not a counter of pure iodine molecules. We now know that chlorine oxidizes iodide too. Those two comparisons alone still cannot order bromine and iodine.

cues.title: 补上缺的一条证据
cues.caption: 溴与碘的比较，让排序可以预测。
cues.captionEn: The missing comparison enables a prediction.
cues.zh: 用溴水试碘离子，棕色碘再次生成。这次接受电子的是溴，最后一条比较补齐了。把三条固定观察连起来，得到氯、溴、碘的氧化能力次序。现在反过来：用碘试溴离子，应该生成溴吗？先停一下。这个次序预测，在同类条件下不会发生明显的反向置换。保留的棕色是原来加入的碘，不是新生成的溴。规律的价值，在于能提出下一次可检验的预测。
cues.en: Test iodide with bromine water. Iodine forms again, but bromine now accepts the electrons. That supplies the missing comparison. Link the three fixed observations to order chlorine, bromine and iodine as oxidants. Reverse the last test: should iodine produce bromine from bromide? Pause before revealing it. The ordering predicts no appreciable reverse displacement under comparable conditions. Remaining brown colour belongs to the iodine added, not newly formed bromine. A useful pattern makes a testable new prediction.

cues.title: 没有明显气泡，就是不能反应？
cues.titleEn: Does no visible bubbling mean no reaction?
cues.caption: 镁的短时观察，不能代替速率与趋势。
cues.captionEn: A short observation cannot settle reactivity.
cues.zh: 进入第三周期的比较。回想钠遇冷水的明显反应，再看已经擦去旧氧化膜的镁条：同样的短观察时间里，变化很不明显。这不等于镁不能和水反应。放大表面，金属与水之间还有表面层和反应过程的限制；表面也会继续变化。没有气泡，是观察尺度上的结果，不是反应量永远为零。保持这份镁和水，升温以后会怎样？
cues.en: For the period-three comparison, recall sodium’s obvious reaction with cold water. Magnesium, cleaned of its old oxide coating, changes much less during a short observation. That does not mean it cannot react with water. At the surface, layers and reaction barriers constrain the process, and the surface keeps evolving. No obvious bubbles describe this observation window, not a reaction extent fixed at zero forever. Keep the magnesium and water: what should heating reveal?

cues.title: 气体里的氢原来在哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where was the hydrogen before it became gas?
cues.caption: 水里的氢变成气体，镁交出电子。
cues.captionEn: Water supplies the gas; magnesium supplies electrons.
cues.zh: 加热后，气泡和碱性变得明显。把净变化放大：镁交出两个电子，水中的两个氢接受这份还原当量，组成氢气。跟住原来的氧和剩下的氢，它们仍以氢氧根的组成留在氢氧化镁里。一个镁、两个水，对应一份氢气和一份固体。粉红色只提示碱性，不能数出生成了多少。升温改变这段观察中的快慢；元素比较还要结合下一组氢氧化物证据。
cues.en: Heating makes bubbles and alkalinity noticeable. Enlarge the net change. Magnesium supplies two electrons; two hydrogens from water accept the reducing equivalents and form hydrogen gas. Track the original oxygens and the remaining hydrogens: their hydroxide composition stays in magnesium hydroxide. One magnesium and two waters give one hydrogen molecule and one formula unit of solid. Pink colour indicates alkalinity, not product quantity. Heating changes the observed pace. Comparing elements also needs the hydroxide evidence that follows.

cues.title: 同样的白色，组成也相同吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the same white colour mean the same composition?
cues.caption: 氨从水接受质子，沉淀保存金属身份。
cues.captionEn: Ammonia accepts a proton; the metals retain their identities.
cues.zh: 分别给镁盐和铝盐加入氨水，两份白色沉淀看起来相像。氨怎样提供氢氧根？跟住水里的这个氢：质子转给氨，留下氢氧根，氨变成铵离子。净组成中，一个二价镁需要两个氢氧根；一个三价铝需要三个。金属没有换身份，也没有在这里得失电子。颜色相似，不能推出化学性质相同。接下来分别给两种沉淀加酸、加碱。
cues.en: Ammonia produces similar white precipitates from magnesium and aluminium salts. Where does the hydroxide come from? Follow a hydrogen in water. A proton transfers to ammonia, leaving hydroxide and forming ammonium. In the net composition, one magnesium two-plus requires two hydroxides; one aluminium three-plus requires three. The metals retain their identities without a redox change. Similar colour therefore cannot establish identical chemistry. Separate portions will now face acid and base.

cues.title: 酸为什么能让两份沉淀消失？
cues.titleEn: Why can acid dissolve both solids?
cues.caption: 氢氧根的氧留在新生成的水里。
cues.captionEn: The hydroxide oxygens remain in the new water.
cues.zh: 加足酸，两种白色沉淀都减少。酸消耗氢氧根，固相继续溶解补充；净账里，原来的氧接上新增的氢，成为水，金属进入水溶液。镁的一份需要两个质子，铝的一份需要三个。现在给各一份沉淀相同的两个净质子当量：镁可以溶完，铝还剩三分之一。这里比较的是扣除背景反应后的净量，不是教材的滴数。少加试剂留下固体，不能误判成它完全不与酸反应。
cues.en: With enough acid, both white precipitates diminish. Acid consumes hydroxide, and further solid dissolves to replenish it. In the net account, the original oxygens acquire added hydrogens to form water, while the metals enter solution. One magnesium formula unit needs two protons; aluminium needs three. Give each one unit of solid just two net proton equivalents. Magnesium can dissolve completely, but one third of the aluminium solid remains. These are amounts after background reactions, not textbook drop counts. Insufficient reagent is not evidence of no reaction.

cues.title: 碱为什么只带走其中一份？
cues.titleEn: Why does base carry away only one solid?
cues.caption: 铝的价态不变，配离子的总电荷变了。
cues.captionEn: Aluminium keeps its oxidation state; the complex has a new charge.
cues.zh: 换用新取的沉淀加足强碱，铝这一份溶解，镁这一份在教材条件下仍明显保留。跟住铝的净组成：加入一个氢氧根，得到能留在水里的四羟基合铝离子。铝仍是正三价，整个配离子却带一个负电荷。这是配位与溶解的联系，不是铝被还原。只给半份净氢氧根，铝沉淀能全消失吗？不能，净计量只够一半。把这些证据放回钠、镁、铝的位置：同为第三层，核电荷增大、原子半径减小；氢氧化物从强碱走向两性。周期性是多条受条件约束的证据共同支持的规律。
cues.en: Add enough strong base to fresh portions. Aluminium hydroxide dissolves; magnesium hydroxide remains conspicuous under the textbook conditions. Follow the aluminium composition. One extra hydroxide yields a soluble tetrahydroxoaluminate ion. Aluminium remains plus three, although the whole complex carries one negative charge. This links complex formation to dissolution, without reducing aluminium. Would half a net hydroxide equivalent dissolve the whole solid? No: the account permits only half. Return the evidence to sodium, magnesium and aluminium. With the same outer shell number, nuclear charge rises and atomic radius falls; hydroxides progress from strongly basic toward amphoteric behaviour. Several conditional comparisons support the periodic pattern.

cues.title: 每一代怎样得到下一代
cues.titleEn: From one generation to the next
cues.caption: 亮色是当前一代。
cues.captionEn: Only the highlighted generation is current.
cues.zh: 从一个细菌开始，假定每二十分钟同步分裂一次。沿分支看一变二、二变四，每一代都由上一代推出来。亮色表示当前一代，上面的节点是谱系记录，不能再加进当前总数。这个规则还隐含资源无限、没有死亡和分裂周期相同等理想条件。
cues.en: Start with one bacterium and assume synchronous division every twenty minutes. Follow the branches from one to two, then four. The highlighted row is the current generation; ancestral nodes are history, not additional living cells. The rule assumes unlimited resources, no deaths and identical division times.

cues.title: 把规则写成预测
cues.titleEn: Turn the rule into a prediction
cues.caption: 极大外推值，提醒我们检查条件。
cues.captionEn: A huge extrapolation asks us to check conditions.
cues.zh: 把逐代倍增写成初始数量乘二的代数次方。一小时对应三代，所以是八个。若把同一假设直接延伸到七十二小时，就得到二的二百一十六次方。这个极大的结果提醒我们检查条件，而不是宣布真实培养液一定达到这样的数量。模型需要与观察比较，再修正。
cues.en: Initial abundance times two to the generation number gives the prediction. One hour contains three generations, producing eight cells. Extending the same assumptions for seventy-two hours gives two to the power of two hundred sixteen. This enormous prediction asks us to check assumptions, compare observations and revise the model.

cues.title: 先读历史培养观察
cues.caption: 0.5 mL：从 5 个到约 375 个。
cues.captionEn: In 0.5 mL: from 5 to about 375.
cues.zh: 高斯将五个大草履虫放入零点五毫升培养液，随后定时计数。教材描述约第五天后数量趋于三百七十五个左右。这里重建开始和后期两个观察状态，后期数值是近似量。没有逐日原始表，就不补造中间测量点。先分清记录了什么，再讨论怎样建模。
cues.en: Gause began with five Paramecium in half a milliliter of culture and counted at regular intervals. The textbook describes a plateau around three hundred seventy-five after roughly five days. These reconstructed snapshots preserve the approximate evidence. Intermediate measurements are not invented when the raw daily table is unavailable.

cues.title: 让限制进入增长模型
cues.caption: 总数稳定，个体仍可更新。
cues.captionEn: Stable numbers can conceal turnover.
cues.zh: 曲线只描述增长慢下来。看同样的有限供给，被更多个体分享，平均份额就减少。现在提出一个可检验的模型：密度增加，平均到每个个体的出生率降低，死亡率升高。看两条速率接近，净增长就减小。两率相等时，总数稳定，生命活动却没有停止。这个可能的片段中，一只分裂，另一只死亡，四只仍是四只。现在改善环境：数量不会瞬间跳高，而是增减速率先变，再逐步趋向新的水平。这里的速率和个体片段是模型，不是高斯的原始录像。
cues.en: The curve describes a slowdown. Share the same finite supply among more individuals: the mean share falls. Now propose a testable model. Increasing density lowers births per individual and raises deaths. As the two rates converge, net growth shrinks. Equal rates can stabilize the total without stopping turnover. In this possible interval, one individual divides and another dies: four remain four. Improve the environment next. The count cannot jump instantly. Rates change first, followed by growth toward a new level. These rates and tracked individuals are a model, not a recording of Gause’s experiment.

cues.title: 先把培养液混匀
cues.caption: 同一批细胞混匀，再取小样。
cues.captionEn: Mix the same cells, then sample.
cues.zh: 酵母实验要先得到可解释的小样。观察同一批示踪细胞从底部重新分散，细胞身份没有凭空增加。轻轻混匀后再取样，才能减少只取到上清液或底部沉积的偏差。画中的三十二个细胞用于显示混匀，不代表十毫升培养液的真实总数。
cues.en: The yeast investigation begins with a meaningful aliquot. Follow the same tracer cells dispersing from the bottom without creating new identities. Gentle mixing before sampling reduces bias from taking only supernatant or sediment. The thirty-two tracers illustrate mixing rather than claiming to count every cell in the ten-milliliter culture.

cues.title: 盖片到位，再充液
cues.caption: 已知面积与室深，才能换算浓度。
cues.captionEn: Known area and depth let us infer concentration.
cues.zh: 先放好盖玻片，再把小样加到边缘，让液体依靠毛细作用进入计数室。侧视图特意放大间隙；实际室深为零点一毫米。液滴不能靠压盖片硬挤进去。待细胞沉降后观察，若太密而无法辨认，应先按记录的倍数稀释，再重新装样计数。
cues.en: Place the coverslip before adding an aliquot at its edge. Capillary action fills the chamber. This magnified side view shows the gap, whose actual depth is one tenth of a millimeter. Do not force liquid under a pressed coverslip. Let cells settle; if they overlap excessively, dilute by a recorded factor and reload.

cues.title: 由数格子换算浓度
cues.titleEn: Convert a counted volume to concentration
cues.caption: 统一边界计数，再按体积换算。
cues.captionEn: Use one edge rule, then convert by volume.
cues.zh: 放大零点二乘零点二毫米的计数范围，按细胞中心计上边和左边，不计下边和右边。深度零点一毫米，所以体积是四乘十的负六次方毫升。把实际计数乘稀释倍数，再除这个体积，才得到每毫升数量。换另一种格子，换算因子也必须跟着面积改变。
cues.en: Inspect a square measuring zero point two millimeters on each side. Include cell centers on the top and left, excluding bottom and right. With a depth of zero point one millimeter, its volume is four millionths of a milliliter. Multiply the count by dilution and divide by that volume; another grid area requires another factor.

cues.title: 先有计数，再看变化
cues.caption: 记录变化，再用对照检验。
cues.captionEn: Record changes; test explanations.
cues.zh: 先把每天三个重复分别换算，再求平均，得到这组练习记录。缺测保留空白，总计数也不等于活细胞数。增长慢下来，能直接断定营养耗尽吗？把同一培养液分成两份，一份补充营养，另一份加入等量对照液，其他条件保持一致。如果缺营养是限制，这个假说预测补给组会恢复更多出芽；图中是待检验的预测，不是测得结果。再比较活性和后续增量，才能判断这个解释是否站得住。
cues.en: Convert each of three daily samples before averaging to obtain these practice records. Missing is not zero, and total counts do not establish viability. Does slower growth prove nutrient exhaustion? Split the same culture. Add nutrients to one portion and an equal volume of control liquid to the other, keeping other conditions matched. If nutrients are limiting, the hypothesis predicts more budding after supplementation. This is a prediction to test, not a measured result. Compare viability and subsequent increases to evaluate the explanation.

cues.title: 不同植物的调查响应
cues.caption: 同一郁闭度，不同物种响应不同。
cues.captionEn: Different species respond differently.
cues.zh: 切换三种植物，读取教材原有的郁闭度调查数据。前两种随郁闭度增加总体减少，刺儿菜却在中等郁闭度处较多。每个点是对应条件下的平均株数，不是由通用增长公式画出来的。比较物种之间的差别，才不会把所有植物都概括成同一个方向。
cues.en: Switch among the three plants using the textbook’s canopy survey values. The first two generally decline as closure increases, while thistle peaks at intermediate closure. Points represent mean plants per square meter, not a generic growth equation. Comparing species prevents assigning every plant the same response.

cues.title: 相关线索还要检验
cues.caption: 相关提供线索，对照检验因果。
cues.captionEn: Association suggests; comparisons test.
cues.zh: 调查发现的关联为解释提供线索，却没有自动排除其他因素。同一季节里，降水、温度和日长可能一起改变，还会影响资源、出生与死亡。图中是定性因果路径，没有捏造降水测量点。要判断某一因素的作用，还需要控制条件、重复调查，或者能区分其他解释的证据。
cues.en: Survey associations suggest explanations without automatically excluding alternatives. Rainfall, temperature and day length may change together, influencing resources, births and deaths. This qualitative diagram does not invent rainfall measurements. Isolating one factor needs controlled comparisons, repeated surveys or evidence that distinguishes competing explanations.

cues.title: 看不见原子，凭什么改画法？
cues.titleEn: What can make us redraw an unseen atom?
cues.caption: 光点为何偏向正极板？
cues.captionEn: Why does the spot bend toward +?
cues.zh: 如果原子看不见，凭什么把它画成一个实心球？道尔顿的图先提出不可再分的假设。现在看阴极射线留下的光点：接通电场，它偏向正极板；把极性反过来，偏转也反过来。跟住射线中的带电部分，受力方向指向它带负电。光点是可观察的证据，还不是原子的照片。
cues.en: How can we redraw something too small to see? Dalton’s solid sphere begins with an indivisible-atom hypothesis. Now watch the spot made by cathode rays. An electric field bends it toward the positive plate. Reverse the plates, and the deflection reverses. Follow the charged component: its force direction identifies negative charge. The spot is observable evidence, not a photograph of an atom.

cues.title: 换材料，证据还在吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the evidence survive a change of material?
cues.caption: 换材料，共同成分仍在。
cues.captionEn: New material; the shared component remains.
cues.zh: 如果这种负电成分只是某种气体或电极的特殊产物，换材料会怎样？汤姆孙改变气体和阴极材料，仍得到同一数量级的质量与电荷之比。图上保留原报告的差异，没有把它们改成完全相等。共同的负电成分进入原子模型，不可再分的假设必须修改。中性原子还需要正电荷；把它铺满整个球，是接下来要检验的模型假设。
cues.en: What if this negative component belongs only to one gas or electrode? Thomson changed both and still obtained mass-to-charge ratios of the same order. These fixed records retain the differences in his report; they have not been forced to agree. A common negative component enters the atom, challenging indivisibility. Neutrality also requires positive charge. Spreading that charge through a sphere is a new hypothesis to test.

cues.title: 哪种分布能把粒子弹回来？
cues.titleEn: Which charge distribution can turn a particle back?
cues.caption: 相同电荷，为什么一个能折返？
cues.captionEn: Same charge: why can only one turn it back?
cues.zh: 有少数阿尔法粒子发生了大角度散射。弥散的正电荷能做到吗？让同样的总正电荷，分别铺在大球里、集中到很小的中心。跟住这次五兆电子伏的正对入射：弥散球的最高势垒还不到入射能量的千分之一，粒子穿过去；集中核让势能不断升高，直到动能用尽，粒子折返。现在预测：能量更高，会靠得更近吗？会。这个对照说明电荷集中为什么重要；现代参数用于检验解释，没有替代当年的散射记录。
cues.en: A few alpha particles scatter through large angles. Can diffuse positive charge explain that? Give a broad sphere and a compact centre the same total charge. Follow a five megaelectronvolt head-on test. The sphere’s highest barrier is less than a thousandth of the incident energy, so the particle passes through. Near the compact centre, potential energy rises until kinetic energy reaches zero and the particle turns back. Predict: does more energy bring it closer? Yes. This modern calculation tests the explanation; it does not replace the historical observations.

cues.title: 一条谱线怎样检验一个能级差？
cues.titleEn: How can a spectral line test an energy gap?
cues.caption: 更大的能级差，会给出什么光？
cues.captionEn: A larger gap: what light should follow?
cues.zh: 氢发出的光有固定的谱线，并不是任何颜色都一样亮。玻尔提出允许的离散能量，并用两个能级的差决定一个光子的能量。跟住这份能量：从第三级到第二级，差值对应红光。保持第二级不变，改从第四级出发，先猜波长会怎样。能量差更大，波长更短，预测落到蓝绿谱线附近。固定记录没有跟着模型移动。光谱支持能级关系，却没有拍到电子走圆圈；接下来，我们换一种方式表达电子的空间分布。
cues.en: Hydrogen emits fixed spectral lines rather than every colour equally. Bohr proposed discrete allowed energies, with one photon carrying the difference between two levels. Follow that energy: level three to level two corresponds to red light. Keep level two, but start at level four. Predict the wavelength before revealing it. A larger gap gives a shorter wavelength, near the blue-green line. The fixed records do not move with the model. Spectra support energy relationships without photographing circular paths. Next, we need a different picture of the electron’s spatial distribution.

cues.title: 电子云不是一群电子
cues.titleEn: An electron cloud is not many electrons
cues.caption: 许多小点表示同一状态的概率分布，不表示许多电子。
cues.captionEn: Many dots represent one state’s probability distribution, not many electrons.
cues.zh: 氢原子只有一个电子，为什么电子云图里会有这么多小点？这些点是对同一种量子状态的概率分布进行采样。点越来越多，分布的轮廓更清楚，电子数却没有增加。这张图没有把点依次连成轨迹，也没有说电子沿某条看不见的圆圈运动。
cues.en: Hydrogen has one electron, so why does its cloud contain so many dots? They sample the probability distribution of the same quantum state. More samples reveal the distribution more clearly without increasing the number of electrons. The dots are not joined into a trajectory, and the picture does not imply an unseen circular orbit.

cues.title: 轮廓包围的是概率
cues.caption: 概率轮廓不是硬边界，轮廓之外仍有非零概率。
cues.captionEn: A probability contour is not a hard boundary; probability remains outside it.
cues.zh: 教材用包围百分之九十概率的空间简化电子云轮廓。这里逐渐扩大氢原子一s态的球，累计概率从一半增加到九成。淡色点仍可在球外出现，所以轮廓不是电子无法穿过的墙。圆形只是三维球面的投影，概率按三维体积计算。
cues.en: The textbook simplifies a cloud with a region enclosing ninety percent probability. Here a sphere expands in hydrogen’s one-s state, raising cumulative probability from one half to nine tenths. Faint samples can still lie outside it, so the contour is not an impenetrable wall. The circle projects a sphere, and probability is calculated in three-dimensional volume.

cues.title: 球对称不等于相同大小
cues.titleEn: Spherical symmetry does not mean equal size
cues.caption: 同一长度尺度下，2s比1s更弥散。
cues.captionEn: On the same length scale, 2s is more diffuse than 1s.
cues.zh: 把一s和二s放到同一个长度尺度下，两者都具有球对称，但二s向更远的空间展开。并不是把同一个小球机械放大：二s的径向分布还有一个节点。这里展示的是氢原子的解析状态，不能把这些半径直接套给所有多电子原子。
cues.en: At a common length scale, both one-s and two-s are spherically symmetric, but two-s extends farther. It is not merely the same small sphere enlarged: its radial distribution also has a node. These are analytic hydrogen states, so their radii should not be copied directly to every many-electron atom.

cues.title: p轨道的三个取向
cues.caption: 2p的三个取向相互垂直，每一幅都是单独的概率分布。
cues.captionEn: The three 2p orientations are perpendicular; each view is a separate probability distribution.
cues.zh: p态不再是球对称，概率分布沿一个方向形成两个主要区域。教材用x、y、z三个相互垂直的方向区分p轨道。画面把它们分别投影出来，不能把三幅图的小点加起来当作一个原子里更多的电子。轨道在这里描述量子状态，已经不是前面历史模型的圆形路线。
cues.en: A p state is not spherically symmetric: its probability distribution has two main regions along one direction. The textbook distinguishes p orbitals along three perpendicular x, y and z directions. Each is projected separately, so their dots should not be added as extra electrons in one atom. Orbital now describes a quantum state, not the circular route in the historical models.

cues.title: 先看杂交第一代
cues.caption: 父母各给一个，保留来源。
cues.captionEn: One from each parent; keep the source.
cues.zh: 摩尔根发现白眼雄果蝇后，用它与红眼雌果蝇杂交。教材的纯合红眼母本给每个后代一个带显性因子的X。父本给女儿X，给儿子Y，因此子一代雌雄都表现红眼。画面把性别、眼色和染色体来源分别标出，避免只看一个总体比例。
cues.en: After finding a white-eyed male fly, Morgan crossed it with a red-eyed female. In the textbook model, the homozygous red-eyed mother supplies a dominant X to every offspring. The father supplies X to daughters and Y to sons, so both sexes in F1 are red-eyed. Track sex, eye color and chromosome origin separately.

cues.title: 把性别一起记下来
cues.titleEn: Record sex as well as eye color
cues.caption: 白眼与性别的关联，需要解释。
cues.captionEn: Explain the link between eye color and sex.
cues.zh: 让子一代的雌雄果蝇交配。母方有两种X，父方有红眼X和Y。跟随配子标记进入四种后代。白眼只出现在获得隐性X和Y的组合中。总体红白比接近三比一还不够；白眼与性别的关联，才是这里需要解释的新证据。
cues.en: Mate the F1 female and male. The mother has two X forms; the father provides either the red-eye X or Y. Trace these gametes into four offspring classes. White eyes occur only with a recessive X and Y. An overall three-to-one color ratio is not enough: association with sex is the new evidence to explain.

cues.title: 测交检验新预测
cues.caption: 测交预测，也允许白眼雌蝇。
cues.captionEn: The test cross predicts white-eyed females.
cues.zh: 把杂合红眼雌蝇与白眼雄蝇测交。如果白眼因子在X上，母方的两种X，分别与父方的白眼X或Y结合，理论上得到红眼雌、白眼雌、红眼雄和白眼雄四类。这里出现白眼雌蝇，说明白眼并不是雄性专属的性状。
cues.en: Cross the heterozygous red-eyed female with a white-eyed male. If the locus is X-linked, the two maternal X types combine with the paternal recessive X or Y to yield four predicted classes: red and white females, and red and white males. White-eyed females show that the trait is not restricted to males.

cues.title: 亲本角色交换后会怎样
cues.titleEn: What changes when parental roles reverse?
cues.caption: 交换亲本性别，预测随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Reverse the parents; test a new prediction.
cues.zh: 再做一个对照：白眼雌蝇与红眼雄蝇杂交。女儿都从父亲得到红眼X，所以表现红眼；儿子从父亲得到Y，唯一的X来自白眼母亲，因此表现白眼。交换亲本的性别改变了结果，X连锁模型能够给出这个可检验的预测。百分比来自模型，不是假造的原始计数。
cues.en: Reverse the cross: a white-eyed female with a red-eyed male. Daughters receive their father’s red-eye X and are red-eyed. Sons receive his Y and their only X from the white-eyed mother, making them white-eyed. X linkage predicts this difference. Percentages are theoretical, not fabricated historical counts.

cues.title: 先比较观察记录
cues.caption: 比较观察报告，不模拟个人视觉。
cues.captionEn: Compare reports, not simulated vision.
cues.zh: 道尔顿把自己和弟弟的颜色观察，与其他人的描述进行比较。教材记录，他在白天和烛光下报告不同颜色，其他人则把花说成粉红色。这里展示的是观察记录的差异，不用屏幕颜色假装复原某个人的精确视觉。这类观察提出问题，遗传解释还需要家系证据。
cues.en: Dalton compared his and his brother’s color observations with other people’s descriptions. The textbook records a difference between daylight and candlelight for them, while others described the flower as pink. This is a comparison of reports, not a screen simulation of anyone’s exact vision. Genetic explanations require family evidence as well.

cues.title: 沿真实家系保留不确定性
cues.titleEn: Follow the pedigree without erasing uncertainty
cues.caption: 实心是观察，圆点是推断。
cues.captionEn: Filled: observed. Dotted: inferred.
cues.zh: 跟着教材家系走。第一代的父亲有红绿色觉障碍；第二代三号女儿表型未受影响，但在教材的X连锁隐性模型下可推断为携带者。她的儿子中又出现受影响者。圆点是模型推断，实心才是观察到的表型。有些女性仍可能对应两个基因型，现有资料不能强行确定。
cues.en: Follow the textbook pedigree. The affected first-generation father has an unaffected daughter, individual two-three, inferred to be a carrier under the textbook’s X-recessive assumptions. An affected son appears in her family. Dots represent inference; filled symbols represent observed phenotype. Some women retain two possible genotypes because the available evidence does not resolve them.

cues.title: 先明确被调查的人群
cues.caption: 人群比例，要保留抽样分母。
cues.captionEn: Keep the sampling denominator.
cues.zh: 现在切换到二百人的合成练习资料。逐步选取样本，分子统计受影响人数，分母统计被调查人数。探索时可只选已有受影响成员的家庭，观察选择偏倚；也可改为男性或女性分母。这些都是教学数据，不是任何真实人群的患病率。
cues.en: Switch to a synthetic classroom population of two hundred people. As the sample grows, count affected people over surveyed people. Exploration restricts sampling to households already containing affected members to expose selection bias, or changes the sex-specific denominator. These are teaching data, not prevalence estimates for a real population.

cues.title: 合并人数，而不是平均百分比
cues.titleEn: Pool people instead of averaging percentages
cues.caption: 合并人数，先去重，再计算。
cues.captionEn: Pool unique people, then calculate.
cues.zh: 第一组二十人中有两人受影响，第二组八十人中有一人。合并后是三除以一百，等于百分之三，不能直接把两个百分比取平均。若同一个人被两个小组重复登记，还要先去重。家系资料帮助分析传递方式；规范的人群抽样才回答人群比例问题。
cues.en: Two of twenty people are affected in one group, and one of eighty in another. Pooled, that is three of one hundred, or three percent, not the simple average of the two percentages. Duplicate registrations must first be removed. Pedigrees address transmission patterns; population sampling addresses proportions.

cues.title: 把元素排进周期
cues.caption: 原子序数决定顺序；同一列保留相似的价层结构。
cues.captionEn: Atomic number fixes the order; columns align related valence structures.
cues.zh: 先跟着第一列向下看。锂、钠、钾等元素分属不同周期，但最外层都有一个电子。周期表不是任意摆放的名字清单，它同时把原子序数的连续变化和性质的重复联系起来。氢虽也放在这一列，却不能简单当成普通碱金属。
cues.en: Follow the first column downward. Lithium, sodium and potassium occupy different periods, but each has one outer electron. The table connects increasing atomic number with recurring properties. Hydrogen also occupies this column, but it should not simply be treated as an ordinary alkali metal.

cues.title: 同一元素，两种布局
cues.caption: 抽出的14格重新插入，元素身份与先后顺序保持不变。
cues.captionEn: The detached 14 cells rejoin each long period without changing element identities.
cues.zh: 现在把底部的两段展开，接回第六和第七周期。十八列与三十二列的表包含同一组元素，只是对长周期的安排不同。这里的颜色帮助跟踪各个区，不代表又发现了一批元素。教材要求比较不同形式的设计依据，布局是否清楚呈现关系，比外形是否新奇更重要。
cues.en: The two detached strips now return to periods six and seven. The eighteen-column and thirty-two-column forms contain the same elements, arranged differently. Colour lets you track each region through the change. The textbook asks you to compare the organizing principles of alternative tables: the useful question is which relationships each layout makes easier to see.

cues.title: 一周期怎样闭合
cues.caption: 第三周期依次填入3s、3p，氩完成价层排布。
cues.captionEn: Period three fills 3s and then 3p, ending with argon’s filled valence shell.
cues.zh: 把镜头放到第三周期。钠先占据三s，镁将它填成一对；从铝开始，电子进入三p。三个p轨道先分别占据，再逐一配对，到氩成为三s二、三p六。方框和箭头表示轨道占据与自旋，它们不是电子在空间绕行的轨道线。
cues.en: Focus on period three. Sodium occupies three s, and magnesium completes its pair. Aluminium begins filling three p. The three p orbitals become singly occupied before pairing, reaching three s two, three p six at argon. Boxes and arrows represent orbital occupancy and spin, not paths followed by moving electrons.

cues.title: 排布规则的边界
cues.caption: Cr与Cu的实测基态排布提醒我们：简易填充顺序不是完整计算。
cues.captionEn: Observed Cr and Cu configurations expose limits of the simple filling mnemonic.
cues.zh: 再看铬和铜。铬的基态是三d五、四s一，铜是三d十、四s一，不能把简单的填充口诀机械外推。这些排布是由光谱等证据约束的基态描述。教材把铜、银、金以及锌、镉、汞所在的两列另称ds区，是一种教学分区方式。
cues.en: Now compare chromium and copper. Their ground configurations are three d five, four s one, and three d ten, four s one. A simple filling mnemonic must not override observed ground-state configurations. The textbook separately labels the copper and zinc columns as the d s region; that is the classification used by the colours here.

cues.title: 第三周期的电负性
cues.caption: 教材电负性从Na到Cl增大；Ar的空白不代表零。
cues.captionEn: Textbook electronegativities rise from Na to Cl; Ar’s blank is not zero.
cues.zh: 把第三周期的教材数据画出来。电负性描述成键原子吸引键合电子的相对能力，从钠到氯逐渐增大。这里照录教材的一位小数，因此与你查到的较新数表可能略有差异。氩没有列出数值，图上保留空白，不能把它补成零。
cues.en: Plot the textbook values for period three. Electronegativity describes a bonded atom’s relative attraction for bonding electrons, increasing here from sodium to chlorine. These are the textbook’s rounded values, so another compilation may differ slightly. Argon has no value in this table: missing data must remain missing, not become zero.

cues.title: 沿碱金属族向下
cues.caption: Li到Cs总体减小；教材舍入使K与Rb显示相同值。
cues.captionEn: Values decrease overall from Li to Cs; textbook rounding makes K and Rb equal.
cues.zh: 现在沿锂、钠、钾、铷、铯向下比较。图中的条形总体缩短，但钾和铷都标为零点八。这不是画图错误，而是教材保留一位小数的结果。趋势是一种概括，读取具体数据时仍要保留相等、缺失与例外。
cues.en: Compare lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium and caesium down the group. The bars become shorter overall, but potassium and rubidium both read zero point eight. That equality comes from textbook rounding. A trend is a summary; the plotted evidence must preserve equal, missing and exceptional values.

cues.title: 遮住碘，先作预测
cues.caption: 先用F、Cl、Br推测I，再揭晓教材值。
cues.captionEn: Use F, Cl and Br to predict I before revealing it.
cues.zh: 先把碘的数值遮住。氟、氯、溴的教材电负性依次降低；它们的价层都以p五结束，但电子所在的能层越来越外。沿着这个方向，你预期碘比溴大，还是小？现在揭晓：二点五，比溴的二点八小。这个比较支持趋势，却不能仅凭电负性就预测所有溶液反应。
cues.en: Hide iodine for a moment. The textbook values fall from fluorine to chlorine to bromine. Each valence configuration ends in p five, but in successively higher shells. Would you expect iodine to be higher or lower than bromine? Reveal the record: two point five, below bromine’s two point eight. This supports the trend; electronegativity alone still cannot predict every solution reaction.

cues.title: 下降的，是哪一个电子？
cues.titleEn: Which electron leaves at each dip?
cues.caption: 追踪被移除的电子，再检验同能量预测。
cues.captionEn: Track the removed electron, then test the same-energy prediction.
cues.zh: 换成第一电离能，曲线出现两个下降。镁移走的是三s电子，铝开始移走能量较高的三p电子，所需能量反而更少。再看磷和硫：磷的三个p轨道各有一个电子，硫多出的电子形成一对；移走这对中的一个，留下三个单占轨道。这是定性解释，具体门槛仍读独立数据。现在给镁和铝同样的六点五电子伏，谁能失去一个电子？铝可以，镁不够。跟踪同一个电子离开后，原子成为正一价离子；电荷总和不变。
cues.en: Switch to first ionization energy: two dips appear. Magnesium loses a three s electron; aluminium loses a higher-energy three p electron and needs less energy. Phosphorus has three singly occupied p orbitals. Sulfur adds a paired electron; removing it leaves three singly occupied orbitals. This explains the pattern qualitatively; the thresholds still come from independent data. Now supply the same six point five electronvolts to magnesium and aluminium. Which can lose an electron? Aluminium can; magnesium cannot. Track that electron as the atom becomes a plus-one ion. Their total charge remains unchanged.

cues.title: 先看分别单独培养
cues.caption: 单养记录给出每个物种自己的参照。
cues.captionEn: Monocultures provide a reference for each species.
cues.zh: 先把两个物种各自单独培养。棕色是大草履虫，绿色是双小核草履虫，点取自高斯原图的公开数字化资料。纵轴是按相对大小统一的体积指数，并非逐只计数。两个种群在各自条件下都能增长，单养结果为下一步比较混养提供参照。
cues.en: Begin with the two species grown separately. Brown identifies P. caudatum and green P. aurelia. Points come from publicly digitized Gause figures. The vertical axis is a size-standardized volume index, not a direct cell count. Each species can grow alone, establishing the reference for mixed culture.

cues.title: 放到共享条件中
cues.caption: 混养改变大草履虫的增长；采样末值仍应如实保留。
cues.captionEn: Mixed culture suppresses P. caudatum; preserve the recorded endpoint.
cues.zh: 换成混合培养，两种草履虫共享培养条件与饲料。大草履虫先增长，后来受到明显抑制。注意这组数字化记录到第二十四天仍非零，不能为了画出理想结论把它改成零；教材概括了后续消失的结果。不同来源的时间范围和计量方法必须保留，竞争也不等于彼此分泌毒物。
cues.en: In mixed culture, the species share conditions and food. P. caudatum initially increases, then becomes strongly suppressed. This digitized series remains above zero at day twenty-four, so its endpoint is preserved. The textbook summarizes eventual disappearance. Time coverage and measurement methods matter; competition does not imply that one species secretes a poison.

cues.title: 把竞争假设单独建模
cues.caption: 减小资源重叠，会改变模型中的相互限制。
cues.captionEn: Reduced overlap changes mutual limitation in the model.
cues.zh: 现在把记录与解释分开，用一个明确标为示意的竞争模型。两个物种都受到自身密度限制，也受到另一物种利用共同资源的影响。探索时把资源重叠降为零，就回到各自独立的增长。模型可以检验假设的后果，但这条光滑线不是原始实验点，也不能代替对培养条件的核查。
cues.en: A clearly labeled illustrative model separates explanation from observation. Each species experiences self-limitation and effects from the other species sharing resources. Setting overlap to zero restores independent growth. The model tests consequences of assumptions; a smooth trajectory is neither a raw observation nor a substitute for checking culture conditions.

cues.title: 长期记录中的相邻波峰
cues.caption: 两条记录分别归一化，不能读成两种动物同样多。
cues.captionEn: Each series is normalized separately; equal height is not equal abundance.
cues.zh: 沿一八四五到一九三五年的补充历史汇编，比较雪兔与猞猁的起伏。两条记录各以自己的最大值归一化，所以同样高不表示动物同样多。历史捕获、地区和调查方法会影响记录。探索中可以移动猞猁曲线来比较滞后，但更高的相关系数仍不能独自证明唯一的因果关系。
cues.en: Compare supplementary historical records from eighteen forty-five to nineteen thirty-five. Each series is divided by its own maximum, so equal height does not mean equal abundance. Harvest, geography and survey methods affect these records. Shifting lynx records can explore lagged association, but a higher correlation does not establish a unique causal explanation.

cues.title: 从单向箭头到反馈
cues.caption: 雪兔影响猞猁的食物，猞猁又影响雪兔死亡。
cues.captionEn: Hares affect lynx food supply; lynx affect hare mortality.
cues.zh: 沿关系图看：食物影响雪兔，雪兔数量影响猞猁的食物供应，猞猁的捕食又改变雪兔的死亡风险。原因产生的结果会反馈回来，所以不能只问哪一个永远是因、哪一个永远是果。真实森林还有其他捕食者、食物质量与生理状态，这张小图只抽取其中几条关系。
cues.en: Food affects hares, hare availability affects lynx food supply, and lynx predation affects hare mortality. Effects feed back into the conditions that produced them. Neither species is permanently the sole cause or sole consequence. Real forests also include other predators, food quality and physiological state; this diagram isolates only a few relationships.

cues.title: 用交叉处理检验解释
cues.caption: 补食与减少捕食者的合并效果，不是简单相加。
cues.captionEn: The combined effect differs from simple addition.
cues.zh: 补充的育空野外研究同时操纵食物和哺乳类捕食者。高峰及下降阶段的平均密度，以对照为一，减少捕食者约为二，补食约为三，两项合并约为十一。这里展示的是研究阶段平均比值，不是即时预测。围栏没有排除猛禽，合并处理也没有完全阻止下降，这些限制仍要保留。
cues.en: A Yukon field study crossed food supplementation with reduction of mammalian predators. During peak and decline phases, mean density ratios were roughly one for controls, two for predator reduction, three for food and eleven for the combination. These are phase averages, not instant predictions. Raptors remained, and even combined treatment did not completely prevent decline.

cues.title: 先改变捕食者
cues.caption: 追踪移除动作，岩面与初始占位保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Follow removal while retaining the rock surface and initial occupancy.
cues.zh: 回到潮间带。海星可以捕食这里的多种动物，岩面空间却有限。实验先移除海星，原来的岩面并没有换成另一块。跟住海星从样地离开的动作，其他占位者此时仍保留。这里是历史干预的教学重建，不是学生可以随意照做的野外采集建议。
cues.en: On the intertidal shore, sea stars consume several animals while rock space remains limited. The historical intervention removed sea stars without replacing the rock surface. Follow the removal while existing occupants remain. This is a teaching reconstruction of a research intervention, not a suggestion for casual field removal.

cues.title: 空位先被谁占据
cues.caption: 藤壶先扩展，占位总面积始终守恒。
cues.captionEn: Barnacles expand first while total surface area is conserved.
cues.zh: 移除后的早期，藤壶能够在空位定居，逐渐占据较多岩面。每一个位置都来自同一片有限基底，空位减少与占位增加由同一个模型计算。百分比是机制重建的数值，并非把原始样地精确还原。关键证据是：减少捕食之后，竞争空间的条件也变了。
cues.en: After removal, barnacles recruit into vacant sites and occupy more of the fixed surface. Vacant area decreases as occupied area increases within the same model. Percentages belong to a mechanism reconstruction, not an exact reconstruction of field measurements. The important change is that reducing predation also changes competition for space.

cues.title: 后来的优势者继续挤占空间
cues.caption: 贻贝扩展，捕食与空间竞争共同改变群落。
cues.captionEn: Mussel expansion connects predation with competition for space.
cues.zh: 先看保留海星的参照，再看移除后较晚的岩面。贻贝扩展并替代部分藤壶占位，其他生物也失去可利用的空间。图上先保留原占位者，再显出新定居者，不把一种动物变成另一种。这个历史例子说明捕食可以间接限制优势竞争者；并不意味着每个群落移除任何捕食者都会得到同样结果。
cues.en: Compare the retained-star reference with the later removal scenario. Mussels expand into space previously occupied by barnacles and other organisms. Old occupants and new settlers are shown separately rather than transforming one animal into another. Predation can indirectly restrain a dominant competitor, but removing any predator from any community need not produce the same outcome.

cues.title: 四组对照，出现新结果
cues.titleEn: Four groups reveal a new result
cues.caption: 四组对照，留下转化问题。
cues.captionEn: Four controls reveal transformation.
cues.zh: 先比较四组历史实验。R型活菌不使小鼠死亡，S型活菌使小鼠死亡；热致死的S型单独也不使小鼠死亡。关键是第四组：把R型活菌与热致死的S型混合，结果又出现了死亡。仅凭这个结果，还不能说遗传物质就是DNA。
cues.en: Compare four historical groups. Live R bacteria did not kill the mice; live S did. Heat-killed S alone did not. The fourth group was decisive: live R mixed with heat-killed S again caused death. This result alone did not identify DNA as the genetic material.

cues.title: 分离活菌，再看后代
cues.titleEn: Recover live bacteria and examine descendants
cues.caption: 活S型的后代仍有S型性状。
cues.captionEn: Live S descendants retain the S trait.
cues.zh: 再看混合组后续的观察。从中分离到的不是只有死菌碎片，而是S型活菌；继续培养，它们的后代也具有S型性状。这支持有某种物质使R型发生可遗传的转化。热致死的S型并不是重新复活，转化因子的化学身份仍需检验。
cues.en: Examine what was recovered from the mixed group: live S bacteria, whose descendants retained S characteristics. This supported a heritable transformation of R cells by some material. Heat-killed S cells had not simply revived. The chemical identity of the transforming principle remained unresolved.

cues.title: 把问题转到培养物
cues.caption: 把转化活性带入可处理的提取物。
cues.captionEn: Test transforming activity in an extract.
cues.zh: 艾弗里等人先制备S型细胞提取物，去除绝大部分糖类、蛋白质和脂质，再加入有R型活菌的培养基。培养物中出现了S型。这一步把转化问题放到可处理的提取物上。图中的四类成分只是成分标识，不表示它们含量相等，也不是全部残留物的实测组成。
cues.en: Avery and colleagues prepared an S-cell extract after removing most sugars, proteins and lipids. Added to live R cultures, it produced S cells. The transforming activity could now be tested through the extract. Four component symbols identify candidates; they do not imply equal quantities or a measured composition.

cues.title: 逐一破坏，追问必要成分
cues.caption: 去除DNA后，原有转化活性消失。
cues.captionEn: Removing DNA removes transforming activity.
cues.zh: 依次看四种处理。蛋白酶破坏蛋白质，RNA酶和酯酶各处理相应成分，转化活性仍在。换成DNA酶，DNA被破坏，培养物只出现R型。选择性处理必须有效，而且不能另行杀死受体。结合纯化和理化性质，这组证据把可遗传的转化与DNA联系起来。
cues.en: Follow four treatments in turn. Protease, RNase and lipase act on their respective components, yet transforming activity remains. DNase destroys DNA and the culture produces only R cells. Treatments must be selective and effective, without separately killing the recipients. Together with purification and chemical characterization, this links heritable transformation to DNA.

cues.title: 两批同位素，分别追踪
cues.caption: 分别标记两批，再感染未标记宿主。
cues.captionEn: Label two separate batches, then infect hosts.
cues.zh: 赫尔希和蔡斯把问题换成T2噬菌体。先在带同位素的培养条件下培养大肠杆菌，再让噬菌体在其中增殖。第一批用硫三十五追踪蛋白质外壳，第二批用磷三十二追踪DNA。随后两批分别感染未标记的大肠杆菌，不能把这一步画成噬菌体直接在无细胞培养基里繁殖。
cues.en: Hershey and Chase used phage T2. Labeled bacteria first supplied material for growing phage. One batch traced protein with sulfur thirty-five; the other traced DNA with phosphorus thirty-two. Each batch then infected unlabeled bacteria. Phages were grown through hosts, not directly in a cell-free nutrient medium.

cues.title: 跟住外壳与DNA
cues.caption: 沿主要路径，跟住原有来源。
cues.captionEn: Follow the source along the dominant route.
cues.zh: 放大噬菌体与细菌的接触处。先看带菱形标记的外壳，它仍在细胞外；再看圆形标记的DNA，它沿尾部进入宿主。这里重建的是实验支持的主要路径，不是当年直接拍摄的分子影片，也不意味着所有放射性都完全按这一条路径分离。
cues.en: Zoom into the phage–host interface. First follow the diamond on the coat, which stays outside. Then follow the circle on DNA as it passes through the tail. This reconstructs the dominant pathway supported by the experiments; it is not a molecular movie recorded at the time, nor a claim of perfectly pure separation.

cues.title: 先脱离，再分层检测
cues.caption: 先分开外壳，再检测各部分。
cues.captionEn: Detach coats, then assay the fractions.
cues.zh: 两批都经过搅拌，再离心。搅拌让吸附外壳与细菌分开，离心使细菌进入管底的沉淀。硫标记主要出现在上清液，磷标记主要在细菌沉淀中。注意两种颜色是追踪符号，实际要用仪器检测放射性。如果省略搅拌，外壳可随细菌一起沉淀，单凭沉淀中的信号就难以解释谁进入了细胞。
cues.en: Each batch is blended and centrifuged. Blending detaches adsorbed coats; centrifugation collects bacteria in the pellet. Sulfur is mainly detected in the supernatant, phosphorus mainly in the pellet. Colors are tracing symbols, not visible radioactive dyes. Without blending, attached coats can accompany the bacteria into the pellet, confounding the inference.

cues.title: 再问标记能否进入子代
cues.titleEn: Ask whether parental label reaches progeny
cues.caption: 比较进入子代的亲代放射性。
cues.captionEn: Compare parental radioactivity in progeny.
cues.zh: 最后检测子代中的亲代标记。原论文报告，进入子代的亲代硫放射性低于百分之一，亲代磷则为百分之三十或更多。这个分母是亲代总放射性，不是有标记的子代个数。证据支持DNA在T2遗传中的作用，但不能推出所有病毒都使用DNA；教材接着指出，有些病毒以RNA为遗传物质。
cues.en: Finally examine parental label recovered in progeny. The original paper reports less than one percent of parental sulfur radioactivity and thirty percent or more of parental phosphorus. The denominator is parental radioactivity, not a count of labeled offspring. This supports DNA’s hereditary role in T2, without implying that every virus has a DNA genome.

cues.title: 一电子转移的记账
cues.caption: Na失去一个电子、Cl得到一个电子，总电子数不变。
cues.captionEn: Na loses one electron and Cl gains one; the total stays unchanged.
cues.zh: 先看教材的电子式。钠贡献一个价电子，氯接收它，形成正一价钠离子和负一价氯离子。下面的总数始终是二十八，电荷总和仍为零。移动的点只是把电子记账过程展开，不是说我们观测到了电子沿这条路线飞行。
cues.en: Start with the textbook’s Lewis representation. Sodium contributes one valence electron and chlorine receives it, producing positive sodium and negative chloride ions. The total remains twenty-eight electrons and zero net charge. The moving dot unfolds an accounting diagram; it does not claim an observed electron flight path.

cues.title: 吸引延伸到晶格
cues.caption: 氯化钠晶体里，一个Na⁺有六个最近Cl⁻邻居。
cues.captionEn: In a sodium chloride crystal, each Na⁺ has six nearest Cl⁻ neighbors.
cues.zh: 电子转移之后，不要把氯化钠想成彼此独立的小分子对。转动这个局部，可以找到钠离子周围六个最近的氯离子，分别在三条空间方向的两端。这样的邻接关系向晶体内部继续重复。画面只取一个局部，球的大小是为了看清结构。
cues.en: After electron transfer, do not picture solid sodium chloride as isolated molecular pairs. Rotate this local neighborhood: six nearest chloride ions lie at the positive and negative ends of three spatial directions around sodium. The pattern repeats through the crystal. This is a local view, with sphere sizes chosen for visibility.

cues.title: 两核共用一对电子
cues.caption: 两个Cl各提供一个电子，形成共用电子对。
cues.captionEn: Each Cl contributes an electron to a shared pair.
cues.zh: 再比较两个氯原子。它们吸引电子的能力相同，电子式把两个未成对电子画到两核之间，表示共用。各自原有的三对孤电子仍留在图中。氯分子由共价键联系，不能照搬前面钠离子与氯离子的完整得失电子图景。
cues.en: Now compare two chlorine atoms. Their attraction for electrons is equal, and the Lewis diagram brings their unpaired electrons into a shared pair. Each atom’s three lone pairs remain visible. A covalent bond joins the chlorine molecule; it should not be described by copying the complete transfer used for sodium and chloride ions.

cues.title: 共用可以不均匀
cues.caption: HCl仍是共用电子，但电子分布偏向Cl。
cues.captionEn: HCl still shares electrons, with the distribution biased toward Cl.
cues.zh: 把一个氯换成氢。氯对键合电子的吸引更强，所以教材把共用电子对画得偏向氯，并用德尔塔正、德尔塔负表示部分电性。这些符号不是正一和负一的离子电荷；共用与转移的理想图景必须分清。实际电荷分布比电子式更连续。
cues.en: Replace one chlorine with hydrogen. Chlorine attracts bonding electrons more strongly, so the shared pair is drawn toward chlorine. Delta plus and delta minus indicate partial charge, not the full plus-one and minus-one charges of separate ions. Lewis diagrams are idealized accounts; actual charge distributions are continuous.

cues.title: s与s：核间相连
cues.caption: 两个s型基函数重叠，核间方向没有π型节点。
cues.captionEn: Two s-shaped bases overlap without a pi-type node along the internuclear axis.
cues.zh: 从电子式转向空间分布。两个球对称的s型区域靠近，核间的剖面逐渐连接起来，这是教材氢分子s与s形成西格玛键的对称性图景。剖面由归一化函数计算，但采用简化高斯形状，不是氢分子的精密电子密度，更没有把重叠量直接当成键能。
cues.en: Move from Lewis accounting to a spatial picture. Two spherical s-shaped regions approach, and the density slice connects between their nuclei. This illustrates the sigma symmetry used for hydrogen in the textbook. Normalized Gaussian functions generate this teaching slice; it is not a precision hydrogen-molecule density or a calculation of bond energy.

cues.title: s与p：沿轴重叠
cues.caption: s区与一个p瓣沿核间轴相遇，仍属于σ型重叠。
cues.captionEn: An s region meets a p lobe along the internuclear axis: sigma-type overlap.
cues.zh: 保留s型区域，把另一侧换成有方向性的p型区域。只有朝向另一原子的一瓣在核间明显重叠，对面的另一瓣仍然存在。教材用氯化氢说明这种s与p的西格玛重叠。这里比较的是角向对称性，氯真实三p轨道的径向细节没有画进来。
cues.en: Keep the s region and replace the other side with a directional p shape. Its inward lobe overlaps between the nuclei, while the outward lobe remains. The textbook uses hydrogen chloride for this s–p sigma picture. We compare angular symmetry here; the radial details of chlorine’s real three-p orbital are omitted.

cues.title: 头碰头的p重叠
cues.caption: 两侧p瓣沿核间轴相对，形成σ型重叠。
cues.captionEn: Opposing p lobes meet end-on to give sigma-type overlap.
cues.zh: 现在两边都是p型区域，并把朝内的两瓣对齐。核间的密度剖面连续相连，教材用氯分子展示这种头碰头的西格玛重叠。s与s、s与p、p与p的外形不一样，但都围绕同一条核间轴保持西格玛型对称。
cues.en: Both sides now use p-shaped regions, with their inward lobes aligned. The slice connects between the nuclei, illustrating the end-on sigma picture used for chlorine. s–s, s–p and p–p differ in their component shapes, but each can have sigma symmetry about the same internuclear axis.

cues.title: 肩并肩与节点
cues.caption: π型分布在轴的两侧；包含核间轴的节点面密度为零。
cues.captionEn: Pi density lies on either side of the axis, with a nodal plane containing it.
cues.zh: 把两个p方向同时转到与核间轴垂直。重叠分成轴两侧的两块，中间留下节点面。沿着穿过两个原子核的虚线看，这个π型分布在节点处为零。上下两块不是两条独立的π键，而是同一个π型状态的两部分。
cues.en: Turn both p directions perpendicular to the internuclear axis. The overlap separates into two regions on opposite sides, leaving a nodal plane between them. Along the dashed line through both nuclei, this pi-type density is zero. The two regions are parts of one pi state, not two separate pi bonds.

cues.title: 方向改变，重叠改变
cues.caption: 仅转动一个p方向，重叠积分在相互垂直时变为零。
cues.captionEn: Rotate one p direction: the overlap integral reaches zero at orthogonality.
cues.zh: 最后固定一侧，只转动另一侧p方向。核间距没有改变，重叠积分却随着夹角减小，并在九十度时成为零。剖面中的函数仍然存在，消失的是两者的净重叠。这个边界说明空间取向有真实影响；它不是一条实际化学反应或扭转能量曲线。
cues.en: Keep one p direction fixed and turn the other. Nuclear separation stays constant, but the overlap integral decreases to zero at ninety degrees. Both functions still exist in the slice; it is their net overlap that vanishes. This boundary demonstrates the role of orientation, without claiming a reaction pathway or a molecular torsional-energy curve.

cues.title: 把生境记录放回湿地
cues.titleEn: Place habitat records in a wetland
cues.caption: 出现率描述记录分布，不等于生境面积。
cues.captionEn: Occurrence describes records, not habitat area.
cues.zh: 先读教材中的四种越冬水鸟资料。三个条带分别表示盐沼光滩、藨草带和鱼塘芦苇区，不是按真实距离画出的地图。百分比显示该种鸟在不同觅食生境中的出现记录。青脚鹬三个区域都有较多记录，绿头鸭则主要出现在第一种生境。不能把观察数量或条带宽度直接当成资源偏好。
cues.en: Read the textbook’s four wintering waterbirds across salt marsh and mudflat, sedge marsh, and ponds with reeds. The bands are habitat categories, not a distance-scaled map. Percentages describe occurrence records. Greenshank uses all three more broadly, while mallard records concentrate in the first. Observed counts alone do not establish resource preference.

cues.title: 相似生境，还要比较资源
cues.titleEn: Compare resources as well as habitat
cues.caption: 胃中检出物保留原分类，沙砾不当营养食物。
cues.captionEn: Retain content categories; grit is not nutritional food.
cues.zh: 绿翅鸭与鹤鹬的生境出现比例接近，但胃中检出物的组成不同。这里按教材保留小坚果、茎类、草屑、螺类、贝壳沙砾和甲壳类等分类。特别注意，沙砾不是营养食物，检出也不自动意味着主动偏好。生态位还包括活动时间、种间关系和其他资源，不能用一个栖息位置概括全部。
cues.en: Teal and spotted redshank have similar habitat occurrence patterns but different stomach contents. The original categories include nutlets, stems, plant fragments, snails, shells and grit, and crustaceans. Grit is not nutritional food, and detection does not automatically imply preference. A niche also includes timing, interactions and other resources, beyond a single habitat location.

cues.title: 回到自己的观察证据
cues.caption: 先记录时间、位置和行为，再提出解释。
cues.captionEn: Record time, place and behavior before interpretation.
cues.zh: 如果在本地调查，先确定对象、地点、时间和观察方法，再记录栖息位置、觅食行为与邻近生物。这是一份明确标注的观察示例，不是替你完成的实地调查。看到两只鸟在同处觅食，只能提出可能共享资源的线索，还要核查食物是否有限。探索中的个人日志从空白开始，不需要干扰动物去复制胃内容物研究。
cues.en: For a local investigation, define the organism, place, time and method before recording habitat, foraging and nearby organisms. This is a labeled example, not a completed field survey. Two birds feeding nearby suggest possible resource sharing, but scarcity still needs evidence. Personal notes begin blank and do not require disturbing animals to reproduce stomach-content research.

cues.title: 取样体积先保持一致
cues.caption: 直径5 cm、深5 cm的土样约为98 mL。
cues.captionEn: A 5 cm diameter, 5 cm deep core is about 98 mL.
cues.zh: 先看取样器进入土层，再把同一柱土壤取出。直径五厘米、深五厘米，体积由圆柱公式算得约九十八毫升，教材取近似值一百毫升。比较样地时，体积、深度、时间和重复方法要一致，还要保留地点和环境记录。被取出的土没有在原处继续复制一份，空缺与样本对应。
cues.en: Follow the sampler into the soil and then lift the same core out. A five-centimeter diameter and depth gives roughly ninety-eight milliliters, rounded to about one hundred in the textbook. Comparisons need consistent volume, depth, timing and replication, plus site records. The removed core corresponds to the remaining hole rather than being duplicated.

cues.title: 沿真实通路采集
cues.caption: 热与干燥响应使部分动物向下，采集量仍有偏差。
cues.captionEn: Heat and drying drive downward movement, with detection bias.
cues.zh: 土样放在网孔上方，和容器壁之间保留空气流通的空隙。灯带来的升温和干燥，使有相应反应的小动物逐渐向下，经网孔、漏斗和窄颈进入收集管。跟住同一个体，通路连续，也没有穿过器壁。不同类群反应不同，所以收集到多少，还受到装置与时间影响，不能宣布已经找到全部物种。
cues.en: The soil sample rests above mesh with space for airflow around it. Warming and drying encourage responsive animals to move down through openings, funnel and neck into the collector. Follow persistent individuals along the continuous path. Responses differ among groups, so method and duration affect detection; collection is not a guaranteed inventory of every species.

cues.title: 动物入口和空气出口分开
cues.titleEn: Separate animal intake from air outlet
cues.caption: 动物进入收集瓶，出气口纱网只让空气通过。
cues.captionEn: Animals enter the vial; air crosses the outlet screen.
cues.zh: 另一个采集工具是吸虫器。示意图改用手动气源，吸入管伸进收集瓶，另一根带纱网的管连接气源。观察小动物沿吸入管进入瓶内，而蓝色示踪表示空气经过纱网排出。动物不应穿过滤网进入气源。大、小个体可以选不同采集方法，但方法与检出限制必须记录。
cues.en: The aspirator has a separate intake and screened air outlet. This reconstruction uses a hand pump. The specimen follows the intake into the vial, while blue tracers show air crossing the screen toward the pump. Animals remain in the vial. Different sizes may require different collection methods, whose detection limits should be recorded.

cues.title: 个体数与类群数分开
cues.caption: 18个个体分为3个记录组，不声称已确定3个物种。
cues.captionEn: Eighteen specimens form three recorded groups, not three proven species.
cues.zh: 把同一土样中收集到的个体按可观察特征整理。示例有八个螨类、六个跳虫类和四个待鉴定对象，共十八个个体，分成三个记录组。宽泛类群不等于已确定的物种；暂时认不出，就保留待鉴定标签和特征记录。个人计数从空白开始，缺测不写成零，后续鉴定可能改变分类。
cues.en: Sort specimens from the same sample using observable features. The example contains eight mites, six springtails and four unresolved specimens: eighteen individuals in three recorded groups. Broad groups are not established species identities. Keep unresolved labels and feature notes until identification improves. Personal counts start blank, and missing observations are not zero.

cues.title: 从缺少土壤的起点开始
cues.caption: 定居者改变基底，后来的植物逐渐获得条件。
cues.captionEn: Colonizers modify the substrate for later plants.
cues.zh: 在裸岩起点，先看微小定居者和土壤条件逐渐变化，再看草本、灌木和乔木获得生长条件。画面压缩了漫长过程，时间没有伪装成统一年限。后来的优势植物出现，也不意味着地衣、苔藓和草本全部消失。它们改变环境，环境又改变不同植物的机会，群落随之更替。
cues.en: At the bare-rock starting point, colonizers and substrate conditions change before herbs, shrubs and trees establish. The compressed process has no universal timetable. Later dominance does not require all earlier organisms to disappear. Organisms modify conditions, which then change opportunities for other organisms, producing community succession.

cues.title: 土壤与繁殖体没有清零
cues.caption: 原有基底保留，恢复的起点不同。
cues.captionEn: Retained substrate changes the starting conditions.
cues.zh: 再看次生演替。虽然地上植被受到扰动，土壤以及部分种子或地下繁殖体仍可能保留。图中地下的繁殖体和现成土层从一开始就存在，所以恢复过程与裸岩起点不同。这不是简单把同一张动画播放得更快，而是给同一模型不同的初始条件。具体恢复还取决于扰动和迁入机会。
cues.en: Secondary succession can retain soil and some seeds or underground propagules despite disturbance above ground. Those initial reserves are visible from the start. Recovery differs from the bare-rock case because the same model begins with different conditions, not because the identical animation is simply sped up. Actual recovery also depends on disturbance and colonization.

cues.title: 终点也受环境约束
cues.caption: 干燥条件下，不能把森林规定为必然终点。
cues.captionEn: Dry conditions do not imply an inevitable forest.
cues.zh: 最后降低水分适宜程度。即使基底逐渐改变，乔木的建立仍会受到环境限制。演替不必走向森林，也没有适用于所有地点的固定顺序。探索时分别改变土壤保留与水分条件，看同一模型怎样给出不同结果。这些形状和系数用于解释机制，不能直接预报某个真实样地多少年后会出现哪些物种。
cues.en: Lower moisture suitability. Even as the substrate changes, tree establishment remains constrained by conditions. Succession need not end in a forest or follow one fixed sequence everywhere. Changing retained soil and moisture tests distinct assumptions in the same model. Its forms and coefficients explain mechanisms rather than forecasting species and dates at a real site.

cues.title: 结构改变，散射怎样回应？
cues.titleEn: How does scattering respond to structure?
cues.caption: 固定证据，改变候选结构；散射图不是分子照片。
cues.captionEn: Keep the evidence fixed; change the structural candidate.
cues.zh: 先留下两条历史结构线索：沿轴的短间隔，和更长的重复周期。下面这幅是教学计算，不是原始照片。把直链卷成螺旋，再改变转角，散射分布跟着变，重复高度也会改变。候选结构必须接受同一份证据的检验。不过，衍射图不是分子照片；即使有螺旋线索，也还读不出每一处碱基和化学连接。
cues.en: Keep two historical structural clues: a short axial spacing and a longer repeat. The pattern below is a teaching calculation, not the original photograph. Curl straight strands into helices and change their twist: both scattering and repeat height change. Each candidate faces the same evidence. Yet diffraction is not a molecular photograph; it does not reveal every base or chemical connection.

cues.title: 总量没变，配对却变了
cues.caption: 同一批碱基换位置，计数不变，接触未必对应。
cues.captionEn: Reordering the same bases preserves totals, not local matches.
cues.zh: 看这段教学序列：两条链合起来，A和T一样多，G和C一样多。现在跟住下方这六个碱基，只换位置，不换身份。计数柱没有动，有些对应位置却变错了。所以总量相等是线索，还不是逐位配对的解释。再只看上面一条链，它自己的A和T就不必相等。下一步，要把化学接触的位置也拿来检验。
cues.en: In this teaching duplex, total A equals T and total G equals C. Follow the six bases below as they change positions without changing identity. The counts stay fixed, yet some facing positions become mismatched. Equal totals are a clue, not an explanation of local pairing. Either individual strand need not have equal A and T. We must also test the sites that make chemical contact.

cues.title: 接触位置决定标准搭档
cues.titleEn: Contact sites constrain the standard partner
cues.caption: 环数相同，接触位点却未必对应。
cues.captionEn: Same ring count; different contact sites.
cues.zh: 一双环加一单环，为什么A不能随便配C？把朝内的化学位置展开。A上带氢的氮，对着T的氧；T上的氮氢，又对着A能接受氢键的位置。氢仍连在原来的氮上。换成C，在这个标准配准里，两处变成供体对供体、受体对受体。换回T，接触恢复；G与C则有三处。现在跟住这些配对，把它们放回完整双螺旋：骨架在外，配对在内，还要同时符合前面的周期和组成线索。保留这一处A，它的标准搭档应该是谁？
cues.en: Two rings plus one: why can A not take C instead? Look at the inward-facing sites. A’s nitrogen-bound hydrogen faces T’s oxygen; T’s N–H faces an accepting nitrogen on A. Each hydrogen stays bonded to its original nitrogen. Replace T with C: in this fixed standard alignment, donor faces donor and acceptor faces acceptor. Restore T and both contacts return; G with C has three. Follow these pairs into a complete double helix: backbones outside, pairs inside, also constrained by the earlier repeat and composition. Keep this A. Which standard partner fits?

cues.title: 沿骨架追踪一条连续路径
cues.caption: 沿链是共价骨架，跨链才是配对氢键。
cues.captionEn: Covalent bonds along strands; hydrogen bonds across.
cues.zh: 碱基之间的氢键，不是沿一条链前进的骨架。看这个糖：碱基接在一撇碳，二撇位置的氢提醒我们这是脱氧核糖。沿三撇氧追下去，经过磷酸，到下一个糖的五撇一侧，一条连续的共价路径就连起来了。现在横着看，两条链之间才是碱基配对的氢键。这里检验连接关系，没有演示核苷酸聚合反应。
cues.en: Hydrogen bonds between bases are not the backbone along a strand. A base attaches to the sugar’s one-prime carbon; hydrogen at two-prime identifies deoxyribose. Follow the three-prime oxygen through phosphate to the next sugar’s five-prime side: a continuous covalent path. Across the strands are the pairing hydrogen bonds. This tests connectivity, without depicting the polymerization reaction.

cues.title: 相同字母，不等于相同方向
cues.titleEn: Matching letters do not fix direction
cues.caption: 5′到3′是化学方向，转动视角也不变。
cues.captionEn: Chemical directions survive a change of view.
cues.zh: 配对字母都对上，方向就一定对吗？先把两条链都标成五撇走向三撇：这个同向方案没有通过结构检验。保持碱基对应，改成反向平行。沿一条骨架从五撇追到三撇，另一条链的化学方向正好相反。转动观察方向，端点身份和连接顺序仍保留；五撇和三撇不是屏幕的左和右。
cues.en: If the letters match, must the directions be right? Label both strands five-prime to three-prime in the same direction: this arrangement fails the structural test. Keep the paired positions but make the strands antiparallel. Tracing five-prime to three-prime along one backbone now opposes the other. Changing our viewpoint preserves the end identities and connections; prime labels do not mean screen left and right.

cues.title: 从实测空间，走向互补预测
cues.titleEn: From measured structure to a prediction
cues.caption: 保留同一条链，预测另一条的序列与方向。
cues.captionEn: Keep one strand; predict its partner and direction.
cues.zh: 现在看后来实测的结构：这是1981年的十二碱基对DNA，不是1953年的原始模型。转动它，沿外侧两条连续骨架往下追，内侧的碱基成对堆叠，还能看见宽窄不同的沟槽。突出的一对使用实测氮氧坐标。最后，保留同一条链，把对面的搭档暂时藏起。按标准互补关系，就能预测它的序列和方向。这个结构线索启发复制设想，但不是复制反应本身。
cues.en: Now inspect a later measured structure: twelve DNA base pairs from 1981, not the original 1953 model. Rotate it and follow the continuous outer backbones, stacked inward-facing pairs and unequal grooves. The highlighted contact uses measured nitrogen and oxygen coordinates. Keep one strand and hide its partners. Standard complementary contacts predict the opposing sequence and direction. This structural clue suggests copying, but does not demonstrate the replication reaction.

cues.title: 四个方向展开
cues.caption: 甲烷四个C—H方向指向正四面体顶点。
cues.captionEn: Methane’s four C–H directions point to tetrahedral vertices.
cues.zh: 先转动甲烷球棍模型。四个氢不在同一平面上，而是指向正四面体的四个顶点。任取两个碳氢方向，夹角约一百零九点四七度。纸上画成十字的结构式只是连接记录，不表示四个键在同一平面成九十度。
cues.en: Rotate the methane model. Its four hydrogens are not coplanar: they point toward the vertices of a tetrahedron. Any pair of carbon–hydrogen directions makes an angle of about one hundred nine point four seven degrees. A cross-shaped drawing records connectivity, not four planar right angles.

cues.title: 连接两个四面体中心
cues.caption: 乙烷有六个C—Hσ键和一个C—Cσ键。
cues.captionEn: Ethane contains six C–H sigma bonds and one C–C sigma bond.
cues.zh: 接上第二个碳。每个碳仍有四个成键方向：一个连接另一碳，另外三个连接氢。逐条数下来，六个碳氢键加一个碳碳键，共七个西格玛键。球的位置和棍的端点由同一套坐标生成，转动后连接不会变。
cues.en: Add a second carbon. Each carbon retains four bonding directions: one toward the other carbon and three toward hydrogen. Six carbon–hydrogen bonds plus one carbon–carbon bond give seven sigma bonds. The atom positions and stick endpoints share one coordinate model, so rotating the view cannot change connectivity.

cues.title: 双键与同一平面
cues.titleEn: A double bond and a plane
cues.caption: 乙烯六个原子共面，具有5个σ键和1个π键。
cues.captionEn: All six ethene atoms are coplanar, with five sigma bonds and one pi bond.
cues.zh: 观察乙烯从侧向转入正面。六个原子在同一平面内，理想键角约一百二十度。四个碳氢键加上碳碳之间一个西格玛键，总共五个西格玛键；双键里还有一个派键。透明的两块只标示这一个派键的空间方向，不是两条额外的键。
cues.en: Watch ethene turn from an edge view toward its plane. All six atoms are coplanar, with idealized angles near one hundred twenty degrees. Four carbon–hydrogen bonds and one carbon–carbon sigma bond make five sigma bonds; the double bond also contains one pi bond. The two translucent regions mark that one pi direction, not two extra bonds.

cues.title: 三键与相互垂直的π方向
cues.titleEn: A triple bond and two pi directions
cues.caption: 乙炔为直线形：3个σ键，加2个相互垂直的π方向。
cues.captionEn: Ethyne is linear: three sigma bonds and two perpendicular pi directions.
cues.zh: 再减少两个氢，得到乙炔的直线模型。两个碳和两个氢在同一直线上，碳碳三键由一个西格玛键与两个派键组成。现在两组透明区域相互垂直。计入两端的碳氢键，整个分子共有三个西格玛键、两个派键。
cues.en: Remove two more hydrogens to reach the linear ethyne model. Both carbons and both hydrogens lie along one line. The carbon–carbon triple bond contains one sigma bond and two pi bonds, whose guide regions are mutually perpendicular. Including the terminal carbon–hydrogen bonds gives three sigma bonds and two pi bonds in total.

cues.title: 不同摆法能否重合
cues.caption: 二氯甲烷的六种顶点选法，可以靠空间旋转相互重合。
cues.captionEn: The six choices of chlorine vertices in dichloromethane superpose by spatial rotation.
cues.zh: 把甲烷的两个氢换成氯，四个顶点中选两个共有六种画法。让每一种选择经过刚体旋转，氯的位置都能与同一参考摆法重合。旋转没有断键、没有交换原子种类，所以这些不是六种不同的二氯甲烷。平面纸上的上下左右，不能直接当作四面体的不同异构体。
cues.en: Replace two methane hydrogens with chlorine. Choosing two of four vertices gives six drawings. A rigid spatial rotation brings every choice onto the same reference arrangement. No bond breaks and no atom changes identity during alignment. These are not six different dichloromethanes: directions on flat paper do not define distinct tetrahedral isomers.

cues.title: 相同分子式，不同连接
cues.caption: 正丁烷与异丁烷都为C₄H₁₀，碳骨架的连接不同。
cues.captionEn: Butane and isobutane both have formula C₄H₁₀, but different carbon connections.
cues.zh: 把四个碳连接成一条链，再比较中央碳连出三个分支的结构。两者都能补足十个氢，都是碳四氢十；但碳与碳的邻接关系不同。无论怎样转动球棍模型，都不能只靠旋转把一条四碳链变成三分支连接。这才是结构上的区别。
cues.en: Connect four carbons in a chain, then compare a central carbon joined to three carbon branches. Both structures complete their valences with ten hydrogens, giving C four H ten. Their carbon adjacency differs, however. Rotating the model cannot turn the four-carbon chain into a three-branch connection. That is a structural difference.

cues.title: 让碳四价约束结构
cues.titleEn: Let carbon valence constrain the graph
cues.caption: 改变连法、键级或闭环时，氢数必须随碳四价一起改变。
cues.captionEn: Connectivity, bond order and ring closure change the hydrogen count required by carbon valence.
cues.zh: 最后把问题转成连接图。每个碳的键级总和必须是四，剩下的位置才由氢补足。加入双键或者闭成一环，都可能得到碳四氢八；加入三键则得到这里的碳四氢六示例。这几种结构用于练习检查，并没有穷尽所有四碳烃。先核对连法与价数，再讨论分子式和是否同分异构。
cues.en: Finish with a connectivity graph. The bond-order sum at each carbon must reach four, with hydrogens completing the remaining valence. A double bond or a ring can give C four H eight; the triple-bond example gives C four H six. These are practice examples, not an exhaustive list of four-carbon hydrocarbons. Check connections and valence before comparing formulas and isomerism.

cues.title: 沿食物链读取年能量
cues.titleEn: Read annual energy along the food chain
cues.caption: 固定与同化的能量，沿营养级逐级减少。
cues.captionEn: Fixed and assimilated energy decreases across trophic levels.
cues.zh: 湖泊里，生产者固定太阳能，植食性动物取食，肉食性动物再获得其中的一部分。先认清三个数字：四百六十四点六、六十二点八和十二点六，单位都是焦每平方厘米每年。这是教材呈现的历史湖泊研究资料，不是画面新测出的结果。动物的数值指同化能量，不能把吃下但未吸收的全部食物都算进去。
cues.en: Producers fix solar energy; herbivores feed on them, and carnivores obtain a smaller share. Read the three annual values: 464.6, 62.8 and 12.6 joules per square centimeter. These are the textbook’s historical lake data, not new measurements made by the animation. Consumer values describe assimilation, excluding ingested material that was never absorbed.

cues.title: 同一份能量去了哪里
cues.titleEn: Account for the same energy input
cues.caption: 呼吸、传递、分解者利用和本期未利用分别记账。
cues.captionEn: Separate respiration, transfer, decomposition and unused energy.
cues.zh: 依次打开三个营养级的收支。横条始终表示同一级的输入，颜色分开下一营养级、呼吸散失、分解者利用和本期未利用。未利用不等于全部变成热。肉食性动物的分解者去向，教材只标微量；我们保留微量标签和零点一的取整余项，不把它伪装成精确测量。
cues.en: Inspect each trophic level’s budget. Its bar partitions the same input into transfer, respiration, decomposer use and energy unused during the accounting interval. Unused does not mean all converted to heat. The carnivore diagram labels decomposer flow only as trace. The display preserves that label and the 0.1 residual instead of inventing a precise measured flow.

cues.title: 分母必须是前一级
cues.titleEn: Use the preceding level as denominator
cues.caption: 两次传递约为13.5%和20.1%，不是固定常数。
cues.captionEn: The two transfers are about 13.5% and 20.1%, not constants.
cues.zh: 用后一级同化量除以前一级同化量，得到约百分之十三点五和百分之二十点一。常见的百分之十到二十是概括，不能当成强行截断数据的法律。再把整个系统的呼吸、分解者利用和未利用相加，保留微量与取整差，能量账目才闭合。能量经过系统，持续有一部分以热散失。
cues.en: Divide each receiving level’s assimilation by the preceding level’s assimilation: about 13.5 and 20.1 percent. The familiar ten-to-twenty-percent range is a generalization, not a rule for clipping data. Add respiration, decomposer use, unused energy and the small residual across the system. This closes the accounting while preserving the continual dissipation of energy as heat.

cues.title: 关系图要有证据来源
cues.titleEn: Give food-web links an evidence source
cues.caption: 观察、访谈和推测，不能混成同一种证据。
cues.captionEn: Observation, interviews and hypotheses are distinct evidence.
cues.zh: 调查本地农田、池塘或校园，先记地点时间，再辨认生产者与消费者。图中逐条出现的是练习资料：实线表示有记录或访谈支持，虚线仍待核实。看到昆虫和鸟同时出现，并不能直接证明取食关系。探索时，自己的图从未核实状态开始；记录食物来源和证据，却不会自动生成不存在的能量测量值。
cues.en: For a local farm, pond or campus, record place and time before identifying producers and consumers. This example adds links one by one. Solid links have recorded or interview support; dashed links still require verification. Seeing insects and birds together does not establish feeding. Your own map begins unverified and never manufactures energy measurements from food-web relationships.

cues.title: 继续利用有机物中的能量
cues.caption: 养分可以回田，能量仍单向经过系统。
cues.captionEn: Nutrients can return to fields; energy flows through the system.
cues.zh: 调查还要问秸秆、饲料和有机废物怎样处理。示意路径把作物、牲畜和有机物处理联系起来，部分有机物还可以继续供能。灰色回路表示养分回到田地，不能把它讲成能量循环。具体建议必须结合现场记录、成本和农户需求，和受访者讨论后再修改；这个路径只是分析思路，不是已经完成的实地方案。
cues.en: Ask how straw, feed and organic wastes are handled. The example connects crops, livestock and organic treatment, allowing further use of remaining organic energy. The gray return path represents nutrients returning to fields, not energy cycling back. Recommendations require local records, costs and discussions with participants. This diagram is an analytical example, not a completed field plan.

cues.title: 跟住同一个碳标记
cues.caption: 光合、取食、呼吸和分解转移碳，标记不凭空产生。
cues.captionEn: Photosynthesis, feeding, respiration and decomposition transfer carbon.
cues.zh: 跟住加深的碳点。空气中的碳进入植物有机物，植物碳可以经取食进入动物；动物和植物的呼吸又把部分碳送回空气。凋落物进入土壤，分解也能释放二氧化碳。十二个标记始终保留身份，转移中的也计入总数。它们代表普通碳元素，不是同位素示踪实验，也不是完整二氧化碳分子。
cues.en: Follow the highlighted carbon label. Atmospheric carbon enters plant organic matter, feeding transfers plant carbon to animals, and respiration returns some carbon to the air. Litter enters soil, where decomposition can also release carbon dioxide. All twelve labels retain their identities, including those in transit. They represent ordinary carbon, not isotope tracers or intact carbon-dioxide molecules.

cues.title: 交换与化石碳释放分开
cues.caption: 海气可以双向交换，燃烧把储存的碳送入空气。
cues.captionEn: Ocean and air exchange carbon; burning releases stored fossil carbon.
cues.zh: 再看海洋、空气和化石碳储库。相反方向的标记同时交换时，可以没有净增加；释放化石碳则让原来储存的两个标记进入空气。没有创造新的碳，改变的是碳所在的储库。这些点数只是守恒示意，不按真实储库规模或时间比例绘制。探索时关闭燃烧，再和原来的结果比较。
cues.en: Now compare ocean, atmosphere and fossil-carbon reservoirs. Equal opposite exchanges can occur without net accumulation. Releasing fossil carbon transfers two previously stored labels into the atmosphere. Carbon is not created; its location changes. Label counts do not represent real reservoir sizes or timescales. Turn off fossil release in exploration and compare the resulting atmospheric count.

cues.title: 摄入与排出共同决定积累
cues.caption: 体内负荷取决于进入与排出的差，不能只看食物链。
cues.captionEn: Body burden depends on uptake minus elimination.
cues.zh: 污染物和碳循环要分开理解。这里用一个持久性污染物的封闭模型：水和鱼之间转移的总量始终为二十四微克。鱼体颜色与浓度随摄入增加，排出也把一部分送回水中。改变排出系数，就能改变积累程度。数值是说明机制的假设，不能当作真实湖泊、特定农药或人体的风险预测。
cues.en: Consider a separate closed model of a persistent contaminant. Water and fish share a conserved total of twenty-four micrograms. Body color and concentration change as uptake adds material and elimination returns some to water. Changing elimination changes accumulation. These parameters explain a mechanism; they are not measurements or risk predictions for a real lake, pesticide or person.

cues.title: 累计摄食后再比较浓度
cues.caption: 保留量除以体重，才得到消费者浓度。
cues.captionEn: Divide retained burden by body mass to obtain concentration.
cues.zh: 每份食物先到达鱼口，再把对应污染物计入摄食量。累计十千克食物，每千克含二微克；保留八成，共十六微克。以给定的一千克消费者体重计算，浓度是每千克十六微克，高于食物。若保留很少，浓度也可以更低，所以营养级放大取决于物质与生物过程，不能宣称所有污染物都必然放大。
cues.en: Each portion reaches the mouth before its contaminant enters the ingestion total. Ten kilograms of cumulative food at two micrograms per kilogram supplies twenty micrograms. Retaining eighty percent leaves sixteen. Dividing by the specified one-kilogram consumer mass gives sixteen micrograms per kilogram. Low retention can instead produce a lower concentration. Magnification depends on the substance and biological processes, not merely trophic position.

cues.title: 标记DNA，再提取分析
cues.caption: ¹⁵N和¹⁴N是稳定同位素，DNA在密度梯度中形成平衡条带。
cues.captionEn: Nitrogen-15 and nitrogen-14 are stable isotopes; extracted DNA forms equilibrium density bands.
cues.zh: 先在重氮培养条件下培养大肠杆菌，让DNA获得重标记。提取DNA，再放入氯化铯密度梯度中分析。它会停在与自身浮力密度相等的位置，重的更靠下，轻的更靠上。这里不是把细菌沉到管底，也不是检测放射性：氮十五和氮十四都是稳定同位素。
cues.en: Grow E. coli in heavy nitrogen to label its DNA, then extract the DNA for cesium chloride density-gradient analysis. It bands where its buoyant density matches the surrounding solution. Heavier DNA lies lower. These are not bacterial pellets or radioactivity measurements: nitrogen fifteen and fourteen are stable isotopes.

cues.title: 第一代，检验全保留
cues.titleEn: The first generation tests conservative copying
cues.caption: 第一代只有中间带，不符合全保留复制预期的重、轻两带。
cues.captionEn: One intermediate band after one generation contradicts the heavy-plus-light conservative prediction.
cues.zh: 转到轻氮培养基，完成一代复制。教材给出的结果只有一条中间密度带。若全保留复制成立，原来的两条重链仍在一个分子里，另一个分子全新，应该分别出现重带和轻带。把这份预测与实际观察并列，就能看出第一代排除了哪一种解释。
cues.en: Transfer the cells to light nitrogen and allow one generation. The textbook reports one intermediate-density band. Conservative replication instead predicts an intact heavy duplex plus a wholly new light duplex, giving two separate bands. Comparing that prediction with the observation reveals what the first generation rules out.

cues.title: 第二代，出现中间与轻带
cues.titleEn: Two bands appear in the second generation
cues.caption: 第二代中间带与轻带并存，符合半保留复制的分配。
cues.captionEn: Intermediate and light bands coexist after two generations, as semiconservative copying predicts.
cues.zh: 再复制一代。每条旧链都成为模板，配上一条新链。第二代四个分子中，两个仍各有一条最初的重链，另外两个完全是轻链。因此出现中间带和轻带，理想同步模型里两类各占一半。画面是由分子组成推导的教学条带，不是把示意图当成原始扫描记录。
cues.en: After another replication, each old strand templates a new partner. Of four duplexes, two retain one original heavy strand and two are entirely light. This predicts intermediate and light bands, each representing half the ideal synchronized population. The displayed bands are a reconstruction derived from molecular composition, not original scans.

cues.title: 扩展检验：逐段混合
cues.caption: 分散复制可产生第一代中间带，但第二代预期仍为一条更轻的混合带。
cues.captionEn: Dispersive copying can give an intermediate first-generation band but predicts one lighter mixed band next.
cues.zh: 再加一个明确标为扩展的对照。假设旧物质分散到每条子链的许多片段里，第一代也可能出现中间带；第一代并不能独自排除所有其他方案。但第二代按这个简单分散模型仍只有一条向轻端移动的带，与中间带加轻带不同。关键是让不同假说给出可以区分的预测。
cues.en: Add an explicit extension: suppose old material is dispersed among segments of every daughter strand. That model can also produce one intermediate band initially. In the second generation, however, the simple dispersive model still gives one band shifted toward light density, rather than separate intermediate and light bands. Competing explanations must make distinguishable predictions.

cues.title: 两条重链始终可追踪
cues.caption: A、B两条原有重链不增加，含重标记的分子比例下降。
cues.captionEn: Original heavy strands A and B do not multiply; their fraction among duplexes falls.
cues.zh: 给最初的两条重链分别记上A和B。第一代两种分子都带一条重链，第二代只剩一半，第三代只剩四分之一。跟住A和B，它们各自只出现一次。变化的是新合成的轻链和分子总数，不是重标记凭空消失，也不是把每条旧链直接复制成另一条重链。
cues.en: Label the original heavy strands A and B. Both first-generation duplexes contain one; half do in generation two, and a quarter in generation three. Follow A and B: each remains present once. New light strands and the total duplex count increase; the original labels neither vanish nor create additional heavy strands.

cues.title: 解开母链，提供起始端
cues.titleEn: Open templates and provide a starting end
cues.caption: 两条母链作为模板，DNA聚合酶需要已有的引物起始端。
cues.captionEn: Both parental strands act as templates; DNA polymerase requires a primer end.
cues.zh: 现在换到机制示意，不再是离心实验的直接观察。沿解开的母链查看互补字母，紫色符号代表RNA引物。DNA聚合酶不能从空白处直接起始，它需要已有的三撇羟基端。这里只画内部的一段DNA，并把引物与片段长度大幅压缩，好让方向和连接关系清楚可见。
cues.en: Switch to a mechanism diagram, not a direct view from the centrifugation experiment. Follow complementary letters on the separated templates. Purple symbols represent RNA primers. DNA polymerase requires an existing three-prime hydroxyl end rather than starting from nothing. This internal DNA window compresses primer and fragment lengths to clarify direction and connections.

cues.title: 两边都只从5′向3′延伸
cues.titleEn: Both sides extend only from 5′ to 3′
cues.caption: 一侧连续延伸，另一侧先分段合成；合成方向都为5′到3′。
cues.captionEn: One side extends continuously and the other in fragments; both synthesize 5′ to 3′.
cues.zh: 看两侧的箭头。新链都按五撇到三撇方向延伸，可是两条模板方向相反。因此一个新链能跟着复制叉连续延长，另一个要先形成短片段。每段仍然是五撇到三撇，并没有一台聚合酶反向合成三撇到五撇。模板先解开，互补原料才能接到新链的生长端。
cues.en: Watch both arrows. New DNA always extends five-prime to three-prime, but the templates oppose. One strand can grow continuously with the fork; the other is assembled as short fragments. Each fragment still grows five-prime to three-prime. No polymerase in this diagram synthesizes DNA in the reverse chemical direction.

cues.title: 替换引物，再连接骨架
cues.titleEn: Replace primers and join the backbone
cues.caption: RNA引物被DNA替换，缺口连接；每个子代保留一条母链。
cues.captionEn: DNA replaces RNA primers and nicks are joined; each daughter retains one parental strand.
cues.zh: 最后紫色引物退出，由DNA补上，片段之间的缺口再连接起来。每一条子代双链都保留了一条蓝色母链，并配上一条新链。这里展示的是复制完成后的理想关系，真实细胞还依赖校对、修复和多种调控，不能把互补配对理解为永远不会发生错误。
cues.en: Finally, RNA primers are replaced with DNA and remaining nicks are joined. Each completed daughter duplex contains one blue parental strand and one new strand. This is the ideal completed relationship. Actual cells also depend on proofreading, repair and regulation; complementary pairing does not imply an absolute absence of errors.

cues.title: 先确定核间距离
cues.caption: 同一比例下，H₂与Cl₂的核间距离不同。
cues.captionEn: At one scale, H₂ and Cl₂ have different bond lengths.
cues.zh: 先搭最简单的双原子模型。氢气的核间距离取教材七十四皮米，氯气取一百九十八皮米。两幅模型保持同一比例，不能为了铺满画面把每个分子单独放大。球的大小用于辨认元素，键长则由球心之间的距离表示。
cues.en: Begin with two-atom models. The textbook gives hydrogen a bond length of seventy-four picometers and chlorine one hundred ninety-eight. Both use the same scale. Sphere sizes identify elements; the distance between their centers represents bond length.

cues.title: 两个方向彼此远离
cues.caption: CO₂的两个成键区域沿相反方向排列。
cues.captionEn: CO₂ has two bonding regions pointing in opposite directions.
cues.zh: 二氧化碳的碳与两个氧相连。虽然各画了两根棍，碳周围仍只有两个成键方向，而不是四个方向。按价层电子对互斥的近似图景，两个区域彼此远离，形成一百八十度的直线骨架。数电子对区域时，一个多重键整体作为一个方向。
cues.en: Carbon dioxide has two oxygens attached to carbon. Each double bond is drawn with two sticks, but there are still only two bonding directions around carbon. Treating each multiple bond as one region gives a linear arrangement, with a one-hundred-eighty-degree angle.

cues.title: 三个方向展开成平面
cues.caption: 甲醛的三个成键区域近似平面三角形。
cues.captionEn: Formaldehyde’s three bonding regions are approximately trigonal planar.
cues.zh: 甲醛的碳连接一个氧和两个氢，形成三个电子对区域。三个方向展开在同一平面，理想化夹角取一百二十度。这里保留双键的标记，却没有把双键算成两个区域。真实甲醛的几个键角会略有不同，不能把理想骨架当作精密测量。
cues.en: Formaldehyde has one oxygen and two hydrogens attached to carbon, giving three electron regions. Their ideal arrangement is planar, with angles of one hundred twenty degrees. The double bond remains one region. Real formaldehyde angles differ slightly, so this ideal framework is not a precision measurement.

cues.title: 四个方向走进空间
cues.caption: 甲烷的四个成键方向组成正四面体。
cues.captionEn: Methane’s four bonding directions form a tetrahedron.
cues.zh: 再增加到四个方向，平面十字就不是最合适的空间排列。转动甲烷，四个氢分布在正四面体的顶点。任取两个碳氢方向，夹角约一百零九度二十八分。虚线只是帮助看清顶点关系，不是氢与氢之间多出了化学键。
cues.en: With four directions, a flat cross no longer describes the spatial arrangement. Rotate methane to see four hydrogens at tetrahedral vertices. Each pair of carbon–hydrogen directions makes an angle near one hundred nine degrees and twenty-eight minutes. Dashed edges reveal the geometry; they are not additional hydrogen–hydrogen bonds.

cues.title: 四气球的几何类比
cues.caption: 四个等大气球围绕同一束口，呈四面体式分布。
cues.captionEn: Four equal balloons share a tied neck and spread tetrahedrally.
cues.zh: 教材还让我们把四个大小相近的气球束在一起。四个方向分散在空间，帮助理解为什么不必挤在同一平面。这里的气球表面按固定几何轮廓绘制，束口始终相连。这个类比展示占据空间的方向，不是电子的真实形状，也没有计算橡胶的弹性。
cues.en: The textbook also ties four similarly sized balloons together. Their directions spread through space instead of lying in one plane. The tied neck stays connected as the view turns. This fixed geometric analogy shows spatial occupancy, not electron shape or a simulation of rubber elasticity.

cues.title: 一对孤电子对保留空间
cues.titleEn: One lone pair still occupies space
cues.caption: NH₃有四个电子对区域，但原子骨架是三角锥。
cues.captionEn: NH₃ has four electron regions, but a trigonal-pyramidal atomic framework.
cues.zh: 氨的氮周围有三个成键区域和一对孤电子对。棕色轮廓标记孤电子对占据的方向，它不是第四个氢原子。只看原子核，三个氢形成底面，氮位于其上，得到三角锥。图中一百零七度来自教材给定的近似值，不是互斥模型自动算出的精确角度。
cues.en: Ammonia has three bonding regions and one lone pair around nitrogen. The brown outline marks the lone-pair direction, not a fourth hydrogen. Considering only nuclei gives a trigonal pyramid. The displayed one-hundred-seven-degree angle is a textbook input, not an exact prediction calculated by VSEPR.

cues.title: 两对孤电子对留下折线
cues.titleEn: Two lone pairs leave a bent framework
cues.caption: 水有四个电子对区域，两个O—H方向形成折线。
cues.captionEn: Water has four electron regions; its two O–H directions form a bend.
cues.zh: 水分子在氧周围留下两个成键区域和两对孤电子对。电子对区域总数还是四，原子核却只形成一条折线。教材模型采用一百零五度和九十六皮米。淡色孤电子对轮廓只是方向标记，分子形状由氧核和氢核的位置命名，不能把四个电子区域都当成四个原子。
cues.en: Water has two bonding regions and two lone pairs around oxygen. There are still four electron regions, but the nuclei form a bent shape. This textbook model uses one hundred five degrees and ninety-six picometers. The pale lobes mark lone-pair directions; molecular shape is named from the nuclei.

cues.title: 有极性键，合向量仍可为零
cues.caption: CO₂两条相反的键偶极相互抵消。
cues.captionEn: The two opposing bond dipoles of CO₂ cancel.
cues.zh: 现在给每条键加上偶极箭头。这里采用物理学从负端指向正端的约定，因此二氧化碳的箭头朝向碳。两个相同的箭头方向相反，相加为零。碳氧键有极性，并不保证整个分子有极性；对称性可以让各方向的贡献抵消。
cues.en: Now add electric-dipole arrows. We use the physical convention, pointing from negative to positive, so the carbon-dioxide arrows point toward carbon. Equal arrows in opposite directions sum to zero. Polar carbon–oxygen bonds do not guarantee a polar molecule: symmetry can cancel their contributions.

cues.title: 弯折后，分量不能全抵消
cues.caption: 水的两个键偶极留下非零合向量。
cues.captionEn: Water’s two bond dipoles leave a nonzero resultant.
cues.zh: 在水的折线骨架上，两个箭头不能再完全相反。它们的横向分量抵消，沿夹角平分方向的分量相加，留下棕色合向量。箭头长度只用于定性比较，不能读成实测偶极矩。判断分子极性时，既要看键的极性，也要看所有方向在空间中怎样组合。
cues.en: On water’s bent framework, the two arrows no longer oppose each other. Sideways components cancel, while components along the angle bisector add, leaving the brown resultant.
