These lengths are qualitative, not measured dipole moments. Molecular polarity depends on bond polarity and the spatial combination of all directions.

cues.title: 替换一个顶点，改变抵消条件
cues.caption: CH₄的对称抵消，在CH₃Cl中不再成立。
cues.captionEn: Methane’s symmetric cancellation no longer holds in CH₃Cl.
cues.zh: 最后比较甲烷和一氯甲烷。甲烷四个等价方向的贡献相互抵消；把一个氢换成氯，那个方向的键极性和大小发生改变，合向量便不再为零。这是两个模型的受控比较，不表示画面中真的发生了取代反应。先检查结构与对称性，再判断整个分子的极性。
cues.en: Compare methane with chloromethane. Methane’s four equivalent directions cancel. Replacing one hydrogen with chlorine changes that bond’s polarity and strength, so a nonzero resultant remains. This is a controlled comparison of models, not an animated substitution reaction. Check geometry and symmetry before judging molecular polarity.

cues.title: 落叶减少，碳去了哪里
cues.titleEn: Where did the leaf carbon go?
cues.caption: 落叶变少，物质并没有消失。
cues.captionEn: Less litter does not mean matter disappeared.
cues.zh: 一片落叶逐渐破碎，减少的物质去了哪里？先比较相同落叶与土层。自然土保留原状态，另一份土按教材用六十摄氏度处理一小时，尽量减弱微生物作用。处理不等于无菌，也可能改变土壤性质。因此温湿度、叶片来源和观察时间仍要一致，图中只是待检验的模型趋势。
cues.en: As a fallen leaf breaks apart, where does its material go? Compare matched leaves and soil layers. Keep one soil untreated; treat the other at sixty degrees Celsius for one hour, as in the textbook, to reduce microbial effects. That does not guarantee sterility or unchanged soil chemistry. Match moisture, temperature and observation time. These trends are model predictions, not measurements.

cues.title: 先切分，再吸收
cues.caption: 胞外切分，再吸收小分子。
cues.captionEn: Break down outside, then take up small products.
cues.zh: 放大落叶表面。许多微生物先用胞外酶切分大分子，再吸收适合利用的小分子。跟住这六份碳标记：连接先断开，标记随后经过细胞边界，碳没有凭空消失。实际还会进入细胞成分、二氧化碳等不同物质；这里合并后续步骤，没有模拟完整呼吸路径。停掉胞外切分，整条材料便不能按这条路径进入。
cues.en: Look closely at the leaf surface. Many microbes use extracellular enzymes to break large molecules down before taking up suitable small products. Follow the six carbon markers: connections break outside, then the same markers cross the cell boundary. Carbon has not disappeared. Later reactions redistribute it into cell material, carbon dioxide and other products. Those steps are grouped here. Stop outside cleavage, and this pathway cannot bring the intact material in.

cues.title: 把解释变成预测
cues.titleEn: Turn an explanation into a prediction
cues.caption: 改变水分，把预测与记录比较。
cues.captionEn: Change moisture; test the prediction.
cues.zh: 孔洞多，不等于测得了减少多少质量。这里的数字来自模型；自己的记录仍留空。只有用一致的清理、干燥条件和重复样本，才能比较干质量。现在只改变水分：同样的土和落叶，在很干的条件下，模型分解变慢。预测要回到真实记录检验；干燥不是杀菌，自然土壤也不只存在这一条好氧分解路径。
cues.en: More holes do not measure mass loss. These numbers come from the model; your own records stay empty. Match cleaning, drying and replicated samples before comparing dry mass. Now change moisture alone. The same litter decomposes more slowly in the dry model. Test that prediction with observations. Dryness is not sterilization, and this aerobic pathway is not the only form of decomposition in real soil.

cues.title: 两种阴性，一个疑问
cues.caption: 剩余糖少，不等于从未生成。
cues.captionEn: Little sugar left does not mean none formed.
cues.zh: 看同一培养液的两份样品：碘液颜色浅，斐林检测也未见明显沉淀。这能证明没有分解吗？先追查土壤浸出液。纱布带走粗土粒，却可能留下微生物、胞外酶和溶解物。它们既可能分解淀粉，也可能继续利用产物，所以最后剩多少糖，不能直接等同于曾经生成多少糖。
cues.en: Two aliquots from one culture show little iodine color and no obvious Fehling precipitate. Does that prove nothing was broken down? First inspect the soil extract. Gauze removes coarse soil but can leave microbes, extracellular enzymes and dissolved substances. The extract can both break starch down and support further use of its products. Sugar remaining at the end is not the same as all the sugar previously formed.

cues.title: 分解与利用不是同一步
cues.caption: 切分与后续利用，可以分别检验。
cues.captionEn: Test cleavage and later use separately.
cues.zh: 两杯先有等量淀粉，分别加入等体积浸出液和水，在同样条件下培养。放大浸出液这一杯：先在细胞外切分，再利用产物，是两个不同过程。关闭后续利用，已形成的小分子便可留在外面；关闭酶切，整条淀粉保留。这里分别控制两条路径，是为了检验解释，不是说加热土壤能只关闭其中一条。
cues.en: Start with equal starch, then add equal volumes of extract or water and incubate under matched conditions. Inside the extract treatment, outside cleavage and later product use are distinct processes. Stop later use, and the small products can remain outside. Stop cleavage, and the intact starch remains. These independent model controls test an explanation; heating real soil would not selectively switch off just one process.

cues.title: 两份样品，两个问题
cues.caption: 两份样品，分别检验。
cues.captionEn: Independent aliquots answer different questions.
cues.zh: 培养结束后，取每组二十毫升培养液，分到两支试管。这个重建选择每份十毫升。跟住移液管：先在原液中吸取，抬高越过器口，再把液体送入对应试管，原液和试管体积同步变化。A一、B一用于碘液检测，A二、B二用于斐林试剂检测，不能把两种试剂加到同一份样品里。
cues.en: After incubation, take twenty milliliters from each group and divide it between two tubes. This reconstruction uses ten milliliters per aliquot. Follow the pipette as it draws below the liquid surface, clears the vessel rim and delivers into the selected tube. Source and receiving volumes change together. Use A1 and B1 for iodine, and A2 and B2 for Fehling reagent.

cues.title: 剩余淀粉的证据
cues.caption: 显色反映样品中还剩多少可检出淀粉。
cues.captionEn: Color indicates detectable starch remaining.
cues.zh: 把碘液加入A一和B一，颜色只在试剂真正进入样品之后改变。这个示例中，水组仍有较多淀粉，颜色较深；浸出液组残留较少，蓝紫色较弱。这条证据支持淀粉发生变化，却不能单凭颜色确定是哪一种微生物、哪一种酶，或产生了多少葡萄糖。还要考虑浸出液本身的背景颜色。
cues.en: Add iodine to A1 and B1. Color changes only after reagent reaches the sample. In this example, the water control retains more starch and gives a stronger blue-purple response; the extract group retains less. This supports starch change, but does not identify the responsible organism or enzyme, or quantify glucose production. Extract background color also matters.

cues.title: 还原性产物的证据
cues.caption: 加热后的沉淀支持还原性产物存在。
cues.captionEn: Heated precipitate supports reducing products.
cues.zh: 给A二和B二加入新配的斐林试剂，再水浴加热。示例中的浸出液组出现砖红色沉淀，水组保持阴性；不开启加热时，模型不会提前长出沉淀。斐林反应检测还原性物质，不是只认葡萄糖的专一标记。把这条证据和淀粉检测联系起来，并用浸出液空白与初始检测检查干扰。
cues.en: Add freshly prepared Fehling reagent to A2 and B2, then heat in a water bath. The example extract group develops brick-red precipitate while the water control remains negative. Without heating, the model does not generate precipitate. Fehling chemistry detects reducing substances, not glucose alone. Combine this result with the starch test and assess interference using extract blanks and initial samples.

cues.title: 迟测为何可能阴性
cues.titleEn: Why a late test can be negative
cues.caption: 产物可以先生成，随后被继续利用。
cues.captionEn: Products can form, then be used further.
cues.zh: 如果产物很快被利用，迟一点检测会怎样？先保留预测，再从同一批碳开始。淀粉减少，可溶产物先增加，随后流入其他碳库。模型百分比始终合计百分之百，标记只是一小批示例。到第七天，剩余糖很少，并不代表早先没有生成。提前检测，再结合淀粉检测、初始样和空白对照，才能更好地区分没有分解与分解后继续利用。
cues.en: What if products are used quickly and we test later? Keep that prediction in mind as the same carbon batch moves. Starch falls; soluble products first rise, then enter other carbon pools. Model percentages always total one hundred percent; the markers are only a small sample. Little sugar on day seven does not mean none formed earlier. Test earlier as well, and combine starch tests, initial samples and blank controls to distinguish no breakdown from breakdown followed by use.

cues.title: 水为什么进入倒置试管
cues.titleEn: Why water enters the inverted tube
cues.caption: SO₂溶入水后，水进入原来的气体空间。
cues.captionEn: As SO₂ dissolves, water enters the former gas space.
cues.zh: 观察倒置试管。水下打开塞子以后，二氧化硫转入水中，管内气体物质的量减少。外部水压推动水进入试管，液面逐渐上升。图中的小点只帮助追踪含硫物质，并不表示气体有颜色。二氧化硫本身是无色的。
cues.en: Watch the inverted tube. Once its stopper opens underwater, sulfur dioxide transfers into the water and less gas remains. External water pressure moves water into the former gas space. The dots track sulfur-containing material; they do not give the gas a colour. Sulfur dioxide itself is colourless.

cues.title: 同一溶液再检验酸性
cues.titleEn: Test the same solution for acidity
cues.caption: 取出的溶液使pH试纸显示酸性。
cues.captionEn: The collected solution gives an acidic pH-paper result.
cues.zh: 保留刚才得到的溶液，再用试纸判断酸碱性。试纸表明溶液呈酸性，说明二氧化硫进入水后，不只是气体空间变小，还形成了具有酸性的水溶液。教材没有给这次观察一个确定的酸碱度读数，所以画面只标小于七，不编造精确数值。
cues.en: Keep the solution from the first observation and test it with pH paper. Its acidic result adds chemical evidence to the earlier volume change. The textbook does not give this observation a definite numerical pH, so the display states only that it is below seven.

cues.title: 品红进入后褪色
cues.caption: 加入品红后，原有颜色逐渐消失。
cues.captionEn: After fuchsin is added, its colour gradually disappears.
cues.zh: 向这份溶液加入少量品红。先看清进入的红色，再观察它逐渐变淡。这里的褪色并不能单独证明有色物质被永久破坏。教材把现象解释为二氧化硫与某些有色物质形成不稳定的无色物质，下一步还要检验颜色能否恢复。
cues.en: Add fuchsin to this solution. Notice the entering red colour, then follow it as it fades. Fading alone does not prove irreversible destruction of a dye. The textbook describes an unstable colourless product with certain coloured substances. The next observation tests whether colour can return.

cues.title: 加热后观察复色
cues.caption: 加热后，已经褪去的品红颜色恢复。
cues.captionEn: On heating, the faded fuchsin colour returns.
cues.zh: 在课堂装置中加热已经褪色的溶液，品红的颜色重新出现。同一份样品从有色到无色，再回到有色，支持教材所说的不稳定无色物质可以分解复色。这里演示的是观察顺序，不是实际加热温度、反应时间或操作用量。
cues.en: Heating the faded solution in the classroom apparatus restores the fuchsin colour. The same sample goes from coloured to colourless and back again, supporting the textbook account of an unstable colourless product. This animation represents the observation sequence, not a heating temperature, reaction time or operating dose.

cues.title: 用未加热样品作对照
cues.caption: 同样褪色的两份样品，加热的一份恢复颜色。
cues.captionEn: Of two equally bleached samples, the heated one regains colour.
cues.zh: 把结论整理成对照：两份样品原先都已褪色，未加热的一份仍浅，经过加热的一份恢复红色。新增的对照帮助辨认温度处理与复色之间的关系，不是教材另编号的一项实验。也不能把这个结果推广为二氧化硫对所有色素都以同样方式作用。
cues.en: Organize the evidence as a comparison. Both samples started bleached; the unheated one remains pale, while the heated one regains its colour. This added teaching control clarifies the role of heating and is not a separately numbered textbook experiment. The result should not be generalized to every pigment affected by sulfur dioxide.

cues.title: 三个一组，起点固定
cues.caption: 单个碱基增减，会改变后续三联体的分组。
cues.captionEn: A one-base insertion or deletion changes downstream triplet grouping.
cues.zh: 从同一个起点，把序列每三个字母分一组。增加一个碱基后，后面的原有字母仍然能找到，但是它们进入了不同的三联体。克里克研究的是噬菌体突变与功能，这段字母是帮助理解阅读框的教学序列，并不是实验中实际测出的基因序列。
cues.en: Read the sequence in triplets from a fixed start. Insert one base: the original letters remain traceable, but their triplet partners change. Crick studied phage mutations and function. These letters are an explanatory sequence, not a measured sequence from that historical experiment.

cues.title: 恢复阅读框的限定
cues.caption: 三个碱基的净增减可恢复后方阅读框，不保证原有功能。
cues.captionEn: A net change of three bases restores the downstream frame, not necessarily protein function.
cues.zh: 把变化从两个碱基改为三个。后方阅读框重新对齐，但局部的氨基酸序列并不一定恢复。原始研究中，特定三重突变组合部分恢复了功能；这不能推广成任何增加或删除三个碱基都没有影响。实验结论必须保留适用条件。
cues.en: Change the net shift from two bases to three. Downstream grouping returns to the original frame, while the local amino acid sequence can remain altered. Particular triple-mutant combinations partially restored function in the original research. That does not make every three-base insertion or deletion harmless.

cues.title: 用合成RNA指定产物
cues.titleEn: Let synthetic RNA specify a product
cues.caption: 教材简化对照中，多聚U对应多聚苯丙氨酸。
cues.captionEn: In the simplified textbook comparison, poly-U specifies polyphenylalanine.
cues.zh: 换一种研究思路：给细胞外的蛋白质合成体系提供多聚U。按教材的简化图比较不同氨基酸条件，苯丙氨酸这一管出现连续产物。多聚U里只有U，结合三联体的证据，就能把UUU与苯丙氨酸联系起来。这个特殊体外体系不按普通细胞的AUG起始过程来画。
cues.en: Provide poly-U to a cell-free protein-synthesis system. In the textbook’s simplified amino-acid comparison, phenylalanine forms the polymer. Combining that observation with triplet evidence links UUU to phenylalanine. This special cell-free assay is separate from ordinary AUG-dependent initiation in the mechanism diagram.

cues.title: 把产物变成可测信号
cues.caption: 原文记录的是标记氨基酸掺入，不是肉眼直接看见肽链。
cues.captionEn: The original assay measured labeled amino-acid incorporation, not visible peptide chains.
cues.zh: 现在打开原文中的一组对照。横条表示带标记苯丙氨酸掺入蛋白质的计数；加入多聚U后信号很强，另外几种条件很低。这些是同一张表中的实测值。前一幕的单氨基酸试管是教材简化，原始论文还使用了不同的标记与混合物设计，不能把两种表达混为一谈。
cues.en: Now inspect one original control series. The bars report labeled phenylalanine incorporation into protein: poly-U produces a strong signal, while the other conditions remain low. These are measured values from one table. The previous single-amino-acid tubes are a textbook simplification; the paper also used labeled mixtures and other assay designs.

cues.title: 先合成一条RNA
cues.caption: 模板按3′到5′被读取，RNA在3′端延长。
cues.captionEn: The template is read 3′ to 5′ while RNA extends at its 3′ end.
cues.zh: 进入机制示意。RNA聚合酶沿DNA模板移动，按互补关系加入RNA单位。看清两个方向：模板被三撇到五撇读取，新RNA却从五撇向三撇延长。原有DNA仍然保留；这不是把其中一条DNA直接改造成RNA。
cues.en: Switch to a mechanism diagram. RNA polymerase advances along a DNA template and adds complementary RNA units. The template is read three-prime to five-prime; new RNA grows five-prime to three-prime. The DNA remains present. One DNA strand is not chemically converted into RNA.

cues.title: 同一信息，不同分子
cues.titleEn: The information passes to another molecule
cues.caption: RNA与模板互补，与编码链对应位置以U替代T。
cues.captionEn: RNA complements the template; relative to the coding strand, U replaces T.
cues.zh: 转录形成的RNA与模板互补，而不是与模板完全相同。把它与另一条编码链比较，对应位置主要是U与T的差别。真实真核细胞还要加工和运输RNA；这里省略这些步骤，接下来跟踪同一段示例信息如何指定氨基酸顺序。
cues.en: The RNA complements its template rather than copying the same letters. Compared with the coding strand, corresponding uracils replace thymines. Actual eukaryotic cells also process and transport RNA. Those steps are omitted here as we follow the same example sequence into amino acid order.

cues.title: 反密码子识别起始位点
cues.caption: tRNA反密码子与mRNA反向互补，氨基酸接在tRNA的3′端。
cues.captionEn: The tRNA anticodon pairs antiparallel to mRNA; its amino acid is attached at the tRNA 3′ end.
cues.zh: 核糖体读取RNA。起始的AUG与携带甲硫氨酸的转运RNA配对。下端是反密码子，上端是连接氨基酸的三撇端，两处不要混淆。图中把核糖体留在镜头中央，所以随后看到RNA向后经过，实际表示核糖体沿RNA向三撇方向前进。
cues.en: The ribosome reads RNA. AUG pairs with an initiator transfer RNA carrying methionine. The anticodon is at the lower end of this schematic, while the amino acid attaches to the three-prime end above. The camera follows the ribosome, so RNA moving backward represents its advance toward the RNA three-prime direction.

cues.title: 转移肽链，再移动一格
cues.caption: 肽链转到A位tRNA，随后tRNA与mRNA一起移动。
cues.captionEn: The peptide transfers to the A-site tRNA, then tRNAs and mRNA translocate together.
cues.zh: 新的携氨基酸转运RNA进入A位。形成肽键后，原有肽链转到它携带的氨基酸上；随后两种转运RNA与RNA一起移动一个密码子的距离。空的转运RNA退出，携带肽链的来到P位，A位重新空出。每轮加入的单位由当前密码子决定，肽链沿N端到C端的方向增长。
cues.en: A charged transfer RNA enters the A site. Peptide-bond formation transfers the existing chain onto its amino acid. The transfer RNAs and messenger RNA then move by one codon. Empty transfer RNA exits, the peptide-bearing one reaches P, and A becomes available. Each cycle adds the specified residue, extending the peptide from N to C.

cues.title: 终止不是另一种氨基酸
cues.titleEn: A stop signal is not another amino acid
cues.caption: 释放因子识别终止密码子，完成的肽链与tRNA分离。
cues.captionEn: A release factor recognizes the stop codon and releases the peptide from tRNA.
cues.zh: 当终止密码子进入A位，来的是释放因子，不是携带某种终止氨基酸的转运RNA。肽链与转运RNA的连接被解除，产物释放。这里得到的是一条短示例肽链；真实蛋白质通常还要折叠、加工或组装，不能把释放瞬间直接等同于所有功能都已完成。
cues.en: When the stop codon enters A, a release factor arrives. There is no transfer RNA carrying a stop amino acid. The peptide is detached from its transfer RNA and released. This short example chain illustrates sequence decoding; real proteins may still need folding, processing or assembly before functioning.

cues.title: 网能挡住昆虫，挡不住所有线索
cues.titleEn: Mesh blocks insects, not every cue
cues.caption: 纱网排除直接接触，气味与视觉仍可能存在。
cues.captionEn: Mesh excludes contact, while odor and visual cues may remain.
cues.zh: 雌蛾与雄蛾被纱网分开，不能直接接触。空气仍能经过网孔，把释放的化学物质带到接收者附近。画面中的雄蚕蛾步行靠近气味来源，停在隔离边界外。这个比较只说明没有直接接触也可能响应，不能立刻断言一定是化学信息，因为视觉和其他线索还没有排除。
cues.en: Mesh keeps the female and male moth apart while air can carry released chemicals through the openings. The illustrated male silkmoth walks toward the source and stops outside the barrier. A response without contact is useful, but does not alone establish chemical communication: visual and other cues remain possible.

cues.title: 遮挡视觉，还要保留气流对照
cues.caption: 有源室和空室使用相同通气路径。
cues.captionEn: Source and empty chambers share the same air pathway.
cues.zh: 现在用不透明室遮住雌蛾，弯曲通气管避免直接看见室内，同时让气味沿连续通道到达雄蛾。随后换成空室，保持相同气流。若多次比较仍发现有源组更常出现定向，才加强可扩散化学信息的解释。还要匹配温湿度、容器和操作，并检查是否有残留气味造成假象。
cues.en: Hide the female in an opaque chamber. A bent duct blocks direct sight while carrying odor along a continuous route. Then compare an empty chamber with the same airflow. Repeatedly stronger orientation toward the occupied chamber supports a diffusible chemical cue. Match temperature, humidity and handling, and check for residual odors before drawing conclusions.

cues.title: 记录每个重复，而不是先写答案
cues.titleEn: Record trials before writing the answer
cues.caption: 70%与20%只是练习示例，个人数据从空白开始。
cues.captionEn: Seventy and twenty percent are practice values, not measured results.
cues.zh: 这张记录图使用假设结果练习比较：有源组与空室组的响应比例不同。它不是替你完成的实验。真实设计应事先规定什么算定向响应，记录响应数与总数，换位置、清理残留并独立重复。不同昆虫的信号可能不同；蚕蛾醇与雄蚕蛾是具体研究对象，不能代表所有昆虫都会作出相同行为。
cues.en: These hypothetical proportions illustrate comparison, not a completed experiment. Define orientation before testing, record responding and total individuals, swap positions, remove residues and repeat independently. Signals differ among insects. Bombykol and male silkmoths are a specific researched system, not evidence that every insect responds in the same way.

cues.title: 数量增加会改变限制条件
cues.caption: 取食压力和捕食者响应，逐渐限制原来的增加。
cues.captionEn: Food pressure and predator responses constrain the initial increase.
cues.zh: 先给草食动物一个增加的扰动。取食压力上升，草的可用程度下降；捕食者也会随资源增加而响应。随后草食动物的偏离受到限制，捕食者的变化又滞后地调整。图形大小代表归一化数量指数，不是把一只动物变大。负反馈可以缩小偏离，但真实系统仍受时滞、环境与更多相互作用影响。
cues.en: An initial increase in herbivores raises grazing pressure and changes food availability. Predators respond with a delay, helping constrain the original increase. Their own deviation subsequently adjusts. Symbol size represents normalized population indices, not individual growth. Negative feedback can reduce displacement, although real systems involve further interactions, delays and environmental changes.

cues.title: 抵抗与恢复回答不同问题
cues.titleEn: Resistance and recovery ask different questions
cues.caption: 先看偏离幅度，再看回返速度。
cues.captionEn: Inspect initial displacement, then the rate of return.
cues.zh: 同样的扰动下，功能指数离原来状态偏开多少，用来讨论抵抗能力；受到影响以后怎样回返，用来讨论恢复能力。图中先标出最初落差，再沿曲线观察恢复。探索时分别改变抵抗参数和恢复速率，它们改变不同部分。不能只凭某一刻看起来恢复了，就把两种能力混成一个指标。
cues.en: Resistance concerns how far function initially moves from its previous state under a disturbance. Recovery concerns the subsequent return. First inspect the marked drop, then follow the curve. The separate controls change displacement and recovery rate independently. One apparently recovered snapshot cannot collapse both properties into a single measure.

cues.title: 自我调节有条件和限度
cues.caption: 强扰动可能把模型推到另一状态。
cues.captionEn: Strong disturbance can move the model toward another state.
cues.zh: 把扰动加强，初始状态越过模型中的阈值。原先促进恢复的关系不再保证回到原状，系统转向较低的功能状态。这里零点二五只是用于解释阈值的假设，不是某个真实森林或湖泊的安全线。生态系统的恢复能力有限，不能由物种多或食物网复杂，就推断任何破坏都能自动消除。
cues.en: A stronger disturbance moves the initial condition below the model’s threshold, after which the trajectory approaches a lower functional state. The threshold of 0.25 is illustrative, not a safety boundary for an actual forest or lake. Recovery has limits; greater diversity or food-web complexity does not guarantee that every disturbance will be repaired automatically.

cues.title: 先把基本组分放在真实空间里
cues.titleEn: Arrange the components in a physical system
cues.caption: 坡面、水域、生产者和分解者共同组成生态缸。
cues.captionEn: Land, water, producers and decomposers form the tank.
cues.zh: 按教材思路，先铺出陆地坡面，再加入水域、适合的植物和少量消费者，保留土壤中的分解者。水面与坡面相接，水草根部在底部，陆地植物位于土层上。封盖后放在通风、间接光照的位置。教材列出的生物是供选择的材料，不表示要把所有种类都放进去；组成比例需要事先论证并持续观察。
cues.en: Following the textbook’s structure, establish a land slope, water, suitable plants and a small consumer component, with decomposers in the substrate. Water meets the slope; aquatic and terrestrial plants occupy appropriate positions. Add the cover and use indirect light. Listed organisms are alternatives, not a requirement to stock every species. Composition needs planning and continued observation.

cues.title: 白天与夜间的氧收支不同
cues.titleEn: Oxygen budgets differ between day and night
cues.caption: 光合作用随光改变，呼吸在夜间仍继续。
cues.captionEn: Photosynthesis follows light; respiration continues at night.
cues.zh: 看水中溶解氧随昼夜变化。白天光合作用产生氧，同时植物、动物和分解者仍在呼吸；夜间光合作用停止，呼吸继续消耗氧。水和缸内空气之间也能交换气体，箭头随交换方向变化。封盖以后，模型没有从外界凭空补氧。这个短期计算解释收支，不证明整个群落已经长期稳定。
cues.en: Follow dissolved oxygen through day and night. In light, photosynthesis supplies oxygen while plants, consumers and decomposers also respire. At night, photosynthesis stops but respiration continues. Water exchanges oxygen with the internal headspace, and the arrow follows that exchange. No oxygen is supplied through the sealed lid. This short-term calculation explains a budget, not long-term community stability.

cues.title: 相同光照，改变消费者负荷
cues.titleEn: Change consumer load under the same light
cues.caption: 更多耗氧需求，会改变同一个缸的结果。
cues.captionEn: Higher oxygen demand changes the same tank’s outcome.
cues.zh: 保持光照和生产者条件相同，提高消费者负荷。模型中的需氧量增加，水中氧的变化随之不同。还可以在探索里降低光照，或改变生产者量，检查这些因素怎样相互限制。图中数量只是负荷指数，不是实际投放密度建议，也没有模拟长期繁殖与死亡。不能用一个漂亮的密封缸画面代替对生物状态的检查。
cues.en: Keep light and producers unchanged while raising consumer load. Greater oxygen demand changes the dissolved-oxygen trajectory. Exploration also allows reduced light or altered producer amount to test interacting constraints. Icons represent a load index, not a stocking recommendation; long-term births and deaths are not modeled. An attractive sealed tank does not replace monitoring the organisms.

cues.title: 稳定要靠连续观察判断
cues.caption: 每周记录组成、数量与环境，不能只看一次。
cues.captionEn: Record composition, counts and conditions each week.
cues.zh: 教材要求每周至少观察一次，记录生物种类、数量和变化。还应记录日期、光温条件、水色、活动和异常，并保留可比较的照片。画面只是观察表的示例，你的实际日志从空白开始。稳定不是个体永远不变，也不是一次溶解氧正常；需要把结构、功能和持续时间一起判断，发现异常后再检查原来的设计。
cues.en: The textbook asks for observations at least weekly, recording organism types, numbers and changes. Include date, light, temperature, water appearance, activity and unusual events, with comparable photographs. This is an example journal; your actual record begins blank. Stability is neither unchanging individuals nor one normal oxygen reading. Evaluate structure, function and duration together, and revisit the design when conditions change.

cues.title: 先看颜色，再看体积
cues.caption: 蔗糖先变黄、变褐，再形成黑色物质。
cues.captionEn: Sucrose yellows, browns and forms black material.
cues.zh: 先把注意力放在颜色。接触浓硫酸后，原先浅色的蔗糖逐渐变黄、变褐，最后形成黑色物质。这不等于把原来混在糖里的水蒸干。教材用这个现象说明脱水性：有机物中的氢和氧，按水的组成比例被脱去。
cues.en: First follow colour. Contact with concentrated sulfuric acid turns pale sucrose yellow, brown and finally black. This is not merely evaporating water that was mixed into sugar. The textbook uses it to illustrate dehydration: hydrogen and oxygen are removed in the proportion that forms water.

cues.title: 按水的组成核对元素
cues.caption: 简化脱水账本：一份蔗糖对应12C和11H₂O。
cues.captionEn: Simplified dehydration inventory: one sucrose unit gives 12C and 11H₂O.
cues.zh: 把这一步写成简化的元素账本。蔗糖有十二个碳、二十二个氢和十一个氧；二十二个氢与十一个氧正好组成十一份水，留下十二份碳。画面中的点是在核对元素数，不是蔗糖的分子结构。真实演示还会发生副反应，不能只用这条式子描述全部产物。
cues.en: Write a simplified atom inventory. Sucrose contains twelve carbons, twenty-two hydrogens and eleven oxygens. The hydrogen and oxygen can form eleven waters, leaving twelve carbons. These dots count atoms rather than showing a sucrose structure. Side reactions also occur, so this one equation cannot describe every product.

cues.title: 气体把黑色物质撑成多孔结构
cues.caption: 热与产气使黑色物质形成膨胀的多孔柱体。
cues.captionEn: Heat and gas formation expand the black material into a porous column.
cues.zh: 继续看体积。反应放热，形成的水蒸气以及副反应产生的气体进入黑色物质中的孔隙，柱体便向上膨胀。体积变大，并不说明碳原子凭空增加了。现在孔洞变多、固体骨架之间的空隙变大，才是画面体积增长所追踪的量。
cues.en: Now follow volume. Released heat, water vapour and gases from side reactions create pores within the black material, expanding it upward. A larger volume does not mean new carbon atoms appear. The model tracks the growing space between solid parts as the visible column expands.

cues.title: 浓硫酸还会参与氧化
cues.caption: 部分碳继续被氧化，硫酸中的硫可从+6变为+4。
cues.captionEn: Some carbon is further oxidized; sulfur can change from +6 to +4.
cues.zh: 浓硫酸不只有脱水作用，它也能氧化一部分生成的碳。按这里选出的反应路径，碳变成二氧化碳，硫酸中的硫被还原成二氧化硫。一个碳失去四个电子，两个硫各得到两个电子。这说明逸出气体不只是水蒸气，也说明黑色残留物不是纯净碳制品。
cues.en: Concentrated sulfuric acid can also oxidize some of the carbon. In the selected pathway, carbon forms carbon dioxide while sulfur is reduced to sulfur dioxide. One carbon loses four electrons and two sulfurs each gain two. The escaping material is therefore not only water vapour, and the black residue is not a pure carbon product.

cues.title: 把固体量和孔隙分开
cues.titleEn: Separate solid amount from pore space
cues.caption: 保持固体量不变，仅增大孔隙就能增大外观体积。
cues.captionEn: At fixed solid amount, more pore space increases bulk volume.
cues.zh: 最后固定模型中的固体量，只改变孔隙率。孔隙越多，外观体积越大，而元素账本没有增加任何碳。关系式是总体积等于固体体积除以一减孔隙率。这里的百分数是用来检验这个几何关系的教学输入，不是对真实演示测得的孔隙率。
cues.en: Finally hold the model’s solid amount fixed and change only porosity. More pore space gives a larger bulk volume without adding carbon to the inventory. Total volume equals solid volume divided by one minus porosity. The percentage is a teaching input for this geometric relation, not a measured porosity of the real demonstration.

cues.title: 三种细胞，三种基因都在
cues.titleEn: Three cell types retain all three genes
cues.caption: 鸡的三种细胞都检出三个基因；红细胞在这里有细胞核。
cues.captionEn: All three genes are detected in these chicken cells, including nucleated red blood cells.
cues.zh: 先看DNA检测。鸡的输卵管细胞、红细胞和胰岛细胞中，都检测到卵清蛋白、珠蛋白和胰岛素的基因。特别注意，教材使用的是鸡的红细胞，它有细胞核。不要把成熟哺乳动物红细胞没有细胞核的特点套到这里。
cues.en: Start with DNA detection. Chicken oviduct cells, red blood cells and pancreatic islet cells all contain the three assayed genes. These are chicken red blood cells, which retain nuclei. The absence of nuclei in mature mammalian red blood cells does not apply to this example.

cues.title: 检测RNA，结果不再相同
cues.caption: 三个基因都存在，但三种特定mRNA的检出模式不同。
cues.captionEn: The genes are present in every cell type, but the three assayed mRNAs have different detection patterns.
cues.zh: 切换到RNA检测。输卵管细胞检出卵清蛋白的信使RNA，红细胞检出珠蛋白的，胰岛细胞检出胰岛素的。细胞并不是丢掉了另外两个基因，而是表达状态不同。这里的减号表示未检出，不等于证明每个分子的数量绝对为零，也不表示细胞只表达这一种基因。
cues.en: Switch to RNA. Oviduct cells show ovalbumin messenger RNA, red blood cells show globin, and islet cells show insulin. The cells have not discarded the other genes; expression differs. A minus means not detected, not proven absolute absence. Nor does the table describe every gene expressed in each cell.

cues.title: 同一Lcyc序列，两种花型
cues.titleEn: Two floral forms with the same Lcyc sequence
cues.caption: 柳穿鱼Lcyc序列相同，表达与花型却不同。
cues.captionEn: The Linaria Lcyc sequence is unchanged while expression and floral symmetry differ.
cues.zh: 看柳穿鱼的两种花。A的上下花瓣不同，具有两侧对称；B的花瓣趋于辐射对称，还形成多条距。教材指出，两株的Lcyc基因序列相同，但开花时的表达不同。这个比较把注意力从碱基是否改变，转向基因为什么没有被表达。
cues.en: Compare the two toadflax flowers. A has different upper and lower petals and bilateral symmetry; B is radially organized with multiple spurs. The textbook reports the same Lcyc sequence but different expression during flowering. The comparison shifts attention from sequence changes to how expression is suppressed.

cues.title: 附加标记，字母保留
cues.titleEn: Add marks without replacing the letters
cues.caption: 甲基化修饰发生在碱基上，示意序列本身保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Methyl groups modify bases while the illustrated base sequence remains unchanged.
cues.zh: 把观察位置移到DNA。B的Lcyc高度甲基化，并受到表达抑制。甲基是加在碱基上的修饰，图中的C仍然是C，没有被替换成别的字母。这几个位点只是连接关系示意，不是测得的完整基因图谱，也不能把所有基因的甲基化都解释成同一个开关。
cues.en: Look more closely at DNA. Lcyc in B is heavily methylated and transcriptionally suppressed. A methyl mark modifies a base: C remains C rather than becoming another letter. The few displayed sites explain the relationship, not a measured gene map or a universal switch for every methylated region.

cues.title: 还要检查后代
cues.caption: 教材的F₁似A，F₂大多数似A、少数似B；不虚构精确比例。
cues.captionEn: The textbook describes A-like F₁ flowers and mostly A-like, some B-like F₂ flowers, without an exact ratio.
cues.zh: 仅有同一代的外形差异，还不足以说明遗传。教材继续给出杂交与自交的后代：第一代像A，第二代大多数像A、少数像B。图中两朵花表示类型，不表示统计个数。后代证据与基因序列、甲基化和表达的检测一起，才构成这个表观遗传案例。
cues.en: Differences in one generation alone do not establish inheritance. The textbook follows crossing and selfing: F1 resembles A; most F2 resemble A and some resemble B. The flower icons denote types, not sample counts. Offspring evidence joins sequence, methylation and expression observations in this epigenetic case.

cues.title: 相同基因型，毛色有过渡
cues.titleEn: One genotype, a range of coat colors
cues.caption: Aᵛʸ/a小鼠可呈不同毛色；上游修饰与异位表达有关。
cues.captionEn: Aᵛʸ/a mice can differ in coat color as upstream methylation affects ectopic expression.
cues.zh: 小鼠提供另一个案例。保持A上标vy与a的基因型不变，仍能观察到黄色、斑驳和深色毛色。上游特殊序列的甲基化与异常位置的基因表达有关。深色个体仍然是这个基因型，并没有变成两个a；毛色图也不是从甲基化百分比直接算出的颜色刻度。
cues.en: Mice provide another example. The A-vy over a genotype stays fixed while coats range from yellow through mottled to dark. Methylation of an upstream element affects ectopic expression. The dark animal has not become a over a, and these coat illustrations are not a numerical color scale calculated from methylation percentages.

cues.title: 改变幼虫培养条件
cues.caption: 31 ℃培养的残翅幼虫中，部分成虫翅长接近正常。
cues.captionEn: Some vestigial larvae raised at 31 °C develop adult wings approaching normal length.
cues.zh: 最后看温度实验。比较的是幼虫在不同条件下发育后的成虫，不是把成年果蝇放热后让翅即时伸长。在三十一摄氏度培养的残翅幼虫中，有些成虫的翅长接近正常。教材没有给出每只果蝇的长度或出现比例，因此这里仅展示定性观察。
cues.en: The temperature comparison concerns adults produced under different larval conditions, not adult wings instantly stretching when heated. Some vestigial larvae raised at thirty-one degrees develop wings approaching normal length. The textbook supplies neither individual lengths nor frequencies, so the display remains qualitative.

cues.title: 回到正常温度看下一代
cues.titleEn: Return the next generation to normal temperature
cues.caption: 这些果蝇的后代在25 ℃培养，仍表现残翅。
cues.captionEn: Their offspring raised at 25 °C still show vestigial wings.
cues.zh: 再把观察对象换成后代。在正常的二十五摄氏度培养条件下，后代仍是残翅。这个结果支持环境影响性状表现，但不能把上一代长一些的翅直接当作基因已经改变的证据。教材要求提出机制假说；假说仍需要后续实验，画面不会把某个酶的解释当成已经证实。
cues.en: Now examine their offspring. Raised at the normal twenty-five degrees, they retain the vestigial phenotype. The observation supports an environmental influence on expression of the trait, rather than proving that longer parental wings changed the gene. Proposed mechanisms still require experiments; an enzyme explanation is not presented as established.

cues.title: 有处理，也要有对照
cues.caption: X射线提高突变检出，不指定有利的变化方向。
cues.captionEn: X irradiation increases mutation detection without prescribing a beneficial direction.
cues.zh: 缪勒用果蝇比较射线处理与对照，并从后代的遗传表现中识别变化。教材给出的是突变个体增加这一结论，没有这次比较的完整剂量与计数。画面因此不编造一条精确曲线。射线可以损伤DNA，但并不会按生物的需要指定一种有利变化。
cues.en: Muller compared irradiated flies with controls and detected changes through their descendants. The textbook gives a qualitative increase, without the complete doses and counts of that comparison. We therefore do not invent a dose-response curve. Radiation can damage DNA without directing a useful mutation according to need.

cues.title: 把遗传表现变成检出信号
cues.titleEn: Turn inheritance into a detection signal
cues.caption: 追踪一条X染色体，隐性致死变化会改变后代类别。
cues.captionEn: A tracked recessive-lethal X changes which offspring classes survive.
cues.zh: 这是检出思路的简化示例，不是完整历史筛选方案。把母系的一条X标成星号。如果它携带隐性致死变异，得到它的雄性后代只有这一条X，因此该类不能存活。其他类别仍能出现。比较的是预期遗传类别与实际后代，而不是只看被照射果蝇的外表。
cues.en: This illustrates detection logic rather than reproducing the complete historical screen. Mark one maternal X with a star. If it carries a recessive lethal change, sons inheriting it have no second X to mask the effect, so that class cannot survive. Other classes remain. The signal is an altered offspring pattern, not merely the irradiated fly’s appearance.

cues.title: 分母决定能说什么
cues.caption: 63.16%与39.06%是各组吸烟比例，不是吸烟者患癌概率。
cues.captionEn: 63.16% and 39.06% are smoking proportions within the sampled groups, not cancer risks among smokers.
cues.zh: 教材的病例与健康对照各有一千三百零三人，吸烟者分别为八百二十三人与五百零九人。两条柱的分母都固定在各自抽取的组内。它们显示关联，不能直接换成吸烟者的患癌概率。吸烟致癌已有广泛证据支持，但那一结论不能只靠这张病例对照表的两个百分数。
cues.en: The textbook samples thirteen hundred and three cases and the same number of controls, with eight hundred and twenty-three and five hundred and nine smokers. Each percentage uses its own sampled group as denominator. This demonstrates association, not population cancer risk. Smoking causation is supported by broader evidence, not these two percentages alone.

cues.title: 处理活根尖，再固定
cues.titleEn: Treat living root tips, then fix them
cues.caption: 先低温、再生根与诱导；固定后观察的是保存的分裂象。
cues.captionEn: Cold pretreatment, rooting and induction precede fixation; the slide preserves division states.
cues.zh: 顺着教材操作顺序看：先在四摄氏度放置一周，再让蒜底部接触水面，在约二十五摄氏度生根。根长约一厘米后，再放入冷藏室诱导四十八到七十二小时。随后取根尖、固定并制作染色装片。固定后的细胞已经停止生命过程，不能把它们画成在显微镜下继续分裂。
cues.en: Follow the textbook sequence: one week at four degrees, then rooting near twenty-five degrees with the bulb base touching water. When roots approach one centimeter, cold induction lasts forty-eight to seventy-two hours. Root tips are then fixed and stained on slides. Fixed cells preserve states; they do not continue dividing under observation.

cues.title: 复制了，却没有正常分开
cues.caption: 纺锤体受抑制可导致复原核；DNA复制本身不等于倍性已经增加。
cues.captionEn: Spindle disruption can lead to a restitution nucleus; DNA replication alone does not increase ploidy.
cues.zh: 机制图暂时缩减为四条染色体，每条已经有两条姐妹染色单体。正常分离后，两个子核各得到四条。受抑制的示例中，姐妹分开却没有完成两极分配与细胞分裂，八条保留在一个复原核中。这个过程说明如何加倍，但不意味着每个低温处理的细胞都会得到同样结果。
cues.en: The mechanism uses four replicated chromosomes, each with two sisters. Normal segregation gives four chromosomes to each daughter nucleus. In the disrupted example, sisters separate without completed poleward segregation or cytokinesis, leaving eight in a restitution nucleus. This explains a doubling route, not a guaranteed outcome for every cold-treated cell.

cues.title: 回到真实材料的数量
cues.titleEn: Return to the material’s chromosome count
cues.caption: 蒜或洋葱正常为16条，加倍示例为32条；按着丝粒计数。
cues.captionEn: Garlic or onion normally has 16 chromosomes; a doubled example has 32, counted by centromeres.
cues.zh: 回到教材材料，蒜和洋葱的正常体细胞是十六条染色体。先找形态清楚的分裂象，再辨认正常和数目改变的细胞。图中以十六与三十二条进行计数训练，并非原始显微照片。交叉形状的两条姐妹仍共用一个着丝粒时，要算一条染色体，不能直接数手臂。
cues.en: Return to the actual material: garlic and onion somatic cells normally have sixteen chromosomes. Find clear division figures before comparing normal and altered cells. These sixteen- and thirty-two-chromosome diagrams train counting; they are not original micrographs. Two sisters sharing one centromere count as one chromosome, not four arms.

cues.title: 多一条，不等于多一组
cues.titleEn: One extra chromosome is not one extra set
cues.caption: 个别染色体增减，与完整染色体组增减需要分开。
cues.captionEn: Individual chromosome gains or losses differ from changes in complete sets.
cues.zh: 这个数量模型每组有三种非同源染色体。先看两个完整组，再增加其中一条：总数改变，但并没有形成第三个完整组。三倍体和四倍体则分别具有三个与四个完整组。模型里的三条只是为了看清结构，不能当作所有生物的染色体组都只有三条。
cues.en: This numerical example has three nonhomologous chromosome types per set. Starting with two complete sets, add one chromosome: the count changes without forming a complete third set. Triploids and tetraploids instead contain three and four complete sets. Three chromosomes per set is a teaching choice, not a biological universal.

cues.title: 单倍体还要看来源
cues.caption: 由配子发育成的个体可为单倍体；其细胞不一定只有一组。
cues.captionEn: A gamete-derived haploid can contain more than one chromosome set.
cues.zh: 现在改变的不是字母标签，而是个体的来源。二倍体的配子通常有一组，由它发育的单倍体也有一组。四倍体的配子通常有两组，由它发育的个体仍称单倍体，却有两组染色体。只数完整组的数量，而不说明原物种与配子来源，容易把这两个概念混淆。
cues.en: Now consider origin. A diploid’s typical gamete has one set, and a haploid developing from it also has one. A tetraploid’s typical gamete has two sets; an individual developing from it is still called a haploid of that species. Set count alone, without the parent species and gamete origin, can mislead.

cues.title: 改变片段的拷贝数
cues.caption: 缺失减少片段，重复增加拷贝；原有片段身份可以追踪。
cues.captionEn: Deletion removes a segment; duplication adds a copy while identities remain traceable.
cues.zh: 把染色体展开成带有字母的片段。缺失时，b离开，剩下的片段连接；重复时，b增加一个拷贝，其他片段并没有变成b。字母表示一段较大的DNA，而不是单个碱基。这里解释结构结果，没有宣称每一种重复都经过完全相同的断裂修复过程。
cues.en: Unfold a chromosome into labeled segments. Deletion removes b and joins the remaining sequence; duplication adds a b copy without converting neighboring segments into b. Each letter represents a substantial DNA segment, not a single base. The animation explains structural outcomes rather than one universal molecular repair pathway.

cues.title: 改变顺序或所在染色体
cues.caption: 倒位改变片段方向；易位涉及非同源染色体。
cues.captionEn: Inversion reverses a segment; translocation moves material between nonhomologous chromosomes.
cues.zh: 倒位的片段保留原来身份，却转过半圈，内部顺序与方向改变。随后比较易位：两种颜色代表非同源染色体，末端片段交换后仍能认出来源。不要把这幅图与减数分裂时同源染色体的非姐妹染色单体互换混为一谈。两者涉及的对象关系不同。
cues.en: An inverted segment retains its identity while rotating, reversing internal order and direction. In the translocation example, the two colors denote nonhomologous chromosomes; exchanged terminal material retains its source color. This differs from exchange between nonsister chromatids of homologous chromosomes during meiosis.

cues.title: 先确定在哪里、何时调查
cues.titleEn: Specify where and when to investigate
cues.caption: 位置、时间、方法与重复共同定义样本。
cues.captionEn: Location, time, method and replication define each sample.
cues.zh: 先确定要调查的环境问题，再看地图上的三个练习位置。采样时段和方法要匹配，每份数据保留地点、天气、深度和仪器条件。已有监测与访谈也能提供证据，但要注明来源。这里没有进行实地取样；不同条件的数据不能直接拼成一条趋势。
cues.en: Start with an environmental question, then locate the three example sites. Match timing and methods, recording location, weather, depth and instruments. Existing monitoring and interviews can contribute with sources retained. No field sampling occurred here; incompatible conditions cannot simply become one trend.

cues.title: 指标和评价依据要一起保留
cues.caption: 单项溶解氧不等于综合水质等级。
cues.captionEn: Dissolved oxygen alone does not establish overall water quality.
cues.zh: 这里的溶解氧是练习值。水质评价还需要水温、酸碱度、透明度、氮磷等数据，并核对适用标准和方法。单项低读数既不能给出综合等级，也不能指认污染来源。个人记录从空白开始，再把证据、待核实问题和复查步骤写进行动计划。
cues.en: The oxygen readings are examples. Water assessment also needs temperature, pH, transparency, nutrients, applicable criteria and methods. One low reading neither grades overall water quality nor identifies a pollution source. Begin personal records blank, then connect evidence and unresolved questions to an action plan.

cues.title: 通道恢复的是可移动的空间
cues.caption: 同一个体通过桥面，始终与道路交通分开。
cues.captionEn: The same individual crosses the bridge, separated from road traffic.
cues.zh: 跟住同一个体，它沿生态通道越过道路；关闭连接，它就停在原来的边界一侧。这是班夫研究启发的空间示意，不是真实定位轨迹。通行影像可以证明设施被使用，但还不能据此推断已经恢复繁殖和基因交流。
cues.en: Follow one individual across the wildlife bridge. With the connection closed, it remains on its original side. This diagram is inspired by Banff research, not GPS tracks. Images establish crossing use; they do not alone establish reproduction or genetic exchange.

cues.title: 不同结论需要不同证据
cues.caption: 通行、个体身份和亲子遗传证据逐层补充。
cues.captionEn: Movement, identity and parentage provide distinct evidence.
cues.zh: 影像回答是否通行，个体鉴定回答是谁，亲子关系和遗传结构再提供繁殖与交流证据。班夫研究综合了这些层次。本地保护案例也应保留来源、年代、方法和限制，再讨论栖息地保护、连通与易地保护如何互补。
cues.en: Images show movement; identification establishes who crossed. Parentage and genetic structure add evidence about reproduction and exchange. Banff researchers combined these layers. Retain sources, dates, methods and limits when examining how habitat protection, connectivity and off-site conservation complement each other.

cues.title: 回用要把输出也记进去
cues.caption: 氮标记经过回用，收获与损失仍保留在账中。
cues.captionEn: Nitrogen reuse retains harvest and loss in the accounting.
cues.zh: 跟住二十四个氮标记：作物吸收土壤养分，部分随收获输出，部分经过饲养和处理后回用。输出与损失始终留在账中。关闭回用，养分就留在储存库。物质循环并非永远无损，也不表示能量回到了最初状态。
cues.en: Follow twenty-four nitrogen labels through crops, harvest, livestock and treatment. Some return to soil; harvest and losses remain accounted for. Disable reuse and nutrients remain stored. Matter cycling is not lossless, and it does not return energy to its original state.

cues.title: 选择组分还要匹配环境
cues.caption: 环境适合与利用容量，限制系统能否维持。
cues.captionEn: Environmental fit and uptake capacity constrain persistence.
cues.zh: 同样的水分条件，让耐旱型和耐湿型功能群有不同表现。这里是性状模型，不是地方树种推荐。生物更新需要适宜环境，也受利用容量限制：输入十份养分、只能利用六份，剩余四份不会因为画了循环箭头就消失。
cues.en: Under the same moisture, dry-adapted and wet-adapted groups respond differently. These are trait models, not local species recommendations. Renewal requires suitable conditions and adequate capacity. With ten nutrient units entering and only six used, four remain regardless of the recycling arrows.

cues.title: 液体与气体沿各自通路走
cues.titleEn: Follow distinct liquid and gas routes
cues.caption: 养分留在所示液体路径，沼气从气室引出。
cues.captionEn: Tracked nutrients follow the slurry route; biogas leaves the gas space.
cues.zh: 看两条独立通路：有机物进入厌氧池，液体经出料和溢流管到达收集处，所示氮标记一直走液体路线。另一些有机碳转化为主要含甲烷和二氧化碳的沼气，从气室引出。剖面解释连接，不是施工图，也未模拟完整处理过程。
cues.en: Trace two separate routes. Inputs enter the anaerobic vessel; slurry and the nitrogen labels reach collection through outlet and overflow pipes. Other organic carbon becomes biogas, mainly methane and carbon dioxide, leaving the gas space. This explains connections, not construction or complete treatment kinetics.

cues.title: 把参观转成可追溯的设计依据
cues.titleEn: Turn a visit into traceable design evidence
cues.caption: 观察、访谈和待核实效果分别记录。
cues.captionEn: Record observations, interviews and unverified effects separately.
cues.zh: 参观时核对设施、管路、沼气利用和沼液去向。向管理者询问用量、成本与维护，并标明访谈来源。再结合本地气候、材料和管理能力提出方案。连接顺畅的示意图不能证明生态与经济效益，效果仍需实际数据检验。
cues.en: During a visit, check structures, pipes, gas use and digestate destinations. Record managers’ answers about quantities, costs and maintenance as interview evidence. Consider local climate, materials and management when designing a proposal. A connected diagram alone cannot establish ecological or economic benefits.

cues.title: 先算清一个样方里的碳
cues.titleEn: First account for carbon within one plot
cues.caption: 植被、凋落物和土层分别计量，再统一面积。
cues.captionEn: Measure vegetation, litter and soil separately before area conversion.
cues.zh: 把样方中的地上植物、根系、凋落物和土壤分别记账。利用干质量、碳比例、容重、土层深度与石砾比例，换算成每公顷碳量。改变面积会改变植被密度，改变深度会改变计入的土壤碳。这些是计算示例，不是全国调查原始样本。
cues.en: Account separately for aboveground biomass, roots, litter and soil. Convert dry mass, carbon fraction, density, depth and coarse fragments into carbon per hectare. Sample area changes vegetation density; depth changes included soil carbon. These are calculation examples, not original national-survey samples.

cues.title: 样方多，不等于面积大
cues.titleEn: More sampled plots do not mean more land
cues.caption: 全国或区域汇总要按各类生态系统面积加权。
cues.captionEn: Regional aggregation weights ecosystem densities by their areas.
cues.zh: 区域中森林二十公顷、草地五十、农田三十。多采森林样方，不会扩大森林面积。按面积加权，均值仍是六十二；按样方个数平均，过度抽样会抬高结果。真实调查还要评价代表性和误差，不能把一个方便样方推广到全国。
cues.en: The region has twenty hectares of forest, fifty of grassland and thirty of cropland. More forest samples do not enlarge its area. Area weighting retains a mean of sixty-two; plot-count weighting changes with oversampling. Real inventories also require representativeness and uncertainty.

cues.title: 库存、年变化和年代不能混用
cues.titleEn: Keep stocks, annual change and dates distinct
cues.caption: 201.1 Tg C/年是2001—2010的历史综合估计。
cues.captionEn: 201.1 Tg C per year is a historical 2001–2010 synthesis.
cues.zh: 总项目约一万七千个样方，碳储量论文使用其中一万四千三百七十一个。二零一一到二零一五是野外调查期；年均二点零一亿吨碳汇则是二零零一到二零一零的历史综合估计。库存、年变化和年代要分开，吨碳也不等于吨二氧化碳。
cues.en: The overall project had roughly seventeen thousand plots; the carbon-stock paper used fourteen thousand three hundred seventy-one. Fieldwork was in 2011–2015; the annual sink of about 201 million tonnes of carbon describes 2001–2010. Keep stocks, yearly changes, dates, carbon and carbon dioxide distinct.

cues.title: 先找证据，再给硫定位
cues.caption: 不同现象，怎样连成同一张硫的转化图？
cues.captionEn: How do different observations connect on one sulfur map?
cues.zh: 黄色分散物、使品红褪色的气体、撤去热源后仍前进的红热带，为什么都能放进同一张图？先认出证据，再追踪硫。负二、零、正四和正六价，是电子归属的记账。换反应伙伴，硫可能给出电子，也可能接收；图上的箭头要由具体反应来支撑。
cues.en: A yellow dispersion, gas that fades fuchsin, and a glow that travels after the heater is removed: how do these belong on one map? Start with the evidence, then follow sulfur. Minus two, zero, plus four and plus six are electron-accounting states. A different partner can make sulfur give up electrons or receive them. Every arrow needs a reaction behind it.

cues.title: 三个硫，电子怎样对上账？
cues.caption: 两个低价硫给出的份额，由同一个高价硫接收。
cues.captionEn: Two donors supply the electron units received by one sulfur.
cues.zh: 先看硫化物与亚硫酸对应的生成硫路线。这里只展开三个硫的净账：两个负二价的硫各给出两份电子，一个正四价的硫接收四份。三个硫都有自己的标记，最后都记为零价，没有一个硫从画面外补进来。胶囊表示电子份额，不是溶液中飞行的自由电子。
cues.en: Consider the sulfur-forming route associated with sulfide and sulfurous acid. Focus on its three sulfur centres. Each of the two at minus two gives up two electron units; the centre at plus four receives all four. Keep their identities: the same three sulfurs finish at zero. No extra sulfur appears. The capsules represent an electron account, not free electrons flying through the solution.

cues.title: 褪色相同，转化上限也相同吗？
cues.titleEn: The same fading, the same conversion limit?
cues.caption: 先确定净反应终点，才能计算电子需求。
cues.captionEn: The assumed endpoint determines the electron demand.
cues.zh: 酸性高锰酸钾的紫色消退，说明它被消耗，却不能替硫选定终点。假设锰最后是正二价，两份高锰酸根接收十份电子。先猜：这够转化同样多的硫化物吗？到单质硫，每个硫给出两份，最多转化五份；到硫酸根，每个给出八份，最多只有一点二五份。这是两条净账假设，不是颜色给出的产物分析。
cues.en: Fading purple shows permanganate being consumed, but does not select sulfur’s endpoint. Assume manganese ends at plus two: two permanganates accept ten electron units. Predict whether that budget converts the same amount of sulfide. Reaching elemental sulfur supplies two units per sulfur, allowing five. Reaching sulfate supplies eight per sulfur, allowing only one point two five. These are alternative net balances, not products identified from colour.

cues.title: 沿导管追踪生成气体
cues.titleEn: Trace the product gas through the tube
cues.caption: 铜与热浓硫酸反应，气体通入品红后使其褪色。
cues.captionEn: Copper reacts with hot concentrated acid; the product gas fades fuchsin.
cues.zh: 沿着导管看气体的去向。铜与热浓硫酸反应，生成的二氧化硫进入品红溶液，使颜色褪去。编号实验使用可提起的螺旋铜丝，章末活动使用铜片；教学入口会保留这个差别。这个反应的气体不是氢气：硫酸中的硫从正六价被还原到正四价。
cues.en: Follow the connected gas path. Copper reacts with hot concentrated sulfuric acid, producing sulfur dioxide that fades fuchsin. The numbered experiment uses a liftable copper coil; the chapter activity uses a copper piece, and its entry preserves that distinction. The gas is not hydrogen: sulfur is reduced from plus six to plus four.

cues.title: 结束反应，保留观察对象
cues.titleEn: End the reaction and preserve the sample
cues.caption: 结束反应后，先让反应体系冷却。
cues.captionEn: End the reaction and let the system cool.
cues.zh: 生成气体的过程结束了，先保留反应后的样品并让它冷却。编号实验可以把铜丝提出液面来停止新增反应，章末铜片装置则显示停止加热后的状态。提起铜丝不会让已经形成的产物倒退消失。后续观察针对的是同一反应所得物。
cues.en: Gas production ends and the reaction sample is kept to cool. In the numbered experiment the wire lifts out of the liquid; the chapter activity instead shows the copper-piece apparatus after heating stops. Lifting the wire does not erase products already formed. The next observation follows the same reaction material.

cues.title: 两个硫，为什么走向两处？
cues.titleEn: Why do two sulfurs take different destinations?
cues.caption: 同一净反应中，一个硫留在盐里，一个进入气体。
cues.captionEn: One sulfur stays in sulfate; the other enters the gas.
cues.zh: 冷却所得物进入水中，蓝色为溶液中的铜离子补上证据。跟住两份硫酸里的两个硫：A留在硫酸盐中，仍是正六价；B进入二氧化硫，降到正四价。其余氧和氢配成两份水。假如只有一份硫酸和一份铜，铜还能全部反应吗？按这个净反应，最多转化半份铜；多放铜也补不上缺少的酸。活动入口借用的是前文编号实验的溶液证据。
cues.en: Adding the cooled material to water gives blue solution, supporting the presence of dissolved copper ions. Follow two sulfurs from the acid. The first sulfur stays in sulfate at plus six. The second sulfur enters sulfur dioxide at plus four. The remaining oxygen and hydrogen make two waters. With only one acid unit and one copper unit, can all the copper react? This net equation allows only half a copper unit. More copper cannot replace missing acid. The activity entry borrows the earlier numbered experiment’s solution evidence.

cues.title: 只点热粉末条的一端
cues.titleEn: Heat one end of the powder strip
cues.caption: 局部热源让一小段铁硫混合物开始反应。
cues.captionEn: A local heat source starts reaction in a small part of the iron–sulfur mixture.
cues.zh: 把视线转到陶土网上的铁硫粉末条。灼热玻璃棒只接触一端，最先变红的是靠近接触点的一小段。模型没有把整条粉末同时点亮：局部温度达到反应阈值后，反应才释放热量。玻璃棒随后移开，接下来要看反应是否还能继续。
cues.en: Move to the iron–sulfur powder strip on the ceramic support. A hot glass rod contacts one end, so only a small nearby region first glows. The whole strip is not switched on at once: local heating starts a reaction that releases more heat. The rod is then removed, letting us test whether the reaction continues.

cues.title: 移开热源，红热带继续前进
cues.titleEn: The glowing front continues without the rod
cues.caption: 放热与热传递推动反应前沿，反应后的区域逐渐冷却。
cues.captionEn: Released heat and heat transfer sustain the front; reacted regions cool.
cues.zh: 外部热源已经移开，红热带仍向未反应区域传播。反应释放的热量传给相邻粉末，触发下一段反应；后方的物质逐渐冷却变暗。铁被氧化，硫被还原，理想主反应生成硫化亚铁。传播速度与颜色只是无量纲模型的表达，不是测得的温度曲线。
cues.en: The external heater is gone, yet the glowing front moves into unreacted powder. Released heat reaches neighbouring material and triggers further reaction, while the material behind cools and darkens. Iron is oxidized and sulfur reduced in the ideal main reaction forming iron-two sulfide. Front speed and glow are dimensionless model outputs, not measured temperatures.

cues.title: 黑色产物一定纯吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a black product have to be pure?
cues.caption: 先用初始量预测剩余物，再看颜色的限度。
cues.captionEn: Use initial amounts to predict what remains.
cues.zh: 按教材的起始质量，铁比主反应所需的量略多。先猜：变黑之后一定只剩硫化亚铁吗？理想主反应算得约一点三七克硫化亚铁，还留下约零点一三克铁；总质量仍是原来的一点五克。这还没有算空气：铁或硫也可能与氧气反应。颜色不能代替成分分析，净账的结论必须带着反应条件一起使用。
cues.en: The textbook’s starting masses contain slightly more iron than the main reaction needs. Predict: must the black product contain only iron sulfide? The ideal balance gives about one point three seven grams of iron sulfide and leaves zero point one three grams of iron. Together they retain the original one point five grams. This excludes air reactions: iron or sulfur can also react with oxygen. Colour cannot replace composition analysis, and a net balance must retain its conditions.

cues.title: 盐水和水封承担不同作用
cues.titleEn: Brine and the seal have different roles
cues.caption: 菜料在液面下，坛盖裙边插在水槽中。
cues.captionEn: Food stays below brine; the lid skirt enters the water trough.
cues.zh: 先看剖面：菜料浸没在盐水下，顶部留出空间。坛盖边缘插入外侧水槽，减少空气进入；水槽干涸后，这个边界就失效。水封和菜料上方的盐水不是同一层液体。
cues.en: In section, vegetables remain below the brine with space above. The lid skirt sits in an outer water trough to limit air entry. A dry trough loses that boundary. The sealing water is separate from the food brine.

cues.title: 发酵进程需要实际记录
cues.caption: 这里选择乳酸生成的简化路径，不预测可食用时间。
cues.captionEn: This selected lactic pathway does not predict edibility.
cues.zh: 乳酸菌利用糖，产物逐渐积累。模型只选择同型乳酸发酵，高盐会降低示意速率。打开空气并不等于所有乳酸菌立刻停止活动；真实菌群、温度和品质仍需记录。
cues.en: Lactic bacteria use sugars and products accumulate. This model selects homolactic fermentation, with high salt reducing the illustrative rate. Air exposure does not instantly stop every lactic bacterium. Real communities, temperature and quality require observations.

cues.title: 不同取样日，答案为何不同
cues.caption: 独立时点的记录，先升后降。
cues.captionEn: Separate time points show a rise and fall.
cues.zh: 教材这组记录中，亚硝酸盐先升后降。每个点来自不同取样日，不是一管液体反复变色。先取有代表性的样品，再保留提取、移取和稀释的量。蔬菜中的硝酸盐可被一些微生物还原成亚硝酸盐，亚硝酸盐也会被后续过程去除。同一曲线并不能告诉我们，具体是哪一种菌或哪一种酶在作用。
cues.en: In this textbook example, nitrite first rises, then falls. Each point belongs to a separate sampling day, not one tube repeatedly changing color. Take representative samples and preserve extraction, transfer and dilution quantities. Some microbes can reduce vegetable nitrate to nitrite; later processes can also remove nitrite. This curve alone cannot identify which organism or enzyme caused the change.

cues.title: 存量由生成与去除共同决定
cues.titleEn: Formation and removal determine the stock
cues.caption: 跟住同一份氮，比较进入和离开。
cues.captionEn: Track the same nitrogen into and out of the pool.
cues.zh: 每个时点都需要空白与标准校准，稀释倍数也要保存。现在换成解释模型：标记追踪同一份氮，不是完整化学反应。生成比去除快，亚硝酸盐积累；去除占优势，存量下降。保持生成过程相同，如果后续去除更快呢？先预测，再重算：积累更少。真实条件还需多时点取样检验，不能据此给所有泡菜规定一个安全天数。
cues.en: Use blanks and standards at each time point, keeping the dilution factor. Now switch to an explanatory model. Markers track the same nitrogen, not complete chemical reactions. Faster formation builds the nitrite stock; faster removal lowers it. Keep formation unchanged: what if removal is faster? Predict first, then rerun the model: less accumulates. Test real conditions with multiple sampling times. This does not establish a universal safe fermentation day.

cues.title: 糖转成乙醇，碳也进入气体
cues.titleEn: Sugar forms ethanol and gaseous carbon
cues.caption: 理想反应同时生成乙醇和二氧化碳。
cues.captionEn: The ideal reaction forms both ethanol and carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 酵母的酒精发酵把一摩尔葡萄糖转成两摩尔乙醇和两摩尔二氧化碳。碳没有凭空消失，一部分沿气体通路离开。真实培养还会形成菌体和其他产物，这里只算主反应。
cues.en: Ideal alcoholic fermentation converts one mole of glucose to two moles each of ethanol and carbon dioxide. Carbon is retained in products, including gas leaving the vessel. Real cultures also produce biomass and other compounds; only the main reaction is balanced here.

cues.title: 限制空气进入，同时留出排气路径
cues.titleEn: Limit incoming air while venting gas
cues.caption: 气泡沿瓶颈和水弯离开，不穿过瓶壁。
cues.captionEn: Gas follows the neck and water bend, never the bottle wall.
cues.zh: 瓶内留有空间，产生的气体沿瓶颈进入排气水弯，再从出口离开。本图是排气装置重建；教材采用定时松盖。酿酒条件并不意味着把正在产气的容器完全封死。
cues.en: Headspace remains above the liquid. Produced gas travels through the neck, water bend and outlet. This is an airlock reconstruction; the textbook uses scheduled cap loosening. Fermentation conditions do not mean sealing a gas-producing vessel without an outlet.

cues.title: 醋酸菌需要新的供氧条件
cues.caption: 乙醇氧化为乙酸，需要从外界供给氧气。
cues.captionEn: Oxidizing ethanol to acetic acid requires external oxygen.
cues.zh: 切换到醋酸发酵，纱布保留气体交换通路。氧气进入液体，乙醇才按所选反应生成乙酸和水。关闭供氧，模型不继续转化；这并不表示任意开盖果酒都会按计划成为果醋。
cues.en: For vinegar, gauze preserves gas exchange. Oxygen enters the liquid, allowing ethanol to form acetic acid and water in the selected reaction. Without oxygen the model stops conversion. Simply opening any bottle does not guarantee controlled vinegar production.

cues.title: 大罐不是按比例放大的小瓶
cues.titleEn: A large tank changes transport demands
cues.caption: 相似放大时，面积增长慢于体积。
cues.captionEn: With similar scaling, surface area grows slower than volume.
cues.zh: 相似罐的线性尺寸加倍，体积变成八倍，表面积只有四倍。单位体积可用的传热面积下降。工业化还要解决供氧、混合、散热和污染控制，不能只把家庭方法的用量放大。
cues.en: Doubling every dimension gives eight times the volume but four times the surface area. Heat-transfer area per unit volume falls. Industrial production must address oxygen, mixing, cooling and contamination control, rather than simply multiplying a small recipe.

cues.title: 比较流程需要有出处的资料
cues.caption: 菌种、灭菌、发酵与分离分别留下依据。
cues.captionEn: Document strain, sterilization, fermentation and recovery separately.
cues.zh: 查阅一个具体果酒或果醋生产流程，逐项比较菌种来源、设备灭菌、条件监测和产物分离。记录工艺年代、规模和资料出处。这里提供调查顺序，不把流程动画当成已经完成的工厂调查。
cues.en: Investigate a specific wine or vinegar process. Compare strain sources, equipment sterilization, process monitoring and recovery. Record date, scale and source. The sequence guides an investigation; it does not pretend that a factory study has already been completed.

cues.title: 部件要连到真正工作的地方
cues.titleEn: Connect each component to its working location
cues.caption: 空气到达底部散气器，电机连接叶轮。
cues.captionEn: Air reaches the bottom sparger; the motor connects to impellers.
cues.zh: 跟着空气进入底部散气器，再沿液体上升并从顶部排出。电机轴连接浸在液体中的叶轮。冷却水走外侧夹套，传感器接触培养液；这些连接承担不同任务，不能混成同一条管路。
cues.en: Follow air into the bottom sparger, upward through liquid and out at the top. The motor shaft connects submerged impellers. Cooling water uses an outer jacket while sensors contact the broth. These paths have distinct functions and must remain separate.

cues.title: 溶氧取决于传入和消耗
cues.titleEn: Dissolved oxygen balances transfer and use
cues.caption: 供氧与搅拌改变传质，微生物持续耗氧。
cues.captionEn: Aeration and mixing affect transfer while microbes consume oxygen.
cues.zh: 先看通气，再看停止通气的对照。液体中的溶氧由气液传入和微生物消耗共同决定。探索时关闭搅拌，示意传质系数下降；关闭空气后也不会把已有溶氧瞬间删除。
cues.en: Compare supplied air with stopped aeration. Dissolved oxygen reflects transfer from gas minus microbial consumption. In exploration, stopping mixing lowers the illustrative transfer coefficient. Stopping air does not instantly erase oxygen already dissolved in the liquid.

cues.title: 冷却夹套改变的是热量收支
cues.titleEn: The jacket changes the heat balance
cues.caption: 产热仍在继续，夹套把热量带走。
cues.captionEn: Heat production continues while the jacket removes heat.
cues.zh: 比较关闭和开启冷却的温度变化。示意模型持续产热，夹套通过与冷却水的温差带走热量。通气、搅拌和温度都应服务于所选菌种与产品；这里的参数不是实际生产设定。
cues.en: Compare temperature with cooling off and on. Heat production continues, while the jacket removes heat through the temperature difference. Aeration, mixing and temperature must suit the chosen organism and product. These illustrative parameters are not production settings.

cues.title: 有水，不等于气体就被吸收
cues.titleEn: Water alone does not absorb every gas
cues.caption: NO与水接触后仍为无色气体，气相没有明显消失。
cues.captionEn: NO remains colourless in contact with water; the gas does not visibly disappear.
cues.zh: 教材先在注射器里放入一氧化氮和少量水，再封住管口振荡。一氧化氮不容易溶于水，画面里的气体仍然存在。无色只说明没有明显的可见颜色，不能说明没有气体。活塞位置和液面由同一份气体与液体账本计算。
cues.en: The textbook first combines nitric oxide with a little water in a sealed syringe and shakes it. Nitric oxide has low water solubility, so gas remains. Colourless does not mean absent. The piston position and liquid level are derived from one shared inventory of gas and liquid.

cues.title: 吸入空气，出现红棕色
cues.caption: 空气中的O₂把部分NO氧化成红棕色NO₂。
cues.captionEn: O₂ in the admitted air oxidizes part of the NO to red-brown NO₂.
cues.zh: 打开夹子吸入空气，再封住管口。颜色出现，是空气中的氧气把一部分一氧化氮氧化成二氧化氮。按教材体积，并把空气的氧体积分数近似取百分之二十一，十毫升空气只带入二点一毫升氧气，最多先生成四点二毫升等效的二氧化氮。
cues.en: Open the clip to admit air, then close it again. Oxygen converts part of the nitric oxide into red-brown nitrogen dioxide. With the textbook volumes and air approximated as twenty-one percent oxygen, ten milliliters of air supplies only two point one milliliters of oxygen, initially making at most four point two milliliters of nitrogen-dioxide equivalent.

cues.title: 颜色消退，仍有NO留下
cues.caption: NO₂与水作用后颜色消退，同时又生成一部分NO。
cues.captionEn: NO₂ reacts with water, losing colour while regenerating some NO.
cues.zh: 再振荡，二氧化氮与水反应，红棕色消退。但每三份二氧化氮只有两份氮进入硝酸，另一份又回到一氧化氮。理想账本中，最初二十毫升一氧化氮仍剩十七点二毫升等效量。因此这一次变清，并不意味着氮氧化物已经完全进入液相。
cues.en: On shaking again, nitrogen dioxide reacts with water and the brown colour fades. Of every three nitrogen-dioxide units, only two nitrogen atoms enter nitric acid; one returns as nitric oxide. The ideal balance still leaves seventeen point two of the initial twenty milliliters of nitric-oxide equivalent. Clearing therefore does not mean complete absorption.

cues.title: 检查氧气账本
cues.caption: 要把剩余NO继续转入液相，还需要足够的O₂。
cues.captionEn: Transferring the remaining NO into solution requires enough O₂.
cues.zh: 把多次氧化和吸收合起来，净反应是四份一氧化氮消耗三份氧气，生成四份硝酸。十毫升空气提供的氧气，在这里最多让百分之十四的初始氮进入液相。作为计算对照，二十毫升一氧化氮需要十五毫升纯氧的等效量，才可能在足量水和理想完全反应下全部转化。
cues.en: Combining repeated oxidation and absorption gives four nitric oxides plus three oxygens forming four nitric acids. Oxygen in ten milliliters of air transfers only fourteen percent of the initial nitrogen into solution in this model. As a calculation comparison, twenty milliliters of nitric oxide needs fifteen milliliters of pure-oxygen equivalent for complete ideal conversion with enough water.

cues.title: 浓硝酸与铜的产物
cues.caption: 教材浓硝酸条件下，铜反应主要生成NO₂。
cues.captionEn: In the textbook concentrated-acid case, copper mainly produces NO₂.
cues.zh: 转到铜与硝酸的对照。浓硝酸条件下，气体主要是二氧化氮，反应管内便能看见红棕色。铜被氧化成铜离子，硝酸中的氮从正五价降到正四价。尾气沿连接的支管进入教材的处理装置；这里只比较反应现象，不把颜色当作产率测量。
cues.en: Now compare copper reacting with nitric acid. In the concentrated-acid case, the main gas is nitrogen dioxide and brown colour appears in the reaction tube. Copper becomes copper ions while nitrogen falls from plus five to plus four. The side arm leads to the textbook’s treatment apparatus. Colour is an observation, not a yield measurement.

cues.title: 稀硝酸的主要气体不同
cues.titleEn: Dilute acid gives a different main gas
cues.caption: 教材稀硝酸条件下，铜反应主要生成无色NO。
cues.captionEn: In the textbook dilute-acid case, copper mainly produces colourless NO.
cues.zh: 把条件改为教材所指的稀硝酸，主要气体变成无色的一氧化氮，氮从正五价降到正二价。铜同样被氧化，并不是因为气体无色就没有反应。这两个方程式是教材的代表情况，不能通过一根浓度滑块推断所有真实混合产物的比例。
cues.en: Under the textbook’s dilute-acid condition, the main gas is colourless nitric oxide, with nitrogen reduced from plus five to plus two. Copper is still oxidized; absence of gas colour does not mean absence of reaction. These equations are representative textbook cases, not a concentration slider that predicts every real product mixture.

cues.title: 分清直接生成与后续氧化
cues.titleEn: Separate primary product from later oxidation
cues.caption: NO接触O₂后也会变成NO₂，出现红棕色。
cues.captionEn: NO also turns into red-brown NO₂ after contact with O₂.
cues.zh: 最后让生成的一氧化氮再接触氧气，它也会变成二氧化氮而显红棕色。于是两条路径可能得到相似的颜色，却有不同的反应先后：一种直接生成二氧化氮，另一种先生成一氧化氮，再被氧化。判断产物时，要追踪气体经历过什么，不能只记住最后的颜色。
cues.en: Finally let the formed nitric oxide meet oxygen. It too becomes red-brown nitrogen dioxide. Similar final colours can therefore follow different sequences: direct nitrogen-dioxide formation, or nitric oxide followed by oxidation. Identify a product by tracing what the gas experienced, rather than memorizing only its final colour.

cues.title: 化石中的组合特征
cues.caption: 同一件化石：骨架与羽毛同时存在。
cues.captionEn: One fossil: skeletal and feather evidence together.
cues.zh: 羽毛只属于现代鸟类吗？看这同一件近鸟龙化石：骨架有恐龙的特征，前后肢旁又保存了羽毛痕迹。两类特征在一起，支持鸟类与恐龙的亲缘关系。这里是证据位置示意，并不证明这一个体就是现代鸟类的直接祖先。
cues.en: Do feathers belong only to living birds? Look at this one Anchiornis specimen: dinosaur skeletal features occur alongside feather traces around its limbs. Their combination supports a relationship between birds and dinosaurs. This diagram locates evidence; it does not establish this individual as a direct ancestor of living birds.

cues.title: 功能不同，骨骼关系仍对应
cues.caption: 先预测，再揭示鲸前肢的独立观察。
cues.captionEn: Predict, then reveal the whale observation.
cues.zh: 人的手臂和蝙蝠的翼，功能不同，骨骼连接却能对应：一根肱骨，接桡骨和尺骨，再接腕、掌和指。先遮住鲸的骨骼。如果这些前肢来自共同祖先，游泳的鳍里会保留什么？现在揭晓教材中的观察：连接依然对应，比例已经改变。猫的前肢也提供一份比较。这是多种观察共同支持的解释，不是现代动物互相变形。
cues.en: A human arm and a bat wing do different jobs, yet their bones correspond: one humerus, then radius and ulna, followed by wrist, palm and digits. Hide the whale bones. If these limbs share ancestry, what relationships should a swimming flipper retain? Reveal the textbook observation: corresponding connections, changed proportions. The cat adds another comparison. Several observations support this explanation; modern animals are not transforming into each other.

cues.title: 比较同源的发育结构
cues.caption: 比较同源区域，不是重演成体进化。
cues.captionEn: Compare homologous regions, not adult replay.
cues.zh: 胚胎图突出咽部和尾部。教材用鳃裂这一传统表述，但人的胚胎并没有长出能像鱼一样呼吸的鳃；更准确地说，是比较同源的咽弓、咽囊等发育结构。不同动物的胚胎也不是完全相同。发育相似性是证据之一，不是一个现代动物先变成另一个的过程。
cues.en: These embryos emphasize pharyngeal and tail regions. The textbook’s traditional gill-cleft wording does not mean a human embryo grows functional fish gills. The comparison concerns homologous pharyngeal arches, pouches and related structures. Embryos are not identical, and development does not replay a sequence of modern adult animals.

cues.title: 比较同一分子的差异
cues.titleEn: Compare differences in the same molecule
cues.caption: 同一蛋白的差异数：独立的一类证据。
cues.captionEn: Fixed counts for the same protein.
cues.zh: 再看教材给出的细胞色素c数据。与人的序列比较，黑猩猩没有氨基酸差异，猕猴有一个，表中另一些生物差异更多。这里展示的只是教材报告的差异个数，没有虚构具体替换位点。不能把单个蛋白的差异直接换算成精确分化年代，也不能靠它独自确定完整的进化树。
cues.en: The textbook compares cytochrome c with the human sequence. Chimpanzee has no amino acid differences, macaque has one, and several other organisms have more. We show reported difference counts without inventing specific substitutions. One protein alone does not determine a complete evolutionary tree or an exact divergence date.

cues.title: 环境改变，个体颜色保留
cues.titleEn: The environment changes; individuals retain their color
cues.caption: 背景改变，三只蛾的基因型保持。
cues.captionEn: New background; unchanged genotypes.
cues.zh: 把同样的三种基因型放到不同树皮背景下。教材把黑色设为显性：两个显性等位基因，或显隐各一个，都呈黑色；两个隐性等位基因呈浅色。背景改变后，可见度与生存繁殖机会可能改变。每只蛾保留自己的颜色和基因型。选择影响已有变异的比例，并不是把每只浅色蛾改成黑色。
cues.en: Keep the same three genotypes on different bark. In this textbook model, two dominant alleles, or one dominant and one recessive allele, give a dark moth. Two recessive alleles give a pale moth. Visibility and reproductive success can change with the background. Each moth keeps its genotype and color. Selection favors existing variants; it does not rewrite each pale moth into a dark one.

cues.title: 用当年的总数重新计算
cues.caption: 11、22、63：数两份等位基因，而非只数黑蛾。
cues.captionEn: 11, 22, 63: count alleles, not just dark moths.
cues.zh: 从十、二十、七十只蛾开始。黑色两类每年增加百分之十，浅色减少百分之十。第二年是十一、二十二、六十三只，共九十六只。现在数显性等位基因：十一只各贡献两个，二十二只各贡献一个，共四十四个。所有等位基因共一百九十二个，频率约百分之二十三。这个教材练习直接更新基因型数量，没有另加随机交配假设。
cues.en: Start with ten, twenty and seventy moths. Both dark classes grow by ten percent; the pale class declines by ten percent. Year two gives eleven, twenty-two and sixty-three: ninety-six moths. Count dominant alleles: eleven moths contribute two each, and twenty-two contribute one each. That is forty-four among one hundred ninety-two, about twenty-three percent. This textbook exercise updates genotype counts directly, without an added random-mating assumption.

cues.title: 空白纸片与三个平行对照
cues.titleEn: A blank disk and three matched drug disks
cues.caption: 药物浓度与生长阈值共同决定空圈。
cues.captionEn: Concentration and growth threshold set the zone.
cues.zh: 虚拟平板保留教材的四个区域：一个空白纸片，三个相同抗生素纸片。模型让浓度随距离衰减，只有低于生长阈值的地方形成菌苔。三个纸片给出直径与平均值，但单位是模型长度，不是实测毫米。标出的R三是预先设定的耐受克隆，用来检验选择的逻辑。
cues.en: The virtual plate retains four textbook regions: one blank disk and three matched antibiotic disks. Concentration declines with distance; growth occurs below a stated threshold. We report three diameters and their mean in model units, not measured millimeters. R-three is a preassigned tolerant clone used to examine selection logic.

cues.title: 跟住被选中的克隆
cues.caption: 选择已有差异；普通对照不会自动变耐受。
cues.captionEn: Select existing variation; test the control.
cues.zh: 跟住原平板中的R三，再看由它的后代形成的新平板。这个假设模型里，较高的生长阈值使抑菌圈变小，随后保持，而不是每传一次就凭空变得更耐药。移除预设克隆，结果也会改变。真实纸片观察本身不能独自证明变异出现的时刻，需要其他实验与对照。
cues.en: Follow R-three from the original plate to a new plate formed by its descendants. Under this hypothesis, its higher growth threshold gives a smaller zone, which then stays stable. Resistance does not magically rise with every transfer. Removing the preset clone changes the result. Real disk observations alone do not establish when a mutation arose.

cues.title: 屏障先改变交流
cues.titleEn: A barrier first changes gene flow
cues.caption: 频率分化，不自动证明形成新物种。
cues.captionEn: Divergence alone does not establish a new species.
cues.zh: 河流把鼠群分到两侧，个体交流受到限制。我们另外假设两侧选择条件不同，计算一个等位基因的频率如何分开。这里没有把差异超过某个数字就直接判成新物种。地理隔离、遗传差异和生殖隔离是需要分别考察的事实，也没有一个统一的物种形成倒计时。
cues.en: A river divides the mouse population and restricts exchange. With an additional assumption of different selection on each side, one allele’s frequency diverges. No numerical threshold automatically declares new species. Geographic separation, genetic differences and reproductive isolation require separate evidence; there is no universal speciation countdown.

cues.title: 屏障消失，还要检验生殖
cues.caption: 还要检验：后代能否继续繁殖？
cues.captionEn: Test whether the offspring can reproduce.
cues.zh: 假设河流消失，比较两种待检验结果。如果仍能产生可育后代，交流可以恢复；如果已经有阻止可育后代产生的生殖隔离，地理障碍消失也不代表交流恢复。这是两种条件分支，不是同一群体在几秒内先恢复又突然失去繁殖能力。
cues.en: Suppose the river disappears. Two alternatives must be tested. If the populations still produce fertile offspring, exchange can resume. If reproductive barriers prevent fertile offspring, removing geography does not restore exchange. These are alternative outcomes, not one population gaining and losing fertility within seconds.

cues.title: 菌落为何停留在原来的落点？
cues.titleEn: Why does growth keep the starting sites?
cues.caption: 生长放大，落点不变。
cues.captionEn: Growth preserves starting sites.
cues.zh: 菌落不是凭空出现的点。跟住A、B、C三个接种起点，在适宜的营养、温度和时间下，细胞繁殖，原来的小点逐渐变成可见菌落。生长放大了起点，却没有告诉我们每个起点是一个细胞，还是相连的一小团细胞。
cues.en: Colonies do not appear from nowhere. Follow starting sites A, B and C. With suitable nutrients, temperature and time, cells multiply and those sites grow into visible colonies. Growth makes a starting site visible, but does not reveal whether it began as one cell or a small attached cluster.

cues.title: 每一段只带出上一段的一小部分
cues.titleEn: Each streak carries a small part of the last
cues.caption: 越往后，生长起点越分散。
cues.captionEn: Later streaks separate starting sites.
cues.zh: 为什么越往后，菌落越容易分开？接种环重新处理并冷却，再从上一段末端带走少量菌体，新的生长起点就更稀疏。画面始终保留这些落点。探索时取消段间处理，比较密集起点如何妨碍分离；数量变化只是教学示意。
cues.en: Why do later streaks yield better-separated colonies? After treatment and cooling, the loop carries a small part of the preceding streak onward. Fewer starting sites make separation easier, and their positions stay fixed. In Explore, remove treatment between regions and compare crowded growth. The numbers illustrate dilution, not measured cell transfer.

cues.title: 空白也长菌，还能相信本批结果吗？
cues.titleEn: Can this batch survive a growing blank?
cues.caption: 空白长菌，本批判读无效。
cues.captionEn: A growing blank invalidates this batch.
cues.zh: 接种平板长出菌落，还不能证明它们都来自目标样品。现在看同条件培养的未接种平板：起初空白，后来也出现了菌落。这一次空白异常，让本批纯培养判读失效，需要查明污染并重新检验。即使空白正常，单菌落也不等于完成菌种鉴定。
cues.en: Growth on the inoculated plate does not prove that every colony came from the intended sample. Watch the matched uninoculated plate: initially clear, it later grows a colony. That failed blank invalidates this batch’s purity interpretation. Investigate contamination and repeat the check. Even a clear blank would not establish the organism’s identity.

cues.title: 并行筛选先统一指标
cues.titleEn: Use a consistent metric for parallel screening
cues.caption: 分母改变，排序也会改变。
cues.captionEn: Change the denominator, change the rank.
cues.zh: 微孔板让多个候选同时培养和检测。这个二十四孔例子保留孔位身份，按同一指标比较产量。若改为单位菌体产量，排序可能变化。微型培养的供氧和蒸发也会影响结果，不能只挑颜色最深的孔。
cues.en: A microplate supports parallel culture and measurement. This twenty-four-well example preserves identities and compares a consistent output metric. Ranking per unit biomass can change the order. Oxygen and evaporation also affect miniature cultures; the darkest well is not automatically the best strain.

cues.title: 初筛最高还要经过重复验证
cues.titleEn: The initial leader needs replicated confirmation
cues.caption: 初筛领先，不等于复筛领先。
cues.captionEn: An initial lead may not repeat.
cues.zh: 把同一候选放入独立重复中复筛。示例中，初筛最高的B3在三次复筛中都回落，A4反而保持较高产量。这里的数字是教学数据，不能据此命名真实高产菌株，更不能直接保证放大生产表现。
cues.en: Retest the same candidates with independent replicates. In this example, initial leader B3 falls back in all three repeats, while A4 retains higher output. These are synthetic measurements, not identified high-yield strains or guarantees of industrial performance.

cues.title: 尿素中的氮怎样进入菌体？
cues.titleEn: How does urea nitrogen enter biomass?
cues.caption: 尿素氮，经同化进入菌体。
cues.captionEn: Urea N → usable N → biomass.
cues.zh: 跟住尿素中的两个氮标记。脲酶水解尿素，产生的氨和铵提供可利用氮，再经摄取和同化进入菌体，支持生长。这里假定碳源、能量等其他条件充足。B不能水解尿素；如果直接供给可用氮，它会怎样？比较同条件培养：B在普通氮源下也能生长，无氮时则不能继续增殖。这是能力的教学模型，不是菌种鉴定。
cues.en: Follow two nitrogen markers from urea. Urease hydrolysis supplies ammonia and ammonium; uptake and assimilation put that nitrogen into biomass, supporting growth. We hold carbon, energy and other needs sufficient. Candidate B cannot hydrolyze urea. What if usable nitrogen is supplied directly? Compare matched cultures: B can then grow on the other nitrogen source, but cannot keep multiplying without nitrogen. This is a model of abilities, not organism identification.

cues.title: 稀释链同时保存体积和样品量
cues.titleEn: Dilution preserves volume and sample accounting
cues.caption: 稀释改变浓度，样品量可追踪。
cues.captionEn: Dilute concentration; track sample mass.
cues.zh: 土样先建立初始悬液，再连续稀释。看一毫升从已混匀源液进入九毫升稀释液，得到下一档十倍稀释。移液前后，样品量仍可追踪。计算时必须包含最初土样悬液，不能只数后面的试管。
cues.en: Prepare the initial soil suspension before serial dilution. One millilitre of a mixed source enters nine millilitres of diluent, producing the next tenfold level after mixing. Sample material remains traceable. Include the initial suspension when calculating, not just the later tubes.

cues.title: 在合适稀释度保留重复平板
cues.titleEn: Use replicate plates at a suitable dilution
cues.caption: 三个重复，保留原始计数。
cues.captionEn: Three replicates, all counts retained.
cues.zh: 同一稀释度设置三个平板，示例分别得到九十六、一百零三和一百零一个菌落。教材用三十到三百作为该练习的计数范围。实际记录需保留接种体积、培养条件、观察时点和异常，不任意删除不喜欢的数值。
cues.en: Three plates at the same dilution give 96, 103 and 101 colonies in the example. This textbook exercise uses a countable range of thirty to three hundred. Keep plated volume, culture conditions, reading time and anomalies; do not discard inconvenient values arbitrarily.

cues.title: CFU计的是形成菌落的单位
cues.caption: 一个菌落，可能来自一团细胞。
cues.captionEn: One cluster can form one colony.
cues.zh: 平均一百个菌落，来自零点一毫升、每毫升含十的负五次方克原土样当量的接种液，换算为每克一亿CFU。它不是直接数出一亿个细胞：细胞团和无法在这些条件下培养的微生物都会影响解释。
cues.en: A mean of one hundred colonies from 0.1 millilitre containing 10⁻⁵ grams of original soil equivalent per millilitre gives 10⁸ CFU per gram. This is not a direct count of individual cells: clusters and organisms unable to grow under the chosen conditions limit interpretation.

cues.title: 空气检测要知道是否采了已知体积
cues.titleEn: Air counts require a known sampled volume
cues.caption: 没有空气体积，就不能按立方米换算。
cues.captionEn: No air volume, no CFU/m³.
cues.zh: 有计量体积的主动采样，可以把菌落数换算为每立方米。自然沉降平板没有已知空气体积，要记录面积和暴露时间。画面的气流路径是方法示意；走访时还要了解设备、培养条件和回收效率。
cues.en: Known-volume active air sampling can support a count per cubic metre. A settle plate has no measured air volume, so retain exposed area and time instead. The airflow is a method diagram; an investigation must also examine equipment, culture conditions and recovery efficiency.

cues.title: 水和牛奶要保留各自检测条件
cues.titleEn: Water and milk retain their own test conditions
cues.caption: 相同菌落数，原样浓度可以不同。
cues.captionEn: Same counts, different original concentrations.
cues.zh: 水样和牛奶都可能以体积报告结果，但稀释、培养方法和评价依据未必相同。探索中切换两种样品，比较原样浓度如何受稀释倍数影响。一次菌落计数不能替代病原体鉴定或完整质量评价。
cues.en: Water and milk may both use volume-based reporting, but dilution, culture methods and assessment criteria can differ. Switch samples to see dilution affect the inferred original concentration. A colony count does not replace pathogen identification or complete quality assessment.

cues.title: 土壤调查保留地点和质量基准
cues.titleEn: Soil investigations retain site and mass basis
cues.caption: 每克结果，要说明质量口径。
cues.captionEn: Per gram needs a defined mass basis.
cues.zh: 土壤真菌或放线菌调查先保留地点、深度、取样质量和稀释链，再说明培养条件与干湿重口径。四类检测是选做调查项目，个人访谈与观察从空白记录开始，动画没有替你完成一次环境检测。
cues.en: For soil fungi or actinomycetes, retain site, depth, sample mass, dilution and culture conditions, including the dry- or wet-mass basis. These four sample types are investigation options. Own interviews and observations start blank; the animation has not completed environmental testing for you.

cues.title: 水还没有进入
cues.caption: 干燥充氨烧瓶内外气压近似平衡，水不会自行上升。
cues.captionEn: Before water enters, the gas pressure is near ambient and water does not rise by itself.
cues.zh: 先观察倒置的充氨烧瓶。玻璃管连接下方的水，但水还没有进入瓶内。此时内外气压接近相等，水不会因为氨在上面就自动上升。画面的空心点只是追踪无色气体的示意，并不是肉眼能看见的氨分子。
cues.en: Look at the inverted ammonia-filled flask. A glass tube connects it to the water below, but water has not yet entered the flask. Inside and outside pressures are nearly equal, so ammonia being above the water does not itself make water rise. Hollow dots trace colourless gas schematically; they are not visible ammonia molecules.

cues.title: 第一滴水改变气相
cues.titleEn: The first drop changes the gas
cues.caption: 少量水溶解氨，气相分子数减少，瓶内压强下降。
cues.captionEn: A little water dissolves ammonia, reducing the gas inventory and the inside pressure.
cues.zh: 现在让少量水从滴管进入烧瓶。氨极易溶于水，部分气体进入液相，瓶内气相分子数减少。温度近似不变时，气相减少使压强下降。原来平衡的两端出现压差，这是喷泉启动的原因；最初滴入的清水还不含酚酞。
cues.en: A little water now enters from the dropper. Ammonia dissolves readily, transferring some of the gas into the liquid and reducing the gas inventory. At approximately fixed temperature, this lowers the inside pressure. The resulting pressure difference starts the fountain. The initial drop is plain water and does not yet contain phenolphthalein.

cues.title: 大气压推动连续入水
cues.caption: 外界大气压推动水沿玻璃管进入；更多水又溶解更多氨。
cues.captionEn: Atmospheric pressure drives water through the tube; more water dissolves more ammonia.
cues.zh: 水面受到外界大气压作用，水沿玻璃管向压强较低的烧瓶流入。进入的水又溶解氨，使入水过程得以继续。喷流来自同一个压差与流量计算，碰到瓶壁后回落；液面升高淹没喷口后，自由喷流不再画在液面上方。
cues.en: Atmospheric pressure acts on the reservoir, driving water through the tube into the lower-pressure flask. Incoming water dissolves more ammonia and sustains the process. The jet follows the same pressure-flow calculation and falls after reaching the vessel wall. Once the rising liquid submerges the nozzle, no free jet is drawn above the surface.

cues.title: 粉红色发生在水相
cues.caption: 氨在水中形成少量NH₄⁺和OH⁻，含酚酞的水显粉红色。
cues.captionEn: Dissolved ammonia forms some NH₄⁺ and OH⁻, turning the indicator water pink.
cues.zh: 下方水中预先加入了酚酞，进入烧瓶后显出粉红色。颜色属于溶液，并不是氨气本身变成粉红色。用离子关系表示，氨与水建立平衡，形成少量铵根与氢氧根。这里以净离子关系说明碱性，没有把所有溶解氨都画成完全电离。
cues.en: Phenolphthalein was added to the reservoir water, which turns pink after entering the flask. The colour belongs to the solution, not to ammonia gas. In ionic terms, dissolved ammonia establishes an equilibrium with water, forming some ammonium and hydroxide ions. This net relation explains alkalinity without suggesting complete ionization of dissolved ammonia.

cues.title: 残余空气留下不同终点
cues.titleEn: Residual air leaves a different endpoint
cues.caption: 空气不随氨同样被大量吸收，会限制烧瓶的最终进水量。
cues.captionEn: Air is not absorbed like ammonia and limits the final water intake.
cues.zh: 最后比较两只教学模型烧瓶：一只只留少量空气，另一只残留较多空气。氨被溶解以后，空气仍占据气相；随着水进入，它被压缩，瓶内压强恢复，入水趋于停止。最终液量因而依赖初始气体组成。百分数是模型计算的液体体积分数，不是教材实测数据。
cues.en: Finally compare two model flasks, one with little residual air and one with much more. As ammonia dissolves, air remains in the gas space. Incoming water compresses that air until pressure recovers and inflow approaches a stop. Final filling therefore depends on the initial gas composition. Percentages are calculated liquid-volume fractions, not textbook measurements.

cues.title: 实验室里的尿素
cues.caption: 1828年，维勒由氰酸铵得到尿素。
cues.captionEn: In 1828, Wöhler obtained urea from ammonium cyanate.
cues.zh: 从氰酸铵到尿素，组成并没有增加生命特有的元素。维勒在实验室中完成这次转化，为有机物能够由非生物原料制得提供了证据。这个发现推动了观念变化，却不是一天之内终结全部生命力论。
cues.en: Start with ammonium cyanate, then compare the urea obtained in the laboratory. No special element of life has been added. Wöhler’s finding helped establish that an organic substance could come from nonbiological starting material. Its historical influence developed over time.

cues.title: 组成相同，连接改变
cues.caption: 氰酸铵是离子化合物；尿素中原子按另一方式连接。
cues.captionEn: The ionic salt and molecular urea have different connections.
cues.zh: 数一数，两者都有一个碳、一个氧、两个氮和四个氢。氰酸铵中的正负离子，不能直接当成一个尿素分子。再看尿素，两个氮都与羰基碳相连。这里显示的是结构和原子计数对照，不是把历史反应简化成一次直接换键。
cues.en: Count the atoms: one carbon, one oxygen, two nitrogen atoms and four hydrogens. The charged ions of ammonium cyanate differ from the covalent urea molecule, where both nitrogen atoms bond to the carbonyl carbon. These are endpoint structures, not a proposed one-step mechanism.

cues.title: 碳骨架的三种连接
cues.caption: 五个碳、十二个氢，可以对应三种碳骨架。
cues.captionEn: Five carbons and twelve hydrogens give three different skeletons.
cues.zh: 先看正戊烷的连续碳链，再看出现支链的异戊烷。到了新戊烷，中心碳连着四个碳。每个碳补足四个键以后，三种结构的氢总数仍然都是十二。不同的是谁和谁相连，而不只是纸上画得弯曲还是笔直。
cues.en: Follow the carbon connections in pentane, then isopentane, then neopentane. The last has a central carbon bonded to four other carbons. Completing each carbon’s valence still gives twelve hydrogens. What changes is connectivity, not simply whether the drawing looks bent.

cues.title: 双键换了位置
cues.caption: 碳骨架相同，双键位置不同。
cues.captionEn: The carbon skeleton stays the same; the double-bond position changes.
cues.zh: 这两条碳链都含四个碳。第一条在一号和二号碳之间有双键，第二条在二号和三号之间有双键。相应碳上的氢数跟着键级改变，分子式都还是碳四氢八。这就是位置异构。
cues.en: Both chains contain four carbons. In but-1-ene the double bond joins the first two carbons. In but-2-ene it joins the middle pair. The hydrogens adjust to carbon valence, leaving the same formula, C four H eight. This is positional isomerism.

cues.title: 氧连接谁
cues.caption: 乙醇含羟基；二甲醚的氧连接两个碳。
cues.captionEn: Ethanol has an O–H group; dimethyl ether has C–O–C.
cues.zh: 观察同样的一个氧。乙醇中，它连接一个碳和一个氢；二甲醚中，它连接两个碳。两个分子的组成都是碳二氢六氧，但官能团不同。分子式只能告诉我们原子有多少，不能独自回答它们怎样连接。
