cues.en: Track the oxygen atom. In ethanol it bonds to a carbon and a hydrogen. In dimethyl ether it bonds to two carbons. Both have the formula C two H six O, but they contain different functional groups. Composition alone cannot identify the connections.

cues.title: 双键的旋转限制
cues.titleEn: Why the double bond resists rotation
cues.caption: 两个p轨道的侧向重叠，在正交时消失。
cues.captionEn: Sideways p-orbital overlap vanishes when the orbitals are perpendicular.
cues.zh: 碳碳双键除了沿轴的西格玛键，还有来自侧向重叠的派键。假想把一端的轨道转到正交方向，侧向重叠就消失了。所以不能把完整双键当成一根可以自由旋转的铰链。这里的重叠指标只说明几何关系，不是反应能量。
cues.en: A carbon double bond includes a sigma bond along the axis and a pi bond from sideways orbital overlap. In this hypothetical twist, perpendicular orbitals lose that sideways overlap. An intact double bond is therefore not a freely rotating hinge. The displayed overlap factor is geometric, not a reaction-energy calculation.

cues.title: 同侧与异侧
cues.caption: 双键每端各接两种不同基团，才可能有顺反异构。
cues.captionEn: Each double-bond carbon must have two different substituents.
cues.zh: 顺二丁烯的两个甲基处在双键同一侧，反二丁烯则在两侧。换一个观察角度，这个关系不会改变。再想一个反例：如果一端连着两个相同的氢，所谓上下互换并不会得到新的顺反异构体。
cues.en: In cis-but-2-ene, the methyl groups lie on the same side of the double bond; in the trans form they lie on opposite sides. Turning the whole molecule does not change that relationship. If either end instead carries two identical hydrogens, exchanging them does not create a cis–trans pair.

cues.title: 先称样品
cues.caption: 已知样品只含C、H、O，先记录质量。
cues.captionEn: Start with a weighed sample known to contain only C, H and O.
cues.zh: 要知道一个有机物含多少碳和氢，不能只看燃烧的颜色。先称出样品质量，并确认它只含碳、氢、氧三种元素。接下来让这些元素进入可以分别收集的产物，再利用质量守恒倒推组成。
cues.en: Flame color cannot tell us how much carbon and hydrogen an organic sample contains. First record its mass and establish that it contains only carbon, hydrogen and oxygen. Then convert its elements into products that can be collected separately and use mass conservation to work backward.

cues.title: 让碳氢变成可收集的产物
cues.titleEn: Convert carbon and hydrogen into collectable products
cues.caption: 充分氧化后，碳进入CO₂，氢进入H₂O。
cues.captionEn: Complete oxidation transfers carbon into CO₂ and hydrogen into H₂O.
cues.zh: 看加热管中的样品与氧化铜。充分氧化以后，碳进入二氧化碳，氢进入水。放大的标记沿同一条气路前进。别把产物中的全部氧都算成样品原来的氧，因为氧化铜也提供了氧。
cues.en: In the heated tube, copper oxide helps oxidize the sample. Complete oxidation puts carbon into carbon dioxide and hydrogen into water. Follow the enlarged markers along the gas path. Product oxygen does not all come from the original sample; copper oxide supplies additional oxygen.

cues.title: 分别收集，分别称量
cues.caption: 先吸收水，再吸收CO₂，增重来自各自产物。
cues.captionEn: Collect water first, then CO₂; each mass gain identifies a product amount.
cues.zh: 先经过无水氯化钙，水被截留，除水管增重。二氧化碳继续进入碱液球管，那里也逐渐增重。两个读数分别来自两种产物。若省去除水这一步，碱液管还会收进水，就会把碳含量算得过高。
cues.en: Water is retained by anhydrous calcium chloride, increasing the drying tube’s mass. Carbon dioxide continues into the alkaline absorption bulbs and increases their mass. Those separate gains represent different products. Without the drying stage, collected water would falsely inflate the carbon estimate.

cues.title: 由质量求原子比
cues.caption: 先算元素质量，再除以原子量，最后约成最简比。
cues.captionEn: Find element masses, divide by atomic masses, then reduce the ratio.
cues.zh: 二氧化碳的增重可以换算成碳的质量，水的增重可以换算成氢的质量。已知只含这三种元素，剩余质量才归为氧。把各元素质量除以相应原子量，得到的最简原子比是二比六比一，实验式就是碳二氢六氧。
cues.en: Convert collected carbon dioxide into a carbon mass and collected water into a hydrogen mass. Only because the sample is known to contain these three elements can the remaining mass be assigned to oxygen. Divide by atomic masses and reduce the result: two to six to one, giving the empirical formula C two H six O.

cues.title: 结论能到哪一步
cues.titleEn: How far does the evidence go?
cues.caption: 元素分析给出组成，不能独自确定原子的连接。
cues.captionEn: Elemental analysis gives composition, not the atomic connections.
cues.zh: 同样的碳二氢六氧，既可能对应乙醇，也可能对应二甲醚。燃烧分析本身分不开这两种连接。通常还需要摩尔质量来判断分子式，再用红外或核磁共振等结构证据继续鉴定。实验式、分子式和结构式，是不同层次的答案。
cues.en: Ethanol and dimethyl ether share the same composition, so combustion analysis alone cannot distinguish their connections. In general, molar mass is also needed to establish a molecular formula, followed by structural evidence such as infrared or NMR spectra. Empirical formula, molecular formula and structure answer different questions.

cues.title: 外植体是整个过程的起点
cues.titleEn: The explant anchors the whole process
cues.caption: 同一茎段在适宜条件下形成愈伤组织。
cues.captionEn: The same stem segment forms callus under suitable conditions.
cues.zh: 从经过处理、方向正确的幼嫩茎段开始，部分插入培养基。周围细胞增殖，形成愈伤组织。画面压缩了培养时间，真实实验需记录污染、正常生长和诱导所用条件，不能只看最终有没有绿色组织。
cues.en: Begin with a prepared young stem segment in the correct orientation, partly inserted into medium. Proliferating cells form callus. Time is compressed; real work records contamination, normal growth and induction conditions rather than judging only whether green tissue appears.

cues.title: 更换培养条件后再诱导芽
cues.titleEn: Change culture conditions to induce shoots
cues.caption: 芽从原来的组织上长出，不是换一个植物图标。
cues.captionEn: Shoots emerge from the existing tissue, preserving its origin.
cues.zh: 将生长良好的愈伤组织转入适合诱导生芽的培养条件。看芽从原来的组织上长出，形成茎和叶。激素、营养、光照和外植体状态共同影响结果；不是所有细胞都会无条件地表现出全能性。
cues.en: Transfer suitable callus to conditions for shoot induction. Shoots emerge from the existing tissue and develop stems and leaves. Hormones, nutrition, light and explant state all matter; not every cell expresses totipotency under every condition.

cues.title: 完整植株还需要根的再生
cues.titleEn: A plantlet also needs regenerated roots
cues.caption: 根与已有的茎组织保持连接。
cues.captionEn: Roots remain connected to the existing stem tissue.
cues.zh: 生芽后再进入诱导生根阶段。根从已有组织延伸，形成能够继续培养的试管苗。各阶段培养基和环境可以不同，不能把脱分化、生芽、生根当成一瓶培养基里必然按时发生的连续结果。
cues.en: After shoots develop, root-induction conditions support connected roots and a plantlet. Media and environments can differ between stages. Dedifferentiation, shoots and roots are not guaranteed to occur on schedule in one unchanged culture vessel.

cues.title: 从瓶内到瓶外需要适应
cues.caption: 先逐步适应，再观察移栽后的存活。
cues.captionEn: Acclimatize gradually, then record survival after transplanting.
cues.zh: 培养瓶打开后，幼苗逐步适应瓶外环境，再转入适当基质。画面切换的是培养阶段，玻璃并没有变成花盆。移栽后仍需记录生长和存活；获得试管苗不等于已经获得能正常生长的成株。
cues.en: After opening the vessel, plantlets gradually adapt before transfer to a suitable substrate. The scene changes stages; glass does not turn into a pot. Record subsequent growth and survival. Producing a plantlet does not establish successful mature growth outside culture.

cues.title: 去除的是细胞壁，膜仍保留
cues.titleEn: Remove the wall while retaining the membrane
cues.caption: 原生质体仍由完整细胞膜包围。
cues.captionEn: An intact membrane still surrounds each protoplast.
cues.zh: 植物细胞壁妨碍直接融合。通过适当方法去壁后，获得仍由细胞膜包围的原生质体。两种颜色只标记不同来源，既不是实际染料，也不是各物种真实的染色体数量。
cues.en: Cell walls impede direct fusion. Appropriate wall removal yields protoplasts still enclosed by cell membranes. The two colours only distinguish origins; they are not actual dyes or the chromosome counts of the parent species.

cues.title: 先接触，才形成共同细胞边界
cues.titleEn: Contact precedes a shared cell boundary
cues.caption: 共同膜边界形成后，内部仍保留两来源成分。
cues.captionEn: A shared membrane encloses components from both origins.
cues.zh: 在适当诱导条件下，两枚原生质体先接触，再形成连续的共同边界。内部的两来源成分保持可追踪，不能让分子穿过尚未融合的膜。画面只演示成功融合的一种过程，实际还可能出现未融合和同来源融合。
cues.en: Under suitable induction, protoplasts contact before forming a continuous common boundary. Components remain traceable inside; they do not cross an unfused membrane. This depicts one successful fusion, while real preparations can contain unfused cells and same-parent fusions.

cues.title: 核来源与细胞壁再生分别观察
cues.titleEn: Track nuclei and wall regrowth separately
cues.caption: 共同细胞内发生后续变化，再培养和筛选。
cues.captionEn: Further changes occur inside the shared cell before culture and selection.
cues.zh: 融合后的细胞继续发生核与细胞壁的变化，随后还要培养、筛选和再生。核内四个图形是来源标记，数量保持不变。细胞器也来自原先两侧，但后续植株未必稳定保留两套细胞器遗传物质。
cues.en: After fusion, nuclei and walls undergo further changes before culture, selection and regeneration. Four nuclear shapes preserve origin identity, not actual chromosome counts. Organelles also enter from both sides, but regenerated plants need not retain both organelle genomes stably.

cues.title: 杂种身份不保证期待的性状组合
cues.titleEn: Hybrid identity does not guarantee desired traits
cues.caption: 核编码产物的双亲本证据，与整株性状分开判断。
cues.captionEn: Evidence from both nuclear parents differs from whole-plant performance.
cues.zh: 番茄与马铃薯的原始研究，用核编码蛋白产物等证据确认杂种，不能只凭绿色植株外观。教材明确指出，得到杂种并未实现地上结番茄、地下长马铃薯的设想。细胞融合与性状评价是不同层次的证据。
cues.en: The original tomato–potato study used evidence including nuclear-encoded protein products, not merely green plant appearance. As the textbook explains, hybrid production did not achieve the imagined combination of tomatoes above and potatoes below. Fusion and trait performance require different evidence.

cues.title: 无外源激素是独立对照
cues.titleEn: No added hormones is a separate control
cues.caption: 零比零没有可计算的激素比例。
cues.captionEn: Zero divided by zero is not a defined hormone ratio.
cues.zh: 先设置不加外源激素的对照，再与加入激素的条件比较。零比零不能写成比例等于一；外植体本身还可能含有内源激素。各组保留相同材料与其他条件，记录实际分化情况。
cues.en: Compare a no-added-hormone control with hormone-supplemented conditions. Zero divided by zero is not a ratio of one, and explants may contain endogenous hormones. Match material and other conditions and record actual differentiation in each group.

cues.title: 配比改变分化倾向
cues.caption: 根、芽和愈伤组织是需要记录的不同结果。
cues.captionEn: Roots, shoots and callus are distinct outcomes to record.
cues.zh: 示意模型中，较高生长素比例偏向根，较高细胞分裂素比例偏向芽，接近平衡时愈伤组织较明显。这来自经典组织培养思路，不是所有植物的精确阈值。个人生芽和生根记录分别统计，同一个外植体可以同时具备两者。
cues.en: The illustrative model favours roots with relatively more auxin, shoots with relatively more cytokinin, and callus near balance. This reflects a classical tissue-culture framework, not universal thresholds. Record roots and shoots separately because one explant can produce both.

cues.title: 相同比例也可能得到不同结果
cues.titleEn: The same ratio can give different results
cues.caption: 绝对浓度、材料和培养背景仍然重要。
cues.captionEn: Absolute dose, material and culture context still matter.
cues.zh: 把比例都保持为一，同时改变两种激素的绝对浓度，模型响应仍会改变。过低与过高并不等价。因此比较实验要写出具体浓度、激素种类和外植体来源，不能只记录一个比例就推断实际生根或生芽率。
cues.en: Keep the ratio at one while changing both absolute concentrations; the model still changes. Very low and high doses are not equivalent. Record concentrations, hormone identities and explant sources rather than inferring real rooting or shoot rates from a ratio alone.

cues.title: 先追踪两种无色气体
cues.caption: NH₃与HCl从玻璃棒附近扩散，气体本身均为无色。
cues.captionEn: NH₃ and HCl spread from the glass-rod tips; both gases are colourless.
cues.zh: 教材照片把观察点放在两根玻璃棒的尖端附近。氨和氯化氢分别向周围扩散，它们本身都是无色气体。画面用少量空心点帮助追踪氨的扩散方向；这些点是说明标记，不是有颜色的氨气，也不是可以直接看见的单个分子。
cues.en: The textbook photograph focuses on the two glass-rod tips. Ammonia and hydrogen chloride spread into the surrounding space, and both gases are colourless. A few hollow tracer marks help reveal ammonia spreading. They are explanatory marks, not coloured ammonia or individual molecules visible to the eye.

cues.title: 接触区出现新的物质
cues.titleEn: A new substance appears at contact
cues.caption: 两种气体接触并反应，生成白色氯化铵微粒。
cues.captionEn: Where the gases meet and react, white ammonium chloride particles form.
cues.zh: 观察两端之间的区域。两种气体在这里重叠、反应，出现白色的氯化铵微粒。白烟并不是某一种气体原有颜色被放大，而是新物质的出现。模型每生成一份氯化铵，就同时消耗一份氨与一份氯化氢，并把生成物继续保留在画面里。
cues.en: Watch the space between the tips. The gases overlap and react there, forming white ammonium chloride particles. The cloud is a new material, not the amplified colour of either original gas. In the model, each ammonium-chloride unit consumes one ammonia and one hydrogen-chloride unit, and the product remains in the scene.

cues.title: 白烟由微粒构成
cues.caption: 教材中的白烟由悬浮的固体微粒形成，不能等同于水雾。
cues.captionEn: The textbook white smoke consists of suspended solid particles, not simply water mist.
cues.zh: 把观察尺度放大。这里的颗粒是示意，代表白烟中的固体氯化铵，既不是显微照片，也不表示真实粒径或晶体形状。微小固体悬浮在气体中，可以形成我们看到的烟；水雾则由液滴构成。仅凭白色不能辨认所有气溶胶，需要结合来源和物质性质。
cues.en: Zoom in on a schematic particle view. The grains represent solid ammonium chloride, not a micrograph, measured particle size or exact crystal shape. Small solids suspended in gas can form visible smoke; water mist instead consists of liquid droplets. White appearance alone cannot identify every aerosol: its origin and material properties matter.

cues.title: 缺少一种气体的对照
cues.caption: 只保留NH₃时，模型没有生成氯化铵白烟。
cues.captionEn: With NH₃ alone, no ammonium chloride cloud forms in the model.
cues.zh: 最后保留同样的空间和观察时间，但移去氯化氢来源。氨仍在扩散，模型却没有生成氯化铵，白色颗粒也随之消失。这个对照把原因收拢到两种反应物的接触：玻璃棒靠近或者气体扩散本身，并不足以解释白烟。真实成粒还涉及湿度、成核和气流，这里不预测它们的精细影响。
cues.en: Keep the same space and observation time, but remove the hydrogen-chloride source. Ammonia still spreads, yet no ammonium chloride forms and no white particles appear. Contact between the two reactants is the essential cause; nearby rods or diffusion alone do not explain the cloud. Real particle formation also involves humidity, nucleation and airflow, which this model does not resolve.

cues.title: 把样品放进磁场
cues.titleEn: Place the sample in a magnetic field
cues.caption: 磁场与射频激发后，探头接收随时间衰减的信号。
cues.captionEn: After radiofrequency excitation in a magnetic field, the probe receives a decaying signal.
cues.zh: 样品管进入磁体中央，液体来到探头的敏感区域。在磁场中，射频激发改变核自旋体系的状态，探头随后接收到衰减信号。画面把很短的采集过程放慢；这些振荡与接下来的谱峰来自同一组模型参数。
cues.en: The sample tube enters the magnet and the liquid reaches the probe’s sensitive region. Radiofrequency excitation changes the nuclear-spin system, and the probe receives a decaying signal. This short acquisition is slowed down here. The oscillations and later spectrum share the same model parameters.

cues.title: 给六个氢分组
cues.caption: 乙醇有三种氢环境，分别包含3、2、1个氢。
cues.captionEn: Ethanol has three proton environments containing 3, 2 and 1 hydrogens.
cues.zh: 逐组看乙醇中的氢。甲基上有三个等效氢，亚甲基上有两个，羟基上还有一个。颜色连接分子里的位置与谱中的信号组。这里比较的是通常溶液条件下的化学环境，不是数图上每一个小尖峰。
cues.en: Follow the hydrogens in ethanol: three equivalent methyl hydrogens, two methylene hydrogens, and one hydroxyl hydrogen. Color links each molecular environment to its signal group. We are counting environments under ordinary solution conditions, not every small line in the spectrum.

cues.title: 读峰面积，别数峰高
cues.caption: 相对积分为3∶2∶1；宽峰可以低，却仍有面积。
cues.captionEn: Relative integrated areas are 3:2:1; a broad low peak still has area.
cues.zh: 现在沿谱线积分。跨过一组信号，累计曲线就抬高一段，抬高量对应这组信号的面积。三个环境的相对面积是三比二比一。羟基峰画得较宽、较矮，却并不表示没有那个氢。读面积和读峰高是两回事。
cues.en: Integrate across the spectrum. Each signal group raises the cumulative curve by an amount related to its area. The relative areas are three, two and one. The hydroxyl signal is broader and lower in this model, but its proton is still represented. Peak height is not integrated area.

cues.title: 另一种连接只有一组氢
cues.titleEn: One environment in the alternative structure
cues.caption: 二甲醚的两个甲基等效，六个氢给出一组信号。
cues.captionEn: The equivalent methyl groups of dimethyl ether give one six-proton signal.
cues.zh: 把候选结构换成二甲醚。氧连接两个相同的甲基，在这里的通常溶液条件下，六个氢处在等效环境，汇成一组信号。它与乙醇的三组信号不同。因此，氢谱提供了元素分析无法给出的连接信息。
cues.en: Change the candidate to dimethyl ether. Oxygen joins two identical methyl groups, whose six hydrogens are equivalent under the solution conditions represented here. They produce one signal group rather than ethanol’s three. NMR therefore supplies structural evidence that elemental composition cannot provide.

cues.title: 一组信号可以分裂
cues.caption: 乙醇的甲基和亚甲基信号可分成三重峰与四重峰。
cues.captionEn: Ethanol’s methyl and methylene signals can form a triplet and a quartet.
cues.zh: 把两组信号分别放大。甲基受到相邻两个氢的耦合，显示三重峰；亚甲基受到相邻三个氢的耦合，显示四重峰。这是一阶、快交换条件下的示意。分成几条线，并不改变各组对应三个氢和两个氢的总面积。
cues.en: Zoom into the two carbon-bound proton signals. Coupling to two neighboring hydrogens gives the methyl triplet; coupling to three gives the methylene quartet. This is a first-order illustration with rapid hydroxyl exchange. Splitting redistributes the lines without changing the three-proton and two-proton total areas.

cues.title: 羟基峰不是固定指纹
cues.titleEn: The hydroxyl signal is not fixed
cues.caption: OH峰位和可见性依赖条件，交换后其¹H信号可减弱。
cues.captionEn: The OH position and visibility depend on conditions; exchange can reduce its ¹H signal.
cues.zh: 最后跟踪羟基氢。改变氢键和交换条件，峰的位置或形状可以变化，不能死记一个固定数值。若羟基氢与氘交换，常规氢谱中的这份信号会减弱甚至消失；碳上的五个氢仍保留。这是教材三比二比一图像需要附带的条件。
cues.en: Track the hydroxyl proton one last time. Hydrogen bonding and exchange conditions can change its signal, so one fixed shift is not a universal fingerprint. Replacing that proton with deuterium reduces its ordinary proton-NMR signal, while the five carbon-bound hydrogens remain. The textbook’s three-to-two-to-one pattern has conditions.

cues.title: 不同铵盐，共同的离子
cues.caption: NH₄Cl、NH₄NO₃和(NH₄)₂SO₄都含有NH₄⁺。
cues.captionEn: NH₄Cl, NH₄NO₃ and (NH₄)₂SO₄ all contain NH₄⁺.
cues.zh: 教材把三种铵盐放在不同试管中比较。它们的阴离子不同，但都含有铵根。检验要寻找这个共同离子的反应证据。画面先保留未放出气体的状态，红色石蕊试纸位于管口，与试管中的液体分开。
cues.en: The textbook compares three ammonium salts in separate tubes. Their anions differ, but all contain ammonium ions. The test seeks evidence from this shared ion. Initially no gas has been released in the shown state, and red litmus stays near the mouth, separate from the liquid.

cues.title: 加碱后，以气体建立证据
cues.titleEn: Use the released gas as evidence
cues.caption: 铵根与OH⁻反应，生成氨；逸出的氨使湿润红色石蕊变蓝。
cues.captionEn: Ammonium reacts with OH⁻ to form ammonia; released gas turns damp red litmus blue.
cues.zh: 加入强碱，铵根转化成氨；教材加热有利于氨从溶液中逸出。气体到达湿润试纸，在水相里产生碱性，红色石蕊变蓝。三支试管的共同现象指向铵根，而不是三种阴离子都发生同样反应。这里的点只追踪无色氨，不能当作可见气体颜色。
cues.en: Strong base converts ammonium into ammonia, and the textbook warming helps ammonia escape from solution. At the damp paper, ammonia produces an alkaline aqueous layer and red litmus turns blue. The shared observation points to ammonium rather than to an identical reaction of the different anions. Dots only trace colourless gas.

cues.title: 把试纸的条件分开
cues.caption: 湿润且只接触气体的试纸，才提供这里需要的气体证据。
cues.captionEn: Damp paper contacting only the gas provides the required gas-test evidence.
cues.zh: 比较三种情况。湿润试纸接触氨，出现碱性颜色；理想干燥试纸缺少水相，不能照搬同样的解释；如果试纸直接沾到氢氧化钠液体，即使没有氨也可以变蓝。因此观察到蓝色还不够，必须追踪让它变蓝的物质来自哪里。
cues.en: Compare three conditions. Damp paper contacting ammonia develops an alkaline colour. Ideally dry paper lacks the aqueous layer for that explanation. Paper touching sodium hydroxide solution can turn blue even without ammonia. A blue result alone is insufficient: trace the material that produced it.

cues.title: 同一性质用于制取氨
cues.titleEn: Use the same chemistry to generate ammonia
cues.caption: NH₄Cl与Ca(OH)₂反应生成NH₃，导管连接发生端与收集端。
cues.captionEn: NH₄Cl and Ca(OH)₂ form NH₃; the delivery tube connects generation to collection.
cues.zh: 同样的铵盐与碱反应，也用于教材的制氨装置。发生试管中是氯化铵和氢氧化钙，生成氨、水和氯化钙。试管口略向下，避免冷凝水回流到热的管底。沿着同一条导管跟踪气体，它进入倒置收集管的上部。
cues.en: The same ammonium-salt and base chemistry is used in the textbook preparation apparatus. Ammonium chloride and calcium hydroxide produce ammonia, water and calcium chloride. The generating tube slopes slightly downward toward its mouth, limiting condensate returning to its heated end. Follow the continuous delivery tube into the upper part of the inverted collector.

cues.title: 氨进入，空气向下排出
cues.titleEn: Ammonia enters and air leaves below
cues.caption: 氨比空气轻，倒置收集；它进入上部并逐渐排出原有空气。
cues.captionEn: Ammonia is lighter than air: the inverted vessel fills as air leaves below.
cues.zh: 收集管不是一开始就空着，它最初装满空气。氨比空气轻，导管把氨送到上部，再逐渐把原来的气体向下排出。两种标记帮助跟踪混合和排出，不表示气体真实颜色。氨易溶于水，所以这里采用排空气的路径。
cues.en: The collector is not initially empty: it contains air. Ammonia is lighter than air, so the delivery tube feeds its upper region while existing gas is progressively displaced downward. Two marker styles show mixing and displacement, not actual gas colours. Because ammonia dissolves readily in water, this collection path displaces air.

cues.title: 管口变蓝，不等于精确验纯
cues.titleEn: A mouth test does not measure purity
cues.caption: 管口试纸变蓝说明氨到达这里，不能证明空气已经全部排尽。
cues.captionEn: Blue paper at the mouth shows ammonia has arrived, not that every trace of air is gone.
cues.zh: 把观察停回仍有空气的阶段。管口已能出现氨的检验证据，但模型里还保留空气。教材提出如何验满，这是一个需要解释边界的问题：湿润试纸适合确认氨到达管口，却不能单独测定纯度，或严格证明整个容器完全充满纯氨。画面的剩余空气比例只是本模型的计算。
cues.en: Return to a stage where air remains. Ammonia can already reach the mouth and affect the paper while some air stays in the model. The textbook asks how to judge filling, and the limit matters: damp paper can identify ammonia at the mouth but does not measure purity or rigorously prove the whole vessel contains pure ammonia. The remaining-air percentage is a model calculation.

cues.title: 吸收路径中的空气间隙
cues.titleEn: An air gap in the absorption path
cues.caption: 浅浸漏斗的几何体积可以让空气先进入，打断连续吸水。
cues.captionEn: A shallow funnel can expose an air gap before water reaches its narrow stem.
cues.zh: 最后回应教材关于多余氨吸收的讨论。这里另画一个漏斗吸收方案，说明几何关系。溶解导致吸水时，水槽液面下降；若漏斗口浅浸，空气可在水到达细管前进入，打断连续吸水。把漏斗浸得更深，结果可能不同。这是模型讨论，不是声称任意漏斗都能保证防止倒吸。
cues.en: Finally consider the textbook’s question about absorbing excess ammonia. A separate funnel arrangement illustrates the geometry. If dissolution draws water upward, the reservoir level falls. A shallow rim can admit air before water reaches the narrow stem, interrupting a continuous water path. Deeper immersion can behave differently. This is a model discussion, not a guarantee that any funnel prevents suck-back.

cues.title: 苯中溴的去向
cues.caption: 水层变浅、苯层变深，溴只是转移到了另一相。
cues.captionEn: The water layer fades while benzene gains color: bromine changes phase.
cues.zh: 先看溴水与苯接触。苯在上层，水在下层。振荡使两相充分接触，溴更倾向进入有机相，水层颜色就变浅了。跟着这对溴原子的标记，它们并没有断开。只看水层褪色，不能断言发生了加成反应。
cues.en: Benzene forms the upper layer and water the lower one. Better contact allows bromine to partition into the organic phase, so the water layer becomes paler. Follow the intact bromine marker. A fading aqueous layer alone does not prove an addition reaction.

cues.title: 苯与酸性高锰酸钾
cues.caption: 在教材比较条件下，苯不使酸性高锰酸钾褪色。
cues.captionEn: Under the textbook comparison conditions, benzene does not decolorize acidified permanganate.
cues.zh: 换成酸性高锰酸钾，仍然保持两层。紫色留在水层，并没有像普通烯烃检验那样消失。这与上一管溴的萃取是两种不同证据。苯的反应特点与离域的芳香结构有关，不能把画在纸上的苯环当成三个普通烯烃双键。
cues.en: With acidified permanganate, two layers remain and the aqueous purple color persists. That observation differs from bromine extraction. Benzene’s reactivity reflects its delocalized aromatic structure; a drawn benzene ring is not simply three ordinary alkene double bonds.

cues.title: 苯与甲苯：萃取对照
cues.caption: 两种有机相都能萃取溴；总量转移不等于消耗。
cues.captionEn: Both organic phases extract bromine; redistribution is not consumption.
cues.zh: 现在让苯和甲苯接受同样的溴水比较。两者都能让溴进入上层有机相。模型把溴的总量保留，只改变它在两相中的分配。这里不把两种溶剂的真实分配系数设成相同的实验事实，而是用共同假设看清萃取原理。
cues.en: Compare benzene and toluene with bromine water. Both can move bromine into the upper organic phase. The model conserves total bromine and changes only its distribution. A shared illustrative partition coefficient isolates the principle; it is not a claim that the real solvents have identical measured coefficients.

cues.title: 苯与甲苯：氧化对照
cues.caption: 条件化氧化模型中，甲苯消耗氧化剂，苯对照保留紫色。
cues.captionEn: In the conditioned oxidation model, toluene consumes oxidant while the benzene control stays purple.
cues.zh: 再比较酸性高锰酸钾。苯的对照保留紫色，而甲苯在合适的氧化条件下会消耗氧化剂。注意，这次颜色减少对应化学消耗，不是高锰酸根跑进上层。动画压缩的是教学进程，实际现象的快慢还取决于温度、接触和试剂条件。
cues.en: Compare acidified permanganate next. The benzene control stays purple, while toluene consumes oxidant under suitable conditions. This loss of color represents chemical consumption, not permanganate moving into the organic layer. The animation is a teaching sequence; actual timing depends on temperature, contact and reagent conditions.

cues.title: 被氧化的是哪一部分
cues.caption: 苯环保留，甲苯的苄位碳可成为羧基碳。
cues.captionEn: The ring remains; toluene’s benzylic carbon can become a carboxyl carbon.
cues.zh: 跟踪甲苯中紧挨苯环的那个碳。充分侧链氧化后，它成为羧基的碳，苯环仍保留。这个位置原先有苄位氢，是反应判断的重要条件。探索里的叔丁基苯没有苄位氢，正好说明不能把所有带碳侧链的苯都套进同一个结论。
cues.en: Track the carbon directly beside toluene’s ring. Exhaustive side-chain oxidation can turn it into the carboxyl carbon while preserving the ring. A benzylic hydrogen is an important condition. The exploration counterexample, tert-butylbenzene, has none, so an alkyl side chain alone is not enough.

cues.title: 从组织获得分散细胞
cues.caption: 分散前后保留同一组细胞标记。
cues.captionEn: The same cell identities remain before and after dissociation.
cues.zh: 动物细胞培养先要从合适组织获得细胞。适当的机械或酶处理使细胞分散，原来的细胞身份仍可追踪。画面中的十六个标记用于观察过程，不代表真实接种量；具体条件要适合所用材料。
cues.en: Animal-cell culture starts by obtaining cells from suitable tissue. Appropriate mechanical or enzymatic treatment separates them while preserving their identities. Sixteen markers illustrate the process, not an actual inoculum. Conditions must suit the material being cultured.

cues.title: 贴壁与生长限制分开判断
cues.caption: 接触抑制不是所有动物细胞的共同开关。
cues.captionEn: Contact inhibition is not a universal animal-cell switch.
cues.zh: 有些细胞需要贴壁生长，有些可以悬浮生长。示意模型让贴壁细胞随密度增加而逐渐减慢。不同细胞系的接触抑制表现不同，悬浮培养也有营养和空间等限制，不能把不贴壁理解为无限增殖。
cues.en: Some cells require attachment; others grow in suspension. This model slows an adherent culture as density rises. Contact inhibition differs among cell lines, and suspension cultures remain resource-limited. Lack of attachment does not mean unlimited proliferation.

cues.title: 分瓶传代保留来源和液量
cues.titleEn: Passage preserves origins and liquid balance
cues.caption: 同十六个标记分为八与八，液量同步变化。
cues.captionEn: The same sixteen markers split eight and eight with matching liquid changes.
cues.zh: 把分散的细胞转入新培养容器，就能调整密度并提供新培养条件。追踪移液器中的同一批标记：先吸取，抬过瓶口，再进入接收瓶。这里分成八与八，所有容器和移液器的液量同时守恒。
cues.en: Transfer dissociated cells into fresh vessels to adjust density and culture conditions. Follow the same markers: aspirate, lift above the rim, then enter the receiving vessel. The illustrative eight-and-eight split preserves both identities and the combined liquid volume.

cues.title: 气体条件与缓冲体系配套
cues.titleEn: Match gas conditions to the buffer
cues.caption: 固定碳酸氢盐时，二氧化碳增加使模型pH下降。
cues.captionEn: At fixed bicarbonate, more carbon dioxide lowers the model pH.
cues.zh: 培养条件还包括营养、温度、气体和适宜酸碱度。这里固定碳酸氢盐浓度，改变二氧化碳比例，缓冲模型随之改变。百分之五不是所有培养基的统一答案；真实条件需要与细胞和培养基要求配套。
cues.en: Culture also depends on nutrients, temperature, gases and pH. With bicarbonate held fixed, changing carbon dioxide changes this buffer model. Five percent is not a universal answer: the atmosphere must match the cells and their particular medium.

cues.title: 融合两种互补的细胞
cues.caption: B细胞来源与骨髓瘤来源保留在共同细胞中。
cues.captionEn: B-cell and myeloma origins enter one shared cell.
cues.zh: 杂交瘤技术把能产生抗体的B细胞与适当骨髓瘤细胞结合。两类细胞先接触，再形成共同膜边界。动画只追踪一个成功融合的结果，真实混合物中还会有未融合细胞和同类型融合的细胞。
cues.en: Hybridoma technology combines antibody-producing B cells with a suitable myeloma partner. Contact precedes a shared membrane boundary. The animation follows one successful fusion; real mixtures also contain unfused cells and fusions between cells of the same type.

cues.title: 选择培养只是第一道筛选
cues.titleEn: Selective culture is only the first screen
cues.caption: 两种抗体特异性不同的杂交瘤都可能存活。
cues.captionEn: Hybridomas with different antibody specificities can both survive.
cues.zh: 在这里选定的HAT选择体系中，缺少相应补救途径的骨髓瘤不能持续生长；普通B细胞也不能长期增殖。杂交瘤能保留互补性质，但两种杂交瘤都可能存活，选择培养还没有选出目标抗体。
cues.en: In the selected HAT system, the salvage-deficient myeloma cannot persist, and ordinary B cells have a limited lifespan. Hybridomas combine complementary properties. Both illustrated hybridomas can survive, so selective culture has not yet identified the desired antibody.

cues.title: 检测抗体是否识别目标
cues.titleEn: Test recognition of the target antigen
cues.caption: 相同检测条件下，只有H-A的示意抗体与目标结合。
cues.captionEn: Under matched conditions, only H-A antibodies bind the illustrated target.
cues.zh: 接着比较不同杂交瘤产生的抗体。画面中的目标抗原保持相同，H-A的抗体发生结合，H-B没有结合。这是特异性检测的示意，实际还需要合适阴性、阳性和背景对照，不能只凭细胞存活作出结论。
cues.en: Compare antibodies from different hybridomas against the same target. H-A binds while H-B does not. This illustrates specificity testing; real assays need suitable negative, positive and background controls. Survival alone cannot establish the required antibody specificity.

cues.title: 单细胞来源需要独立确认
cues.caption: 有限稀释降低多细胞概率，但不自动证明单克隆。
cues.captionEn: Limiting dilution reduces multiple occupancy but does not prove monoclonality.
cues.zh: 获得目标抗体后，还要克隆化并反复确认。图中的谱系以单细胞来源已经确认作为前提。平均每孔零点三个细胞时，泊松模型仍有少量孔含多个细胞；平均一个细胞更不等于每孔恰好一个。
cues.en: After identifying the desired antibody, clone and recheck the cells. The lineage diagram assumes that single-cell origin has been verified. Even at a mean of point three cells per well, a Poisson model allows multiple cells; a mean of one never guarantees exactly one.

cues.title: 移出MⅡ纺锤体—染色体复合物
cues.caption: 卵细胞质和其中的线粒体仍保留。
cues.captionEn: Oocyte cytoplasm and its mitochondria remain.
cues.zh: 体细胞核移植先要处理受体卵母细胞。教材中的去核，在MⅡ阶段更准确地说是移出纺锤体—染色体复合物。看复合物沿微管离开卵细胞；卵细胞质及其中细胞器并没有同时消失。
cues.en: Somatic-cell nuclear transfer requires preparation of the recipient oocyte. At metaphase two, enucleation more precisely removes the spindle–chromosome complex. Follow it through the pipette while the oocyte cytoplasm and its organelles remain in place.

cues.title: 供体核进入保留的卵细胞质
cues.titleEn: The donor nucleus enters retained oocyte cytoplasm
cues.caption: 已置于卵周隙的供体细胞先接触，再与卵融合。
cues.captionEn: A donor cell already placed in the perivitelline space contacts and fuses with the oocyte.
cues.zh: 这一镜头从供体体细胞已经放入卵周隙开始。适当处理后，供体细胞与去核卵接触并融合，紫色供体核进入共同细胞质。棕色标记一直追踪卵原有的细胞器，不会因为换入一个核而全部变成供体来源。
cues.en: This shot starts after placement of a somatic donor cell in the perivitelline space. Following suitable treatment, it contacts and fuses with the enucleated oocyte. The purple donor nucleus enters shared cytoplasm; brown markers retain the oocyte organelles’ original identity.

cues.title: 融合以后仍需激活与发育
cues.titleEn: Fusion must be followed by activation and development
cues.caption: 早期卵裂不等于已经获得正常出生个体。
cues.captionEn: Early cleavage does not establish a normal live-born animal.
cues.zh: 重构细胞还需要激活，才可能开始早期发育。画面把一、二、四细胞阶段压缩显示，并不是实际发育时间。后续胚胎培养、移植、妊娠和出生仍各有条件与失败可能，不能用卵裂照片直接证明克隆成功。
cues.en: The reconstructed cell needs activation before early development may begin. One-, two- and four-cell stages are compressed in time. Culture, transfer, gestation and birth remain separate stages with their own requirements and failure possibilities; cleavage alone does not prove successful cloning.

cues.title: 三种来源承担不同角色
cues.caption: 核遗传来源、线粒体来源和孕育环境分别说明。
cues.captionEn: Distinguish nuclear origin, mitochondrial origin and gestational environment.
cues.zh: 最后分别追问三个来源：主要核遗传信息来自体细胞供体，线粒体通常主要来自卵供体，妊娠由受体承担。克隆不是所有分子、环境和性状百分之百相同的复制；遗传、重编程和发育环境仍需分别讨论。
cues.en: Ask three separate questions: the somatic donor supplies the main nuclear genome, the oocyte usually supplies most mitochondria, and the recipient provides gestation. Cloning does not duplicate every molecule, environment or trait. Genetics, reprogramming and developmental conditions remain distinct.

cues.title: 先区分溶液与不溶物
cues.titleEn: Separate dissolved ions from insoluble matter
cues.caption: 溶解后，Na⁺、Cl⁻与杂质离子同在水中；不溶物仍是固体。
cues.captionEn: After dissolution, Na⁺, Cl⁻ and impurity ions share the water; insoluble matter remains solid.
cues.zh: 粗盐溶解以后，看起来澄清的部分也不一定只有氯化钠。教材要除去钙离子、镁离子和硫酸根。我们给这些离子加上追踪标记，同时保留杯底不溶物。下一步不是把水蒸掉，而是先把指定的溶解杂质转移到可以分离的固体里。
cues.en: Dissolved crude salt can contain more than sodium and chloride. The textbook targets calcium, magnesium and sulfate ions. Tracer marks identify those ions while insoluble material remains at the bottom. Before removing the water, we must transfer the selected dissolved impurities into solids that can be separated.

cues.title: 硫酸根转移到沉淀
cues.caption: Ba²⁺与SO₄²⁻生成BaSO₄；略过量的Ba²⁺仍留在溶液中。
cues.captionEn: Ba²⁺ and SO₄²⁻ form BaSO₄; excess Ba²⁺ stays in solution.
cues.zh: 加入氯化钡，硫酸根进入硫酸钡沉淀。看硫酸根的份数下降，同时观察钡离子：稍过量的试剂有助于完成目标反应，却也带来了新的溶解成分。这里不能把出现沉淀理解成所有杂质已经除尽。多余的钡离子还需要后续步骤处理。
cues.en: Barium chloride transfers sulfate into barium sulfate precipitate. Follow the declining sulfate amount, then notice barium ions. A small reagent excess helps complete the intended reaction, but also leaves a new dissolved component. The appearance of a precipitate does not mean every impurity has been removed. Excess barium still needs a later step.

cues.title: 在上层清液中检验
cues.caption: 静置后再检验上层清液：新的浑浊提示仍有可反应的SO₄²⁻。
cues.captionEn: After settling, new cloudiness in a supernatant test indicates residual reactive sulfate.
cues.zh: 把已充分沉淀和钡盐不足的两种情况并列。静置后，对上层清液加入少量同种试剂。若又出现新的浑浊，说明还有硫酸根参与反应；模型里的充分沉淀样品不再出现这一变化。这是教材要求的完成性检查，不能只凭原来已经有一堆沉淀来判断。
cues.en: Compare sufficient precipitation with too little barium reagent. After settling, add a small test dose to the clear supernatant. New cloudiness shows that sulfate can still react. The fully treated model sample shows no new cloudiness. This completion check is different from merely noticing that some precipitate already exists.

cues.title: 用氢氧化物带走镁
cues.caption: Mg²⁺与2OH⁻形成Mg(OH)₂，过量OH⁻留待最后处理。
cues.captionEn: Mg²⁺ and 2OH⁻ form Mg(OH)₂; excess OH⁻ remains for later treatment.
cues.zh: 接着加入氢氧化钠。镁离子减少，转移到氢氧化镁固体中。反应比例是一个镁离子消耗两个氢氧根，模型依照这个比例记账。与前一步一样，过量并不会自动消失；剩下的氢氧根也必须在得到精盐以前处理。
cues.en: Sodium hydroxide now transfers magnesium ions into solid magnesium hydroxide. Each magnesium ion consumes two hydroxide ions, and the inventory follows that ratio. As in the previous step, excess reagent does not disappear on its own. Remaining hydroxide must also be dealt with before the final salt is obtained.

cues.title: 碳酸根同时处理钙和钡
cues.caption: CO₃²⁻使Ca²⁺及前面过量加入的Ba²⁺进入沉淀。
cues.captionEn: Carbonate precipitates both calcium and the barium left from the earlier addition.
cues.zh: 碳酸钠在这里有两个目标：原来粗盐中的钙离子，以及刚才过量加入的钡离子。观察两个份数都下降，对应形成碳酸钙和碳酸钡。这就是教材询问钡离子从哪里来的原因。安排试剂顺序时，必须把前一步引入的成分也纳入后一步的清除范围。
cues.en: Carbonate has two targets: calcium originally present in crude salt and barium left from the earlier reagent addition. Both amounts decrease as calcium carbonate and barium carbonate form. This explains the textbook question about where the barium came from. Reagent order must account for components introduced by earlier steps, as well as the original impurities.

cues.title: 把固体与溶液真正分开
cues.caption: 滤纸截留沉淀和不溶物；Na⁺、Cl⁻及过量碱性成分随滤液通过。
cues.captionEn: The paper retains precipitates and insoluble matter; dissolved ions pass with the filtrate.
cues.zh: 现在才把这些固体一起过滤。沿玻璃棒追踪液体进入滤纸，再沿漏斗进入接收烧杯。固体留在滤纸上，溶解的离子随水通过。因此过滤移走的是已经形成的固体，并不能直接拦住溶液里的钠离子、氯离子，或者过量氢氧根和碳酸根。
cues.en: Now filter the collected solids. Follow the liquid along the glass rod, through the paper and funnel, into the receiving beaker. Solids stay on the paper while dissolved ions travel with the water. Filtration removes material already in the solid phase; it does not directly trap sodium, chloride, or excess dissolved hydroxide and carbonate.

cues.title: 为什么不能把加酸提到过滤前
cues.caption: 先过滤再加酸可处理过量OH⁻与CO₃²⁻；提前加酸会使部分沉淀重新溶解。
cues.captionEn: Acid treats excess OH⁻ and carbonate after filtration; adding it earlier can redissolve precipitates.
cues.zh: 给滤液加盐酸，氢氧根转化为水，碳酸根转化为二氧化碳和水。再看反向顺序：如果固体还没有移走就加酸到同样的中性附近，氢氧化镁和两种碳酸盐也会溶解，杂质离子重新回到溶液。教材要求观察气泡并检查酸碱性，气泡停止本身不能代替酸碱性的判断。
cues.en: Acid added to the filtrate converts hydroxide into water and carbonate into carbon dioxide and water. Reverse the order: acidifying the suspension toward the same endpoint can also dissolve magnesium hydroxide and the two carbonates. Impurity ions return to solution. The textbook checks both bubbling and acidity; cessation of bubbles alone cannot establish the final acid-base condition.

cues.title: 蒸发不能补救漏掉的反应
cues.titleEn: Evaporation cannot repair a missed reaction
cues.caption: 处理后的滤液蒸发留下盐；未除去的非挥发杂质也会留下。
cues.captionEn: Evaporating treated filtrate leaves salt; nonvolatile impurities that escaped removal remain too.
cues.zh: 最后从处理后的滤液移走水。出现较多固体后停止直接加热，利用余热完成教材中的收尾。晶粒只示意留下的盐，不是实测结晶速度或产率。自由探索中可以漏加碳酸钠，或者减少钡盐，再观察终点：把水蒸掉并不会自动去掉仍留在水中的杂质。
cues.en: Finally remove water from the treated filtrate. The textbook stops direct heating when substantial solid appears and uses residual heat to finish. Crystal marks indicate retained salt, not a measured crystallisation rate or yield. In exploration, omit carbonate or reduce barium and inspect the endpoint: evaporating water does not automatically remove impurities still dissolved in it.

cues.title: 两类生殖细胞分别准备
cues.caption: 卵母细胞成熟与精子获能是不同过程。
cues.captionEn: Oocyte maturation and sperm capacitation are separate processes.
cues.zh: 体外受精不是把任意精子和卵细胞放在一起。卵母细胞需要达到适合受精的成熟阶段，精子还要完成获能。画面分别表示这两项准备，并不把精子会游动当成已经获能的证明。
cues.en: IVF is more than placing arbitrary gametes together. The oocyte must reach an appropriate mature stage, while sperm must undergo capacitation. These preparations are shown separately; motility alone does not establish that a sperm is capacitated.

cues.title: 先接触，再进入卵细胞
cues.titleEn: Contact precedes entry into the oocyte
cues.caption: 追踪进入的精子来源，区分两个原核。
cues.captionEn: Track the entering sperm origin and distinguish two pronuclei.
cues.zh: 获能精子经过卵外结构后接触卵细胞膜，膜融合后才进入。卵细胞继续完成减数分裂，形成雌原核，精子来源形成雄原核。这里保留两个原核的区别，也显示后来精子被阻挡；没有把原核直接画成两个核互相熔接。
cues.en: After traversing the surrounding structures, a capacitated sperm contacts and fuses with the oocyte membrane. Meiotic completion and sperm remodelling produce female and male pronuclei. Their identities remain distinct, while later sperm are blocked; the two pronuclei are not depicted as simply melting together.

cues.title: 卵裂先增加细胞数
cues.caption: 早期总体积近似不变，各细胞变小。
cues.captionEn: Early total volume remains approximately constant as cells become smaller.
cues.zh: 受精后的早期卵裂增加细胞数量，胚胎总体积在这一阶段近似不变。画面的隔线是剖面示意，不是每个细胞真实三维形状。体外受精只完成技术链的一部分，后续培养、评价和适宜受体仍然重要。
cues.en: Early cleavage increases cell number while total embryonic volume remains approximately constant. Dividers are sectional schematics, not exact three-dimensional blastomere shapes. IVF completes only part of the process; culture, evaluation and a suitable recipient remain necessary.

cues.title: 收集以后逐枚检查
cues.caption: 形态筛选与最终妊娠结果不是同一证据。
cues.captionEn: Morphological selection differs from eventual pregnancy evidence.
cues.zh: 以牛的胚胎移植为例，供体经过适当处理和配种后，收集胚胎并逐枚检查。这里六枚材料保留各自编号，未受精和明显退化的示意材料被排除。形态合格只表示进入下一步评价，不能保证一定产生正常后代。
cues.en: In bovine embryo transfer, donor preparation and breeding are followed by recovery and individual inspection. Six samples retain their identities; unfertilized and visibly degenerate examples are excluded. Suitable morphology supports further evaluation but never guarantees a normal offspring.

cues.title: 让胚胎阶段与受体周期对应
cues.titleEn: Match embryo stage to the recipient cycle
cues.caption: 胚胎阶段需要与受体生理状态相适应。
cues.captionEn: The embryo stage must suit the recipient’s physiological state.
cues.zh: 胚胎需要与同种受体的生理状态相适应。把胚胎日龄与受体周期并排，观察偏差逐渐减小。这里的零偏差是对齐示意，不是要求所有真实移植都精确到同一时刻；允许范围还受种类、胚胎质量和处理条件影响。
cues.en: The embryo must suit the physiological state of a same-species recipient. Compare embryo age with the recipient cycle as their offset narrows. Zero offset illustrates alignment, not a universal exact-time requirement; tolerance depends on species, embryo quality and treatment conditions.

cues.title: 胚胎沿导管进入正确腔道
cues.titleEn: The embryo travels through the catheter into the lumen
cues.caption: 同一E1标记在导管内移动，再从管口释放。
cues.captionEn: The same E1 marker travels inside the catheter before release.
cues.zh: 放大牛生殖道的示意截面，追踪编号E1。导管通过宫颈进入黄体同侧的子宫角，胚胎沿同一腔道从管口释放。它没有穿过组织壁跳到终点；完成移植以后，还需要独立的妊娠检查和后续评价。
cues.en: Follow E1 in an enlarged schematic of the bovine reproductive tract. The catheter passes through the cervix into the uterine horn on the corpus-luteum side, releasing the embryo through its tip. Transfer does not itself establish pregnancy; subsequent checks remain necessary.

cues.title: 先识别囊胚的不同区域
cues.caption: 内细胞团、滋养层与囊胚腔承担不同角色。
cues.captionEn: Inner cell mass, trophectoderm and cavity are distinct structures.
cues.zh: 分割囊胚前，先辨认结构。紫色标记集中在内细胞团，棕色标记沿滋养层分布，中间是囊胚腔。图形数量用于保持来源可追踪，不是教材显微照片的实际细胞计数，也不能把囊胚腔误认为一个巨大细胞核。
cues.en: Before splitting, identify the regions. Purple markers occupy the inner cell mass, brown markers indicate trophectoderm, and the internal space is the cavity. Counts preserve source identity rather than reproducing a microscopy count. The cavity is not a giant nucleus.

cues.title: 分割线同时考虑内细胞团
cues.titleEn: Place the cut through the inner cell mass
cues.caption: 刀具先通过组织，两份才逐渐分开。
cues.captionEn: The blade crosses the tissue before the two portions separate.
cues.zh: 选择发育良好、形态正常的胚胎，显微操作时让内细胞团均衡分配。看刀具先通过组织，随后两份分开，同一组来源标记各有所属。这个几何演示解释分配原则，不表示每一份分割胚都能继续正常发育。
cues.en: Select a well-developed, morphologically normal embryo and distribute the inner cell mass appropriately. The blade crosses first; the two portions then separate with their original markers. This geometry explains allocation, not a guarantee that every split portion will develop normally.

cues.title: 切线偏移会改变两份的组成
cues.titleEn: An offset cut changes the composition of each portion
cues.caption: 一份缺少内细胞团，不能只看分出了两块。
cues.captionEn: One portion lacks inner cell mass: two pieces are not sufficient evidence.
cues.zh: 现在把切线偏移，虽然仍分成两块，内细胞团标记却全部落在同一份里。判断分割不能只数块数，还要看关键细胞群的分配与后续发育证据。来自同一胚胎的后代也不意味着毛色、体重和环境影响全部一样。
cues.en: Offset the cut. Two pieces still form, but all inner-cell-mass markers remain in one. Evaluate essential cell populations and subsequent development, not merely the number of pieces. Shared embryonic origin also does not make every phenotype or environmental influence identical.

cues.title: 水相中的取代
cues.caption: 水溶液中，羟基取代溴，溴离子进入水相。
cues.captionEn: In the aqueous route, hydroxyl replaces bromine and bromide enters water.
cues.zh: 从溴乙烷开始。教材使用氢氧化钠水溶液并加热，净结果是碳溴键被碳氧键替代。碳骨架仍是原来的两个碳，溴则成为水相中的溴离子。这里比较净连接变化，不把连续移动的标记当成真实分子的基元反应轨迹。
cues.en: Start with bromoethane. Heating with aqueous sodium hydroxide gives a net replacement of the carbon–bromine connection by carbon–oxygen. The two-carbon skeleton is retained, and bromine becomes aqueous bromide. The moving labels compare net connections; they do not trace an elementary molecular mechanism.

cues.title: 取上层水样
cues.caption: 溴乙烷在下层；检验应取上层水相到另一管。
cues.captionEn: Bromoethane is the lower layer; transfer the upper aqueous phase for testing.
cues.zh: 反应后的混合物静置分层。溴乙烷比水密度大，所以含有无机离子的水相在上层。吸管从上层取样，再转入另一支试管。后面的银盐检验针对的是这个水样，而不是直接给原来的有机物贴一个有溴的标签。
cues.en: Let the mixture settle. Bromoethane is denser than water, so the aqueous phase containing inorganic ions is above it. Transfer an aqueous sample to another tube. The silver test concerns dissolved bromide in this sample, not bromine still covalently attached to the organic compound.

cues.title: 先酸化再检验
cues.caption: 先排除氢氧根干扰，再把浅黄色沉淀解释为 AgBr。
cues.captionEn: Remove hydroxide interference before interpreting pale yellow AgBr.
cues.zh: 教材先用稀硝酸酸化水样，再加入硝酸银。溴离子可以生成浅黄色溴化银沉淀。如果省略酸化，残余氢氧根也能使银离子产生氧化银干扰。在探索中把水解进程降到零并取消酸化，仍有浑浊，就能看出为什么只凭沉淀不够。
cues.en: The aqueous sample is acidified with dilute nitric acid before silver nitrate is added. Bromide produces pale yellow silver bromide. Without acidification, residual hydroxide can produce silver oxide interference. In exploration, set hydrolysis to zero and omit acidification: a precipitate can still appear, showing why precipitation alone is insufficient.

cues.title: 确认醇类产物
cues.caption: 分离后的产物需要组合证据；O—H 峰本身不能区分两种醇。
cues.captionEn: Use combined evidence after separation; an O–H band alone cannot distinguish two alcohols.
cues.zh: 把碳链延长到一溴丁烷，水相取代的净产物是丁醇。教材要求思考怎样验证产物。可以在分离后结合红外的羟基信息与质谱等结构证据。必须先处理样品中的溶剂：乙醇也有羟基，不能把混合物的一个羟基吸收峰直接当成丁醇的唯一证明。
cues.en: Extend the chain to one-bromobutane. Its aqueous substitution product is butanol. To investigate that product, combine evidence such as hydroxyl absorption in an isolated sample and mass spectrometry. Solvent separation matters: ethanol also has a hydroxyl group, so one O–H band in a mixture is not unique proof of butanol.

cues.title: 醇溶液中的消去
cues.caption: 相邻碳上的氢与溴被脱去，碳骨架上形成双键。
cues.captionEn: Removing hydrogen and bromine from adjacent carbons creates a double bond.
cues.zh: 改用氢氧化钠醇溶液并加热，教材转向消去反应。跟踪与带溴碳相邻的氢：净反应脱去这部分氢和溴，形成碳碳双键，一溴丁烷对应一丁烯。溶剂、温度和底物都会影响取代与消去的竞争，本片不把条件切换说成百分之百的选择性开关。
cues.en: With alcoholic sodium hydroxide and heating, the textbook turns to elimination. Track a hydrogen on the carbon beside the carbon bearing bromine. Their net removal forms a carbon–carbon double bond, giving one-butene from one-bromobutane. Conditions influence competing pathways; this is not a claim of perfect selectivity.

cues.title: 水洗气的对照
cues.caption: 先除去乙醇蒸气，减少高锰酸钾检验的假阳性。
cues.captionEn: Remove ethanol vapor before interpreting the permanganate test.
cues.zh: 生成的气体先经过水，再进入酸性高锰酸钾。绿色标记代表烯烃，金色标记代表可能夹带的乙醇蒸气。有效水洗把乙醇留住，而烯烃通过。乙醇本身也能消耗酸性高锰酸钾，因此取消水洗、只保留杂质的对照，仍可能褪色。
cues.en: The gas passes through water before reaching acidified permanganate. Green marks the alkene; gold marks possible ethanol vapor. An effective water wash retains ethanol while the alkene passes. Ethanol itself consumes acidified permanganate, so an impurity-only stream without washing can still give a color change.

cues.title: 乙醇脱水与碱洗气
cues.caption: 乙醇脱水装置中的碱洗气，针对的是酸性杂质。
cues.captionEn: The alkaline wash in ethanol dehydration targets acidic impurities.
cues.zh: 另一套教材装置用乙醇和浓硫酸制取乙烯。温度计测的是液体温度，教材条件为一百七十摄氏度。气体先经过氢氧化钠溶液，以除去可能夹带的二氧化硫等酸性杂质。这与上一套装置的水洗有不同目的，不能仅凭两者都叫洗气就交换用途。
cues.en: The next textbook apparatus dehydrates ethanol with concentrated sulfuric acid. The thermometer measures the liquid temperature, with one hundred seventy degrees Celsius specified in the text. Sodium hydroxide solution removes possible acidic impurities such as sulfur dioxide. This wash has a different purpose from the preceding water wash.

cues.title: 净化后的烯烃检验
cues.caption: 分别检验净化气体，并用杂质对照检查结论。
cues.captionEn: Test separate portions of purified gas and check impurity controls.
cues.zh: 净化后的气体分别接受酸性高锰酸钾与溴的四氯化碳溶液检验。画面切换的是两次独立检验，气流没有同时凭空分成两路。二氧化硫也能让这两种试剂褪色，因此洗气与对照是证据的一部分。颜色变化支持不饱和性判断，却不能单独识别所有可能的气体。
cues.en: Separate portions of purified gas are tested with acidified permanganate and bromine in carbon tetrachloride. The display switches between separate tests; it does not invent a simultaneous gas split. Sulfur dioxide can decolorize both reagents, so washing and controls are part of the evidence. Color change alone cannot uniquely identify every possible gas.

cues.title: 取样先确定比较对象
cues.titleEn: Define the sample and its reference
cues.caption: 直接收集雨水并保留参照水；清澈的外观不能说明酸度相同。
cues.captionEn: Collect rain directly and retain reference water; clear appearance does not establish equal acidity.
cues.zh: 先看采样杯。教材要求在降雨时直接收集雨水，并用蒸馏水或自来水作参照。雨滴先经过屋顶或地面，样品就会混入接触表面的影响。两杯水都可以很清澈，却不能凭外观判断酸度相同。这里的参照水也需要测量，不能预先假定它一定是中性。
cues.en: Start with the collection cup. The textbook collects falling rain directly and compares it with distilled or tap water. Water that first crosses a roof or the ground also carries the effects of that surface. Both samples can look clear without having equal acidity. Measure the reference too; do not assume it must be neutral.

cues.title: 同一样品，两种测量
cues.titleEn: Two methods for the same sample
cues.caption: 试纸提供有限分辨率的颜色比较，pH计的数字也需要校准与质量检查。
cues.captionEn: Paper gives a colour comparison with limited resolution; a meter still needs calibration and quality checks.
cues.zh: 同一个教学样品，试纸读到约五，而校准仪表显示四点八。试纸颜色是粗略比对，不应从一个色块编出很多小数。仪表多显示几位，也不等于真实误差就只有最后一位。雨水中的离子很少，电极响应、污染和读数稳定性都可能影响结果。
cues.en: For the same synthetic sample, the paper indicates about five while the calibrated meter reads four point eight. Paper is a coarse colour comparison; a colour patch cannot justify many decimal places. More digits on a meter do not guarantee an equally small error. Low ion content, electrode response, contamination and reading stability can all affect rainwater measurements.

cues.title: 校准后再看判断边界
cues.caption: 教材用pH5.6作参考；读数区间跨过参考线时，不能作精确二分判断。
cues.captionEn: The textbook uses pH 5.6 as a reference; an interval crossing it does not support a precise binary decision.
cues.zh: 这个接近边界的模型样品，先由带偏差的仪表读取，再用四和七两个标准点校正。注意读数的位置改变了。这里另外画出教学误差区间，它跨过教材的五点六参考线。因此不能只看显示屏最后一位就下结论。校准能移除模型里的线性偏差，但现实中的全部误差不会自动消失。
cues.en: This near-boundary model sample is first read with a biased meter, then corrected using standards at four and seven. Notice the reading move. The illustrated error interval crosses the textbook reference of five point six, so the last displayed digit cannot settle the classification. Calibration removes the model’s affine bias, but does not automatically eliminate every real measurement error.

cues.title: 连续记录并保留缺测
cues.titleEn: Keep a sequence and preserve missing records
cues.caption: 连续记录要标明样品、时间与缺测；没有样品不能记作pH0。
cues.captionEn: A sequence records samples, times and gaps; no sample must not become pH 0.
cues.zh: 把观察扩展到七个记录日。不同样品的读数有高有低，第三日没有样品，因此保留空缺，而不是填成零。所有数值都是教学合成数据，不是你的所在地实测值。这样的记录能描述这段时间采到的样品，不能仅凭一个点就代表整周，更不能代表整个地区的长期情况。
cues.en: Extend the observation to seven record days. Values differ among samples, and day three has no sample, so its gap is preserved rather than replaced with zero. Every value here is synthetic teaching data, not a measurement from your location. The record describes the samples obtained during this period; one point cannot represent the whole week or a region’s long-term condition.

cues.title: 平均酸度需要先定义
cues.caption: pH是对数。平均pH与先按水量平均H⁺再换算，是不同的统计量。
cues.captionEn: pH is logarithmic: averaging pH differs from weighting H⁺ by water amount before converting back.
cues.zh: 最后比较两份教学样品，pH分别为四和六。它们的氢离子活度相差一百倍，不能把pH当作普通浓度直接相加。两个pH的算术均值保持为五；先按水量平均氢离子再换算，结果会随水量比例改变。研究报告应说明使用哪种统计量。pH本身也不能单独告诉我们酸来自哪种污染物或哪一家排放源。
cues.en: Finally compare synthetic samples at pH four and six. Their hydrogen-ion activities differ by a factor of one hundred, so pH is not an ordinary concentration to add. The arithmetic mean of the two pH values stays at five, while weighting hydrogen ions by water amount before converting gives a result that changes with the volume ratio. State which statistic your report uses. pH alone also cannot identify the acid or a particular emission source.

cues.title: 苯酚与碱
cues.caption: 形成可溶的苯酚盐，原先分离的苯酚逐渐消失。
cues.captionEn: Soluble phenolate forms, reducing the separated neutral phenol.
cues.zh: 室温下，教材的苯酚用量超过这部分水能溶解的量，所以混合物浑浊。加入氢氧化钠，酚羟基失去质子，生成更易进入水相的苯酚根。注意分散相与溶解物种同时变化：澄清不是苯酚凭空消失，而是酸碱反应改变了它的存在形式。
cues.en: At room temperature, the textbook amount of phenol exceeds what that water can dissolve. Adding sodium hydroxide removes the phenolic proton and forms water-compatible phenolate. Follow both the separated phase and dissolved species. Clearing means a change in chemical form, not disappearance of the material.

cues.title: 加酸恢复苯酚
cues.caption: 加酸使苯酚根重新获得质子，溶解限度之外的苯酚析出。
cues.captionEn: Acid reprotonates phenolate; neutral phenol beyond its solubility separates.
cues.zh: 接着加入稀盐酸。苯酚根重新得到质子，变回中性苯酚；超过室温溶解限度的部分又分离出来。画面同时守恒总苯酚与电荷。不能从浑浊程度直接读出真实浓度，因为实际颗粒大小、温度和混合状态也会影响光的散射。
cues.en: Dilute hydrochloric acid gives the proton back to phenolate. Neutral phenol beyond the room-temperature solubility limit separates again. The model conserves total phenol and charge. Cloudiness is not a direct concentration reading: particle size, temperature and mixing also affect scattering.

cues.title: 碳酸与苯酚
cues.caption: 二氧化碳进入水中，也能使苯酚根转回苯酚。
cues.captionEn: Carbon dioxide in water can also convert phenolate back to phenol.
cues.zh: 教材继续向苯酚钠溶液通入二氧化碳。生成的碳酸可以把苯酚根转回苯酚，同时形成碳酸氢根。这条净反应支持碳酸的第一步酸性强于苯酚。不要把产物误写成碳酸根，也不要将这条比较扩张成每个浓度下都同样明显的浑浊。
cues.en: The textbook next passes carbon dioxide into sodium phenolate solution. Carbonic acid can protonate phenolate, producing phenol and bicarbonate. This supports the first acidity of carbonic acid being stronger than phenol. The product is bicarbonate, and visible cloudiness still depends on concentration and solubility.

cues.title: 邻对位溴代
cues.caption: 羟基影响苯环，2、4、6 位的氢被溴取代。
cues.captionEn: The hydroxyl group activates substitution at positions 2, 4 and 6.
cues.zh: 苯酚与饱和溴水反应，羟基影响苯环，使邻位和对位容易发生取代。图中保留同一个苯环，标出二、四、六位，净产物是二四六三溴苯酚白色沉淀。每生成一个产物需要三个溴分子，并形成三个溴化氢。溴过量时可以保留颜色，不能强迫所有条件都完全褪色。
cues.en: With bromine water, phenol undergoes substitution at the ortho and para positions. The same ring is retained, with positions two, four and six marked. The net product is white tribromophenol. Three bromine molecules are consumed per product molecule, forming three hydrogen bromides. Excess bromine can retain its color.

cues.title: 铁盐显色
cues.caption: 苯酚与铁盐的紫色，属于另一种配合显色证据。
cues.captionEn: The violet ferric-ion response is a different kind of evidence.
cues.zh: 向稀苯酚溶液滴入氯化铁，教材观察到紫色。这里的显色来自相应条件下形成的配合物，不等同于上一管白色沉淀。乙醇对照在所示条件下不给出同样的阳性。不同酚类、溶剂和酸碱条件会改变显色，因此不能把紫色规定成所有酚类唯一的颜色。
cues.en: Dilute phenol with ferric chloride gives the textbook violet response. It comes from complexes formed under suitable conditions, rather than the white precipitate in the previous test. The ethanol control is negative here. Other phenols and different media can produce different colors, so violet is not universal.

cues.title: 利斯特的防腐证据
cues.caption: 历史病例与多项防腐干预支持实践，证据类型需要说清。
cues.captionEn: Historical cases and combined antiseptic measures supported practice.
cues.zh: 教材的科学史话介绍利斯特与苯酚的防腐应用。从污染与腐败的观察，到器械、敷料和手的处理，再到病例记录，证据逐步积累。一八六七年发表的临床报告推动了防腐外科。这里没有把历史资料改造成随机对照试验，也不提供苯酚用于人体的操作处方。
cues.en: The historical section connects Lister with antiseptic uses of phenol. Observations of contamination led to interventions involving instruments, dressings and hands, followed by clinical reports. Publications in eighteen sixty-seven advanced antiseptic surgery. These records were not modern randomized trials, and this account is not a recipe for applying phenol to people.

cues.title: 验证羧酸的酸性
cues.caption: 甲酸、苯甲酸和乙二酸，分别提供可检验的酸性证据。
cues.captionEn: Formic, benzoic and oxalic acids each provide testable acidic behavior.
cues.zh: 后面的探究要求验证甲酸、苯甲酸和乙二酸具有酸性。选择稀水溶液，可用指示剂和碳酸氢盐放气等方法构成证据。模型求解各自的酸碱平衡；乙二酸有两个可中和的酸性质子。苯酚作为对照，在这些碳酸氢盐条件下不按羧酸那样明显放出二氧化碳。
cues.en: The later inquiry asks about formic, benzoic and oxalic acids. Dilute aqueous samples can be examined with an indicator and bicarbonate gas evolution. The model solves their acid equilibria, including two acidic protons for oxalic acid. Under these bicarbonate-test conditions, phenol does not show the same clear carbon dioxide evolution.

cues.title: 一次性酸性比较
cues.caption: 乙酸先释放 CO₂，净化后的 CO₂ 再使苯酚钠变浑浊。
cues.captionEn: Acetic acid releases CO₂; purified CO₂ then clouds sodium phenolate.
cues.zh: 连接教材给出的装置：乙酸与碳酸钠反应生成二氧化碳，气体经过饱和碳酸氢钠溶液，再进入苯酚钠。中间瓶去除夹带的乙酸蒸气，避免它直接造成末端的变化。两段置换共同支持乙酸、碳酸、苯酚依次减弱的酸性比较。
cues.en: Connect the textbook apparatus: acetic acid reacts with sodium carbonate, the gas passes through saturated sodium bicarbonate, and then reaches sodium phenolate. The middle bottle removes carried acetic-acid vapor. The two displacement observations support decreasing acidity from acetic acid to carbonic acid to phenol.

cues.title: 去除乙酸的干扰
cues.caption: 只保留乙酸蒸气的反例，显示洗气为什么属于证据链。
cues.captionEn: An acetic-vapor-only counterexample reveals why washing matters.
cues.zh: 最后只保留乙酸蒸气，暂时取消二氧化碳。在没有洗气的模型里，乙酸仍能使苯酚钠出现浑浊。恢复有效的碳酸氢钠洗气，乙酸被截留，末管就保持澄清。这个人为隔离的反例说明，观察到末管浑浊之前，必须先排除另一种酸的直接干扰。
cues.en: Isolate acetic-acid vapor and remove carbon dioxide from the hypothetical input. Without washing, acetic acid can still cloud sodium phenolate. Restore an effective bicarbonate wash and the acid is retained, leaving the final tube clear. This counterexample explains why direct interference from a second acid must be excluded.

cues.title: 新制银氨溶液
cues.caption: 制备阶段的沉淀溶解，尚不是银镜反应。
cues.captionEn: Dissolving the preparation precipitate is not yet the silver-mirror reaction.
cues.zh: 教材先制备银氨溶液。加入氨时出现的沉淀，在继续配位后溶解，形成含二氨合银离子的澄清试剂。此时银仍处于正一价，还没有被还原成金属。将试剂制备和后面的有机物检验分开观察，才能避免把两次不同的固体变化混在一起。
cues.en: First prepare the silver–ammonia reagent. A precipitate initially appears and then dissolves through complex formation, leaving a clear solution containing diamminesilver ions. Silver is still in oxidation state plus one. This preparation step is chemically distinct from its later reduction to metallic silver.

cues.title: 银沉积到内壁
cues.titleEn: Silver deposits on the inner wall
cues.caption: 乙醛失去两个电子，两个银离子被还原为金属银。
cues.captionEn: Ethanal supplies two electrons, reducing two silver ions to metal.
cues.zh: 加入乙醛并在热水浴中温热，银离子被还原，银逐渐沉积在洁净的试管内壁。跟踪标记从液体进入壁面的过程，看到的是金属镀层，不是把整管液体染灰。每氧化一个乙醛，羰基碳的氧化态从正一变成正三，对应两个银离子各得到一个电子。
cues.en: After ethanal is added and the tube is warmed in a water bath, silver deposits on the clean inner wall. Follow markers from the liquid to the surface: the result is a metallic coating, not gray liquid. Oxidizing one ethanal changes its carbonyl carbon from plus one to plus three and reduces two silver ions.

cues.title: 新制氢氧化铜
cues.caption: 过量碱中制得的蓝色 Cu(OH)₂，是反应前的悬浊液。
cues.captionEn: Blue Cu(OH)₂ in excess base is the starting suspension.
cues.zh: 第二个实验先在过量氢氧化钠溶液中加入硫酸铜，制得新鲜的蓝色氢氧化铜。画面把蓝色表示成分散颗粒，而不是均匀溶液。这时铜仍然是正二价。这个教材试剂也不能与含有其他配体的斐林试剂直接画成同一种配方。
cues.en: The second experiment prepares fresh blue copper hydroxide in excess sodium hydroxide. Blue dispersed particles represent a suspension, not a uniform solution. Copper is still in oxidation state plus two. This textbook preparation is not identical to Fehling’s reagent, which contains additional ligands.

cues.title: 砖红色氧化亚铜
cues.caption: 两份 Cu(II) 接受两个电子，生成一份 Cu₂O。
cues.captionEn: Two Cu(II) centers accept two electrons to produce one Cu₂O unit.
cues.zh: 加入乙醛并加热，蓝色氢氧化铜转变为砖红色氧化亚铜。两个铜原子各得到一个电子，进入同一个氧化亚铜计量单位，乙醛则在碱性环境中生成乙酸根。探索中换成丙酮，可得到所示条件下的阴性对照；不要把任何含羰基的物质都判断为相同阳性。
cues.en: With ethanal and heating, blue copper hydroxide gives brick-red copper(I) oxide. Two copper atoms each accept one electron and form one Cu₂O formula unit, while ethanal becomes acetate in the alkaline medium. Acetone is a negative control under these conditions; a carbonyl group alone does not guarantee the same response.

cues.title: 切断的位置在DNA骨架上
cues.titleEn: Cut the DNA backbone at specified sites
cues.caption: EcoRI产生互补的AATT黏性末端。
cues.captionEn: EcoRI produces complementary AATT cohesive ends.
cues.zh: 先看两条反向平行的DNA链。EcoRI识别特定序列，在两条链错开的部位切断磷酸二酯键，露出互补的黏性末端。字母保持身份，切割没有删除中间四个碱基，也不是单纯拆开碱基对。
cues.en: Follow the two antiparallel DNA strands. EcoRI recognizes a sequence and cuts phosphodiester bonds at staggered positions, exposing cohesive ends. The letters retain their identities: cleavage neither deletes the four overhanging bases nor merely separates base pairs.

cues.title: 末端配对还没有修复骨架
cues.titleEn: Pairing does not yet seal the backbone
cues.caption: 碱基配对以后，两处骨架缺口仍然存在。
cues.captionEn: Two backbone nicks remain after the bases pair.
cues.zh: 让互补末端重新靠近，碱基之间可以配对，但两条骨架上的缺口仍然可见。这一步与共价连接不同。探索里还可以切换SmaI，比较平末端与黏性末端，而不是把所有限制酶都当成相同剪刀。
cues.en: Bring complementary ends together. Bases can pair while two backbone nicks remain visible. Pairing and covalent joining are different events. Switch to SmaI in exploration to compare blunt and cohesive ends rather than treating every restriction enzyme as the same cutter.

cues.title: 连接酶修复磷酸二酯键
cues.caption: 连续的是糖—磷酸骨架，不是新增一段碱基。
cues.captionEn: The sugar–phosphate backbone becomes continuous without adding a base segment.
cues.zh: 在适宜条件下，DNA连接酶将相邻片段的骨架缺口修复。看原先断开的两段线变为连续，原有碱基数量没有增加。连接酶与从引物末端逐个加入脱氧核苷酸的DNA聚合酶，承担不同任务。
cues.en: Under suitable conditions, DNA ligase seals backbone nicks between adjacent fragments. The broken lines become continuous without adding bases. This differs from DNA polymerase, which extends a primer by adding individual deoxyribonucleotides.

cues.title: 载体还需要复制与筛选功能
cues.titleEn: Vectors also need maintenance and selection
cues.caption: 复制原点与标记基因不是目的基因的替代品。
cues.captionEn: An origin and selectable marker do not substitute for the target gene.
cues.zh: 改造后的质粒可以携带DNA片段。复制原点帮助它在相容宿主中维持复制，标记基因帮助筛选携带载体的细胞。画面复制数只是示意；通过标记筛选，也不能直接证明目的基因插入正确并且正常表达。
cues.en: An engineered plasmid carries DNA. A compatible replication origin supports maintenance, while a marker helps select cells carrying the vector. Copy numbers are illustrative. Marker selection alone does not establish a correct target insert or its functional expression.

cues.title: 破碎组织后获得粗滤液
cues.titleEn: Disrupt tissue and collect crude filtrate
cues.caption: DNA经过滤路，较大的组织碎屑被截留。
cues.captionEn: DNA follows the filtration route while larger debris is retained.
cues.zh: 洋葱材料经过研磨，细胞结构被破坏，再过滤或用适宜方法分离。追踪细小的DNA示意线经过漏斗颈进入收集液，较大的碎屑停在滤层上。滤液仍混有多类物质，过滤并不是把DNA完全纯化。
cues.en: Grinding disrupts the onion tissue before filtration or another suitable separation. Small DNA symbols follow the funnel neck into the receiver while larger debris remains above the filter. The filtrate is still a mixture; filtration does not produce pure DNA.

cues.title: 预冷酒精使粗提物析出
cues.titleEn: Cold alcohol precipitates a crude extract
cues.caption: 白色丝状物的出现与纯度证明分开。
cues.captionEn: A white fibrous precipitate is not proof of purity.
cues.zh: 加入与上清液等体积的预冷酒精后，可以看到白色丝状粗提物。这里用二十加二十毫升示意液量变化，实际取用量按实验条件记录。白色物质可能夹带其他成分，不能只凭外观就宣称获得了纯DNA。
cues.en: Adding an equal volume of cold alcohol produces a visible crude precipitate. Twenty plus twenty millilitres illustrates liquid balance; actual volumes depend on the experiment. Other components can remain, so appearance alone cannot establish that the material is pure DNA.

cues.title: 用相同处理的空白作比较
cues.caption: 相同试剂和加热条件下，比较样品与空白。
cues.captionEn: Compare sample and blank under matched reagent and heating conditions.
cues.zh: 两管都加入相同盐溶液与二苯胺试剂，只有样品管加入粗提物。试剂实际进入液体后再水浴加热，冷却后比较颜色。示意中样品变蓝、空白不变；缺少必要条件的阴性结果，也不能被解释成任何情况下都没有DNA。
cues.en: Both tubes receive matching salt solution and diphenylamine reagent; only the sample receives the crude material. Reagent enters before heating, followed by comparison after cooling. Blue colour is illustrated in the sample. A negative result under inadequate conditions does not establish universal absence of DNA.

cues.title: 目标片段需要合适的获取方法
cues.caption: PCR依赖已知引物与相应模板条件。
cues.captionEn: PCR requires suitable primers and corresponding template conditions.
cues.zh: 选择目的基因需要已有的结构和功能证据，获取方法可以包括合成或PCR。这里把扩增作为一种示例：高温打开双链，引物分别结合两条模板，再从引物的三撇端延伸。PCR并不会凭空发明一个需要的基因。
cues.en: Selecting a target requires evidence about structure and function; acquisition can involve synthesis or PCR. In this example, heating separates strands, primers bind opposite templates, and synthesis extends from their three-prime ends. PCR does not invent a desired gene.

cues.title: 把表达元件按方向接入载体
cues.caption: 启动子、目的基因和终止子形成明确顺序。
cues.captionEn: Promoter, target and terminator have a defined order.
cues.zh: 把含有表达元件的片段接入载体，连接处实际靠拢后才闭合。启动子、目的基因与终止子需要合理的方向和相容宿主。启动子与终止子本身也是DNA序列，不能把终止子与翻译时的终止密码子混为一谈。
cues.en: Insert the expression segment and seal the junctions after contact. Promoter, target and terminator require appropriate orientation and host compatibility. Promoters and terminators are themselves DNA sequences; a transcription terminator is not the same as a translation stop codon.

cues.title: 进入细胞以后仍要分层检验
cues.titleEn: Entry still requires separate levels of verification
cues.caption: DNA存在、RNA产生、蛋白表达分别需要证据。
cues.captionEn: DNA presence, RNA production and protein expression need distinct evidence.
cues.zh: 以细菌受体为例，沿示意通路追踪同一个重组质粒进入细胞。随后是否转录、是否形成蛋白，还取决于表达条件。关闭可用启动子，质粒仍然存在而表达消失。最终功能也需要独立检测，不能凭一条DNA阳性结果包办。
cues.en: Follow one recombinant plasmid into a bacterial recipient through an illustrative entry route. Transcription and protein production depend on expression conditions. Disabling the functional promoter leaves plasmid DNA present while expression disappears. Biological function likewise requires separate evidence.

cues.title: 温度循环控制三种分子事件
cues.titleEn: A thermal cycle controls three molecular events
cues.caption: 变性、引物结合与延伸按顺序发生。
cues.captionEn: Denaturation, primer binding and extension occur in sequence.
cues.zh: 教材的示例循环采用九十四度变性、五十五度复性、七十二度延伸。温度不是任意DNA与引物的统一配方。看两条新链分别从引物三撇端向相反方向延伸；高温替代解旋过程，不是把DNA骨架切碎。
cues.en: The textbook example cycles through ninety-four, fifty-five and seventy-two degrees. These are not universal settings for every primer and template. The two new strands extend in opposite directions from primer three-prime ends. Heating separates strands rather than cutting their backbones.

cues.title: 每轮产物成为下一轮模板
cues.titleEn: Products become templates in later cycles
cues.caption: 指数增长是条件理想时的上限示意。
cues.captionEn: Exponential growth illustrates ideal conditions.
cues.zh: 延伸产物在后续循环继续作模板，理想情况下总量每轮翻倍。探索里改变循环数和效率，计算会同步更新。这个模型没有试剂耗尽和平台期；从较长模板开始，最初几轮的全部产物也不都具有两个引物限定的精确长度。
cues.en: Products serve as templates in later cycles, giving ideal doubling. Change cycles and efficiency to update the calculation. Reagent depletion and plateau effects are omitted. Starting from longer templates, not every early product has the exact length bounded by both primers.

cues.title: 用标准和对照阅读条带
cues.titleEn: Read bands with a ladder and controls
cues.caption: 小片段迁移更远，同大小仍不等于同序列。
cues.captionEn: Smaller fragments migrate farther; equal size does not establish equal sequence.
cues.zh: 电泳中，线性DNA由加样孔向正极迁移，小片段在同一凝胶中通常走得更远。比较大小标准、阳性、样品和无模板对照。蓝色指示剂前沿不是DNA条带；样品大小符合预期仍需进一步验证，空白出现条带则提示这次比较存在问题。
cues.en: Linear DNA migrates from the wells toward the positive electrode, with smaller fragments usually moving farther in the same gel. Compare ladder, positive, sample and no-template lanes. The blue dye front is not DNA. Expected size needs further verification, while a band in the blank challenges the run.

cues.title: 先有初温，才有温差
cues.caption: 先记录盐酸初温，再把镁条反应后的温度与它比较。
cues.captionEn: Record the acid’s initial temperature before comparing it with the reacting mixture.
cues.zh: 先让温度计测量盐酸，得到同一支试管的起点。画面中的二十度是模型设定，并不是教材规定的实测温度。镁条还没有放入液体，所以此时不出现反应气泡。温差必须有反应前的参照，不能只凭试管摸起来热不热来定义。
cues.en: First the thermometer establishes the temperature of the acid in this tube. Twenty degrees is a model starting condition, not a textbook measurement. The magnesium ribbon has not entered the liquid, so there are no reaction bubbles yet. A temperature change needs a before-reaction reference, rather than only a judgement that the tube feels warm.

cues.title: 气泡、镁条与温升
cues.titleEn: Connect bubbles, magnesium consumption and warming
cues.caption: 镁与H⁺反应产生H₂，反应释放的能量使溶液与器物升温。
cues.captionEn: Magnesium reacts with H⁺ to form H₂, while released energy warms the solution and apparatus.
cues.zh: 镁进入盐酸以后，跟踪同一段镁条的减少和氢气泡的出现。温度计的液柱随模型能量账目上升。镁转化为镁离子，氢离子转化为氢气，这个反应向周围溶液和器物释放能量。气泡本身不是放热的定义；温度证据说明了这里的热效应。
cues.en: After magnesium enters the acid, follow the shrinking ribbon and appearing hydrogen bubbles. The thermometer column rises with the model’s energy inventory. Magnesium forms magnesium ions and hydrogen ions form hydrogen gas, while the reaction releases energy to the surrounding solution and apparatus. Bubbles alone do not define an exothermic reaction; temperature provides the thermal evidence here.

cues.title: 反应完成后仍可降温
cues.titleEn: Cooling can continue after reaction completion
cues.caption: 镁已反应完，热的试管仍向较冷环境传热；降温不表示反应倒转。
cues.captionEn: After magnesium is consumed, the warm tube still transfers heat outward; cooling does not imply reversal.
cues.zh: 把时间推进到镁已经消耗完。气泡停止，但试管并不会永远保持最高温度。只要它比环境热，能量就继续向外传递，温度逐渐下降。生成物仍然保留。这个对照把化学反应的热效应与反应后的传热过程分开，避免把温度曲线的每个下降都解释成吸热反应。
cues.en: Move beyond complete magnesium consumption. Bubbling stops, but the tube does not remain at its maximum temperature forever. While it is warmer than its surroundings, heat continues to flow outward and its temperature falls. The products remain. This separates the reaction’s heat effect from subsequent heat transfer, avoiding the mistake that every falling temperature curve must indicate an endothermic reaction.

cues.title: 两种晶体混合后降温
cues.titleEn: Two crystals react and cool the mixture
cues.caption: Ba(OH)₂·8H₂O与NH₄Cl的反应吸热，混合物出现液相并降温。
cues.captionEn: Hydrated barium hydroxide and ammonium chloride react endothermically, forming liquid and cooling.
cues.zh: 另一组教材实验从两种晶体开始：八水合氢氧化钡与氯化铵。随着搅拌和反应，混合物出现液相，温度下降。反应形成氨等产物；本片关注能量证据，不用闻气味来推动操作。反应所需的能量从混合物、容器和周围接触物的热运动中取得，因此附近物体会变冷。
cues.en: The second textbook experiment starts with barium hydroxide octahydrate and ammonium chloride crystals. As mixing and reaction proceed, liquid appears and temperature falls. Ammonia is among the products, but this film follows the thermal evidence rather than directing a smell test. The required energy comes from thermal energy in the mixture, vessel and contacting surroundings, which become colder.

cues.title: 追踪杯底的水层
cues.titleEn: Follow the water beneath the beaker
cues.caption: 水层先冷却，再在凝固时释放潜热；继续吸热可使它形成冰层。
cues.captionEn: The water layer first cools, then releases latent heat as it freezes and supplies the endothermic process.
cues.zh: 现在关注杯底与木片之间的薄水层。它先降温，接近零度以后，进一步移走能量会形成冰，而不是让温度立即无限下降。凝固时水释放潜热，这部分能量进入正在吸热的过程。画面的结冰份额由能量计算，不是看到反应开始就直接贴上一层冰。
cues.en: Focus on the thin water layer between beaker and wood. It first cools. Near zero degrees, further energy removal forms ice rather than immediately driving temperature down without limit. Freezing releases latent heat, contributing energy to the endothermic process. The frozen fraction follows the energy calculation; ice is not simply added when the reaction begins.

cues.title: 用干湿木片检验连接原因
cues.caption: 有冰层时木片可随烧杯抬起；干木片即使变冷，也没有这层冰连接。
cues.captionEn: An ice layer can lift the wet wood with the beaker; dry wood lacks that ice connection even when cold.
cues.zh: 抬起烧杯，已经冻住的湿木片跟着离开桌面。再比较同样冷却但没有水层的干木片：烧杯上升，木片仍留在桌上。它可能更冷，却没有冰把两者连接起来。因此教材里的悬起木片既是低温造成相变的证据，也需要杯底原本有水这个条件。模型没有计算冰层的实际承载强度。
cues.en: Lift the beaker and the frozen wet wood follows it away from the bench. Compare dry wood under the same cooling model: the beaker rises but the wood stays behind. It can be colder yet lack the ice that connects the two objects. The textbook observation therefore depends on both sufficient cooling and water initially present at the interface. Actual ice-bond strength is outside this model.

cues.title: 三条酯键的皂化
cues.caption: 甘油骨架保留，三条脂肪酸链成为羧酸盐。
cues.captionEn: The glycerol backbone remains while three fatty-acid chains become carboxylates.
cues.zh: 油脂是甘油与长链脂肪酸形成的酯。碱性水解切开三条酯连接，得到一份甘油和三份脂肪酸盐。跟踪原先靠近甘油的氧，它们保留在甘油一侧。画面比较的是反应前后的净连接，不是三条键必定同时断裂的分子电影。
cues.en: Fats are esters of glycerol and long-chain fatty acids. Alkaline hydrolysis gives one glycerol and three fatty-acid salts. The original glycerol-side oxygens remain with glycerol. The diagram compares net connectivity, rather than claiming that all three bonds break simultaneously.

cues.title: 盐析分离
cues.caption: 盐降低皂在水相中的溶解程度，皂相与母液分开。
cues.captionEn: Salt reduces soap solubility, separating a soap-rich phase from the mother liquor.
cues.zh: 反应混合物中还有甘油、盐和可能剩余的碱。加入盐可以降低皂在水相中的溶解程度，使皂相分离出来；甘油主要留在母液中。这里的百分数来自一个明确的示意溶解容量模型，不是实际配方的收率。盐析也不是把脂肪酸盐重新变回油脂。
cues.en: The mixture also contains glycerol, salts and possibly excess alkali. Added salt reduces soap solubility and separates a soap-rich phase while glycerol largely remains in the mother liquor. The displayed percentage follows an illustrative capacity model, not a recipe yield. Salting out does not reverse soap into fat.

cues.title: 洗涤与成形
cues.caption: 滤去母液、减少夹带杂质，再得到可成形的皂相。
cues.captionEn: Remove mother liquor and carried impurities before shaping the soap-rich phase.
cues.zh: 分离的皂相仍会夹带母液。过滤和适当洗涤减少其中的盐、甘油与残余碱，再进行成形。模型只演示夹带液经稀释后的杂质变化，不把一次洗涤说成完全纯化，也不表示任意自制样品已经适合接触皮肤。
cues.en: Separated soap can retain mother liquor. Filtration and suitable washing reduce carried salt, glycerol and residual alkali before shaping. The model shows dilution of retained liquid; it does not imply perfect purification in one wash or certify a homemade sample for skin contact.

cues.title: 油水界面上的肥皂
cues.caption: 亲水端留在水中，疏水链进入油相。
cues.captionEn: Hydrophilic heads face water while hydrophobic chains enter oil.
cues.zh: 脂肪酸盐的一端是带电的羧酸根，另一端是长烃链。到达油水界面时，亲水头朝向水，疏水链进入油。画面中每一条链的方向都由同一个界面几何决定。这是油滴表面吸附的剖面示意，并非把所有含油颗粒都叫作同一种小胶束。
cues.en: A fatty-acid salt has an ionic carboxylate head and a long hydrocarbon chain. At an oil–water interface, heads face water and chains enter oil. Each orientation comes from the same interface geometry. This is a cross-section of an adsorbed layer on an oil droplet, not a claim that every oil-containing particle is the same small micelle.

cues.title: 去污与硬水对照
cues.caption: 界面覆盖配合扰动帮助油污脱离；硬水会消耗肥皂。
cues.captionEn: Interfacial coverage and agitation help oil detach; hard water consumes soap.
cues.zh: 界面排列改善水对油污的接近，再配合扰动，让油滴从织物表面脱离。油并没有被化学分解或凭空消失。探索中加入钙离子，每个钙离子可结合两个脂肪酸根形成难溶盐，可用的肥皂因此减少。这个对照不能推广为所有合成洗涤剂都一样怕硬水。
cues.en: Interfacial coverage and agitation help an oil droplet detach from fabric. The oil is neither chemically destroyed nor made to vanish. In exploration, calcium binds two carboxylates into an insoluble salt, reducing available soap. This behavior should not be generalized to every synthetic detergent.

cues.title: 表面活性剂的类型
cues.caption: 两亲性相似，亲水基团的电性可以不同。
cues.captionEn: Amphiphilic architecture can have different head-group charges.
cues.zh: 教材还要求了解表面活性剂的类型。普通羧酸盐肥皂属于阴离子型；季铵盐可作为阳离子型例子，聚氧乙烯类可为非离子型，甜菜碱类同时具有正负电荷。它们共享两亲结构，但不能仅凭头部电荷就预测全部溶解性、去污能力或使用适应性。
cues.en: The inquiry also asks about surfactant classes. Carboxylate soap is anionic; quaternary ammonium surfactants can be cationic, polyoxyethylene types nonionic, and betaines zwitterionic. They share amphiphilic architecture, but head-group charge alone does not predict every solubility, cleaning or application property.

cues.title: 逆推两个酯键
cues.caption: 把目标酯倒推为乙二酸与两份乙醇，保留六个碳的来源。
cues.captionEn: Plan oxalic acid and two ethanols while preserving the six-carbon accounting.
cues.zh: 教材以乙二酸二乙酯说明逆合成。目标中有两个酯基，倒推可得到乙二酸和两份乙醇。原来的六个碳仍然可追踪，只是分配到不同前体。注意，这是为了寻找能向前合成的反应而进行的设计，并不是说目标分子会按这段动画自行分解。
cues.en: The textbook illustrates retrosynthesis with diethyl oxalate. Its two ester groups suggest oxalic acid and two ethanol molecules as precursors. All six carbon identities remain traceable. This is a planning disconnection that must correspond to a feasible forward synthesis, not a movie of spontaneous decomposition.

cues.title: 分支合成路线
cues.caption: 两条乙烯支路分别提供乙醇与乙二酸，再汇合成酯。
cues.captionEn: Ethene branches provide ethanol and oxalic acid before esterification.
cues.zh: 向前检查教材路线。一条支路由乙烯水合制乙醇；另一条经二氯乙烷、乙二醇，再到乙二酸，最后酯化汇合。路线设计需要同时考虑试剂、条件、副产物与物料数量。探索中的相同步产率只是计算假设；分支路线要先找受限支路，不能看到五个反应就机械连乘五次。
cues.en: Check the route forward. One ethene branch provides ethanol by hydration. The other passes through dichloroethane and ethylene glycol to oxalic acid, before esterification joins them. Conditions and material amounts matter. The equal step yields in exploration are hypothetical; a branched route must account for the limiting branch rather than blindly multiplying five steps.

cues.title: 碳碳双键的检验
cues.caption: 1-己烯的褪色需要与萃取和其他氧化反应区分。
cues.captionEn: Distinguish 1-hexene reactions from extraction and other oxidation.
cues.zh: 实验活动先比较一己烯与溴水、酸性高锰酸钾。溴的加成使溴被消耗，高锰酸钾则提供氧化证据。但苯也能把溴萃取到另一层，醛也可以被溴水氧化；只看某一层变浅或某一种试剂褪色，都不能唯一证明碳碳双键。
cues.en: The activity tests one-hexene with bromine water and acidified permanganate. Bromine addition consumes bromine; permanganate provides oxidation evidence. But benzene can extract bromine into another phase, and aldehydes can also consume bromine by oxidation. One fading layer or one positive test cannot uniquely establish a double bond.

cues.title: 水解后检验卤素
cues.caption: 先把共价卤素转为水相离子，再排除氢氧根干扰。
cues.captionEn: Release aqueous halide before excluding hydroxide interference.
cues.zh: 一溴丁烷的检验有明确前处理：与氢氧化钠水溶液反应，加热后取水样，再用稀硝酸酸化，最后加入硝酸银。浅黄色溴化银对应的是释放出的溴离子。如果跳过酸化，氧化银等干扰就可能破坏判断，不能把这个结果直接塞进鉴别树。
cues.en: For one-bromobutane, hydrolyze with aqueous sodium hydroxide and heat, sample the aqueous phase, acidify with dilute nitric acid and then add silver nitrate. Pale yellow silver bromide detects released bromide. Incomplete acidification introduces interference, so that observation cannot be treated as valid identification evidence.

cues.title: 酚羟基的证据
cues.caption: 溴代白色沉淀与铁盐显色，是两项相互补充的检验。
cues.captionEn: Bromination precipitate and ferric-ion color provide complementary tests.
cues.zh: 苯酚可以与溴水生成白色三溴苯酚，也可在适当条件下与氯化铁显色。两项证据来自不同反应，因此比只说颜色变了更有信息。检验要使用独立份样品，不能把前一次加入的大量试剂带进下一次检验而不考虑干扰。
cues.en: Phenol gives a white tribromophenol precipitate with bromine water and a color response with ferric chloride under suitable conditions. The tests probe different reactions. Use separate sample portions: carrying reagents from one test into another can create interference.

cues.title: 醛基的还原检验
cues.caption: 新制 Cu(OH)₂ 在所示条件下被乙醛还原为 Cu₂O。
cues.captionEn: Ethanal reduces fresh Cu(OH)₂ to Cu₂O under the specified conditions.
cues.zh: 乙醛与新制氢氧化铜在碱性加热条件下，出现砖红色氧化亚铜。把它与苯酚显色和卤素水解检验放在一起，可以从不同官能团出发安排鉴别顺序。这里的结论针对教材给出的候选集合，不承诺凭一管阳性就识别世界上所有未知化合物。
cues.en: Under alkaline heated conditions, ethanal gives brick-red copper(I) oxide with freshly prepared copper hydroxide. Combine this with phenol and hydrolyzed-halide tests to distinguish the textbook candidates. Conclusions apply to that finite set, not to every possible unknown compound.

cues.title: 组合证据鉴别样品
cues.caption: 每次排除候选，都要能指出独立观察与适用条件。
cues.captionEn: Every eliminated candidate must follow from an independent valid observation.
cues.zh: 第一组先用水混溶与上下分层，识别乙醇和四氯化碳，再区分一己烯反应消耗溴与苯的萃取。第二组用铁盐显色识别酚，用铜盐还原识别醛，再在正确前处理后检验氯离子，剩余候选才是丙醇。探索中每加入一条观察，候选集合都会按模型真正缩小。
cues.en: For the first set, water miscibility and layer position identify ethanol and carbon tetrachloride; bromine consumption versus extraction separates one-hexene and benzene. For the second set, ferric color, copper reduction and correctly pretreated chloride testing isolate phenol, propanal and chloropropane, leaving propanol. Each valid observation filters the candidate set.

cues.title: 阿司匹林的两个官能团
cues.caption: 分别取样看酸性；水解并中和过量酸后，再检验显露的酚羟基。
cues.captionEn: Use separate samples for acidity and for hydrolysis followed by the phenolic test.
cues.zh: 阿司匹林清液的一份用石蕊检验酸性，另一份用于酯基水解。原来的酚羟基被乙酰基保护，水解后成为水杨酸，酚羟基重新显露。教材随后加入碳酸氢钠，是为了中和过量硫酸，再进行铁盐显色。不要省略这个条件，也不要把两支试管的证据混成同一份样品。
cues.en: One aspirin-solution portion tests acidic behavior with litmus; another undergoes ester hydrolysis. The acetyl-protected phenolic group is exposed in salicylic acid. The textbook then uses bicarbonate to neutralize excess sulfuric acid before the ferric-ion test. Keep these conditions and separate sample histories explicit.

cues.title: 核磁共振作为补充证据
cues.caption: 氢环境与积分比例补充化学检验，示意谱不冒充实测数据。
cues.captionEn: Hydrogen environments and integrals complement tests; these are schematic spectra.
cues.zh: 活动最后还让我们比较乙醇、乙酸和乙酸乙酯的氢谱。乙醇的三组氢可对应三比二比一；乙酸为三比一，酸性氢通常更靠低场；乙酸乙酯有三比二比三的三组氢。这里只画环境与积分的示意峰，真实位移、裂分和交换需要结合仪器与样品条件。
cues.en: The final discussion compares ethanol, acetic acid and ethyl acetate. Their ideal hydrogen-group integrals are three to two to one, three to one, and three to two to three. Acidic hydrogen typically lies downfield. These schematic peaks illustrate environments and group areas, while real shifts, splitting and exchange depend on sample and instrument conditions.

cues.title: 从同一组原子出发
cues.titleEn: Start with the same tracked atoms
cues.caption: H₂与Cl₂变为HCl时，原子种类与数目不变，连接关系改变。
cues.captionEn: When H₂ and Cl₂ form HCl, atom identities and counts stay fixed while bonds change.
cues.zh: 保留两个氢原子和两个氯原子的身份。开始时氢与氢相连，氯与氯相连；终点要形成两份氯化氢。下面用教材的近似键能核对收支。这个画面是经过假想孤立原子状态的能量账本，并不是说真实反应必须先把所有分子拆散，再同时重新连接。
cues.en: Keep track of two hydrogen and two chlorine atoms. Initially hydrogen is bonded to hydrogen and chlorine to chlorine; the endpoint contains two hydrogen chloride units. We will check the balance using the textbook’s approximate bond energies. This is a hypothetical separated-atom energy account, not a claim that the real reaction first dismantles every molecule and then reconnects them simultaneously.

cues.title: 把断键成本记进去
cues.titleEn: Account for the energy needed to break bonds
cues.caption: 断开1mol H—H与1mol Cl—Cl，教材分别记436kJ和243kJ的吸能。
cues.captionEn: Breaking 1 mol each of H—H and Cl—Cl costs 436 kJ and 243 kJ in the textbook account.
cues.zh: 先只看断键。连接逐渐分开，吸收能量的一栏上升。教材把一摩尔氢氢键记为四百三十六千焦，一摩尔氯氯键记为二百四十三千焦，合计六百七十九千焦。断键这一项需要能量，不是因为键断了就自动向外放热。
cues.en: First isolate bond breaking. As the connections separate, the energy-input term grows. The textbook assigns four hundred thirty-six kilojoules to one mole of hydrogen–hydrogen bonds and two hundred forty-three to one mole of chlorine–chlorine bonds, totalling six hundred seventy-nine. Breaking these bonds requires energy; breaking a bond does not itself release that energy outward.

cues.title: 形成新键时释放能量
cues.titleEn: Release energy when new bonds form
cues.caption: 形成2mol H—Cl键，教材记862kJ的放能；原子仍是先前那一组。
cues.captionEn: Forming 2 mol of H—Cl bonds releases 862 kJ in the textbook account, using the same atoms.
cues.zh: 现在让同一组原子改为氢与氯相连，形成两份氯化氢。成键释放能量，另一栏逐渐增加到八百六十二千焦。不要把两份氯化氢误记成一份，也不要把形成键的放能写成吸能。原子的数量没有改变，变化的是连接和对应的能量。
cues.en: Now reconnect the same atoms into two hydrogen chloride units. Bond formation releases energy, and the output term rises to eight hundred sixty-two kilojoules. There are two hydrogen chloride units, not one, and this formation term releases rather than absorbs energy. Atom counts stay unchanged; their connections and associated energy change.

cues.title: 比较吸收与释放的总量
cues.caption: 679kJ−862kJ≈−183kJ，净结果是向环境放出能量。
cues.captionEn: 679 kJ −862 kJ ≈ −183 kJ: the net result releases energy to the surroundings.
