cues.zh: 最后比较两项。断键吸收六百七十九千焦，成键释放八百六十二千焦，释放得更多，所以净焓变约为负一百八十三千焦。这里对应一摩尔氢气与一摩尔氯气反应的教材近似数据。能量条的长度与同一计算对应，不能只看某一根键的强弱就判断整个反应。
cues.en: Compare both terms: six hundred seventy-nine kilojoules absorbed and eight hundred sixty-two released. The larger release leaves a net enthalpy change of approximately minus one hundred eighty-three kilojoules, for the textbook account of one mole of each reactant. The bars use that same calculation. One bond’s strength alone cannot determine the whole reaction’s heat effect.

cues.title: 不同途径，相同始态与终态
cues.caption: 石墨与O₂生成CO₂，直接完成或经CO分步完成，总焓变相同。
cues.captionEn: Graphite and O₂ forming CO₂ have the same total enthalpy change directly or through CO.
cues.zh: 把视角从键换到完整物质状态。起点是石墨和氧气，终点是二氧化碳。可以把总变化写成直接一步，也可以先到一氧化碳，再氧化到二氧化碳。图中的高度来自教材焓值，而不是反应速度。只要温度、相态和始末状态一致，两条途径的总焓变就必须相同。
cues.en: Now consider complete substance states rather than individual bonds. Start with graphite and oxygen and end with carbon dioxide. Write this as one direct change, or first form carbon monoxide and then oxidise it. Diagram heights come from textbook enthalpies, not reaction speed. With consistent temperature, phases and endpoint states, both routes must have the same total enthalpy change.

cues.title: 消去中间物种，求未知量
cues.titleEn: Cancel the intermediate and solve the unknown
cues.caption: 直接反应的−393.5kJ减去CO氧化的−283.0kJ，得到生成CO的−110.5kJ。
cues.captionEn: Subtracting −283.0 kJ for CO oxidation from −393.5 kJ overall gives −110.5 kJ for CO formation.
cues.zh: 看两条分步反应式。一氧化碳在第一步生成，在第二步消耗，相加时可以消去；两份二分之一氧气合成一份氧气。已知总焓变负三百九十三点五千焦，第二步为负二百八十三千焦，第一步就等于两者之差，负一百一十点五千焦。自由探索可以把反应整体倍乘或反向，反应式与焓变必须一起改变。
cues.en: Add the two step equations. Carbon monoxide is produced in the first and consumed in the second, so it cancels; two half-units of oxygen add to one. The overall change is minus three hundred ninety-three point five kilojoules, and the second step is minus two hundred eighty-three. Their difference gives minus one hundred ten point five for the first step. Scaling or reversing the reaction in exploration changes equations and enthalpy together.

cues.title: 从预期功能开始设计
cues.caption: 设计推理反向展开，表达仍沿DNA到蛋白质进行。
cues.captionEn: Design reasoning works backward; expression proceeds from DNA to protein.
cues.zh: 蛋白质工程先提出需要的功能，再形成结构与氨基酸序列假设，最后设计基因并检验表达产物。这是设计思路的反向推理，不是让蛋白质把遗传信息反向传给DNA。未经测定的设计，仍然只是等待验证的假设。
cues.en: Protein engineering begins with a desired function, proposes structural and sequence changes, and then designs genes and tests their products. This is backward design reasoning, not reverse transfer of genetic information from protein to DNA. An untested design remains a hypothesis.

cues.title: 一个短肽对应多种编码方案
cues.titleEn: One short peptide admits multiple coding choices
cues.caption: Ala–Trp–Lys–Glu–Phe有32种所示编码链组合。
cues.captionEn: The illustrated five-residue peptide has 32 coding-strand combinations.
cues.zh: 看这段由五种氨基酸组成的短肽。改变编码链上的密码子组合，得到的氨基酸顺序仍然相同。按这里采用的标准遗传密码，这段十五个碱基的编码链共有三十二种组合，所以不能仅凭蛋白质序列唯一反推出原来的DNA。
cues.en: Follow the five-residue peptide while its coding-strand triplets change. All thirty-two combinations shown encode the same amino-acid order under the standard genetic code. The peptide sequence therefore cannot uniquely identify the original fifteen-base coding sequence.

cues.title: 优劣取决于预先定义的测定
cues.titleEn: Performance depends on a specified assay
cues.caption: 改变温度，合成测定中两种酶的排名可以改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing temperature can reverse the ranking in this synthetic assay.
cues.zh: 再看一个独立的合成酶测定。两种变体有不同的初始活性和失活速度；改变温度，保温后的活性排名会改变。这里的数值不是胰岛素实验数据。工程上的更好，必须对应明确条件、评价指标和真实测量，不能只看结构是否漂亮。
cues.en: This separate synthetic enzyme assay gives two variants different initial activities and inactivation rates. Changing temperature can reverse their ranking after incubation. These are not insulin measurements. A better design must satisfy a defined objective under specified conditions and ultimately be tested.

cues.title: 从真实结构找出改造位置
cues.titleEn: Locate the changes in measured coordinates
cues.caption: A链21个残基、B链30个残基，三条二硫键保留。
cues.captionEn: The 21-residue A chain and 30-residue B chain retain three disulfides.
cues.zh: 现在转到胰岛素。画面来自公开结构中的真实坐标，显示两条链的骨架和三条二硫键，省略了多数侧链。金色节点标出B链二十八和二十九位。旋转可以帮助找出它们的位置，但单个结构本身还不能证明体内效果。
cues.en: The insulin view uses public structural coordinates: two chain backbones and three disulfide bonds, with most side chains omitted. Gold nodes identify B-chain residues twenty-eight and twenty-nine. Rotation helps locate the sites, but a structure alone does not establish effects in the body.

cues.title: 交换相邻残基改变相互作用
cues.titleEn: Exchange adjacent residues to alter interactions
cues.caption: 赖脯胰岛素将B28的P和B29的K交换。
cues.captionEn: Insulin lispro exchanges P at B28 and K at B29.
cues.zh: 对照两段B链末端序列。天然人胰岛素在二十八位是脯氨酸，二十九位是赖氨酸；赖脯胰岛素把这两个位置交换，其他画出的残基保持不变。教材还提到另一种置换方案，这里只追踪赖脯这一种，避免把不同改造混在一起。
cues.en: Compare the B-chain ends. Native human insulin has proline at position twenty-eight and lysine at twenty-nine. Insulin lispro exchanges those positions while the other displayed residues remain unchanged. The textbook also describes another substitution; this sequence comparison specifically follows lispro.

cues.title: 减少关联不等于永不聚集
cues.titleEn: Reduced association does not mean none
cues.caption: 示意曲线满足C=M+2D；关联仍随浓度改变。
cues.captionEn: The illustrative model conserves C=M+2D while association varies with concentration.
cues.zh: 在简化的单体与二聚体平衡中，降低关联常数可以提高单体所占比例，但仍会随总浓度改变。两条曲线的常数是示意，不能当作药物测量值。真实的赖脯胰岛素结构中也有六聚体证据，所以降低关联倾向不能解释成绝不形成聚集体。
cues.en: In a simplified monomer–dimer equilibrium, a lower association constant increases the monomer fraction, which still depends on total concentration. The constants here are illustrative, not measured drug parameters. Lispro has also been observed in hexameric structures, so reduced association does not mean that aggregates cannot form.

cues.title: 先确认数据库版本和比较范围
cues.titleEn: Check record versions and comparable regions
cues.caption: 前体中的A链、B链需要按注释分别提取。
cues.captionEn: Extract the annotated mature A and B chains separately from precursors.
cues.zh: 网络分析首先需要认清记录。画面给出人、猪、牛的固定登录号与版本，并标出前体中成熟A链和B链的位置。比较成熟胰岛素时，不能把不同长度的信号肽和连接肽误算为成熟链差异；来源、范围与检索日期都应留下记录。
cues.en: Begin a database analysis by identifying the record. Fixed human, pig and bovine accessions show the annotated A and B regions within their precursors. Comparing mature insulin requires excluding signal and connecting peptides. Record the source, sequence region, version and retrieval date.

cues.title: 把差异放回同源位置
cues.caption: 分别对齐两条成熟链后，汇总相同位置。
cues.captionEn: Align the two mature chains separately before aggregating matches.
cues.zh: 把成熟链放在对应位置上看，金色格子显示差异。这里的人和猪共有五十个位置相同，人和牛共有四十八个位置相同，比较范围都是两条成熟链合计五十一个位置。序列相近提供可检验的线索，但不能单独证明功能或使用条件完全相同。
cues.en: The highlighted cells locate differences at corresponding mature-chain positions. Human and pig match at fifty of fifty-one positions; human and cow match at forty-eight. The chains are aligned separately and their counts combined. Similarity provides evidence to investigate, not proof of identical function or conditions of use.

cues.title: 一致性必须连同比对范围阅读
cues.caption: B链前20位完全相同，只覆盖30位中的三分之二。
cues.captionEn: The identical first 20 B-chain residues cover only two-thirds of the chain.
cues.zh: 只截取人和牛B链的前二十位，可以得到百分之百一致，但它只覆盖整条B链的三分之二。扩大到三十位，就会看见末端差异。探索区可比较自己输入的同源片段；它执行教学用全局比对，不是实时BLAST搜索，也没有数据库命中的统计显著性。
cues.en: The first twenty human and bovine B-chain residues match completely, but cover only two-thirds of the chain. Extending to all thirty reveals the terminal difference. Exploration can align your own homologous regions with a teaching global-alignment algorithm; it is not a live BLAST search and supplies no database-hit significance.

cues.title: 反应前，两种溶液分别量温
cues.caption: 等体积稀溶液近似有相同热容量，初温取两者平均。
cues.captionEn: For equal volumes of dilute solutions, use the mean starting temperature.
cues.zh: 先看教材的两种溶液：五十毫升零点五摩尔每升盐酸，和五十毫升稍过量的氢氧化钠。两种溶液要分别记录初温。在近似相同密度和比热容的条件下，取两者平均，作为反应前体系温度。图中的数字只是计算示例，不是一次实际实验的记录。
cues.en: The textbook uses fifty millilitres of half-molar hydrochloric acid and an equal volume of slightly excess sodium hydroxide. Record the starting temperatures separately. Assuming equal density and specific heat capacity, their mean gives the initial temperature for the combined system. The displayed numbers are a calculated example, not a record of a performed experiment.

cues.title: 混合后，追踪最高温度
cues.caption: 内筒、隔热层与杯盖减少散热；温度计浸入液体，搅拌使读数有代表性。
cues.captionEn: The inner cup, insulation and lid reduce heat loss; an immersed thermometer follows the stirred liquid.
cues.zh: 现在看量热器剖面。内筒放在隔热层里面，杯盖上穿过温度计和玻璃搅拌器。反应放热后，温度上升；即使反应已经结束，温度还会因为散热而下降。教材记录的是最高温度，不是任意等待之后的温度。这里的时间曲线用于解释能量流向，并不是实际反应速率的预测。
cues.en: The section shows an inner vessel surrounded by insulation, with a thermometer and glass stirrer through the lid. Reaction heat raises the temperature. After the reaction ends, the temperature can fall as heat escapes. The textbook records the maximum, not an arbitrary delayed reading. The timeline illustrates energy transfer; it does not predict the actual reaction rate.

cues.title: 三次温差，换算到一摩尔
cues.titleEn: Repeat three times and convert per mole
cues.caption: 先平均三次温差，再算100g溶液吸热；生成水为0.025mol。
cues.captionEn: Average three temperature rises, then calculate heat absorbed by 100 g of solution; 0.025 mol of water forms.
cues.zh: 教材要求重复三次，先求温差平均值。两份溶液合计约一百克，以水的比热容四点一八焦每克每摄氏度计算吸热。盐酸提供零点零二五摩尔氢离子，氢氧化钠略过量，所以生成水的物质的量由盐酸限制。最后把这一次反应的热量，换算为生成一摩尔水的焓变，放热要取负号。
cues.en: The textbook calls for three trials and the mean temperature rise. The combined solution is approximately one hundred grams, with the specific heat capacity of water, four point one eight joules per gram per degree. Hydrochloric acid supplies zero point zero two five moles of hydrogen ions; the base is slightly in excess. Divide the heat by that amount of water formed, and give the exothermic enthalpy change a negative sign.

cues.title: 没有计入的热量去了哪里
cues.titleEn: Account for heat outside the solution
cues.caption: 反应放热分到溶液、杯体和环境；重复测量不能消除同方向的系统偏差。
cues.captionEn: Released heat enters the solution, vessel and surroundings; repeated trials do not remove systematic bias.
cues.zh: 把热量去向拆开看。同一次反应释放的能量，一部分留在溶液，一部分被量热器吸收，还有一部分已经流向环境。若只用溶液的质量乘比热容乘温差，算出的放热绝对值就偏小。虚线表示忽略杯体热容和散热的理想情况。三次平均可以减轻随机波动，却不能自动补回每次都漏算的热量。
cues.en: Separate the destinations of the released energy: solution, vessel and surroundings. Counting only solution mass times specific heat capacity times temperature rise underestimates the magnitude. The dashed curve ignores both vessel heat capacity and environmental loss. Averaging trials can reduce random variation, but cannot restore energy systematically omitted from every calculation.

cues.title: 冰量热计的三层空间
cues.caption: 中央放热，测量冰吸热；外围防护冰截留环境热，两层融水分别排出。
cues.captionEn: The central source melts measurement ice; outer guard ice intercepts ambient heat, with a separate drain.
cues.zh: 历史上的冰量热计换了一种读数。中央空间放入被研究的物体或反应，周围的测量冰吸收它释放的热量。最外层还有防护冰，拦住环境传来的热。两层冰的融水必须分别排出，不能混在同一个收集器里。燃烧还需要进气和出气管，气路通过冰层换热。这是依据原著画出的结构示意，不是复制文物的外观尺寸。
cues.en: The historical ice calorimeter uses a different observable. A central body or reaction transfers heat to surrounding measurement ice. An outer layer of guard ice intercepts environmental heat. The two meltwater streams must drain separately. Combustion also needs inlet and outlet gas tubes, conditioned by the ice layers. This is a structural diagram based on the original description, not a dimensionally exact replica.

cues.title: 反应热化成多少融水
cues.titleEn: Turn released energy into melted ice
cues.caption: 冰与水共存时，吸收的热量用于相变；测量层的融水逐渐积累。
cues.captionEn: With ice and water coexisting, absorbed heat drives melting and the measurement melt accumulates.
cues.zh: 让中央的碳放出热量。测量层中的冰在零摄氏度附近熔化，融水沿独立通道流进下面的收集器。外围防护层也可能产生融水，但那一部分对应外界输入，留在另外的收集器。这里用现代石墨燃烧焓驱动示例，并未把动画数字说成拉瓦锡和拉普拉斯当年的观测结果。
cues.en: Let the central carbon release heat. Measurement ice melts near zero Celsius and its water drains into the main collector. The guard can also produce meltwater, but that reflects external input and enters a different collector. Modern graphite combustion enthalpy drives this example; the displayed numbers are not presented as Lavoisier and Laplace’s original measurements.

cues.title: 把融水质量换回热量
cues.titleEn: Convert measurement melt mass to heat
cues.caption: 在零摄氏度融冰、完整收集等理想条件下，Q=m融冰L；防护层融水不相加。
cues.captionEn: For ice initially at 0 °C and complete collection, Q = mL; do not add guard melt.
cues.zh: 最后只称测量层的融水。用融冰质量乘熔化潜热，就能把质量读数换回热量。自由探索可以增加外围输入的热量：只要防护冰仍然有效，外围融水变多，不应改变中央反应的测量值。这说明量热测量既需要一个可计算的读数，也需要让这个读数只属于研究对象。
cues.en: Weigh only the measurement-layer melt. Multiplying its mass by the latent heat of fusion converts mass back to heat. In exploration, increasing external heat produces more guard melt without changing the central measurement while the guard remains effective. Calorimetry needs both a calculable observable and an apparatus that attributes it to the intended source.

cues.title: 从单体到链段
cues.caption: 双键参与加聚，碳与氯的身份保留，不生成小分子副产物。
cues.captionEn: Addition retains the carbon and chlorine identities without a small-molecule byproduct.
cues.zh: 追踪这四份氯乙烯。每一份仍有两个碳和一个氯，但原来双键的一部分连接转化为单体之间的连接，最后成为连续链段。两端的短线表示链还可以延续，真实端基没有展开。这里展示净连接变化，不把插值动画当作自由基反应的实际轨迹。
cues.en: Track four vinyl chloride units. Each retains two carbons and one chlorine as double-bond participation allows links between units to form. The short end lines indicate continuation of a chain; actual end groups are omitted. This animation represents net connectivity, not an elementary radical trajectory.

cues.title: 连接一次，排出一份水
cues.titleEn: A link and a water molecule
cues.caption: 二酸与二醇形成一条开链时，2n 个单体形成 2n − 1 个连接。
cues.captionEn: An open chain from 2n diacid and diol molecules has 2n − 1 links.
cues.zh: 放大缩聚中的一处酯键。醇的氧保留在酯键中，酸的羟基与氢形成水；这是便于计数的净反应表示。把两份二酸与两份二醇连成一条开链，需要三个连接，也排出三份水。两端还保留官能团，因此有限链不能把水的数量直接写成四。
cues.en: Zoom in on one ester linkage. Alcohol oxygen remains in the ester while acid hydroxyl and hydrogen provide water, shown as a net accounting transformation. Two diacids and two diols need three links to make one open chain, releasing three waters. Functional groups remain at the ends, so a finite chain does not release four.

cues.title: 水浴中的酚醛树脂
cues.titleEn: Phenolic resin in a water bath
cues.caption: 实验比较酸、碱条件；教材用酸催化与等物质的量配比解释线型结构。
cues.captionEn: The experiment compares catalysts; the textbook explains a linear structure with acid catalysis and equimolar reactants.
cues.zh: 实验五之一在水浴中比较苯酚与甲醛的酸、碱催化反应。画面把试管观察与结构解释分开。按照教材的酸催化、等物质的量模型，亚甲基在苯酚的邻位或对位连接不同苯环，羟基仍保留。树脂的颜色和外观这里只作示意，不代表测得的反应速度。
cues.en: Experiment five-one compares acid and base catalysis for phenol and formaldehyde in a water bath. The vessel observation is separated from the structural interpretation. In the textbook acid-catalyzed equimolar model, methylene bridges link ortho or para ring positions while hydroxyl groups remain. Appearance and color are illustrative, not measured kinetics.

cues.title: 继续反应形成交联网
cues.caption: 碱催化、甲醛过量与继续反应共同构成此处的网状树脂条件。
cues.captionEn: Base catalysis, excess formaldehyde and further reaction support this crosslinked resin model.
cues.zh: 继续看第二种结构。甲醛过量时，苯环可以带有多个羟甲基；继续反应便在原有链之间增加连接。新的棕色桥不是氢键，而是共价交联。不能只换一个催化剂就保证相同的网络；探索中去掉甲醛过量条件，模型便不作形成交联网的判断。
cues.en: With excess formaldehyde, a phenol ring can acquire several hydroxymethyl groups. Further reaction adds covalent links between chains. The new brown bridges are not hydrogen bonds. A catalyst switch alone does not guarantee this network: removing the excess-formaldehyde condition in exploration withholds that prediction.

cues.title: 吸水而不溶解
cues.caption: 亲水基团帮助吸水，少量交联让原有网络在膨胀时保持相连。
cues.captionEn: Hydrophilic groups support water uptake while sparse crosslinks retain a connected network.
cues.zh: 高吸水性树脂需要另一种交联程度。亲水链段与水相互作用，水进入后链间距离增大，但少量交联让原来的网络仍然相连。若完全没有稳定网络，溶解的聚合物不能简单当作可称量的湿凝胶。这里保留每条连接，只把膨胀画成可追踪的结构变化。
cues.en: A superabsorbent uses a different degree of crosslinking. Hydrophilic segments interact with water, and the network expands while sparse crosslinks preserve connectivity. Without a stable network, dissolved polymer cannot simply be treated as a retained wet gel. Each displayed connection persists during the illustrative swelling.

cues.title: 同质量、同水量的对照
cues.titleEn: Equal dry mass and water supply
cues.caption: 两份 1.0 g 材料接触相同水量；本片容量是明确标出的假设值。
cues.captionEn: Equal 1.0 g samples receive equal water; capacities here are explicitly hypothetical.
cues.zh: 教材用一克树脂与一克普通吸水材料，分别接触七十毫升水，搅拌后静置五分钟。本片用假设容量演示记录方法，不冒充教材实测结果。吸收的水从游离水中转移，水总量不变。即使材料的容量更大，这次实验的有限水源也会限制能观察到的吸水量。
cues.en: The textbook compares one gram of resin with one gram of an ordinary absorbent, each given seventy milliliters of water and allowed to stand after stirring. These illustrative capacities teach measurement, not textbook experimental results. Water moves from the free pool into the material, and finite supply limits observable uptake.

cues.title: 倾水、扣皮重、计算
cues.caption: 先倾出未吸收的水，再用湿样质量计算 g/g；残留游离水会高估结果。
cues.captionEn: Drain unabsorbed water and subtract tare; retained free water inflates the g/g result.
cues.zh: 称量前要倾出未被吸收的水，也要扣除烧杯皮重。所得湿样质量减去干样质量，再除以干样质量，就是每克材料所保留的水质量。看两只烧杯的读数随倾水而下降，真正吸收的水却没有被扣掉。探索中停在倾水未完成的位置，就能看到游离水怎样把结果虚增。
cues.en: Before weighing, drain unabsorbed water and subtract the beaker tare. Subtract dry mass from wet sample mass and divide by dry mass to obtain grams of retained water per gram of material. Balance readings fall as free water drains, without removing the absorbed amount. Pause exploration before draining finishes to expose the overestimate.

cues.title: 从具体对象和原始清单开始
cues.titleEn: Start with an identified event and original list
cues.caption: 同是安全证书，条目中的对象、用途和区域不同。
cues.captionEn: Certificate entries specify different events, purposes and regions.
cues.zh: 先读两份历史条目。玉米MON87427的这一条用于进口加工原料；番木瓜YK1601的另一条涉及华南适宜生态区的生产应用。调查应保留对象标识、编号、日期和出处，不能只抄一个作物名称，也不能把这两个例子当成全部现行清单。
cues.en: Compare two archived entries. One concerns imported MON87427 maize for processing; the other concerns YK1601 papaya production in suitable South China zones. Preserve identifiers, numbers, dates and sources. Crop names alone are insufficient, and these two examples are not a complete current register.

cues.title: 改变用途会越出证据范围
cues.titleEn: Changing the proposed use exceeds the evidence
cues.caption: 加工原料条目不能直接支持种植用途。
cues.captionEn: An imported-processing entry does not establish permission to plant.
cues.zh: 保持对象和日期不变，把拟议用途从加工原料改成种植，用途一项就不再匹配。探索里也可以改变地区、日期或对象。即使四项都匹配，也只是与这份文件相符；后续变更、品种审定和其他许可，仍要分别查证。
cues.en: Keep the event and date unchanged while switching the proposed use from processing to planting. The purpose no longer matches. Exploration also changes region, date and identity. Even four matching fields establish only agreement with this document; later changes and other permissions require separate checks.

cues.title: 生产过程与最终产品分开记录
cues.titleEn: Record manufacturing origin and final product separately
cues.caption: 重组DNA生产证据不等于产品里存在活的工程菌。
cues.captionEn: Recombinant production does not mean the product contains living engineered bacteria.
cues.zh: 生活中的生物技术产品还包括重组蛋白。FDA历史资料记录了重组人胰岛素在一九八二年的批准，提供生产方法的来源证据。生产用细胞、制备得到的蛋白和最终产品是不同对象。自己的家庭调查要查具体产品资料，不能把历史例子冒充访问结果。
cues.en: Biotechnology products include recombinant proteins. FDA historical records document the nineteen-eighty-two approval of recombinant human insulin and its manufacturing origin. Production cells, prepared protein and finished product are different objects. Investigate specific household products rather than treating this historical example as an interview result.

cues.title: 翻面后再核对原料与目录
cues.caption: 先记录标签原文，再核对原料、类别与适用规定。
cues.captionEn: Record exact wording before checking ingredients, category and applicable rules.
cues.zh: 示意包装的正面不能告诉我们生产方法。翻到背面，记录原料标识，再与产品类别和来源证据一起核对。练习依据所列法规版本和目录；棉纤维也不能因为名字相近，就当成目录里的棉花种子。信息不全时，保留待核查状态。
cues.en: The fictional package front cannot establish how the product was made. Inspect the ingredient wording, then check it against category and provenance. The exercise uses the specified regulatory version and catalogue. Cotton fibre is not cotton seed; incomplete evidence must remain unresolved.

cues.title: 缺失记录不能变成阴性结论
cues.titleEn: Missing observations are not negative findings
cues.caption: 八条教学记录中，三条未记录仍保持未知。
cues.captionEn: Three of the eight teaching records remain unrecorded, not negative.
cues.zh: 这八条是教学样本，不是真实市场调查。三条记录了转基因标识，两条记录了非转基因宣称，还有三条没有完成记录。问号不能改成非转基因，也不能把便利取得的八个产品外推为整个市场。自己的记录区从空白开始，只汇总实际录入的产品。
cues.en: These eight records are teaching examples, not a market survey. Three record GM statements, two record non-GM claims and three are incomplete. Missing information is not a non-GM finding, and a convenience sample does not represent the market. Your own record starts blank and counts only entered products.

cues.title: 营销语句不能代替比较研究
cues.titleEn: Marketing language cannot replace comparison evidence
cues.caption: “非转基因”几个字不能独立证明“更安全”。
cues.captionEn: The words non-GM alone do not establish greater safety.
cues.zh: 再看示意营销语句：非转基因，所以更安全。前一部分描述或宣称生产来源，后一部分却是比较性的风险结论。要支持这个结论，需要明确比较对象、条件和测定指标。即使补充一份研究，也要检查它的设计与适用范围，而不是看到链接就直接接受。
cues.en: The illustrative slogan turns an origin claim into a comparative safety conclusion. Supporting that conclusion requires a defined comparator, matched conditions and measured endpoints. Supplying a study is only a starting point: its design and applicability still require assessment.

cues.title: 把观察、证据和边界带入科普
cues.caption: 科普草案保留原始链接、资料日期和未解决问题。
cues.captionEn: A communication draft retains original links, dates and unresolved questions.
cues.zh: 最后把调查整理成可复核的科普计划。先写实际观察到什么，再列原始证据、日期与结论边界，最后说明面向谁、怎样呈现和怎样接收反馈。不要替商家编造动机，也不要用赞成或反对的立场代替证据；保留未知同样是严谨调查的一部分。
cues.en: Turn the investigation into a checkable communication plan: observations first, then original evidence, dates and limits, followed by audience, format and feedback. Do not invent a seller’s motives or substitute a position for evidence. Keeping unresolved questions visible is part of a careful investigation.

cues.title: 保持混合气相同，只改变光照
cues.titleEn: Hold the mixture fixed and change light
cues.caption: 相同甲烷—氯气混合物，一组遮光、一组在光亮处比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare identical methane–chlorine mixtures in darkness and in light.
cues.zh: 教材把两支装有相同混合气的试管倒置在饱和氯化钠溶液中。一组包上铝箔遮光，另一组置于光亮处，比较时尽量保持其他条件一致。左侧铝箔作了剖开显示，方便看见内部状态。这个对照关注的是光照条件，不是改变气体配比或换一种容器。
cues.en: The textbook compares two inverted tubes containing the same mixture over saturated sodium chloride solution. One is wrapped in foil; the other is exposed to light, with other conditions held alike. The foil is shown in cutaway so the unchanged interior remains visible. This comparison changes light, not gas composition or vessel type.

cues.title: 光先改变哪根键？
cues.titleEn: Which bond does light change first?
cues.caption: 吸收光后，Cl—Cl断裂成两个自由基。
cues.captionEn: Absorbed light splits Cl—Cl into two radicals.
cues.zh: 先看光照侧的颜色变浅，再放大一个氯分子。它吸收合适的光，氯氯键断裂，两个氯各保留一个未成对电子。圆点标出自由基，不是额外生成的原子。新鲜的暗样本没有这次光引发，所以保持原状。如果此后没有新的光，已经形成的自由基会立刻消失吗？先记住这两个圆点，后面沿着它们引出的反应继续看。
cues.en: First notice the fading illuminated sample. Now follow one chlorine molecule. Absorbed light breaks its bond, leaving one unpaired electron on each chlorine. The dots mark radicals, not newly created atoms. The fresh dark sample lacks this initiation event and stays unchanged. If no new light arrives, must radicals already present vanish at once? Keep track of these two dots as we follow the reaction they can start.

cues.title: 液滴与液面提供另一组证据
cues.titleEn: Look for droplets and liquid rise
cues.caption: 管壁出现有机液滴，HCl进入水相，气相减少而液面上升。
cues.captionEn: Organic droplets appear; HCl enters the aqueous phase and the liquid level rises as gas is removed.
cues.zh: 现在同时看管壁和液面。继续取代能够形成常温下可呈液态的有机产物，所以管壁出现油状液滴。生成的氯化氢容易进入水相，气相数量减少，液体进入管内。不要把液滴直接认作一氯甲烷：它在常温下是气体。液面和液滴只展示教材观察到的趋势，没有按真实汽液平衡预测高度或滴数。
cues.en: Now inspect the wall and liquid level. Further substitution produces organic compounds that can be liquid at room temperature, giving oily droplets. Hydrogen chloride enters the aqueous phase, removing gas and allowing the liquid level to rise. The droplets should not be labelled chloromethane, which is a gas at room temperature. Height and drop count illustrate textbook observations rather than a quantitative phase-equilibrium prediction.

cues.title: 自由基怎样把反应接下去？
cues.titleEn: How does a radical carry the reaction onward?
cues.caption: 一个Cl·被消耗，另一个Cl·产生；链可以继续。
cues.captionEn: One Cl· is consumed; another is produced to carry the chain.
cues.zh: 回到已经引发的样本，此后不再给新的光。一个氯自由基夺走甲烷的一个氢，形成氯化氢，碳上留下未成对电子。这个碳自由基再与一分子氯气反应：一个氯接到碳上，另一个成为新的氯自由基。新载体不是刚才那个氯原子，却能接着夺氢。现在它遇到同一碳骨架上剩下的氢，第二次取代继续了。再看两份氯自由基相遇，结合成氯分子，这条链就终止。跟踪对象始终是一个碳、四个氢和六个氯；这是一条可能的反应链，不是所有碰撞必走的路线，也不把动作秒数当反应速率。
cues.en: Return to the initiated sample, with no new light. A chlorine radical takes one hydrogen from methane, making hydrogen chloride and leaving an unpaired electron on carbon. The carbon radical reacts with a chlorine molecule. One chlorine bonds to carbon; the other becomes a new chlorine radical. It is a different atom, but the same kind of chain carrier. Now it encounters a remaining hydrogen on that carbon framework, allowing a second substitution. Finally, two chlorine radicals meet and combine. This chain ends. The same one carbon, four hydrogens and six chlorines remain throughout. This is one possible chain, not a prediction that every collision follows this route or that screen seconds measure reaction speed.

cues.title: 更多甲烷，为什么会改变混合物？
cues.titleEn: Why does extra methane change the mixture?
cues.caption: 仍有C—H的产物能再被选中；配比改变这种机会。
cues.captionEn: Products retaining C—H can be selected again; the ratio changes that opportunity.
cues.zh: 把视野拉开。每个格子仍是同一个碳，下面四点记录它的四个氢位置。同一个碳可能被选中不止一次，因此一氯产物与更深度取代的产物能够并存。现在固定八份氯气，把甲烷从八份增加到三十二份：哪一组会有更少的多取代分子？先作预测。若暂时假设所有剩余氢位置被选中的机会相同，更多尚未取代的位置会分走机会，重复选中减少。画面显示这个有限统计模型的平均份数，不是实验产率。真实产物的反应性并不相同；配比能帮助控制混合物，却不能凭一条总方程保证只有一氯甲烷。
cues.en: Widen the view. Each tile remains the same carbon, with four dots recording its original hydrogen sites. A carbon can be selected more than once, so monochlorinated and further substituted products can coexist. Keep eight chlorine units but increase methane from eight to thirty-two units. Which sample should have fewer multiply substituted molecules? Make a prediction. If all remaining hydrogen sites were equally likely to be selected, more untouched sites would compete for the same substitutions, reducing repeat selections. The numbers are mean amounts in this finite statistical model, not measured yields. Real products have different reactivities. Changing the ratio helps control the mixture; a single overall equation cannot guarantee chloromethane alone.

cues.title: 太阳中的陌生谱线
cues.caption: 相近的黄色并不等于同一种谱线；波长标尺先要对齐。
cues.captionEn: Similar yellow colors are not identical spectral lines; compare calibrated wavelengths.
cues.zh: 一八六八年，太阳边缘的光谱出现了新的线索。把黄光附近放大，氦的谱线约在五百八十七点六纳米，旁边钠的两条黄线并不在同一位置。画面只截取这一小段波长，亮度也作了归一化。未知线值得继续研究，但一条颜色相近的亮线本身还不是完整鉴定。
cues.en: In eighteen sixty-eight, light from the solar edge supplied a new clue. In this enlarged yellow region, helium lies near five hundred eighty-seven point six nanometers, apart from the sodium doublet. This is a narrow, normalized spectral window. An unfamiliar line motivates investigation, but a similar-looking color alone is not complete identification.

cues.title: 把天空与矿物联系起来
cues.titleEn: Connect sunlight with a mineral gas
cues.caption: 矿物中释放的气体提供可比对的地面光谱证据。
cues.captionEn: Gas released from a mineral supplied a terrestrial spectrum for comparison.
cues.zh: 二十多年后，拉姆齐研究矿物释放的气体，再请光谱学家协助判断。把两个来源放到同一标尺上，关键谱线的位置吻合。探索中故意偏移气样标尺，或加宽谱线，就会看到校准和分辨率的重要性。这里展示的是这条证据的原理，不是复制当年的原始记录。
cues.en: Decades later, Ramsay investigated gas released from a mineral and sought a spectroscopist’s help. On a common wavelength scale, the diagnostic line matches the solar clue. In exploration, shift the sample scale or broaden the lines to see why calibration and resolution matter. This reconstructs the evidence principle rather than reproducing original records.

cues.title: 一丁点密度差
cues.caption: 同体积、同条件下，教材两组数据相差每升 6.4 mg。
cues.captionEn: At equal volume and conditions, the textbook values differ by 6.4 mg per liter.
cues.zh: 另一条发现链来自称量。教材给出的化学来源氮气密度是一点二五零八克每升，空气来源气样是一点二五七二克每升。每升只差六点四毫克，但重复存在的差别需要解释。必须比较同样的温度、压力和体积；探索中的假设温差也能改变质量差，提醒我们先排除条件不一致。
cues.en: Another discovery chain began with weighing. The textbook gives one point two five zero eight grams per liter for chemically prepared nitrogen, versus one point two five seven two for an air-derived sample: just six point four milligrams per liter. Temperature, pressure and volume must match. The hypothetical temperature control shows why unequal conditions could confound that comparison.

cues.title: 剩余气体没有消失
cues.caption: 移去已知组分后，残留气体及其独立光谱继续支持新元素判断。
cues.captionEn: After known components are removed, the residual gas and its distinct spectrum support a new element.
cues.zh: 密度差引出了空气含有较重未知组分的假设。沿着密封循环追踪金色标记：已知气体依次被移走，进入另外的反应产物，剩余标记仍留在气相。随后还需要检查残留物的光谱。这个简化回路解释分离逻辑，不是拉姆齐完整装置的复刻，也不是说剩余的气体自动就证明一种新元素。
cues.en: The density difference suggested a heavier unknown component in air. Track the gold marker through this closed teaching loop. Known components are removed into products while the residual marker remains gaseous. Its spectrum supplies further evidence. The loop illustrates separation logic, not Ramsay’s complete apparatus, and a residue alone does not prove a new element.

cues.title: 密封打开后出现新物质
cues.titleEn: A new material appears after contact
cues.caption: 相近的电离能启发假设；打开密封后的新产物提供实验检验。
cues.captionEn: Similar ionization energies motivated a hypothesis; new material after contact tested it.
cues.zh: 一九六二年，巴特利特把六氟化铂与氙分隔在相连的容器中。六氟化铂能氧化氧气，而氧分子与氙原子的电离能相近，这启发了检验。打开密封后出现橙黄色固体，说明氙参与了反应。仅凭相近电离能不能预言全部产物；画面也没有把历史首产物假定为一种确定的简单晶格。
cues.en: In nineteen sixty-two, Bartlett separated platinum hexafluoride and xenon in connected containers. Platinum hexafluoride could oxidize molecular oxygen, whose ionization energy is close to atomic xenon’s. Opening the seal produced an orange-yellow solid and evidence of xenon reaction. Ionization energy alone does not predict every product, and this view does not assign one definitive simple lattice to the historical material.

cues.title: 修正的是绝对判断
cues.caption: 已确认的氙化合物推翻“绝不反应”，但反应仍取决于具体条件。
cues.captionEn: Confirmed xenon compounds refute absolute inertness; reactivity still depends on conditions.
cues.zh: 后来确认的二氟化氙提供了清楚的分子结构例子：两个氟位于氙的两侧，整体为线型。它与最初的铂氟化物产物不是同一种物质。新的证据迫使人们放弃“稀有气体绝不反应”的绝对判断，却不意味着每一种稀有气体都能在普通条件下轻易形成同样的化合物。
cues.en: Later-confirmed xenon difluoride provides a clear molecular example: two fluorines lie on opposite sides of xenon in a linear structure. It is distinct from the original platinum-fluoride product. Such evidence rejects the absolute claim of inertness without implying that every noble gas readily forms analogous compounds under ordinary conditions.

cues.title: 比较入射与透过
cues.caption: 同一波数下比较 I 与 I₀，吸收越强，透过率越低。
cues.captionEn: At one wavenumber, compare I with I₀: stronger absorption gives lower transmittance.
cues.zh: 红外光经过样品池后，有些频段的强度减弱。探测器要比较透过强度与参照强度，得到透过率。画面中进入与离开样品的光来自同一条光路，光场振幅按强度平方根变化。波形的空间尺度只是示意，不是把纳米级电磁波放进桌面装置直接看见。
cues.en: After infrared light crosses a sample cell, some frequency bands lose intensity. Comparing transmitted and reference intensities gives transmittance. Both fields share one optical path, and displayed field amplitude follows the square root of intensity. The waveform is magnified symbolism, not a directly visible microscopic electromagnetic wave.

cues.title: 频率吻合还不够
cues.caption: 红外活性还要求振动改变偶极矩；N₂ 振动提供反例。
cues.captionEn: Infrared activity also requires a changing dipole; N₂ vibration is a counterexample.
cues.zh: 把一处键看成有质量的谐振子。接近自身振动频率时，外场更容易驱动它，但还有一个条件：振动要改变电偶极矩。后面出现的氮分子仍在振动，却不因这个对称伸缩模式吸收红外光。探索中把氢换成氘，质量增加，计算出的振动波数也会下降。
cues.en: Treat one bond as a mass-bearing harmonic oscillator. Driving strengthens near its natural frequency, but the vibration must also change the electric dipole. The nitrogen molecule still vibrates while its symmetric stretch remains infrared inactive in this ideal model. Replacing hydrogen with deuterium increases reduced mass and lowers the calculated wavenumber.

cues.title: 把透过率连成谱
cues.caption: 波数由高到低扫描，透过率谷对应样品的吸收带。
cues.captionEn: Scan from high to low wavenumber; transmittance valleys mark absorption bands.
cues.zh: 现在改变入射波数，把每次得到的透过率记在同一张图上。横轴按红外光谱常见的方式，从高波数排到低波数；纵轴是透过率，所以吸收对应向下的谷。这里用合成谱带展示测量关系，并不复制教材谱图的细节，也不把一条谷直接当作完整分子结构。
cues.en: Scan the incident wavenumber and record each transmittance value. The horizontal axis runs from high to low wavenumber, as commonly displayed in infrared spectroscopy. Because the vertical axis is transmittance, absorption appears as a downward valley. These synthetic bands explain the measurement without copying every feature of the textbook spectrum or assigning a whole structure from one valley.

cues.title: 把谱带联系到官能团
cues.caption: O–H、C–H 与 C–O 的证据共同支持含羟基结构。
cues.captionEn: O–H, C–H and C–O evidence together supports a hydroxyl-containing structure.
cues.zh: 教材中的未知物出现了氧氢、碳氢与碳氧的振动吸收。看羟基连接到分子上的位置，再看高波数区的宽吸收带。凝聚态中氢键等相互作用会影响谱带位置和宽度，因此真实谱图不是三条固定不变的刻度线。判断官能团之后，还要和已经获得的分子式等证据合并。
cues.en: The textbook unknown exhibits O–H, C–H and C–O absorption. Locate its hydroxyl group, then inspect the broad high-wavenumber band. Hydrogen bonding and environment affect condensed-phase positions and widths, so real spectra are not three immutable lines. Functional-group evidence must be combined with the previously established molecular formula.

cues.title: 同分异构体与干扰
cues.caption: C₂H₆O 候选中的羟基有区分力，但未扣除水背景会造成误判。
cues.captionEn: A hydroxyl band distinguishes the C₂H₆O candidates, but unremoved water can mislead.
cues.zh: 乙醇和二甲醚都有碳氧键，也都含六个氢；只有乙醇本身带羟基。叠加比较时，宽的氧氢带提供关键区别。接着加入没有扣除的水吸收背景，二甲醚通道也出现类似信号。这不把二甲醚变成乙醇，而是说明空白、样品状态与多种独立证据为什么必要。
cues.en: Ethanol and dimethyl ether both contain carbon–oxygen bonds and six hydrogens, but only ethanol has its own hydroxyl group. Overlaying their spectra reveals that distinction. An unremoved water background then adds a similar signal to the ether channel. The ether has not become ethanol: blanks, sample conditions and independent evidence remain essential.

cues.title: 先看乙烯的燃烧
cues.caption: 黑烟提示局部不完全燃烧。
cues.captionEn: Soot signals incomplete burning.
cues.zh: 先从教材实验七之二的燃烧现象出发。乙烯的火焰明亮，伴有黑烟；烟炱与局部不完全燃烧有关。火焰能说明它可以燃烧，却不能仅凭颜色或黑烟认定一种气体的身份。本镜头展示教材观察，不计算真实火焰流场或烟粒产率。
cues.en: Experiment seven-two begins with ethene combustion. The flame is bright and accompanied by soot associated with locally incomplete combustion. Burning establishes combustibility, but flame colour or soot alone does not identify a gas. This view illustrates the textbook observation without predicting flame flow or soot yield.

cues.title: 紫色消失，锰去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does manganese go when purple fades?
cues.caption: 追踪锰、氧和氢，再检验预测。
cues.captionEn: Track Mn, O and H, then predict.
cues.zh: 紫色变浅，锰原子去了哪里？在足够酸的条件下，一份高锰酸根接受五份电子当量，成为二价锰。沿着原来的四个氧看：它们与八份质子一起，净生成四份水。这是净收支，不是游离电子在水中飞行。现在，一毫摩尔高锰酸根只得到四毫摩尔电子当量，还能全部褪色吗？先作预测。最多能还原零点八毫摩尔，还剩零点二毫摩尔高锰酸根。再看另一种褪色：溴原子接到了碳上。这个加成也改变了氧化数。相似的颜色变化，不能代替对产物和原子去向的判断。
cues.en: Purple fades, but where does the manganese go? In sufficiently acidic solution, a permanganate unit gains five electron equivalents and becomes manganese two. Follow its four oxygens: together with eight protons they account for four waters. These moving tokens show the net balance, not free electrons flying through water. Now give one millimole of permanganate only four millimoles of electron equivalents. Can it all disappear? Pause to predict. At most eight-tenths can be reduced, leaving two-tenths. Bromine fades for a different visible reason: its atoms become attached to carbon. That addition also changes oxidation states. Colour alone cannot tell us the product or the reaction pathway.

cues.title: 换成溴的四氯化碳溶液
cues.titleEn: Change to bromine in carbon tetrachloride
cues.caption: Br₂被消耗，追踪两个溴原子。
cues.captionEn: Br₂ is consumed; track its atoms.
cues.zh: 教材实验七之三换用溴的四氯化碳溶液。溴的颜色随着消耗变浅，乙烯的碳碳双键发生加成。虽然两种试剂都褪色，原因不能混为一谈。这里保留教材的溶剂名称，也不把它替换成可能产生不同副产物的溴水。
cues.en: Experiment seven-three uses bromine in carbon tetrachloride. Bromine colour fades as addition occurs at ethene’s carbon–carbon double bond. Both reagents lose colour, but their reactions are different. The textbook solvent is retained rather than silently replaced by bromine water, which can involve different products.

cues.title: 跟住两个碳和两个溴
cues.titleEn: Track both carbons and both bromines
cues.caption: 碳和氢保留，两个溴加入。
cues.captionEn: Carbon and hydrogen remain; Br joins.
cues.zh: 放大连接关系。双键中的一份不饱和连接消失，碳碳单键仍然保留。溴分子的两个原子分别连到两个碳，生成一二二溴乙烷；原来乙烯中的四个氢没有被替换，也不生成氯化氢那样的取代副产物。图中只记净加成前后的连接，不把淡入连线当成真实基元机理。
cues.en: Enlarge the connectivity. One unsaturated bond is removed while the carbon–carbon single bond remains. The two bromine atoms attach to different carbons, producing one-two-dibromoethane. Ethene’s four hydrogen atoms remain; this is not hydrogen replacement with a hydrogen-halide by-product. Fading bonds record net connectivity, not an elementary reaction mechanism.

cues.title: 从电石沿气路追踪乙炔
cues.titleEn: Trace ethyne from the carbide generator
cues.caption: 气体先进入洗气液内部。
cues.captionEn: Gas goes through the liquid first.
cues.zh: 选择性必修三的乙炔探究先需要看清气路。分液漏斗通向发生瓶，电石与水反应生成乙炔和氢氧化钙。教材用饱和氯化钠溶液帮助减缓剧烈反应。气体离开发生瓶，经过导管进入洗气液深处，再从液面上方的短导管离开。器物先连接成连续路径，才能解释后续观察。
cues.en: The acetylene inquiry first requires a continuous gas path. A dropping funnel feeds the generator, where calcium carbide and water form acetylene and calcium hydroxide. The textbook uses saturated sodium chloride solution to moderate the vigorous reaction. Gas leaves the generator, enters deep in the washing liquid and exits through a short tube above the surface. The connected apparatus determines what reaches the tests.

cues.title: 洗气先排除干扰
cues.caption: Cu²⁺容量不足，H₂S可能穿透。
cues.captionEn: Finite Cu²⁺ can leave residual H₂S.
cues.zh: 近看洗气瓶。电石制得的气体可能夹带硫化氢等杂质，教材用硫酸铜溶液吸收它们。模型把硫化氢与铜离子生成硫化铜的过程单独记账，黑色固体在瓶底积累。净化剂不是无限容量：自由探索减少铜离子份数，就会留下出口杂质。若不先排除干扰，后面的褪色就不能全部归因于乙炔。
cues.en: Look closely at the scrubber. Gas from carbide can contain hydrogen sulfide and other impurities, which the textbook removes with copper sulfate. The model separately accounts for hydrogen sulfide reacting with copper ions to form copper sulfide, shown accumulating as dark solid. Capacity is finite: less copper leaves outlet impurity. Without purification, later decolourisation cannot be attributed entirely to acetylene.

cues.title: 分别检验氧化与加成
cues.caption: 两份独立样品，分别提供证据。
cues.captionEn: Separate samples, separate evidence.
cues.zh: 净化后的乙炔分别进入两种性质试剂，画面是两个替换检验，不是让气体先穿过一种再穿过另一种。酸性高锰酸钾检验氧化性质，溴的四氯化碳溶液用于观察加成。乙炔的三键含有两份可用于加成的不饱和连接，足量溴可以分两步加入，最终得到四溴取代的加成产物，两个碳仍然相连。
cues.en: Purified acetylene is tested separately with the two reagents; they are alternatives, not bottles connected in series. Acidic permanganate provides oxidation evidence, while bromine in carbon tetrachloride shows addition. The triple bond has two unsaturated connections available for successive addition. Sufficient bromine can add in two stages to give the tetrabromo addition product, retaining the carbon skeleton.

cues.title: 最后观察乙炔燃烧
cues.caption: 净化后仍见明亮火焰和黑烟。
cues.captionEn: Purified gas: bright flame and soot.
cues.zh: 最后才转向乙炔的燃烧观察。教材要求先检验气体纯度；动画直接展示课堂条件下的结果，不提供点火操作。明亮火焰和黑烟与组成及燃烧条件有关，也仍然不能作为唯一鉴别依据。把发生、净化、两种性质检验和燃烧串起来，才形成完整的实验论证。
cues.en: The inquiry ends with acetylene combustion. The textbook requires a gas-purity check first; the animation presents the classroom observation rather than an ignition procedure. Bright flame and soot depend on composition and combustion conditions and are not unique identification tests. Generation, purification, separate reagent tests and combustion together form the experimental argument.

cues.title: 没有外电流，锌仍可与酸反应
cues.titleEn: Zinc can react with acid without external current
cues.caption: 导线断开：锌表面仍有析氢，电流表为零。
cues.captionEn: Open wire: local hydrogen evolution remains while external current is zero.
cues.zh: 锌片和铜片都浸在稀硫酸中，先让外电路断开。锌可以直接与酸反应，表面出现气泡；铜片没有所示析氢，电流表也不偏转。局部化学反应发生，并不等于电子已经沿外导线形成电流。
cues.en: With zinc and copper in dilute sulfuric acid, leave the external wire open. Zinc still reacts locally and releases gas, while the meter reads zero. A local chemical reaction does not by itself establish an external electron current.

cues.title: 让还原反应在铜表面发生
cues.titleEn: Enable reduction at the copper surface
cues.caption: 连接后，电子由锌经导线到铜，铜表面析氢。
cues.captionEn: Connection routes electrons from zinc to copper, where hydrogen evolves.
cues.zh: 接通外电路后，锌失去电子形成锌离子。电子沿导线到达铜片，使氢离子在铜表面还原成氢气。铜在这里提供还原反应的表面，不是铜离子被还原。锌上的局部反应也不必因此完全消失。
cues.en: Closing the circuit lets electrons from zinc reach copper and reduce hydrogen ions there. Copper provides a reaction surface; this is not copper-ion deposition. Local reaction at zinc need not disappear completely when the external path is connected.

cues.title: 导线与溶液使用不同载流子
cues.titleEn: Conductors and solution carry charge differently
cues.caption: 电子沿导体传递，电解质中的离子迁移维持电路。
cues.captionEn: Electrons move through conductors; ionic migration completes the electrolyte path.
cues.zh: 追踪导线上的电子方向，再看液体中的离子通路。不能把电子画成穿过整杯溶液的颗粒。正负离子的迁移配合两处电极反应维持电路；画面中的少量彩点只指示路径，不代表真实溶液里只有这些粒子。
cues.en: Follow electrons in the wire, then the ionic route in solution. Electrons should not be drawn traversing the liquid as free particles. Ion migration complements the electrode reactions. The few coloured markers indicate pathways, not a complete inventory of solution particles.

cues.title: 水果提供电解质，不单独供给电能
cues.titleEn: Fruit supplies electrolyte, not energy by itself
cues.caption: 锌、铜和水果中的离子通路共同组成电池。
cues.captionEn: Zinc, copper and the ionic route inside the fruit form the cell.
cues.zh: 把两种电极插入水果，可以利用其中的电解质形成离子通路。这里以锌、铜和酸性介质作教学近似，锌参与反应并被消耗。输出取决于电极、反应物和内阻，不能把水果看成无需其他物质就发电的能源。
cues.en: A fruit supplies an electrolyte route between electrodes. This example approximates zinc and copper in an acidic medium, with zinc consumed by reaction. Output depends on electrodes, reactants and internal resistance; the fruit is not an independent, inexhaustible electrical source.

cues.title: 换成湿纸，重新检查反应条件
cues.titleEn: With wet paper, check the new reaction conditions
cues.caption: 盐水湿纸提供离子通路；相同条件的两片铜不给出所示电势。
cues.captionEn: Saline paper provides an ionic path; matching copper electrodes give no illustrated EMF.
cues.zh: 盐水浸湿的滤纸也能连接电极间的离子通路。这里含氧介质的正极反应用氧还原作近似，与酸性水果中的析氢区分。再把两端都改成铜，在相同溶液条件的模型中，电势和电流归零；实际材料还可能受到钝化等因素影响。
cues.en: Saltwater-wet paper can provide the ionic path. Its oxygenated cathode is approximated by oxygen reduction, distinct from the acidic fruit example. Matching copper electrodes under matching conditions remove the illustrated EMF and current. Passivation and other factors complicate real materials.

cues.title: 串联同时增加电势和内阻
cues.titleEn: Series cells add both EMF and internal resistance
cues.caption: 增加电池数量后，LED电流仍受总内阻限制。
cues.captionEn: Adding cells can light the LED, but total internal resistance still limits current.
cues.zh: 逐个把电池串联，检查一个电池的正极确实接到下一个的负极。总电动势相加，内阻也一起增加。示意LED接在实际回路上，只有达到正向条件才有电流和亮度。电压足够，并不意味着能带动任意负载。
cues.en: Add cells in series, connecting each positive terminal to the next negative terminal. EMFs add, but internal resistances add too. The LED is part of the circuit and conducts only after its forward condition is met. Sufficient voltage does not guarantee arbitrary load capacity.

cues.title: 两种导体接触不是完整原电池
cues.titleEn: Touching conductors do not constitute a complete cell
cues.caption: 没有电解质通路，所示金属接触回路不持续供电。
cues.captionEn: Without an electrolyte route, the illustrated contact loop supplies no sustained current.
cues.zh: 把两种电极接触，并接入电流表，但不提供电解质通路，装置没有所示持续电流。构成原电池需要能进行的反应和完整的电荷通路。两种金属这个条件本身不够，也不能把所有原电池都限定为两种金属。
cues.en: Touching two electrodes and connecting a meter without an electrolyte path produces no sustained current in this model. A working cell needs a feasible reaction and complete charge transport. Two metals alone are insufficient, and not every cell requires two different metals.

cues.title: 用石墨表面对照电极材料
cues.titleEn: Compare an inert graphite reaction surface
cues.caption: Zn/C也可形成所示电池；Cu/C不具备这里的活泼金属反应。
cues.captionEn: Zn/C supports the illustrated cell; Cu/C lacks its active-metal reaction.
cues.zh: 在相同稀酸条件下，依次比较锌和铜、锌和石墨、铜和石墨。石墨能够提供导电和反应表面，不必像锌那样被消耗。最后一组在这个忽略溶解氧副反应的模型中没有持续电流，说明要结合具体反应判断电极作用。
cues.en: Compare zinc–copper, zinc–graphite and copper–graphite in the same acid. Graphite can provide a conductive reaction surface without being consumed like zinc. The final pair gives no sustained current in this model, which excludes dissolved-oxygen side reactions. Electrode roles depend on the reaction.

cues.title: 把两个半电池的电荷通路接通
cues.caption: 盐桥浸入两侧液体后，锌铜半电池形成完整回路。
cues.captionEn: The immersed salt bridge completes the two-half-cell circuit.
cues.zh: 现在换成锌片浸在硫酸锌中，铜片浸在硫酸铜中。盐桥两端实际接触两侧液体，外导线也接通，才形成持续电荷通路。这里的正极反应变为铜离子得到电子并沉积，已经不同于前面的稀酸析氢实验。
cues.en: Zinc now sits in zinc sulfate and copper in copper sulfate. The bridge ends contact both liquids and the external wire closes the circuit. The cathode reaction is now copper-ion reduction and deposition, unlike hydrogen evolution in the earlier acid experiment.

cues.title: 金属变化与离子补偿同时发生
cues.caption: 锌减少、铜增加；Cl⁻向锌侧、K⁺向铜侧迁移。
cues.captionEn: Zinc decreases and copper increases; Cl⁻ enters the zinc side and K⁺ the copper side.
cues.zh: 随着电荷转移，锌的质量减少，铜在另一极沉积。两者的物质的量相等，但质量变化并不相等。盐桥中的氯离子移向锌侧，钾离子移向铜侧，补偿电极反应造成的电荷变化。电极厚度已夸大，读数来自同一计算。
cues.en: Transferred charge dissolves zinc and deposits copper. Equal mole changes do not imply equal mass changes. Chloride enters the zinc side and potassium the copper side to compensate charge changes. Electrode thickness is exaggerated, while geometry and mass readings follow the same calculation.

cues.title: 移出盐桥，中断的是离子通路
cues.titleEn: Removing the bridge interrupts the ionic route
cues.caption: 盐桥口离开液面后，电流归零，已有沉积保留。
cues.captionEn: Once bridge mouths leave the liquids, current stops and prior deposits remain.
cues.zh: 把盐桥缓缓抬起。观察管口真正离开液面时，离子通路中断，电流表归零，已有金属变化保留。这里显示的E是根据溶液状态计算的电动势，不是说断路就把电极反应的热力学电势也一并抹去了。
cues.en: Lift the bridge until its mouths leave the liquids. The ionic path breaks, current stops and existing metal changes remain. The displayed E is a calculated EMF from the solution state. Breaking a circuit does not erase its underlying thermodynamic potential.

cues.title: 先由外电源制得两种气体
cues.titleEn: First use external power to produce the gases
cues.caption: K1闭合、K2断开；电解产生H₂与O₂，左侧局部变碱。
cues.captionEn: K1 is closed and K2 open: electrolysis produces H₂/O₂ and local alkalinity at the left electrode.
cues.zh: 教材的简易燃料电池先电解含酚酞的硫酸钠溶液。此时只接外电源支路，左侧石墨电极产生氢气和氢氧根，附近显粉红色；右侧产生氧气。理想气体生成量为二比一，能量首先来自外电源。
cues.en: The textbook activity first electrolyses sodium sulfate with phenolphthalein. Only the power branch is closed. Hydrogen and hydroxide form at the left electrode, producing local pink colour; oxygen forms at the right. Ideal gas production is two-to-one, powered by the external supply.

cues.title: 断开外电源再切换负载
cues.titleEn: Disconnect external power before switching to a load
cues.caption: 两支路均断开时，留存气体还在，外电流为零。
cues.captionEn: With both branches open, retained gas remains but external current is zero.
cues.zh: 先断开电解支路，暂时也不连接负载。两处电极附近仍留存少量气体，但外电流已经为零。这个中间状态把电解和原电池放电分开，不能让电源与负载同时接通，再把持续供电误认为全部来自留存气体。
cues.en: Disconnect the electrolysis branch before connecting a load. Some gas remains near each electrode, but external current is zero. This intermediate state distinguishes charging from galvanic discharge. Leaving the power supply connected would confound the evidence for energy from retained gas.

cues.title: 用有限留存气体释放电能
cues.titleEn: Release energy from finite retained gas
cues.caption: K2闭合后电流出现，随着留存反应物消耗而衰减。
cues.captionEn: Closing K2 produces current that declines as the finite reactants are consumed.
cues.zh: 接通负载支路，留存氢气和氧气参与反应，外电路重新出现电流。两种气体按二比一消耗，模型电流随储存电荷减少而下降。普通石墨装置只能提供有限演示；它没有持续供气，也不能代表商业燃料电池的效率和性能。
cues.en: Close the load branch. Retained hydrogen and oxygen react, restoring external current. Their amounts decrease in a two-to-one ratio as stored charge falls. This graphite demonstration has finite reactants and no continuous supply; it does not represent commercial fuel-cell efficiency or performance.

cues.title: 先得到离子
cues.caption: 电子电离形成分子正离子，电荷与电子数量要一起核对。
cues.captionEn: Electron ionization creates a molecular cation; account for charge and electrons together.
cues.zh: 质谱首先需要带电粒子。用电子电离作例子，一个高能电子与分子相互作用，留下分子正离子，同时有两个电子离开。先追踪原来的甲苯骨架，它在这一净过程里还没有分裂。这个图解释电荷计数，不把电子的插值路线当成真实的碰撞轨迹。
cues.en: Mass analysis begins with charged particles. In electron ionization, one energetic electron interacts with a molecule, leaving a molecular radical cation and two departing electrons. Track the original toluene skeleton before fragmentation. This is net charge accounting, not a reconstruction of an actual microscopic collision trajectory.

cues.title: 同一装置分开不同质荷比
cues.caption: 同电压与磁场下，离子曲率由 m/z 决定；收集狭缝只接收窄范围轨迹。
cues.captionEn: At fixed voltage and field, m/z determines curvature and the collector accepts a narrow trajectory range.
cues.zh: 正离子经过电场加速，进入朝向观察者的磁场。先看六十五，再看九十一和九十二：在同样条件下，它们的弯曲半径不同，只有匹配的轨迹进入收集狭缝。下方把微小半径偏差放大显示。探索中调节电压或磁场，路径会由同一运动方程重算，而不是把标签换到另一条装饰曲线上。
cues.en: Positive ions accelerate through an electric field and enter a magnetic field directed toward the viewer. Compare mass-to-charge ratios sixty-five, ninety-one and ninety-two under identical conditions. Their radii differ, and only a matched path reaches the narrow collector. The radius-offset gauge magnifies small differences. Voltage and field controls recalculate the actual trajectory.

cues.title: 失去一部分，但仍带电
cues.titleEn: Lose a fragment and retain charge
cues.caption: 92 的分子离子失去中性氢后，可留下 91 的带电片段。
cues.captionEn: A molecular ion at 92 can lose neutral hydrogen and leave a charged fragment at 91.
cues.zh: 分子离子也可能继续碎裂。教材用甲苯失去一个氢的情况说明：九十二分成带电的九十一和中性的一个质量单位，电荷留在可检测的片段上。真实气相离子还可能重排；这里保留净组成与质量关系，不用一幅苄基画法排除其他合理结构。
cues.en: A molecular ion may fragment. The textbook illustrates toluene losing hydrogen: ninety-two becomes a charged ninety-one fragment plus one neutral mass unit. Charge remains with the detectable ion. Gas-phase ions can also rearrange; this view preserves net composition and mass without claiming that one benzyl drawing excludes other structures.

cues.title: 最高的峰不是分子质量
cues.titleEn: The tallest peak need not give molecular mass
cues.caption: 甲苯示例中基峰为 91，分子离子峰为 92。
cues.captionEn: In the toluene example, the base peak is 91 and the molecular-ion peak is 92.
cues.zh: 把不同离子的信号排到质荷比轴上，就得到质谱。最高峰定义为百分之一百相对丰度，称为基峰。甲苯示例中它在九十一，而分子离子峰在九十二。因此不能把最高的峰直接当成相对分子质量。图中的高度只保留教材关系，实际峰强还取决于电离条件和仪器响应。
cues.en: A mass spectrum arranges ion signals by mass-to-charge ratio. The tallest signal defines one hundred percent relative abundance and is called the base peak. For this toluene example it lies at ninety-one, while the molecular ion is at ninety-two. Peak heights here preserve the teaching relationship; real intensities depend on ionization conditions and instrument response.

cues.title: 实验式还要配合分子质量
cues.titleEn: Combine empirical formula with molecular mass
cues.caption: C₂H₆O 的实验式质量约为 46；确认单电荷分子离子 46 后得到 n = 1。
cues.captionEn: C₂H₆O has empirical mass near 46; a confirmed singly charged molecular ion at 46 gives n = 1.
cues.zh: 另一册教材先由燃烧分析得到实验式碳二氢六氧。仅凭最简比例还不够，要用确认的分子质量来决定倍数。试把三十一或四十五当成分子离子，比例就不成立；确认单电荷分子离子在四十六时，倍数为一。这一步依赖峰归属与电荷，不能只套一个整数公式。
cues.en: The other textbook first derives the empirical formula C-two-H-six-O from combustion analysis. A confirmed molecular mass determines its multiplier. Trying thirty-one or forty-five as the molecular ion fails the ratio check; a confirmed singly charged ion at forty-six gives one. Peak assignment and charge must be established before applying the integer-multiple rule.

cues.title: 最右边也不总是答案
cues.titleEn: The rightmost peak is not always the answer
cues.caption: 同位素会在分子离子旁增加更高 m/z 的峰。
cues.captionEn: Isotopes can add higher-m/z signals beside the principal molecular-ion peak.
cues.zh: 再回到甲苯，加入碳十三的自然丰度这一扩展。只替换一个碳原子的同位素，信号就可以出现在九十三；两个替换还会有更弱的九十四。这说明最右侧出现的峰也不应被机械当作通常的分子离子质量。模型只计算碳同位素的组合，未包含氢同位素与全部碎片的同位素峰。
cues.en: Return to toluene and add a carbon-thirteen isotope extension. Replacing one carbon isotope produces a signal at ninety-three; two replacements add a much weaker ninety-four. The rightmost signal is therefore not automatically the principal molecular-ion mass. This calculation includes carbon combinations only, omitting hydrogen isotopes and isotope patterns of every fragment.

cues.title: 质量相同，连接可以不同
cues.titleEn: Equal mass can hide different connectivity
cues.caption: C₂H₆O 可以连接为乙醇或二甲醚，还需独立结构证据。
cues.captionEn: C₂H₆O permits ethanol or dimethyl ether, requiring independent structural evidence.
cues.zh: 确定分子式之后，问题仍没有结束。同样的两个碳、六个氢和一个氧，可以连接成乙醇，也可以连接成二甲醚。一个分子离子质量并不能唯一决定连接方式。教材接下来使用红外和核磁共振氢谱，正是为了补上这些结构信息，而不是重复测一次相同的质量。
cues.en: Determining the molecular formula does not finish identification. The same two carbons, six hydrogens and one oxygen can form ethanol or dimethyl ether. One molecular-ion mass cannot uniquely determine connectivity. The textbook therefore adds infrared and proton NMR evidence to supply structural information beyond mass.

cues.title: 从乙醇中的气体开始
cues.titleEn: Begin with gas formation in ethanol
cues.caption: 气泡只说明有气体生成。
cues.captionEn: Bubbles show that gas forms.
cues.zh: 教材实验七之四把钠加入无水乙醇。钠在液体中逐渐消耗，气泡升起，气体沿带塞子的导管离开。乙醇并不是只会燃烧的液体：它的羟基参与了这次反应。先记录产气，再按教材的证据链判断气体，不能看到气泡就直接宣布它是什么。
cues.en: In experiment seven-four, sodium is added to anhydrous ethanol. The metal is consumed, bubbles rise and gas leaves through a stoppered outlet. Ethanol does more than burn: its hydroxyl group participates in this reaction. Begin with gas evolution, then examine the textbook’s evidence rather than identifying a gas from bubbles alone.

cues.title: 燃烧后的产物留下水滴
cues.caption: 燃烧产物留下水滴。
cues.captionEn: Combustion leaves water.
cues.zh: 教材先检验气体纯度，再观察出口气体的燃烧。干燥的小烧杯罩在火焰上方，内壁逐渐出现水滴，说明收集到含水的燃烧产物。这里展示的是课堂实验的观察结果，不提供点火步骤。水滴是一条证据，还需要结合下一步检验和反应物组成，避免把任何能生成水的气体都认成氢气。
cues.en: The textbook checks gas purity before observing combustion. A dry small beaker above the flame develops droplets, providing evidence for water among the products. This scene presents the classroom observation without ignition instructions. Droplets alone are insufficient: other combustible substances also form water, so the next test and the reactant composition matter.

cues.title: 把石灰水结果一起考虑
cues.caption: 澄清结果要与其他证据合看。
cues.captionEn: Combine the clear result with other evidence.
cues.zh: 收集杯倒转，加入澄清石灰水。教材观察中液体保持澄清，没有出现由二氧化碳形成碳酸钙的浑浊。这个结果与水滴一起，支持产气是氢气的解释，也与羟基中的氢被置换一致。但阴性检验有灵敏度和实验条件限制，不能据此宣称已经测定气体的绝对纯度。
cues.en: Turn the collector upright and consider the limewater test. It stays clear in the textbook observation, without calcium-carbonate cloudiness from carbon dioxide. Together with water droplets and the reaction context, this supports hydrogen formation and displacement of hydroxyl hydrogen. A negative test has sensitivity and procedural limits; it does not establish absolute gas purity.

cues.title: 追踪羟基里的两个氢
cues.caption: 两份羟基氢组成一份氢气。
cues.captionEn: Two O—H hydrogens form one H₂.
cues.zh: 现在跟踪两份乙醇的羟基氢。每份乙醇失去一个羟基氢，两个氢共同形成一份氢气；乙基中的碳氢连接没有被拆掉。钠失去电子成为钠离子，与乙氧基负离子保持电荷平衡。化学方程式常写乙醇钠，但不要把图中的钠离子误画成碳骨架里新形成的普通共价键。
cues.en: Track the hydroxyl hydrogen of two ethanol units. Each contributes one H, producing one hydrogen molecule, while ethyl carbon–hydrogen connections remain unchanged. Sodium loses electrons to form sodium ions, balanced by ethoxide anions. Sodium ethoxide is often written as one formula, but the sodium ion should not be drawn as an ordinary new covalent bond in the carbon skeleton.

cues.title: 相同钠样进入水与乙醇
cues.titleEn: Compare equal sodium samples in both liquids
cues.caption: 相同原料，快慢与终量分开。
cues.captionEn: Separate reaction speed from final yield.
cues.zh: 选择性必修三用同样大小的钠，分别比较蒸馏水和无水乙醇。水中的反应更剧烈，乙醇中相对缓和。钠的密度略低于水而高于乙醇，因此示意中一个靠近水面，一个沉在乙醇内。快慢不同不意味着最终氢气一定更多：若两边钠相同且供氢物质充足，完全反应的氢气总量相同。
cues.en: Selective Compulsory Three compares equal sodium pieces in distilled water and anhydrous ethanol. The water reaction is more vigorous. Sodium is slightly less dense than water and denser than ethanol, so the views place it near the water surface and within ethanol. Different speed does not imply different final hydrogen amount: equal sodium with sufficient donors gives the same complete-reaction total.

cues.title: 质子去哪边，能由快慢判断吗？
cues.titleEn: Can reaction speed tell us where the proton goes?
cues.caption: 跟住质子，再预测交换方向。
cues.captionEn: Track the proton, then predict the shift.
cues.zh: 水和乙醇都有氧氢键，但氧另一边的邻居不同。换一个独立的酸碱比较：乙醇把一个质子交给氢氧根。原来的成键电子对留在乙醇的氧上，受体的一对电子形成新的氧氢键。这里不产生氢气。哪边更有利，要在同一介质中测量。一组在共同溶剂二甲基亚砜中测得的数据，给出一个反直觉的结果：乙醇反而比水更容易给出质子。这意味着这次交换更偏向乙氧根和水。现在补入一些产物水，交换会怎样移动？先预测。模型中，更多乙氧根取回质子，平衡向回移动。基团会影响性质，介质也会参与；这份平衡证据不能给刚才钠的反应速度排序。
cues.en: Water and ethanol both have an oxygen–hydrogen bond, but oxygen has a different neighbour. Now consider a separate acid–base exchange. Ethanol gives a proton to hydroxide. The old bonding pair stays with ethanol’s oxygen; a pair on the receiving oxygen forms the new bond. No hydrogen gas forms here. Which side is favoured must be measured in the same medium. A matched study in D M S O gives a surprising result: ethanol gives up a proton more readily than water. This favours ethoxide and water in the exchange. Now add some product water. Which way will the balance move? Make a prediction. In the model, more ethoxide takes a proton back and the balance shifts towards the reactants. Groups affect properties, and the medium matters too. This equilibrium evidence cannot rank the speeds of the earlier sodium reactions.

cues.title: 观察铜表面
cues.caption: 黑色氧化层来自空气中的氧。
cues.captionEn: Air supplies oxygen for the black oxide.
cues.zh: 先看同一根铜丝。它在空气中受热，红色的铜表面逐渐出现黑色氧化铜。这里既需要加热，也需要空气提供氧。颜色变化对应铜的氧化，不是把灯焰的颜色涂到铜丝上。先记住这层黑色表面，下一镜继续追踪它。
cues.en: Follow one copper coil. Heating in air turns its reddish surface black as copper oxide forms. Air supplies oxygen while the flame supplies heat. The changing colour represents oxidation of the copper, not light reflected from the flame. Keep track of this same blackened surface as the coil moves to the next observation.

cues.title: 乙醇中恢复铜色
cues.caption: 铜色恢复，伴随乙醇被氧化。
cues.captionEn: Copper returns as ethanol is oxidized.
cues.zh: 把视线留在黑色表面：热铜丝接触乙醇后，黑色逐渐退去，铜色重新出现。模型把氧化铜被还原和乙醇被氧化连在一起。乙醇在这里生成乙醛和水，并非直接燃烧成二氧化碳。教材记载的气味属于辅助观察，画面不把颜色恢复当作单独确认乙醛的完整检验。
cues.en: The hot, blackened coil now contacts ethanol. The dark surface recedes and the copper colour returns. Reduction of copper oxide is coupled to oxidation of ethanol, producing acetaldehyde and water in this account. This differs from complete combustion to carbon dioxide. The textbook also records an odour observation, but the returning copper colour alone is not a complete identification of acetaldehyde.

cues.title: 铜循环，氧会用完吗？
cues.titleEn: Can a copper cycle run out of oxygen?
cues.caption: 铜能再生，氧的库存会耗尽。
cues.captionEn: Copper regenerates; oxygen can run out.
cues.zh: 同一份铜再完成两次循环，乙醛累计增加，铜元素总量不变。把空气中的氧化和乙醇中的还原两步叠在一起，约去两边的铜和氧化铜：净反应仍要消耗乙醇和氧气。催化剂会再生，不等于原料不用消耗。现在先让一份铜全部变成氧化铜，再切断空气。接触过量乙醇，还能生成乙醛吗？先预测。模型中仍能生成一份，因为氧化层已经储存了氧；铜色恢复后，再重复接触也不会继续增加。这个限制针对画出的铜和氧化铜供氧路径，不是否定其他条件下的醇脱氢反应。
cues.en: The same copper completes two more cycles. Acetaldehyde accumulates while the total copper stays fixed. Add oxidation in air to reduction by ethanol, then cancel copper and copper oxide from both sides. Ethanol and oxygen are still consumed: regenerating a catalyst does not regenerate the reactants. Now begin with one full unit of copper oxide and cut off fresh air. Can excess ethanol still produce acetaldehyde? Predict first. One unit can still form because the oxide already stores oxygen. Once copper returns, repeating the contact adds no more product in this model. That limit belongs to this copper–oxide oxygen route; it does not rule out alcohol dehydrogenation under other conditions.

cues.title: 两个氢与两份电子去哪了？
cues.titleEn: Where do two hydrogens and two electrons go?
cues.caption: 同一净反应，同时核对原子与电子。
cues.captionEn: Balance atoms and electrons in the same net reaction.
cues.zh: 先用形式氧化数记账。连着羟基的碳从负一价升到正一价，乙醇给出两份电子当量；铜从正二价降到零价，正好接受两份。这不是拍到电子飞行，也不是一步反应机理。再跟住原子：乙醇的氧留在原来的碳旁，形成羰基。羟基的一个氢和相邻碳的一个氢离开，与氧化铜的氧计入水。其余碳氢骨架保留。同一份净反应，既要对得上原子，也要对得上氧化还原的电子份额。
cues.en: Begin with formal oxidation numbers. The carbon bearing the hydroxyl group rises from minus one to plus one: ethanol supplies two electron equivalents. Copper falls from plus two to zero and accepts two. This is bookkeeping, not a filmed electron trajectory or a single reaction step. Now follow the atoms. Ethanol’s oxygen stays beside the same carbon as a carbonyl forms. One hydroxyl hydrogen and one hydrogen on that carbon are accounted for in water with oxygen from copper oxide. The remaining carbon–hydrogen framework stays intact. The same net reaction must balance atoms as well as electron equivalents.

cues.title: 观察酸性氧化剂
cues.caption: 颜色指向铬的还原，不独自证明产物。
cues.captionEn: Colour points to chromium reduction, not product identity.
cues.zh: 换到教材的另一种氧化条件：酸性重铬酸钾溶液与乙醇接触后，橙色转向绿色。下方把铬原子分成六价与三价两栏，总量不变。色彩只表示两种状态的定性变化，不是吸光度读数。自由探索里改变乙醇或氧化剂的份数，反应物不足时，过量的氧化剂可以留下来。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s other oxidation condition: acidified dichromate with ethanol. Orange shifts towards green as chromium six is reduced to chromium three. The two counts retain the same total number of chromium atoms. Colour is a qualitative illustration, not an absorbance reading. In exploration, changing the alcohol or oxidant amount can leave excess oxidant when another reactant runs out.

cues.title: 多加乙醇，乙酸就加倍吗？
cues.titleEn: Does twice the ethanol make twice the acid?
cues.caption: 用电子配比，预测谁先用完。
cues.captionEn: Use electron ratios to predict the limiting reactant.
cues.zh: 教材把进一步氧化分成两段：乙醇失去两个氢成为乙醛，乙醛再加氧成为乙酸。跟住同一个碳，氧化数从负一到正一，再到正三；完全走到乙酸，共给出四份电子。一个重铬酸根含两个六价铬，降到三价共接受六份电子。三份乙醇与两份重铬酸根，正好配成十二份。现在乙醇从三份加到六份，氧化剂和酸保持原量，乙酸也会加倍吗？先预测。不会：这份模型仍最多生成三份乙酸，另外三份乙醇留下。实际混合物会受条件影响，颜色变化不能单独证明某一刻已经得到纯乙酸。
cues.en: The textbook separates further oxidation into two stages. Ethanol loses two hydrogens to become acetaldehyde; adding oxygen gives ethanoic acid. Follow the same carbon: minus one, plus one, then plus three. Reaching the acid releases four electron equivalents. Each dichromate contains two chromium-six atoms; becoming chromium three accepts six electrons altogether. Three ethanol units and two dichromate units match at twelve. Now double ethanol from three to six, keeping oxidant and acid unchanged. Will the acid product double? Predict first. No: this model still produces at most three acid units, leaving three ethanol units. Actual mixtures depend on conditions; colour alone cannot establish pure ethanoic acid at a particular instant.

cues.title: 氢属于哪个分子
cues.caption: 实线 O—H 属于水分子内部；虚线联系另一个水分子的氧。
cues.captionEn: The solid O–H bond is inside one molecule; the dashed link reaches another oxygen.
cues.zh: 先追踪一个水分子。实线连着氧和氢，表示分子内部的共价键；虚线从这个氢指向另一个水分子的氧，表示氢键。教材的二百七十六皮米，量的是两个氧之间的距离，不是虚线本身的长度。让受体偏离原来的方向，虚线会随几何条件减弱，再回到接近直线的排列。
cues.en: Follow one water molecule. Solid lines join its oxygen and hydrogens by covalent bonds. A dashed link reaches the oxygen of another molecule. The textbook distance of two hundred seventy-six picometres runs between the two oxygens, not just along the dashed segment. Moving the acceptor away from alignment weakens the displayed link before it returns.

cues.title: 从一个水分子看四个邻居
cues.caption: 冰中一个水分子可提供两条氢键，并接受另外两条。
cues.captionEn: An ice water molecule donates two hydrogen bonds and accepts two more.
cues.zh: 现在把中心水分子圈出来，转动观察它周围的四个邻居。它的两个氢分别指向两个邻居，形成两条给出的氢键；另外两个邻居把自己的氢朝向中心，形成两条接受的氢键。四个邻居沿四面体方向排列，不能把平面上的交叉误认成同一平面里的四条线。
cues.en: The ring marks the central molecule. Rotate around its four neighbours. Its two hydrogens point toward two neighbours, donating two hydrogen bonds. Two other neighbours supply hydrogens toward the central oxygen, which accepts two bonds. The neighbours lie along tetrahedral directions; crossings in a projection do not make this a planar arrangement.

cues.title: 规则排列留下空隙
cues.caption: 普通六方冰的开放网络来自有方向性的分子间连接。
cues.captionEn: Directional intermolecular links form the open network of ordinary hexagonal ice.
cues.zh: 把局部结构延伸，就得到普通六方冰的氧骨架。仍然是同样的水分子，靠分子之间的氢键联系；空隙并不是漏画的原子。这是一小段有限网络，边缘外的邻居没有继续画出。所选氢的取向满足每个氧附近有两个氢的规则，但不代表真实冰里唯一的排法。
cues.en: Extend the local structure into the oxygen framework of ordinary hexagonal ice. The same intact water molecules connect through hydrogen bonds, leaving real spaces in the network. This is a finite portion, so neighbours outside its boundary are omitted. The chosen hydrogen orientation obeys the ice rules but is only one of many allowed arrangements.

cues.title: 改变网络，保留水分子
cues.titleEn: Change the network, retain the molecules
cues.caption: 融化使有序结构部分解体；液态水仍存在氢键。
cues.captionEn: Melting partly disrupts order while hydrogen bonds remain in liquid water.
cues.zh: 观察这些带着原来两个氢的氧，逐渐改变位置和朝向。连接会依据距离与方向重新判断，有些减弱，有些保留，水分子内部的键长与夹角始终不变。这个构造动画只解释网络的部分重排，不是分子动力学，也不声称算出了真实融化速度。液态水并不是所有氢键都消失了。
cues.en: Track each oxygen together with its original two hydrogens as positions and orientations change. Links are reevaluated from distance and direction: some weaken while others remain. Internal bond lengths and angles stay fixed. This constructed transition illustrates partial network rearrangement, not molecular dynamics or a predicted melting rate. Liquid water has not lost all its hydrogen bonds.

cues.title: 从体积到浮起
cues.caption: 等质量的冰体积更大；浮起时排开水的重力等于自身重力。
cues.captionEn: Equal-mass ice occupies more volume; at flotation, displaced water balances its weight.
cues.zh: 最后回到可以观察的尺度。用近熔点的圆整参考密度，各取九十二克，冰约占一百毫升，水约占九十二毫升。把这块冰放入水中，液面随排水量上升；平衡时约百分之九十二的体积在水下。这是密度和浮力给出的结果，不能把微观重排示意直接当成密度测量。
cues.en: Return to the visible scale. Using rounded near-melting densities, ninety-two grams occupies about one hundred millilitres as ice and ninety-two as water. As the ice enters, the water level rises with displacement. At equilibrium, about ninety-two percent of its volume is submerged. This follows from density and buoyancy, not a density measurement extracted from the microscopic animation.

cues.title: 更热，为何更快？
cues.titleEn: Why does warmth speed it up?
cues.caption: 升温改变能量条件。
cues.captionEn: Warming changes energy conditions.
cues.zh: 同样的过氧化氢和催化剂，热水浴中的产气通常更快。为什么？放大一组刻意选在门槛附近的能量个案。升温时，门槛没有降低，却有更多个案越过它。这说明有效反应的机会可以增加。先猜一猜：放到足够久，热的一组会多产氧气吗？初始物料相同，模型的极限产量相同。
cues.en: With the same peroxide and catalyst, warming usually speeds gas production. Why? Look at selected cases near an energy threshold. Warming leaves the threshold in place, but more cases cross it. That creates more opportunities to react. Now predict: after enough time, will the warmer sample yield more oxygen? With equal starting material, this model gives equal limiting yields.

cues.title: 相遇更多，还是原料更多？
cues.caption: 浓度增加相遇机会。
cues.captionEn: Concentration adds encounter opportunities.
cues.zh: 两份盐酸体积相同，大理石的质量与表面积也相同。浓的一份初期产气更快。进入相同大小的观察窗口，反应机会的判据不变，但相遇变多了。这是浓度影响速率的一条解释。现在只把同量固体磨碎：最终气量会增加吗？表面增大可以加快反应，却没有增加可反应的物料。
cues.en: Use equal acid volumes and equal marble mass and surface area. The more concentrated acid reacts faster initially. In an equal observation window, more encounters face the same reaction criterion. This explains one role of concentration. Now crush the same amount of solid. Will the final gas amount increase? Extra surface can change speed, but supplies no extra reactant.

cues.title: 什么时候再等也看不到？
cues.titleEn: When does waiting no longer help?
cues.caption: 相同光程，才可比较浑浊。
cues.captionEn: Compare cloudiness at the same path length.
cues.zh: 两支试管最终都是四毫升，一份硫代硫酸钠被稀释了。相同温度下，相遇机会减少，硫形成得更慢，观察靶也更晚变模糊。浑浊来自固体硫。再猜一次：继续稀释十倍，只要等够久就一定能遮住靶吗？模型中硫的总量已不足以达到同一遮光阈值，不能把看不到终点解释成完全不反应。
cues.en: Both mixtures total four milliliters, but one thiosulfate sample is diluted. At equal temperature, fewer encounters can slow sulfur formation and delay cloudiness. Solid sulfur obscures the target. Now dilute that sample tenfold again. Must the target eventually disappear? In this model, even all the available sulfur cannot reach the same optical threshold. No visible endpoint does not mean no reaction.

cues.title: 温度改变哪一道条件？
cues.caption: 升温不等于降低门槛。
cues.captionEn: Warming is not lowering the threshold.
cues.zh: 配方与光程都相同，只改变温度。热的一份更早出现相同浑浊程度。再看近门槛的个案：原来未满足能量条件的个案，现在可以越过固定门槛。它不只是运动画得更快。请预测：升温时必须把门槛画低吗？不需要。改变能量分布与改变反应路径，是两种不同的解释。
cues.en: Keep the recipe and viewing path fixed. Warming reaches the same cloudiness earlier. Among the selected near-threshold cases, some that previously lacked enough energy can now cross the unchanged threshold. This is more than moving the dots faster. Predict: must warming lower the barrier? No. Changing the energy distribution and changing the reaction pathway are different explanations.

cues.title: 催化剂改变了哪条路？
cues.titleEn: What route does a catalyst change?
cues.caption: 催化改变路径，物料保持。
cues.captionEn: Catalysis changes the pathway, not the material.
cues.zh: 相同过氧化氢，分别与空白、二氧化锰和氯化铁条件比较。两种催化条件都可以使反应更快，但这里不按不等剂量排效率名次。切到通用能量图：催化提供另一条较低能垒的路径，起点与终点保持。先预测：有催化剂就会多产氧气吗？不会凭空增加氧原子；本模型改变到达速度，不改变相同物料的极限产量。
cues.en: Compare equal peroxide under a blank, manganese dioxide and iron chloride conditions. Both catalysts can speed the reaction; unequal doses do not establish an efficiency ranking. A generic energy diagram shows an alternative route with a lower barrier and unchanged endpoints. Predict: does a catalyst supply more oxygen? The net reaction gains no extra oxygen. This model changes how quickly the same material approaches its limiting yield.

cues.title: 把定性设计写成可重复的条件
cues.caption: 记录原液、补水、加酸和观察标准。
cues.captionEn: Record stock, added water, acid and the observation criterion.
cues.zh: 选必教材先要求自行设计浓度、温度与催化剂对照。画面以稀释方案为例：只报两份原液体积还不够，还要说明补水、加酸、混合起点和观察标准。自己的记录留空，教学动画不替你生成实验数据。
cues.en: The elective inquiry begins by asking you to design controlled comparisons. This dilution example needs more than the stock volumes: specify added water, acid, mixing baseline and observation criterion. Your own record starts blank. The animation does not create experimental data for you.

cues.title: 收集到同样的十毫升
cues.caption: 相同锌量和酸体积，分别计时至 10 mL。
cues.captionEn: Equal zinc and acid volume; time each run to 10 mL.
cues.zh: 教材用两克锌和四十毫升硫酸，比较一摩尔与四摩尔每升的条件。气体经过连通导管推动注射器活塞，每次都在十毫升停表。这里的时间只是教学参数，实际实验必须测量，并检查装置气密性。
cues.en: The textbook compares two grams of zinc with forty milliliters of one-molar or four-molar sulfuric acid. Connected tubing carries gas to the syringe. Stop each timer at ten milliliters. The displayed times are teaching parameters; actual times and leak checks require measurement.

cues.title: 斜率、终点和漏气
cues.caption: 同一体积除以所用时间，得到平均收集速率。
cues.captionEn: Divide the common volume by elapsed time for an average collection rate.
cues.zh: 把两个过程画成体积随时间的曲线。同一体积除以用时，可以比较平均收集速率。这仍不是直接写成浓度变化的反应速率。漏气会让收集量落后于生成量，探索中可改变漏气比例，再填自己的实测时间。
cues.en: The curves show collected volume over time. Dividing the same volume by its elapsed time gives an average collection rate, not directly a concentration-based reaction rate. Leakage separates gas produced from gas collected. Explore that distinction before entering your own measured times.

cues.title: 相撞不一定反应
cues.caption: 保持有利取向，比较能量不足与足够的碰撞。
cues.captionEn: Keep a favorable orientation; compare insufficient and sufficient energy.
cues.zh: 现在追踪两对氢碘原子。第一次碰撞后，它们仍是两个碘化氢分子。第二次满足教学模型的能量条件，先生成氢气和两个碘自由基，再生成碘分子。原子一直保留身份，反应没有凭空增加粒子。
cues.en: Track the same four hydrogen and iodine atoms. The first collision leaves two hydrogen iodide molecules. In the second, sufficient model energy permits hydrogen and two iodine radicals to form, followed by iodine. Atom identities remain continuous through both steps.

cues.title: 能量足够，还要合适取向
cues.titleEn: Enough energy also needs a suitable orientation
cues.caption: 能量条件相同，只有有利取向进入所示反应路径。
cues.captionEn: With equal energy, only the favorable orientation follows the shown pathway.
cues.zh: 保持足够的能量，先让不利的原子端接近，再让两个氢端相向。前者弹开，后者进入所示反应过程。这里把真实分子运动简化为二维碰撞，说明取向条件；不是把每次足够能量的碰撞都判作有效碰撞。
cues.en: Keep enough energy and change which molecular ends approach. The unfavorable orientation rebounds, while hydrogen ends facing each other enter the shown pathway. This two-dimensional reconstruction illustrates orientation; it does not say every energetic collision must react.

cues.title: 降低能垒不改变反应热
cues.titleEn: A lower barrier does not change reaction enthalpy
cues.caption: 两条路径起终点相同，催化路径能垒较低。
cues.captionEn: Both paths share endpoints; the catalytic pathway has a lower barrier.
cues.zh: 最后换成通用能量图。两条路径从同样的反应物到同样的生成物，催化路径的能垒较低，但起终点能量差不变。催化剂改变反应历程和速率，不把更多最终产物或不同反应热凭空加进这张图。
cues.en: Switch to a generic energy profile. Both paths connect the same reactants and products. The catalytic route has a lower barrier, while the endpoint energy difference stays fixed. Catalysis changes the pathway and rate, not the reaction enthalpy shown by those endpoints.

cues.title: 验证燃烧产物
cues.caption: 水滴与石灰水：两份不同证据。
cues.captionEn: Droplets and limewater provide different evidence.
cues.zh: 综合活动先从乙醇开始。燃烧后的干燥收集器出现水滴，另一份产物检验使澄清石灰水浑浊。两项证据分别对应水和二氧化碳。教材要求设计验证方案，画面展示一种教学对照；不能只看蓝色火焰就宣称已经确认了所有燃烧产物。
cues.en: The combined activity starts with ethanol. Water droplets appear in a dry collector after combustion, while a separate limewater test becomes cloudy. These support water and carbon dioxide formation. The textbook asks learners to design the tests; this is one teaching example. A blue flame alone does not identify all combustion products.

cues.title: 重访催化氧化
cues.caption: 同一铜丝循环，产物逐渐累积。
cues.captionEn: The same copper cycles as product accumulates.
cues.zh: 接着追踪同一根铜丝。空气中受热形成的黑色氧化铜，在接触乙醇后恢复铜色；往返几次，产物逐渐积累。这个循环解释了综合活动为何重复操作。铜总量保持不变，净反应消耗乙醇和氧气。这里生成的是醛类产物乙醛，与刚才的完全燃烧不同。
cues.en: Next, follow the same copper coil. Black oxide forms during heating in air, then copper colour returns on contact with ethanol. Repetition accumulates product and explains the repeated observation in the activity. Total copper is conserved while ethanol and oxygen are net reactants. This oxidation produces acetaldehyde, an aldehyde, unlike the previous complete combustion.

cues.title: 设计酸性证据
cues.caption: 颜色与气体共同支持酸性。
cues.captionEn: Colour and gas provide evidence of acidity.
cues.zh: 综合活动还要求设计乙酸的性质实验。这里选石蕊颜色与碳酸盐反应作为两种证据：酸性环境使石蕊呈红色，乙酸与碳酸盐反应放出二氧化碳。后者联系乙酸与碳酸的酸性比较。它也为下一步解释接收液的作用作铺垫：碳酸钠可以把混入的乙酸转为乙酸盐。
cues.en: The activity also asks for evidence of ethanoic acid properties. Here, litmus turns red and carbonate releases carbon dioxide. These observations support acidity and connect to comparing ethanoic acid with carbonic acid. The carbonate reaction will matter again in the receiver: it converts carried-over ethanoic acid into an acetate salt.

cues.title: 追踪酯中的氧
cues.caption: 标记氧会进入酯，还是水？
cues.captionEn: Will the labelled oxygen enter ester or water?
cues.zh: 接收液出现酯较多的上层，但分层不能告诉我们哪根键重组。现在给乙醇的氧做十八氧标记：它会进入酯，还是水？教材的示踪结论是，标记氧留在酯中。沿着同一个氧看，乙醇的碳氧键保留。按净反应记账，酸的羟基与醇羟基的氢计入水，其余部分形成酯的连接。这是原子去向的对照，不是一步碰撞的机理。酸参与催化并再生，反应仍然可逆。接下来，再看产物怎样被收集。
cues.en: An ester-rich upper layer appears, but a layer cannot tell us which bonds changed. Label the oxygen in ethanol with oxygen eighteen. Will it enter the ester or the water? The textbook tracing result places it in the ester. Follow that same oxygen: its bond to the ethyl group stays. In the net account, the acid hydroxyl and the alcohol hydroxyl hydrogen form water; the remaining groups make the ester connection. This tracks atom destinations, not a one-step collision mechanism. Acid participates and regenerates, and the reaction remains reversible. Next, follow product collection.

cues.title: 跟随混合蒸气
cues.caption: 反应生成，不等于已经收集。
cues.captionEn: Ester formed is not ester collected.
cues.zh: 导管中移动的不同颜色代表不同组分，不是真实分子的颜色。收集到的液体不只是目标酯，还可能带来乙醇、乙酸和水。模型将反应与转移分别记账，所以生成的酯不等于已经收集到的酯。加热和催化剂改变过程速度，移走产物也能影响可逆反应的推进。
cues.en: Different dot colours represent components, not the real colours of molecules. Collected material can include ethanol, ethanoic acid and water alongside the target ester. The model separately accounts for reaction and transfer, so ester formed is not the same as ester collected. Heating and catalysis affect speed; product removal can also influence reversible reaction progress.

cues.title: 区分上下两层
cues.caption: 分层帮助分离，不代表纯品。
cues.captionEn: Layers help separation; neither is pure.
cues.zh: 接收液各有作用：碳酸盐与乙酸反应，乙醇容易进入水层，盐溶液还会降低酯的溶解。静置后，较轻、酯较多的液层出现在上方。但上层不等于纯乙酸乙酯，下层也不等于完全没有酯。画面用分层帮助判断分离方向，不用油层厚度宣称实际纯度或产率。
cues.en: The receiver has several roles. Carbonate neutralises acid; ethanol readily enters the aqueous layer; dissolved salt reduces ester solubility. On standing, the less dense ester-rich layer appears above. Neither layer is perfectly pure. The drawing shows a separation direction; layer thickness is not a measurement of product purity or yield.

cues.title: 控制介质变量
cues.caption: 同样起点，只改变介质。
cues.captionEn: Same starting amounts; change the medium.
cues.zh: 反过来看酯的水解。三支试管从相同酯量出发，在同一个水浴中比较中性、酸性和碱性条件。此处选用教学参数，展示酸或碱能够明显促进水解的一组情况。剩余酯读数和酯层变化来自同一计算，但数值不是教材实测结果。不同浓度下，酸和碱之间的快慢顺序不能一概而论。
cues.en: Now reverse the question and examine hydrolysis. Three tubes start with equal ester amounts in one water bath, comparing neutral, acid and base conditions. The selected teaching parameters illustrate accelerated hydrolysis in acid or base. The remaining-ester count and layer change share one calculation, but are not textbook measurements. Relative acid and base speeds are not universal across concentrations.

cues.title: 理解酸性水解
cues.caption: 同温同初态，更快会改变终点吗？
cues.captionEn: Same start and temperature: does faster change the endpoint?
cues.zh: 酸性条件下，乙酸乙酯与水反应生成乙酸和乙醇，两个方向都保留。酸催化剂使反应更快，并不会单凭催化剂身份改变平衡常数。水的用量与产物移出等条件可以影响组成。下方的双向流只表示反应方向仍然存在，不是测量到的分子轨迹或速率。
cues.en: In acid, ethyl ethanoate reacts with water to form ethanoic acid and ethanol, while the reverse reaction remains possible. The catalyst accelerates reaction without itself changing the equilibrium constant. Water amount or product removal can affect composition. The paired flows indicate available directions, not measured molecular trajectories or reaction rates.

cues.title: 追踪碱的消耗
cues.caption: 每水解一份酯，消耗一份OH⁻。
cues.captionEn: Each ester hydrolysed consumes one hydroxide.
cues.zh: 碱性条件要换一种记账。羧酸部分以乙酸根保留下来，每水解一份酯，就消耗一份氢氧根。这与把碱说成永远不变的催化剂不同。乙酸根在这些条件下不容易与乙醇回到原来的酯，推动反应向前。自由探索减少初始氢氧根，会看到碱不足时酯仍有剩余。
cues.en: Basic conditions require a different account. The acid-derived group remains as acetate, and each ester hydrolysed consumes one hydroxide. Base is therefore not an unchanged catalyst here. Acetate does not readily return to the ester with ethanol under these conditions, helping drive the process forward. Reducing initial hydroxide in exploration leaves ester when the base runs out.

cues.title: 单独比较温度
cues.caption: 只改温度；层消失不等于反应完全。
cues.captionEn: Change temperature alone; no layer need not mean full conversion.
cues.zh: 最后只改变温度，同样的介质、起始份数和示意时长，比较较冷与较热的体系。模型中升温使水解更快。教材探究建议比较酯层消失时间，章末活动还讨论气味变化；这里用可见的层变化替代嗅觉操作。溶解、混合与挥发也会影响实际观察，因此层看不见不能直接等同于百分之百转化。
cues.en: Finally, change only temperature while keeping medium, starting amounts and model duration fixed. Heating accelerates the model reaction. The inquiry suggests comparing layer-disappearance times, while the activity also discusses odour change; this visualization uses visible layers. Dissolution, mixing and evaporation affect real observations too, so disappearance of a layer is not proof of complete conversion.

cues.title: 同样的连接，镜中的排列
cues.caption: 四个不同基团的四面体排列，反射后保留组成与连接。
cues.captionEn: Reflection preserves composition and connectivity in a tetrahedral four-group model.
cues.zh: 先不看复杂的化学式，只追踪四个不同的基团。原像和镜像都连接着同样的中心，字母和颜色各自保留。它们的区别在空间排列。手性的判据不是长得不对称，而是一个对象与自己的镜像，能否只靠平移和转动完全重合。
cues.en: Track four distinct groups before introducing complex formulas. The object and its mirror connect the same groups to the same centre, preserving every letter and colour. What changes is spatial arrangement. Chirality asks whether an object can coincide with its mirror using only translation and rotation.

cues.title: 只转动，不改基团身份
cues.caption: 对齐 A、B 后，另外两个不同基团仍互换位置。
cues.captionEn: Aligning A and B leaves the other two distinct groups exchanged.
cues.zh: 把镜像移到原像的位置，再绕一条固定空间轴转动。空心圈保留原像，实心球是正在转动的镜像。转到能对齐 A 和 B 时，C 和 D 仍然对不上。不是再多转几次就会解决：只做正常转动不会改变四个有标签顶点的排列方向，反射却会改变。
cues.en: Place the mirror over the original and rotate it around a fixed spatial axis. Hollow rings mark the reference; filled groups belong to the moving mirror. Once A and B align, C and D still occupy one another’s positions. More turning cannot fix the handed arrangement: proper rotations preserve its orientation, while reflection reverses it.

cues.title: 两个基团相同时
cues.caption: 把 D 换成与 C 相同的基团，这个单中心模型可与镜像重合。
