cues.captionEn: Replacing D with an identical C group makes this single-centre model superposable.
cues.zh: 现在只改变一个条件：把 D 换成与 C 相同的基团，再进行同样的转动。最后两个 C 虽然交换了位置，却没有可区分的差别，四个位置可以全部匹配。这个反例说明，不能只见到四面体碳就断言分子有手性。复杂分子还要检查整体对称性。
cues.en: Change one condition: replace D with a second group identical to C, then repeat the rotation. The two C groups exchange positions without creating a distinguishable mismatch. All four sites can match. A tetrahedral carbon alone therefore does not establish chirality; more complex molecules require an overall symmetry check.

cues.title: 巴斯德按晶面分开样品
cues.caption: 放大晶面差别，再追踪每一颗晶体进入对应的一组。
cues.captionEn: Inspect the facet differences, then follow each crystal into its corresponding group.
cues.zh: 回到一八四八年的研究。先放大观察两种晶形，它们的不对称小晶面朝向不同。巴斯德从酒石酸钠铵的样品中，仔细挑出两类晶体。这里用八颗保持身份的晶体演示分选逻辑，晶形经过简化，不能当作原样品精确的晶面指数或真实统计数量。
cues.en: Return to the historical investigation in eighteen forty-eight. Enlarged views reveal differently oriented small facets. Pasteur carefully separated two crystal forms from sodium ammonium tartrate samples. Eight persistent objects illustrate the sorting logic here. Their simplified morphology is not an indexed reconstruction of the original crystals or a measured sample count.

cues.title: 晶体消失，溶液仍有差别
cues.caption: 两组晶体分别溶解后，在同样条件下使偏振面向相反方向转动。
cues.captionEn: Separately dissolved crystal groups rotate polarization in opposite directions under matching conditions.
cues.zh: 接着把两组晶体分别溶解。固体外形逐渐消失，但两份溶液的性质仍然不同。迎着入射光观察，一份使偏振面顺时针转，另一份逆时针转。相同条件下等量对映体的旋光大小相同、方向相反。图中角度只是示意；这一结果把证据从晶体外形推进到溶液中的化学物种。
cues.en: Dissolve the groups separately. The solid shapes disappear, yet the solutions remain different. Looking toward the incoming light, one rotates polarization clockwise and the other anticlockwise. Equal amounts of enantiomers under matching conditions give equal and opposite rotations. The displayed angles are illustrative; persistence in solution moves the evidence beyond crystal shape.

cues.title: 零旋光也有两种可能
cues.titleEn: Zero rotation has more than one explanation
cues.caption: 等量对映体的旋光抵消，不表示两种物质消失。
cues.captionEn: Equal enantiomer rotations cancel without removing either component.
cues.zh: 现在改变同一总量里两种对映体的比例。两条含量条逐渐相等，偏振面的净转角回到零。两种手性物种仍然存在，只是光学贡献抵消。检偏器的透射亮度由它和当前偏振方向的夹角决定。因此，不旋光不能单独证明样品中没有手性分子；一个亮度读数也需要参照和校准。
cues.en: Vary the two enantiomer fractions at fixed total amount. As their bars become equal, the net rotation returns to zero. Both chiral species remain; their optical contributions cancel. Analyzer brightness depends on its angle relative to the emerging polarization. Zero rotation alone does not prove an absence of chiral molecules, and one brightness reading needs a reference and calibration.

cues.title: 选择性利用改变剩余比例
cues.caption: 若其中一种被优先利用，等量关系被打破，剩余溶液可以旋光。
cues.captionEn: Preferential consumption breaks the equal mixture, allowing the remaining solution to rotate light.
cues.zh: 教材还介绍了微生物选择性利用的后续证据。从两种物质等量开始，若其中一种消耗得更多，剩余浓度不再相等，溶液就可能表现出旋光。看的是培养液取样后的测定，不是在旋光仪里长菌丝。探索中取消选择性，两种同步减少，净旋光仍可保持为零。这不能推出所有生物产物都必然旋光。
cues.en: The textbook also describes subsequent evidence from selective microbial consumption. Starting with equal amounts, preferential use of one form leaves unequal concentrations and possible optical rotation. The measurement represents a culture sample, not fungi growing inside a polarimeter. Remove selectivity in exploration and both forms decline together with zero net rotation. This does not imply that every biological product must be optically active.

cues.title: 由反应物走近平衡
cues.caption: 浓度趋于稳定时，正逆反应仍都存在。
cues.captionEn: Concentrations settle while both reaction directions continue.
cues.zh: 从氮气和氢气开始，氨的浓度逐渐上升。留意两条反应通路：正向速率减小，逆向速率增大。组成稳定时，两条通路仍在运行，只是净变化接近零；平衡不是所有分子停止反应。
cues.en: Start with nitrogen and hydrogen. Ammonia increases as the forward rate falls and the reverse rate rises. When the composition settles, both pathways still operate. Their net effect approaches zero; equilibrium does not mean that every molecular reaction has stopped.

cues.title: 也可以从生成物一侧接近
cues.titleEn: Approach from the product side too
cues.caption: 原子总量相同，从氨开始也接近同一平衡。
cues.captionEn: With the same atom totals, ammonia approaches the same equilibrium.
cues.zh: 换成具有相同原子总量的氨。逆向过程先占优势，随后两种速率靠近。相同温度、体积和总量下，两种起点到达同一平衡。探索中的催化加速只改变抵达时间，不移动终点。
cues.en: Now begin with ammonia containing the same atom totals. The reverse process dominates initially, then the rates converge. Under the same conditions, both starting compositions approach the same endpoint. The exploration catalyst changes the approach time, not that equilibrium composition.

cues.title: 拉出活塞：先稀释
cues.titleEn: Pull out the piston: dilution comes first
cues.caption: 体积先增大、颜色变浅，随后颜色部分加深。
cues.captionEn: Expansion first lightens the gas; chemical relaxation then partly darkens it.
cues.zh: 先把封闭注射器从二十毫升拉到四十毫升。气体立即稀释，所以颜色先变浅。活塞停住后，四氧化二氮继续解离，二氧化氮浓度部分回升。侧面观察光程固定，两个阶段才不会混在一起。
cues.en: Expand the sealed syringe from twenty to forty milliliters. Dilution initially lightens the gas. Once the piston stops, further dissociation raises nitrogen dioxide concentration partway back. The fixed side-view optical path separates the immediate volume effect from subsequent chemical relaxation.

cues.title: 推入活塞：先浓缩
cues.titleEn: Push in the piston: concentration comes first
cues.caption: 压缩先加深颜色，随后部分变浅。
cues.captionEn: Compression first darkens the gas; subsequent reaction partly lightens it.
cues.zh: 再从四十毫升平衡状态压回二十毫升。浓缩先使颜色加深，随后更多二氧化氮结合成四氧化二氮，颜色部分变浅。后续变浅不等于比压缩之前还浅；比较的是不同时间点，不能省略中间状态。
cues.en: Compress an equilibrated forty-milliliter sample back to twenty. Concentration first darkens it, then dimer formation partly lightens it. That second change does not mean it becomes lighter than before compression. The intermediate state is essential to a correct comparison.

cues.title: 封闭后放入不同水浴
cues.caption: 同样的初始气体，热浴较深、冰浴较浅。
cues.captionEn: The same initial gas darkens in the hot bath and lightens in ice water.
cues.zh: 两只烧瓶先封闭，再分别放入热水和冰水。生成四氧化二氮是放热方向，升温使所示平衡偏向二氧化氮，红棕色加深。冷却时颜色变浅。这里保留相同装量与观察光程，不让气体从一瓶流向另一瓶。
cues.en: Seal equal initial samples before placing them in hot and ice-water baths. Dimer formation is exothermic, so heating favors more nitrogen dioxide and a deeper brown. Cooling lightens it. Equal loading and optical paths are retained; gas does not transfer between the flasks.

cues.title: 较快与较多是两个目标
cues.titleEn: Faster and more are different goals
cues.caption: 高温示意曲线更快，教材平衡含氨量更低。
cues.captionEn: The hotter illustrative curve rises faster toward a lower textbook equilibrium fraction.
cues.zh: 看二十兆帕下的两条曲线。五百度的示意过程较快，但教材给出的平衡含氨量低于四百度。虚线来自教材表，弯曲的时间过程另用教学模型。工业条件需要兼顾速度和组成，不能只看其中一个。
cues.en: Compare two temperatures at twenty megapascals. The hotter illustrative process advances faster, but its textbook equilibrium ammonia fraction is lower. Dashed endpoints are tabulated data; time curves use a separate teaching model. Industrial choices must consider both rate and attainable composition.

cues.title: 提高压强还有实际代价
cues.caption: 相同温度下，教材平衡含氨量随压强提高。
cues.captionEn: At fixed temperature, the textbook equilibrium ammonia fraction rises with pressure.
cues.zh: 固定温度，比较教材表中的不同压强。平衡含氨量上升，但这不是可以无限加压的建议。承压材料、设备制造和压缩功都构成约束。画面没有把这些复杂成本压成一个虚假的最优分数。
cues.en: At fixed temperature, compare the textbook pressure entries. Equilibrium ammonia content rises, but pressure cannot simply be increased without limit. Vessel strength, manufacturing and compression work impose constraints. This view does not invent a single score that claims to optimize an industrial plant.

cues.title: 分离氨，再循环原料
cues.caption: 分离液氨，未反应的氮氢继续循环。
cues.captionEn: Separate liquid ammonia and recycle the remaining nitrogen and hydrogen.
cues.zh: 教材还加入了冷却分离和循环。反应混合物经过冷凝器，氨被分离，剩余氮气和氢气返回催化床。看累计收集量继续增加：单次平衡组成不等于全部投料的最终转化率。这里用有限批次和理想分离说明流程。
cues.en: The textbook also adds cooling, separation and recycle. Ammonia leaves the condenser as collected liquid, while remaining nitrogen and hydrogen return to the catalyst bed. Cumulative collection increases beyond a single pass. This finite-batch model assumes ideal separation, rather than predicting a complete operating plant.

cues.title: 增加一种反应物，保留对照
cues.titleEn: Add one reactant and retain a reference
cues.caption: 铁盐或硫氰酸盐滴入后，与未加料试管比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare each addition with the unchanged reference tube.
cues.zh: 三份初始混合液相同，一份加铁盐，一份加硫氰酸盐，一份作为对照。每滴落入后，液量和红色物种共同重新计算。颜色加深提示组成改变，但不能只凭红色就把实际所有铁配合物判成同一种分子。
cues.en: Begin with equal aliquots. Add iron salt to one, thiocyanate to another, and leave a reference. Each delivered drop changes both volume and the calculated red-species amount. A deeper red indicates changed composition, without identifying every real iron complex as one molecular species.

cues.title: 铁粉消耗铁离子
cues.caption: 铁粉进入溶液后，红色物种减少。
cues.captionEn: After iron enters the solution, the red-species amount falls.
cues.zh: 继续向两份加料后的溶液加入铁粉。金属铁把三价铁还原为二价铁，红色平衡物种随之减少。这里的触发不是简单稀释，也不是铁粉吸走颜色；需要把氧化还原与配位平衡连起来看。
cues.en: Add iron powder to the two treated solutions. Iron metal reduces iron(III) to iron(II), lowering the amount available to the red equilibrium species. This is neither simple dilution nor powder absorbing color. Redox chemistry and complex formation must be considered together.

cues.title: 先加碱再加酸
cues.caption: 同一份铬溶液从橙向黄，再向橙变化。
cues.captionEn: The same chromium sample shifts from orange toward yellow and back toward orange.
cues.zh: 同一份重铬酸钾溶液先加碱，铬酸根比例上升，颜色偏黄；再加酸，颜色转回橙色方向。溶液不是重置了一次，累计加液和铬原子总量都保留。酸碱改变的是平衡条件，不是凭空生成新的铬。
cues.en: Add base to one dichromate sample, favoring yellow chromate, then acid to favor orange again. The sample is not reset between additions: cumulative volume and total chromium remain tracked. Acid and base alter equilibrium conditions without creating new chromium atoms.

cues.title: 铜盐的颜色来自混合物
cues.titleEn: Copper color belongs to a mixture
cues.caption: 加热与冷却可逆改变混合颜色，并与室温对照比较。
cues.captionEn: Heating and cooling change the mixture color relative to a room-temperature reference.
cues.zh: 一支铜盐试管先加热，再冷却，另一支保持室温。升温有利于所示氯配合物，但溶液仍包含蓝色水合物种和其他配合物。不要把整体绿色直接标成纯黄色物种；冷却后再观察颜色返回的方向。
cues.en: Heat one copper chloride sample, then cool it, while retaining a room-temperature reference. Heating favors the illustrated chloro species, but aqua and other complexes remain. A green mixture is not a pure yellow species. Cooling lets you check the direction of the returning color.

cues.title: 跟着瓶号交换水浴
cues.titleEn: Follow flask identities through the exchange
cues.caption: 两瓶保持封闭，交换水浴后颜色逐渐反转。
cues.captionEn: Both flasks stay sealed; swapping baths gradually reverses their colors.
cues.zh: 最后把两只封闭烧瓶交换水浴，保留一号和二号身份。先前较深的一号进入冰水，先前较浅的二号进入热水。等待重新平衡后，颜色趋势交换。结果跟随温度条件，而不是跟随屏幕的左边或右边。
cues.en: Exchange the sealed flasks while preserving their identities. Previously darker flask one enters ice water, and lighter flask two enters the hot bath. Their color trends gradually reverse. The result follows temperature, rather than a permanent left or right position on the screen.

cues.title: 先观察溶解状态
cues.caption: 葡萄糖与蔗糖溶解；淀粉受热糊化。
cues.captionEn: Glucose and sucrose dissolve; warmed starch forms a paste.
cues.zh: 活动先观察样品本身。葡萄糖和蔗糖的晶体逐渐溶入水中；淀粉在冷水里保留颗粒，加热后出现糊状体系。固体不再明显可见，可能来自溶解，也可能涉及颗粒吸水与结构改变，不能把淀粉糊简单说成同样的分子真溶液。
cues.en: Start with the samples themselves. Glucose and sucrose crystals dissolve in water. Starch retains particles in cool water and forms a paste on warming. A solid becoming less visible can involve different processes: dissolution, swelling and structural change are not interchangeable. Starch paste is not simply the same kind of molecular solution.

cues.title: 环里的醛基怎样出现？
cues.caption: 环状葡萄糖开环，醛端还原银试剂。
cues.captionEn: Glucose opens its ring; the aldehyde end reduces silver reagent.
cues.zh: 银镜是金属银。追踪葡萄糖的第一号碳：水中多数分子成环，但能开环露出醛端。醛端被氧化，银得到电子。开链分子消耗后，环链平衡继续补充，所以少量开链形式不等于只能产生少量银。
cues.en: The mirror is metallic silver. Follow carbon one: most glucose molecules form rings, but ring opening exposes an aldehyde end. That end is oxidised while silver gains electrons. As open chains react, equilibrium replenishes them. A small open-chain population does not limit the result to a tiny silver deposit.

cues.title: 电子从糖转移给铜
cues.caption: 醛端失电子，铜得到电子形成 Cu₂O。
cues.captionEn: The aldehyde end loses electrons; copper gains them in Cu₂O.
cues.zh: 另一份葡萄糖遇到铜试剂，形成砖红色氧化亚铜。仍是同一个醛端失去两个电子，两个铜中心各得到一个，正二价变正一价。试剂必须处于合适的碱性并加热。酸性样品没有沉淀，不能据此判定没有还原糖。
cues.en: A separate glucose sample forms brick-red copper one oxide. Again the aldehyde end loses two electrons; two copper centres each gain one, changing from plus two to plus one. The test needs suitable alkalinity and warming. No precipitate in an acidic mixture cannot establish that reducing sugar is absent.

cues.title: 检验食物中的淀粉
cues.caption: 碘显蓝色，提供淀粉仍在的证据。
cues.captionEn: The blue iodine response indicates remaining starch.
cues.zh: 碘液落在含淀粉的食物切片上，局部出现蓝色。这个证据与淀粉链形成的有色体系有关，用来判断样品中是否仍有淀粉。它不是检测所有糖的通用方法，也不是银镜或铜试剂检验的同一种反应。下一步要把淀粉证据和水解产物证据分开。
cues.en: Iodine solution stains a starch-containing food slice blue. This response involves the starch-chain complex and helps detect remaining starch. It is not a universal test for every carbohydrate, nor the same reaction as the silver or copper tests. We will keep evidence of starch separate from evidence of its hydrolysis products.

cues.title: 先水解，再调节环境
cues.caption: 长链水解；冷却并调至碱性后检验。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolyse the chain; cool and make alkaline before testing.
cues.zh: 淀粉在酸催化条件下水解，最终可以得到葡萄糖。画面用同一组单元表示净变化，实际还会经过多种较短的糖链。接下来有一个不能跳过的条件转换：水解液冷却后，需要调至碱性。若把酸性水解液直接当作合适的铜检验体系，结果就不能正常解释。
cues.en: Acid-catalysed starch hydrolysis can ultimately yield glucose. The same unit symbols track the net change, while real hydrolysis passes through shorter chains. An essential condition change follows: cool the hydrolysate and make it alkaline. Treating the acidic hydrolysate as a valid copper-test mixture would make the observation unreliable.

cues.title: 比较水解前后
cues.caption: 水解释放还原端；两种检验可以同为阳性。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolysis releases reducing ends; both tests can be positive.
cues.zh: 两支试管分别来自水解前后。在本教材的普通定性条件下，淀粉原样不出现明显的砖红色证据；充分水解后的样品可以出现。长链并非绝对没有还原端，而是相同质量下端基数量很少。自由探索做部分水解时，碘检验与铜检验可以同时阳性，表示淀粉和还原性产物共存。
cues.en: Compare separate samples before and after hydrolysis. Under the textbook’s ordinary qualitative conditions, untreated starch shows no clear brick-red result, while the hydrolysed sample does. Long chains are not absolutely devoid of reducing ends; there are few per unit mass. Partial hydrolysis can leave both iodine and copper tests positive, indicating coexistence.

cues.title: 保留未水解对照
cues.caption: 条件相同，原蔗糖没有明显阳性。
cues.captionEn: Matched conditions; untreated sucrose gives no clear positive.
cues.zh: 蔗糖同样能溶于水，但溶解不等于具有还原性。保持铜试剂、碱性和加热条件一致，未经水解的蔗糖不出现明显砖红色沉淀。这支试管作为对照，帮助排除只要糖有甜味、能溶解就会给出同样检验结果的误解。
cues.en: Sucrose dissolves in water too, but dissolution does not establish reducing behaviour. With the same copper reagent, alkaline conditions and warming, untreated sucrose produces no clear brick-red precipitate. Keep this control: being soluble or sweet does not guarantee the same chemical-test result.

cues.title: 检验蔗糖水解产物
cues.caption: 水解改变组成，产物可还原试剂。
cues.captionEn: Hydrolysis changes the composition; products reduce the reagent.
cues.zh: 蔗糖水解后得到葡萄糖和果糖。冷却并调至适合的碱性，再作同样检验，出现砖红色沉淀。这里不能把结果解释成原来的蔗糖突然成了还原糖，而是样品组成已经改变。果糖也能在碱性检验中通过结构转化表现还原性，因此阳性并不只对应原来就有醛基的分子。
cues.en: Hydrolysis changes sucrose into glucose and fructose. After cooling and establishing suitable alkaline conditions, the same test gives a brick-red precipitate. The composition has changed; the result does not make the original sucrose a reducing sugar. Fructose can also give a reducing response through structural rearrangement in the alkaline test.

cues.title: 比较蔗糖与麦芽糖
cues.caption: 分子式相同，可反应的端基却不同。
cues.captionEn: Same formula, different available reducing ends.
cues.zh: 探究把蔗糖与麦芽糖并排比较，两者都先不水解。它们的分子式相同，却不必给出相同的化学性质。保持条件相同，麦芽糖可以显示还原性，而蔗糖原样没有明显阳性。画面用同一套试剂账避免凭标题换颜色；差别来自模型中可参与反应的端基。
cues.en: The inquiry compares sucrose and maltose without first hydrolysing either. Their molecular formulas match, but their chemical behaviour need not. Under matched conditions maltose can give reducing evidence, unlike untreated sucrose. The same reagent account drives both drawings; their difference comes from the available reducing groups, not a title-dependent colour swap.

cues.title: 解释连接部位
cues.caption: 麦芽糖保留自由端，能与开链醛式平衡。
cues.captionEn: Maltose retains a free end that equilibrates with an aldehyde.
cues.zh: 用简化的环形符号看连接位置。蔗糖的葡萄糖和果糖都把关键异头位点用于连接，不能直接保留可开环的半缩醛端。麦芽糖还有一个自由端，可以与开链醛式建立平衡。因此不能只数有几个糖环，要看连接占用了哪些位点。符号图不表示完整立体结构。
cues.en: The ring symbols now show linkage positions. Sucrose uses both anomeric sites in its connection, leaving no free hemiacetal end. Maltose retains one such end, which can equilibrate with an open-chain aldehyde form. Counting sugar rings is therefore insufficient; the occupied sites matter. These symbols show connectivity, not complete stereochemistry.

cues.title: 观察纤维素处理
cues.caption: 特定酸处理使纤维素水解，释放葡萄糖。
cues.captionEn: Specific acid treatment hydrolyses cellulose, releasing glucose.
cues.zh: 脱脂棉主要提供纤维素。教材使用特定的酸处理，使纤维结构被破坏并发生水解，最终能得到葡萄糖。它和淀粉都由葡萄糖单元组成，但结构不同，不能把相同温和条件下的快慢视为一样。图中纤维逐渐减少，单糖符号出现，只表达净转化方向。
cues.en: Cotton provides cellulose. The textbook uses a specific acid treatment to disrupt fibres and hydrolyse their chains, ultimately yielding glucose. Cellulose and starch share glucose building blocks but have different structures; they should not be assumed to hydrolyse equally readily under mild conditions. Fading fibres and appearing units show the net transformation only.

cues.title: 完成纤维素产物检验
cues.caption: 碱性、加热后，检出还原性产物。
cues.captionEn: With alkalinity and warming, reducing products are detected.
cues.zh: 纤维素处理后的液体同样不能省略条件调节。先中和酸，并使体系呈碱性，再加入铜盐并加热，才能按教材方法解释氧化亚铜的出现。还原性证据支持水解后出现了能还原试剂的产物，但单凭这一项不能证明产物绝对纯净，或原来的纤维素已经百分之百水解。
cues.en: The cellulose-treated liquid needs the same condition check. Neutralise acid and establish alkalinity before adding copper reagent and warming. The copper oxide evidence supports the presence of reducing products after hydrolysis. This single test does not demonstrate absolute product purity or prove that all of the original cellulose has been hydrolysed.

cues.title: 熔化，却还没有澄清
cues.caption: 历史样品在 T₁ 之后成为浑浊流体，不能只按固体与普通液体二分。
cues.captionEn: Above T₁ the historical sample becomes a cloudy fluid, challenging a simple solid–liquid split.
cues.zh: 一八八八年，莱尼采尔加热苯甲酸胆甾酯，先看见固体在熔点后变成浑浊的流体。这里用倾斜观察的示意，帮助区分固定形状与会重新铺展的液面，并不是原仪器复原。样品已经能够流动，但透过它看到的背景仍然模糊，这还不是通常想象的澄清液体。
cues.en: In eighteen eighty-eight, Reinitzer heated cholesteryl benzoate and saw the solid become a cloudy fluid above its melting point. This illustrative tilt distinguishes a retained shape from a liquid that levels itself; it is not his original apparatus. The sample can flow, yet the background remains obscured rather than becoming an ordinary clear liquid.

cues.title: 继续加热，还有第二次变化
cues.caption: 到 T₂ 澄清点，浑浊流体转为透明清亮态。
cues.captionEn: At the clearing point T₂, the cloudy fluid becomes transparent.
cues.zh: 继续沿温度轴移动，到第二个特征温度时，浑浊状态变得清亮。教材把熔点与澄清点之间标为液晶的温度范围。两次变化提示，失去固体的形状和失去某种内部有序性，并不一定同时发生。这里的浑浊外观只重现这个历史样品，不能作为所有液晶的识别标准。
cues.en: Continue along the temperature axis. At a second characteristic temperature, the cloudy fluid clears. The textbook marks the interval between melting and clearing as a liquid-crystalline range. Losing solid shape and losing internal order need not happen together. Cloudiness describes this historical sample; it is not a universal test for liquid crystals.

cues.title: 位置改变，方向仍有秩序
cues.caption: 向列相示意中，单元能够移动，而长轴仍倾向同一方向。
cues.captionEn: In the nematic teaching model, units move while their long axes retain a preferred direction.
cues.zh: 为了分开两种有序性，现在换成一个明确标注的向列相教学模型。追踪带环的同一条棒：它离开原来的位置，其他单元也在移动，原晶格的规则印记减弱；但长轴仍然倾向同一方向。历史苯甲酸胆甾酯属于胆甾相，不能把这一平行棒模型当成它的完整微观结构。
cues.en: To separate two kinds of order, switch to a labelled nematic teaching model. Follow the ringed rod as it leaves its original position. Other units move too, weakening the original lattice pattern, while their long axes still favour a common direction. Historical cholesteryl benzoate has a cholesteric phase; this parallel-rod model is not its complete microscopic structure.

cues.title: 再失去取向序
cues.caption: 位置仍可移动，长轴的共同方向也逐渐消失。
cues.captionEn: Positions remain mobile while the common long-axis direction disappears.
cues.zh: 保留这些单元的身份和移动路线，再逐渐放开它们的长轴方向。它们没有化学分解，变化的是整体取向的统计关系。下方的二维指标由画面中的角度实际计算，不是给阶段名称配上的固定数字。它解释向列相到各向同性状态的差别，但不拟合真实材料的相变温度或速度。
cues.en: Keep the same units and continuous paths while releasing their common alignment. They do not chemically decompose; their collective orientation changes. The planar indicator is calculated from the displayed angles, rather than assigned by phase name. It illustrates the nematic–isotropic distinction without predicting a real material’s transition temperature or rate.

cues.title: 电场改变取向，也改变透光
cues.caption: 两侧仍受边界固定，内部取向随电场变化，透光率由同一分布计算。
cues.captionEn: Boundary directions stay anchored while the interior responds to the field and determines transmission.
cues.zh: 最后看教材提到的电场应用。这里的短线代表局部平均方向，两片玻璃把边界方向固定。超过阈值后，内部逐渐朝电场方向倾斜，边缘仍保持原方向。由同一个取向分布计算光学相位差，交叉偏振片后的透光随之改变。撤去电场又回到原态。这是理想平面液晶层，不是完整手机显示器，也不套用历史样品的温度。
cues.en: For the textbook’s electrical application, short lines show local average directions. Two glass boundaries anchor their edges. Above a threshold, the interior tilts toward the field while the edges remain fixed. That same orientation profile determines optical retardation and transmission between crossed polarizers. Removing the field restores the starting state. This ideal planar cell is neither a complete phone display nor the historical high-temperature sample.

cues.title: 观察盐析
cues.caption: 较高硫酸铵浓度降低这组蛋白质的溶解度，使其析出。
cues.captionEn: High ammonium-sulfate concentration lowers solubility and precipitates this protein population.
cues.zh: 先观察盐析。硫酸铵浓度升高后，鸡蛋清中的一些蛋白质从溶液里析出。放大的链符号仍保持原来的盘曲形态，只是逐渐聚在一起。这表达的是本教材条件下溶解状态的改变，不是把所有蛋白质都说成已经变性。不同蛋白质达到盐析的条件也可以不同。
cues.en: Begin with salting out. As ammonium-sulfate concentration rises, some egg-white proteins precipitate. The enlarged chain symbols retain their folded shapes while clustering. This represents a change in solubility under the textbook conditions, not proof that every protein has denatured. Different proteins can precipitate at different salt concentrations.

cues.title: 加水检验可逆性
cues.caption: 加水降低盐浓度，盐析出的蛋白质可以重新溶解。
cues.captionEn: Adding water lowers salt concentration and can redissolve the salted-out protein.
cues.zh: 现在加水，继续追踪同一批蛋白质。盐没有凭空消失，但体积增大、盐浓度降低，聚在一起的链逐渐分散回去。盐析和复溶可以用于蛋白质分离。这里的形态示意不能替代活性测定，也不能保证任意样品在任意条件下都能百分之百恢复。
cues.en: Add water while following the same protein population. Salt does not vanish, but the larger volume lowers its concentration and the clustered chains disperse again. Salting out and redissolution can support separation. The drawing is not an activity assay, nor a guarantee that every protein sample can be fully recovered under arbitrary conditions.

cues.title: 观察加热变性
cues.caption: 加热改变蛋白质的空间状态，并可产生凝聚物。
cues.captionEn: Heating changes protein conformation and can produce aggregates.
cues.zh: 换到加热的鸡蛋清样品。蛋白质的空间状态改变，一些原来不易相遇的部位暴露出来，分子间发生聚集。链仍然连续，说明变性不等于已经把肽链水解成氨基酸。图形是机制示意，不是对某一种鸡蛋蛋白结构或实际折叠路径的原子级预测。
cues.en: Now heat a separate egg-white sample. Protein conformation changes, exposing regions that can associate with neighbouring molecules and produce aggregates. The chains remain continuous: denaturation is not the same as hydrolysing them into amino acids. These shapes illustrate a mechanism; they do not predict an atomic folding pathway for a particular egg protein.

cues.title: 比较两种化学处理
cues.caption: 硝酸银与乙醇分别处理样品，也能产生变性和凝聚现象。
cues.captionEn: Separate silver-nitrate and ethanol treatments can also denature and aggregate protein.
cues.zh: 教材还把两份鸡蛋清分别与硝酸银和乙醇接触。观察到的凝聚现象与加热一组相联系，但处理因素不同。重金属离子可以与蛋白质基团相互作用，乙醇改变周围溶剂环境。它们不需要完全相同的微观机制，也可能出现相似的宏观浑浊。
cues.en: The textbook treats two other egg-white samples with silver nitrate and ethanol. Their aggregation resembles the heated sample, but the causes differ. Heavy-metal ions interact with protein groups, while ethanol changes the solvent environment. Similar cloudiness therefore does not require an identical microscopic mechanism.

cues.title: 再加水作对照
cues.caption: 这三组教材处理后的凝聚物，加水后不能简单恢复原状。
cues.captionEn: The aggregates from these textbook treatments do not simply return to the original state on adding water.
cues.zh: 给三组样品继续加水。液体变稀了，凝聚物却仍然保留。这个结果与前面的盐析复溶形成对照。要把结论限定在这些样品和处理条件：蛋白质变性并非在所有情况下都绝对不可逆，但这里单纯加水不能使鸡蛋清恢复原来的分散和功能状态。
cues.en: Add water to all three treated samples. The liquid is diluted, yet aggregates remain, contrasting with the earlier salting-out observation. Keep the conclusion specific to these samples and treatments. Denaturation is not universally irreversible, but simple water addition does not restore the original egg-white dispersion and functional state in this experiment.

cues.title: 保留铅盐实验位置
cues.caption: 必修实验用醋酸铅处理鸡蛋清，观察蛋白质凝聚。
cues.captionEn: The required-book experiment uses lead acetate with egg white to observe aggregation.
cues.zh: 回到必修的实验位置，教材这里使用的是醋酸铅，而不是刚才选必实验的硝酸银。画面保留试剂身份，再次观察蛋白质链状态和凝聚的变化。不同重金属盐不能因为现象相似就被改成同一个实验名称。此处用于解释教材现象，不提供家庭操作或试剂处置步骤。
cues.en: Return to the required-book position. Its reagent is lead acetate, rather than the silver nitrate used in the elective comparison. Keep that identity explicit while observing changes in protein state and aggregation. Similar appearances do not make different reagents interchangeable textbook experiments. This is an explanation of the observation, not a home procedure.

cues.title: 区分析出与显色
cues.caption: 浓硝酸先使样品出现白色沉淀，加热后可变黄。
cues.captionEn: Concentrated nitric acid first precipitates the sample; warming can produce yellow colour.
cues.zh: 接着看另一份样品与浓硝酸的反应。先出现白色沉淀，加热后逐渐变黄，两个现象不要合成一步。黄色与某些芳香族残基发生硝化等反应有关，常见于可反应的酪氨酸和色氨酸位点。不同蛋白质的显色能力并不相同，弱显色也不能直接当作没有蛋白质。
cues.en: A separate sample now meets concentrated nitric acid. White precipitation comes first; warming then produces yellow colour. Keep these observations distinct. The colour relates to reactions of susceptible aromatic residues, notably tyrosine and tryptophan sites. Proteins do not all respond equally, so weak colour is not direct proof that protein is absent.

cues.title: 区分灼烧与变性
cues.caption: 头发与蚕丝灼烧发生热分解；教材记录了特殊气味。
cues.captionEn: Hair and silk undergo thermal decomposition on burning; the textbook records a characteristic odour.
cues.zh: 最后分别看头发和蚕丝灼烧。纤维卷曲、变暗并产生热分解产物，这已经涉及物质组成改变，不能只用空间折叠变化解释。教材记录了类似焦羽毛的气味；屏幕不能重现或验证气味。它是辅助观察，不应仅凭一项气味就给未知材料作完整鉴定。
cues.en: Finally, hair and silk curl, darken and undergo thermal decomposition on burning. Composition changes are involved, beyond a change of folding alone. The textbook records an odour resembling burnt feathers; the screen cannot reproduce or verify smell. It is supporting evidence, not a complete identification of an unknown material by odour alone.

cues.title: 相同浓度，先测 pH
cues.caption: 探头入液后，比较两种 0.1 M 酸。
cues.captionEn: Immerse the probes and compare two 0.1 M acids.
cues.zh: 先比较相同浓度的盐酸和醋酸。复合电极的敏感端进入液体后，才显示读数。醋酸只部分电离，模型中的氢离子浓度较低，pH 较高。这里测的是溶液的酸性，不能直接把读数当作酸的总量。
cues.en: Compare hydrochloric and acetic acids at the same concentration. Readings appear after the electrode tips enter the liquid. Partly ionized acetic acid has a lower calculated hydrogen-ion concentration and higher pH. This observation concerns acidity, rather than directly measuring total acid content.

cues.title: 保持相同电极条件
cues.caption: 相同交流电压与电极几何，电流响应不同。
cues.captionEn: Equal AC voltage and electrode geometry give different current responses.
cues.zh: 换成相同几何的电导电极，保持交流电压一致。盐酸中可迁移离子更多，模型响应更强。电导还受到离子迁移能力和浓度影响，所以只有把条件说明清楚，这个比较才有意义；它不是任何浓度下都成立的强弱排序。
cues.en: Use conductivity electrodes with equal geometry and alternating voltage. Hydrochloric acid gives a stronger model response because more mobile ions are present. Conductivity also depends on ion mobility and concentration. The comparison requires specified conditions; it is not a universal ranking across arbitrary concentrations.

cues.title: 等量镁的产气快慢
cues.caption: 同量镁在两种酸中有不同的产气过程。
cues.captionEn: Equal magnesium samples show different gas-production histories.
cues.zh: 两份溶液再放入同量镁，比较产气快慢。此处补充采用每组两毫升零点一摩尔每升的酸和五毫克镁，时间过程是教学示意。气泡快慢提供反应速率证据，不能直接证明最终能生成多少氢气。
cues.en: Compare equal magnesium samples in the two acids. This view adds a design of two milliliters of 0.1 molar acid and five milligrams of magnesium per sample. Timing is illustrative. Bubble production provides rate evidence, but does not by itself determine the final hydrogen yield.

cues.title: 电离比例与离子浓度
cues.caption: 稀释醋酸时，电离比例上升而氢离子浓度下降。
cues.captionEn: Diluting acetic acid raises its ionized fraction while lowering hydrogen-ion concentration.
cues.zh: 保留盐酸作参照，逐渐稀释醋酸。绿色部分代表电离比例，它会上升；下面的氢离子浓度却下降。比例和浓度是不同的量。自由探索还可以改变两种酸的浓度，检查为什么不能只凭强酸、弱酸标签比较电导。
cues.en: Retain hydrochloric acid as a reference while diluting acetic acid. The green ionized fraction rises, yet hydrogen-ion concentration falls. Fraction and concentration are different quantities. Exploration lets you vary both concentrations and see why strong or weak labels alone cannot rank conductivity.

cues.title: 碳酸钠逐滴进入醋酸
cues.caption: 碳酸钠进入足量醋酸后，产生二氧化碳。
cues.captionEn: Carbonate entering excess acetic acid releases carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 向两毫升一摩尔每升的醋酸中，逐滴加入同浓度碳酸钠。液体确实加入后，二氧化碳才开始生成。醋酸比碳酸更易提供氢离子，气体逸出也推动总反应；这些气泡支持酸性比较，却不能单独给出电离常数的数值。
cues.en: Add one molar sodium carbonate dropwise to two milliliters of one molar acetic acid. Carbon dioxide forms after the liquid enters. Acetic acid donates protons more readily than carbonic acid, while escaping gas helps drive the overall process. Bubbles support comparison without measuring a numerical dissociation constant.

cues.title: 先看加液与测量路径
cues.caption: 两瓶各含 0.05 g 镁，分别注入 2 mL 2 M 酸。
cues.captionEn: Each flask contains 0.05 g Mg and receives 2 mL of 2 M acid.
cues.zh: 压强实验换用教材规定的量：每瓶零点零五克镁，分别注入两毫升二摩尔每升的酸。针头把酸送进瓶内，另一条通路把气相接到传感器。加液本身还压缩原有空气，因此后续产气比较需要统一加液后的基线。
cues.en: The pressure experiment uses the textbook quantities: 0.05 grams of magnesium and two milliliters of two molar acid per flask. Needles deliver the acid, and separate tubes connect the gas spaces to sensors. Injection compresses existing air, so subsequent gas comparisons need a common post-addition baseline.

cues.title: 重建教材的压强趋势
cues.caption: 盐酸先快后慢，醋酸先加速再减速。
cues.captionEn: Hydrochloric acid slows from a fast start; acetic acid initially accelerates.
cues.zh: 这两条曲线重建教材的定性趋势，不是原始测量点。盐酸早期上升较快；醋酸先加速，再逐渐趋平。继续电离能解释酸的持续供应，却不能独自推出开始加速的原因，真实温升和镁表面状态等还需要另外的证据。
cues.en: These curves reconstruct the textbook trend rather than reproduce raw measurements. Hydrochloric acid rises rapidly at first; acetic acid initially accelerates, then levels off. Further ionization explains continued acid supply, but does not by itself derive the acceleration. Temperature and magnesium surface conditions need additional evidence.

cues.title: 用总量判断共同终点
cues.titleEn: Use total amounts to explain the common endpoint
cues.caption: 两组最多生成 2 mmol 氢气，并剩余约 1.39 mg 镁。
cues.captionEn: Both can produce 2 mmol hydrogen, leaving about 1.39 mg magnesium.
cues.zh: 最后比较总量。每组都有四毫摩尔酸，最多生成两毫摩尔氢气；镁略微过量，终点仍留下约一点三九毫克。醋酸初始游离氢离子少，但未电离部分继续参与。共同终点由可反应总量决定，不等于开始时的离子量相同。
cues.en: Each sample contains four millimoles of acid and can produce two millimoles of hydrogen. Magnesium is slightly in excess, leaving about 1.39 milligrams. Acetic acid begins with fewer free hydrogen ions, but its unionized portion continues supplying reaction capacity. Equal total capacity does not imply equal initial ion amounts.

cues.title: 从同一份熔体长出来
cues.caption: 硫先熔融，撤去热源后冷却结晶。
cues.captionEn: Sulfur first melts, then crystallizes after heating stops.
cues.zh: 先看蒸发皿中的硫。粉末受热后失去颗粒边界，成为熔体；停止加热并冷却，熔体中又出现晶体形貌。这条路径没有先把硫溶进水里。画面把不同状态的先后关系压缩在一起，晶形只是示意，不据此判定硫的具体同素异形体。
cues.en: Watch the sulfur in the dish. Heating removes the powder’s separate boundaries as it melts. Once heating stops and the melt cools, crystalline forms appear again. This route never required dissolving sulfur in water. Time and morphology are simplified; the image does not identify a particular sulfur allotrope.

cues.title: 冷面接住蒸气
cues.caption: 碘蒸气在冷的表面皿下方凝华，原料与产物位置不同。
cues.captionEn: Iodine vapor deposits beneath the cold watch glass, away from the source.
cues.zh: 换一份材料。杯底的碘受热形成蒸气，上方表面皿盛着冷水，晶体长在它的下表面。跟随带环的示踪份额，从杯底走向冷面；下方三个数相加始终不变。这些份额表示去向，不是分子计数或真实速率。去掉冷面条件时，模型不再把蒸气固定成这里的沉积。
cues.en: Now change materials. Iodine at the bottom supplies vapor, while water cools the watch glass above. Crystals collect underneath that glass. Follow the ringed parcel from source to cold surface. The three counts always sum to the same total. These parcels track destinations, not molecules or measured rates. Without the cold-surface condition, this model no longer fixes the vapor into that deposit.

cues.title: 溶液中也能析出晶体
cues.caption: 饱和氯化钠溶液加入浓盐酸，出现白色晶粒。
cues.captionEn: Concentrated hydrochloric acid produces white crystals in saturated sodium chloride solution.
cues.zh: 教材第三项使用饱和氯化钠溶液，再加入浓盐酸。白色晶粒从原本无色的液体中析出，新增的氯离子影响了溶解平衡。旁边的数字来自归一化教学模型，用来追踪钠在溶液和固体之间的分配。浓盐水和浓酸并不理想，不能把这些数当成实际产率。
cues.en: The textbook’s third experiment adds concentrated hydrochloric acid to saturated sodium chloride solution. White crystals emerge from a colourless liquid as added chloride affects the dissolution equilibrium. The normalized teaching numbers track sodium between solution and solid. Concentrated brine and acid are nonideal, so these values are not laboratory yields.

cues.title: 用复溶检查解释
cues.caption: 加入水后，原来的晶粒可以重新溶解。
cues.captionEn: Adding water can redissolve the original crystals.
cues.zh: 保留刚才的沉积，再加入水。白色晶粒逐渐减少，钠回到溶液中，钠的总量没有改变。这是一个补充对照，帮助区分析晶和产生了另一种难溶物。真实体系还受到稀释、活度和温度的共同影响；这里只把平衡方向和物质去向分清楚。
cues.en: Keep the deposit and add water. The same white grains shrink as sodium returns to solution without changing its total amount. This added comparison helps distinguish crystallization from creating a different insoluble substance. Real behavior also depends on dilution, activities and temperature; the teaching model isolates direction and material balance.

cues.title: 先得到小晶种
cues.caption: 温热饱和明矾溶液冷却静置，先得到小晶体。
cues.captionEn: Cooling and standing a warm saturated alum solution first produces small crystals.
cues.zh: 现在沿教材研究实践来养大一颗明矾晶体。先在温水中配制饱和溶液，再把澄清液转移到洁净浅皿。画面从转移后开始：盖纸防尘，冷却并静置一夜，底部逐渐出现小晶体。这个过程提供晶种，还不是最终大晶体；这里没有把过夜的时间当成几秒钟的真实生长速度。
cues.en: To grow a large alum crystal, first prepare a warm saturated solution and transfer the clear liquid to a clean shallow dish. The image begins after transfer. Cover against dust, cool, and leave overnight; small crystals gradually appear at the bottom. These provide seeds, rather than the final large specimen. The compressed sequence is not a prediction of growth within seconds.

cues.title: 选择并悬挂同一颗晶种
cues.caption: 选形状完整的晶种，用细线悬在溶液中央。
cues.captionEn: Choose a well-formed seed and suspend it centrally on a thread.
cues.zh: 从小晶体中选一颗形状完整的，跟踪它移向新的生长容器。用细线固定，让晶种悬在溶液中，不贴杯壁或杯底。这样各个方向都能接触溶液。重新配好的温热饱和液需要先冷却到教材指定的接近室温范围，再放入晶种；过热或不饱和条件可能让它反而溶解。
cues.en: Choose a well-formed small crystal and follow it into the growth vessel. A thread holds it clear of the walls and bottom, exposing its sides to solution. The replenished warm saturated solution must first cool close to room temperature as specified in the textbook. An overly warm or undersaturated solution may dissolve the seed instead.

cues.title: 增大的物质来自溶液
cues.titleEn: The added material comes from solution
cues.caption: 晶体增加，溶液中的相应物质量减少。
cues.captionEn: As the crystal gains material, the corresponding dissolved amount decreases.
cues.zh: 现在只追踪这一颗晶种。它保持八面体示意外形，表面向外长大，溶液中的相应份额同时减少。模型保持总量守恒，尺寸按体积的立方根计算，不是把图标随意放大。探索中提高当前可溶量，还能看到同一晶种缩小。教材实际要求反复补充溶液并等待，本片展示的是其中一轮。
cues.en: Follow this one seed. Its illustrative octahedral faces expand as the corresponding dissolved fraction decreases. Total material is conserved, and linear size follows the cube root of crystal volume. Raising the current soluble capacity in exploration can make the seed shrink instead. The textbook repeats replenishment and waiting; this shot represents one growth cycle.

cues.title: 留下透明、紫色、透明的层次
cues.titleEn: Retain clear, purple and clear layers
cues.caption: 换到不同生长液，原核外依次增加新的晶层。
cues.captionEn: Changing growth solutions adds new layers around the retained core.
cues.zh: 最后把同一晶体提出液面，移到铬钾矾生长液，再移回明矾生长液。观察上方的剖面放大：原来的透明核一直保留，外面先增加紫色层，再增加透明层。它不是整颗晶体瞬间被染成另一种颜色。真实界面可能混晶、再溶解或不够整齐；这里突出顺序生长留下的层次。
cues.en: Lift the same crystal out, move it into chrome-alum growth solution, then return it to alum solution. In the enlarged section, the clear core persists while a purple layer and then a clear layer are added. The whole crystal is not instantly recoloured. Real interfaces may mix, redissolve or grow unevenly; this construction emphasizes the record of sequential growth.

cues.title: 沿着序列走
cues.caption: 一级结构记录残基的种类与排列顺序。
cues.captionEn: Primary structure records residue identities and their order.
cues.zh: 先只看这串字母。每个字母代表一个氨基酸残基，亮起的位置沿着同一条链从氨基端走向羧基端。这是小蛋白 crambin 的真实序列，共四十六个残基。一级结构回答的是先后顺序；这里换行只是排版，不代表肽链在这些地方断开。
cues.en: Each letter represents an amino acid residue. The highlight follows one chain from its amino end to its carboxyl end. This is the actual forty-six-residue sequence of crambin. Primary structure tells us the order of residues. The line breaks are only typography; the chain does not break there.

cues.title: 放大局部螺旋
cues.caption: 局部螺旋由同一条链形成；虚线连接实际氧、氮坐标。
cues.captionEn: A local helix belongs to one chain; dashed contacts use actual oxygen and nitrogen coordinates.
cues.zh: 现在放大第七到第十七个残基所在的链段。彩色粗线连起各残基的阿尔法碳，用来追踪主链走向，并不是直接的碳碳化学键。虚线从羰基氧指向后方第四个残基的氮，标出螺旋中的氢键联系。文件没有这些氢原子的坐标，所以画面没有凭空补出氢的位置。
cues.en: Zoom into residues seven through seventeen. The thick trace joins alpha carbons to show the path of the chain; it is not a sequence of direct carbon-carbon bonds. Dashed contacts connect a carbonyl oxygen to the nitrogen four residues later, marking the helical hydrogen-bond pattern. Hydrogen positions are absent from this coordinate file, so they are not invented here.

cues.title: 对照反平行折叠
cues.caption: 同一条链的两段靠近，也能形成反平行 β 折叠。
cues.captionEn: Two segments of the same chain approach to form an antiparallel beta sheet.
cues.zh: 再看第一到第四、以及第三十二到第三十五个残基。这两段在序列中隔得很远，却在空间中靠近，走向相反。虚线显示两段之间的主链氢键联系。螺旋与折叠都属于局部构象，也就是二级结构；看到两段并排，并不意味着这里有两条不同的蛋白质链。
cues.en: Now inspect residues one to four alongside residues thirty-two to thirty-five. They are distant in sequence but close in space, running in opposite directions. Dashed contacts mark backbone hydrogen bonds between the segments. Both helices and sheets are local secondary structures. Two adjacent segments do not necessarily mean two separate protein chains.

cues.title: 回到整条链
cues.caption: 三级结构描述整条链的空间构象；局部结构仍嵌在其中。
cues.captionEn: Tertiary structure describes the complete chain conformation, including its local structures.
cues.zh: 把镜头拉回，刚才的螺旋与折叠都回到这条四十六残基的链中。淡绿色部分连接它们，金色短线是这个蛋白质中的三处二硫键，端点使用真正的硫原子坐标。整条链的空间结构就是三级结构。二硫键只是稳定因素之一，并不是每种蛋白质都一定有。
cues.en: Pull back to the complete forty-six-residue chain. The helices and sheet remain embedded in it, joined by the pale green regions. Three gold links mark this protein’s disulfide bonds, using the actual sulfur positions. Tertiary structure describes the overall conformation of one chain. Disulfide bonds are one stabilizing feature, and not every protein contains them.

cues.title: 换到四链血红蛋白
cues.caption: 血红蛋白由两条 α 链和两条 β 链组成；这属于四级结构。
cues.captionEn: Hemoglobin contains two alpha and two beta chains: quaternary structure.
cues.zh: 最后换一个真实例子：去氧血红蛋白。四种颜色追踪四条已经折叠的链，两条阿尔法链各一百四十一个残基，两条贝塔链各一百四十六个。画面把各链分开再放回，只是帮助观察，并非真实组装动力学。多个亚基之间的组织关系属于四级结构；单链蛋白质并不必然具有这一层次。
cues.en: Switch to a different real structure: deoxyhemoglobin. Four colours follow four folded chains: two alpha chains with one hundred and forty-one residues each, and two beta chains with one hundred and forty-six. Separating and returning them is a viewing aid, not a simulation of assembly kinetics. Their organization is quaternary structure, a level that single-chain proteins do not necessarily have.

cues.title: 泡豆吸水
cues.caption: 泡豆使水进入豆粒，体积逐渐增大。
cues.captionEn: Soaking lets water enter the beans and increases their volume.
cues.zh: 跟着这批豆粒看一遍豆腐的来路。泡豆时，水进入豆粒，豆粒逐渐膨胀。画面把容器剖开，方便看清豆粒的变化。这里首先发生的是吸水，不是凝固剂把蛋白质变成了新的物质；水和豆子的总量都有各自的去向。
cues.en: Follow one batch of beans into tofu. During soaking, water enters the beans and they swell. The vessel is shown in cutaway so the changes remain visible. This first step is hydration, before coagulant is added. Both the soybean material and the water remain part of the material account.

cues.title: 磨豆释放分散物
cues.caption: 磨碎豆粒，使蛋白质等成分进入水中的分散体系。
cues.captionEn: Grinding releases protein and other components into a water-based dispersion.
cues.zh: 磨豆把豆粒组织破碎，让其中的成分进入水中。完整豆粒逐渐消失，细小的分散物增多。豆浆不是单一纯物质，也不只是蛋白质的真溶液，其中还有脂类和其他成分。后面的凝固发生在这个复杂体系里。
cues.en: Grinding disrupts the bean tissue and releases its components into water. Whole beans diminish as dispersed material increases. Soymilk is a mixture, containing fat and other components as well as protein. It is not simply a pure protein solution. This mixed dispersion is the starting point for coagulation.

cues.title: 滤去豆渣
cues.caption: 粗大的豆渣被截留，豆浆及其中分散的蛋白质通过。
cues.captionEn: Coarse okara is retained while soymilk and its dispersed protein pass through.
cues.zh: 过滤时，先盯住留在滤布上的豆渣，再看流到容器中的豆浆。过滤利用的是粗颗粒与液体的分离；它没有把豆浆中的全部蛋白质筛出去。部分蛋白质也会留在豆渣中，所以原料里的蛋白质不可能全部进入最后的豆腐。
cues.en: Watch the okara retained on the cloth, then the milk collecting below. Filtration separates coarse solids from the liquid dispersion; it does not remove every protein from the milk. Some protein also remains in the okara, so not all of the initial soybean protein reaches the final tofu.

cues.title: 煮浆改变结构
cues.caption: 热处理改变蛋白质构象，为后续聚集提供条件。
cues.captionEn: Thermal treatment changes protein conformations and prepares them for aggregation.
cues.zh: 镜头进入蛋白质的示意层面。加热时，原本较紧凑的结构展开，原先隐藏的部分更容易参与后续相互作用。这里保留相同数量的蛋白质符号，表示形状和状态改变，不是加热凭空增加蛋白质。图中的线不是实际测得的大豆蛋白结构。
cues.en: Move to a symbolic view of the proteins. Heating changes compact conformations and can expose regions involved in later interactions. The same number of protein symbols remains present: thermal preparation changes their state, rather than creating additional protein. These lines are explanatory symbols, not measured soybean-protein coordinates.

cues.title: 点卤形成网络
cues.caption: 钙、镁盐可促进蛋白质聚集，形成含水的凝胶网络。
cues.captionEn: Calcium or magnesium salts can promote protein association into a hydrated gel network.
cues.zh: 加入凝固剂后，蛋白质之间的联系逐渐增多，形成贯通的网络。传统凝固剂包括石膏和氯化镁等，离子作用与蛋白质已有的热处理状态共同影响结果。画面连接线概括多种相互作用，不表示每一根都是钙离子桥，也不是简单把高浓度盐析照搬到豆腐。
cues.en: After coagulant is introduced, protein associations build into a connected network. Traditional coagulants include calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride. Ion effects work together with the previous thermal treatment. The links summarize several interactions; they are not all literal calcium bridges. Tofu formation should not be equated directly with high-salt precipitation.

cues.title: 压制排出液体
cues.caption: 压制排出部分液体，使凝胶更加紧实。
cues.captionEn: Pressing releases some liquid and compacts the gel.
cues.zh: 把凝胶放入模具，压板下移，部分液体沿空隙流出。豆腐变得紧实，湿质量却会减少。看清这个区别：蛋白质在较少的水中显得更集中，但压制本身没有增加蛋白质的总量。排出的液体也并非完全纯水。
cues.en: Place the gel in a mould. As the plate descends, some liquid escapes through the openings. The curd becomes more compact while its wet mass decreases. Protein becomes more concentrated in less water, but pressing does not create protein. The expelled liquid is not necessarily pure water either.

cues.title: 揭开成品内部
cues.caption: 成形豆腐仍是含水网络，并非干燥的纯蛋白质。
cues.captionEn: Finished tofu remains a hydrated network, not dry pure protein.
cues.zh: 最后把成形的豆腐切开，用示意剖面看内部。浅褐色网络中仍分布着水，还含有脂类及其他成分。改变自由探索中的热处理、促凝作用或压制程度，可以看到网络和物料分配的变化。这里用无量纲参数讲原理，不把模型读数当成实际食谱或最佳用量。
cues.en: The final cutaway reveals water still distributed within the protein network, alongside fat and other components. Exploration changes thermal preparation, ion-driven association and pressing to show their effects on the network and material partition. These dimensionless settings explain the mechanism; their numerical values are not a recipe or an optimum dose.

cues.title: 先看碱滴入酸的曲线
cues.titleEn: Start with base added to acid
cues.caption: 加入体积改变剩余酸碱量，也改变总体积。
cues.captionEn: Added volume changes both excess acid or base and total solution volume.
cues.zh: 先用已知浓度的示范说明原理：二十毫升零点一摩尔每升的盐酸，接受同浓度氢氧化钠。横轴是加入体积，纵轴是计算的 pH。起初变化较缓，接近二十毫升时，少量加入就会产生明显变化。
cues.en: Begin with known concentrations to explain the principle: twenty milliliters of 0.1 molar hydrochloric acid receives 0.1 molar sodium hydroxide. Added volume is horizontal and calculated pH is vertical. Initially the change is gradual; near twenty milliliters, a small addition has a large effect.

cues.title: 放大当量点附近
cues.caption: 同样的微小体积，在当量点附近引起更大的 pH 变化。
cues.captionEn: The same tiny volume causes a larger pH change near equivalence.
cues.zh: 放大十九点八到二十点二毫升之间。恰好按一比一计量反应时，理想模型的 pH 为七；前后少量过量的酸或碱，都会明显改变读数。因此靠近终点要减慢加入，不能沿用开始时的放液速度。
cues.en: Magnify the region from 19.8 to 20.2 milliliters. At exact one-to-one equivalence, this ideal model gives pH seven. Small excesses on either side change pH sharply. Near the endpoint, delivery must slow instead of continuing at the initial rate.

cues.title: 变色范围不等于一个点
cues.titleEn: A transition range is not a single point
cues.caption: 指示剂在范围内变色，终点不严格等于当量点。
cues.captionEn: Indicators change across ranges; endpoint is not exactly equivalence.
cues.zh: 把酚酞与甲基橙的变色范围放到同一曲线上。它们都可落在强酸强碱的陡变区，却并不要求在 pH 七才变色。当量点由化学计量定义；实验终点由可见的颜色变化判断，两者应当分清。
cues.en: Place phenolphthalein and methyl-orange transition ranges on the curve. Both can lie in the steep region without changing at exactly pH seven. Equivalence is defined by chemical stoichiometry; the experimental endpoint is judged from an observable color change. Keep these definitions separate.

cues.title: 检漏后，用将盛装的液体润洗
cues.titleEn: Check leaks and condition with the intended solution
cues.caption: 润洗内壁后，从下口弃去润洗液。
cues.captionEn: Wet the inner walls, then discard the rinse through the tip.
cues.zh: 先确认关闭活塞后不会漏液。洁净滴定管再用将要盛装的溶液润洗：倾斜转动，让内壁接触溶液，从下口弃去。教材要求两到三次，这里演示三次。残水逐次减少，避免标准液加入后被稀释。
cues.en: First check that the closed stopcock does not leak. Condition the clean burette with its intended solution, tilting and rolling to wet the walls, then discarding through the tip. The textbook requires two or three rinses; this view shows three, progressively reducing residual water.

cues.title: 排除气泡，再记初读数
cues.titleEn: Clear bubbles before the starting reading
cues.caption: 尖嘴充满液体后，调节并记录初读数。
cues.captionEn: Fill the tip with liquid, then adjust and record the starting level.
cues.zh: 正式读数之前，放液赶出尖嘴中的气泡，这部分流出液弃去。随后按教材调至零刻度，并记录初读数。若把气泡留到滴定时再填满，滴定管少掉的一部分液体并没有进入锥形瓶，就会造成体积判断错误。
cues.en: Before the formal reading, drain liquid to clear air from the tip and discard that liquid. Then set and record the starting level as directed by the textbook. If a bubble fills during titration, some liquid leaving the scale region never reaches the flask, biasing the volume interpretation.

cues.title: 用碱式管量取待测液
cues.titleEn: Measure the analyte with the base burette
cues.caption: 量出 20.00 mL 待测碱，再加入两滴酚酞。
cues.captionEn: Deliver 20.00 mL unknown base, then add two drops of phenolphthalein.
cues.zh: 本活动用碱式滴定管量出二十点零零毫升待测氢氧化钠，再加入两滴酚酞，溶液呈粉红色。注意乳胶管和玻璃球阀的结构。主图压缩了全量程，真正读数需要平视弯月面，不能按画面长度估计体积。
cues.en: Use the base burette to deliver twenty milliliters of unknown sodium hydroxide, then add two drops of phenolphthalein to make it pink. Notice the rubber sleeve and glass-ball valve. The main scale is compressed; real readings require eye-level meniscus observation, not measuring screen length.

cues.title: 酸滴入碱，逐步接近终点
cues.titleEn: Add acid to base and approach the endpoint
cues.caption: 盐酸从尖嘴进入锥形瓶，与待测碱混合。
cues.captionEn: Hydrochloric acid enters the flask and mixes with the unknown base.
cues.zh: 现在改由零点一零零零摩尔每升的盐酸滴定待测碱。方向与开头的原理曲线相反：酸进入碱，颜色最终由粉红变为无色。每次加入都要混匀，接近预计终点时放慢，准备控制更小的一次加入量。
cues.en: Now 0.1000 molar hydrochloric acid titrates the unknown base. This reverses the introductory curve: acid enters base, and pink eventually becomes colorless. Mix after additions and slow near the expected endpoint, preparing to control a smaller final addition.

cues.title: 让半滴真正进入溶液
cues.titleEn: Deliver the partial drop into the solution
cues.caption: 悬滴接触内壁并被冲下后，才计入主体中和。
cues.captionEn: The partial drop affects bulk neutralization only after wall contact and rinsing.
cues.zh: 让半滴停在尖嘴，触及锥形瓶内壁，再用少量蒸馏水冲入溶液。看清酸所在的位置：挂在尖嘴或留在瓶壁上时，还没有全部进入主体溶液。粉红色刚好消失后，观察半分钟不返色；画面时钟采用压缩播放。
cues.en: Form a partial drop, touch it to the inside flask wall and rinse it down with distilled water. Track where the acid is: hanging at the tip or left on the wall, it has not all reached the bulk. Observe no returning pink for half a minute; the clock is time compressed.

cues.title: 读弯月面，再取差值
cues.titleEn: Read the meniscus and take the difference
cues.caption: 体积等于终读数减初读数。
cues.captionEn: Delivered volume equals final minus initial reading.
cues.zh: 放大滴定管的一小段。眼睛与凹弯月面最低点同高，刻度向下增大，体积要用终读数减去初读数。示范里消耗二十毫升标准酸；把它与二十毫升样品代入一比一关系，才得到浓度计算结果。
cues.en: Magnify a small section of the burette and read the meniscus bottom at eye level. Numbers increase downward, so subtract the initial reading from the final reading. This demonstration uses twenty milliliters of standard acid; combine that with the sample volume and one-to-one stoichiometry to calculate concentration.

cues.title: 重复实验与原始记录
cues.caption: 教材例题的数据用来示范计算；自己的三次记录保持空白。
cues.captionEn: Textbook example data illustrate calculation; your three-run record starts blank.
cues.zh: 这里展示教材第六十九页的三次例题数据，条件与活动不同：标准酸为零点一零三二摩尔每升，样品二十五毫升。它们用于说明平均值，不能冒充自己的实验。实际活动要再重复两次，并检查异常操作和系统误差。
cues.en: These three results belong to the separate textbook problem on page sixty-nine, using 0.1032 molar acid and a twenty-five-milliliter sample. They illustrate averaging, not your own experiment. The practical requires two further trials and an assessment of flawed operations and systematic error.

cues.title: 水的位置决定误差方向
cues.caption: 滴定管残水、锥形瓶残水和多余待测液有不同后果。
cues.captionEn: Burette water, flask water and extra analyte have different consequences.
cues.zh: 比较三种情况。滴定管残水稀释标准酸，按原浓度计算会偏高；锥形瓶少量蒸馏水不增加待测物质的量，理想当量体积不变。若用待测液润洗锥形瓶，就会带入额外样品，所以不能这样润洗。
cues.en: Compare three cases. Burette water dilutes the standard acid, biasing a calculation using its original concentration high. Distilled water in the flask adds no analyte, so the ideal equivalence volume is unchanged. Rinsing the flask with analyte introduces an unmeasured extra sample and must be avoided.

cues.title: 按讨论题绘制反向曲线
cues.titleEn: Plot the direction requested in the discussion
cues.caption: 活动用酸滴定碱，讨论题再画碱滴定酸的曲线。
cues.captionEn: The practical adds acid to base; the discussion requests base added to acid.
cues.zh: 最后回到活动要求的曲线：横轴是加入氢氧化钠的体积，纵轴是盐酸样品的 pH。它与刚才实际操作的方向相反。自由探索可切换两种方向、放大终点附近，并记录自己的三次测量，检查曲线、操作和计算是否一致。
cues.en: Finish with the activity discussion curve: added sodium-hydroxide volume versus the hydrochloric sample pH. Its direction reverses the practical operation. Exploration switches directions, magnifies the endpoint region and accepts your three measurements, helping connect the curve, procedure and calculation.

cues.title: 先追踪已有分子
cues.caption: 原油是混合物；加热后，蒸气与液体经管道进入分馏塔。
cues.captionEn: Crude oil is a mixture; heated vapour and liquid enter the column.
cues.zh: 石油里本来就有许多不同的分子。这里选五种正烷烃作代表，用固定身份的小点追踪它们，不表示实际原油配方。看这些点沿加热炉的连通管道进入塔内。现在改变的是温度和物态，还没有把碳链拆开。
cues.en: Crude oil already contains many different molecules. Five normal alkanes stand in for a much richer mixture here. The fixed markers track identities, not the composition of a real crude. Follow them through the connected furnace pipe into the tower. Heating changes physical state; it has not cut their carbon chains.

cues.title: 上冷下热，分路离开
cues.caption: 较易挥发的组分能升得更高，较难挥发的组分较早凝结或留在底部。
cues.captionEn: More volatile components rise farther; others condense lower down or remain at the bottom.
cues.zh: 塔里上冷下热。沿着被圈出的十六烷代表物，看它在较冷区域凝结，并沿支路离开。较易挥发的组分能继续上升，最轻的代表物保持气态，最重的留在底部。这是用沸点排序的示意，真实分馏要反复进行气液接触，各馏分仍是混合物。
cues.en: The column is cooler at the top. Track the circled hexadecane representative as it reaches a cooler region and leaves along a side branch. More volatile components can rise farther; the lightest representative stays gaseous, while the heaviest remains below. This boiling-point illustration omits repeated vapour–liquid equilibration. Actual fractions are still mixtures.

cues.title: 放大同一条碳链
cues.caption: 分馏前后，十六烷的碳原子数、氢原子数和连接方式没有变化。
cues.captionEn: Hexadecane keeps the same atom counts and connections through fractionation.
cues.zh: 放大刚才追踪的十六烷。圈住的碳原子仍与原来的邻居相连，整条链也没有变短。分子到了不同的出口，不等于生成了新的分子。分馏根据物理性质，把原来混在一起的组分分开；它本身不能把重油变成较短的烃。
cues.en: Zoom in on the same hexadecane molecule. The circled carbon still has the same neighbours, and the chain has not become shorter. Reaching another outlet does not mean a new molecule was made. Fractionation separates existing components by physical properties; it does not itself convert heavy hydrocarbons into shorter ones.

cues.title: 连接关系真正改变
cues.caption: 一个十六烷可按教材净反应转化为一个辛烷和一个辛烯。
cues.captionEn: The textbook net reaction converts hexadecane into octane and octene.
cues.zh: 现在换成化学转化。十六个碳原子的身份保留，但连接方式改变，形成八个碳的烷烃和八个碳的烯烃。注意烯烃中的双键。两边氢原子合计仍是三十四个。这是教材给出的一种净反应，过渡画面不代表真实的反应中间体，也不说明工业上只生成这两种产物。
cues.en: Now change the chemistry. The sixteen carbon identities remain, but their connections produce an eight-carbon alkane and an eight-carbon alkene. Notice the double bond. Their hydrogen counts still add to thirty-four. This is one textbook net reaction. The moving transition is not an elementary mechanism, and industrial cracking does not yield only this pair.

cues.title: 较短的烃还能再变化
cues.caption: 辛烷可继续转化为丁烷和丁烯；总计仍为八个碳、十八个氢。
cues.captionEn: Octane can give butane and butene, conserving eight carbons and eighteen hydrogens.
cues.zh: 把刚才的辛烷拿出来，它还可以继续转化。现在四个碳留在烷烃中，另四个碳进入烯烃。检查分子式，十个氢加八个氢，正好等于原来的十八个。裂化得到的不是随意拼出来的短链，产物结构和原子守恒必须同时满足。
cues.en: Take the octane product and consider another conversion. Four carbons now belong to butane and four to butene. Ten hydrogens plus eight give the original eighteen. Shorter chains cannot be invented arbitrarily: the proposed structures and the atom balance must agree. This is another possible net reaction rather than a prediction of product selectivity.

cues.title: 同一原料，选择一种产物组合
cues.caption: 丁烷可生成甲烷和丙烯，这是一种可能的净反应。
cues.captionEn: Butane can give methane and propene in one possible net reaction.
cues.zh: 再看一份丁烷。把一个碳分到甲烷，剩下三个碳形成丙烯，双键对应的氢数也随之改变。四加六，仍是十个氢。丙烯可以成为化工原料。这个镜头说明一种可配平的途径，不能把连线的动画当作单步裂解机理。
cues.en: Start with a fresh butane molecule. One carbon goes into methane and three into propene. The double bond is consistent with their hydrogen counts: four plus six still gives ten. Propene is a useful chemical feedstock. The drawing communicates a balanced overall possibility, not a single-step bond-breaking mechanism.

cues.title: 换一条途径，再核对守恒
cues.caption: 另一种丁烷净反应生成乙烷与乙烯；裂解产物并不唯一。
cues.captionEn: An alternative butane net reaction gives ethane and ethene; products are not unique.
cues.zh: 回到相同的丁烷起点，改成两个碳和两个碳的组合，就能得到乙烷与乙烯。注意，这与上一镜头是两种替代途径，不是同一个分子同时变出两套产物。真实产物分布取决于原料和工艺。分馏保留分子身份，裂化和裂解改变结构，这就是两者的核心区别。
cues.en: Return to the same butane starting point and choose a two-and-two carbon split. The balanced products are ethane and ethene. These are alternatives to the previous route, not two product sets from one molecule. Real distributions depend on the feed and process. Fractionation sorts existing molecules; cracking changes their structures.

cues.title: 把金属还原为单质
cues.titleEn: Reduce the metal to its element
cues.caption: 冶炼的共同目标，是把化合物中的金属还原为单质。
cues.captionEn: The common goal is to reduce a metal in a compound to its elemental state.
cues.zh: 矿物中的金属往往以化合物形式存在。这里先用氧化铁看共同目标：铁从正三价回到零价，需要得到电子。得到电子的同时，体系里必有别的部分失去电子。接下来比较三条路线，观察氧与电子的去向，而不是把所有矿物都画成加热后自动变成金属。
cues.en: Metals in minerals often occur in compounds. Iron oxide illustrates the common goal: iron in oxidation state plus three must gain electrons to reach elemental iron. Another part of the system must lose electrons. We will compare routes by following oxygen and electron transfer, rather than assuming every mineral simply becomes metal when heated.

cues.title: 热分解氧化汞
cues.caption: 氧化汞分解时，汞被还原，氧元素被氧化。
cues.captionEn: When mercury oxide decomposes, mercury is reduced and oxygen is oxidized.
cues.zh: 教材用氧化汞举例说明热分解路线。保持原子身份不变，两个氧化汞计量单元变成两个汞原子和一个氧分子。汞从正二价回到零价；氧从负二价升到零价，电子收支相等。这里是计量和价态示意，不是汞实验的操作演示，也不是所有金属氧化物都能这样分解。
cues.en: The textbook uses mercury oxide to illustrate thermal decomposition. Two formula units become elemental mercury and one oxygen molecule while every atom is retained. Mercury changes from plus two to zero; oxygen changes from minus two to zero, balancing electron transfer. This is a stoichiometric explanation, not an operating demonstration or a rule for every metal oxide.

cues.title: 一氧化碳夺取氧
cues.caption: CO 转变为 CO₂，氧化铁中的铁得到电子。
cues.captionEn: Carbon monoxide becomes carbon dioxide while iron in the oxide gains electrons.
cues.zh: 现在跟踪氧化铁中的三个氧。它们进入一氧化碳，形成三个二氧化碳计量单元，铁留下成为单质。碳从正二价升到正四价，提供的六个电子恰好对应两个铁的还原。高炉中的真实过程有多步反应，这里只显示教材所需的净反应，不把移动轨迹当作原子真实碰撞路径。
cues.en: Follow the three oxygen atoms in iron oxide. They join carbon monoxide to form three carbon-dioxide units, leaving elemental iron. Carbon changes from plus two to plus four, releasing the six electrons needed by two iron atoms. Actual blast-furnace chemistry involves several steps. This is the net reaction, and the animated paths are bookkeeping rather than measured atomic trajectories.

cues.title: 金属也能作还原剂
cues.titleEn: A metal can be a reducing agent
cues.caption: 铝被氧化为氧化铝，氧化铁被还原为铁。
cues.captionEn: Aluminium is oxidized to aluminium oxide as iron oxide is reduced.
cues.zh: 还原剂也可以是另一种金属。把一氧化碳换成铝，氧的最终去向变成氧化铝。两个铝从零价升到正三价，共失去六个电子，与铁的还原配对。教材的铝热反应说明了一条置换还原路线；本片只展示物质与电子的关系，不展示点火、配料或高温操作。
cues.en: A different metal can act as the reducing agent. Replace carbon monoxide with aluminium: oxygen now ends up in aluminium oxide. Two aluminium atoms change from zero to plus three, releasing six electrons to match iron reduction. The textbook thermite equation illustrates this displacement route. The film explains the reaction account without presenting ignition, mixture preparation or hot-metal handling.

cues.title: 熔盐中的电解路线
cues.caption: 外电源驱动阴极还原与阳极氧化；两种产物分别收集。
cues.captionEn: External power drives cathodic reduction and anodic oxidation, with products separated.
cues.zh: 对教材中的钠，换成熔融氯化钠和外接电源。钠离子在阴极得到电子，氯离子在阳极失去电子成为氯气。示意界面把金属和气体分开，实际装置也必须防止它们重新反应。这里强调熔体：把氯化钠水溶液当作相同原料，不会按这条路线得到钠。
cues.en: For sodium, switch to molten sodium chloride and an external power source. Sodium ions gain electrons at the cathode; chloride ions lose electrons at the anode to form chlorine. The separated interfaces emphasize separate product collection, preventing recombination. The melt matters: an aqueous sodium-chloride solution does not produce sodium by this same route.

cues.title: 镁需要两个电子
cues.caption: 一个 Mg²⁺ 接受两个电子，与两个 Cl⁻ 的氧化配对。
cues.captionEn: One magnesium ion accepts two electrons, paired with oxidation of two chloride ions.
cues.zh: 再把原料换成熔融氯化镁。镁离子带两个正电荷，每形成一个镁，需要两个电子；两个氯离子恰好提供相应的氧化过程。结构相似，但计量关系不能只换一个金属名字。电解是教材给出的镁冶炼路线之一，并不表示工业上只能使用这一种方法。
cues.en: Now use molten magnesium chloride. A magnesium ion carries two positive charges, so producing one magnesium atom requires two electrons. Two chloride ions supply the matching oxidation process. Similar interfaces still require different stoichiometry. Electrolysis is one magnesium-production route presented by the textbook, not the only industrial method available.

cues.title: 把碳阳极计入反应
cues.caption: 工业铝电解使用碳阳极；碳消耗并形成含碳气体。
cues.captionEn: Industrial aluminium electrolysis consumes carbon anodes and produces carbon-containing gases.
cues.zh: 最后看铝。氧化铝溶于熔融冰晶石体系，铝在阴极生成。教材前面的氧气总式是简化表达；真实碳阳极会参与反应，因此这里把碳计入物料账本，显示以二氧化碳为主的净反应。阳极随过程缩短。具体工况也可产生其他气体，画面不是完整工厂排放模型。
cues.en: Finally, alumina is dissolved in a molten cryolite-based electrolyte and aluminium forms at the cathode. The textbook’s oxygen-producing overall equation is a simplification. Industrial carbon anodes participate, so this account includes carbon and shows the carbon-dioxide net pathway. The anode is consumed. Other gases can occur under particular conditions; this is not a complete industrial emissions model.

cues.title: 一个原子被几个晶胞共享
cues.titleEn: How many cells share one atom?
cues.caption: 分数来自相邻晶胞共享，不是把原子切碎。
cues.captionEn: Fractions count shared spatial ownership; atoms are not cut apart.
cues.zh: 先把周围晶胞也放回来。顶角的同一个原子邻接八个晶胞，所以每个晶胞按八分之一计入。换到棱上，变成四个共享；面上是两个；内部才完全归入一个晶胞。画面始终保留完整原子，这些分数是对无限重复结构的空间计数，不是原子真的被切成碎片。
cues.en: Restore the neighboring cells. One corner atom is shared by eight cells, contributing one eighth to each. At an edge, four cells share it; at a face, two; inside, only one. The atom stays intact throughout. These fractions account for an extended repeating structure rather than physically cutting atoms into fragments.

cues.title: 十四个位置，四个原子的计数
cues.titleEn: Fourteen drawn sites count as four atoms
cues.caption: 铜的常规面心立方晶胞：8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4。
cues.captionEn: Copper’s conventional face-centred cubic cell counts 8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4.
cues.zh: 现在看铜的常规面心立方晶胞。八个顶角和六个面心，在图上能看见十四个位置；按刚才的共享规则，计数却是四个原子。观察角度改变，权重不会改变。探索里还可以切到氯化钠，分别计算两种离子，不能把图中所有球直接加起来当成化学式。
cues.en: Copper’s conventional face-centred cubic cell draws eight corners and six face centres: fourteen visible sites, but a count of four atoms under the sharing rules. Rotating the view changes no weight. Exploration also counts sodium and chloride separately; simply adding every drawn sphere does not determine a chemical formula.

cues.title: 有序不必等于周期重复
cues.titleEn: Order need not mean periodic repetition
cues.caption: 准周期构造有确定规则，却没有普通晶格的平移重复。
cues.captionEn: A quasiperiodic construction follows rules without ordinary lattice translation repetition.
cues.zh: 接下来挑战把有序等同于周期重复的想法。这是按确定规则细分得到的彭罗斯铺排。金色副本平移后，有些局部仍相似，整体却不能像普通晶格那样重合。有限画面本身不是非周期性的数学证明；它帮助看见这种构造的特征。它也不是某种合金的实际原子结构。
cues.en: Now separate order from periodic repetition. This Penrose patch follows a definite subdivision rule. Translating the gold copy leaves local similarities but fails to align the whole pattern as an ordinary lattice would. A finite image alone is not a proof of aperiodicity; it illustrates the construction. Nor is this an actual alloy’s atomic structure.

cues.title: 非周期也可以产生尖锐亮斑
cues.titleEn: Aperiodic order can produce sharp peaks
cues.caption: 同一组有序坐标经相位叠加，得到有对称性的衍射亮斑。
cues.captionEn: Phase summation from the same ordered coordinates produces symmetric diffraction peaks.
cues.zh: 把刚才的顶点作为相同的散射点，逐个加上它们的波动相位，再取振幅平方。亮斑从这些坐标计算出来，没有另外摆成一个好看的图案。准晶仍可产生尖锐的衍射信号，促使晶体概念容纳非周期有序。这里是二维有限点阵的计算，实际准晶还需要三维结构和实验分析。
cues.en: Treat those same vertices as equal scatterers, sum their wave phases, and square the amplitude. Every bright feature is calculated from the coordinates, not arranged decoratively. Quasicrystals can retain sharp diffraction and broaden the crystal concept to include aperiodic order. This is a finite planar calculation; real quasicrystals require three-dimensional structural and experimental analysis.

cues.title: 同样的点数，不同的排列
cues.caption: 周期排列集中形成亮斑，无序对照的强度更分散。
cues.captionEn: Periodic positions concentrate intensity into peaks; the disordered comparison spreads it out.
cues.zh: 保留相同的散射点种类和数目，分别计算周期排列与位置无序的对照。观察亮度分布，而不是只看有没有外形规则的轮廓。教材用水晶和石英玻璃的衍射说明这个区别；我们的点模型只解释排列怎样影响干涉，明确没有把它冒充二氧化硅的真实坐标或实测谱。
cues.en: Use the same type and number of scatterers in periodic and positionally disordered arrangements. Compare where intensity gathers rather than judging an external outline. The textbook uses crystalline quartz and silica glass to demonstrate this distinction. Our point model explains interference without pretending to contain silica coordinates or measured silica spectra.

cues.title: 不同取向平均成环与峰
cues.titleEn: Orientation averaging produces rings and peaks
cues.caption: 粉末取向平均的强度由同一批三维点之间的距离计算。
cues.captionEn: Powder-averaged intensity is calculated from pair distances in the same three-dimensional cluster.
cues.zh: 单晶斑点和粉末曲线也要分清。粉末包含许多取向，取向平均后可以形成衍射环，再用随散射变量变化的曲线表示。这里用三维点的成对距离计算这个平均，环图和曲线共享同一组强度。绿色对应周期结构，棕色对应无序对照。有限尺寸会展宽峰，不能把峰宽全部解释成化学成分变化。
cues.en: Distinguish single-crystal spots from powder curves. Many orientations contribute to rings, which can also be expressed as intensity versus scattering variable. Pair distances in a three-dimensional cluster calculate that orientational average here; rings and curves share the same intensities. Green denotes periodic structure and brown the disordered comparison. Finite size broadens peaks, so width alone does not identify a chemical change.

cues.title: 候选坐标必须解释强度
cues.caption: 移动一个候选氧原子，重新计算衍射强度，误差下降。
cues.captionEn: Moving one candidate oxygen recomputes the diffraction intensities and reduces the mismatch.
cues.zh: 有机结构测定并不是把衍射图当作分子照片。先看一个透明的教学例子：固定参考强度，只有一个氧原子的候选位置可以调整。模型真的重新计算每个反射，再逐步减小误差。其他坐标和组成在这里已经给定；真实研究还要解决相位、对称性和更多参数，不能由这一根滑块完成完整结构反演。
cues.en: Diffraction is not a molecular photograph. In this deliberately transparent example, reference intensities remain fixed while one candidate oxygen position changes. Each reflection is recalculated and the mismatch is reduced step by step. Composition and all other coordinates are already supplied. Real structure determination must resolve phases, symmetry and many more parameters; one slider cannot solve the full inverse problem.

cues.title: 从精修坐标量出键长与键角
cues.titleEn: Measure bonds and angles from refined coordinates
cues.caption: 青蒿素示例的键长、键角由公开精修坐标计算。
cues.captionEn: Published refined coordinates determine the artemisinin example’s bond lengths and angles.
cues.zh: 最后回到教材列举的青蒿素。这里使用另一项公开研究的精修坐标，保留十五个碳和五个氧，氢为清晰起见省略。突出过氧桥，再量出邻接键角，读数始终由同一组三维坐标得到。这不是教材历史发现的原始数据，也不能只凭这组测量就宣称所有绝对构型信息都已确定。
cues.en: Return to the textbook’s artemisinin example. This model uses refined coordinates from a separate published study, showing fifteen carbons and five oxygens while omitting hydrogens for clarity. Highlight the peroxide bridge, then measure its neighboring angle from the same three-dimensional coordinates. These are not the historical discovery data, and this dataset alone does not establish every aspect of absolute configuration.

cues.title: 水先蒸发，再冷凝
cues.caption: 非挥发性盐留在原液，水蒸气冷凝后收集。
cues.captionEn: Nonvolatile salts stay behind while water vapour is condensed and collected.
cues.zh: 从海水中得到淡水，可以先利用挥发性的差别。水变成蒸气，进入连接的冷凝通道，冷却后流入接收器。原液减少，接收器中的水增加，盐仍留在原液。这里假设盐不挥发，也没有液滴夹带；蒸发并不等于已经收集到水，冷凝和接收同样是过程的一部分。
cues.en: Desalination can begin with a difference in volatility. Water becomes vapour, enters the connected condenser and reaches the receiver as liquid. The feed shrinks as collected water increases, while nonvolatile salt remains behind. This model omits droplet entrainment. Evaporation alone is not collection: condensation and a connected receiver complete the path.

cues.title: 水的自然渗透
cues.caption: 在没有外加压力差时，水净流向较浓的盐水一侧。
cues.captionEn: Without an imposed pressure difference, water flows toward the more concentrated saline side.
cues.zh: 换成一层允许水通过、对盐有较强阻挡的膜。两侧压力相等时，水的自然净流向是从稀的一侧到浓的一侧。这一方向图只表示瞬时通量，没有模拟随后液位差的建立。盐点代表溶解的离子，水点则让跨膜方向容易看清；它们不是实际分子大小或浓度的计数。
cues.en: Now introduce a membrane that transmits water much more readily than salt. At equal pressure, the net water flow is from the dilute side toward the saline side. This is an instantaneous direction diagram; it does not simulate the later buildup of a liquid-height difference. Salt and water markers make the distinction visible, without representing true molecular sizes or concentrations.

cues.title: 用压力改变净方向
cues.caption: 盐水侧的压力差超过渗透压差，净产水方向反转。
cues.captionEn: When pressure on the saline side exceeds the osmotic difference, the net water flow reverses.
cues.zh: 逐渐提高盐水侧的压力，观察箭头何时改变方向。压力差必须克服渗透压差，才得到反渗透产水。本片用二十五摄氏度的理想氯化钠等效模型估算渗透压；每升三十五克对应约三十巴。这个数用来解释方向关系，不能替代真实海水组成、活度和装置运行数据。
cues.en: Raise the pressure on the saline side and watch the arrow reverse. The pressure difference must overcome the osmotic difference to produce reverse-osmosis water. An ideal sodium-chloride-equivalent model at about twenty-five degrees Celsius gives roughly thirty bar for thirty-five grams per litre. It explains the direction relation, not real seawater activities or plant operating requirements.

cues.title: 两股物流都要保留
cues.caption: 产水增加，原液变浓；压力不变时，产水驱动力逐渐减小。
cues.captionEn: As permeate is removed, the feed concentrates and the driving force decreases at fixed pressure.
cues.zh: 跟踪一百升起始盐水。透过水逐渐被收集，剩余液体的盐度升高，渗透压也升高，因此相同压力下的产水速度逐渐变小。左右液位与下方体积使用同一份物料账本。盐透过率很低但不严格为零，所有水量和盐量都保留在产水与浓缩液两侧。
cues.en: Follow an initial hundred litres of saline feed. Removing permeate raises the remaining salt concentration and osmotic pressure, reducing production at a fixed applied pressure. The liquid levels and volume readouts use one material balance. Salt passage is small but not exactly zero. Both water and salt remain accounted for between permeate and concentrate.

cues.title: 剩下的盐还有去向
cues.caption: 海水利用还包括制盐及镁、溴等资源的开发。
cues.captionEn: Seawater use also includes salt production and recovery of resources such as magnesium and bromine.
cues.zh: 淡水不是海水利用的唯一产品。教材把食盐、镁盐和溴化物等连接到不同的化工产品。画面保留这些不同分支：氯化钠可作为烧碱和纯碱工业的原料，镁盐和溴化物也有各自的后续过程。箭头表示原料关系，不表示一股浓缩液必然按这个顺序生产，也不承诺全部资源都能经济回收。
cues.en: Freshwater is only one use of seawater. The textbook connects sodium chloride, magnesium salts and bromides with different chemical products. Sodium chloride can feed industries producing sodium hydroxide and sodium carbonate; magnesium and bromine require their own processes. These arrows show resource relationships, not a compulsory process sequence or a promise that every dissolved resource can be recovered economically.

cues.title: 比较四类膜
cues.caption: 微滤、超滤、纳滤和反渗透的选择性不同。
cues.captionEn: Microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration and reverse osmosis differ in selectivity.
cues.zh: 沿教材图示比较四类膜。微滤主要截留较大的分散颗粒；超滤能保留许多大分子，而溶解盐通常仍可通过。纳滤对部分溶解物的截留更强，反渗透则可以实现较高的脱盐。右侧标记深浅只是选定的教学透过份额；真实表现还取决于分子尺寸、电荷、膜材料及运行条件，不能只看一个孔径数字。
cues.en: Compare the four membrane classes from the textbook. Microfiltration retains larger dispersed particles. Ultrafiltration retains many macromolecules while dissolved salts usually pass. Nanofiltration rejects some dissolved species more strongly, and reverse osmosis can achieve high salt rejection. Marker opacity represents chosen teaching fractions. Actual separation also depends on charge, material and operating conditions, not a single pore-size number.

cues.title: 看一层致密选择层
cues.caption: 反渗透膜的选择性不能仅用刚性筛孔解释。
cues.captionEn: A reverse-osmosis selective layer is not adequately explained as a rigid sieve.
cues.zh: 把反渗透膜放大，看到的是致密高分子选择层的示意，而不是把水和盐按圆球大小硬塞过孔洞。水与盐在材料中的传递能力有很大差别，压力提供净产水驱动力。不同膜的化学结构和表面性质会改变选择性。图中弯曲线条只表示高分子材料，不是测得的链构象或原子级运输轨迹。
cues.en: Zoom into a schematic dense polymer selective layer. Water and salt are not simply hard balls sorted through a rigid opening; their transport through the material differs greatly. Pressure supplies the net water-production drive. Membrane chemistry and surface properties affect selectivity. The curved lines stand for polymer material, not measured chain conformations or atomistic transport trajectories.

cues.title: 浓缩液也可以是产品
cues.titleEn: The retained stream can be the product
cues.caption: 选择性移走水，可以在保留溶质的同时浓缩原液。
cues.captionEn: Selective water removal can concentrate retained solutes.
cues.zh: 最后改变目标：如果需要的是被保留的成分，浓缩液也可以成为产品。示意体系中溶质标记数保持不变，水移走后，它们在更小的体积里变得更密。教材列举了果汁、乳制品和药物等膜分离应用，但这些过程并不全都采用反渗透，也不使用完全相同的驱动力。应先明确保留什么，再选择合适的膜。
cues.en: Change the objective: the retained material can be the desired product. Here the solute markers stay while water removal reduces their volume, increasing concentration. The textbook mentions membrane applications in juices, dairy products and medicines. They do not all use reverse osmosis or identical driving forces. First decide what should be retained, then consider an appropriate membrane.

cues.title: 完整分子离开
cues.caption: 碘分子之间分开，I—I 连接保留。
cues.captionEn: Iodine molecules separate while their I—I bonds remain.
cues.zh: 跟住金色环线标记的碘分子。它与邻近分子的距离增加，分子之间的虚线逐渐消退，但两个碘原子之间的实线一直保留。这里比较的是两种连接层次：把分子从分子晶体中分开，并不等于把分子拆成原子。排列与运动是教学示意，不是碘晶体的精确晶格或分子轨迹。
cues.en: Follow the ringed iodine molecule. Its distance from neighboring molecules grows and the dashed intermolecular connections fade, but the solid bond joining its two atoms remains. Separating molecules from a molecular solid does not require splitting each molecule into atoms. This arrangement and path illustrate connectivity; they are not a refined iodine crystal or molecular dynamics.

cues.title: 冰中也保留水分子
cues.caption: 实线连接一个水分子；虚线连接不同水分子。
cues.captionEn: Solid bonds define each water molecule; dashed bonds connect different molecules.
cues.zh: 再看冰。红色是氧，浅色小球是氢。中心水分子内部保留两条氧氢共价键；周围的四条氢键则把它与另外四个水分子联系起来。氢键形成延伸网络，仍然可以沿共价键识别独立的水分子。不能因为画面出现了网络，就把所有连线都叫作共价键。
cues.en: Now look at ice. Oxygen is red and hydrogen is pale. The central molecule has two internal oxygen–hydrogen covalent bonds, while four hydrogen bonds link it to four neighboring molecules. An extended hydrogen-bond network can still contain identifiable water molecules. A connected drawing does not make every connection covalent.

cues.title: 共价连接延伸出去
cues.titleEn: Covalent bonds extend through the solid
cues.caption: 每个内部碳原子连接四个近邻，网络向视野外延续。
cues.captionEn: Each interior carbon has four neighbors, and covalent connectivity extends beyond the view.
cues.zh: 金刚石改变了连接方式。先看环线中的碳：四条共价键指向四面体的四个方向。视野中的其他连接逐渐显现，相邻碳又继续连接其他碳，形成三维网络。这里不能像碘一样划出一个个独立的分子。边缘短虚线表示观察范围以外还有连接，不是晶体真实存在的一圈游离末端。
cues.en: Diamond changes the bonding pattern. Four covalent bonds leave the ringed carbon in tetrahedral directions. As the surrounding bonds appear, neighboring carbons continue the same three-dimensional network. There are no separate molecular units like the iodine pairs. Short dotted boundary stubs mean that the structure continues beyond this selected viewing region.

cues.title: 比例不等于分子
cues.titleEn: A ratio is not a molecule
cues.caption: 硅连四个氧，桥氧连两个硅：Si∶O = 1∶2。
cues.captionEn: Silicon bonds to four oxygens; each bridging oxygen links two silicons.
cues.zh: 石英中的金色球是硅，红色球是氧。每个内部硅连接四个氧，而一个桥氧又连接两个硅。把连接共享的关系算进去，硅和氧的数目比是一比二。画面从发表的室温石英坐标构建，因此四面体的转向和连续连接来自同一套结构。SiO₂ 在这里表示组成比例，不是一群各含三个原子的独立分子。
cues.en: In quartz, gold spheres are silicon and red spheres are oxygen. Each interior silicon bonds to four oxygens, and each bridging oxygen connects two silicons. This sharing gives a silicon-to-oxygen ratio of one to two. Published room-temperature quartz coordinates determine the actual orientations and connections. Here SiO₂ denotes composition, not separate three-atom molecules.

cues.title: 高硬度仍可断裂
cues.caption: 共价网络分成两部分，跨越分离面的键必须断开。
cues.captionEn: Separating the covalent network requires breaking bonds across the cut.
cues.zh: 最后沿金刚石的一组解理方向观察。跨越选定平面的键先被标出并断开，保留下来的两部分再分离；各部分内部的键长没有被任意拉长。这个几何演示说明，分开共价网络涉及断键。金刚石抗划伤能力很强，却仍可能劈裂。硬度与抗破碎能力是不同性质；这里不预测需要多大的力。
cues.en: Finally, inspect one diamond cleavage direction. Bonds crossing the chosen plane are highlighted and removed before the two pieces separate. Bonds within each piece retain their lengths. Splitting a covalent network involves bond breaking. Diamond strongly resists scratching, yet it can cleave: hardness and resistance to fracture are different properties. This geometric model does not predict the required force.

cues.title: 先检验两种近中性的盐
cues.caption: 玻璃棒点到干燥试纸后才出现酸碱性读数。
cues.captionEn: A reading appears after a rod sample touches dry paper.
cues.zh: 先看氯化钠和硝酸钾。这里另定相同温度和零点一摩尔每升的分析浓度，用玻璃棒点样，干燥试纸接触后才显色。普通试纸只显示近似整数；两种溶液在模型中近中性，但不能因此推断所有盐都中性。
cues.en: Start with sodium chloride and potassium nitrate at an added design of equal temperature and 0.1 molar analytical concentration. A glass rod transfers each sample to dry pH paper, which gives approximate integer readings. Both are near neutral in this model; that does not establish neutrality for every salt.

cues.title: 弱酸的盐可以呈碱性
cues.titleEn: Salts of weak acids can be basic
cues.caption: 碳酸根、醋酸根参与酸碱平衡，溶液呈碱性。
cues.captionEn: Carbonate and acetate participate in equilibria that make the solutions basic.
cues.zh: 再检验碳酸钠与醋酸钠。它们的阴离子能够接受质子，平衡中氢氧根增加。碳酸根还需要考虑逐级变化，不能把所有碳都画成同一种粒子。试纸颜色支持酸碱性判断，不会告诉我们每种离子的精确数量。
cues.en: Now test sodium carbonate and sodium acetate. Their anions accept protons, increasing equilibrium hydroxide. Carbonate also requires sequential equilibria rather than representing all carbon as one species. Paper color supports an acidity classification without precisely counting every ion.

cues.title: 铵盐给出相反的方向
cues.titleEn: Ammonium salts give the opposite direction
cues.caption: 两种铵盐呈酸性，但溶液整体仍电中性。
cues.captionEn: Both ammonium salts are acidic while remaining electrically neutral overall.
cues.zh: 氯化铵和硫酸铵则呈酸性。铵根参与质子转移，改变氢离子与氢氧根的相对浓度。酸性并不是整杯溶液带正电；所有正负电荷总量仍然相等。硫酸铵还包含硫酸氢根平衡，不能把它简单删去。
cues.en: Ammonium chloride and ammonium sulfate are acidic. Proton transfer changes hydrogen-ion relative to hydroxide concentration. Acidity does not mean the whole solution carries positive charge: total positive and negative charges remain equal. The sulfate sample also includes bisulfate equilibrium rather than deleting that contribution.

cues.title: 保留参照，只改变温度
cues.titleEn: Retain a reference and change temperature
cues.caption: 升温的方向用受限的一阶水解模型说明。
cues.captionEn: A restricted first-step model illustrates the temperature direction.
cues.zh: 两管从相同硫酸铁溶液开始，右管升温，左管保持二十五度。画面只计算第一步水相水解，用来分清温度与组成的关系。模型读数不是仪器实测；真实铁盐还有络合、多核物种和固相，不能只凭颜色认定一种产物。
cues.en: Start with equal ferric-sulfate samples. Warm the right while holding the reference at twenty-five degrees. This restricted first-aqueous-step model separates temperature from composition. Its readings are not measurements. Real iron also has complexes, polymeric species and solids, so color alone cannot identify a single product.

cues.title: 稀释增加比例，却降低浓度
cues.titleEn: Dilution raises fraction but lowers concentration
cues.caption: 总铁量不变，加水后的比例与浓度有不同变化。
cues.captionEn: With total iron fixed, dilution changes fraction and concentration differently.
cues.zh: 换一组相同初态，向右管加水，保留左边参照。总铁量没有增加，体积却增大。所示水解比例上升，同时水解物种的浓度可以降低。颜色变浅不等于水解比例变小，这两个量必须分别判断。
cues.en: Reset to equal initial samples and add water only to the right. Total iron stays fixed while volume increases. The hydrolyzed fraction rises, yet the concentration of hydrolyzed species can fall. A lighter color therefore does not necessarily indicate a smaller hydrolyzed fraction.

cues.title: 晶体改变总铁量
cues.caption: 晶体进入液体后，浓度与水解比例一起重算。
cues.captionEn: After crystals enter, concentration and hydrolyzed fraction are recalculated.
cues.zh: 再向右管分次加入硫酸铁晶体。每份晶体进入溶液后，铁和硫酸根总量才增加，平衡重新计算。这次改变的是反应物总量。颜色同时受总浓度和物种比例影响，不能用颜色深浅单独代替水解程度。
cues.en: Add ferric-sulfate crystals to the right sample. Iron and sulfate totals increase only after each portion enters, then equilibrium is recalculated. This intervention changes reactant amount. Color depends on both total concentration and species fractions, so it cannot independently measure hydrolysis extent.

cues.title: 加酸改变平衡条件
cues.caption: 右管加酸，一阶水解模型中的比例降低。
cues.captionEn: Adding acid lowers the first-step hydrolyzed fraction.
cues.zh: 这里用另行设定的稀硫酸作受控比较。酸进入右管，液量和酸度都改变，所示水解受到抑制。它说明调节酸度的方向，不能把这种稀溶液计算直接套到下一项活动规定的浓硫酸条件。
cues.en: This controlled comparison uses an explicitly added dilute-sulfuric-acid design. Delivery changes volume and acidity, suppressing the represented hydrolysis. It illustrates the direction of acid control; the dilute calculation must not be transferred directly to the concentrated-acid conditions in the next activity.

cues.title: 按活动用量观察酸化
cues.titleEn: Observe acidification at the activity quantities
cues.caption: 5 mL 水溶解晶体，再加入 2 mL 浓硫酸。
cues.captionEn: Dissolve crystals in 5 mL water, then add 2 mL concentrated sulfuric acid.
cues.zh: 实验活动先让少量硫酸铁晶体进入五毫升水，再加入两毫升浓硫酸。晶体溶解、加酸路径和总体积都保留，但浓酸阶段不显示精密 pH。这种酸化抑制水解的思路，也用于解释氯化铁溶液的配制。
cues.en: The activity dissolves a small amount of ferric-sulfate crystals in five milliliters of water, then adds two milliliters of concentrated sulfuric acid. Dissolution, acid delivery and total volume remain visible, without a precise concentrated-acid pH. The acid-suppression principle also helps explain preparing ferric-chloride solution.

cues.title: 三份泥水，保留原空白
cues.caption: 铁盐和铝盐组加料，空白保持原来的 5 mL。
cues.captionEn: Iron and aluminum samples receive reagent; the blank stays at 5 mL.
cues.zh: 三份泥水都从五毫升开始。两组分别加入两毫升饱和氯化铁和一摩尔每升硫酸铝，另一组按教材不加料。这样总体积不同。探索中可以另给空白加入等体积水，进一步检查单纯稀释对观察的影响。
cues.en: Begin with three five-milliliter muddy-water samples. Add two milliliters of saturated ferric chloride or one molar aluminum sulfate to two samples; leave the textbook blank unchanged.
