Their final volumes differ. Exploration can add equal water to the blank to examine the dilution contribution.

cues.title: 跟踪同一批颗粒沉降
cues.titleEn: Follow the same particles through settling
cues.caption: 在明确假设的加料后 pH 下，凝聚使沉降加快。
cues.captionEn: Under an explicit post-dose pH assumption, aggregation accelerates settling.
cues.zh: 看同一批细颗粒先聚集，再更快沉降，颗粒没有凭空消失。这里明确假设加料后 pH 为六点五，五分钟观察被压缩播放。泥土缓冲能力未给出，教材剂量不能保证这个条件；探索可改为酸性，观察凝聚为何可能受阻。
cues.en: Follow the same particles as they aggregate and settle faster, without disappearing. This illustration explicitly assumes pH 6.5 after dosing and compresses five minutes of observation. Soil buffering is unspecified, so the textbook dose cannot guarantee that condition. Exploration tests acidic conditions that may inhibit aggregation.

cues.title: 沸水中逐滴制备胶体
cues.titleEn: Prepare colloid dropwise in boiling water
cues.caption: 铁盐滴入沸水，形成细小分散相后停止加热。
cues.captionEn: Iron salt enters boiling water; stop heating after the dispersed phase forms.
cues.zh: 另一项活动用四十毫升沸水，逐滴加入五到六滴饱和氯化铁；这里取六滴。继续煮沸，看到红褐色后停止加热。细小分散相仍留在水中，不等于所有铁立即沉到底部；饱和浓度未给出，所以模型按等剂量单位追踪铁。
cues.en: Another activity uses forty milliliters of boiling water and five or six drops of saturated ferric chloride; this view uses six. Continue boiling, then stop when red-brown forms. Fine dispersed material remains suspended. With stock concentration unspecified, the model tracks equal iron-dose units rather than inventing moles.

cues.title: 只加热其中一管
cues.caption: 同样纯碱与油量，比较冷热处理。
cues.captionEn: Compare cold and heated treatments with equal carbonate and oil quantities.
cues.zh: 两管各有五毫升饱和纯碱，并加入同样的植物油。仅右管加热煮沸，再振荡。加热会影响水解、油脂反应和去除过程。油膜百分数是教学示意，不是测得的去污率；真正的观察还要等倒掉、冲洗之后。
cues.en: Both tubes contain five milliliters of saturated carbonate and equal vegetable oil. Heat only the right, then shake. Heating affects hydrolysis, lipid reaction and removal. Film percentages are teaching illustrations, not measured cleaning efficiencies. The actual comparison still requires discarding the liquids and rinsing.

cues.title: 冲洗之后再比较内壁
cues.caption: 液体沿管口流出，冲洗后保留可比较的油膜。
cues.captionEn: Liquid exits through the mouth, leaving comparable wall films after rinsing.
cues.zh: 最后分别倾倒两组，再用水冲洗，比较留下的内壁油膜。液面始终保持水平，超过较低管口的液体才流入废液杯，管内量和废液量相加保持守恒。观察的是相同处理之后的残留，而不是把油在动画里直接删除。
cues.en: Drain and rinse both treatments, then compare the remaining inner-wall films. The surface stays horizontal; only liquid exceeding the lower lip enters the waste beaker. Retained liquid plus waste conserves volume. The comparison concerns residue after matched treatment, rather than deleting oil from the animation.

cues.title: 同为液体，挥发性不同
cues.caption: 教材的三种氯代甲烷具有不同的常压沸点。
cues.captionEn: The three chloromethanes have different normal boiling points.
cues.zh: 教材以甲烷氯代后的液态混合物说明蒸馏。二氯甲烷、三氯甲烷和四氯化碳的常压沸点大约为四十、六十二和七十七摄氏度。这些是各纯物质的参照值。混合液不会简单地等到每个参照温度，就让某一种物质单独全部蒸出；下一步要分别观察液相和汽相组成。
cues.en: The textbook illustrates distillation with a liquid mixture of chlorinated methanes. Its approximate normal boiling points are forty, sixty-two and seventy-seven degrees Celsius. These are pure-substance reference values. A mixture does not wait for each reference temperature and then release only one completely pure component. We need to examine liquid and vapour compositions separately.

cues.title: 蒸气与液体组成不同
cues.caption: 易挥发组分在蒸气中富集，其他组分仍可同时存在。
cues.captionEn: The more volatile component is enriched in the vapour, while others are also present.
cues.zh: 比较瓶内液体和刚形成的蒸气。较易挥发的二氯甲烷在汽相中的份额更大，但另外两种组分并没有被完全排除。颜色条来自同一个汽液平衡教学模型。这里假设液体理想混合，按蒸气压差计算分配，因此显示的是富集机制，不是这份真实样品的精确分离效果。
cues.en: Compare the flask liquid with the newly formed vapour. Dichloromethane occupies a larger vapour fraction because it is more volatile, but the other components remain present. Both colour bars come from one teaching vapour–liquid equilibrium model. Ideal mixing is assumed. The display explains enrichment rather than predicting the exact separation of a real sample.

cues.title: 沿连续通路冷凝
cues.caption: 蒸气经蒸馏头进入冷凝管，再成为接收器中的液体。
cues.captionEn: Vapour passes through the head and condenser before entering the receiver as liquid.
cues.zh: 跟踪一个标记：它从烧瓶上升，经蒸馏头转入向下倾斜的冷凝通道，冷却后成为液滴，流向开放接收器。内管运输样品，外套中的冷却水沿另一条通路交换热量，两股流体没有混合。模型用同一条中心线推导移动轨迹，接收量增加时，烧瓶中的物质量相应减少。
cues.en: Follow a marker from the flask through the distillation head and down the condenser. Cooling produces liquid drops that reach the open receiver. Sample travels inside the inner tube, while coolant follows a separate jacket path. They exchange heat without mixing. The marker follows the apparatus centreline, and collection is deducted from the flask material account.

cues.title: 温度计观察哪里
cues.caption: 感温部位在蒸气出口附近，读数对应经过的蒸气。
cues.captionEn: The sensing region is near the vapour outlet and reads the passing vapour.
cues.zh: 把视线移到温度计的感温部位。它位于蒸馏头侧出口的高度附近，观察正经过这里的蒸气，而不是直接测加热器或烧瓶底部。随着瓶中组成变化，混合物的平衡温度也可以变化。图示数值采用理想模型，并忽略蒸馏头的热损失和温度计的响应延迟。
cues.en: Look at the thermometer sensing region near the side outlet of the distillation head. It observes passing vapour rather than the heater or flask bottom. As the flask composition changes, the mixture equilibrium temperature can also change. The displayed number follows the ideal model and omits heat losses in the head and thermometer response delay.

cues.title: 把不同时间段分开
cues.caption: 分段收集得到不同组成的馏分；每份仍可能是混合物。
cues.captionEn: Separate collection intervals give different compositions, each still potentially a mixture.
cues.zh: 现在把收集过程分成三个连续时间段。每个接收器中的色带高度表示各组分的物质的量，不表示它们在容器里真的分成了三层。前段相对富集二氯甲烷，后段组成逐渐改变。一次简单蒸馏并不保证三个纯品；需要更高分离程度时，必须重新考虑分馏、回流和纯度检验。
cues.en: Split collection into three consecutive intervals. Coloured heights account for the amount of each component; they do not indicate three physical liquid layers. The earlier cut is richer in dichloromethane and later composition changes. One simple distillation does not guarantee three pure products. Higher separation may require fractionation, reflux and an independent purity check.

cues.title: 瓶内剩余液体改变
cues.caption: 易挥发组分不断移走，瓶内组成与后续蒸气随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Removing the volatile component changes both the residue and subsequent vapour.
cues.zh: 返回烧瓶。每收集一小份蒸气，都从原有组分账本中扣除对应物质量，因此易挥发组分逐渐减少，剩余液体的组成改变。后来的蒸气也不能继续沿用最初的组成。三个接收段与烧瓶中的每种组分分别守恒，颜色变化来自这一连续计算，而不是按章节预设三个纯物质。
cues.en: Return to the flask. Every small vapour increment subtracts the corresponding component amounts from the feed, gradually depleting the more volatile species. Subsequent vapour must be recalculated from the changing residue. Each component is conserved across the flask and three collection cuts. The colours follow this continuous account rather than assigning a pure substance to each chapter.

cues.title: 没有冷凝的独立对照
cues.caption: 在无冷凝的模型对照中，汽化量不算作已收集液体。
cues.captionEn: In the no-condensation model, evaporated material is not counted as collected liquid.
cues.zh: 最后开启一份独立模型对照：起点重新置为同样的混合物，但不把蒸出的物质冷凝为接收液。液态收集量保持为零，汽化物仍保留在未冷凝物料账本中。这不是建议中断实际实验的冷却，而是检验模型是否把汽化和收集误认为同一件事。三种含氯溶剂也不作为家庭实验材料。
cues.en: Start a separate counterfactual trial with the same initial mixture but no condensation into the receiver. Collected liquid stays at zero, while evaporated material remains in the uncondensed account. This checks that evaporation is not mistaken for collection. It is not a suggestion to interrupt cooling during an experiment, nor a household procedure using these chlorinated solvents.

cues.title: 共有的价电子
cues.caption: 离域价电子属于整块金属，正离子实保持有序排列。
cues.captionEn: Delocalized valence electrons are shared across the ordered metal lattice.
cues.zh: 金色球表示金属的正离子实，柔和的蓝绿色区域表示被整个金属共有的离域价电子。它不是每个原子旁边固定的一对电子，也不是实际拍到的一层液体。这个简化图先抓住金属键的特点：电子不局限在某两个原子之间，正离子实与电子系统共同维持金属的结合。
cues.en: Gold spheres represent positive ion cores, while the blue-green region represents valence electrons shared across the metal. These are not fixed electron pairs between particular atoms, and the colored region is not a photographed liquid. This simplified picture highlights delocalization: the ion cores and electronic system together hold the metal together.

cues.title: 滑移时仍然结合
cues.caption: 同一排原子连续越过相邻排，模型不让硬球互相穿透。
cues.captionEn: A row slides past its neighbor without hard-sphere interpenetration.
cues.zh: 看金色环线中的离子实随原子层移动。滑移中，两侧原子仍处在共有电子区域里。画面根据最近邻的间距给出很小的抬升，避免把球直接画成互相穿过；移动一个周期后，又回到等价排列。真实金属的塑性变形常由位错运动逐步完成，这里只是层滑移的几何示意，不计算受力大小。
cues.en: Follow the ringed ion core as its layer slides. Both sides remain within the shared-electron region. A small lift, derived from nearest-neighbor spacing, prevents the spheres from passing through one another. After one period the packing is equivalent again. Real plastic deformation commonly proceeds through dislocations; this is a geometric layer-slip demonstration, not a force calculation.

cues.title: 无规则运动叠加漂移
cues.caption: 电子平均速度与电场相反，常规电流与电场同向。
cues.captionEn: Mean electron drift opposes the field; conventional current follows it.
cues.zh: 这次用速度分布观察电子。浅绿曲线以零速度为中心；施加电场后，新的分布向负速度一侧偏移，竖虚线标出平均速度。并不是每个电子都只向同一个方向运动，而是大量运动叠加后出现一个较小的平均漂移。电子带负电，所以它的平均漂移方向和常规电流相反。
cues.en: Now examine a velocity distribution. The pale reference curve is centered at zero. With an electric field, the new curve shifts toward negative velocity; its dashed marker shows the mean. Individual electrons do not all move in one direction. A net drift emerges from the distribution, and the electron’s negative charge makes this drift oppose conventional current.

cues.title: 更短的弛豫时间
cues.caption: 电场相同，散射模型中的弛豫时间缩短，电流减小。
cues.captionEn: At the same field, a shorter relaxation time reduces the current.
cues.zh: 保持同一个电场，观察相对温度增加的对照。教学模型让散射更频繁，弛豫时间缩短，平均漂移更接近零，电流随之减小。曲线也按经典模型展宽，但真实金属中的电子需要量子统计来描述。这里表达常见金属在声子散射占主要作用时的趋势，不把它推广成所有材料、所有温度都服从的定律。
cues.en: Keep the field fixed while increasing relative temperature. In this teaching model, stronger scattering shortens the relaxation time, bringing mean drift closer to zero and reducing current. The classical curve also broadens, although real metal electrons require quantum statistics. This illustrates a common phonon-dominated metallic trend, not a universal temperature law for all materials.

cues.title: 同一层保留共价连接
cues.titleEn: A sheet keeps its covalent bonds
cues.caption: 石墨层内 C—C 为 142 pm，层间距离约 335 pm。
cues.captionEn: Graphite has 142 pm in-plane C—C bonds and about 335 pm between layers.
cues.zh: 石墨的碳原子组成平面六元环，每个内部碳连接三个近邻。把相邻层一起显示出来，会看到层间距离远大于层内碳碳距离。跟住带环线的碳，它所在的一层整体移动，层内的共价连接仍然保留。层间结合较弱，与层内容易划分出不同的连接层次；画面没有把层间虚构成一排排共价键。
cues.en: Carbon atoms in graphite form planar hexagonal networks, with three neighbors around each interior carbon. Adjacent sheets reveal a much greater interlayer separation than the in-plane bond length. Follow the ringed carbon while its whole sheet moves: the sheet’s covalent bonds remain intact. The weaker interlayer interaction is not represented as a row of invented covalent bonds.

cues.title: 平行轨道侧向重叠
cues.caption: p 轨道垂直于碳平面；两色表示相位，不是电荷。
cues.captionEn: p orbitals stand normal to the carbon plane; colors denote phase, not charge.
cues.zh: 靠近同一个六元环，看看每个碳平面两侧的轨道截面。未参与平面杂化的 p 轨道相互平行，侧向重叠，对应离域的 π 电子结构。蓝色和金色代表相反相位，不代表两团正、负电荷。这个轨道图用来解释连接方向，不能把它当作一条电子按固定路线绕环奔跑的轨迹。
cues.en: Move closer to a six-membered ring and inspect orbital sections on both sides of the carbon plane. Parallel p orbitals overlap sideways and contribute to the delocalized π electronic structure. Blue and gold denote opposite phases, not positive and negative charges. These shapes explain orbital orientation; they are not fixed paths followed by electrons around the ring.

cues.title: 跨层较弱，仍然非零
cues.caption: 转动电场，电导明显改变；跨层电导不等于零。
cues.captionEn: Rotating the field changes conductivity; cross-plane conductivity remains nonzero.
cues.zh: 把电场从沿着层面逐渐转向垂直层面。两支箭头只标方向，数字给出沿电场的归一化电导。中间角度下，电流甚至不必与电场平行。最后跨层电导明显较小，但仍然非零。教材用强弱对比介绍石墨；真实实验已经测得跨层输运，因此不能把简化图读成电子绝对无法跨层。
cues.en: Rotate the field from within the sheets toward their normal. The arrows show directions only; the number gives conductivity along the field. At intermediate angles, current need not be parallel to the field. Cross-plane conductivity ends much smaller, but remains nonzero. Experiments have measured cross-plane transport, so the textbook’s strong contrast should not be read as an absolute prohibition.

cues.title: 先有两个液相
cues.caption: 液液萃取需要能分开的两个液相。
cues.captionEn: Liquid–liquid extraction needs two separable liquid phases.
cues.zh: 教材介绍的液液萃取，先要求两种溶剂形成能够分开的两个液相。这里用水相和有机相示意，棕色标记代表待分离溶质，最初在水相中。颜色只帮助识别，不对应教材照片里某一种具体药品。若两种溶剂完全混合成一个相，就不能再按这张两层图进行分液。
cues.en: The textbook’s liquid–liquid extraction begins with two solvents forming separable phases. Water and an organic phase are shown schematically, with brown solute markers initially in water. Colours identify roles rather than specific chemicals from the textbook photograph. If the solvents form one homogeneous phase, the two-layer separation shown here no longer applies.

cues.title: 比较两相浓度
cues.caption: 达到分配平衡时，溶质通常仍同时存在于两相中。
cues.captionEn: At distribution equilibrium, solute usually remains in both phases.
cues.zh: 让两相接触，溶质向有机相转移，直到满足选定的分配关系。注意两边仍然都有溶质。这里选定有机相与水相的浓度比为四，但有机相体积只有水相的一半，因此转移的物质量不能直接按四比一判断。画面与读数同时使用浓度、体积和总量守恒来计算。
cues.en: Contact allows solute to transfer until the chosen distribution relation is reached. Both phases still contain solute. The organic-to-water concentration ratio is set to four, but the organic volume is only half the aqueous volume. Transferred amounts therefore cannot be inferred from a four-to-one concentration ratio alone. Concentrations, volumes and conservation are calculated together.

cues.title: 密度决定上下位置
cues.caption: 分配关系与上下层身份是两个不同的问题。
cues.captionEn: Distribution and upper-versus-lower layer identity are different questions.
cues.zh: 并排比较两份独立的示意体系。左边有机相比水轻，位于上层；右边有机相比水重，位于下层。为单独比较密度，两图采用相同的分配关系，所以溶质份额不随上下位置改变。不能把下层固定叫作水层，也不能仅凭颜色判断目标物在哪一层。
cues.en: Compare two independent schematic systems. The organic phase is lighter than water on the left and denser on the right. Both deliberately use the same distribution relation to isolate the density effect, so solute fractions remain the same when layer order changes. The bottom layer is not automatically water, and colour alone does not identify the desired material.

cues.title: 把下层单独收集
cues.caption: 分液改变两相的位置，不会把溶质全部变到某一侧。
cues.captionEn: Separating layers relocates them without forcing all solute into one phase.
cues.zh: 两相重新分层后，打开通气的上口和下活塞，观察下层液体进入接收器。漏斗中的液面和界面随实际流出体积下降，到下层边界为止。接收液也带走它原本含有的溶质，因此物料账本始终包含漏斗两相和接收器。分液是物理转移，不是又发生了一次化学转化。
cues.en: After the layers separate, an open upper vent and lower stopcock let the lower layer enter the receiver. Surface and interface heights follow the drained volume, stopping at the lower-layer boundary. The receiver also gains the solute already dissolved in that liquid. Both funnel phases and the receiver remain in the account: draining is physical transfer, not a new chemical conversion.

cues.title: 空气也需要进入
cues.caption: 上口封闭时，顶空气压下降，液体难以持续流出。
cues.captionEn: With the upper opening sealed, falling headspace pressure restricts sustained outflow.
cues.zh: 改看一份上口封闭的独立对照。刚开始可以流出一点液体，但顶空气体随之膨胀、压力下降，很快抵消液柱的驱动力。读数不是硬设为零，而是由气体压力和两层液体的静压共同计算。教材要求分液时打开上方玻璃塞，正是让空气补入，避免这一压力限制。
cues.en: In a separate trial the upper opening is sealed. A small initial outflow expands the headspace gas and lowers its pressure, soon opposing the liquid head. The result is calculated from gas pressure and the hydrostatic contributions of both layers rather than simply forcing flow to zero. Opening the upper stopper permits replacement air and removes this pressure restriction.

cues.title: 分次用新鲜溶剂
cues.caption: 相同总溶剂量分成多份，常可提高累计萃取份额。
cues.captionEn: Dividing the same solvent total into fresh portions can improve cumulative extraction.
cues.zh: 保持总溶剂量相同，比较一次接触与三次使用新鲜溶剂。每一次都让剩余水相重新和一份新鲜有机相分配，单次转移量越来越小，但累计回收份额可以更大。这个比较使用恒定分配比、完全分层和忽略操作损失的理想边界；它不表示无限增加次数就总是最经济。
cues.en: Keep the total solvent volume fixed and compare one contact with three fresh portions. Each portion equilibrates with the remaining aqueous phase. The extracted amount per contact decreases, yet cumulative recovery can increase. This comparison assumes a constant distribution ratio, complete phase separation and no handling losses. More contacts are not necessarily the most economical choice.

cues.title: 从固体中溶出
cues.titleEn: Extract a component from a solid
cues.caption: 固液萃取让可溶组分进入溶剂，固体基质仍可留下。
cues.captionEn: Solid–liquid extraction transfers soluble material into solvent while the matrix can remain.
cues.zh: 教材还介绍固液萃取。现在取消第二个液相，换成含有待提取组分的固体。溶剂使其中一部分溶质溶出，棕色基质保持不变。这里的进度是选定的溶出份额，不是某种植物或药物的真实速率。关键是区分被溶出的组分和留下的基质，不能把整块固体都当作自动消失。
cues.en: The textbook also introduces solid–liquid extraction. Replace the second liquid with a solid containing an extractable component. Solvent removes part of that component while the matrix remains. Progress represents a chosen dissolved fraction, not the measured kinetics of a plant or medicine. The distinction is between extracted solute and retained matrix, rather than making the entire solid disappear.

cues.title: 接通石墨电极
cues.caption: 负极析铜，正极产生气体。
cues.captionEn: Copper deposits at the negative electrode; gas forms at the positive one.
cues.zh: 先看百分之二十五的氯化铜溶液，两根石墨棒分别接直流电源的负极和正极。合上电路后，负极表面出现铜，正极产生气体。这些产物对应当前的电极与溶液条件，不能直接推广到所有电解液。
cues.en: Two carbon rods in twenty-five-percent copper chloride connect to the negative and positive supply terminals. Closing the circuit produces copper at the negative electrode and gas at the positive. These products depend on the stated electrodes and solution, rather than applying to every electrolyte.

cues.title: 区分两段载流路径
cues.caption: 导线中的电子流与溶液中的离子迁移相接。
cues.captionEn: Electron flow in conductors connects to ionic migration in solution.
cues.zh: 导线中的亮点表示电子流方向。溶液中的两种标记分别表示铜离子与氯离子的迁移方向。它们在电极界面完成得失电子的反应；电子没有从一根石墨棒穿过液体，直接游到另一根。
cues.en: Bright wire markers indicate electron flow. The two liquid markers indicate copper-ion and chloride migration. Electron-transfer reactions connect these paths at the electrode interfaces. Electrons do not swim directly through the electrolyte from one carbon rod to the other.

cues.title: 气体真正到达试纸
cues.caption: 阳极气体上升并接触湿润的 KI–淀粉试纸。
cues.captionEn: Anode gas rises and reaches moist KI–starch paper.
cues.zh: 跟踪阳极旁产生的气体：先穿过液体，再从管口到达湿润的碘化钾淀粉试纸，试纸随后变蓝。在这些已知条件下，这与氯气生成相一致；试纸不是绝对专一的氯气检测器，干燥时不显蓝也不能说明没有气体。
cues.en: Follow gas from the anode through the liquid and out of the tube to moist iodide–starch paper. Blue appears after contact. Under the known conditions this supports chlorine formation. The paper is not absolutely chlorine-specific, and dry paper failing to respond does not exclude gas production.

cues.title: 用电量核对产物
cues.caption: 理想情况下，每 2 mol 电子对应 1 mol 铜和 1 mol 氯气。
cues.captionEn: Ideally, two moles of electrons correspond to one mole each of copper and chlorine.
cues.zh: 把观察时间压缩到十分钟。另设平均电流零点二安，电量是一百二十库仑。若电流效率为百分之百，理论析铜约三十九点五毫克，同时生成等物质的量的氯气。放大剖面显示微米级铜层，主装置不把它画成厚块。
cues.en: Compress ten minutes of observation. An assumed mean current of 0.2 ampere transfers 120 coulombs. At full current efficiency, about 39.5 milligrams of copper deposits, with an equal molar amount of chlorine. The magnified section shows micrometer-scale coating rather than a thick block on the apparatus.

cues.title: 先准备铁件表面
cues.caption: 打磨后除油，取出并用蒸馏水冲洗。
cues.captionEn: Abrade, degrease, lift out and rinse with distilled water.
cues.zh: 电镀活动从同一件铁样开始。砂纸打磨之后，把它浸入一摩尔每升的氢氧化钠除油，再提离杯口，移到蒸馏水中冲洗。油污减少发生在接触处理液之后，不能靠切换画面让污层凭空消失。
cues.en: Begin plating preparation with one iron specimen. Abrade it, immerse it in one-molar sodium hydroxide for degreasing, then lift it clear and transfer to distilled water. Oil removal follows contact with the treatment solution, while the same specimen remains visible throughout.

cues.title: 除锈与第二次冲洗
cues.caption: 20% 盐酸除锈之后，铁件再次水洗。
cues.captionEn: After rust removal in 20% hydrochloric acid, rinse the iron again.
cues.zh: 接着用百分之二十的盐酸除去锈层，取出后再次用蒸馏水冲洗。酸处理、清洗和后面的电镀是不同环节。每次转移先提起铁件越过杯口，实际操作的观察与时间仍应记录，动画没有代替这份实验数据。
cues.en: Next, twenty-percent hydrochloric acid removes rust, followed by another distilled-water rinse. Acid treatment, rinsing and plating are separate operations. Lift the specimen above each rim before transfer. Actual observations and treatment times still belong in your experimental record; the animation does not supply measured data.

cues.title: 正确连接两块电极
cues.caption: 铁接负极、铜接正极，两极相距约 5 cm。
cues.captionEn: Iron is negative, copper positive, with about 5 cm separation.
cues.zh: 把铁件接负极，铜片接正极，平行放置、相距约五厘米。教材要求二到三伏直流电，通电五到十分钟。这里显示二点五伏，平均电流另作输入；不能只看电压就认定真实电流大小。
cues.en: Connect iron to the negative terminal and copper to the positive, parallel and about five centimeters apart. The activity specifies two to three volts for five to ten minutes. This view shows 2.5 volts, with mean current supplied separately rather than inferred from voltage alone.

cues.title: 铜从阳极补进溶液
cues.titleEn: Copper replenishes the bath from the anode
cues.caption: 铜阳极损失与阴极获得相等，浴液总铜保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Anode loss equals cathode gain, preserving total bath copper.
cues.zh: 铜阳极溶解进入电镀液，铜离子在铁阴极得到电子。理想条件下，铜片失去的质量等于铁件镀上的铜。用同一电量核算两边，浴液总铜保持不变。放大视图的厚度还取决于另行设定的有效面积。
cues.en: Copper dissolves from the anode while copper ions gain electrons at the iron cathode. Ideally, anode mass loss equals copper deposited on the specimen, leaving total bath copper unchanged. Both use the same charge calculation. The magnified thickness also depends on the explicitly assumed active area.

cues.title: 把接线反过来
cues.caption: 铁成为阳极而溶解，铜在铜电极上析出。
cues.captionEn: Iron dissolves as the anode while copper deposits on the copper electrode.
cues.zh: 现在只反接电源。铁件成为正极连接的阳极并溶解，铜则在另一块铜电极上析出。即使电源仍然工作，得到的也不是原本想要的铁件镀铜。电极名称由反应决定，不能把某种金属永久叫作阳极或阴极。
cues.en: Reverse only the supply connections. Iron becomes the positive-connected, dissolving anode; copper deposits on the copper electrode. The powered cell no longer produces the intended iron coating. Electrode names follow the reactions, rather than assigning one metal permanently to anode or cathode.

cues.title: 断路不是所有反应停止
cues.titleEn: An open circuit does not stop every reaction
cues.caption: 外部电量为零，铁仍可局部置换铜离子。
cues.captionEn: External charge is zero, yet iron can locally displace copper ions.
cues.zh: 断开外电路，导线中的电子流停止。但铁仍接触铜离子，可能发生铁置换铜的局部反应，出现铜色沉积。这里的速度只是示意。仅凭铁表面有铜，不能判断完成了受电源控制的电镀。
cues.en: Open the external circuit and wire current stops. Iron still contacts copper ions, allowing a local displacement reaction that can leave copper-colored material. Its rate here is illustrative. Copper on the surface alone does not prove that controlled electroplating occurred.

cues.title: 相同电量，不同表面
cues.caption: 被遮挡区域不沉积，理想铜量集中到有效面积。
cues.captionEn: Masked regions do not deposit; ideal copper is concentrated on active area.
cues.zh: 最后固定同样的电量，比较清洁表面与部分被油污遮挡的表面。简化模型让相同铜量分布在不同有效面积上：遮挡处空缺，其余位置更厚。真实附着力与晶粒品质还受电镀液和工艺影响，不能由这一示意图直接判断。
cues.en: Hold total charge fixed and compare clean with partly oil-masked surfaces. The simplified model distributes equal copper mass over different active areas, leaving gaps and thicker active regions. Actual adhesion and grain quality also depend on bath chemistry and processing, and cannot be inferred from this illustration alone.

cues.title: 共同的蓝色来自哪里
cues.titleEn: What gives the shared blue color?
cues.caption: 三种铜盐溶于足量水后呈蓝色，另三种盐作对照。
cues.captionEn: Three copper salts become blue in ample water; three other salts serve as controls.
cues.zh: 先比较六种固体。无水硫酸铜、二水合氯化铜、溴化铜的固体颜色不同，加入足量水后，它们的溶液都呈蓝色。下面的氯化钠、硫酸钾和溴化钾溶液没有这样的蓝色。这个对照把共同现象指向水合铜离子，而不是只凭一种盐的颜色猜测。这里强调足量水；浓度和其他配体改变时，铜盐溶液的颜色也可能改变。
cues.en: Compare six solids. Anhydrous copper sulfate, copper chloride dihydrate and copper bromide begin with different colors, yet form blue solutions in ample water. Sodium chloride, potassium sulfate and potassium bromide do not show that blue. The control points to hydrated copper ions rather than one particular counterion. Ample water matters: concentration and competing ligands can change the color.

cues.title: 少量氨水先沉淀
cues.titleEn: A little ammonia first precipitates copper
cues.caption: 先出现浅蓝色 Cu(OH)₂ 沉淀。
cues.captionEn: A pale-blue Cu(OH)₂ precipitate appears first.
cues.zh: 向硫酸铜溶液先加少量氨水，注意出现的是浅蓝色的难溶物。氨在水中表现碱性，产生的氢氧根使氢氧化铜沉淀。它和随后出现的深蓝色澄清溶液不是同一种状态。图中保留同一份铜，只改变它在水合离子、沉淀与配合物之间的分配。
cues.en: Add a small amount of aqueous ammonia to copper sulfate. The new material is a pale-blue insoluble solid. Ammonia acts as a base in water, enabling copper hydroxide precipitation. This state differs from the deep-blue clear solution that appears later. The model keeps the same copper inventory while changing its allocation among solution and solid phases.

cues.title: 再加氨水，沉淀溶解
cues.caption: 继续加氨水并混匀，得到深蓝色澄清溶液。
cues.captionEn: Further ammonia and mixing produce a deep-blue clear solution.
cues.zh: 继续加氨水并混匀，原来的沉淀逐渐减少，溶液变成深蓝色。这次氨同时作为配体，与铜形成较稳定的配合物，使溶解过程得以继续。加水对照不会产生同样的深蓝色配合变化。颜色只是观察证据，不能单凭深浅就认定配合物的精确浓度或结构。
cues.en: Continue adding ammonia and mix. The precipitate diminishes as the solution becomes deep blue. Ammonia now also acts as a ligand, stabilizing dissolved copper complexes and allowing dissolution to continue. Adding water does not produce the same deep-blue complexation change. Color is evidence, but its shade alone does not determine an exact concentration or structure.

cues.title: 回看配体替换
cues.caption: 铜中心保持，水与氨的配位原子发生替换。
cues.captionEn: The copper center remains while water donors are replaced by ammonia donors.
cues.zh: 把刚才的变化放大回看。金环标记同一个铜中心，四个赤道方向上的水配体离开，氨从不同方向接近，以氮的孤电子对参与配位。两端淡色的水提示额外轴向配位。教材用四氨合铜的简写突出四个氨，真实溶液的配位环境还会随条件变化。这里的分步路线是解释用的连续示意，不是实际反应轨迹。
cues.en: Revisit the change in close-up. The gold ring tracks the same copper center as four equatorial water ligands leave and ammonia approaches through separate paths. Nitrogen donates a lone pair for coordination. Pale axial waters remind us that the textbook’s tetraammine shorthand omits additional solvation. Actual coordination depends on conditions. These continuous staged paths explain replacement; they are not measured reaction trajectories.

cues.title: 深蓝晶体再出现
cues.caption: 加入乙醇并摩擦管壁，析出配合物晶体。
cues.captionEn: Ethanol and scratching the tube wall promote complex crystallization.
cues.zh: 在深蓝溶液中加入乙醇，并用玻璃棒摩擦管壁。现在出现的深蓝晶体，是四氨合铜硫酸盐的水合物，不是最初浅蓝色的氢氧化铜。改变溶剂环境后，配合物可以从溶液中结晶出来。晶体形状和数量是示意，实际成核、溶解度和产率还取决于实验条件。
cues.en: Add ethanol to the deep-blue solution and scratch the tube wall with a glass rod. The new deep-blue crystals are hydrated tetraamminecopper sulfate, not the original pale copper hydroxide. Changing the solvent environment permits crystallization of the complex salt. Crystal shapes and counts are illustrative; actual nucleation, solubility and yield depend on conditions.

cues.title: 先得到白色银盐
cues.titleEn: First form a white silver salt
cues.caption: 氯化钠溶液与硝酸银形成 AgCl 白色沉淀。
cues.captionEn: Sodium chloride and silver nitrate form white AgCl precipitate.
cues.zh: 再换一支试管。向氯化钠溶液中滴加硝酸银，两种本来澄清的溶液产生白色氯化银沉淀。这一步先建立要比较的固体。接下来加入氨水时，我们要观察这同一份银的去向，而不是把溶液变澄清简单理解成银已经不见了。
cues.en: Take another tube. Adding silver nitrate to sodium chloride turns two initially clear solutions into a white silver chloride precipitate. This establishes the solid for the next comparison. When ammonia is added, follow where the same silver goes: clearing the solution does not mean the silver has disappeared.

cues.title: 配位推动溶解
cues.caption: 形成 [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺，降低游离 Ag⁺，推动 AgCl 溶解。
cues.captionEn: Forming [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ lowers free Ag⁺ and promotes AgCl dissolution.
cues.zh: 随着游离氨增加，白色沉淀减少，银进入含二氨合银离子的澄清溶液。代表结构中，两个氨配体位于银的两侧。计算同时使用氯化银的溶度积和银氨配合物的形成常数。若氯离子背景较高，或者氨不足，沉淀仍可能保留；所以“加入氨水”并不自动保证任何数量的银盐全部溶解。
cues.en: As free ammonia increases, white solid diminishes and silver enters a clear solution containing diamminesilver ions. Its representative linear structure has ammonia ligands on opposite sides of silver. The calculation combines AgCl solubility with complex formation. More background chloride or insufficient ammonia can leave solid behind: adding ammonia does not guarantee dissolution of unlimited silver chloride.

cues.title: 同含铁，反应仍不同
cues.titleEn: Iron in different environments reacts differently
cues.caption: FeCl₃ 与铁氰化钾接受同样的 SCN⁻ 检验，结果不同。
cues.captionEn: FeCl₃ and ferricyanide give different results under the same SCN⁻ test.
cues.zh: 最后给两份含铁样品加入同样的硫氰化钾。氯化铁一侧出现红色配合显色；铁氰化钾一侧在这些短时条件下没有明显红色。后者溶液中主要是完整的六氰合铁配离子，不能把它等同于同量的游离三价铁。配位环境改变了化学性质，这正是这组对照要揭示的区别。
cues.en: Finally, add the same thiocyanate reagent to two iron-containing samples. The ferric chloride sample develops the red complex color, while ferricyanide shows no obvious red under these short-duration conditions. Its iron remains predominantly within the hexacyanoferrate complex rather than behaving as the same amount of free ferric ion. Coordination changes chemical behavior.

cues.title: 把三种物质分开记账
cues.caption: 粗苯甲酸中的泥沙、氯化钠和苯甲酸需要不同去向。
cues.captionEn: Sand, sodium chloride and benzoic acid need different destinations.
cues.zh: 教材的粗苯甲酸含有少量氯化钠和泥沙。不能只把它们统称为杂质后一起消失：泥沙难溶，氯化钠易留在水中，苯甲酸的溶解度则随温度明显变化。本片用一克粗品作总量基准，选定九成苯甲酸，余下为盐和泥沙；这个比例是模型设定，不是教材给出的成分分析。
cues.en: The textbook sample contains benzoic acid with small amounts of sodium chloride and sand. They cannot simply disappear together as impurities. Sand is insoluble, salt remains readily dissolved, and benzoic-acid solubility varies strongly with temperature. The model uses a one-gram reference sample with a chosen ninety-percent acid content, not a composition measured by the textbook.

cues.title: 加热增加溶解量
cues.caption: 升温时更多苯甲酸进入溶液，泥沙仍留下。
cues.captionEn: Heating dissolves more benzoic acid while sand remains.
cues.zh: 观察升温过程中固体苯甲酸变少，溶液中的标记增加。教材给出的溶解度是二十五、五十和七十五摄氏度时，每一百克水分别溶解零点三四、零点八五和二点二克。模型在这三个点之间插值。加热并不是使泥沙消失，也不意味着所有溶质在任何水量下都能完全溶解。
cues.en: As temperature rises, solid acid decreases and dissolved markers increase. The textbook gives solubilities of zero point three four, zero point eight five and two point two grams per hundred grams of water at twenty-five, fifty and seventy-five degrees Celsius. The model interpolates between these anchors. Heating does not remove sand or guarantee complete dissolution at every solvent quantity.

cues.title: 热过滤保留泥沙
cues.caption: 泥沙留在滤纸上，溶解的苯甲酸和盐进入滤液。
cues.captionEn: Sand stays on the filter while dissolved acid and salt enter the filtrate.
cues.zh: 沿玻璃棒引流，热溶液经过滤纸。泥沙被截留，已经溶解的苯甲酸和氯化钠通过。趁热的作用，是尽量让苯甲酸仍保持溶解。自由探索中可以降低过滤温度：提前析出的苯甲酸会跟泥沙一起留在滤纸上，减少后续可回收量。这里不把滤纸当作能拦住所有溶质的细筛。
cues.en: The hot solution follows a glass rod through filter paper. Sand is retained while dissolved acid and sodium chloride pass. Keeping the solution hot helps retain the acid in solution. Lowering the filter temperature in exploration makes acid crystallize prematurely and remain with the sand, reducing later recovery. Filter paper does not block every dissolved substance.

cues.title: 冷却后仍有溶解损失
cues.caption: 冷却降低溶解容量，部分苯甲酸析晶，部分仍在母液。
cues.captionEn: Cooling reduces solubility, forming crystals while some acid remains in the mother liquor.
cues.zh: 让澄清滤液慢慢冷却。苯甲酸的溶解容量下降，超过容量的部分进入晶体。在示意的五十毫升水中，二十五摄氏度仍可保留约零点一七克苯甲酸。因此析出晶体并不意味着全部目标物都已回收。针片只是晶体外形示意，不预测实际成核速度、颗粒数和尺寸。
cues.en: Let the clear filtrate cool. Lower solubility transfers excess benzoic acid into crystals. The model’s fifty millilitres of water can still hold about zero point one seven grams at twenty-five degrees Celsius, so crystal formation does not mean complete recovery. The drawn needles illustrate crystal appearance rather than predicting nucleation, particle count or size.

cues.title: 这次保留的是晶体
cues.caption: 再次过滤时，晶体保留，母液携带盐和部分苯甲酸离开。
cues.captionEn: The second filtration retains crystals while mother liquor carries salt and some acid away.
cues.zh: 再次过滤，但这次要保留的对象换成晶体。母液携带氯化钠和仍溶解的苯甲酸进入接收器。刚过滤的晶体表面通常还带着少量母液；如果直接把水蒸干，附着的可溶杂质也会留在固体上。下一步洗涤处理的是这部分附着母液，不能只根据晶体颜色认定已经纯净。
cues.en: Filter again, now retaining the crystals. Mother liquor carries sodium chloride and dissolved benzoic acid into the receiver. Freshly filtered crystals can retain some adhering liquor. Drying it directly leaves its soluble impurities on the solid. Washing addresses this retained liquor; appearance alone does not establish purity.

cues.title: 洗涤存在取舍
cues.caption: 少量冷水带走附着母液，但也会溶走部分苯甲酸。
cues.captionEn: A small cold wash removes adhering liquor but also dissolves some benzoic acid.
cues.zh: 用冷水洗涤，模型中的残留氯化钠减少，同时有少量苯甲酸进入洗液。继续增加水量，可以进一步减少表面盐，但会增加目标物的溶解损失。这份账本选定晶体上滞留两毫升液体，并假设洗液充分混合；这些用于展示取舍，不是对真实滤饼滞液和洗涤效率的测量。
cues.en: A cold wash reduces retained sodium chloride while some benzoic acid enters the wash liquid. More water can remove more surface salt but also increases product loss. This account chooses two millilitres of retained liquid and perfect mixing during the wash. Those assumptions illustrate the trade-off rather than measuring real filter-cake retention or washing efficiency.

cues.title: 分清收率与纯度
cues.caption: 干燥固体质量除以粗品质量是教材的收率，不等于纯度。
cues.captionEn: The textbook recovery is dry solid divided by crude sample mass; it is not purity.
cues.zh: 将晶体干燥后再称量。教材把所得晶体质量除以原粗品质量，作为重结晶收率。它与苯甲酸纯度不同：收率回答拿回多少固体，纯度回答这些固体里有多少是苯甲酸。模型分别显示两个数，也单独保留母液、洗液和热过滤中的损失，所以不会用漂亮的大晶体代替质量核算。
cues.en: Dry the collected solid before weighing. The textbook defines recovery as crystal mass divided by initial crude mass. This differs from purity: recovery asks how much solid was recovered, while purity asks how much of it is benzoic acid. The model displays both and retains losses in mother liquor, wash liquid and hot filtration as separate accounts.

cues.title: 用化学证据检查盐
cues.caption: 氯离子可用氯化银反应检验；检测结果仍有灵敏度边界。
cues.captionEn: Chloride can be tested through silver chloride formation, subject to detection limits.
cues.zh: 教材最后要求思考如何检验氯化钠是否除净。可将所得固体的一小份溶于适当溶剂，在稀硝酸酸化条件下检验氯离子与银离子生成氯化银的现象。模型把残留盐映射为反应可能量，不给出肉眼检测限。没有看到沉淀，只能在方法灵敏度范围内解释，不能证明氯离子严格为零。
cues.en: The textbook asks how to check removal of sodium chloride. A dissolved sample can be tested under dilute-nitric-acid conditions for silver chloride formation. The model maps residual salt to a possible reaction amount without assigning a visual detection limit. No visible precipitate must be interpreted within the method’s sensitivity, not as proof of exactly zero chloride.

cues.title: 耗氧改变水柱
cues.titleEn: Oxygen uptake changes the water column
cues.caption: 密闭、恒温条件下，耗氧压降推动外部水上升。
cues.captionEn: In a sealed isothermal setup, oxygen uptake lowers pressure and raises external water.
cues.zh: 除锈铁钉沾上饱和食盐水，放进密闭具支试管。氧气被消耗后，气相压强下降，外面的水沿导管上升。模型同时计算水移入后的气相压缩与外部液面下降；漏气或温度变化都会干扰这项证据。
cues.en: Cleaned nails moistened with saturated salt solution sit in a sealed side-arm tube. Oxygen consumption lowers pressure and raises external water through the connected tube. The model includes gas compression and the reservoir-level change. Leaks or temperature changes can interfere with this evidence.

cues.title: 先保留相同起点
cues.caption: 相同锌粒、等体积等浓度稀盐酸，先观察基线。
cues.captionEn: Equal zinc samples and equal dilute acid establish the baseline.
cues.zh: 再取两组锌粒，加入等体积、等浓度的稀盐酸，先观察两边析氢。这里另设每组两颗锌共零点五克、五毫升零点五摩尔每升的酸。两组从同一条件出发，后面才有可比较的改变。
cues.en: Place equal zinc samples in equal volumes and concentrations of dilute acid and observe hydrogen evolution first. This added design uses two granules totaling half a gram and five milliliters of half-molar acid per sample. The matched starting conditions make the later intervention comparable.

cues.title: 铜析出之后才加速
cues.caption: 一组滴入硫酸铜，铜接触锌后，析氢变快。
cues.captionEn: Copper sulfate enters one sample; copper–zinc contact accelerates hydrogen release.
cues.zh: 只向一组加两滴硫酸铜。液滴先进入溶液，铜离子在锌表面被还原，析出的铜与锌接触，使析氢加快。速率只是示意，但锌、铜和氢离子数量保持守恒。不要漏掉铜离子先发生置换这一步。
cues.en: Add two copper-sulfate drops to one sample. They enter the liquid before copper ions reduce onto zinc. The resulting contact accelerates hydrogen evolution. Kinetics are illustrative, while zinc, copper and hydrogen-ion inventories remain balanced. The initial displacement of copper ions is essential to the explanation.

cues.title: 让锌供电子
cues.caption: 锌氧化，电子沿金属通路到达铁。
cues.captionEn: Zinc oxidizes and supplies electrons to iron through the metallic path.
cues.zh: 把铁和锌接入同一酸化的百分之三氯化钠溶液，并通过导线相连。锌成为牺牲阳极，电子沿金属通路到达铁，支持铁表面的还原反应。电流表在这里只表示电流方向与有无，不是实测电流数值。
cues.en: Connect iron and zinc through a conductor in acidified three-percent sodium chloride. Zinc becomes the sacrificial anode, supplying electrons to reduction at the iron surface. The meter illustrates current direction and presence, rather than displaying a measured current.

cues.title: 取样之后再加检验剂
cues.titleEn: Sample first, then add the test reagent
cues.caption: 比较独立试验：Fe—Zn 与仅 Fe 的铁附近取样。
cues.captionEn: Compare separate iron-region aliquots from Fe—Zn and iron-alone trials.
cues.zh: 分别看连接铁锌与只有铁的两次试验。从铁附近吸取一毫升，提起后移到检验试管，再加两滴铁氰化钾。铁单独腐蚀产生的亚铁离子可显蓝色。保护组不显蓝，支持腐蚀受到抑制，但不能证明真实腐蚀严格为零。
cues.en: Compare independent connected iron–zinc and iron-alone trials. Aspirate one milliliter near iron, lift and transfer it, then add two ferricyanide drops. Ferrous ions from the iron-alone trial give blue. A negative protected sample supports suppression, but does not prove exactly zero real corrosion.

cues.title: 先制备观察介质
cues.caption: 琼脂在盐水与水的混合液中加热溶解，再稍冷。
cues.captionEn: Dissolve agar by heating the salt–water mixture, then cool slightly.
cues.zh: 将一克琼脂加入五十毫升饱和食盐水和一百五十毫升水，搅拌加热溶解，稍冷后分装培养皿。按教材，每皿加入五到六滴酚酞和铁氰化钾，再放入处理好的铁钉。下一步比较两种金属接触。
cues.en: Dissolve one gram of agar by stirring and heating fifty milliliters of saturated salt solution with 150 milliliters of water. Cool slightly and divide into dishes. Add five or six drops each of phenolphthalein and ferricyanide before introducing prepared nails for the metal-contact comparison.

cues.title: 观察裹锌的铁钉
cues.caption: 铁附近的阴极反应产生局部碱性，酚酞显粉红。
cues.captionEn: Cathodic reaction near protected iron creates local alkalinity and pink phenolphthalein.
cues.zh: 先看裹锌皮的铁钉。锌与铁保持金属接触，锌优先失去电子，铁附近的阴极区域产生局部碱性，酚酞显粉红。粉红色并不是铁在这里溶解的证据；它与另一种指示剂的蓝色有不同含义。
cues.en: First inspect the zinc-wrapped nail. Metallic contact allows zinc to oxidize preferentially. Cathodic regions near iron become locally alkaline, turning phenolphthalein pink. Pink is not evidence of iron dissolving there; it has a different meaning from the other indicator’s blue response.

cues.title: 铜接触改变腐蚀区域
cues.titleEn: Copper contact changes the corrosion regions
cues.caption: 铁附近的蓝色提示 Fe²⁺，铜附近可出现阴极粉红。
cues.captionEn: Blue near iron indicates Fe²⁺; cathodic pink may appear near copper.
cues.zh: 换成缠铜丝的铁钉。铁更容易成为阳极，进入凝胶的亚铁离子与铁氰化钾产生蓝色检验现象；铜附近的阴极区域可显粉红。色团还会扩散，不能把每一个有色位置精确对应成一个铁原子离开的地点。
cues.en: With a copper-wrapped nail, iron more readily acts as the anode. Ferrous ions entering the gel give a blue ferricyanide test, while cathodic regions near copper may turn pink. Diffusion changes the pattern, so each colored location is not an exact map of atom release.

cues.title: 仅仅相邻还不够
cues.caption: 分离与接触是两次独立比较，电子通路改变保护关系。
cues.captionEn: Separate trials compare isolation and contact; the electronic path changes protection.
cues.zh: 再比较锌片只是放在旁边和锌片实际接触铁的两次试验。共同接触凝胶提供离子通路，还需要金属之间的电子通路，才形成所示保护关系。画面重置代表另一份试样，不表示后来接上锌就能抹掉已经生成的蓝色。
cues.en: Compare zinc merely nearby with zinc in metallic contact, using independent specimens. Shared gel supplies an ionic path, but an electronic connection is also needed for the illustrated protection. The reset represents another trial, not removal of an already formed blue product by attaching zinc later.

cues.title: 先确定组成与变量
cues.caption: 虚拟配方用于控制变量，实际研究另记数据。
cues.captionEn: The virtual formula supports controlled comparisons; actual research requires its own data.
cues.zh: 暖贴任务要求查资料、比较组成、制作并提出改进。这里用一组明确标注的虚拟配方，分清铁粉、活性炭、盐、水和蛭石的作用。先选一个要改变的条件，保持其余条件可比；这份模型配方不是推荐的实物制作方案。
cues.en: The warmer task calls for research, composition comparisons, construction and improvement. An explicitly virtual formula separates iron, carbon, salt, water and vermiculite. Choose one variable and keep other conditions comparable. This numerical example is not a recommended physical fabrication recipe.

cues.title: 打开外包装，氧进入内袋
cues.titleEn: Opening the outer package admits oxygen
cues.caption: 铁氧化放热，内袋的透气性限制供氧。
cues.captionEn: Iron oxidation releases heat; inner-pouch permeability limits oxygen supply.
cues.zh: 打开外包装后，氧气经过透气内袋到达湿润的铁粉，铁逐渐氧化并放热。内袋不是纯粹的装饰，它影响供氧。探针显示的是模型温度，剩余铁和氧的输入、消耗也一起计算，不能把画面数值当成商品性能。
cues.en: After the outer package opens, oxygen crosses the inner pouch and reaches moist iron powder. Oxidation releases heat, while permeability limits oxygen supply. The probe shows model temperature; remaining iron and oxygen entry and consumption are tracked together. These values are not product-performance measurements.

cues.title: 温度不是累计放热量
cues.caption: 放热一部分储存在材料中，另一部分散向环境。
cues.captionEn: Some released heat is stored; the rest flows to the environment.
cues.zh: 同一份样品一边放热，一边向环境散热。温度曲线由两者共同决定，并不等于累计放热量。模型逐步核对放热等于储热加散热。铁粉用量、含水、供氧和保温条件改变时，必须重新计算，不能只拉伸一条预设曲线。
cues.en: The sample generates heat while losing heat to its surroundings. Their balance determines temperature, which is not accumulated reaction heat. Each calculation checks released against stored plus lost energy. Changing iron, moisture, oxygen access or insulation recalculates the process rather than stretching a preset curve.

cues.title: 用对照组织实际研究
cues.caption: 供氧受限与缺水组检验条件，实测记录保持独立。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen-limited and dry controls test conditions; measured records remain separate.
cues.zh: 保留供氧受限与缺水的对照。封闭组仍有少量初始氧气，因此可以短暂反应，之后受限。真正研究要重复测量温度和时间，比较峰值、持续时间并改进设计，还要记录使用与冷却后的处置。这里三条线都是模型结果。
cues.en: Keep oxygen-limited and dry controls. The sealed sample contains a little initial oxygen, allowing brief reaction before limitation. Actual research repeats temperature–time measurements, compares peaks and duration, improves the design and records use and cooled-material disposal. All three curves here remain model results.

cues.title: 先看两个碳笼
cues.caption: C₆₀ 与 C₇₀ 的原子连接不同，不能只画成两个大小不同的球。
cues.captionEn: C₆₀ and C₇₀ have different atomic networks, not just different sphere sizes.
cues.zh: 先让两个碳笼转过来。一个有六十个碳原子，另一个有七十个，每个碳都连着三个邻居。金环一直追踪同一个原子，帮助你辨认形状。接下来要分离这两种相似分子，我们可以利用主体和客体之间不同的相互作用。
cues.en: Turn the two carbon cages. One contains sixty carbon atoms; the other has seventy. Each carbon connects to three neighbors, and a gold ring tracks one atom as the cage turns. To separate these similar molecules, we can exploit differences in how they interact with a surrounding host.

cues.title: 进入杯酚骨架
cues.caption: 主体与客体保持各自骨架；C₇₀ 也可以形成配合物。
cues.captionEn: Host and guest retain their own skeletons; C₇₀ can also form a complex.
cues.zh: 现在看杯酚骨架。同一个六十碳客体接近并落在主体上方，两个分子的共价连接仍各自保留。真实杯酚有取代基和多种构象，这里省略部分原子，突出主体的环状结构。不能把这幅图理解成七十碳绝对进不去：原始研究中，两种客体都能形成配合物，关键在于条件下的选择性。
cues.en: Watch the calixarene skeleton as the same sixty-carbon guest approaches. Host and guest keep their own covalent networks. Real calixarenes have substituents and multiple conformations; this drawing omits some atoms to reveal the ring. It is not a gate that absolutely excludes the seventy-carbon cage: the original study found complexes with both guests. Selectivity depends on conditions.

cues.title: 分离固相与液相
cues.titleEn: Separate the solid and liquid phases
cues.caption: 保留相富集 C₆₀，但仍含 C₇₀；比例来自示例平衡计算。
cues.captionEn: The retained phase is enriched in C₆₀ but still contains C₇₀; percentages are illustrative equilibrium results.
cues.zh: 教材用甲苯体系的过滤说明分离思路。主体配合物保留，游离客体随溶剂进入滤液。放大的分子标记只用来追踪去向，并不是滤纸孔径的比例图。下面的计算故意保留两种客体的竞争结合：保留相富集六十碳，却仍含七十碳。改变结合常数比，富集程度就会改变，不能把它当成实测纯度。
cues.en: The textbook uses filtration in toluene to explain the separation. Host complexes are retained while free guests pass into the filtrate. Enlarged molecular markers trace destinations; they do not represent pore size. The illustrative calculation allows both guests to compete for hosts, so the retained fraction is enriched in C sixty but still contains C seventy. Changing the binding-constant ratio changes enrichment, not a measured experimental purity.

cues.title: 改变环境，释放客体
cues.titleEn: Change the environment to release the guest
cues.caption: 同一客体离开主体，主体可以回收；分离效果仍取决于条件。
cues.captionEn: The same guest leaves and the host can be recovered; separation remains condition-dependent.
cues.zh: 再改变溶剂环境，观察带金环的同一个客体离开。教材以氯仿处理说明释放客体、回收主体的路线。模型把已结合的两种客体逐步转到释放份额，总量不变。实际溶解度、沉淀和纯度取决于具体条件，原始研究还使用了多次重结晶；一次释放并不意味着自动得到完全纯的样品。
cues.en: Change the solvent environment and follow the same gold-marked guest as it leaves. The textbook illustrates release and host recovery using chloroform. Our model transfers both bound guests into released pools without changing their totals. Actual solubility, precipitation and purity depend on conditions; the original study also used repeated recrystallization. One release step does not automatically give a completely pure sample.

cues.title: 用氧原子围住阳离子
cues.caption: 18-冠-6 有 18 个环原子，其中 6 个是氧。
cues.captionEn: 18-crown-6 has 18 ring atoms, including 6 oxygens.
cues.zh: 换到冠醚。十八冠六的环上共有十八个原子，其中六个红色原子是氧；每两个氧之间保留两个碳。钾离子接近环中心，氧原子的孤电子对参与配位。教材给出的空腔直径范围是二百六十到三百二十皮米，钾离子直径约二百七十六皮米。这是理解适配的起点，还不是结合强弱的完整答案。
cues.en: Now look at eighteen-crown-six. Its ring contains eighteen atoms, including six red oxygens, with two carbons between successive oxygens. A potassium ion approaches the center, where oxygen lone pairs can participate in coordination. The textbook gives a cavity range of two hundred sixty to three hundred twenty picometers and an approximate potassium-ion diameter of two hundred seventy-six. Size matching is a starting point, not a complete binding prediction.

cues.title: 空腔大小只是一个因素
cues.caption: 不同环的尺寸范围不同；柔性、溶剂和配位共同影响识别。
cues.captionEn: Rings have different cavity ranges; flexibility, solvent and coordination also affect recognition.
cues.zh: 把四种冠醚放在一起比较，环上的氧原子数和空腔范围都在变化。图中的四组搭配只是尺寸对照，不是宣称每种冠醚只能结合一种离子。自由探索时，可以把更大的离子放到较小的环上，观察它如何偏离环平面。真实冠醚会变形，溶剂和其他相互作用也参与决定稳定性；主客体识别不是僵硬的筛孔。
cues.en: Compare four crown ethers. Both the number of oxygen donors and the cavity range change. These pairings illustrate size, not exclusive binding to one ion. In exploration, place a larger ion beside a smaller ring and watch its position move away from the ring plane. Real crowns are flexible, and solvent and other interactions affect stability. Host–guest recognition is not a rigid sieve.

cues.title: 把混合物送入吸附柱
cues.caption: 植物色素随液体进入碳酸钙粉末，棉花支撑柱床。
cues.captionEn: Plant pigments enter a calcium carbonate bed supported by cotton.
cues.zh: 教材讲述茨韦特用玻璃管和碳酸钙粉末分离植物色素的历史实验。先看结构：底部棉花支撑粉末，液体可以从颗粒之间向下通过。色素混合物进入柱顶，形成最初重叠的色区。这里的碳酸钙是吸附剂，不是把所有溶解色素都截住的滤纸。
cues.en: The textbook describes Tswett’s historical separation of plant pigments using a glass tube packed with calcium carbonate. Cotton supports the powder while liquid passes through spaces between particles. The mixture enters near the top as overlapping colored material. Calcium carbonate acts as an adsorbent, not as filter paper that simply blocks every dissolved pigment.

cues.title: 移动与停留交替
cues.caption: 只有处于流动相的时间用于迁移；吸附停留降低平均速度。
cues.captionEn: Time spent adsorbed reduces average migration with the moving liquid.
cues.zh: 放大一段柱床。色素可以暂时吸附在固体表面，也可以回到流动液体中。画面跟踪两个示意组分：停留在固体上的份额越大，能随液体移动的份额越小。因此同样的液流速度，会产生不同的平均迁移速度。轨迹是教学用的周期停留示意，不是对单个分子随机运动的测量。
cues.en: Look closely at the column bed. A pigment can spend time adsorbed on solid and then return to the moving liquid. The two model components spend different fractions of their time mobile. More residence on the solid means slower average migration even under the same liquid flow. These periodic traces illustrate residence rather than measuring individual molecular motion.

cues.title: 把时间差变成位置差
cues.caption: 迁移速度不同，最初重叠的组分逐渐形成不同色带。
cues.captionEn: Different migration speeds turn an overlapping mixture into distinct bands.
cues.zh: 回到整根柱。让液体继续向下流动，最初重叠的三种教学组分逐渐错开。比较色带的位置与下方速度：保留较强的组分落后，保留较弱的组分更靠下。三个字母对应画面中的三种示意组分，不代表叶绿素、叶黄素和胡萝卜素在所有条件下都有同一种排列。
cues.en: Return to the whole column and follow the bands. Three illustrative components gradually separate as liquid continues downward. The more strongly retained component lags behind; the more weakly retained component moves farther. The letters A, B and C label model components, not a universal ordering of chlorophyll, xanthophyll and carotene under every solvent and adsorbent condition.

cues.title: 对照相同的保留
cues.caption: 将三者的保留设为相同，颜色重叠；扩大差异才能分开。
cues.captionEn: Equal retention produces overlapping bands; contrasting retention separates them.
cues.zh: 做一个对照：保持观察时间相同，先把三种组分的保留设为一样。它们就会一起移动，不能只靠换一种颜色在图上分开。逐渐恢复保留差异，色带才出现位置差。真实分离需要选择合适的流动相和固定相；这个滑动对照只改变理想模型的保留差异，并不预测某种具体溶剂。
cues.en: Compare the same migration time with equal retention for all three components. Their bands coincide: different drawing colors cannot create real separation. Gradually restore the retention contrast and their positions diverge. Real separation depends on the chosen mobile and stationary phases. This comparison changes ideal retention contrast without predicting the behavior of a particular solvent.

cues.title: 展宽会损害分离
cues.caption: 色带具有宽度，相邻分布重叠时，单一色层也可能含多种组分。
cues.captionEn: Bands have width: overlapping distributions can leave a colored zone as a mixture.
cues.zh: 色带不是没有厚度的线。用沿柱的位置分布来观察，展宽会让相邻色带重新重叠。数字表示两条模型分布的重叠程度，不是实验测得的纯度。一个看起来独立的色层仍可能带有其他组分，因此只凭颜色不能宣称得到绝对纯品。取层范围与后续分析同样重要。
cues.en: A band has width rather than being a perfectly thin line. These distributions show that spreading can make neighboring components overlap. The number measures overlap between two model distributions, not experimentally measured purity. A visibly colored zone can still contain another component, so color alone cannot establish absolute purity. Selection of the cut and later analysis also matter.

cues.title: 取出固体色层
cues.caption: 回到分开的色带，把吸附色素的碳酸钙分层取出。
cues.captionEn: Return to separated bands and remove the pigment-bearing calcium carbonate zones.
cues.zh: 回到已经较好分开的色带。教材记述的是把吸附了不同色素的碳酸钙分层取出。看清移动的对象：是带颜色的固体吸附剂，不是已经从柱底流出的三杯纯液体。图中的侧向展开用来显示各个固体层的归属，不表示真实操作中可以让固体穿过完整的玻璃管壁。
cues.en: Return to the more clearly separated bands. In the textbook’s historical account, the differently colored calcium carbonate zones are removed separately. Follow what moves: it is pigment-bearing solid adsorbent, not three pure liquid fractions already collected from the column outlet. The sideways exploded view identifies solid sections; it is not a literal procedure through an intact glass wall.

cues.title: 再从色层提取色素
cues.titleEn: Extract pigments from the removed zones
cues.caption: 乙醇接触取出的色层，色素从吸附剂转入液相。
cues.captionEn: Ethanol contacts the removed zones and transfers pigment into the liquid.
cues.zh: 最后，按教材记述，用乙醇从取出的色层中提取色素。观察固体颜色变淡，同时液体显色；同一组分在固体和液体之间转移，并没有凭空生成新色素。模型选定最终转移九成二来展示仍有残留，这不是茨韦特实验的实测收率。分离与提取相接，才能得到可继续研究的组分。
cues.en: Finally, as the textbook describes, ethanol extracts pigment from the removed colored adsorbent. The solid fades as the liquid gains color. Each component transfers between phases without creating new pigment. The model chooses ninety-two percent final transfer to retain a visible residue; this is not a measured yield from Tswett’s experiment. Separation and extraction together provide material for further study.
